items.desc: Goede documentatie is essentieel voor begrijpelijke en onderhoudbare software, zeker wanneer applicaties intensief met elkaar communiceren. Nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI maken het mogelijk om documentatie automatisch en contextgericht te genereren. In deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek en bouw je een Proof of Concept die communicatiestromen inzichtelijk maakt en documentatie structureel integreert in het ontwikkelproces. In welke sector je ook consultancydiensten aanbiedt, code moet duidelijk en beschrijvend zijn en goed worden gedocumenteerd. Voor dat laatste zijn er de afgelopen tijd veel ontwikkelingen geweest die het mogelijk maken om een klantoverstijgende documentatietechniek toe te passen. Wanneer communicatiestromen automatisch worden gedocumenteerd, ontstaat er meer overzicht en draagvlak bij andere afdelingen over opgeleverde functionaliteit en wordt achterstallige documentatie voorkomen. Er is veel vooruitgang geboekt op het gebied van AI en we zijn tegenwoordig in staat om deze via Context Engineering zeer klant- en applicatiespecifiek in te zetten als assistent. De opdracht Onderzoek in welke mate het overzicht over het landschap en de actualiteit van documentatie van verschillende stromen verbeterd kan worden. Doe dit door het automatisch genereren van documentatie, zoals diagrammen met bijvoorbeeld PlantUML of Mermaid, en contextuele toelichting met bijvoorbeeld Markdown. Dit zou geïntegreerd moeten worden in het ontwikkelingsproces. Dit betreft initieel documentatie voor een enkele applicatie, maar er zijn mogelijk ook kansen om communicatiestromen over meerdere applicaties heen inzichtelijk te maken, bijvoorbeeld door Model Context Protocols te integreren voor externe componenten of door het uitlezen van SwaggerDocs van koppelingen. Bouw hiervoor een Proof of Concept om dit aan te tonen. items.desc: Het opzetten van een microserviceslandschap volgens Domain Driven Design kost vaak veel tijd en vraagt om specifieke kennis. Wat als AI kan helpen bij het maken van cruciale ontwerpkeuzes? Tijdens deze opdracht onderzoek je hoe non-functional requirements kunnen worden gebruikt om automatisch de juiste patterns, frameworks en designprincipes te selecteren of zelfs software te genereren. Met jouw oplossing kunnen ontwikkelaars sneller en efficiënter aan de slag met complexe DDD-projecten. Domain Driven Design (DDD) biedt een reeks patterns die afhankelijk van de gewenste non-functional requirements (NFRs) kunnen worden toegepast. Deze NFRs, zoals schaalbaarheid, consistentie en beveiliging, bepalen in grote mate welke patterns en ontwerpkeuzes relevant zijn. In de initiële fase van een softwareproject besteden ontwikkelaars vaak veel tijd aan het opzetten van een microserviceslandschap volgens DDD-principes. Dit omvat het ontwerpen van services, integreren van event bus frameworks (zoals MassTransit of NServiceBus) en toepassen van designprincipes zoals idempotentie, exactly-once message delivery, message signing, message encryption en eventual consistency. Deze opstartfase kost vaak veel tijd en vereist diepgaande kennis die niet altijd direct beschikbaar is. Het opzetten van een full-blown DDD-project kan daardoor lang duren en hoge kosten met zich meebrengen. De uitdaging ligt dan ook in hoe de complexiteit en kosten van de oplossing in balans gebracht kunnen worden. Het gebruik van bestaande frameworks, libraries of standaardoplossingen kan hierin een belangrijke rol in spelen. Omdat veel van onze klanten gebruik maken van Domain Driven Design, kan de kennis die uit deze opdracht voortkomt bijdragen aan snellere en effectievere softwareontwikkeling. De opdracht Het kiezen van DDD-patterns, het inzetten van een event bus framework en het kiezen van design-principes gebeurt op basis van non-functional requirements. Onderzoek in hoeverre het mogelijk is om deze non-functional requirements te gebruiken als input voor een AI die keuzes kan automatiseren. Of nog beter: om op basis van deze non-functional requirements software te genereren waarin deze patterns, framework en design-principes al geïmplementeerd zijn. Deze AI moet de gemaakte keuzes kunnen onderbouwen, zodat deze keuzes gevalideerd en gedocumenteerd kunnen worden. items.desc: Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA. Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA et des technologies quantiques. Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique. Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients. Contexte La business unit AI & Cloud Infrastructure (ACI) de Bull construit un portefeuille d’infrastructures IA à l’échelle des racks pour les fournisseurs de services cloud, Neo Clouds et les programmes européens AI Gigafactory — en commençant par le NVIDIA NVL72 de marque Bull (génération Vera Rubin) fabriqué en Europe, suivi d’autres projets non divulgués. L’ingénieur transforme ces designs en systèmes fonctionnels et supportables mise en route, intégration, validation et responsabilité technique de la configuration Bull, à l’interface entre les fournisseurs de silicium (NVIDIA, AMD), le partenaire de fabrication et les équipes produit, avant-vente et support de Bull. Mission Faire passer une plateforme IA à l'échelle du rack du design de référence à un produit Bull validé et supportable mettez en place les premiers systèmes, qualifiez la configuration spécifique Bull (options matérielles, firmware, pile de gestion, réseau), lancez les campagnes de validation avec les partenaires, et transformez les résultats en matériel de référence sur lequel la présales, la livraison et le support peuvent compter. Responsabilités clefs Mise en route, intégration et validation Mettre en route et tester les premiers racks Bull (racks d'échantillons hébergés chez le partenaire, puis sur les systèmes Bull eux-mêmes) firmware et pile BMC/gestion, gestion des nœuds et des racks, NVLink / architecture scale-up, réseau scale-out, télémétrie de refroidissement liquide. Définir et exécuter le plan de validation de la configuration Bull fonctionnement, performance (calcul, interconnexion, chemin de stockage), comportement thermique et consommation d'énergie, RAS et facilité de maintenance. Qualifier les choix spécifiques à Bull par rapport à la référence du fournisseur pièces de nomenclature provenant du partenaire, options de sécurité/root-of-trust de la plateforme. Reproduire, isoler et documenter les défauts avec les équipes d'ingénierie du partenaire et du fournisseur ; assurer le suivi technique jusqu'à résolution. Architecture de référence et responsabilité de conception (avec le Portfolio) Contribuer au contenu technique des revues de propositions de conception avec le partenaire de fabrication et des réponses aux programmes de qualification des partenaires du fournisseur. Soutenir le Directeur du Portfolio sur la définition des produits et les Architectes Presales / Solutions sur les configurations spécifiques aux clients et la due diligence technique. Outils, automatisation et labo Mettre en place et faire fonctionner l'environnement de labo d'ingénierie autour des racks provisionnement / nœud principal, accès hors bande, suivi et collecte de télémétrie, modèle d'accès à distance avec le partenaire. Automatiser les procédures de démarrage, de test et de collecte de données afin que les campagnes soient reproductibles à travers les générations et les sites partenaires. Support, livraison et documentation Produire la documentation technique qui part de l'ingénierie rapports de validation, guides de configuration, listes de problèmes connus, notes de support sur le terrain pour l'organisation de maintenance et de support. Servir de point d'escalade technique de niveau 3 pour les systèmes déployés, en collaboration avec le partenaire de service. Compétences requises Hard Skills Personne n’est censé maîtriser les cinq domaines dès le premier jour nous recherchons une bonne base dans les deux premiers, une expérience réelle dans au moins un des trois autres, et la volonté d’apprendre le reste sur le terrain. Indispensables Systèmes à l’échelle des racks ou HPC/IA — expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l’intégration ou la validation de serveurs GPU accélérés ou de solutions à l’échelle des racks BIOS / BMC / firmware, topologies PCIe et accélérateurs, NVLink ou réseau haute vitesse. Ingénierie des systèmes Linux — provisionnement et gestion de configuration de flottes, piles noyau / pilotes, conteneurs, Slurm …

items.desc: Commit messages shape how teams understand and maintain their code, but AI tools are starting to take over this task. In this thesis, you analyze the quality of AI-generated commit messages and compare them to human-written ones. The goal: uncover how well these tools capture the intent behind code changes and where they still fall short. Commit messages are a vital part of modern software development. They help teams track changes, understand decisions and maintain codebases over time. More and more, AI tools like GitHub Copilot generate these messages automatically. While this can speed up workflows, it’s unclear how this shift affects message quality. AI may summarize code effectively but often lacks the context behind decisions. To evaluate this development, we need a clearer picture of what makes a commit message effective and how AI compares to humans in practice. The Assignment In this thesis, you will contribute to improving commit message quality by exploring how AI can support this part of the development workflow. The goal is to understand how AI-generated commit messages compare to human-written ones in terms of clarity, relevance and usefulness for understanding code changes. Based on your findings, you will draw conclusions about the strengths and limitations of current AI-generated commit messages and identify opportunities for improvement. items.desc: About Sona Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here. About The Role Sona's Labour AI team builds the forecasting, rules and scheduling tools that help hospitality and retail businesses get staffing right. This role is about getting that tooling to work for a specific site: its trading patterns, its staff, its quirks. You'll work directly with customers to turn Sona's tools into labour models that are used on site and have a huge impact. You'll derive labour rules from real trading data, spend time on site with customer teams to learn how the business runs, and build the trust with site managers. You'll present the impact and ROI of that work to customer executives and general managers, and act as the subject matter expert for labour optimisation in sales conversations. You'll also be the person site managers trust enough to change how they staff, and the person customer executives and General Managers trust enough to back the changes you're proposing. You'll need as much influence as analysis to make that work. You'll report back to customer leadership on the impact, in numbers they can take to their own board. You'll adapt the same underlying labour model across different business types, from QSR to premium dining to retail. Responsibilities Derive labour rules from real trading data using Sona's tooling and your own operational knowledge Spend time on site with customer teams, learning practical realities like stock deliveries and close-down procedures Build trust with site managers so workload models actually get followed Present impact and ROI to customer executives and general managers, winning buy-in for operational change Act as the labour optimisation subject matter expert in sales conversations Work across the full portfolio of live customer projects, picking up work as priorities shift between accounts Requirements An operational background in hospitality, retail, or a similar hourly-workforce, fluctuating-demand business. You understand how the business runs day to day, not just how to analyse it from the outside Confident presenting to and winning buy-in from customer executives, general managers and boards, and comfortable holding your own with competing agendas in the room Comfortable with technology and confident picking up new tools quickly, including using AI tools in your own workflow Able to look into the data yourself and make decisions from what you find Comfortable operating without a fixed playbook Excited about using AI in your day-to-day work to 10x your output Bonus: a retail or workforce-management background where the underlying concepts transfer to hospitality Bonus: a commercial finance background with genuine credibility in front of operators We're a hybrid working team you can expect to work 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho), and 2+ days/week on site with customers. Benefits Salary: £85,000 - £100,000 Share options 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days) Extra day of leave for every year of service Pension contributions matched up to 5% Comprehensive health insurance Enhanced parental leave & pay Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery) Annual all expenses paid team retreats The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office Professional development budget Unlimited free books Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

items.desc: Recommendation systems often favor dominant sellers and ignore user context, leading to biased and irrelevant suggestions. This thesis examines how AI can improve both fairness and trustworthiness in e-commerce recommendations. You’ll analyze existing methods, test algorithms on real-world data, and design a solution that balances market visibility with user relevance. Recommendation systems are a cornerstone of modern e-commerce platforms. They shape customer behavior, influence satisfaction and directly affect market dynamics. However, the fairness and reliability of these systems are questionable, as studies have shown that many popular algorithms tend to favor products from dominant sellers, creating a biased product offering. This undermines the visibility of smaller vendors and reduces consumer trust. Additionally, these systems often lack contextual awareness. They may recommend items that have already been purchased or fail to distinguish between multiple users sharing the same account (e.g., family members), leading to irrelevant suggestions. These inefficiencies not only diminish the user experience but also further question the effectiveness of the recommendation engine. The Assignment The aim of this thesis is to contribute to the development of fair and trustworthy recommendation algorithms for e-commerce platforms using AI. This assignment addresses both aspects through three main stages: Literature review and analysis Explore existing research on bias in recommendation systems. Identify fairness metrics used in literature and industry, and review approaches to mitigate bias. Also, study methods for incorporating user feedback directly into the recommendation process (customer-in-the-loop systems). Algorithmic evaluation Compare algorithms that explicitly aim to optimize fairness. Evaluate these algorithms using publicly available datasets (e.g., Amazon Reviews, MovieLens), comparing their performance in terms of recommendation quality, fairness, and diversity. Solution design Develop an approach that addresses and combines both fairness and trustworthiness, improving the overall usability of e-commerce recommendations. Measure the impact on the recommendation system’s performance using clearly defined metrics, for example through a prototype webshop. This thesis should contribute to the academic discourse on fairness in AI, while offering practical insights for improving recommendation systems in online commerce. items.desc: AI Business Developer - fra AI-strategi til konkrete løsninger i forretningen Brænder du for AI, og kan du omsætte teknologiske muligheder til løsninger, der gør en reel forskel i en stor, operationel virksomhed? Hos Danske Fragtmænd søger vi en passioneret og forretningsorienteret AI Business Developer, der kan identificere mulighederne i AI, skabe engagement omkring nye idéer og føre dem ud i livet. Du har måske en baggrund inden for softwareudvikling eller data og har samtidig udviklet en stærk forretningsforståelse. Du ser naturligt muligheder for at optimere arbejdsgange, udfordre eksisterende processer og skabe værdi gennem teknologi. Vi leder efter dig, der er oprigtigt optaget af AI. Dig, der eksperimenterer med nye teknologier, undersøger mulighederne på eget initiativ og motiveres af at finde løsninger på udfordringer, som andre endnu ikke har fundet svaret på. Du skal både kunne sætte retningen, udarbejde roadmaps, skabe opbakning og selv tage operationelt ansvar for, at idéerne bliver omsat til konkrete resultater. En nyoprettet rolle med stor indflydelse Danske Fragtmænd har allerede integreret AI i softwareudviklingen. Nu ønsker vi at bringe teknologien endnu tættere på forretningen og udnytte potentialet på tværs af organisationen. Det handler ikke om administrative processer, men i høj grad om at undersøge, hvordan AI kan skabe værdi i virksomhedens operationelle aktiviteter, hvor transport, logistik, terminaldrift og daglige arbejdsgange skal fungere effektivt. Du bliver en del af vores Data & AI-team på 7,5 medarbejdere og refererer til Head of Data & AI. Samtidig får du en bred kontaktflade til ledere, medarbejdere og softwareudviklere på tværs af organisationen. Din opgave bliver at forstå forretningens udfordringer, identificere de mest værdifulde AI-muligheder og omsætte dem til løsninger, der skaber mærkbare forbedringer i hverdagen. Stillingen er nyoprettet, og du får derfor stor mulighed for at præge både rollen, arbejdsformen og den fremtidige anvendelse af AI hos Danske Fragtmænd. Fra AI-roadmap til operationel eksekvering Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, data, mennesker og forretning. Du skal kunne sætte dig ind i komplekse arbejdsgange og forstå, hvordan virksomheden fungerer i praksis. Det kræver nysgerrighed, analytisk sans og lysten til at komme tæt på de medarbejdere og processer, hvor teknologien skal gøre en forskel. Du skal kunne identificere forbedringsmuligheder, vurdere deres forretningsmæssige potentiale og prioritere de initiativer, der giver størst værdi. Men du skal også selv være en aktiv del af eksekveringen. Det er ikke tilstrækkeligt at udarbejde strategier og præsentere gode idéer. Du skal kunne eksperimentere, afprøve teknologier og drive initiativerne frem mod konkrete løsninger i samarbejde med forretningen og de tekniske specialister. Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder bliver at: Identificere og analysere processer og arbejdsgange på tværs af organisationen, med særligt fokus på mulighederne i den operationelle forretning. Udarbejde business cases, investeringsforslag og et prioriteret AI-roadmap med tydelige mål og forventet forretningsværdi. Tage ejerskab for udvalgte AI-initiativer og sikre fremdrift fra idé til afprøvning og implementering. Drive Proof of Concept (POC) og Proof of Value (POV) og selv bidrage aktivt til udvikling og afprøvning af løsninger. Undersøge mulighederne inden for blandt andet AI-agenter, sprogmodeller og computer vision. Skabe relationer, engagere stakeholders og sikre opbakning til nye initiativer på tværs af organisationen. Samarbejde tæt med udviklere (du kan også noget selv teknisk), ledere og medarbejdere om at omsætte teknologien til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis. Følge op på effekten af implementerede løsninger og sikre, at de skaber den forventede værdi. Bidrage til AI-governance, videndeling og udbredelsen af AI i organisationen. Inden for de første 6–12 måneder forventer vi, at du har identificeret og kvalificeret relevante forretningscases, gennemført de første konkrete AI-afprøvninger og bidraget til et roadmap for virksomhedens videre AI-udvikling. Hvem er du? Din passion for AI, din tekniske forståelse og din evne til at skabe relationer og resultater vægter højt hos os. Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse, eksempelvis inden for softwareudvikling, datalogi, IT, data science eller en tilsvarende teknisk retning. Du har samtidig en stærk forståelse for forretning og data og evner at se sammenhængen mellem teknologi, processer og de mennesker, der skal anvende løsningerne. Vi ser gerne, at du har dokumenteret erfaring med at udvikle, afprøve eller implementere AI-baserede løsninger, og at du kan fortælle om konkrete projekter, hvor du har været med til at skabe resultater. Design, develop, test, and maintain integration solutions using SAP Integration Suite. Integrate data from APIs, databases, applications, and other enterprise systems using SAP technologies and Databricks. Apply AI-enabled capabilities to improve data quality checks, data validation, and data processing. Learn and apply SAP integration and data engineering best practices while working on real-world projects. items.desc: About The Job You’re Considering We’re looking for curious, driven graduates who are excited to kick-start their career in tech and make a real impact from day one. You’ll become part of a high-performing team delivering solutions for one of the UK’s largest public sector organisations - giving you the chance to work on meaningful projects that truly matter. Along the way, you’ll learn from experienced professionals, build in-demand technical skills, and gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies. As part of this journey, you’ll join one of our specialist tracks aligned to your interests: Data Engineer: turn data into powerful insights, working with modern analytics tools and cloud platforms to drive smarter, data-led decisions. Software Engineer: bring ideas to life by building scalable, user-focused applications using modern frameworks and full-stack technologies. This is more than just your first job - it’s a chance to grow, innovate, and shape the future of digital solutions, all while accelerating your career in a supportive and dynamic environment. At Capgemini, we are helping shape a new age of intelligence, partnering with clients across industries to harness AI, technology, and human potential to drive meaningful change. If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: Identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service). This role is based in either Telford or Hove, and you’ll typically be in the office up to 3 days a week, so you’ll need to be within commuting distance of your chosen location. The nature of this role requires you to work on a secure site, if this isn't a suitable location for you, we encourage you to explore our other graduate opportunities with Capgemini, which are available at various locations across the UK. What you will bring Data Engineer Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related STEM discipline Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail Experience working with SQL/NoSQL databases Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) Programming ability in Python, R, or Java Understanding of data modelling, ETL processes, or data pipelines (desirable) Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and testing principles Academic, personal, or internship projects involving data analysis or insights Software Engineer Degree in Computer Science or related a STEM discipline Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Java, Python, C++, JavaScript) Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles Experience with modern frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, Spring Boot, Django) Knowledge of full-stack development concepts (e.g. MEAN/MERN) Familiarity with version control (Git) and collaborative development Awareness of CI/CD tools (e.g. Docker, Jenkins) and DevOps practices Understanding of software testing, debugging, and SDLC Strong foundation in data structures and algorithms Projects or internships showcasing software development skills Graduate Development Experience Our graduate experience is designed to help you build the skills, mindset, and confidence to thrive in a rapidly evolving, AI-enabled world. From day one, you'll be part of a community focused on innovation, collaboration, and delivering accelerated solutions for our clients. Through a combination of professional and technical development, client experience, and mentorship, you’ll develop the capabilities to solve complex challenges, innovate with confidence, and contribute from the very start of your career. Supercharge your development with access to our best-in-class content providers and technology partners including Harvard Business, Microsoft, OpenAI, and more. Built around modules that encourage you to think creatively, embrace new technologies and turn ideas into meaningful impact. You’ll work alongside leaders and experts to build future-focused skills that prepare you for long-term success in technology, business, and consulting careers. items.desc: Job Description As part of Mantu’s continued growth and digital transformation, we are looking for an AI FinOps & Platform Cost Analyst to join our IT team. Reporting to the Data & AI Manager , you will help establish and operate Mantu’s AI FinOps capability. Your role will sit at the intersection of IT operations, data analytics, AI platform management, and financial governance . You will provide visibility into AI and LLM consumption, build the data foundations and dashboards required to monitor usage and costs, and help the organisation optimise the performance, scalability, and commercial value of its AI platforms. You will work closely with the Data & AI, IT, Finance, Procurement, Security, and business teams to ensure that AI services are used efficiently, sustainably, and in line with Mantu’s technical and commercial objectives. Your missions Build dashboard-level visibility into AI platform spend (e.g., Dust, Claude), identifying which agents and use cases drive costs Develop predictive consumption models that go beyond linear extrapolation, enabling accurate forecasting of AI/LLM costs Report monthly on cost, consumption trends, and risk exposure to relevant stakeholders Identify and shift workloads off premium models where not justified, optimizing spend by aligning tasks with appropriate model tiers Track model pricing evolution and reassess cost/quality tradeoffs as new models are released Monitor consumption against contracted thresholds and flag commercial risks proactively Support contract negotiation and renewal discussions with AI platform vendors in collaboration with Procurement and the AI team Build and continuously refine Mantu’s AI cost model, incorporating external advisory input and documenting methodology for future client-facing offers[doc1] Your profile You have a strong interest in the intersection of IT, data, artificial intelligence, cloud platforms, and cost optimisation . You are comfortable working with technical teams and translating complex usage data into clear recommendations for business and financial stakeholders. Experience in IT, data analytics, cloud operations, platform engineering, FinOps, or AI operations. Experience with modeling, Python or SQL for data extraction, and generative AI tools Academic background: Master’s degree in management, engineering, or a related field English fluent. French is a plus. Experience with cloud or SaaS FinOps practices Experience building and maintaining cost dashboards or models Familiarity with AI/LLM commercial models, including token or credit-based pricing, tiered contracts, and overage rates You demonstrate the ability to build and defend cost/value models to non-technical stakeholders You demonstrate comfort working with high-variance, unpredictable cost data and understanding of budget and vendor contracts You demonstrate strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to translate technical usage into actionable cost insights Remuneration Gross Annual Salary (GAS): EUR 22,000 - EUR 40,000 (basic salary only, the variable component will be detailed in the offer) What We Offer An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.) At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support. Mantu is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics Who are we? Mantu is an independent international consulting player, founded in 2007. Bringing together expert and complementary brands, Mantu stands out for the breadth of its spectrum, responding to all business transformation challenges. Its activities are divided into four practices: Leadership & Advocacy, Technology, Brand Strategy & Experiences and Total Talent Management. A wide range of skills, all serving a single mission: connecting and powering companies with leading teams and technology to succeed faster and sustainably. From its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland, Mantu relies on a community of 12,000 talented people in more than 60 countries on 5 continents and …

You will work closely with the Global Head of Language Talent on quality frameworks, priorities, and continuous improvement. Tasks As a Language Quality & AI Specialist, you'll own the language quality lifecycle across human and AI-assisted
items.desc: Since 2008, Language Inspired has grown from a translation provider into a language solutions integrator. Today, we're a fully remote team with a global network of linguists. We combine human expertise, AI, and language technology to help international companies make localization smarter in every market. We're currently looking for a Language Quality & AI Specialist to join our Language Talent Team. In this role, you will manage quality processes across human and AI-assisted localization, including recurring AI evaluation and linguistic asset management programmes. You will work closely with the Global Head of Language Talent on quality frameworks, priorities, and continuous improvement. Tasks As a Language Quality & AI Specialist, you'll own the language quality lifecycle across human and AI-assisted workflows. You will: Evaluate linguistic quality using industry frameworks and standards such as MQM, ISO 5060, ISO 17100, ISO 18587, and client-specific scorecards. Run recurring AI quality evaluation cycles: calibrate evaluators, validate findings, and track improvement from one round to the next. Design, maintain, and improve validation and evaluation workflows across multiple TMS platforms and MT/AI engines. Apply a risk-based approach to quality by defining quality tiers and estimating effort based on content type, sensitivity, and business impact. Assess the health of translation memories, termbases, and style guides, and coordinate maintenance with linguists and technical teams. Handle client and internal feedback cases, making objective, consistent, and well-documented quality decisions. Track quality KPIs, spot trends and root causes, and propose data-driven improvements and AI-enabled workflows. Prepare structured quality analyses and feedback reports for linguists, internal teams, and clients, working with the Global Head of Language Talent. Act as the go-to quality contact for key clients, contributing to style guides, termbases, onboarding materials, and quality guidelines. Work with the Client Solutions & Support team and linguist teams to align quality expectations, workflows, and improvement actions. Requirements Essential: Fluency in English. Linguistic degree (translation, linguistic studies). 3+ years of experience owning language quality in the localization industry. Strong multilingual awareness: a solid understanding of i18n/l10n/g11n across markets, fit-for-purpose content solutions, and how languages work, including ones you don't speak. Strong quality expertise: hands-on experience with quality frameworks and standards such as MQM, ISO 5060, ISO 17100, and ISO 18587, and with assessing, maintaining, and improving language assets such as translation memories, termbases, and style guides. Strong language technology awareness: hands-on experience with TMS platforms, MT engines, and AI tools, and the ability to evaluate their output, judge fitness for purpose, and use findings to improve quality and reduce risk. Strong analytical, reporting, and communication skills: including confidence with spreadsheet analysis, clear documentation, and presenting findings to clients and external stakeholders. Strong ownership and sharp eye for detail: the ability to manage recurring quality work independently, set priorities, and stay objective and consistent in your assessments. Strong advantage: Additional languages. Experience with multiple cloud-based TMS platforms, MT engines, and AI/LLM tools in localization. Experience applying risk-based or tiered quality models across content types, from software and technical content to regulated domains such as finance, legal, and life sciences. Experience calibrating language experts or managing multilingual language programmes. Benefits Remote-first workplace with freedom, trust & accountability. Work-life balance and a supportive company culture. Best software & hardware. Real impact – shape quality processes and influence client success. A unique experience in a dynamic, multicultural environment and a thriving, fast-paced industry. Competitive salary based on experience & expertise. Seriously great colleagues – we mean it! This role is ideal for someone comfortable taking ownership and building structure where it does not yet exist. If you enjoy shaping how things work rather than simply following predefined or legacy processes, this role is for you. You will help improve, test, and document language quality practices across human and AI-assisted workflows at Language Inspired, working closely with the Global Head of Language Talent and cross-functional teams. If you are proactive and motivated by creating clarity and impact in a fast-evolving environment, we would love to hear from you. items.desc: Werken bij CM, is werken met goesting. Want bij CM heb je een positieve impact op het leven van miljoenen Belgen. Dat ervaren onze duizenden medewerkers elke dag. Samen dragen we bij aan een gezondere samenleving voor iedereen. Dat geeft voldoening en energie. Ook voor jou is CM een fijne en zorgzame werkomgeving, waar je ideeën uitwisselt en jezelf ontwikkelt. Waar je kan rekenen op je collega’s en je verbonden bent met elkaar. Plezier hebben in wat je doet, daar doen we het voor! Bij CM telt elke dag. Voor de mensen, de samenleving en voor jezelf. Met 650 ICT-collega's zetten we ons dagelijks samen in om de beste service te bieden aan onze 4,5 miljoen leden en onze bijna 8.000 personeelsleden. Flexibiliteit gegarandeerd! Mogelijkheid tot 4 dagen per week homeworking of vanuit één van onze regionale kantoren. Dit zoeken we In het kader van onze toekomstgerichte digitale transformatie zijn we op zoek naar een Technology Coach met een passie voor innovatie en een sterke motivatie om AI-tools te integreren binnen de Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) in een Agile DevOps-context. Bij CM krijg je als Technology Coach de kans om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van onze organisatie. We zijn volop bezig met de integratie van AI en andere innovatieve tools in onze werking. Jij krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren, nieuwe technologieën te verkennen en mee vorm te geven aan hoe we werken. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan onze digitale transformatie, maar groei je ook zelf mee via verdiepende opleidingen. Zo blijf je niet alleen bij, maar loop je voorop. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het begeleiden van onze DevOps-teams bij de implementatie van AI-versnelde ontwikkelprocessen. Denk aan het integreren van intelligente AI-agenten & tools in het dagelijkse werkproces, waarbij zowel technische als culturele verandering centraal staan. Je volgt de evoluties in AI op en denkt strategisch mee over hoe AI-oplossingen op schaal geïntegreerd kunnen worden in bestaande ontwikkelpijplijnen. (SDLC) Jouw impact Je ondersteunt teams bij het herdenken van hun werkprocessen en begeleidt hen in het effectief inzetten van AI tijdens sprintplanning, backlogbeheer en iteratieve levering. Dankzij jouw ervaring met Agile coaching en frameworks zoals Scrum , weet je technologie, teamdynamiek en organisatiecultuur samen te brengen in concrete verandering. Je zet AI Tools in om je werk te optimaliseren, Copilot of andere AI tools. Wat je bijdraagt Met jouw visionaire blik, pragmatische aanpak en coachende stijl help je bouwen aan een organisatie waarin technologie en mensen elkaar versterken. Je draagt niet alleen bij aan slimmere software, maar ook aan zelfsturende, wendbare teams die AI op een ethisch verantwoorde en innovatieve manier inzetten. Dit ben jij Je beschikt bij voorkeur over een Bachelor diploma of gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Je hebt min 5 jaar ervaring in het coachen en mentoren van ICT teams en ook al ga je zelf niet meer testen, enkele jaren ervaring als tester of analist is een must. Ervaring en kennis van Agile Scrum en AI tools is een must. Een opleiding in Github Copilot of andere AI tools is een groot pluspunt. Je beheerst het Engels zeer goed en hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands of Frans en noties van de andere landstaal. Je combineert technologische diepgang met een sterke coachende aanpak en communicatie skills. Je bent geboeid door de rol van AI in de bredere Software Development Life Cycle = SDLC. Je bent een inspirator: je weet collega’s warm te maken voor de mogelijkheden van AI en hen te enthousiasmeren voor verandering. Je creëert draagvlak door AI tastbaar, relevant en werkbaar te maken in hun dagelijkse praktijk. Dit bieden we je Aantrekkelijk loonpakket : We bieden je een contract van onbepaalde duur, een aantrekkelijk salaris en een mooi pakket aan voordelen: maaltijdcheques (9 euro) en bedrijfsrestaurant, 13e maand, een extra premie in juli, thuiswerkvergoeding, fietsvergoeding, aanvullende kinderbijslag, groepsverzekering, hospitalisatieverzekering, verzekering gewaarborgd inkomen, fietslease, smartphone met abonnement, … Flexibel werken : Mogelijkheid tot 4 dagen per week homeworking of vanuit één van onze regionale kantoren. Vakantie, 20 verlofdagen, 4 extra feestdagen, 12 ADV-dagen en extra verlof naarmate je langer bij ons werkt. Maatschappelijke impact : Bij CM werk je niet zomaar. Samen met je collega’s draag je rechtstreeks of onrechtstreeks je steentje bij aan de gezondheid van velen. Je werk heeft echt betekenis. Opleidingen en Groeimogelijkheden : Bij CM sta je zelf aan het stuur van je loopbaan. Je krijgt kansen om te groeien in je functie en in de organisatie. Er zijn opleidingen om je kennis en vaardigheden te vergroten. Team : Als kers op de taart, enthousiaste en toffe collega’s en een werkcultuur die gericht is op samen mooie resultaten behalen. Dit is je kans Ben jij net zo enthousiast als wij? Stuur dan snel je CV en motivatiebrief via onderstaande link!

As an AI Training Expert, you will apply your professional knowledge and judgement to evaluate AI-generated content, identify errors, improve responses and create realistic
items.desc: About the Role We are seeking experienced professionals and subject-matter experts from a range of industries to contribute to AI training projects focused on improving the accuracy, quality, safety and usefulness of AI-generated responses. As an AI Training Expert, you will apply your professional knowledge and judgement to evaluate AI-generated content, identify errors, improve responses and create realistic questions and scenarios based on your field of expertise. You will initially work on a Social Media AI Training Project, with potential opportunities to contribute to additional projects aligned with your professional background as they become available. This is a fully remote, part-time, fixed-term contractor opportunity offering flexible, project-based work. Full training, structured guidelines and ongoing support from a dedicated project trainer will be provided. We welcome qualified professionals from healthcare, law, finance, business, technology, engineering, science, education, research, creative industries and other specialist fields. Key Responsibilities AI Training and Evaluation Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, relevance, clarity, quality and safety. Identify factual errors, inconsistencies, misleading information and gaps in reasoning within your area of expertise. Correct inaccurate responses and write clear, reliable explanations. Compare alternative AI-generated responses and assess which best meets the task requirements. Develop realistic questions, professional scenarios and examples based on your industry knowledge. Provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance. Quality Assurance and Professional Judgement Apply your professional knowledge to complete tasks in line with project guidelines. Check responses carefully before submission to maintain high standards of accuracy and consistency. Incorporate feedback from project trainers and reviewers. Flag ambiguous instructions, quality concerns and technical issues promptly. Maintain confidentiality and follow applicable project security requirements. Project Coordination and Documentation Complete assigned task sets within agreed deadlines. Follow task instructions, quality standards and project workflows. Maintain accurate records of completed work and progress where required. Communicate questions, updates and issues to your project trainer. Participate in brief project check-ins when required. Areas of Expertise Applications are welcome from professionals with relevant qualifications and experience in areas such as: Healthcare and life sciences: Doctors, dentists, pharmacists, nurses, psychologists and allied health professionals. Law and compliance: Solicitors, barristers, legal executives, compliance specialists and regulatory professionals. Finance and business: Accountants, auditors, financial analysts, economists, consultants, HR and operations professionals. Technology: Software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity specialists, IT professionals and cloud engineers. Engineering and the built environment: Civil, mechanical, electrical and chemical engineers, architects and surveyors. Science and research: Chemists, biologists, physicists, mathematicians and statisticians. Education and humanities: Teachers, lecturers, historians, writers, editors, translators and linguists. Creative and media industries: Marketers, designers, journalists and other relevant subject-matter experts. Professionals from other industries are also encouraged to apply if they have relevant expertise and strong written communication skills. Requirements A degree or recognized professional qualification in a relevant field. Professional experience in your industry, either currently practising or recently practicing. Strong written English, analytical thinking and attention to detail. The ability to assess information critically and identify inaccuracies. Clear written communication and the ability to explain complex concepts accurately. Good organizational skills and the ability to work independently. The ability to follow detailed instructions and incorporate feedback. A reliable laptop or desktop computer and a stable internet connection. Eligibility to work as a self-employed contractor in the UK. Desirable Experience Current professional registration, certification or chartered status, where relevant. Postgraduate qualifications or specialist professional training. Experience in research, quality assurance, technical writing or content evaluation. Fluency in an additional language alongside English. Coding experience in Python or another programming language. What We Offer Fully remote working arrangements. Flexible, part-time project work with agreed task schedules. Full training and step-by-step guidance from a dedicated project trainer. Practical experience contributing to AI training and evaluation. Potential opportunities to access additional projects matched to your professional expertise, subject …

items.card: Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA. items.desc: Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA. Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA et des technologies quantiques. Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique. Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients. Contexte La business unit AI & Cloud Infrastructure (ACI) de Bull construit un portefeuille d’infrastructures IA à l’échelle des racks pour les fournisseurs de services cloud, Neo Clouds et les programmes européens AI Gigafactory — en commençant par le NVIDIA NVL72 de marque Bull (génération Vera Rubin) fabriqué en Europe, suivi d’autres projets non divulgués. L’ingénieur transforme ces designs en systèmes fonctionnels et supportables mise en route, intégration, validation et responsabilité technique de la configuration Bull, à l’interface entre les fournisseurs de silicium (NVIDIA, AMD), le partenaire de fabrication et les équipes produit, avant-vente et support de Bull. Mission Faire passer une plateforme IA à l'échelle du rack du design de référence à un produit Bull validé et supportable mettez en place les premiers systèmes, qualifiez la configuration spécifique Bull (options matérielles, firmware, pile de gestion, réseau), lancez les campagnes de validation avec les partenaires, et transformez les résultats en matériel de référence sur lequel la présales, la livraison et le support peuvent compter. Responsabilités clefs Mise en route, intégration et validation Mettre en route et tester les premiers racks Bull (racks d'échantillons hébergés chez le partenaire, puis sur les systèmes Bull eux-mêmes) firmware et pile BMC/gestion, gestion des nœuds et des racks, NVLink / architecture scale-up, réseau scale-out, télémétrie de refroidissement liquide. Définir et exécuter le plan de validation de la configuration Bull fonctionnement, performance (calcul, interconnexion, chemin de stockage), comportement thermique et consommation d'énergie, RAS et facilité de maintenance. Qualifier les choix spécifiques à Bull par rapport à la référence du fournisseur pièces de nomenclature provenant du partenaire, options de sécurité/root-of-trust de la plateforme. Reproduire, isoler et documenter les défauts avec les équipes d'ingénierie du partenaire et du fournisseur ; assurer le suivi technique jusqu'à résolution. Architecture de référence et responsabilité de conception (avec le Portfolio) Contribuer au contenu technique des revues de propositions de conception avec le partenaire de fabrication et des réponses aux programmes de qualification des partenaires du fournisseur. Soutenir le Directeur du Portfolio sur la définition des produits et les Architectes Presales / Solutions sur les configurations spécifiques aux clients et la due diligence technique. Outils, automatisation et labo Mettre en place et faire fonctionner l'environnement de labo d'ingénierie autour des racks provisionnement / nœud principal, accès hors bande, suivi et collecte de télémétrie, modèle d'accès à distance avec le partenaire. Automatiser les procédures de démarrage, de test et de collecte de données afin que les campagnes soient reproductibles à travers les générations et les sites partenaires. Support, livraison et documentation Produire la documentation technique qui part de l'ingénierie rapports de validation, guides de configuration, listes de problèmes connus, notes de support sur le terrain pour l'organisation de maintenance et de support. Servir de point d'escalade technique de niveau 3 pour les systèmes déployés, en collaboration avec le partenaire de service. Compétences requises Hard Skills Personne n’est censé maîtriser les cinq domaines dès le premier jour nous recherchons une bonne base dans les deux premiers, une expérience réelle dans au moins un des trois autres, et la volonté d’apprendre le reste sur le terrain. Indispensables Systèmes à l’échelle des racks ou HPC/IA — expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l’intégration ou la validation de serveurs GPU accélérés ou de solutions à l’échelle des racks BIOS / BMC / firmware, topologies PCIe et accélérateurs, NVLink ou réseau haute vitesse. Ingénierie des systèmes Linux — provisionnement et gestion de configuration de flottes, piles noyau / pilotes, conteneurs, Slurm …

Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique. Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients. items.desc: Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond. About The Role We are looking for an experienced software engineer to lead the development of tools that support every stage of the autonomy lifecycle. You will be responsible for building and evolving core internal platforms that allow engineers to test new ideas, diagnose system behaviors, and understand complex interactions between software and the physical world. This role combines backend systems work with front-end visualization, and requires a strong sense of software design, developer experience, and a passion for enabling others through effective tooling. The systems you build will be used daily by autonomy developers, test engineers and other stakeholders across the company. Areas Of Responsibility Design and build robust replay and analysis systems that enable engineers to inspect and reproduce recorded autonomy behavior, with fine-grained control over system state, perception outputs, and decision-making at every stage of the stack. Develop scalable infrastructure for automated testing and failure triage, expanding our simulation and log-driven test coverage while accelerating root-cause analysis through automated log processing and diagnostics. Operate at the interface between autonomy software and core robotics middleware, defining clear APIs, data contracts, and performance requirements for messaging, state propagation, and coordination across subsystems, while partnering closely with downstream teams to support their implementation and integration. Design and implement high-quality developer infrastructure and tools that prioritize reliability, performance, and usability, enabling rapid iteration, safe experimentation, and sustained velocity across the autonomy organization. What You’ll Do Lead the design and implementation of scalable tools used across autonomy development and testing workflows. Collaborate with autonomy, QA, and infrastructure teams to gather requirements, align on priorities, and deliver impactful tooling. Build tools that streamline stages of the robotics development process. Take ownership of internal services from concept through deployment and monitoring. Contribute to the long-term vision and roadmap for developer tools that improve debugging efficiency, test coverage, and system understanding. Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, ideally in robotics, simulation, or systems development. Proficiency in C++ and Python, with a strong grasp of performance-sensitive and multi-threaded systems. Experience with simulation frameworks, time-synchronized data systems, or state-machine-driven applications. Familiarity with structured data visualization, log processing, or developer tooling design. Strong communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams. Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where requirements evolve and priorities shift. Bonus Experience Experience building performance-sensitive systems (profiling, multithreading, real-time constraints) in robotics, aerospace, automotive, or similar domains. Exposure to robotics / simulation / physics engines. Background in telemetry systems, log ingestion pipelines, or automated test environments. Front-end development skills in modern web frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript, Three.js, Plotly) with a focus on data interaction and visualization. Familiarity with distributed systems or cloud-hosted services used to support internal tools and customer applications. At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. Présentes dans toutes les régions, les entreprises de proximité de VINCI Construction mobilisent les ressources de ses collaborateurs pour réaliser des ouvrages, infrastructures de transport et aménagements urbains utiles aux Hommes et aux territoires. Les missions. Dans le service Structures de la Délégation Génie Civil Ouest, votre mission principale sera de dimensionner un ouvrage en phase d’exécution. Vous serez épaulé par votre maître de stage qui vous accompagnera à toutes les étapes de l’étude d’un projet dès la phase de démarrage de l’étude jusqu’à la fourniture de tous les livrables. Dans le service Structures Génie Civil Ouest ; vous participerez au développement d'un assistant IA destiné à automatiser le contrôle des plans de ferraillage et à générer des rapports de vérification pour les ouvrages de génie civil. Rattaché au Directeur du bureau d’études, vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du projet Analyse métier Réalisation des principes de ferraillage à destination des projeteurs sur la base de notes de calculs Comprendre les méthodes de contrôle des plans de ferraillage. Identifier les règles techniques applicables et les points de vigilance. Participer à la constitution d'une base de données de cas réels. Développement de la solution Structurer et exploiter les données techniques issues des plans et documents d'études existants Développer des outils de contrôle automatisé à l'aide de Python et d’agents IA Exploiter des technologies d'OCR, de Computer Vision et des modèles d'IA générative. Validation et amélioration Comparer les résultats obtenus avec les vérifications réalisées par les ingénieurs structures. Évaluer les gains en termes de productivité, de fiabilité et de qualité. Formuler des recommandations en vue d'un déploiement à plus grande échelle. Ce stage vous permettra de travailler sur un sujet concret à la croisée de l'ingénierie des structures et des nouvelles technologies, avec un réel potentiel d'application opérationnelle. Vous êtes en dernière année du cycle ingénieur ou en master universitaire dans le domaine du Génie Civil. Vous Possédez De solides connaissances en béton armé et en lecture de plans de ferraillage. Une bonne maîtrise des fondamentaux des Eurocodes, notamment l'Eurocode 2. Une appétence pour les outils numériques et l'innovation. Des bases en programmation Python. Des connaissances en IA, automatisation, BIM, Computer Vision ou traitement de données seraient un plus. Curieux, rigoureux et autonome, vous aimez comprendre les problématiques techniques et développer des solutions concrètes en collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle. Jobbeskrivning Ämne: AI inom Integrated Logistics Support Som en del av ett examensarbete finns möjlighet att undersöka hur artificiell intelligens (AI) kan användas för att effektivisera och stödja framtagning, sammanställning och vidareutveckling av informationsprodukter inom Integrated Logistics Support (ILS). Arbetet omfattar en analys av hur AI kan tillämpas med utgångspunkt i befintliga informationskällor såsom databaser, handböcker, standarder, mallar samt närliggande dokumentation, exempelvis underhållsmanualer och underhållstabeller. Målet är att identifiera möjligheter, strategier och eventuella utmaningar kopplade till AI-stöd vid framtagning av dokumentationsprocessen. Uppdraget erbjuder stora frihetsgrader där examensarbetaren förväntas bidra med egna idéer, genomföra relevanta analyser och utforska innovativa lösningar. Resultatet förväntas skapa värdefulla insikter samt ge inspiration för framtida arbetssätt inom området. Detta är ett exjobb som kan utföras i samverkan med kund till AFRY. Kunden är ett teknik- och kunskapsintensivt bolag som arbetar med utveckling, dokumentation och support av komplexa produkter och system. Verksamheten har ett starkt fokus på kvalitet, struktur och effektiv informationshantering, och ser stora möjligheter i att dra nytta av ny teknik för att utveckla framtidens arbetssätt Kvalifikationer Kvalifikationer Studerar på högskole- eller universitetsnivå inom exempelvis maskinteknik, industriell ekonomi, systemvetenskap, datateknik eller närliggande område Intresse för artificiell intelligens, digitalisering och informationshantering Förmåga att analysera och strukturera information från flera olika källor God förståelse för teknisk dokumentation eller vilja att sätta sig in i området God kommunikativ förmåga i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Erfarenhet av AI-verktyg, språkmodeller eller datadrivna metoder är meriterande Kunskap om ILS, teknisk dokumentation eller underhållsrelaterade processer är meriterande Personliga egenskaper Självständig och initiativtagande. Nyfiken och analytisk. Strukturerad med god problemlösningsförmåga. Kreativ och intresserad av att utforska nya arbetssätt och tekniska möjligheter. Du kommer ha handledare inom AFRY. Detta examensarbete kan genomföras som ensamarbete eller samarbete mellan två studenter, där en lämplig uppdelning i arbetsområden bestäms i samråd utifrån utbildningsinriktning och intresse. Har du en egen idé om ett examensarbete diskuterar vi gärna det och ser om det kan vara passande för vår verksamhet och identifierade behov framåt. Tidplan Uppstart efter överenskommelse, men förslagsvis mitten av januari 2027 och genomförande under våren (motsvarande 30 hp). Exjobbet utförs till största del på vårt huvudkontor i Solna, med viss möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Ytterligare information Exjobbet utgör en grund för en möjlig framtida anställning hos AFRY. Som anställd på AFRY erbjuder vi en modern arbetsplats i ett globalt sammanhang med framåtanda och trygghet i form av kollektivavtal och personalförmåner så som friskvårdsbidrag och en förmånsportal med en mängd rabatter. Vår personalklubb arrangerar sociala aktiviteter på och utanför kontoret. Allt från skidresor, sjunga i kör till att spela brädspel – det finns något för alla. Vårt arbete med mångfald är också ständigt pågående, en mix av personligheter och bakgrunder gör oss ännu starkare, mer kreativa och framgångsrika ute på marknaden. Dessutom finns det många sätt att vidareutveckla sig hos oss! Vi satsar på våra medarbetare och har individuella utvecklingsplaner där du får möjligheten att gå utvecklande kurser och certifieringar inom ramen för din tjänst och dina karriärmål. Vi vill att din ansökan består av ett personligt brev samt CV. Beskriv vem du är och vad som gör dig lämpad för detta exjobb hos AFRY! Sista ansökningsdag är 20 november 2026. Kontaktperson för frågor: Johan Endrell, johan.endrell@afry.com Group Manager ILS Vi kan ej ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Sök via länken. På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

items.desc: Who You'll Work With Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. Your Impact Te integrarás en un equipo de consultoría y asumirás la responsabilidad de liderar un workstream del proyecto. Trabajamos en estrecha colaboración con nuestros clientes para generar un valor escalable a través de la tecnología y la inteligencia artificial (IA). Entre nuestros clientes se encuentran algunas de las organizaciones más influyentes a nivel global, desde grandes corporaciones hasta start-ups innovadoras. En nuestra firma te enfrentarás a grandes retos, al mismo tiempo que impulsamos tu desarrollo profesional. Diseñarás soluciones para los desafíos más actuales y estratégicos, impulsando así transformaciones a largo plazo. Trabajarás de forma conjunta con nuestros clientes en sus instalaciones, ayudándoles a maximizar el potencial de los datos e IA, logrando resolver problemas estrechamente, perfeccionar sus estrategias y ejecutar transformaciones complejas. Desarrollarás soluciones basadas en IA, modernizarás infraestructuras tecnológicas, optimizarás y automatizarás procesos, impulsarás el crecimiento digital y capacitarás a los equipos para que adopten la IA y las tecnologías digitales de manera eficaz. Junto con nuestros clientes y tus colegas de McKinsey, combinarás investigación, análisis de datos, entrevistas y sesiones de ideación para generar información de valor y diseñar soluciones innovadoras. Al dotarles de las herramientas y los conocimientos adecuados, garantizarás que nuestros proyectos sigan impulsando la innovación y la mejora continua incluso después de su finalización, logrando un impacto duradero. De este modo, contribuirás al propósito de McKinsey de marcar una diferencia significativa en múltiples industrias y en la sociedad en su conjunto. Your Qualifications and Skills Titulación universitaria superior en disciplinas técnicas, científicas o del ámbito económico-empresarial Experiencia profesional de hasta 3 años, adquirida bien en empresas del sector tecnológico, o bien en posiciones especializadas en tecnología, Inteligencia Artificial o transformación digital dentro de otros sectores Elevada capacidad analítica para la toma de decisiones basada en datos, hechos y un razonamiento lógico estructurado Trayectoria académica y profesional excelente, con logros destacados tanto dentro como fuera de los estudios Capacidad para elaborar materiales de proyecto, como presentaciones de PowerPoint, modelos de Excel, artículos u otros documentos escritos de alto impacto Excelente capacidad de trabajo en equipo Sólidas competencias organizativas y de gestión del tiempo, incluyendo la capacidad de abordar y completar tareas de manera autónoma Excepcionales habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, con un dominio excelente de los idiomas español e inglés

items.card: About The Job You're Considering At Capgemini Invent, we combine strategy, technology and innovation to help organisations solve complex challenges and deliver lasting change.As an Associate Consultant on our Business Technology pathway, you'll support transformation programmes, contribute to client projects and develop your consulting, technology and problem solving skills while working across a range of
items.desc: Eligibility To be eligible for this programme, you must have obtained, or be studying towards, a minimum 2:2 degree. If you are currently studying, you must have completed your degree prior to proposed start date. We recognise that mitigating circumstances can have an impact on academic performance. If you have experienced any circumstances that you would like us to take into consideration, please provide details in your application. About The Job You're Considering At Capgemini Invent, we combine strategy, technology and innovation to help organisations solve complex challenges and deliver lasting change.As an Associate Consultant on our Business Technology pathway, you'll support transformation programmes, contribute to client projects and develop your consulting, technology and problem solving skills while working across a range of industries.As part of the Accelerate Graduate Programme, you'll benefit from structured development, hands on learning and early career opportunities. The Accelerate Programme The Accelerate Programme is Capgemini Invent UK's award winning graduate development programme. Over approximately 19 to 21 months, you'll progress from Associate Consultant to Consultant through a blend of structured learning, coaching, mentoring and hands on client experience. Following an initial three week induction and a twelve week consulting training programme delivered by the Institute, you'll move into your chosen pathway, applying your skills on live client projects while benefiting from ongoing development, regular feedback and a strong graduate community. Travel to client sites may be required, and candidates should live within reasonable commuting distance of their chosen office location. Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs and those of the business. It will be a blend of Company offices, client sites and your home, noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time. Your role The specific roles available within the Business Technology pathway as an Associate Consultant are: Technical Strategy and Change Consultant Digital Trust Consultant Junior Architect AI and Digital Workplace Consultant Digital Business Analyst Digital Delivery Consultant Cloud and Infrastructure Consultant Typical Responsibilities May Include Supporting business and technology transformation initiatives Conducting research and analysis to solve business challenges Gathering and interpreting business and user insights Supporting workshops and stakeholder engagement activities Contributing to technology enabled solutions Presenting findings and recommendations Building strong relationships with clients and colleagues At Capgemini, building an inclusive future is part of everyday life. We foster a welcoming environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and thrive as part of a diverse community. Your Skills And Experience We're looking for curious and motivated individuals who are interested in using technology to solve business challenges and create positive change. Working at Ardonagh Specialty means you’ll be part of The Ardonagh Group. We are proud of our innovative environment offering many opportunities for growth across the wider group. Employees regularly move between our united teams, and we encourage you to make your role your own. Our offices are lively and exciting places to be, but we understand that life needs flexibility, and offer a genuinely flexible approach to working. If you are looking to join a thriving, energetic business with exciting plans, this role could be an ideal fit for you. What We Can Offer We offer much more than just an inclusive culture with apprenticeships, study support, participation in our annual Spotlight Awards, Community Trust, Sports Teams, office socials, events and so much more. All of this with a supportive management team as well as working alongside some of the industry’s top talent. You’ll have access to wellbeing programs, fantastic discounts across many big-name businesses including supermarkets, gym memberships, restaurants, and healthcare cash plans etc. Further Perks Of Working With Us (Fixed Benefits) Employer pension contribution of 10% (providing you, the Employee provides 5%). Good work life balance - flexibility to suit you. Competitive salary. Life Assurance at X4 of your base salary. Group Income Protection. Generous Annual Leave entitlement. Private Medical Insurance. Group annual bonus scheme. Manager Says We are looking for an experienced Privacy Analyst to perform day-to-day privacy processes and support the operation of ASL’s emergent Data Protection & Governance frameworks. The role is the core operational administrator for the OneTrust Data Management platform, maintaining accurate records and workflows and coordinating the timely, compliant handling of data subject rights requests, assessments and activities such as due diligigence for internal and external risk assessments. The role holder will embed privacy by design by triaging new projects, systems and business initiatives; determining when a PIA, DPIA or AI Risk Assessment is required; and coordinating assessments through to documented approval and remediation. The role also supports privacy due diligence for suppliers through the Know Your Supplier (KYS) process, reviews relevant contractual privacy safeguards, and assesses the privacy and responsible-use risks of internal and third-party AI solutions. Working within ASL policies, standards and governance, the role will provide clear management information, maintain auditable evidence and escalate material risks to the DPO and appropriate control owners. What You Will Do OneTrust and GDPR administration Support operational administration of OneTrust, configuring and maintaining workflows, user access, templates, reporting and supporting guidance. Maintain data inventories, data maps and records of processing activities (ROPA), coordinating periodic reviews with accountable business owners and challenging incomplete or inconsistent records. Track privacy obligations, control gaps, actions and evidence; produce management information and escalate overdue or material issues to the DPO and relevant control owners. Screening and impact assessment Manage the privacy intake and initial screening process for new projects, products, systems, processing changes and internal initiatives. Assess whether proposals involve personal data, special category or criminal offence data, vulnerable individuals, large-scale monitoring, international transfers, profiling or automated decision-making. Determine, with appropriate DPO oversight, whether a PIA, DPIA, legitimate interests assessment, transfer risk assessment or AI Risk Assessment is required (escalating to the Data & AI Controls lead as appropriate).
