items.desc: Description Du Poste 🎯 Chargé(e) de Gouvernance Data & IA (H/F) 🎯 🚀 Votre rôle Au sein du Département Technologies, le Data Management Office (DMO) pilote la gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Il accompagne les métiers sur la valorisation, la qualité, la maîtrise et la conformité des données, ainsi que sur les usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 9 personnes, dont trois collaborateurs dédiés à la gouvernance Data & IA. Aux côtés des deux collaborateurs déjà en poste, vous faites de la Data et de l'IA des leviers responsables, maîtrisés et créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à appliquer un cadre. Vous le faites vivre, vous le challengez et vous le faites progresser. Vous intervenez au croisement des métiers, de la technologie, de la réglementation et de la maîtrise des risques, dans un environnement bancaire où la confiance dans la donnée est un enjeu stratégique. 🧩 Vos missions Vos missions s'organisent autour de quatre axes. 1- Piloter les usages Data & IA Vous pilotez et suivez le développement des usages Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous accompagnez le déploiement de l'Offre de Service Data et diffusez les bonnes pratiques associées auprès des métiers. Vous analysez et challengez les dispositifs existants, identifiez les axes d'amélioration et contribuez à leur mise en œuvre. 2- Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité et la maîtrise des risques Vous contribuez aux travaux de gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous participez aux démarches de conformité et de maîtrise des risques, notamment BCBS 239 et le cadre normatif IA. Vous préparez et contribuez aux instances de gouvernance : Comité Data & IA, Comité de Qualité des Données, Comité d'Homologation IA. Vous assurez une veille sur les évolutions Data, IA, technologiques et réglementaires, et contribuez à leur prise en compte en interne. 3- Améliorer la connaissance et la qualité des données Vous accompagnez les métiers dans la connaissance et la documentation de leurs données. Vous les aidez à identifier les écarts de qualité et à mettre en place des actions d'amélioration concrètes. Vous transformez des problématiques complexes en recommandations claires et opérationnelles. 4- Diffuser une culture Data & IA Vous animez les communautés Data & IA et coordonnez les différents acteurs de la gouvernance des données. Vous concevez et déployez des actions de sensibilisation et d'acculturation à la Data et à l'IA. Vous animez des ateliers et vous faites le lien entre les experts et les métiers. 🧩 Environnement Une équipe DMO de 9 personnes, rattachée au Département Technologies. Un pôle gouvernance Data & IA de trois collaborateurs, dont vous. Des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques, risques, conformité et instances de gouvernance. ⚒ Environnement réglementaire et outils Réglementation : BCBS 239, cadre normatif IA Gouvernance : qualité des données, documentation, homologation des usages IA Outils appréciés : Python, SQL ou tout autre langage d'analyse de données Profil recherché 🧬 Profil recherché 🎓 Formation supérieure en data, gestion des risques, audit, finance, ingénierie ou équivalent. 💼 Expérience réussie en audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou conformité, idéalement en environnement bancaire ou financier. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil hybride. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le fil opérationnel. Vous aimez les sujets complexes, vous savez challenger l'existant et vous formulez des recommandations qui se mettent en œuvre. La Data et l'IA vous passionnent, et vous voulez mettre cette curiosité au service d'usages utiles et maîtrisés. 🤝 Savoir-être et compétences clés Gestion de projet et coordination transverse. Capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de challenge. Connaissance ou forte appétence pour la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données. Intérêt marqué pour l'IA et ses enjeux de gouvernance, de maîtrise et de conformité. Aisance pour animer des ateliers, des communautés et des instances de gouvernance. Excellentes qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques. Curiosité, pragmatisme et sens du collectif. Ce poste ne sera malheureusement pas pour vous cette fois-ci si : vous n'avez aucune expérience en audit, contrôle, gestion des risques, conformité ou gouvernance des données ; Vous ne connaissez pas les principes BCBS239 vous recherchez un poste purement technique de développement ou de data engineering ; vous n'êtes pas à l'aise pour animer des communautés, présenter en comité et embarquer des interlocuteurs variés ; la Data et l'IA ne suscitent pas chez vous une vraie curiosité. 🎯 Ce qui fera la différence Votre capacité à relier les enjeux métiers, technologiques, réglementaires et de maîtrise des risques. Votre goût du challenge constructif, qui fait avancer les dispositifs sans bloquer les projets. Votre pédagogie pour rendre la Data et l'IA accessibles à tous. Une pratique de Python, SQL ou d'un outil …

items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two. Role Details 📍 Job location: Barcelona, Spain (Onsite model) 🕒 Contract type: Employee / Contractor B2B 🗓 Target start date: Early January 2027 ⏰ Working hours: Full-time 💵 Compensation: €45,000–€60,000 gross per year 🗣 Languages: Spanish and English Note: All applications and CVs must be submitted in English. 📋 What You'll Architect As an AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer , you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining business analysis, data, AI-enabled ways of working, and human decision-making . Working closely with business stakeholders and digital delivery teams , you will help identify the real problem behind a request, challenge assumptions constructively and translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements. You will also bring a practical AI-first approach to your work, exploring how AI and Generative AI can accelerate analysis, improve processes and help teams validate solutions more effectively. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business, data and technology , and who is curious about better ways to turn ideas into outcomes. Key Responsibilities Engage directly with business stakeholders to understand processes, challenges, and desired business outcomes. Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria for digital delivery teams. Challenge requirements constructively to ensure teams solve the right business problem, rather than simply implementing requested features. Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle. Apply an AI-first mindset to identify opportunities where AI and GenAI can accelerate analysis, improve requirements quality, support prototyping, or optimise business processes. items.desc: Scientist Jena Developmental and Evolutionary Biology & Genetics Immunobiology and Infection Biology & Medicine Earth Sciences and Climate Research Social Sciences Linguistics Job Offer from October 23, 2026 The Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology (MPI-GEA) was founded in summer 2022 and is a dynamically growing, highly-interdisciplinary and international research institution. The research focuses on modeling and analyzing the interrelationships between biophysical and human-made systems, looking from the deep past to the future. The institute examines how humanity has driven the emergence of the Anthropocene – the period in which human activities began significantly impacting our planet’s climate and ecosystems – and identifying potential intervention points towards a more sustainable future. The Carl Zeiss Stiftung Independent Research Group on High-End Climate Risks (CZS-HECR) at MPI-GEA works towards an end-to-end understanding of worst-case climate outcomes, from unprecedented and compounding extremes to their societal impacts. The group combines fundamental physical process understanding rooted in climate physics and Earth System analyses, targeted climate model experiments, advanced statistics, including machine-learning- and explainable AI to deliver usable climate risk estimates under current and future climates for core societal sectors such as health, food, energy and finance. Candidate tasks Develop, deploy and maintain the real-time online tool that detects and visualizes global record-breaking and compounding extreme weather events as they occur. Set up, operate and maintain numerical and AI/ML-based climate models and aid in the setup of modeling experiments on MPI-GEA’s HPC systems Build and maintain a climate database, including reanalysis, observational, model and impact data, with reproducible workflows Develop and maintain analytical tools and shared code libraries for the research group (Co-)author scientific publications and present research at workshops and conferences Support group members in efficient data handling, machine learning workflows and good software practice (version control, testing, documentation) Ensure that data, code and tools are documented, and available for use by the wider community Your qualification Essential PhD in climate, physics, math, data science, or related fields Experience with climate model data and gridded climate data tools and libraries (e.g. xarray, Dask, CDO) Experience with machine-learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) Experience with setting up climate or weather model simulations and with HPC environments Experience in web development and deploying interactive data platforms (e.g. web mapping and dashboards, containers, APIs) Good command of written and spoken English Our offer The full-time or part-time position with at least 34 hours/week will begin on the 1st of January, 2027, though some flexibility in start date is possible. The term is five years. Renumeration will follow the public service pay scale (TVöD Bund) up to paygroup 13, according to the candidate’s qualifications and experience. You are entitled to an annual bonus, 31 days' holiday and time off on 24th and 31st December. We also offer attractive, family-friendly flexi-time and remote-working arrangements. A company pension scheme (VBL), an employer subsidy for public transport, the opportunity for further training, and language and health courses complete our offer. The Max Planck Society is committed to employing more individuals with disabilities and especially encourages them to apply. We are also committed to encouraging diversity and actively challenging biases based on gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion and other components of identity. We were honored with the TOTAL E-QUALITY award for the first time in 2023 for our commitment. The Max Planck Society supports the compatibility of family and career and is certified according to the "berufundfamilie" (“job and family”) audit. Your application should include A cover letter A CV of no more than 3 pages A summary of research interests with max. 2 pages A list of scientific, peer-reviewed publications or examples of successful coding projects related to the position Contacts of two referees Any relevant certificates Position remains open until filled. Contact for more information Application portal Dr. Kai Kornhuber Email: kornhuber@gea.mpg.de

items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 



ABOUT THE TEAM



Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 



ABOUT THE ROLE:


As a Data Scientist II at Faculty, you will lead the design of end-to-end analytical approaches, developing high-quality models that solve complex, multi-faceted business problems. Joining our Applied AI division, you will leverage advanced programming to turn high-level client needs into rigorous mathematical frameworks. 

This role is for an ambitious practitioner ready to own the delivery of robust, scalable model components while ensuring every solution is mathematically sound and ethically responsible. You will play a vital part in pushing our technical boundaries and mentoring others.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:


 - Designing and implementing core data science approaches for project workstreams, including the selection of optimal algorithms and validation strategies.

 - Combining deep domain expertise with advanced machine learning techniques to solve unique and complex business challenges.

 - Owning the end-to-end delivery of specific model components, ensuring they are scalable, robust, and mathematically precise.

 - Developing innovative algorithms or adapting existing frameworks to meet bespoke client requirements and technical constraints.

 - Building the software architecture required to wrap models and agentic workflows into production-grade, reliable environments.

 - Supporting Level 1 Data Scientists by providing technical guidance and conducting rigorous peer reviews on modeling tasks.

 - Managing personal delivery timelines while proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks or data limitations within projects.

 
 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:


 - You possess expertise in statistical modeling and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, to implement complex paradigms.

 - You are disciplined in extracting valid insights from messy or incomplete datasets, ensuring solutions remain robust under uncertainty.

 - You have the ability to translate high-level, ambiguous client needs into actionable data science requirements and mathematical frameworks.

 - You promote a culture of shared best practices, ensuring all AI development is transparent, ethical, and held to high peer-reviewed standards.

 - You are a clear communicator who can manage technical discussions with customers and articulate project feasibility and delivery timelines.

 - You are highly proficient in advanced Python and harness frameworks, capable of building the architectures necessary for production-grade AI.




OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 

 1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

 2. Take Home Technical Assessment

 3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

 4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)










OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact.  As Mimic Robotics scales deployment of our wearable systems across key industrial partner sites in Germany and Europe, we are looking for a hands-on Service Technician (Deployment Support) to help us maintain rock-solid system uptime. 
 This role will entail acting as our frontline responder for system downtime, remote diagnostic support, and field operations. You will be the technical backbone keeping our deployed systems running smoothly - getting on the phone to diagnose hardware and Linux system issues remotely via command line and where necessary, heading into the field across Southern Germany for hands-on support. 
 Responsibilities 
 Frontline System Triage & Remote Support: Act as the first point of contact for downtime incidents across deployed sites; perform remote diagnostics via SSH, analyze system logs, and execute Linux commands to identify and resolve issues rapidly.

 Customer Interface & Access Coordination: Guide client technical teams smoothly through active remote access procedures (e.g., coordinating via MS Teams for active SSH connections) with poise and clarity. 
 Proactive Operational Upkeep: Conduct regular system health checks, review diagnostic logs, and perform data quality verifications during downtime to prevent field issues before they occur. 
 Feedback Loop to R&D: Document edge cases, recurring fault patterns, and hardware behaviors in the field to provide clean technical context back to our engineering and development teams. 
 What you bring 
 Linux Command-Line Fluency: Strong, hands-on comfort navigating Linux terminals, running CLI diagnostic tools, reviewing system logs, and troubleshooting network/system issues remotely via SSH. 
 Technical Background: Educational foundation or practical experience in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering , or a closely related technical field. 
 Operational & Uptime Mindset: A strong drive for keeping systems running reliably in real-world production environments, with a preference for field problem-solving over R&D software development. 
 Field Readiness: Possess a valid European driver’s license and the flexibility to make frequent day trips to customer sites within a few hours travel time from our Zurich HQ. 
 Structured Problem Solver: Calm and methodical under pressure when facing site downtime, with strong customer communication skills. 
 Nice to have 
 Prior experience in technical customer support, field application engineering, or hardware-in-the-loop debugging. 
 Hands-on familiarity with camera vision systems, embedded PCs, or wearable hardware setups. 
 Basic conversational German (beneficial for on-site interactions). 
 What we offer 
 We offer a total compensation package including a competitive yearly base salary and a strong stock option package to make you part of our shared success. 
 You will work with the founders from day one, shaping the company and participating in its success from its early stages. 
 Surprise team trips, gym subsidy, team breakfasts, dinners and other exciting team activities.

Vous intervenez directement sur la conception et le développement des solutions et contribuez aux choix techniques avec les architectes et les autres développeurs de l’équipe. Principales activités: Concevoir et développer des microservices Java / Spring Boot robustes, performants et sécurisés. Développer des traitements distribués et des flux de données à forte volumétrie avec Kafka. Concevoir les interfaces nécessaires aux échanges entre SICONIA et les systèmes externes. Contribuer aux composants IoT permettant la collecte de données et la gestion de gateways et d’équipements communicants. Concevoir les modèles de données, principalement sous PostgreSQL. Déployer les services dans des environnements conteneurisés Kubernetes. Garantir la qualité des développements par les tests automatisés, les revues de code et l’analyse des performances. Utiliser de manière avancée les outils et agents IA tout au long du cycle de développement, tout en gardant la maîtrise du résultat. Contribuer au partage des bonnes pratiques techniques au sein de l’équipe. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : Java 17+ / Spring Boot, ainsi que les problématiques de performance et de concurrence. Kafka et le traitement distribué de flux de données. PostgreSQL, SQL et la modélisation de données. Docker/Podman, Kubernetes et Helm, ainsi que les pratiques CI/CD. Les tests automatisés, l’analyse des performances et l’observabilité des applications distribuées. L’utilisation avancée d’outils de développement assisté par IA tels que Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou équivalents, incluant le pilotage d’agents IA, la décomposition des tâches, la revue du code généré et la validation des résultats. Une expérience des environnements IoT, télécoms, énergie ou plateformes logicielles à grande échelle est appréciée. La connaissance de protocoles tels que LwM2M, CoAP, MQTT ou DLMS/COSEM constitue un plus. Nous …

items.desc: Als onderdeel van het Decision Intelligence-team speel je een sleutelrol in de verandering van de luchtvaart. Een luchtvaartmaatschappij is één grote puzzel waarin alles met elkaar samenhangt. Hoe verdelen ervaren piloten hun tijd tussen vliegen en het opleiden van collega’s, zodat we duurzaam kunnen groeien én ons cockpit- en cabinepersoneel tevreden blijft? Hoe zetten we vliegtuigmotoren gedurende hun hele levensduur zo in dat ze aansluiten op wat ons netwerk nodig heeft? Hoe verbeteren we de beschikbaarheid en luchtwaardigheid van onze vloot, zodat we een betrouwbare dienstregeling kunnen vliegen? En met welke metrics maken we de juiste afwegingen tussen processen en afdelingen? In dit vooruitstrevende team, dat innovatieve AI-producten levert aan KLM en externe klanten, ligt er altijd een nieuw optimalisatievraagstuk op je te wachten. Wat ga je doen? We zoeken een Data Scientist met specialisatie in operations research en softwareontwikkeling, die ook praktische ervaring heeft met andere AI-technieken. In deze rol werk je nauw samen met onze businesspartners om hun behoeften te vertalen naar overtuigende, innovatieve producten op basis van predictive en prescriptive analytics. Samen met collega-developers van KLM en BCG ontwerp en ontwikkel je onze nieuwste AI-producten. Daarnaast zet je je kennis van operations research in om efficiënte wiskundige modellen en algoritmen te bouwen die echte waarde opleveren voor de business. Waar land je? Je werkt binnen de afdeling Operations Decision Support (ODS), het data- en analysehart van KLM Operations. Het Decision Intelligence-team combineert Machine Learning, GenAI en Optimization om operationele beslissingen slimmer en voorspelbaarder te maken. Onderdeel van dit team’s verantwoordelijkheid is ook het unieke partnership tussen KLM en Boston Consulting Group (BCG). Het partnership wordt aangestuurd door een apart gezamenlijk managementteam, met daarin onder anderen de COO van KLM en een Managing Director van BCG. Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair team van Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers en Product Consultants. Het team combineert talent en resultaatgerichtheid met diepgaande kennis van de luchtvaartsector en de operatie van KLM. Jouw profiel We zoeken getalenteerde professionals met een passie voor Operations Research: nieuwsgierige bouwers met een sterke focus op actie, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en plezier in werken in een dynamische, internationale omgeving. Je hebt een gedegen basiskennis van zowel OR als ML, en weet hoe je deze toepast in een operationele context om impact te realiseren in complexe organisaties. Dat blijkt uit het volgende: je hebt een relevante master (of PhD) en ervaring met het bouwen van op operations research gebaseerde producten met meetbare impact op de business, in een zakelijke of commerciële omgeving; je programmeert vloeiend in Python en levert graag productieklare code op; je kunt complexe technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen aan vakgenoten, niet-technische collega’s en management, en je past je stijl aan op je publiek; je bent van nature nieuwsgierig en blijft altijd leren; je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring met beslissingsondersteuning voor operations en planning in complexe omgevingen. Ervaring in de luchtvaart of logistiek is een pré; je bent beschikbaar en bereid om naar het buitenland te reizen om met klanten samen te werken en optimalisatieoplossingen ter plaatse te implementeren; je spreekt vloeiend Engels. Nederlands spreken is een pluspunt. Flightplan Als je wordt geselecteerd, kun je rekenen op twee sollicitatierondes in de week van 9 november: technisch gesprek (90 minuten, online): een uitdagende case en een gesprek met je mogelijke toekomstige collega’s; business gesprek (60 minuten, op locatie): een gesprek met senior leidinggevenden van Decision Intelligence over hoe je verschillende business-vraagstukken benadert en oplost. Competenties initiatief; impact; resultaatgedreven; samenwerken; communicatieve vaardigheid; probleemanalyse. Wat bieden wij Een uitdagende rol bij een uniek Nederlands bedrijf; Een brutosalaris tussen € 4.348,98 en € 6.212,83 bruto per maand; Volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en mooie doorgroeimogelijkheden; Een uitstekende pensioenregeling; 8% vakantiegeld; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%; Een regeling voor winstdeling, tot 20%; 25 vakantiedagen en 5 extra vrije dagen; Fikse korting op vliegtickets (als je minimaal 6 maanden in dienst bent); Een duurzaam vervoersbeleid, met o.a. 100% gratis reizen naar het werk met het Openbaar Vervoer (binnen Nederland); Als je functie dit toelaat: thuiswerken en tot 8 weken werken vanuit het buitenland (EU en Caribisch gebied); Korting op je ziektekostenverzekering; Een budget voor duurzame inzetbaarheid. items.desc: About Marex Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world's major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas. For more information visit https://www.marex.com/ Department Description Marex's Algo and Flow department, formerly WEBB Traders, brings together expertise in proprietary trading, electronic market making, and quantitative research. The department provides liquidity across global cash equity and derivatives markets, using proprietary capital, advanced technology, and automated trading strategies. This role sits within the WEBB team, whose roots date back to 2009. Based in Amsterdam, with a significant presence in Paris, the team combines its entrepreneurial approach and specialist trading expertise with Marex's global reach, market access, and broader financial services capabilities. Market makers, quantitative researchers, software engineers, and business professionals work closely together to develop trading strategies, improve technology, and solve complex market challenges. Joining the team offers the opportunity to take ownership, contribute directly to the business, and grow within the wider Marex Group. Role Summary Our Operations team ensures the accurate, timely, and controlled execution of the full trade lifecycle across all products. Through scalable processes, robust controls, and an automation-first approach, we support business growth while minimizing operational risk. We provide real-time oversight of trading activity and systems, continuously improving workflows to increase efficiency, transparency, data quality, and resilience. As part of our Operations team, you will design and build automated tooling, workflows, and dashboards that power our trading operations. You'll combine technical problem-solving with operational ownership, creating scalable solutions while staying close to day-to-day processes to ensure they run seamlessly. Operations is a key enabler of our business growth. As we expand into new products, markets, and initiatives, the team ensures our processes remain efficient, controlled, and resilient. We manage operational risk while continuously driving improvements through automation and process optimization. Working alongside traders, risk management, data scientists, software engineers, and Legal & Compliance, you will help shape and improve the operational infrastructure that supports the business. Our automation-first approach focuses on eliminating manual effort, increasing reliability, and building scalable workflows, while retaining the operational expertise needed to oversee and intervene when necessary. Design, build, and maintain tools, dashboards, and automated controls that support operational processes and decision-making. Identify opportunities to automate and improve processes, driving implementation in collaboration with engineering teams. Take end-to-end ownership of operational processes, ensuring they are scalable, well-controlled, and perform reliably in day-to-day operations. Manage end-to-end trade lifecycle processes across cash equities, listed and OTC derivatives, and structured products. Perform daily reconciliations of trades, positions, and cash, investigating and resolving exceptions in a timely manner. Monitor trading activity and operational systems during market hours, ensuring stability and prompt issue resolution. Support transaction reporting processes, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness. Een grote uitdaging voor het data science team ligt in het verkrijgen van structurele datastromen, een sluitende (data) infrastructuur en het verder verbeteren van de data- en AI geletterdheid van de organisatie. Hoe kan de organisatie geautomatiseerd data binnenhalen? Hoe verwerken we deze data? Hoe koppelen we de data met andere systemen en AI? Hoe krijgen we de data- en AI-geletterdheid van inspecteurs op peil? Je zet de koers uit en bent coach, coördinator en collega voor de andere data scientists die binnen het KKC vallen. Je zult soms ook operationele taken op je nemen door in concrete toezichtsactiviteiten je data science-kennis en -expertise in te zetten, maar probeert daarnaast vooral richting te geven aan de rol en functie van data en AI in ons toezicht. Extern ben je verantwoordelijk voor het monitoren van, bijwonen en het representeren van de Inspectiepositie in wetgeving- en beleidstrajecten. Je zorgt voor afstemming en je werkt nauw samen met zowel in- als externe partijen en legt daarbij verantwoording af over (de kwaliteit van) de eigen diensten en producten. items.title: AI Product Analyst - Automation team
items.card: The role You'll be the Product Analyst for the team - across everything we ship, both classical product features and AI-powered ones. You'll turn the production behavior of our systems into evidence the team can act on: which parts work, where they fail silently, and what to fix next. The work blends product analytics, AI evaluation, and operational analysis. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in Product
items.desc: At MEDvidi, the Automation team builds and operates a mix of AI and conventional product features that automate clinical and operational workflows - from AI-drafted medical documentation to automated resolution of patient issues, intake verification flows, provider tooling, and the backend pipelines behind them. We free clinicians and operations from manual work a machine can do reliably and safely, in a domain where mistakes have real clinical and compliance consequences. It's a full-stack product team, not an AI lab: we ship UI, backend workflows, integrations, and AI features side by side, and we measure them the same way. The team works closely with Product, Engineering, MedOps, Clinical people. We're hiring an Product Analyst to own analytics for the team end-to-end as our automated surface area grows. The role You'll be the Product Analyst for the team - across everything we ship, both classical product features and AI-powered ones. You'll turn the production behavior of our systems into evidence the team can act on: which parts work, where they fail silently, and what to fix next. The work blends product analytics, AI evaluation, and operational analysis. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in Product Analytics/Operational Analytics/Data Analytics, or analytics roles within complex production systems. Understanding of AI, ML, and LLM systems. Hands-on experience evaluating LLM or AI output - prompt iteration, eval frameworks and human review pipelines is a strong plus. Effective, structured written and verbal communication - able to turn analysis into crisp, decision-ready writeups that non-analysts can act on. Comfort in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where ground truth often has to be constructed. Strong product / operational analytics background, comfortable owning metrics end-to-end and writing SQL and Python code against messy production data. Fluent Russian; English level B2 or higher, Ability to work CET-overlapping hours in a B2B format. Nice to Have Experience evaluating LLM outputs or AI systems. Previous experience in Data Science or Machine Learning. Responsibilities: Own the full product analytics stack for features the team ships - discovery and sizing, experiment design and analysis, funnel and adoption analysis, post-release impact assessment - across both AI-powered and conventional product features. Analyze production behavior of AI and automation workflows across clinical and operational journeys. Investigate hallucinations, silent failures, and quality degradation in AI-generated output. Work directly with logs, transcripts, generated artifacts, and operational data to find patterns dashboards miss. Design evaluations for AI quality - both automated and human review - and close the loop into prompt and product changes. Build monitoring and dashboards for AI and automation health, and the operational metrics they roll up to. Measure business and operational impact of automation initiatives and surface the risks they introduce. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, MedOps, and Legal to support fast decisions under ambiguity. What we offer: Opportunity to work on products at the intersection of Product Analytics and AI. Real influence on product direction and engineering practices High-impact work in a product-driven medical tech company Startup environment: fast iteration, high ownership, minimal bureaucracy Competitive compensation and growth opportunities Benefits Health insurance after probation period Sports & wellness compensation Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration 19 working days of vacation per year 3 additional wellness days per year Paid sick leave for the first 5 working days Gifts to employees for important events Career Development Personalized English lessons via Preply ﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile - let’s build something meaningful together.

API & AI Integration Specialist Vill du arbeta med API, integrationer och samtidigt vara med och bygga den tekniska grunden för hur AI-lösningar på ett säkert och kontrollerat sätt får tillgång till verksamhetsdata? Newsec SSC - Group IT söker nu en API & AI Integration Specialist till vårt Integration Competence Center (ICC) . ICC ansvarar för centrala integrationsplattformar och integrationslösningar inom Newsec. Vi arbetar idag bland annat med Microsoft Azure API Management, Azure Logic Apps och Azure Data Factory och samarbetar nära verksamheten, olika IT- och projektinitiativ samt externa partners. Nu vill vi stärka vår interna kompetens inom framför allt API Management och API-utveckling , samtidigt som vi etablerar nästa generation av integrationsförmåga för AI genom bland annat AI Gateway och MCP (Model Context Protocol) . Om rollen I rollen får du ett brett ansvar inom API-området och blir en viktig teknisk kompetens inom ICC. items.desc: AI håller på att förändra mjukvaruutveckling i grunden. På Softhouse i Luleå vill vi ligga i framkant av den utvecklingen och söker nu fler erfarna utvecklare och arkitekter som vill vara med och forma framtidens mjukvaruutveckling. Vi letar efter dig som har en gedigen teknisk grund, men som också har omfamnat de nya möjligheterna med AI. Du använder redan AI som en naturlig del av ditt utvecklingsarbete och är nyfiken på hur vi kan bygga bättre mjukvara, snabbare och smartare. Vi tror på AI Native Software Development För oss handlar AI Native inte bara om att använda Copilot för att skriva kod snabbare. Det handlar om att tänka nytt kring hela utvecklingsprocessen: Hur AI hjälper oss att gå från idé till fungerande lösning snabbare Hur utvecklarens roll förändras när AI-agenter kan ta ett större ansvar för implementation, testning och dokumentation Hur vi använder tekniken utan att kompromissa med kvalitet, säkerhet och långsiktig hållbarhet Det här är frågor vi vill utforska tillsammans med dig, samtidigt som vi fortsätter leverera riktigt bra mjukvara till våra kunder. Vem söker vi?‍ Vi tror att du är en erfaren och självgående utvecklare med flera års professionell erfarenhet av att bygga och vidareutveckla mjukvarusystem. Du har en stark teknisk grund inom exempelvis .NET, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript eller andra moderna språk och ramverk. Du känner dig bekväm med komplexa system, arkitektur och tekniska vägval. Framför allt söker vi dig som: Redan använder AI-verktyg aktivt i ditt dagliga utvecklingsarbete, exempelvis Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor eller liknande. Har börjat utveckla ett AI-native arbetssätt där AI är en integrerad del av hur du planerar, bygger, testar och förbättrar mjukvara. Har ett starkt tekniskt omdöme och förstår när AI-genererad kod är bra, när den behöver förbättras och när andra angreppssätt är bättre. Är nyfiken på agentbaserad utveckling, automatisering och hur AI kan förändra mjukvaruutveckling på riktigt. Trivs med att arbeta nära kunder, förstå deras verksamhet och omsätta behov till välbyggda tekniska lösningar. Gillar att dela erfarenheter, utmana gamla arbetssätt och utvecklas tillsammans med andra. Kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska. Du behöver inte kunna allt om AI, men vi tror att du redan har kommit längre än att bara experimentera med enstaka promptar. Känner du inte igen dig i precis allt? Hör av dig ändå! Vi letar lika mycket efter rätt tankesätt och nyfikenhet som ett visst antal års erfarenhet. Vad du får göra hos oss Vi befinner oss i en spännande fas där vi stärker vår traditionella affär inom avancerad mjukvaruutveckling, samtidigt som vi bryter ny mark inom AI och digital transformation. Här får du arbeta med varierande uppdrag hos både stora och små organisationer i regionen, från komplexa affärskritiska system till nya skräddarsydda lösningar. Du kliver in som erfaren specialist eller arkitekt i kundernas team, men får också en nyckelroll i att utveckla vårt eget erbjudande. Vi vill bygga en miljö där vi tillsammans utforskar AI-native arbetssätt i praktiken. Kort och gott får du hos oss: Vara med och forma framtiden: Du får en aktiv roll i att utveckla våra tekniska erbjudanden och omsätta AI-drivna arbetssätt från teori till verklighet. Påverka på riktigt: Hos oss är det nära mellan idé och beslut. Det finns ett stort utrymme att prova ny teknik och dina initiativ gör verklig skillnad. Utvecklas tillsammans med andra: Vi värdesätter kompetensdelning, nyfikenhet och att gemensamt utmana gamla sanningar. Ha roligt på jobbet: Vi har en prestigelös kultur med engagerade kollegor som tycker om att göra saker tillsammans och där vi känner igen oss i våra värdeord: Team, Enkelhet, Mod och Passion. Självklart erbjuder vi också ett generöst förmånspaket med exempelvis 5 000 kr i friskvård, individuellt anpassad kompetensutveckling och en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid. Varför Softhouse Luleå? Vi är ett litet, sammansvetsat team med stor kompetens, korta beslutsvägar och mycket arbetsglädje. I Luleå hittar du oss i centrala lokaler på Kyrkogatan, med fin utsikt över Södra Hamn. Samtidigt är vi en del av Softhouse med cirka 300 kollegor, ett brett tekniskt nätverk och kunder över hela Sverige. Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens mjukvara? Vi är nyfikna på vad du har byggt, hur du arbetar och hur du ser på AI:s påverkan på utvecklarrollen. Berätta gärna hur du använder AI i ditt utvecklingsarbete idag och vad du tror blir nästa stora förändring. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Vi tillämpar löpande urval. Vi hanterar all rekrytering internt och undanber oss därför kontakt från externa rekryteringsbolag och annonsförmedlare.

items.desc: Job Description At H&M Creative Studios, we develop and deliver H&M’s customer-facing brand and content experiences globally. Bringing together strategists, creatives, designers, creators, producers and specialists, we are responsible for H&M’s global campaigns, editorial storytelling, creator marketing, organic social channels, e-commerce content, brand design and physical brand experiences. Together, we shape how millions of customers discover, experience and engage with H&M every day. WHAT YOU’LL DO As an AI Creative, you are responsible for creating high-quality product imagery using generative AI tools and image enhancement technologies. Working from production needs, visual guidelines and creative briefs, you combine creativity, visual expertise, and aesthetic judgement with emerging AI technology to produce imagery at scale, from generating new visual content to enhancing existing product imagery. You will work closely with creative and production teams to ensure that all output aligns with our brand direction, visual standards, and responsible AI principles. You will: Create and enhance product imagery and creative still life using AI generation and enhancement tools, aligned with brand direction, visual guidelines, and creative briefs. Work consistently within established creative and production workflows while maintaining a high level of visual quality and accuracy, following brand standards and AI policies. Ensure production targets are met by working efficiently towards set timelines and deadlines. Support the testing, evaluation, and implementation of new AI tools and develop scalable AI-enabled workflows for product imagery and still life production. Collaborate with creative and production colleagues to deliver consistent, high-quality output. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You’ll be part of H&M Creative Studios, collaborating closely with different creatives, Photographers, Stylists and production colleagues. Together, you’ll create clear, inspiring, and high-quality product imagery that helps our customers experience and understand our products. Qualifications WHO YOU ARE We are looking for people with… Hands-on experience using generative AI tools for creative image production, such as Figma Weavy, Magnific or similar node-based tools, demonstrated through a portfolio or relevant projects. Ability to build and refine complex node-based workflows, with strong judgement in selecting the right tools and workflow structure for the task at hand. An understanding of composition and visual storytelling, with the ability to work within established visual and brand guidelines and translate creative briefs into consistent, high-quality visual output. Experience from a creative environment such as photography, design, content production, retouching, art direction, styling, or other relevant creative fields. The ability to work efficiently within structured workflows, production targets, and deadlines. The ability to quickly learn and adapt to new AI tools, technologies, and creative workflows. And people who are… Passionate about technology and curious to explore the possibilities of AI within creative production. Proactive, self-driven, and solution-oriented, comfortable working autonomously and adapting to changing needs and priorities. Hands-on and comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working. Visually driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain high quality while working at pace. Collaborative and open-minded, with a willingness to continuously learn and develop. Additional Information WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 25% staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET) H&M Incentive Program – HIP JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. This is a full-time permanent role based in Stockholm. Vi söker dig som vill kombinera verksamhetsutveckling, affärssystem, automation och artificiell intelligens för att skapa konkreta resultat i en internationell decentraliserad industrikoncern. Du har erfarenhet av ERP-system och affärsprocesser. Därtill erfarenhet av digital transformation, verksamhetsutveckling eller förändringsledning. Du besitter en god förståelse för processutveckling, integrationer, data och automation och har dessutom ett starkt intresse för AI, generativ AI och framtidens digitala arbetssätt. Som van projektledare hanterar du komplexa förändringsinitiativ med en positiv attityd. Ditt kunnande, din professionalitet och din förmåga till samarbete skapar förtroende och engagemang hos både ledning, verksamhet och IT. Hos oss får du möjligheten att vara en drivande kraft och utvecklas i en dynamisk koncern där initiativrikedom och genomförandeförmåga uppmärksammas och belönas. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att uppnå goda resultat. AQ Group har 8000 medarbetare globalt inom sju olika affärsområden med en total omsättning på över 9 miljarder SEK. För mer information, besök: www.aqgroup.com AQ:s värdegrund: Kunden i Fokus, Enkelhet, Entreprenörsanda, Kostnadseffektivitet, Mod & Respekt. items.desc: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This is the Volvo Group Graduate Program A new era of manufacturing and R&D is here. Are you passionate about technology, eager to solve real business challenges, ready to drive innovation, and join our transformation journey? Then this Graduate program is for you! As part of the Graduate Program at Volvo Group, you will tackle real challenges from day one and contribute to the development of next-generation production solutions. The 15-month Graduate Program combines 50% time in your home department with 50% dedicated program activities, giving you broad exposure across Volvo Group. Through local and international rotations, short-term assignments and targeted training in areas such as operations, engineering and purchasing, you will build a strong understanding of our business, brands and strategy. The program also includes direct customer exposure and encourages collaboration, knowledge-sharing and an end-to-end mindset, enabling you to contribute to transformation across the organization from day one. Your future team Welcome to Volvo Trucks Technology Industrial Division (TTI) in Umeå. Our plant is one of the Volvo Groups largest plants with over 1800 employees and we are one of Northern Sweden’s largest industries. We produce cabs for Volvo Trucks, with everything from stamping sheet metal to welding and painting complete cabs. Our facility is one of the world’s most modern, with advanced technology and competent employees. You will join the BIW Maintenance Engineering team in Umeå, working closely with our other engineers, project teams and the larger Maintenance teams. How you’ll contribute The primary responsibilities will include working cross-functionally to synchronize maintenance methods and reinvestment needs. You will develop models that ensure maintainability in new facilities. Alongside other maintenance engineers, technicians, managers and colleagues, you will actively participate in, and drive the development of maintenance methods. Together, you will find the best solutions within our network at the Umeå factory and across other Volvo production units. We are on an exciting digitalization journey at the plant, creating real opportunities for development in the maintenance field, where data and IT are powerful tools. You will work with data analytics, machine learning and AI. This helps create the conditions for preventive and condition-based maintenance, enabling us to become more proactive. Who are you? We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity, and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team. You enjoy building relationships and leveraging a global network to create impact while working collaboratively across teams and functions. In addition, you contribute to a culture of continuous learning by actively sharing knowledge, exchanging insights and supporting the development of others. To qualify for the Graduate program, you: Have completed a bachelor or master’s degree prior to the start of the program but not more than three years ago. Should not have more than three years' full-time relevant working experience in the field prior to starting the program, excluding part-time work during studies. You have a relevant education within Mechanical, Automotive, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineer or a related field Are fluent in Swedish and English, both written and verbal. Are willing to travel and participate in international short-term assignments Valid work or study permit for Sweden if not a citizen What’s in it for you? Our Volvo Group Graduate Program starts in August 2027, and you will be offered a permanent position at Volvo TTI Maintenance, with placement in Sweden, Umeå. These are some of the benefits of joining our program: An opportunity to work with the latest technology. An exciting and global working environment with experienced colleagues. Possibility to gain international experience through a short-term assignment abroad. A competitive salary and a permanent position from day one. Various workshops and seminars designed to help you grow into your future career at Volvo Group. The possibility to shape your own career with endless career opportunities. The application process The journey begins! An email confirmation will be sent when you submit your application. After this, it is still possible to update your personal profile by …

items.desc: Job title Research Fellow in Applied AI and Cybersecurity Job reference BEDS2978 Date posted 23/10/2026 Application closing date 15/11/2026 Location Luton Salary Grade 7 £40,704 - £48,337 Contract Full time Fixed Ter Contractual hours 35 Basis Full time Job category/type Research Attachments Blank Job information The University of Bedfordshire’s Luton AI initiative is seeking a talented Research Fellow in Applied AI and Cybersecurity to develop new approaches to identifying unmanaged wireless and Internet of Things (IoT) security threats. The post forms part of SAZT-Wi-Fi (Spatial-Aware Zero-Trust Platform for Shadow Wi-Fi IoT Threat Detection), an Innovate UK-funded project developing a standalone, plug-and-play cybersecurity proof of concept for critical infrastructure. About Luton AI Luton AI is the University of Bedfordshire's growing applied AI research and innovation initiative, connecting researchers, engineers and industry partners to solve real-world problems. Since 2024, we have engaged more than 600 organisations and undertaken over 60 bespoke AI projects, spanning aviation, public services, cybersecurity and critical infrastructure. Our expanding AI computing and cybersecurity facilities support the development of new technology, from early research to working demonstrators. You will join a collaborative, interdisciplinary team focused on turning ambitious technical ideas into useful, deployable solutions. About the role Working with Luton AI academics and industry partners, you will lead day-to-day technical development and integration of a working proof of concept combining Wi-Fi radio-frequency (RF) telemetry, machine learning, cybersecurity software and locally deployed AI for human-readable threat explanations. You will translate research into a functional demonstrator, with an emphasis on robust software, reproducible experimentation and evaluation in realistic environments. What you will be doing Capturing and processing Wi-Fi RF metadata and network telemetry through passive monitoring and commercially available sensing technologies. Building data ingestion, processing and analysis pipelines for wireless telemetry. Designing, training and evaluating machine learning methods to detect anomalous, unmanaged or potentially malicious IoT activity. Combining spatial, behavioural, RF and network features, with local large language models to explain detected threats. Developing Python-based services, APIs, an accessible dashboard and interfaces with SIEM/SOC security tooling. Testing, benchmarking and refining the integrated proof of concept, documenting performance and limitations. Collaborating with academic and industry partners and contributing to reports, demonstrations, technical documentation and research or IP outputs. About you We are looking for a technically capable, self-directed researcher who enjoys developing working systems. You will have: A good honours degree, or equivalent professional experience, in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, AI, Data Science, Electronic Engineering or a related discipline. Strong Python software development skills and knowledge of machine learning for anomaly detection or classification. An understanding of Wi-Fi/network telemetry and cybersecurity, with practical experience analysing wireless or network data. Experience developing end-to-end data or software prototypes and evaluating models on real-world data. The ability to manage technical delivery, document findings and collaborate with academic and external partners. Experience with local LLMs, edge deployment, RF sensing, Linux, containerisation, APIs or SIEM/SOC integration would be advantageous. For an informal discussion, please contact Dr Edward Braund, Head of School and Director of Luton AI, on 01582 743209 or edward.braund@beds.ac.uk For a full job description and person specification The post will be based at Luton (with travel to other campuses as required) Interview date is w/c 23rd Nov 2026. items.desc: AV Engineer Every week, our cameras produce thousands of live broadcasts across more than 15 sports, with no camera operator behind them. As AV Engineer, you make sure the cameras, audio and servers behind every one of them perform. About Studio Automated At Studio Automated, we are redefining how the sports and media industry operates through AI-driven camera automation. Based in Amsterdam, overlooking the IJ, Studio Automated develops intelligent technology that automates the pan, tilt and zoom of cameras for sports productions and media environments. Since 2020, our technology has been scaling rapidly across the globe on edge devices and in the cloud. Our systems run from affordable Streaming setups that let clubs stream every match automatically, to Broadcast-grade multi-camera and VAR solutions for top-level productions. Our customers range from sports clubs and sports analytics companies to streaming providers and broadcasters, and the number of sports we cover keeps growing. In April 2026, Studio Automated was acquired by two major players in the market, marking the start of our next growth phase as a scale-up company. The best is still ahead, and it is the perfect time to join during the scaling phase. We are now looking for an experienced AV Engineer to join our hardware team. The role Our hardware team is three people, so you own a whole domain: technical integration. You decide how cameras, audio and edge servers come together with our automation software, from the lab to the stadium. You will report to the Head of Hardware. You will: Integrate cameras, audio and edge servers with our automation stack Evaluate and qualify new cameras, lenses, audio gear and server hardware Set up and tune image and audio capture and processing pipelines Calibrate systems and run field tests at venues Work closely with our software and AI engineers to solve hardware-software issues Document setups so installs are repeatable Technical profile Required: Hands-on experience with camera and imaging capture and processing Experience with audio capture and processing Solid knowledge of PC and server hardware Comfortable with on-site calibration and testing at venues Bonus: Broadcast or live sports production experience Basic knowledge of SDI, NDI, SMPTE ST 2110 and PTZ control Networking for AV (IP video, PoE, multicast) Video capture cards, GPUs and edge compute Linux and scripting (e.g. Python, Bash) Personal profile You like owning a technical area end to end and making the calls You stay calm and methodical when something fails an hour before kick-off You enjoy being at venues as much as in the lab, and travel to venues when needed You explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-engineers What we offer A founding role in a three-person hardware team, with a real say in how it grows Your work goes live every week, from grassroots clubs to top-level leagues Hands-on time with the latest broadcast cameras, audio and edge hardware Close collaboration with our software and AI engineers Hybrid working from our Amsterdam office overlooking the IJ Competitive salary and growth opportunities How to apply Send your CV and/or motivation letter to Christian Gedde-Dahl at christiangeddedahl@studioautomated.com. Feel free to reach out with any questions about the role. Job Type: Full-time Pay: €3.000,00 - €5.000,00 per month Work Location: Hybrid remote in Amsterdam (Gemeente Amsterdam)

items.desc: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you. About the Role We are seeking an experienced QA Analyst to join our Quality Assurance team. This is a strategic, client-facing role focused on identifying systemic issues before they impact our customers. You will conduct hypothesis-driven target audits, partner with account management teams, and drive root cause analysis that protects our commercial relationships and drives meaningful operational improvements. This role is perfect for someone who loves investigative work, has deep claims expertise, and wants to make a tangible impact on business outcomes. What You'll Do Proactive Issue Identification: Find problems before clients do by conducting strategic target audits across accounts, lines of business, and exposures Hypothesis-Driven Investigations: Develop and test hypotheses about potential quality issues, then execute detailed audits to validate findings Strategic Analysis: Conduct deep-dive, exposure-specific, LOB-specific, and client-specific reviews that require seasoned claims judgment Account Partnership: Participate in account management calls, discuss client expectations, and serve as a trusted quality advisor Root Cause Analysis: Lead root cause investigations with leadership teams, present findings with clear recommendations and action plans Accountability & Escalation: Follow through to ensure action plans are executed; escalate when teams don't follow through on required actions Collaboration: Work closely with the QA team on escalated issues and with leadership to drive systemic improvements What Makes This Role Unique Unlike traditional QA roles focused on individual file audits, this is focused on strategic and investigative claims handling. You'll have the autonomy to identify what to investigate, design your approach, and drive change at the account and organizational level. Your work directly protects revenue and strengthens client relationships. Required Qualifications Claims Experience: 3-5+ years of claims adjusting experience across multiple lines of business Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of exposures, coverage, and regulatory requirements QA/Audit Background: Previous quality assurance, audit, or quality review experience Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to identify patterns, trends, and root causes in complex data Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting findings to leadership Strategic Thinking: Ability to see both details and big picture; hypothesis development and problem-solving skills Preferred Qualifications Experience working across multiple client accounts or business units Track record of identifying and resolving systemic operational issues Client-facing or account management experience Experience with data analysis tools and dashboards Familiarity with AI/LLM tools in claims or quality processes Key Competencies Investigative Mindset: Natural curiosity about why issues occur, not just what occurred Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop hypotheses and design audits to test them Independence: Self-directed and comfortable working with ambiguity Influence: Can challenge leaders constructively with data-backed recommendations Detail-Oriented: Thorough in analysis while maintaining big-picture perspective Relationship Management: Builds trust with stakeholders at all levels Proactive: Takes initiative to surface issues before they escalate What Success Looks Like Identifying systemic issues before clients raise concerns Building trusted relationships with account managers and directors Driving measurable improvements in quality outcomes through root cause work Contributing strategic insights that inform operational decisions At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Description
 🚀 Le Bureau des Talents est spécialisé dans la chasse, l’accompagnement et le coaching des talents pour les startups, les scale-ups et les entreprises à impact.
 Description de l’entreprise 
 Notre client est une entreprise à impact en forte croissance qui développe des solutions digitales au service d'un secteur essentiel de la société.
 Portée par une forte culture produit et technologique, l'entreprise investit continuellement dans ses plateformes, ses outils et l'innovation afin d'améliorer l'expérience de ses utilisateurs et l'efficacité de ses opérations.
 Dans le cadre de son développement, elle souhaite accélérer l'intégration de l'IA au sein de ses produits et de ses processus internes, tout en conservant un haut niveau d'exigence technique, de qualité et de maintenabilité.
 L'environnement est entrepreneurial, agile et responsabilisant, avec une équipe à taille humaine où chaque collaborateur contribue directement aux orientations stratégiques et aux décisions structurantes.
 Mission
 Principales missions et responsabilités 
 Architecture & Développement
 Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des applications métier stratégiques. 
 Participer aux décisions d'architecture et aux choix technologiques structurants. 
 Garantir la robustesse, la performance et la maintenabilité des systèmes. 
 Piloter des projets techniques complexes de bout en bout. 
 Identifier les risques techniques et proposer des solutions adaptées. 
 Accompagner la modernisation et l'évolution des plateformes existantes. 
 Intelligence Artificielle & Innovation
 Évaluer les opportunités offertes par les technologies d'IA pour les produits et les opérations. 
 Concevoir et intégrer des solutions d'IA dans les workflows métiers et les outils internes. 
 Définir les bonnes pratiques d'utilisation de l'IA afin de garantir fiabilité, cohérence et qualité. 
 Participer à la structuration de la stratégie IA de l'entreprise aux côtés du CTO. 
 Accompagner l'adoption de nouveaux outils et usages auprès des équipes. 
 Collaboration & Leadership Technique
 Travailler en proximité avec le CTO sur les orientations techniques. 
 Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques d'ingénierie. 
 Participer aux réflexions stratégiques liées à l'évolution des produits et des systèmes. 
 Être une force de proposition sur les sujets d'innovation et d'optimisation. 
 Profile
 Profil recherché 
 Must-have
 Formation supérieure en informatique (Bac +5 ou équivalent). 
 Minimum 4 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel. 
 Expérience significative sur des systèmes complexes en production. 
 Solide expertise backend (Python/Django ou technologies équivalentes). 
 Bonne maîtrise des technologies frontend modernes (React ou équivalent). 
 Excellente compréhension des bases de données relationnelles. 
 Expérience en conception et évolution d'architectures logicielles. 
 Capacité à piloter un sujet complexe de manière autonome jusqu'à sa mise en production. 
 Forte capacité d'analyse et de prise de décision technique. 
 Nice-to-have
 Expérience sur des environnements cloud. 
 Expérience des architectures distribuées et des intégrations complexes. 
 Expérience dans l'intégration d'outils ou de solutions d'intelligence artificielle. 
 Intérêt marqué pour les sujets liés à l'automatisation et à l'IA générative. 
 Expérience dans des environnements à forte croissance ou en transformation. 
 Soft Skills
 Vision systémique et sens de l'impact. 
 Esprit entrepreneurial. 
 Autonomie et sens des responsabilités. 
 Curiosité intellectuelle et technologique. 
 Pragmatisme et capacité à arbitrer entre différentes solutions. 
 Infos pratiques 
 CDI. 
 Basé à Marseille (ou à Paris) 
 Organisation hybride 
 Équipe technique à taille humaine. 
 Environnement favorisant l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative. 
 Pourquoi les rejoindre 
 Devenir un acteur clé de la stratégie technologique de l'entreprise. 
 Co-construire avec le CTO la vision et l'adoption de l'intelligence artificielle. 
 Influencer directement les choix d'architecture et les orientations techniques. 
 Travailler sur des problématiques complexes avec un impact concret et visible. 
 Rejoindre une équipe à taille humaine où chaque décision compte. 
 Bénéficier d'un niveau d'ownership rarement proposé sur ce type de poste. 
 Participer à la transformation des produits et des opérations grâce à l'IA.

items.desc: About The Role We’re looking for experienced software engineers to help develop ExecuTorch, PyTorch’s framework for running AI models efficiently on edge devices. You’ll join a team building software across AI model optimisation, compilers, runtimes and hardware acceleration. Our technology spans Python developer tools and ahead-of-time compilation through to portable C++ runtimes and hardware-accelerated backends, giving you the opportunity to contribute at different layers of the software stack. A key part of this role is understanding how AI models execute on hardware, identifying bottlenecks and improving cycle count, latency, memory use and power efficiency. You’ll move between high-level model transformations and low-level runtime and hardware behaviour to solve complex performance problems. ExecuTorch targets Arm technology including Mali GPUs with Neural Graphics, Cortex-A and Cortex-M CPUs, and Ethos-U NPUs. We contribute to ExecuTorch in the open and work with the wider PyTorch community to help developers deploy AI models efficiently across mobile, embedded and other resource-constrained platforms. What You’ll Do Develop and optimise components of the ExecuTorch compiler, runtime and developer tooling, ranging from Python APIs and model transformations to low-level C and C++ components. Analyse and profile AI workloads to identify bottlenecks, improving latency, memory use, cycle count and power efficiency across model transformations, generated code, runtimes and hardware backends. Develop optimised backends for Mali GPUs, Cortex-A and Cortex-M CPUs, Ethos-U NPUs and other edge platforms, while investigating software and performance challenges across the stack. items.title: R&I Data Scientist
items.card: you will turn data from systems including EDGE, Florence, Tableau and NIHR reporting platforms into clear, actionable intelligence. You will work closely with R&I leaders, operational teams and colleagues across the wider Trust to improve visibility of the clinical trial pipeline, forecast demand, identify risks and capacity pressures, and support evidence-based decisions about workforce, resources and service
items.desc: We are looking for an experienced and motivated Data Scientist to join our Research and Innovation (R&I) Division. This is an exciting opportunity to use advanced analytics, predictive modelling and data visualisation to help shape the future of clinical research at The Christie. Working across a complex research portfolio, you will turn data from systems including EDGE, Florence, Tableau and NIHR reporting platforms into clear, actionable intelligence. You will work closely with R&I leaders, operational teams and colleagues across the wider Trust to improve visibility of the clinical trial pipeline, forecast demand, identify risks and capacity pressures, and support evidence-based decisions about workforce, resources and service development. We are seeking someone who can combine strong technical expertise with curiosity, sound judgement and the ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Please note that this role is hybrid working, with 2 days on site per week required. The post holder will collect, link, analyse and interpret large and complex datasets from multiple sources, ensuring that outputs are accurate, timely and meaningful. They will develop and maintain dashboards, reports, forecasts and analytical products for audiences including the R&I Leadership Team, ERIG, Trust Board, senior committees and external stakeholders. Using statistical and machine-learning techniques, the post holder will model future trial activity and demand, identify trends, inequalities, risks and capacity constraints, and translate findings into practical recommendations. This will support research performance, workforce and resource planning, patient recruitment, the national 150-day site set-up target, and improved diversity and inclusivity in research participation. The successful candidate will have substantial experience of data science, statistics or business intelligence, including strong skills in R, Python, TSQL, data modelling and visualisation. They will work autonomously and collaboratively, manage complex projects, maintain clear technical documentation, support safe change management, and ensure solutions comply with NHS data, information governance, security and quality standards. The role also includes providing technical guidance and line management support to junior staff. The Christie is one of Europe’s leading cancer centres, looking after more than 64,000 patients a year. We are based in Manchester and serve a population of 3.2 million across Greater Manchester & Cheshire, but as a national specialist around 25% patients are referred to us from other parts of the country. We are the largest radiotherapy provider in the NHS with one in 20 treatments delivered at The Christie. We have up to 15 linear accelerators operating across our network of sites. We operate the largest chemotherapy unit in the UK on our main site and treatments are also provided at 13 other networked sites, and in patients homes. And as a specialist tertiary surgical centre, we focus on rare cancers, complex procedures, and multidisciplinary approaches to cancer surgery, specialising in colorectal, peritoneal, gynaecological, urological and plastic surgery. We are also an international leader in research, with world first breakthroughs for over 100 years. We have been named by the UK’s National Institute for Health Research (NIHR), as one of the best hospitals providing opportunities for patients to participate in clinical research studies, with more than 800 studies open at any time, caring for over 3,000 patients. For further details / informal visits contact: Name: Kirstie Shearman Job title: R&I Service Manager Email address: Kirstie.shearman1@nhs.net
