items.desc: About Us & The Product Jeppesen Foreflight is one of the largest software development companies in Gothenburg.We develop and implement innovative resource management and optimization solutions for the world’s leading airlines. We are dedicated to continuous improvement and delivering more value to our clients. At Jeppesen’s office in central Gothenburg you will work in a one-of-a-kind software development organization with solutions that make a real difference to people around the world. You will be working in an agile learning organization, surrounded by a team of talented, creative and dedicated colleagues. You will learn and broaden your perspective by working with 400 professionals from more than 50 different nations, but also be part of a global organization allowing for collaboration with customers and colleagues across the world. Most importantly, you will be expected to make a difference. How do we best use AI to keep our competitive edge? That question is very much alive across our organization right now. Our AI enablement team works closely with product teams across the organization. We don't deliver finished features ourselves — we help other teams understand what's possible, show them how to build it and support them along the way. The work is hands-on, collaborative and moves fast. About You You're a software developer or machine learning engineer who has gotten genuinely into generative AI. You've built things with it that actually work in production, and you understand what that takes. You're the kind of person who picks things up and runs with them. When something needs to happen, you figure out how to make it happen without waiting to be told. You ask when you're unsure, but then you move. You also like helping other developers grow. You contribute in meetings, you share what you know and you're comfortable jumping into an unfamiliar team and being useful quickly. You think about how your own work can be done better and faster, and you're already using AI tools to get there. You move between teams and contexts with ease, enjoy meeting new people and you're deliberate about how you hand over knowledge when you move on so that the value you created stays behind. What We Think You Have Drive to teach, coach and inspire others A solid software engineering foundation. You write code that others can read, test and build on. You think about clean interfaces and long-term maintainability, not just getting something to run. Real experience working with LLMs in practice like context management, tool calling, structured output, retrieval. You know which details matter when you need something to behave reliably, not just impressively. Experience building agents or agentic systems and an understanding of what makes them fail. You think about failure modes, state, fallbacks and how to know when something has gone wrong. Experience from the production phase of an AI product — not just shipping it, but the ongoing work of keeping it running, handling real edge cases and improving it based on how actual users interact with it. Some instinct for evals and observability. You care about whether what you shipped is actually working, and you've thought about how to measure that. Comfortable developing and running AI systems in a cloud environment. You don't need to be a cloud infrastructure specialist, but you need to be able to find your way around and get things deployed without being blocked. Meriting Experience Experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow) Experience with data pipelines and orchestration What We Can Offer You Learning something new every day Highly motivated and skilled teammates Working with new technologies in a domain where AI actually makes a real difference Exploring and innovating together with teams across the organization Having fun at work Relocation: This position does not offer relocation. Candidates must live in the immediate area of Gothenburg or relocate at their own expense. Please apply by sending your CV (PDF format) in English. items.desc: Chez MBDA, le sens de notre mission est ce qui nous unit : contribuer à la souveraineté des nations et préserver notre sécurité et notre liberté en Europe. Pour y parvenir, la collaboration et la confiance sont essentielles. MBDA doit relever des défis uniques pour répondre aux besoins des forces armées face à de nouvelles menaces. Motivés par les challenges technologiques, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation, de la science et de la technologie pour développer des solutions au meilleur niveau. Nous encourageons le dépassement de soi dans un environnement unique qui offre des opportunités à chacun d’entre nous. Ensemble, nous sommes fiers du rôle que nous jouons. Au sein de la Direction Technical, vous rejoignez le Centre d'Excellence franco-britannique dédié aux senseurs de navigation. Vous participez au développement de technologies de navigation de haute précision intégrées aux systèmes de défense de nouvelle génération. Au sein d'une équipe d'une quinzaine d'ingénieur(e)s, vous intervenez sur la conception, la modélisation et la validation d'algorithmes embarqués pour des récepteurs GNSS et des fonctions de navigation résistantes aux environnements les plus exigeants. Vous évoluez dans un environnement fortement technique, au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires (antennes, traitement du signal, électronique, système, essais...) et bénéficiez d'un accompagnement technique vous permettant de développer rapidement votre expertise sur le domaine GNSS. Au Sein De L'équipe, Vous Participez Au Développement Des Futures Solutions De Navigation En Intervenant Sur L'ensemble De La Chaîne D'études Pour concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes de traitement du signal appliqués aux systèmes GNSS ; réaliser des études de performances, des simulations numériques et des modélisations sous MATLAB/Simulink ou C/C++ ; analyser les résultats d'essais (simulation, laboratoire, vols ou tirs) afin de valider les performances des solutions développées ; contribuer à l'intégration des algorithmes dans les équipements et les modèles de référence ; participer aux investigations techniques et au traitement des faits techniques en collaboration avec les différents métiers ; assurer le suivi technique de certaines activités confiées à des partenaires externes ; rédiger la documentation technique et présenter vos travaux aux équipes projets. Des déplacements sont à prévoir sur les sites de Bourges et Selles Saint Denis. Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en radiofréquences, traitement du signal ou télécommunications, vous justifiez d'une première expérience (stage, apprentissage ou premier emploi) en conception d'algorithmes, modélisation ou développement de systèmes RF. Vous possédez des connaissances en traitement du signal, radiofréquences ou systèmes de navigation . Des compétences en MATLAB, Simulink et/ou C/C++ seront appréciées. Une expertise préalable en GNSS n'est pas indispensable : vous bénéficierez dès votre arrivée d'un accompagnement et d'un parcours de formation dédié pour monter progressivement en compétences. Curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et doté(e) d'un bon esprit d'analyse, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et les environnements techniques multidisciplinaires. Un niveau d'anglais professionnel est requis. 🛰️ Développer des algorithmes de navigation de pointe au cœur des futurs systèmes de défense. 🎓 Bénéficier d'un accompagnement technique et d'une montée en compétences sur les technologies GNSS auprès d'une équipe d'experts. 🤝 Évoluer dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire mêlant traitement du signal, radiofréquences, modélisation, essais et ingénierie système. Notre rémunération comporte un salaire fixe et des éléments additionnels individuels (une part variable pour nos salariés cadres et une prime d’ancienneté ainsi qu’une prime annuelle pour nos salariés non-cadres) ou collectifs dépendant de la performance et des résultats de l’entreprise (participation, intéressement). De nombreux services/avantages sont également proposés : restaurant d’entreprise, épargne salariale (PEG, PERCOL), protection sociale (mutuelle et prévoyance), comité social et économique, infirmerie et service de santé au travail interne...

items.desc: The way people discover and book holidays is changing, and we're rebuilding our technology for what comes next. We are Awaze, Europe’s largest managed vacation rentals and holiday resorts business, bringing together some of the continent’s most recognised travel brands, including cottages.com, Hoseasons, NOVASOL and James Villa Holidays. With more than 1.5 million bookings every year, 100,000+ properties and customers across Europe, we already operate at serious scale. But the next chapter for Awaze is about much more than scale. We’re embarking on an ambitious AI transformation that will reshape how our customers discover, plan and book their holidays, and how our engineering teams build the technology behind those experiences. Our strategy spans AI-powered search, natural-language discovery, intelligent recommendations, richer property data and AI-assisted engineering, all underpinned by a platform built around speed, trust, quality and real-time data. Position: Data Scientist We're looking for an exceptional product-minded Data Scientist who can build and operate warehouse-based ML pipelines, design decision-relevant metrics and experiments, and reason about ranking well enough to decide what should be modelled, monitored and changed. The role will extend Awaze's existing sort-order capability: training tabular propensity models; combining their outputs with commercial and customer criteria through multi-criteria scoring; tuning and evaluating criteria and weights; and designing reliable ranking outputs for Search and other customer surfaces. This is primarily a Data Science role rather than a pure ML Engineering role. Strong engineering practice is essential, but the differentiator is the ability to connect models, experiments and business decisions: formulate hypotheses, distinguish prediction from causal impact, understand interactions between ranking, price, promotion and channel decisions, and turn evidence into a product recommendation. The data scientist will also own work beyond initial delivery: stakeholder discovery, roadmap shaping, experiment readouts, production monitoring, documentation, mentoring and knowledge transfer. A bit more about what you'll be doing: Building intelligent ranking and recommendation capabilities Develop, improve and operate Machine Learning models that predict customer preferences, propensity to book and property relevance. Evolve our existing ranking capability using Python, CatBoost, optimisation techniques and multi-criteria decision-making. Explore more advanced ranking approaches, including personalised search, destination-specific ranking and recommendation systems. Balance multiple commercial and customer objectives, including conversion, relevance, pricing, margin and inventory exposure. Design reliable ML pipelines and ensure model outputs can be effectively integrated into customer-facing products. Driving experimentation and commercial impact Design and run A/B tests to understand how ranking changes influence customer behaviour and business outcomes. Partner with Product and Commercial teams to define hypotheses, success metrics and measurable business opportunities. Apply statistical reasoning and causal thinking to distinguish correlation, predictive performance and genuine incremental impact. Evaluate trade-offs between ranking, pricing, promotions, inventory and marketing decisions. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations that influence product and commercial strategy. Building scalable, production-ready Data Science Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines using Python, SQL, Snowflake and AWS. Establish robust model evaluation, monitoring, alerting and retraining processes. Develop reporting tools and dashboards that provide visibility into model performance and commercial outcomes. Apply strong engineering practices across version control, testing, documentation and production deployment. Improve existing systems pragmatically while laying the foundations for more advanced capabilities. Who We're Looking For: We're looking for someone who combines strong applied Data Science expertise with commercial curiosity, product thinking and the ability to turn insight into action. You'll ideally bring: Strong hands-on experience developing and deploying Machine Learning models using Python. Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform. Experience implementing and evaluating ranking models, recommendation systems or optimisation solutions. Exposure to search relevance, learning-to-rank, recommender systems or personalisation. A strong understanding of A/B testing, statistical experimentation, hypothesis testing and causal reasoning. Experience designing meaningful product and commercial metrics, including guardrails and experiment success measures. Knowledge of multi-criteria optimisation, weighted scoring or similar decision-making approaches. Experience building and operating …

Som Data Scientist hos oss får du analysera stora datamängder, utveckla modeller och metoder samt driva förbättringar som bidrar till ökad kvalitet och bättre beslutsunderlag. Om tjänsten Som Data Scientist inom Kapacitetsmodeller har du en central roll i att utveckla metoder för att analysera och höja kvaliteten på de prognosticerade modeller enheten skapar. Rollen är en kombination av analys, utveckling och verksamhetsnära förbättringsarbete där du bidrar till att höja kvaliteten och träffsäkerheten i våra modeller. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: analysera stora datamängder för att identifiera förbättringsområden och säkerställa kvaliteten i de modeller och prognoser som verksamheten använder utveckla metoder, verktyg och applikationer för uppföljning, analys och kontinuerlig kvalitetsutveckling av modeller och data driva analyser som ligger till grund för framtida utveckling och förbättringar av modeller, arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar identifiera behov av nya eller vidareutvecklade lösningar samt ta fram krav, följa upp och kvalitetssäkra leveranser från externa leverantörer vid behov delta i och bidra till arbetsgrupper både internt och nordiskt för att utveckla metoder, processer och lösningar inom området självständigt driva ansvarsområden och förändringsinitiativ från analys och idé till genomförande och uppföljning. Du får möjlighet att utveckla enhetens strategi kring hur analyser kan appliceras på kraftsystem för att generera insikter om hur data påverkar utfallet och framför allt uträknade kapaciteter i systemet. Du får även möjlighet att utvecklas genom kunskapsutbyte med nordiska systemoperatörer samt genom relevanta utbildningar och kurser inom kraftsystemanalys. Du kommer att tillhöra enheten Kapacitetsmodeller som består av 10 medarbetare och är organiserad i tre team: operativt team, utvecklingsteam och produktägarteam. Denna tjänst ingår i utvecklingsteamet. Enhetens huvudsakliga uppdrag är att vidareutveckla och operativt stötta och övervaka processen att skapa prognosticerade nätmodeller. Vi har ett nära samarbete mellan teamen där kunskapsutbyte och gemensam problemlösning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Hos oss präglas arbetet av prestigelöshet och ett gemensamt fokus på verksamhetens mål. Om dig Skallkrav: Personliga egenskaper: För att lyckas i rollen är du analytisk och har förmåga att omsätta komplex information och stora datamängder till insikter och förbättringsförslag. Du är även strukturerad och arbetar metodiskt för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i dina leveranser. Rollen kräver dessutom kreativitet och uthållighet, där du har förmågan att pröva nya angreppssätt när utmaningarna är komplexa och vägen framåt inte alltid är självklar. Samtidigt är du samarbetsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra för att nå gemensamma mål och driva utveckling framåt. Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden. I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. items.desc: About The Role We’re looking for experienced software engineers to help develop ExecuTorch, PyTorch’s framework for running AI models efficiently on edge devices. You’ll join a team building software across AI model optimisation, compilers, runtimes and hardware acceleration. Our technology spans Python developer tools and ahead-of-time compilation through to portable C++ runtimes and hardware-accelerated backends, giving you the opportunity to contribute at different layers of the software stack. A key part of this role is understanding how AI models execute on hardware, identifying bottlenecks and improving cycle count, latency, memory use and power efficiency. You’ll move between high-level model transformations and low-level runtime and hardware behaviour to solve complex performance problems. ExecuTorch targets Arm technology including Mali GPUs with Neural Graphics, Cortex-A and Cortex-M CPUs, and Ethos-U NPUs. We contribute to ExecuTorch in the open and work with the wider PyTorch community to help developers deploy AI models efficiently across mobile, embedded and other resource-constrained platforms. What You’ll Do Develop and optimise components of the ExecuTorch compiler, runtime and developer tooling, ranging from Python APIs and model transformations to low-level C and C++ components. Analyse and profile AI workloads to identify bottlenecks, improving latency, memory use, cycle count and power efficiency across model transformations, generated code, runtimes and hardware backends. Develop optimised backends for Mali GPUs, Cortex-A and Cortex-M CPUs, Ethos-U NPUs and other edge platforms, while investigating software and performance challenges across the stack. Identify technical opportunities and take solutions from initial idea through delivery, working with engineers across Arm and contributors in the PyTorch open-source community. Share technical knowledge and, depending on your experience, contribute to technical projects and mentor other engineers. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for professional software engineering experience using C++ and Python, including developing, debugging and maintaining production-quality software. You’ll have knowledge of programming, compilers, runtimes or performance optimisation, along with an interest in understanding how software executes on hardware and how its efficiency can be improved. An interest in AI and deploying models on resource-constrained devices will also be valuable. You should be able to identify technical problems, determine a practical approach and take work through to completion. The role also requires good communication, technical judgement and the ability to work effectively with engineers across different teams. You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification. AI and edge computing are evolving quickly, and relevant experience can come from different technical areas. If you’re keen to develop your knowledge and tackle new technical challenges, we’d like to hear from you! Useful Additional Experience Experience with PyTorch, ExecuTorch or another machine-learning framework would be useful, as would knowledge of ahead-of-time compilers, graph transformation or model optimisation. We’re also interested in experience with embedded systems, mobile or edge computing, hardware-accelerator programming, performance analysis, Vulkan, open-source development, technical leadership or mentoring. Why Join the Team? Help develop open-source AI technology used by developers around the world! You’ll have opportunities to build expertise across AI software, compilers, runtimes and edge computing while solving problems that connect software directly with the underlying hardware. The breadth of the role allows you to explore both high-level AI frameworks and low-level hardware optimisation, improving performance and power efficiency across a wide range of edge devices. You’ll also work with specialists across Arm and the wider PyTorch ecosystem, with opportunities to develop and share your technical expertise. We support different needs and ways of working. If you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we’ll work with you to provide the support you need. Please note that no relocation package is available for this role. Our 10x Mindset At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. items.desc: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. Role Overview: As a Data Scientist, you will help measure the impact of PlayStation's products, features and commercial initiatives through experimentation, causal inference and applied data science. Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will apply robust analytical techniques to solve complex business problems, generate actionable insights and support evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation. This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will apply modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to evaluate initiatives where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to deliver high-quality measurement and insights. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives affecting millions of PlayStation players while developing your expertise in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science. What You'll Be Doing: Apply measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics to evaluate product and commercial initiatives. Design and execute robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical. Apply statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex measurement challenges and generate actionable business insights. Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions. Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement. Partner closely with product managers, engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence. Collaborate with engineering teams by providing feedback on experimentation and measurement capabilities to improve tooling and workflows. Develop reusable analytical solutions, dashboards and code that improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of measurement. Communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Stay current with emerging developments in statistics, machine learning and AI, identifying opportunities to improve measurement capabilities and analytical workflows. Contribute to a culture of evidence-based decision-making by sharing knowledge, collaborating across teams and promoting analytical best practices. What We're Looking For: Required: Master's degree (or equivalent industry experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. PhD preferred. 3+ years of industry experience applying experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning or related analytical techniques to solve business problems. Good understanding of experimental design, A/B testing and modern causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental approaches. Experience applying data science, machine learning and statistical modelling techniques to analyse complex datasets and generate actionable insights. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for analytical workflows. Experience developing robust analytical solutions using sound statistical principles and software engineering best practices. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Curiosity, creativity and a pragmatic approach to solving ambiguous business problems. A collaborative mindset with a passion for continuous learning and improving analytical capabilities. Preferred: Experience working in gaming, digital products, consumer technology, e-commerce or subscription businesses. Familiarity with modern data engineering and analytics tooling such as Databricks, Snowflake, Git and Airflow. items.desc: Job Description Asset Modelling Data Scientist Working hours - Full time 37 hours per week (flexible working arrangements including part time will be considered) Fixed Term Contract or Secondment - 2 years Salary - from £49,810 to £58,600 per year (depending on experience) Location - hybrid working with office location at Pity Me, Durham At Northumbrian Water, our customers are at the heart of everything we do. Every day, we provide essential water and wastewater services to millions of people, and we are committed to delivering reliable, affordable and sustainable services while supporting our communities and protecting the environment. By focusing on the outcomes that matter most to our customers, we are also working towards our ambition to be the National Leader in sustainable water and wastewater services. We are building a dedicated team to create our PR29 business plan, which will set out what we will deliver for customers and the environment, and the investment needed to achieve it, between 2030 and 2035. We are recruiting a number of key roles to join this team, offering an exciting opportunity to work with colleagues across Northumbrian Water, influence important decisions and help develop an ambitious and compelling plan that delivers lasting value for our customers and communities. About The Role We have new opportunities for Asset Modelling Data Scientists who will play a key role in delivering solutions to strategic, tactical and operational business challenges through data analytics, statistical modelling, simulation and optimisation. Working within the Asset modelling team, the role uses asset, operational and business data to identify trends, forecast future performance, model investment scenarios, inform PR29 planning and provide evidence-based recommendations to decision makers. You will work collaboratively and build positive relationships with stakeholders including operational, maintenance and planning teams to improve data quality, strengthen modelling approaches, transfer knowledge and encourage innovation in analytical decision making. You will gather, transform, validate and prepare asset and operational data from multiple sources including SQL and geospatial databases for analysis and modelling. You will investigate and develop asset performance relationships using statistical analysis, technical knowledge and industry insight. You will identify critical data needs, data quality issues and gaps, and influence the business to address them sustainably. You will develop, maintain and enhance asset performance, deterioration and forecasting models and apply optimisation techniques to identify the most efficient intervention and investment solutions. You will produce forecasts of asset condition and performance and recommending interventions to support service plans. About You If you have experience of solving problems using data mining techniques and statistical modelling to develop practical solutions, we would love to hear from you! You will have excellent interpersonal and engagement skills and the ability to build positive relationships with stakeholders at varying levels, communicating clearly and with confidence. You will be skilled in data analysis, modelling, machine learning and programming, with a good working knowledge of a statistical programming language, such as R or Python. Any successful candidate will be expected to develop proficiency in R as part of the role. We will be hosting an Open Evening session to learn more about PR29 roles at our Northumbria House office in Pity Me, Durham on Tuesday 10th November 2026. Please register your interest at: recruitment@nwl.co.uk Please note this role will require a DBS to be completed prior to employment .

items.desc: Are you an (AI-native) software engineer with a passion for technology and a strong desire to work on the development of life-critical IT systems in the healthcare sector? Do you want to be part of a team that constantly challenges itself and drives innovation forward? We are now looking for a motivated and technically skilled software engineer to join our Amplifier group. The Amplifier group is responsible for a SaaS offering called Amplifier Services, a fully managed service allowing Sectra PACS customers to easily access AI applications for clinical use. Our service offering consists of a combination of our own software products (Amplifier Platform and Connector Proxy) combined with Sectra's other products and services and the use of Azure for deployment. Through our service, we are part of an ongoing revolution within healthcare, where AI goes from being a pipe dream to a clinical reality making a difference for both patients and healthcare providers. We're looking for someone who wants to grow in an environment where your experience is valued and where you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the successful adoption of AI in clinical practice. What You Will Do Design, build, and maintain high-quality services and applications used in medical imaging workflows. Apply AI tools (e.g., code assistants, code generators) responsibly to increase velocity without compromising quality, security, or cost. Collaborate with product management, operations, clinicians and end-users, to translate clinical needs into robust solutions. Own features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, observability, documentation, and deployment. Implement and uphold strong engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, performance profiling, etc. Work with medical imaging standards and infrastructure (e.g., DICOM, HL7/FHIR, PACS/VNA, cloud services). Continuously learn: evaluate new tools, frameworks, and AI capabilities; share knowledge across the team. Location This role is based at our headquarters in Linköping. , At Sectra, we hire for attitude and ability – train for skill. This means who you are is more important than your previous experiences. There are a few core abilities that are central for any role at Sectra. We always look for your willingness and ability to learn and take on new tasks fast, utilize previous experiences and quickly grasp new information. We also want you to have a strong analytical and solution-oriented mindset as we consider it to be important that you can understand and break down and solve problems. What You Bring Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures/algorithms, concurrency, networking, API design, software architecture. Proficiency in one or more programming languages for software development (e.g., C# or Python) and modern software engineering tooling. Quality mindset: automated testing, observability (metrics/logs/traces), and performance awareness. Security and privacy literacy (secure coding, handling sensitive data). Curiosity and learning agility; ability to adapt to new domains, tools, and AI workflows. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, product-oriented approach. Required: Humor and strong academic record from university and upper secondary school; please include transcripts or grade summaries in your application. Required: Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Most of all, we are looking for an open, passionate person who shares our values, is a true team player and will enjoy working with us at Sectra. Nice to have Experience with cloud services, containers, and CI/CD (AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes or serverless). Experience in medical imaging or healthcare IT (DICOM, HL7/FHIR, imaging pipelines, PACS/VNA). Infrastructure and reliability skills (SRE practices, performance engineering, cost). Pursue passions outside of work, whether in sports, music, the arts, or unique hobbies. Experience from different cultures. What We Offer You The opportunity to work with advanced technology that makes a real difference for patients and healthcare providers. A dynamic and developmental work environment with great variety of tasks. The chance to influence your own career development and specialize in areas that interest you. A team of dedicated and experienced colleagues who will support and challenge you. Application The goal is for the right candidate to start as soon as possible. We recruit on an ongoing basis. This means we encourage you to apply or contact us as soon as possible. Depending on the role, a mandatory background security screening might be performed as part of the recruitment process at Sectra. Please reach out to the responsible hiring team if you have any questions regarding this. Learn more about our recruitment process here.

items.desc: 👋 Welcome to dexter health! At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients. We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features. The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed. You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day. Tasks As our AI Engineer, you will: Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow Ship quickly while keeping production quality high Requirements We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles. Must-have Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment Clear written and spoken English Nice-to-have Experience with frontend or fullstack product development Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation German language skills Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows This role is probably not for you if You are mainly looking for an ML research role You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills You need detailed specifications before making progress You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution Benefits Remote work Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location Ownership of important backend systems Work on software used in real healthcare workflows Modern AI-native development workflow Room to grow with the company Why? Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden. AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome. If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

items.desc: Das Fraunhofer-Center für Maritime Logistik und Dienstleistungen CML ist eine von über 80 Forschungseinrichtungen der Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft. In praxisorientierten Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten unterstützt das Fraunhofer CML private und öffentliche Auftraggeber aus den Bereichen Hafen, Terminal, Schifffahrt und Logistikdienstleistung bei der Initiierung und Realisierung von Innovationen. Dazu entwickelt und optimiert das Fraunhofer CML Prozesse und Systeme entlang der maritimen Supply Chain. Die Abteilung Ship and Information Management bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, an interessanten Industrie- und Forschungsprojekten in der maritimen Logistik mitzuwirken. Zu den Arbeitsbereichen zählen unter anderem Personal- und Beschaffungsvorgänge, die oftmals einen erheblichen Anteil der Betriebskosten ausmachen. Das Fraunhofer CML entwickelt und pilotiert für seine Kunden individuelle Lösungen zur Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen beim Betrieb und bei der Steuerung von Schiffsflotten. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt der ausgeschriebenen Stelle liegt auf der Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Assistenztools marFM ®. Das KI-basierte System wurde speziell für die automatische Spracherkennung (Automatic Speech Recognition, ASR) in maritimen Anwendungsbereichen entwickelt und kürzlich um Funktionen zur Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache (Natural Language Processing, NLP) erweitert und ist als moderne Microservice-Anwendung (Python/FastAPI, React, asynchrone Verarbeitung, Container-Betrieb) umgesetzt. items.desc: We are seeking a motivated and collaborative individual to join our team as a Research Associate in Indoor Air Quality . This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the Retrofit Advanced Materials & Manufacturing Innovation Centre (RAMMIC), a major collaborative research and innovation programme supported through the UKRI Local Innovation Partnership Fund. RAMMIC brings together Greater Manchester capabilities in building performance, advanced materials, indoor air quality, acoustics, environmental sustainability assessment, and innovation support to establish a collaborative innovation ecosystem for smart and sustainable retrofit products and processes. You will be responsible for: Develop and lead research examining indoor air quality within retrofit environments at the Energy House. Design experimental protocols for evaluating retrofit products, materials, ventilation systems and other interventions. Undertake measurements in Energy House facilities and other project locations. Deploy, operate and maintain appropriate sensor systems and research-grade atmospheric instrumentation. Work closely with the Research Associate in Sustainable Materials to coordinate experiments and integrate indoor air-quality and material-sustainability evidence. We welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives, experiences, and approaches to their work. About You We encourage applications from individuals with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. You should demonstrate: Essential Criteria Have, or be about to obtain, a PhD or equivalent qualification in atmospheric science, or a very closely related discipline. Specialist knowledge of atmospheric composition measurements and their application to indoor or outdoor air quality. Demonstrable experience of designing and undertaking atmospheric measurement studies. Experience of quantitative data processing, quality assurance, analysis and interpretation. Understanding of the physical and chemical processes influencing indoor air quality. Desirable Criteria Experience of indoor air-quality measurements in homes, test buildings or other occupied environments. Experience of online mass spectrometry, including Chemical Ionisation Mass Spectrometry, or other advanced gas- or particle-phase measurement techniques. Knowledge of emissions from building materials, consumer products or retrofit interventions. Experience of investigating ventilation, damp, mould related indoor air-quality problems. Experience of controlled intervention studies or building-performance experiments. We value transferable skills and real-world experience as much as formal qualifications. Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working arrangements. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Enquiries About The Role, Shortlisting And Interviews Name: Thomas Bannan Email Address: thomas.bannan@manchester.ac.uk General enquiries and administrative support recruitmentservices.people@manchester.ac.uk Technical and job portal support Jobtrain Client Support Hub Applications close at midnight on the closing date. items.desc: 👋 Chi siamo Siamo m-ai, una startup italiana che sviluppa software basati su Intelligenza Artificiale. Il nostro team è ancora piccolo ma con una visione molto grande: rendere la potenza dell’AI accessibile, utile e produttiva per risolvere problemi del mondo reale. Cerchiamo qualcuno che abbia voglia di crescere insieme a noi, imparando sul campo come progettare soluzioni intelligenti che automatizzano processi, comprendono documenti, analizzano immagini e alimentano sistemi di ricerca, raccomandazione e decision-making. 🎯 Cosa farai Entrerai nel nostro team tecnico, lavorando a stretto contatto con il CTO e con gli sviluppatori che ogni giorno portano in produzione modelli e microservizi AI. Ti occuperai principalmente di: Sviluppare applicazioni di Agentic AI, integrando e orchestrando OpenAI, Gemini e modelli open-source per creare sistemi intelligenti capaci di ragionare, pianificare e agire in autonomia. Sperimentare e fare fine-tuning di reti neurali (es. BERT, ViT, Yolo, Stable Diffusion) su dataset reali. Sperimentare con piccoli LLM e pipeline di fine-tuning, esplorando il bilanciamento tra velocità, accuratezza e costo. Costruire e containerizzare API con FastAPI, Redis e Docker, ottimizzate per velocità e scalabilità. Portare le idee dal prototipo al prodotto, sviluppando interfacce interattive web e desktop in Next.js e PyQt/PySide che connettono utenti e modelli di AI in tempo reale. Lavorare su infrastrutture cloud moderne (Azure, AWS) per il deployment, il monitoraggio e l’ottimizzazione di microservizi e workload GPU. 🔍 Sei quello giusto se Sei uno studente o neolaureato in Informatica, Ingegneria, Data Science (o qualcosa di simile) e hai una vera passione per l’AI. Hai un pensiero analitico: ragioni per principi, scomponi i problemi e vai dritto al punto. Hai curiosità e grinta e ti piace sperimentare, imparare e vedere le cose prendere forma grazie a ciò che costruisci. Hai solide basi tecniche: sai smanettare con Python, API e framework di machine learning senza paura di rompere qualcosa (e poi sistemarlo meglio). Ti senti a tuo agio lavorando in autonomia, ma anche in squadra, condividendo idee e risultati. 🛠️ Stack & Skillset Linguaggi: Python (obbligatorio), JavaScript/TypeScript Framework: FastAPI, Next.js, PyQt/PySide AI/ML: PyTorch, transformers, yolo, diffusion models Cloud: Azure / AWS (Functions, EC2, S3, Container Apps) Plus: conoscenza di C++ e curiosità verso GPU, CUDA, ottimizzazione dei modelli ❤️ Cosa offriamo Uno stage vero e retribuito, non da spettatore: lavorerai fianco a fianco con il CTO su progetti AI che vanno davvero in produzione. Un ambiente ad alta intensità, dove si impara tanto e in fretta, costruendo cose che hanno un impatto reale (niente demo da laboratorio). Libertà totale di sperimentare, proporre e costruire: se hai un’idea, la testiamo insieme. Un percorso chiaro di crescita e integrazione in azienda dopo lo stage. Lavoro ibrido, orari flessibili e massima autonomia: ci interessa cosa realizzi, non da dove lavori o quante ore stai davanti al monitor (anche se sei in spiaggia va bene, basta che il Wi-Fi regga). Presenza in sede, seppur flessibili crediamo molto nel rapporto umano e che questo si possa consolidare in ufficio, quindi ci farebbe piacere garantissi una presenza di 8 giorni al mese presso il nostro ufficio di Grottaglie (Taranto). RAL: 26k-30k Non ci piacciono le gerarchie rigide, preferiamo persone che si prendono responsabilità, fanno domande, provano e migliorano.

items.card: Vos missions Transformer les opérations R&D grâce à l’automatisation et à l’intelligence artificielle, afin d’améliorer la productivité des équipes, d’accélérer la résolution des problèmes et de renforcer la qualité des produits SIMULIA : Automatiser et optimiser les validations logicielles Contribuer à l’automatisation et à l’industrialisation des validations pour garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des produits
items.desc: Au sein de la R&D SIMULIA de Dassault Systèmes, vous rejoindrez l’équipe SIMULIA RelOps, au cœur du développement et de la validation de nos solutions logicielles de simulation. Vous évoluerez dans une équipe dynamique et conviviale, où l’entraide, le partage des connaissances et la collaboration sont essentiels. Vous contribuerez à des projets concrets de transformation de la R&D par l’intelligence artificielle, avec l’opportunité de proposer vos idées, d’explorer de nouvelles technologies et d’améliorer la productivité des équipes. Un environnement international stimulant, qui encourage les initiatives, la curiosité et l’expérimentation, tout en offrant de belles opportunités de progression technique. Vos missions Transformer les opérations R&D grâce à l’automatisation et à l’intelligence artificielle, afin d’améliorer la productivité des équipes, d’accélérer la résolution des problèmes et de renforcer la qualité des produits SIMULIA : Automatiser et optimiser les validations logicielles Contribuer à l’automatisation et à l’industrialisation des validations pour garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des produits SIMULIA. Identifier les tâches répétitives et optimiser les processus pour réduire les interventions manuelles et accélérer les cycles de validation. Accélérer la transformation par l’IA Identifier et développer des cas d’usage de l’IA, notamment générative, pour améliorer l’efficacité des opérations et des équipes de développement. Explorer l’automatisation de l’analyse des logs, la synthèse des résultats de validation et l’identification des causes de régression. Prototyper et industrialiser des solutions permettant de réduire les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et de mesurer les gains de productivité. Exploiter les données pour anticiper les anomalies Analyser les données de validation et les diagnostics pour détecter les anomalies, identifier les tendances et prévenir les régressions. Évaluer les approches statistiques et de Machine Learning pour améliorer les diagnostics. Vos Qualifications Titulaire d’un Bac+5 en informatique, école d’ingénieurs ou cursus universitaire équivalent, vous disposez idéalement d’une première expérience en développement logiciel. Vous avez un intérêt pour la qualité logicielle, l’automatisation et l’amélioration de la productivité grâce à l’IA. Vous possédez des connaissances en Python et C++, ainsi qu’un intérêt pour le Machine Learning, le Deep Learning et l’IA générative. Vous faites preuve de curiosité, d'autonomie, vous aimez analyser des problèmes complexes et transformer des idées en améliorations concrètes. Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral dans un contexte professionnel international. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé (salles de sport & de musique, conciergerie…) Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.desc: 👋 Welcome to dexter health! At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients. We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features. The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed. You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day. Tasks As our Applied AI Engineer, you will: Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow Ship quickly while keeping production quality hi Requirements We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles. Must-have Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment Clear written and spoken English Nice-to-have Experience with frontend or fullstack product development Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation German language skills Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows This role is probably not for you if You are mainly looking for an ML research role You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills You need detailed specifications before making progress You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on based on skills, experience, and location Ownership of important backend systems Work on software used in real healthcare workflows Modern AI-native development workflow Room to grow with the company Why? Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden. AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome. If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

items.desc: Accelerated Knowledge Transfer (AKT) Associate in Agent-Based Modelling & AI Systems An exciting opportunity has arisen for a talented and enthusiastic researcher or graduate developer to join an Accelerated Knowledge Transfer (AKT) project between the University of Bath and Synoptix Ltd. About The Role The project will develop a simulation-supported threat-modelling methodology that identifies how cyber and technical disruption across systems-of-systems can affect the stability of interconnected human-AI teams and command structures, supporting the assessment and resilience of AI-enabled systems in defence and other high consequence sectors. You will play a key role in designing and implementing prototype simulation environments that support the assessment of threats, vulnerabilities and interventions across interconnected human-AI systems. This role offers an opportunity to work on a novel challenge involving AI assurance, digital security and simulation-supported threat analysis while collaborating directly with industry specialists and academic experts on cutting-edge research. Synoptix is an award-winning engineering consultancy delivering advanced solutions across defence, aerospace, healthcare, energy and cyber security sectors. The company develops innovative AI-powered products including Synx-Lookout, an edge-computing maritime awareness platform that uses computer vision and autonomy technologies. Key Responsibilities Develop agent-based simulation models representing human and AI actors. Contribute to the creation of reference architectures for Human-AI Systems (SoHAS). Support the development of threat and resilience modelling approaches. Encode vulnerabilities, attack behaviours and mitigation strategies within simulation environments. Analyse how failures and disruptions propagate across complex socio-technical systems. Contribute to project reports, presentations and recommendations. Engage regularly with both academic and industrial project partners. We Welcome Applications From Candidates Who Have BSc Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline. Strong programming skills, particularly in Python or similar languages. Knowledge of software development and modelling approaches. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. This AKT project is funded by UKRI through Innovate UK. This programme has been designed to create short-term collaborations between a university and business to deliver a rapid and targeted intervention to accelerate the development of an innovation project, with potential for significant impact on the business. AKT projects are delivered by graduates who benefit from the opportunity to work on a strategically relevant project within industry, whilst receiving support and guidance from university academics. More information about the Accelerated Knowledge Transfer programme can be found at: https://www.ktp-uk.org/accelerated-knowledge-transfer/ Further information This is a part-time role (0.5 FTE) for a fixed-term role for a period of 3 months, and the role must start no later than 13 November 2026. We consider ourselves to be a university where difference is celebrated, respected and encouraged. We truly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds will lead to a better environment for our employees and students and encourage applications from all genders, backgrounds, and communities, particularly from under-represented groups, and value the positive impact that will have on the university. We are committed to maintaining a safe and secure environment for our students, staff, and community by reinforcing our Safer Recruitment commitment. items.desc: As a Graduate Quantitative Trader, you will undergo an extensive six-month training program that combines advanced theory with hands-on market-making experience. Your journey includes : First 4 Weeks : Mastering the fundamentals of options theory, trading systems, and tools through engaging lectures and hands-on shadowing sessions led by our experienced traders. Next Phase : Applying your knowledge by contributing to a research or development project aligned with your assigned desk’s current focus, working under the close guidance of a mentor quant, and supported by ongoing coaching, technical training, and performance feedback. In this role, you will: Learn options theory and our business operations, then apply them by researching and designing systematic strategies rather than trading by hand. Build and backtest signals, pricing tools, and automated trading algorithms, and take them from idea to production within your first months. Spend most of your time on research and development: analysing data, testing hypotheses, and finding statistical edge. Monitor live strategy performance, diagnose why it deviates from expectations, and improve it. Enhance and extend our pricing models and volatility analytics. Own and improve core parts of the codebase and tech stack (Python/C++ etc., adjust to your stack). Programming is a daily, central part of the job, not a side task. Contribute to P&L through the strategies and tools you build; your impact is measured by the quality and performance of your systematic work rather than by discretionary trading calls. Your Profile: A Master’s degree or higher in a quantitative field: STEM, Statistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance (or related fields). Strong interest in option trading and financial markets, demonstrated through courses attended and/or experience. Result-driven and able to prioritize. Strong at pattern recognition. You excel at applying theoretical knowledge to practical challenges. Coding is second nature to you, with Python experience considered a valuable asset. Ready to excel in a fast-paced environment. Excellent verbal and written English skills. Currently based in Europe. Why Join All Options? At All Options, we offer a dynamic role with room for growth, collaboration, and recognition. Enjoy a competitive salary, bonus opportunities, profit sharing, 29 vacation days, and perks like a well-being allowance and in-house meals. Celebrate success with monthly drinks and festivities, and take advantage of our bicycle plan, NS Business Card, and the option to work from abroad. Apply Now! If this sounds like your next challenge, submit your CV and cover letter. Our interview process ensures we find the right fit—and if it’s a match, we can’t wait to welcome you to the team! About the cover letter: Think of your cover letter as the part of your application where you add value, not repetition. We are not interested in a summary of your CV. Instead, tell us: What excites you about the role beyond “markets”, "fast-paced and dynamic environment", "applying theory in practice" and “problem-solving”? Finish your letter with the following sentence: "I want to become a trader because…" Ask yourself: Why should we remember you after screening hundreds of applications? Surprise us with something genuine. Share a motivation, experience, or perspective that does not appear on your CV. Available start dates: March and September 2027 Please apply to only one of our graduate roles. If you apply to both, we will assign you to one recruitment process, as candidates cannot take part in both processes simultaneously. Note that candidates who are unsuccessful at any stage of the selection process will not be reconsidered for the same or a similar role for a period of six months.

Du verfügst über Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse, der Entwicklung von Prognosemodellen und Machine Learning. Du hast Erfahrung mit Python oder R sowie mit Datenbankabfragen in SQL. Du kennst Dich mit größeren Datenmengen, Datenaufbereitung und Feature Engineering aus. Du analysierst komplexe Daten mit Freude, denkst analytisch und arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich. Du kommunizierst und präsentierst überzeugend auf verhandlungssicherem Deutsch (mind. C1); Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Unser Angebot für Dich Dialogische Unternehmenskultur: Sie ist die Basis unseres gemeinsamen Handelns. Wertschätzung, Eigenverantwortung und flache Hierarchien prägen unsere Arbeitsgemeinschaft – ebenso wie der Gestaltungswille und die Initiative aller Mitarbeitenden. Denn nur zusammen sind wir erfolgreich. Gesundheit & Vorsorge: Wir bieten Dir zahlreiche individuelle Zusatzleistungen. Dich erwarten ein Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, eine Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung, viele Angebote für die mentale und körperliche Gesundheit, Kooperationen mit Krankenkassen und hauseigene Kurse. Im "culinarium" bieten wir Dir täglich frische Mahlzeiten, gesunde Snacks und süße Kleinigkeiten zum fairen Preis. Arbeitsbedingungen: Für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance sorgen flexibles und mobiles Arbeiten, unsere 37,5-Stunden-Woche und 30 Urlaubstage. Du kannst Arbeit und Urlaub sogar bei einer "Workation" im europäischen Ausland verbinden. Zusatzleistungen: Den Erfolg unserer Arbeitsgemeinschaft geben wir gern an Dich zurück – mit Zulagen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld, mit Sonderzahlungen und Warengutscheinen. Du bekommst außerdem 10 % Mitarbeiterrabatt in allen deutschen dm-Märkten und profitierst in vielen Onlineshops von exklusiven Angeboten für dm-Mitarbeitende. Darüber hinaus kannst Du zweimal jährlich aktuelle Smartphones, Tablets oder Laptops für Deinen Privatgebrauch preiswert leasen. Mobilität: Mit einem Zuschuss für das "Deutschlandticket Job" bist Du günstig unterwegs. Wenn Du lieber Fahrrad fährst, kannst Du auch das JobRad® nutzen. Auf unserem Gelände gibt es genügend Parkplätze, E-Ladestationen und eine Fahrradgarage. Eine S-Bahn-Station und der Anschluss zur Autobahn liegen in direkter Nähe.

We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff. items.desc: Hybrid in London, United Kingdom We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit Cards team. You'll build the credit risk, pricing, and customer lifetime value models behind iwoca's business credit card – who gets a card, with what features, and at what rate. The Company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The card is a core part of iwoca's long-term growth. The Credit Cards team builds the card on iwoca's existing lending infrastructure and customer base. The team is made up of commercial strategy product, engineering, operations, and a data scientists. The role As a Data Scientist in Credit Cards, you'll do the analysis and modelling for the card's commercial decisions. You'll often have small samples and incomplete data, which suits Bayesian methods. You'll quantify the uncertainty in each estimate and explain what it means for the decision. You'll run your own projects, from framing the question with the commercial lead to helping the team act on the result. Your models will shape how the card grows. You will be embedded in a broader Credit Cards Team and learn about the product and customer needs. You'll share methods with Credit Risk Modelling, especially where card and lending models overlap, and with data scientists across iwoca in the analytics guild. Live project examples: Credit limits. Setting initial limits that balance risk with what each customer needs, and designing a framework that adjusts them as spending and repayment data comes in. Pricing. Modelling how interest and fees affect take-up and spending,, to find pricing that works for iwoca and its customers. Customer lifetime value. Estimating activation, spending, and retention from early signals, and updating the estimates as each cohort matures. Card and loan together. Measuring cross-sell and combined credit exposure for businesses that hold both the card and an iwoca loan. Designing the mechanisms to optimise how the two products interact. The Requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Bayesian reasoning. You've used priors, updating, and hierarchical models in real work. You know when a Bayesian model is worth the extra complexity, and when something simpler will do. Analytical ownership. You've taken loosely defined problems from framing the question to a decision the business acted on. Business curiosity. You've used what you learnt about a business's customers and economics to shape your analysis. AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a prototype, an automation, or a modelling pipeline others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles. Bonus: Lending experience. You've worked on credit risk, pricing, or customer lifetime value in lending or financial services. Small-sample modelling. You've worked with scarce data and made principled choices about regularisation or sequential updating. Production machine learning. You've taken models from exploration through to deployment and monitoring. Coding in Python. The team works in Python and you’ll write analyses and code in that language. The salary We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. You will be able to determine the underlying dynamics of our complex ecosystem and use this to deliver insights and strategic direction, but your main focus will be a complete obsession with driving impact within the product team, drawing on whatever analytical and statistical techniques that will unlock the most benefits. Data Science and Analytics at Trainline exists within the wider data organisation as part of the tech org, and is complemented by data engineering teams, data platform teams, and ML teams for when deep ML and AI techniques are required. Our autonomous model creates a huge opportunity for personal influence and impact – as the data scientist on the team you will be actively driving innovation on the team by contributing to strategy, execution and continuous learning. As a Data Scientist at Trainline, you will... 🚄 As a Data Scientist in our New Business team, you'll help shape how Trainline grows beyond train tickets. From insurance and protection to hotels, car hire, attractions and other travel experiences, we're exploring new ways to add value throughout the customer journey, including making it easier for customers to plan more of their trip in one place. You'll use customer insights, experimentation and analytical techniques to uncover new opportunities, influence product strategy and create meaningful value for both our customers and Trainline. About As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for influencing product and business outcomes, have the autonomy to make things happen and must obsess about having business impact. More specifically you will: Own data science work from start to finish within an embedded product team, from shaping the right question with your colleagues to delivering a solution and measuring its impact Explore customer behaviour and product usage to uncover areas of friction, spot new opportunities and estimate the benefit of acting on them Contribute to simple, seamless customer journeys by identifying where we can remove barriers and add value Design, run and analyse experiments using sound statistical methods, and help define metrics Build, test and improve models such as forecasting, personalisation or customer behaviour prediction that enhance the customer experience and support business growth Turn your findings into clear, practical recommendations that help shape product and monetisation strategy, tailoring your message for both technical and non-technical audiences We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍 Hands-on experience applying data science to real product or customer problems, ideally within an embedded or cross-functional team Confidence using Python and SQL to explore large datasets of customer activity, build models and write efficient, readable code Experience of product engagement evaluation and measurement of success. For example, running A/B tests to evaluate product effectiveness or using front-end data to quantify the effectiveness of new features and how it changes user engagement. The ability to explain complex ideas simply and adapt how you communicate for different audiences Ideally, an interest in monetisation, advertising, recommendations or e-commerce, and familiarity with tools such as dbt, Looker or Tableau, although none of these are essential Tech Stack: SQL, Python, R, Tableau, AWS Athena + More! More …

items.desc: Data u nás nejsou jen čísla, ale příběhy o tom, co naši zákazníci chtějí a jak můžeme být lepší. Hledáme nadšeného absolventa, který dokáže v obrovském množství dat najít souvislosti, vytvářet prediktivní modely a pomáhat nám tak s byznys rozhodováním. Jestli máš analytické myšlení a chceš vidět reálný dopad své práce v jednom z největších retailových řetězců, přidej se k nám. Co tě u nás bude bavit analýza velkých datových sad (Big Data) – budeš pracovat s daty z našeho věrnostního programu (Kaufland Card XTRA), prodejními statistikami a logistickými daty pro odhalování trendů a optimalizaci procesů tvorba a testování prediktivních modelů – využiješ statistické metody a machine learning (např. v Pythonu nebo R) pro predikci poptávky, analýzu nákupního chování a optimalizaci zásob reporting, dashboardy a alerting systémy – navrhneš přehledné dashboardy a systémy včasného varování napříč různými datovými sadami, které týmu umožní okamžitě reagovat na významné výkyvy a trendy v datech data mining a zpracování dat – postaráš se o přípravu datových sad a jejich čištění s využitím pokročilého SQL v prostředí DWH/Cloudových řešení vyhodnocování a interpretace – tvým úkolem bude srozumitelná interpretace výsledků a navrhování konkrétních byznys doporučení, včetně prezentace výstupů mezinárodním, kros-funkčním týmům (v angličtině/němčině) s přímým vlivem na zákaznickou zkušenost spolupráce a rozvoj – budeš úzce spolupracovat s oddělením BI/Customer & Market Insights INT, postupně se zaškolíš do moderních analytických a vizualizačních nástrojů a budeš se podílet na inovacích v datové analytice Jak si tě představujeme máš ukončené VŠ vzdělání (magisterské nebo bakalářské) v oborech jako Matematika, Statistika, Informatika/Aplikovaná informatika, Ekonometrie nebo Datová analytika (pozice je vhodná i pro čerstvé absolventy) máš analytické a koncepční myšlení, umíš pracovat s čísly a máš chuť se dále rozvíjet v oblasti Data Science ovládáš základy programování pro datovou analýzu (ideálně Python, R) a orientuješ se v SQL využíváš generativní AI (např. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) jako chytrého asistenta, více než mechanické biflování syntaxe je pro nás důležité, že umíš AI správně zadat zadání, kriticky ověřit výsledek a pochopit logiku řešení domluvíš se dobře anglicky (požadujeme dobrou znalost AJ anebo NJ ) nechybí ti komunikační a prezentační schopnosti a umíš složitá data vysvětlit srozumitelnou formou jsi flexibilní osobnost, které nechybí tah na branku a chuť učit se nové věci Co za to dostaneš stabilní zázemí u TOP zaměstnavatele odměnu : motivující finanční ohodnocení flexibilitu : po zaškolení možnost 2 dní v týdnu na home office (hybridní model) kvalitní zaškolení : nenecháme tě v tom, všechno tě krok za krokem naučíme (podpora zkušenějších kolegů v týmu) cenné zkušenosti : hluboký vhled do práce s reálnými Big Data v enterprise měřítku u předního mezinárodního retailera 5 týdnů dovolené na pořádný relax bohatý balíček benefitů : Cafeteria, stravenkový paušál, MultiSport karta, parkování, online lékař a příspěvky při životních událostech Chceš být tím, kdo ukazuje směr díky přesným datům a predikcím? Přidej se k #tymkaufland.
