items.desc: Data & AI Engineer We have an exciting opportunity for a bright, passionate, and driven individual to join our successful, dynamic, and reputable multi-utilities business. This role will sit within our Technology team and requires an individual with a high-level of competency in data analytics, automation and AI and a proactive approach to problem solving and the confidence to independently learn new technologies. This is a junior role within the team and would suit a recent graduate in Computer Science or similar. This role will be dedicated to identifying opportunities and improvements to enhance our current systems and their ability both through the use data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions to identify opportunities, realise efficiency savings, minimise risks and improve customer service. This role is based onsite full time in our Leatherhead, Surrey office. Key Accountabilities The Data & AI Engineer is accountable for using software, artificial intelligence and machine learning to analyse and interpret large amounts of data and support the successful implementation of new technologies and improved system functionality, including automation across ESP. Review and understand business processes and data requirements and specify data analytics and automation solutions Produce simple to understand management insight using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and machine learning to analyse large amounts of data to support improved decision making, Implement process automation solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power platform (and other AI solutions and relevant scripting languages) to help the business to improve business efficiency and customer experience Maintain and support data platform to ensure data security, integrity and accuracy in all reports and analytics. Maintain and support automation solutions to ensure continued efficient operation, and business process continuity. Continuously improve and optimise existing reports and automation processes. You will be an advocate for Data Analytics and AI within the business and will take a proactive role in ensuring that individuals and teams have the systems and resources in place that will enable ESP to deliver in line with our fast-paced and agile commercial strategy. This individual will produce simple to understand management insight by using technologies including artificial intelligence (AI), to analyse large amounts of data to help improve decision making. Key Responsibilities Analyse and interpret large amounts of data from a range of sources – using technical, analytical and communication skills to collect and examine data to help provide management insight to make better informed decisions and solve problems. Development of automation solutions – understanding business processes and requirements and identifying appropriate solutions to improve business efficiency and customer outcomes through the use of automation and AI Support and maintain the data platform and automation solutions to ensure the ongoing integrity or the environment and ensure efficient operation of the solutions Inspire stakeholders to recognise opportunities that are beyond their current understanding – helping break down the barrier of how things are ‘now’ and articulate the future alternatives which would support improved working practises, process enhancements and a greater sense of ease of business for our external stakeholders. Share regular presentations – with audiences at all levels within the business as appropriate to help illustrate project progress, achievements, challenges, and a commitment to departmental/business strategy. Support the system Super User community – reviewing feedback collected via this forum, helping articulate how system development could support any pain points/change requests raised and delivering actions assigned as an output of the work inspired by this community. Hands-on support / participation in system testing – on an as required basis, undertake system testing for new developments and changes thus allowing the opportunity to track back to the original business requirements, testing may sometimes be addressed before handing across to the business for further testing or be carried out alongside the business itself. Skills Needed: Degree in Computer Science, or a related field An aptitude for understanding IT software, systems and highly technical solutions Advanced knowledge of relevant scripting languages (e.g.Python, R, SQL, Java Script Experience Microsoft Power platform, Fabric, PowerBI A passion and ability to learn new technologies, as full training will be provided Strong analytical and problem-solving skill including experience with data analytics A positive and innovative approach to problem solving, be able to understand and empathise with business users’ issues and problems Must be collaborative and not confrontational in approach An ‘eye’ for improvements and realising opportunities for efficiency gains …

items.desc: Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre du développement de ses projets d’intelligence artificielle générative et agentique, notre client souhaite mettre en place un outil permettant d’estimer la consommation de tokens et les coûts associés à l’utilisation des modèles LLM. L’objectif est de permettre aux équipes projet d’anticiper leurs dépenses en fonction de leurs besoins, des volumes d’utilisation prévus et des modèles d’IA utilisés. Pour cela, nous recherchons un AI Engineer capable de participer au cadrage du besoin et au développement d’une calculatrice de prévision de consommation de tokens. Missions Le consultant interviendra sur les différentes étapes du projet : Recueillir les besoins des équipes et définir les principales fonctionnalités de l’outil. Identifier les paramètres à prendre en compte pour estimer la consommation de tokens selon les cas d’usage. Développer en Python une calculatrice permettant de simuler les volumes de consommation et les coûts associés. Prendre en compte les spécificités des différents modèles LLM et leurs modalités de tarification. Intégrer les particularités des projets agentiques, notamment les appels successifs aux modèles et les interactions entre agents. Tester et fiabiliser les calculs afin de fournir des estimations cohérentes. Rédiger la documentation technique et fonctionnelle de la solution. Compétences recherchées Bonne maîtrise de Python. Connaissance des LLM et des mécanismes de tokenisation. Expérience dans l’utilisation d’API de modèles d’IA générative. Compréhension des coûts associés à la consommation de tokens. Capacité à cadrer un besoin et à proposer une solution technique adaptée. Une expérience sur des projets d’IA générative, des architectures agentiques ou des sujets LLMOps constituera un réel atout. Livrable attendu Développement d’une calculatrice de prévision de consommation de tokens, accompagnée de sa documentation. Profil recherché Nous recherchons un profil technique et pragmatique, capable de comprendre les besoins des équipes, de les traduire en fonctionnalités concrètes et de développer un outil fiable et facilement utilisable. Unser Team aus rund 50 Expert:innen in ServiceNow, Software Development und Security baut aktuell den Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz von Grund auf auf – eine grüne Spielwiese mit Start-up-Spirit im Konzern. Hier hast du die Chance, unsere AI-Community mitzugestalten, eigene Lösungen zu entwickeln und Kunden in verschiedensten Branchen Mehrwert zu liefern. Ob Fach- oder Führungslaufbahn: Du bestimmst die Richtung, wir unterstützen dich. B. GitLab CI, Terraform, Ansible) Programmierkenntnisse (Python, Bash oder Go) sowie Monitoring-Tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (nachweisbar mindestens C1-Niveau) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse Knowhow im Umgang mit MLOps-Frameworks (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker) von Vorteil Was wir bieten Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Die richtigen Trainings und Zertifikate bringen deine Weiterbildung voran. Unsere E-Learning-Plattform Academia ermöglicht dir das Lernen, wo und wann du willst. Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet, sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Mit Jobticket und Jobbike fördern wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität. Abhängig von deiner Rolle und Projektsituation sind auch Bahncard oder Elektro-Firmenwagen möglich. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir sind an deiner Seite, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir immer zur Verfügung. Eine Vielzahl an gemeinsamen Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Rejoignez une nouvelle aventure, avec la création d'une activité dédiée à l'industrialisation des usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle au sein du département de la Qualité du Système d'Information et contribuez à transformer des idées innovantes en solutions concrètes utilisées par les collaborateurs au quotidien. Vos missions : Concevoir des prototypes d'applications IA en Python et JavaScript, ou des prompts, répondant aux besoins des équipes Maquetter et développer des cas d'usage permettant d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle des collaborateurs Intégrer et exploiter des services d'IA générative au sein d'outils et de démonstrateurs Participer aux phases de tests, de validation et d'amélioration continue des solutions développées Contribuer à la documentation et à la diffusion des bonnes pratiques auprès des utilisateurs Ce que nous vous proposons : Participer à la création d'une nouvelle activité dédiée à l'IA Développer des cas d'usage concrets à destination des collaborateurs du département QSI Monter en compétences sur les technologies d'IA générative et leur intégration dans des outils métier Bénéficier d'un accompagnement et des outils pour mener à bien vos missions Durée du stage : 4 mois. Et si c’était vous ? Vous êtes étudiant en Bac+2/3 en informatique, développement logiciel, génie logiciel ou équivalent Vous maîtriser le développement en Python et disposer de bonnes bases en JavaScript pour concevoir rapidement des prototypes fonctionnels Vous faites preuve de curiosité et d'appétence pour l'Intelligence Artificielle, notamment les usages de l'IA générative et l'automatisation des tâches Vous savez analyser un besoin utilisateur et le traduire en une solution simple, pragmatique et à forte valeur ajoutée Vous savez travailler efficacement en équipe, partager ses idées et collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de rigueur et d'esprit d'initiative dans la réalisation et l'amélioration continue des développements Vous avez un esprit d'initiative, curiosité et capacité à travailler en équipe Vous êtes à l'aise dans la réalisation de prototypes et dans la résolution de problèmes techniques Plus qu’un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous, en France et à l’international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d’avantages : Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d’Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport…) Offre variée de restaurants d’entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l’action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s’engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l’éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d’engagement sont multiples.

Als Business Analyst AI Products gebruik je jouw ervaring als accountant of samensteller om de praktijk en productontwikkeling met elkaar te verbinden. Je vertaalt de dagelijkse werkzaamheden naar duidelijke eisen voor AI-producten en toetst of die producten goed aansluiten op het werk. Je werkt aan AI-producten die collega’s al gebruiken. Denk aan AI-producten die facturen lezen, boekingen voorbereiden en vragen van klanten beantwoorden. Je ziet wat goed werkt, waar verbetering nodig is en wat het product oplevert. Je krijgt een eigen productdomein en wordt daarin een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor de praktijk en het productteam. Over PIA Group PIA Group is een ondernemend professioneel netwerk met meer dan 70 kantoorlabels en zo'n 3.500 collega's in Nederland, België, Luxemburg en Duitsland. De labels behouden hun eigen naam, mensen en klantrelaties. PIA Group voegt schaal, gedeelde data en gezamenlijke AI-producten toe. Vanuit PIA Group International werk je met de kantoren aan oplossingen die passen bij het dagelijkse werk. Wat ga je doen als Business Analyst AI Products? Je kent de werkzaamheden op een accountantskantoor uit eigen ervaring. Die kennis gebruik je om productteams te laten zien wat accountants, samenstellers en fiscalisten nodig hebben. Je bespreekt de praktijk met collega’s uit de kantoren en vertaalt hun kennis naar concrete producteisen. Je maakt ook duidelijk wat een goede AI-uitkomst is. Je brengt uitzonderingen en btw-situaties in kaart en legt vast wanneer een collega de uitkomst moet controleren. Tijdens de ontwikkeling test je de producten met praktijkvoorbeelden. Na de introductie meet je hoe collega’s ze gebruiken en wat ze opleveren. Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor: Praktijkervaring vertalen naar duidelijke eisen voor jouw productdomein. Vastleggen welke uitkomsten goed zijn, inclusief uitzonderingen en btw-situaties. Bepalen wanneer een collega een AI-uitkomst moet controleren. Producten testen met voorbeelden uit de accountantspraktijk en beoordelen of ze klaar zijn voor gebruik. Vooraf de verwachte impact inschatten, in bespaarde uren en verwerkt volume, en na de livegang gebruik en werkelijk resultaat meten. Experts uit de kantoren betrekken en hun ervaringen met het product ophalen. Binnen zes maanden het inhoudelijke aanspreekpunt zijn voor jouw productdomein en met cijfers kunnen laten zien of jouw producten werken. Wat maakt jou succesvol? Je hebt zelf in de accountantspraktijk gewerkt en begrijpt hoe het werk verloopt. Je kunt die ervaring vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen voor AI-producten. Je communiceert makkelijk met accountants én productcollega’s, werkt kritisch en durft aan te geven wanneer een product nog niet goed genoeg is. Verder breng je mee: Je hebt 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring als (junior) accountant of samensteller bij een accountantskantoor. Je hebt zelf een werkende AI-toepassing gebouwd die door anderen wordt gebruikt. Je ervaring gaat dus verder dan het gebruiken van een chatbot. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Je werkt graag met concrete praktijkvoorbeelden en meetbare resultaten. Je neemt initiatief en vindt het prettig om mee te bouwen aan een functie die nog in ontwikkeling is. Wat krijg je bij PIA Group? Je krijgt een vaste, fulltime rol waarin je werkt aan AI-producten die al in gebruik zijn. Je rapporteert aan de Head of Product & AI en werkt samen met productcollega’s en experts uit de kantoren. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw productdomein verder te ontwikkelen en mee te werken aan producten die het dagelijkse werk ondersteunen. Verder bieden we jou: Een salaris tussen € 70.000,- en € 90.000,- bruto per jaar op basis van 40 uur, 25 vakantiedagen, pensioenregeling, mobiliteit/leaseauto, opleidingsbudget en ruimte voor hybride werken. Een standplaats in Utrecht met twee tot drie kantoordagen per week. Bezoeken aan PIA-kantoren tellen mee als kantoordag. De middelen en ondersteuning om je werk goed te doen. Ready to join the ride? 🚀 Wil jij jouw ervaring uit de accountantspraktijk inzetten voor AI-producten die collega’s echt gebruiken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Het selectieproces bestaat uit drie gesprekken: eerst met de Head of Product & AI, inclusief een korte case over AI in het accountancywerk, daarna met het Business Improvement-team, en tot slot met de Group CTO en de HR Business Partner. Solliciteer via onze officiële sollicitatiepagina. Zo komt jouw sollicitatie op de juiste plek terecht en kunnen we deze zorgvuldig behandelen. Sollicitaties via e-mail nemen we daarom niet in behandeling. PIA Group – changing the game in accountancy.

items.desc: Le pôle Nutrition végétale joue un rôle central dans la mise en œuvre des projets de recherche et développement au sein du Centre Mondial de l’Innovation Roullier, en étudiant et en proposant des solutions innovantes pour la nutrition des plantes et la santé des sols. Au sein de ce département, l’Unité Nutrition des Plantes et Stress Abiotiques contribue à la conception de solutions visant à optimiser l’efficacité d’utilisation des nutriments, la tolérance aux stress et la productivité des cultures. Afin de renforcer notre expertise, nous recrutons un(e) : Ingénieur de Recherche en Sciences Végétales / Nutrition des Plantes F/H , en CDI à Saint-Malo. Rattaché(e) au Chef de projet Nutrition des Plantes et Stress Abiotiques, vous participerez à des projets de recherche portant principalement sur la nutrition des plantes mais également sur la tolérance des plantes aux stress abiotiques. À ce titre, vous devrez démontrer de solides connaissances en physiologie végétale, nutrition des plantes et agronomie. Missions : - Identifier et mettre en œuvre les méthodes clés permettant d’évaluer l’état nutritionnel, la croissance et le développement des plantes. - Étudier les mécanismes impliqués dans l’acquisition et l’efficience d’utilisation des nutriments. - Gérer et analyser les données expérimentales. - Participer à la rédaction de rapports, de publications scientifiques et de propositions de projets de recherche. - Collaborer avec des partenaires académiques, industriels et institutionnels. The Plant Nutrition department plays a central role in the implementation of research and development projects at the Centre Mondial de l’Innovation Roullier, by studying and developing novel solutions for plant nutrition and soil health. Within this department, the Plant Nutrition and Abiotic Stress Unit supports designing solutions aimed at optimizing Nutrient Use Efficiency, stress tolerance and crop productivity. To strengthen our expertise, we are hiring a : Plant Nutrition Research Scientist in St Malo (Brittany, France). Reporting to the Plant Nutrition and Abiotic Stress Project Manager, you will take part in research projects focusing primarily on plant nutrition but also on plant tolerance to abiotic stresses. In this role, you will be expected to demonstrate a solid understanding of plant physiology, plant nutrition and agronomy. Responsibilities : - Identify and implement key methods to assess the nutritional status, growth and development of plants. - Study the mechanisms involved in nutrient uptake and use efficiency. - Manage and analyse experimental data. - Participate in writing reports, scientific publications, and research project proposals. - Collaborate with academic, industrial, and institutional partners. - Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat en physiologie végétale, sciences de l’environnement, nutrition des plantes ou dans un domaine connexe. - Vous maîtrisez les méthodes et techniques d’analyse appliquées aux plantes (phénotypage, analyses physico-chimiques, biochimie, biologie moléculaire, métabolomique, etc.). - Vous disposez de solides compétences en biostatistiques, analyse et interprétation des données. - Vous faites preuve d’excellentes capacités de rédaction scientifique et de communication. - Vous parlez couramment anglais. - Vous démontrez de l’autonomie, de la rigueur scientifique, un fort esprit d’équipe ainsi qu’une capacité à travailler sur des projets multidisciplinaires. Qu’avons-nous à offrir ? - Une prise en charge de l’abonnement transport en commun à hauteur de 75% - Un comité interentreprise - Des accords de participation et d’intéressement - Une participation aux repas - Un bâtiment dédié aux activités du sport et de la culture - Une vie interne dynamique : Afterwork, teambuilding… About you : - Ph.D. in Plant Physiology, Environmental Sciences, Plant Nutrition, or a related field. - Strong understanding of plant physiology, plant nutrition and agronomy, with the ability to investigate nutrient acquisition, utilization and nutrient use efficiency mechanisms. - Experience with analytical methods and techniques applied to plants, including phenotyping, physico-chemical analyses, biochemistry, molecular biology and metabolomics. - Solid skills in biostatistics, data analysis and interpretation. - Excellent scientific writing, communication and presentation skills. - Fluency in English. - Autonomous and rigorous approach to research, combined with a collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary projects. What do we offer? - 75% reimbursement of public transportation subscription costs - Access to an intercompany employee benefits committee - Profit-sharing and incentive schemes - Meal contribution allowance - A dedicated facility for sports and cultural activities - A vibrant company culture with regular events such as after-work gatherings and team-building activities.

items.desc: Le pôle Nutrition végétale joue un rôle central dans la mise en œuvre des projets de recherche et développement au sein du Centre Mondial de l’Innovation Roullier, en étudiant et en proposant des solutions innovantes pour la nutrition des plantes, la santé des sols et l’amélioration de la résistance des cultures face aux stress. Au sein de ce département, l’Unité Soil and Plant Care contribue à la conception de solutions visant à améliorer la qualité des sols et à aider les plantes à mieux résister aux bioagresseurs (agents pathogènes et ravageurs). Afin de renforcer notre expertise, nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur(e) de Recherche en Science du Végétale / Stress Biotiques des Plantes , en CDI à Saint-Malo. À propos du poste : Rattaché(e) au chef de projet Gestion des stress biotiques, vous participerez à des projets de recherche visant à mieux comprendre les relations entre les plantes et leurs bioagresseurs, et sur les mécanismes permettant d’améliorer la tolérance des plantes aux stress biotiques. À ce titre, vous devrez démontrer de solides connaissances en interactions plante-bioagresseurs (agents pathogènes et/ou ravageurs), microbiologie et/ou entomologie, ainsi qu’en physiologie végétale. Missions : - Identifier, développer et mettre en œuvre des méthodes permettant de sélectionner, d’évaluer et d’étudier l’efficacité des produits développés. - Étudier les mécanismes impliqués dans la tolérance des plantes aux stress biotiques ainsi que dans la virulence et/ou la fitness des bioagresseurs. - Planifier et conduire des essais, analyser les données obtenues et assurer la synthèse et l’interprétation des résultats. - Participer à la production des livrables associés aux projets : rapports, documents de synthèse, etc. - Participer à la valorisation scientifique des projets : posters, communications, publications scientifiques, brevets. - Collaborer avec des partenaires académiques, industriels et institutionnels. - Déplacements professionnels en France et à l’international dans le cadre du suivi des collaborations et de conférences/congrès scientifiques. The Plant Nutrition Department plays a central role in the implementation of Research & Development projects at the Centre Mondial de l’Innovation Roullier, investigating and developing innovative solutions for plant nutrition, soil health, and to improved crop resilience to stress. Within this department, the Soil and Plant Care Unit contributes to the development of solutions designed to improve soil quality and increase plant resistance to biotic threats, including pathogens and pests. To strengthen our expertise in this field, we are looking for a : Research engineer in Plant Science / Plant Biotic Stress, in Saint-Malo, France. About the position: Reporting to the Project Manager biotic stress, you will contribute to projects aimed at better understanding the relationships between plants and biotic threats, as well as the mechanisms involved in improving plant tolerance to biotic stress. You will be expected to demonstrate strong knowledge in plant– pathogen and/or plant–pest interactions, in microbiology and/or entomology, as well as in plant physiology. Key responsibilities : - Identification, development, and implementation of methods to screen, evaluate, and investigate the efficacy of new developed products. - Investigate the mechanisms involved in plant tolerance to biotic stress, as well as those underlying the virulence and/or fitness of pathogens and pests. - Plan and conduct experiments, analyze the data, synthesize and interpret the results. - Contribute to the project deliverables, including reports, summaries, and other scientific documents. - Contribute to the scientific valorization of the research projects through posters, presentations, scientific publications, and patents. - Collaborate with academic, industrial, and institutional partners. - Travel in France and internationally to support collaborative projects and attend scientific conferences and congresses. - Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat en biologie végétale, phytopathologie, interactions plante-bioagresseurs ou dans un domaine connexe. - Une expertise dans l’étude des interactions entre les plantes et les bioagresseurs ou des réponses associées aux stress biotiques est attendue. - Vous maîtrisez les méthodes et techniques d’analyse appliquées aux plantes et/ou aux bioagresseurs : biologie moléculaire et/ou métabolomique, microbiologie, physiologie, biochimie, histochimie et microscopie. - Vous disposez de solides compétences en biostatistiques et en analyse de données. - Vous faites preuve d’excellentes capacités de rédaction scientifique. - Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral. - Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux(se) et organisé(e). - Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et évoluez aisément dans des environnements multidisciplinaires et collaboratifs. - Vous faites preuve de flexibilité, d’adaptabilité et d’un fort sens du collectif. - Vous aimez partager vos …

items.desc:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
 AI Governance Specialist 
 Logitech is hiring an AI Governance Specialist on a fixed-term contract to help us develop our global AI Governance program and run AI Governance operations, enabling responsible AI adoption while managing regulatory and operational risks. 
 This is an exciting global role on our legal team which covers all of Logitech's functional teams and business groups such as Gaming, Hardware, Software, and Logitech for Business. 
 This person will play a key role in delivering operational aspects of Logitech's AI governance program, including ensuring both our internal use of AI and use of AI in our products remain in compliance with our policies, standards and procedures. They will provide practical guidance on AI use, challenge incomplete information, and lead a defined set of projects.
 This role reports to the AI Governance Manager. This is a hybrid role, with 2 days a week on site in Cork. 
 Your Contribution 
 Be yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and Do. 
 These are the behaviours you'll need to be successful at Logitech. In this role, you will lead or support the following projects and ongoing activities: 
 AI Inventory: Review and improve the completeness and accuracy of the global AI Inventory and identify gaps with business owners and engineering teams. Update the related procedure and documentation. 
 AI risk assessment and remediation: Work with business teams on AI risk assessments, helping system owners complete their assessments, address identified risks, and put in place the required documentation and controls. Track mitigation actions through to completion and challenge gaps in supporting evidence. 
 AI content labelling: Help coordinate the roll-out of Logitech's AI content labelling requirements across the business, including supporting Design Guidelines, training, and technical controls in tools and onboarding. 
 AI vendor reviews: Evaluate new AI vendor submissions, manage the review queue to meet our approval targets, challenge business units where information is missing, critically assess vendor responses and identify potential risks, and track completion of agreed risk treatment plans. 
 Project management: Drive further AI Governance projects and priorities as agreed, managing timelines, stakeholders and deliverables across multiple teams and time zones, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency. 
 Knowledge sharing: Provide pragmatic advice to product and business teams, respond to day-to-day AI governance queries on approved enterprise tools, public AI tools and product-specific AI use, contribute to training materials, and support our AI Champions network.
 Key Qualifications 
 Undergraduate qualification in Law, Business, Technology, or a related field. 
 Minimum of 2 years of experience in AI governance, privacy, compliance, risk, or a technology-focused legal role. 
 Working knowledge of the EU AI Act and AI governance best practices, including the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical controls and guidance. 
 Project management experience, including the ability to deliver multiple workstreams to deadlines and drive cross-functional action. 
 Technical aptitude including comfortable reading technical and vendor documentation and asking engineers and product teams clear, probing questions about how AI systems work. 
 Strong critical thinking, with the ability to spot omissions in proposals and challenge business units for clarity, including identifying gaps in vendor evidence and assessing residual risks. 
 Excellent communication skills, including translating legal concepts for technical teams and preparing training materials for non-specialist colleagues. 
 A self-starter who can work independently, learn quickly and be effective with minimal onboarding.
 Preferred 
 Technical skills to automate manual governance tasks (for example scripting, workflow automation, dashboards or reminders), reducing repetitive work for the team. 
 Knowledge of privacy and data protection (e.g. GDPR), copyright or intellectual property. 
 Experience with AI inventories, impact assessments, mitigation tracking or governance process improvement. 
 Availability to start at short notice. 
 Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Job Description Summary 
As a leading global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions innovator, GE HealthCare enables clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications, and services, supported by the Edison intelligence platform. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect, transparency, and unyielding integrity.
We are seeking a Firmware Engineer specializing in FPGA development and embedded real time control, with strong skills in digital design and low level embedded software. In this role, you will design the firmware and control systems that interface tightly with power electronics, mixed signal ASICs and advanced imaging hardware used across CT, MR, and Ultrasound platforms. Familiarity with power electronics and/or ASIC RTL design is a strong plus. 
 Job Description 
 As a leading global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions innovator, GE HealthCare enables clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications, and services, supported by the Edison intelligence platform. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect, transparency, and unyielding integrity.
 We are seeking a Firmware Engineer specializing in FPGA development and embedded real‑time control , with strong skills in digital design and low‑level embedded software. In this role, you will design the firmware and control systems that interface tightly with power electronics, mixed‑signal ASICs and advanced imaging hardware used across CT, MR, and Ultrasound platforms. Familiarity with power electronics and/or ASIC RTL design is a strong plus.
 Job Description 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the planning, development, and transition of embedded control technologies from concept to product. You will:
 Embedded Firmware & Real‑Time Control (Primary Focus) 
 Implement and test signal processing, control and data interfaces between FPGAs, processors, custom ASICs and imaging subsystems.
 Design FPGAs and custom ASICs using VHDL/Verilog, perform timing analysis and timing closure using tools such as QuestaSim, Quartus, Xcelium.
 Design and implement real-time embedded firmware in C/C++ for control, configuration, calibration, and diagnostics of mixed‑signal ASICs and custom hardware modules.
 Develop deterministic, low‑latency control loops and high‑speed data acquisition routines for advanced imaging applications.
 Integrate embedded firmware with FPGA or SoC platforms, supporting tight hardware/software co‑design.
 Interface with sensors, analog front ends, actuators, RF subsystems, and other hardware components.
 Implement and optimize real‑time communication protocols (SPI, I²C, UART, Ethernet, etc.).
 Software Integration & System Control 
 Partner with embedded software teams to define register maps, communication layers, drivers, and system-level behavior.
 Develop driver‑level software, scripts, and automation tools to enable hardware bring‑up, system validation, and production test.
 Create simulation and modeling frameworks to verify real‑time control algorithms.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation 
 Work closely with electrical engineers, ASIC designers, systems engineers, and software teams.
 Communicate technical results through documentation, reports, and presentations.
 Track industry trends in embedded systems, real‑time control, FPGAs, and ASIC technologies.
 Contribute to internal R&D proposals and collaborative programs with government agencies.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
 Strong fundamentals in synchronous digital design, floor-planning, synthesizable RTL code, timing analysis and closure, developing embedded firmware in C/C++, including register-level programming and hardware abstraction layers.
 Experience with FPGA development, or SoC platforms (e.g., Altera, Xilinx, Zynq)
 Experience with verification tools (Quartus, QuestaSim) and STA workflows.
 Experience with Verilog, VHDL for understanding hardware–firmware interaction.
 Must work onsite in Niskayuna, NY Tuesday–Thursday (hybrid schedule).
 Desired Characteristics 
 PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
 4+ years of full-time professional engineering experience
 Familiarity with ASIC digital design flows
 Familiarity with power electronics control
 Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink for modeling or algorithm development.
 Background in high‑reliability industries (medical, aerospace, defense).
 Strong problem-solving ability, communication skills, and ability to work in cross-functional teams

items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You will support the smooth, high-quality delivery of Learning & Development (L&D) operations, including onboarding, learning logistics, platform administration, and content coordination, so that every Faculty employee has a seamless, engaging, and data-enabled learning experience from day one. This will be a highly collaborative role, working in a high-agency learning and development function, partnering with  an array of stakeholders and course facilitators.

This role suits somebody highly organised, who enjoys ticking off to-do lists, thrives in context switching and enjoys the opportunity to identify where processes can be improved with the autonomy to build a solution that suits.

This role requires a regular presence in the London office (minimum 3 days per week) to ensure smooth delivery, strong collaboration, and a consistently high-quality learner experience.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Coordinating Faculty's end-to-end onboarding programme for all new joiners, managing schedules, logistics, facilitators, and communications while co-hosting cohort sessions in person.

 - Managing day-to-day administration of our Learning Experience Platform (Sana), including content uploads, tagging standards, user enrollments, and basic technical troubleshooting.

 - Supporting the Faculty-wide learning calendar and workshop logistics, handling invitations, materials, attendee tracking, and continuous improvement evaluation surveys.

 - Collaborating with Subject Matter Experts to update learning content, maintain brand standards, and manage document version control.

 - Utilising cutting-edge AI tools to increase efficiency across content creation, communication drafting, and learning administration processes.

 - Generating regular LXP analytical dashboards and insight summaries to track engagement, compliance, and overall operational performance.

 - Liaising across cross-functional teams, external partners, and facilitators to deliver seamless, clear, and timely communication for all learning initiatives.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - You bring experience in L&D, HR operations, events, or programme coordination, with a strong foundation in managing multi-stakeholder workflows.

 - You are highly organised with exceptional attention to detail, easily balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - You possess digital confidence and a strong tech aptitude, ideally with exposure to LXPs/LMSs (such as Sana) or adjacent HR tools.

 - You are an articulate communicator who builds clear, effective relationships with learners, internal experts, and external contributors alike.

 - You embrace an innovative mindset, proactively exploring AI and digital tools to streamline manual processes and raise delivery standards.

 - You thrive on taking ownership and bringing an adaptable, solutions-focused approach to high-touch learner support.
   
   

Our Interview Process

1) Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

2) Panel interview with L&D Associate and People Team (60 mins)

3) Interview with Head of Talent Development (60 mins)




OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

 Facilitate cross-functional improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies. 
 Analyse workflows and data to identify bottlenecks, waste, and opportunities for optimisation. 
 Assist with/facilitate workshops and training sessions to upskill teams in continuous improvement tools and techniques. Developing an imbedded excitement and culture of CI in manufacturing. 
 Develop and track KPIs to measure the success of improvement initiatives. 
 Ensure the sustainability of our changes. 
 What You'll Bring 
 Knowledge or strong interest of Lean, Six Sigma or similar methodologies. 
 Excellent facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills—you can bring people with you on the journey. 
 Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, ideally qualified to engineering degree level or equivalent work experience. 
 Resilience, adaptability, and a passion for making things better every day 
 Entry Requirements 
 A minimum of a 2:2 Bachelor’s/Integrated Master’s degree, or higher degree, such as MSc or PhD. 
 For this role, acceptable degree disciplines include: Engineering degrees 
 Maths and Science degrees 
 Computing & Digital degrees 
 Business & Professional Degrees 
 A full statement of courses and projects studied at university and corresponding grades/marks/percentage should be included in your CV. 
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.

items.card: What you'll do Model Development: Help improve the models and pipelines that infer skills from the work people actually do, using Transformers, PyTorch and LLMs, and measure whether each change makes our inference more accurate. items.desc: TechWolf is at the forefront of transforming the HR tech industry through the power of Artificial Intelligence. Our AI team owns everything from cutting-edge research through end-to-end production deployment, empowering companies to thrive in the age of AI through skills-based decision making. We prioritize fair, transparent, and impactful AI. As a Junior AI Engineer, you'll learn how to turn an idea into an AI feature that customers use every day. Our AI team works close to the product and close to our customers: we experiment quickly, measure carefully and ship what works. Here's what you can expect: Hands-On Learning: You'll learn from experienced AI engineers through mentorship, pairing sessions and code reviews, and build a real understanding of how AI systems work in production. Real Product Impact: Your work reaches customers. Within your first months you'll ship features that enterprises rely on. Room to Experiment: New models and techniques appear every week. We give you the space to try them, measure them and share what you find. Career Growth: We're invested in your success. As your strengths and interests become clear, we'll tailor a development plan to help you grow into a well-rounded AI engineer. What you'll do Model Development: Help improve the models and pipelines that infer skills from the work people actually do, using Transformers, PyTorch and LLMs, and measure whether each change makes our inference more accurate. Agent Engineering: Help build agentic features with LLMs (AWS Bedrock) and modern agent SDKs, from first prototype to production. Evaluation: Build eval sets and offline evaluations that show whether a change actually makes a feature better, and learn to read the signals from production. Experimentation: Try new models, prompts and approaches, and share what you learn, including what didn't work. Productization: Ship your work as tested, observable Python services (FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes) in AWS. Product & Customer Focus: Work with Product and customer-facing colleagues to understand the problem before building the solution. Who you are You're a (soon-to-be) graduate, preferably in Computer Science or Engineering, or you have up to 2 years of experience. You've built something with LLMs or ML, such as a thesis, internship, side project or hackathon, and you can tell us what worked and what didn't. You write solid Python and are comfortable with git and writing tests. You care about the people who use what you build, and you ask "why" before "how". You're curious, you enjoy experimenting, and you learn fast. You exhibit excellent communication and teamwork. You're passionate about impactful AI, fairness and transparency. You already work AI-first: coding agents and AI assistants are a natural part of how you build, learn and solve problems. You're based in Belgium and excited to work together with the TechWolf team in our Ghent office at least three days per week. What's in it for you? Fair & competitive salaries – we benchmark our salaries yearly and pay above the market median in every role and location. ‍‍‍ Hybrid working and flexible hours - make your work schedule work for you Mobility your way - choose between a company car or a mobility budget Health insurance & retirement savings ️ Work from abroad 3 weeks each year Learning and development opportunities ‍ ️ Walking culture - who doesn’t love brainstorming or connecting with colleagues while taking a walk around the office? Fun teambuildings, social & sports activities Sounds like your cup of tea? There’s more! TechWolf is on a mission to make work better and fairer for millions of people by powering the shift from jobs to skills as a framework to model talent. Our enterprise software uses AI to provide the skill data needed to power that transformation. We provide a unique opportunity to work with an all-star team and cutting-edge product, in a purpose-driven company that aims to empower people to flourish at work. TechWolf is growing fast and you’ll join a high-performing international team with a unicorn dream. Are you ready to build a rocket ship with us?

items.desc: Jobomschrijving: Je komt terecht in een team dat volop in transformatie is, waar kwaliteit, risicobeheersing, automatisering en artificiële intelligentie een sleutelrol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van de activiteiten binnen de rechtsbijstandsverzekering. Met jouw expertise draag je bij aan betrouwbare, conforme en efficiënte processen, met een sterke focus op een kwalitatieve dienstverlening aan onze klanten. Je werkt op het kruispunt van operations, governance, data en continue verbetering om het interne controlesysteem te versterken en de kwaliteitsstandaarden van de organisatie verder uit te bouwen. Jouw dagelijkse verantwoordelijkheden Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert het interne controlekader voor operationele activiteiten, schadedossiers en betalingen. Je voert risicoanalyses uit en coördineert eerstelijnscontroles. Je ontwikkelt steekproefmethodologieën waarmee de kwaliteit van dossiers en processen objectief kan worden gemeten. Je analyseert kwaliteitsresultaten en identificeert de grondoorzaken van vastgestelde afwijkingen. Je benut data en AI-oplossingen om risico's sneller te detecteren en de kwaliteitsopvolging te versterken. Je coördineert interne audits, regelgevende controles en de opvolging van actieplannen. Je werkt mee aan de uitwerking van controles voor nieuwe processen, digitale projecten en geautomatiseerde oplossingen. Je waakt over datakwaliteit, toegangsbeheer en de naleving van wettelijke en regelgevende vereisten. Je ontwikkelt dashboards en KPI's die een efficiënte sturing van de activiteiten mogelijk maken. Je ondersteunt teams bij het uitbouwen van een cultuur van kwaliteit, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering. Onmisbare competenties Je beschikt over ruime ervaring in interne controle, audit, risicobeheer of kwaliteitsmanagement. Je hebt een grondige kennis van governance, interne controlemechanismen en risico-evaluatie. Je bent vertrouwd met data-analyse, performantiemeting en rapporteringstools. Je vertaalt regelgeving en controlevereisten naar pragmatische en werkbare oplossingen. Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Frans. Troeven Ervaring binnen de verzekeringssector of de financiële dienstverlening. Kennis van artificiële intelligentie, data-analyse en geavanceerde rapportering. Vertrouwdheid met frameworks zoals COSO, het Three Lines Model of Lean Six Sigma. Ervaring met Power BI of vergelijkbare business intelligence-oplossingen. Je voelt je comfortabel in een Engelstalige werkomgeving. AXA wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de diverse samenleving waarin wij leven en voert daarom al jaren een beleid van actieve diversiteit, non-discriminatie en gelijke kansen. In dit kader garanderen wij een gelijke behandeling en toegang tot selecties, ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, culturele achtergrond, handicap, geslacht of seksuele geaardheid of andere kenmerken . Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af. AXA Belgium Meer dan 3000 mensen werken bij ons, vanuit onze vooruitstrevende kantoren in Brussel, Antwerpen, Eupen en Luik. We werken samen met 3200 makelaars. We hebben 3 miljoen klanten en zijn nummer 1 in autoverzekeringen. Het is onze ambitie om onze relatie met al onze klanten te transformeren van betaler naar partner om ons echt te onderscheiden. Onze fundamenten Onze belangrijkste leidraad zijn onze waarden: Customer first, Integrity, Courage en One AXA . Alles wat we doen, daar staan we als één team achter. Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af. Meer info in ons Diversiteits- en Inclusiebeleid. Wat we aanbieden Een mooie beloning voor je werk Een competitief loon, eventueel aangevuld met discretionaire persoonlijke en collectieve premies en natuurlijk ook maaltijd- en ecocheques, een volledige terugbetaling van het openbaar vervoer en een cafetariaplan. Alle voordelen van werken bij een verzekeraar Van groepsverzekering tot ambulante en hospitalisatieverzekering (ook gezinsleden kunnen daarbij aansluiten aan een voordelig tarief) en met tot 30% korting op onze andere verzekeringsproducten. Een job die zich aanpast aan je leven en dromen Een flexibel rooster van 35 uur per week, 36 dagen verlof per jaar om op te laden, evenals de mogelijkheid om gedeeltelijk van thuis uit te werken. Wij bieden sportlessen op het werk, welzijnsprogramma's voor werknemers en trainingen, om u in topvorm te houden, zowel fysiek als mentaal.

Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Wavestone recherche actuellement des profils : Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, l'ambition de Wavestone est d'apporter à ses clients des réponses uniques sur le marché, en les éclairant et les guidant dans leurs décisions les plus stratégiques. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Nous recrutons des talents aux parcours diversifiés, de tous niveaux d'expérience. Des personnalités engagées, reconnues pour leur goût d'entreprendre et leur esprit d'équipe. Venez vivre une expérience unique au sein de Wavestone ! \n\n Description de l'entreprise Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, Wavestone s’est donné pour mission d’éclairer et guider les grandes organisations dans leurs transformations les plus critiques. Des transformations qui visent à répondre aux grands enjeux stratégiques auxquels elles vont faire face dans les années à venir : l’accélération de la révolution numérique, l’intensification de la concurrence, ou encore la prise en considération de l’urgence climatique. Le cabinet possède des compétences sectorielles centrées sur le cœur de métier de ses clients, des compétences technologiques parmi les plus pointues tant sur le digital, les systèmes d’information qu’en matière de cybersécurité, et des compétences en développement durable. Wavestone se distingue dans sa capacité à conjuguer étroitement toutes ces compétences, sans couture, au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires afin d’apporter une réponse à 360°, en phase avec les grands enjeux auxquels sont confrontés ses clients. Le cabinet réalise un chiffre d’affaires de l’ordre de 940 M€ et rassemble près de 5500 collaborateurs présents dans 17 pays répartis sur 4 continents. Il figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe. Wavestone est coté sur Euronext à Paris et labellisé Great Place To Work. Pour plus d'informations, consulter www.wavestone.com Description du poste Contexte Au sein du bureau de Paris, la business unit Digital Customer (350 collaborateurs) accompagne les grandes entreprises françaises et internationales dans leurs projets de transformation. La BU accompagne en particulier les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, de la Beauté, de l'Hospitalité, des Services et des FMCG. Au cœur des plus grands enjeux actuels et futurs de ces secteurs, vous accompagnerez nos clients dans leurs projets de transformation les plus importants : lancement de nouvelles offres et de produits, digitalisation des parcours et processus métier, amélioration de la connaissance client, performance de la Supply Chain, exploitation des données pour la recherche et l'innovation, refonte des modèles de distribution… Au sein de la BU DC, l'offre Data, Analytics & AI (70 consultants au sein de cette communauté) accompagne les directions métiers, Data & IT dans leurs transformations liées aux données. Les enjeux sont vastes : le renforcement de la connaissance client pour mieux cibler les actions Marketing, l'automatisation de processus via l'IA, la monétisation des données en sont des exemples. Nos équipes vont intervenir de bout en bout sur ces projets de transformation, de la stratégie à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle. Nos interventions vont par exemple se décliner en : Définition de stratégies Data/IA et pilotage des programmes de transformation associées Cadrage de cas d'usage et pilotage de leur mise en œuvre Définition des organisations et des modèles opérationnels Data/IA Diagnostic de la qualité des données …

items.desc: Four FM är ett nordiskt facility management-företag som erbjuder skräddarsydda tjänster till företag och fastighetsägare. Verksamheten omfattar bland annat kontorsservice, lokalvård, teknisk fastighetsservice och andra tjänster som får kundernas vardag att fungera smidigt. Med verksamhet i fem nordiska länder kombinerar Four FM flexibilitet och personlig service med ambitionen att ständigt utveckla och förbättra sina arbetssätt. Läs mer om Four FM på https://fourfm.com/ Om uppdraget Vill du omsätta AI i praktiken och bidra till smartare arbetssätt i ett växande företag? Four FM söker dig som är nyfiken på AI, gillar att lösa problem och vill identifiera hur ny teknik kan skapa konkret verksamhetsnytta. Här får du möjlighet att utforska nya lösningar, testa idéer och hjälpa en verksamhet att ta nästa steg i sin digitala utveckling. AI utvecklas snabbt, men hur kan tekniken användas för att förenkla arbetsmoment, effektivisera processer och skapa verklig nytta i en verksamhet? Det är frågan du får vara med och utforska hos Four FM. I uppdraget arbetar du nära verksamheten för att identifiera möjligheter med AI och automatisering. Du undersöker hur befintliga verktyg kan användas smartare exempelvis inom Microsofts verktygsmiljö, och hur AI kan integreras i det dagliga arbetet. Du förväntas inte ha alla svar från början. Det viktigaste är att du är nyfiken, vågar testa nytt och kan omsätta idéer till konkreta förslag som går att använda i praktiken. Du förväntas att arbeta 12 tim/veckan på plats på deras kontor i Örebro. Uppdraget förväntas starta så snart som möjligt och pågå åtminstone fram till sommaren 2027. Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat vara att: Kartlägga arbetsprocesser och identifiera moment som kan effektiviseras med AI och automatisering. Undersöka hur befintliga digitala verktyg, exempelvis Microsoft 365 och relevanta AI-funktioner kan användas på nya sätt. Ta fram och testa idéer, prototyper eller enklare automatiserade lösningar. Utvärdera vilka lösningar som skapar störst nytta för verksamheten. Dokumentera resultat och presentera konkreta rekommendationer för fortsatt utveckling. Bidra till att öka kunskapen om AI och inspirera kollegor att använda tekniken i sitt arbete. Fungera som stöd i allmänna IT-frågor. Din bakgrund Vi söker dig som studerar det systemvetenskapliga programmet eller datateknik vid Örebro universitet och som har kommit en bit in i studierna. Du är kreativ, orädd för nya utmaningar och bekväm med att testa dig fram. Du gillar att förstå hur saker fungerar, ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och tar gärna egna initiativ för att komma framåt. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och kan förklara tekniska lösningar på ett begripligt sätt. Du uttrycker dig obehindrat i såväl tal som skrift på både engelska och svenska. Du behöver inte vara expert på AI, men du bör ha ett intresse för tekniken och vilja lära dig mer genom att använda den i verksamhetsnära situationer. Du har grundläggande förståelse för digitala verktyg och gärna erfarenhet av Microsofts verktygsmiljö. Det är meriterande om du har testat att bygga AI-agenter, automatisera arbetsflöden eller använda AI för att lösa konkreta problem. Det viktigaste är dock din nyfikenhet, ditt driv och din förmåga att omsätta idéer till handling. Välkommen med din ansökan Bifoga ditt CV, personligt brev och något du själv byggt/skapat. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag, dock senast 8 november 2026. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post utan hänvisar samtliga sökande till att ansöka via vårt rekryteringssystem Varbi. Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Kajsa-Stina Johansson på kajsa-stina.johansson@oruholding.se. items.desc: Join Pay.UK as a Data Scientist and work with data connected to services that millions of people and businesses across the UK rely on every day. This is a role for someone who wants to apply solid data science practice in a clear, meaningful setting, with the chance to help shape how we use data and AI across a trusted payments environment. We are looking for a specialist who enjoys turning complex data into clear insight, practical models and well-structured analysis. You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation, using evidence to support decisions, improve understanding and help us develop our data capability in a way that is thoughtful, transparent and useful. Accountabilities Analyse large and complex datasets to identify patterns, trends and risks relevant to Pay.UK's services and operations. Build, test and refine statistical and machine learning models that support better forecasting, monitoring and decision-making. Prepare clear visualisations, reports and presentations that explain methods, findings and limitations in a straightforward way. Work with colleagues across business and technical teams to define data questions, shape analytical approaches and agree practical outputs. Translate business problems into structured analytical tasks, including data preparation, feature selection and model evaluation. Improve data quality and analytical processes by documenting methods, validating outputs and supporting good data practice. Use SQL and programming tools to extract, clean and transform data from multiple sources for analysis and modelling. Support the development of Pay.UK's wider data and AI capability by contributing to repeatable methods, standards and shared learning. Qualifications, Skills and Experience Professional experience in a Data Scientist role, with responsibility for delivering analysis and predictive or statistical models. Solid applied experience using Python and SQL to extract, prepare, analyze, and model data. Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning, with the ability to choose and evaluate suitable methods for real business questions. Experience presenting technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences through reports, visualisations or presentations. Experience working with large, complex datasets and applying clear quality checks, documentation and validation methods. Pay.UK Behaviours At Pay.UK, our behaviours are central to who we are and how we operate. They bring our values to life, shape our culture, and guide how we make decisions, collaborate, and respond to challenges across the payments ecosystem. All interview processes will assess the following behaviours: Listen to Find Win-Wins - Empathy, Listening and Understanding Influence with Courage - Influence, Courage Go Horizontal First - Cross Boundary Collaboration Take Ownership - Self Development Opportunity Mindset - Initiative Simplify - Achievement Orientation Inclusivity At Pay.UK, we value diversity and inclusivity. Research has shown that candidates from underrepresented groups may hesitate to apply unless they meet all the requirements listed. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of how closely their skills and experience match the requirements. We are committed to supporting accessibility needs and creating a welcoming environment for all employees. Become part of our team and contribute to the creation of an inclusive work environment that values everyone's unique input. Who we are Pay.UK is the recognised operator and standards body for the UK's interbank retail payment systems. We provide the infrastructure and services that millions of people and businesses rely on every day, including Bacs, Faster Payments and the Image Clearing System for cheques, the Current Account Switch Service and Confirmation of Payee. Together, these services help keep money moving safely, securely and reliably across the UK and play an important role in supporting the economy. In 2025, the UK's retail payment systems processed more than 12.5 billion transactions worth over £11 trillion. Since its launch in 2013, the Current Account Switch Service has successfully helped consumers and businesses switch more than 12 million current accounts. These services help people receive their salaries, pay their bills, make payments and manage their finances with confidence. Our purpose is to provide the trusted infrastructure, standards and services that underpin UK retail payments. We deliver safe, resilient and efficient payment systems while working collaboratively with industry, regulators and stakeholders to strengthen resilience, tackle fraud, improve access and support innovation across the payments landscape. As the ecosystem evolves, we are continuing to develop our capabilities in areas such as data and AI, enhancing operational insight and helping to build a modern, trusted payments ecosystem. items.desc: Description Turn data into performance. Start your Formula 1 journey at Aston Martin Aramco Formula 1 Team. Are you passionate about mathematics, data science and understanding how complex systems perform? Join our Vehicle Science team as a Graduate Data Scientist , applying mathematical modelling, statistical analysis and machine learning to help improve the performance of our Formula One car. You'll work with data from simulation, wind tunnel testing and the track, developing practical models and analysis tools that help our engineers understand vehicle behaviour, identify trends and make better-informed decisions. Working alongside experienced specialists, you'll build your technical expertise while contributing to the engineering work that drives car development. Key Responsibilities Develop and improve physics-based, reduced-order and data-driven models to support engineering analysis and vehicle performance decisions. Build and maintain Python analysis tools to turn simulation, wind tunnel and track data into meaningful engineering insight. Undertake modelling tasks from problem definition and data preparation through to development, verification, validation and documentation, with guidance from experienced colleagues. Apply mathematical modelling, statistics and machine-learning techniques to identify trends, improve predictions and accelerate engineering workflows. A sound understanding of mathematical modelling, statistics and data analysis, with an interest in applying these to complex engineering problems. Knowledge of regression, optimisation and machine-learning methods; familiarity with surrogate or reduced-order modelling would be advantageous. Programming experience in Python, ideally using libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy and scikit-learn. Understanding of model validation, uncertainty and error analysis, with the ability to investigate unexpected results and draw evidence-based conclusions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn, with the ability to communicate findings clearly. A collaborative, proactive approach, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver work to demanding timescales. An interest in Formula 1, motorsport, aerospace or other high-performance engineering environments would be advantageous. Make an impact At Aston Martin Aramco, data science is an important part of understanding and improving car performance. You'll have the opportunity to apply your mathematical and programming skills to real engineering problems, helping our engineers extract greater value from simulation, wind tunnel and track data. You'll learn from experienced specialists, develop your modelling and data science capabilities, and see how your work contributes to the decisions that shape a Formula 1 car. If you're curious about how things work, enjoy solving complex problems and want to apply your skills where engineering performance is pushed to its limits, we'd like to hear from you. You will also have access to our state-of-the-art facilities at the AMR Technology Campus, featuring a new on-site gym with fitness, spin and yoga classes, a bistro café, and restaurant. items.desc: About CommonAI CommonAI CIC is a non-profit organisation built around collaborative engineering and is backed by a mix of UK Government and private funding in order to design, build and deploy innovative AI systems. Our Scaling Inference Lab (SIL) is developing simulation grounded in real measurements to help the UK invest in promising AI infrastructure. We connect proposed hardware designs to realistic workloads, helping investors and engineers understand their potential, their limitations and the next experiment worth doing. The Opportunity Build simulation software that helps engineers and investors explore how AI systems would behave with different processors, memory systems, networks or serving strategies. Your work will help turn models and existing software into a practical framework for comparing design choices against realistic LLM workloads. You will develop and connect simulation components, making sure that changes in one part of a system have the appropriate consequences elsewhere. This means understanding unfamiliar code, designing clear interfaces and building software whose predictions can be investigated and tested against measurements. We aim to reuse and extend existing frameworks wherever they provide a sound foundation. We welcome depth in one or more relevant areas, including simulation, systems software, performance modelling and inference serving. Your initial focus will reflect your strengths and the components we choose to build on, with complementary expertise added as the team grows. What you will do Develop and integrate simulation components that capture behaviour and interactions relevant to an AI infrastructure comparison. Work with the technical lead and our partners to evaluate existing frameworks and software, extending and connecting useful components through clear interfaces. Develop appropriate models of system state and resource use so that changes in one component have the appropriate consequences elsewhere. Build reproducible simulation scenarios, diagnostic outputs and tests that expose incorrect assumptions, integration errors and unsupported cases. Work with measurement and uncertainty colleagues to compare predictions with evidence, improve models and integrate calibration and uncertainty methods into the simulator. Maintain reliable software, documentation and development workflows, using AI coding agents to support implementation and testing. An example early project would be to bridge an existing simulator component with our workload models and measurement datasets, producing a reproducible comparison between predicted and measured performance over two systems. Requirements Strong software engineering skills and evidence of building, debugging and maintaining substantial technical software. Experience in one or more of: discrete-event simulation; computer architecture or performance modelling; distributed/HPC systems; inference runtimes and serving; memory or network modelling; integration of scientific software and heterogeneous components. The ability to understand unfamiliar code, reason about interfaces and assess the suitability and maintenance costs of reusing, extending or building software. A collaborative approach to testing assumptions and working with specialists in adjacent areas. Practical experience using AI coding agents, with the judgement to check their output for correctness and maintainability. Python, C++, Rust or other relevant systems or scientific programming experience can provide a route into the role. Familiarity with vLLM or SGLang, simulator frameworks, or hardware performance tools would be useful. Depth in a subset of these areas is sufficient; languages and frameworks will follow the engineering needs of the programme. Why join us Help build UK AI capability and improve how investment and compute serve the public good. Build a network spanning UK hardware SMEs, major technology companies, venture and public investors, and leading universities. Shape a growing team with startup pace and close academic links. Use frontier models and coding agents with a substantial tooling budget. Benefits A collaborative and supportive work environment The opportunity to have a high impact in a growing organisation Competitive salary package, including pension and benefits Professional development opportunities Networking opportunities with influential figures from across the tech sector and academia A vibrant office environment located a few minutes’ walk away from Cambridge train station Working with us Hybrid, with Cambridge attendance agreed individually around collaboration and the work; applicants across the UK are welcome. We are open to permanent employment, part-time arrangements and consultancy. We would like you to start as soon as practical and can be flexible for the right person. We particularly welcome experienced engineers and can also consider earlier-career candidates with strong evidence of ability. Relevant postgraduate study …

The Opportunity Help investors turn questions about AI infrastructure into technical evidence they can use. You will translate between investment and engineering audiences, turning diligence questions into well-defined simulation studies and experiments, and explaining what the findings mean for a proposed technology. Working with the engineering team, you will make SIL's simulation framework accessible to investors without specialist systems knowledge. You will guide users through studies, help them understand the assumptions and uncertainty behind the results, and turn their feedback into improvements to our framework. Produce concise assessments explaining technical findings, assumptions, uncertainty, integration requirements and the next evidence worth obtaining. Bring together simulator results, company and research developments, and investor questions to contribute to the Scientific Director's technology roadmap for SIL. An example early project would be to work with an investor and the engineering team to compare two AI infrastructure options, producing a concise assessment of the findings, assumptions and further evidence needed to inform an investment decision.
