items.desc: Research Assistant – In Vivo Neurophysiology, Circuit Biology Are you a passionate, hands-on, experimental neuroscience, interested in using advanced in vivo technologies to support the discovery of new treatments for brain diseases? Do you have experience in electrophysiology and/or functional imaging? Then you may be our new Research Assistant in Circuit Biology. Your new role As Research Assistant, you will be a key hands-on contributor to Lundbeck’s early drug discovery projects, generating high-quality in vivo pharmacology data that help us understand how novel treatments affect neuronal and neuromuscular function. You will work across central and peripheral in vivo electrophysiology, with opportunities to contribute to approaches such as EEG, multiunit and high-density neuronal recordings, and neuromuscular electrophysiology. In close collaboration with scientists and project teams, you will plan and perform experiments, analyse and document data, troubleshoot methods, and help drive timely project decisions. You will also have the opportunity to broaden your expertise across other advanced in vivo platforms, including functional imaging with genetically encoded biosensors and neurochemical measurements. The role offers a strong development opportunity to build practical expertise in cutting-edge neuroscience technologies while contributing directly to Lundbeck’s drug discovery pipeline. Your future team You will join the Circuit Biology Department at Lundbeck's headquarters. We are an experimental neuroscience group focused on understanding how brain circuits are altered in disease, and how our drug candidates can correct these. Our department combines complementary approaches including: in vivo electrophysiology, including EEG and high-density neuronal recordings ex vivo brain slice electrophysiology and imaging peripheral and neuromuscular electrophysiology in vivo functional imaging using biosensors neurochemistry using microdialysis and advanced perfusion approaches We work closely with drug discovery project teams across our pipeline and place a strong emphasis on scientific quality, collaboration and developing experimental approaches that can answer critical questions for our projects. The position is based in Valby, Copenhagen. What you bring to the team We are looking for someone who enjoys experimental work and is comfortable spending a substantial part of their time hands-on in the laboratory. Ideally, you have: An MSc in neuroscience, physiology, biomedical science, pharmacology, biology or a related discipline. Hands-on experience conducting in vivo experiments in rodents, preferably involving electrophysiology, neurophysiology or functional imaging. FELASA accreditation or equivalent qualification permitting experimental work with laboratory animals. Experience with animal surgery, physiological recordings or other technically demanding in vivo procedures. A solid understanding of experimental design, data quality and documentation. Experience with analysis of physiological or biological data using appropriate software. The ability to troubleshoot experimental procedures and learn new techniques quickly. A proactive, flexible and collaborative approach to working in a multidisciplinary research environment. Experience with techniques such as EEG, extracellular electrophysiology, high-density neuronal recordings, peripheral nerve or muscle electrophysiology, or in vivo optical imaging would be an advantage, but we do not expect candidates to have experience across all of these areas. Most importantly, you are curious, technically skilled and motivated by generating robust experimental data that directly contribute to drug discovery projects. Our promise to you Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further on addressing the big unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with a mix of exciting tasks and development opportunities that are balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being. We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion. Annual base salary range: 491 000 - 675 400 DKK gross. Un parcours de carrière personnalisé et des perspectives d'évolution rapides. Un environnement favorisant l'expertise, le partage de connaissances et l'innovation. items.desc: Equal1 is building silicon-based quantum computers, integrating spin qubits and cryo-CMOS control electronics on standard semiconductor processes. We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineer to join our team in Timișoara and build infrastructure for the whole company, across all our sites, with a focus on our full-stack software framework and our measurement activities. You will work closely with our IT Manager from day one. Over time, the role will also support our SoC / hardware modeling team. Main Duties and Responsibilities Own CI/CD, build and release pipelines for the quantum software stack (Python, C/C++), including simulator and hardware-in-the-loop testing. Automate the flow of data from lab instruments and measurement setups into central storage, with experiment tracking and traceability. Design data infrastructure that scales across sites: storage, backup, retention and access policies. Manage lab and engineering compute as code, and run observability (logging, metrics, alerting) for internal services. Progressively support the SoC / HW modeling team with simulation compute, job scheduling, license servers and regression pipelines. Evaluate and, if pursued, build GPU infrastructure for ML / LLM training and serving. Work with the IT Manager on identity, networking, security and cloud accounts, so DevOps and IT form one coherent setup. Experience and Qualifications Required: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 4+ years of experience in DevOps, platform, SRE or build/release engineering. Strong Linux administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python). Hands-on experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins), Docker and Kubernetes or similar. Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) across on-premises and cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP). Solid networking and security fundamentals. Fluent English and the ability to work with physicists, hardware and software engineers. Desired: Experience with HPC, EDA or scientific computing environments (Slurm, license servers). Lab automation or data acquisition (QCoDeS, PyVISA) and experiment tracking (ClearML, MLflow). Data engineering (object storage, HDF5/Parquet, PostgreSQL) or GPU / ML infrastructure. If you want to build the platform behind a quantum computer from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

Its activity includes high-intensity focused ultrasound and histotripsy for tumour treatment (with clinical studies such as THERESA and HOPE4LIVER, in collaboration with HistoSonics), ultrasound-based training simulators, and the co-development of medical devices with industry partners. We are looking for a Biomedical Engineer to join the team and contribute to the technical development of these projects, working closely with clinicians, researchers and external collaborators. Main responsibilities and duties: Provide technical and scientific support to the research projects led by Dr. Xavier Serres within the FUSMED research line Manage project documentation and coordinate the planning and follow-up of project phases and milestones Contribute to the design and development of the medical devices and software required by each project Liaise with collaborating entities, both external companies and other research groups within the institution, and organise and manage the related meetings and joint activities. items.desc: IoT Security Analyst (m/f/d) Campanillas, MA, ES, 29590 Key Area: Product Testing & Laboratory Services Level of Experience: Entry Level Employment Type: Permanent Full Time / Part Time: Full Time Weekly Hours: 40.00 Remote Working: Hybrid Requisition ID: 7068 Posting Date: Oct 22, 2026 Since its foundation in 1925, the DEKRA promise has been to ensure the safety of human interaction with technology and the environment. Today, DEKRA employs around 48,000 people across more than 60 countries on all five continents. Following our 100th anniversary in 2025, our vision remains clear and ambitious: to be the global partner for a safe, secure, and sustainable world. Within our Cybersecurity Hub , we evaluate the security of connected products end to end, with a strong focus on IoT and embedded devices and their full ecosystem: hardware, firmware, wireless protocols, companion mobile apps, web interfaces and cloud backends. We collaborate with world-leading manufacturers and technology companies to identify risks and vulnerabilities and verify compliance with international security standards and certification schemes. You will join a globally recognized security lab within a multidisciplinary team covering IoT/hardware, web and mobile security, working on international projects for top-tier customers. We are looking for professionals passionate about IoT and embedded security who also want to grow in web and mobile penetration testing, combining analytical thinking and creativity to help safeguard our digital world. What will your responsibilities be? Perform security evaluations of IoT devices and their full ecosystem (device, companion app and cloud backend) against standards such as EN 18031, ETSI EN 303 645 and OWASP ISVS. Analyze hardware and firmware: identify debug interfaces (UART, JTAG/SWD), extract firmware from flash memory or update packages, and review embedded Linux systems for weaknesses. Assess wireless and IoT communication protocols such as BLE, Wi-Fi, Zigbee and MQTT. Perform penetration tests of web applications and APIs, including device web interfaces and cloud backends, following OWASP WSTG and OWASP ASVS. Perform security assessments of Android and iOS applications, including IoT companion apps, following OWASP MASVS/MASTG. Support product security certification and compliance projects (e.g., EU Cyber Resilience Act, ETSI/EN standards, ioXt, MASA, CASA) under the guidance of senior team members. Prepare clear technical reports documenting vulnerabilities, risk ratings and recommended mitigations, and communicate findings to international customers. Stay current with emerging attack techniques, tools and security practices across IoT, web and mobile. What do we expect from you? Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a closely related field. 1–2 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ideally in IoT or embedded security (professional experience, internships, research or personal projects). Practical knowledge of IoT and embedded systems (microcontrollers, embedded Linux, firmware) and common IoT communication protocols such as BLE, Wi-Fi or MQTT. Basic hardware security skills: identifying and using debug interfaces (UART, JTAG/SWD) and extracting and analyzing firmware (e.g., binwalk, unblob). Basic knowledge of web and mobile application security (OWASP Top 10, OWASP MASVS) and tools such as Burp Suite. Working knowledge of Linux and scripting (Python, Bash or similar). Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in international and multidisciplinary teams. Id eally, you’ll also have: Familiarity with IoT security frameworks and standards such as OWASP IoT Top 10, ETSI EN 303 645 or EN 18031. Experience with hardware hacking tools (logic analyzer, flash programmers, SDR), reverse engineering of embedded binaries (e.g., Ghidra), RTOS or IoT ecosystems such as Zigbee, Thread or Matter. Hands-on experience in web application and API penetration testing. Experience with mobile app testing tools (Frida, Objection, MobSF, jadx) and rooted/jailbroken devices. Knowledge of the EU Cyber Resilience Act and product security certification schemes. Cybersecurity certifications (e.g., OSCP, eJPT, CWES, BSCP, eMAPT, or IoT/hardware-specific ones), which are valuable but not mandatory. Participation in security communities, CTFs, bug bounty programs or open-source projects (e.g., GitHub, Hackaday). Additional language skills (German, Spanish, Chinese) would be beneficial At DEKRA we value your unique experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We are committed to an inclusive workplace for all team members.

items.desc: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you. About the role: The Compliance Analyst – UK at Reserv will play a valuable role in supporting our company’s adherence to UK regulatory requirements, industry best practices and ethical standards. This position is designed for a developing compliance professional with strong UK complaints knowledge, who will assist in developing and implementing compliance programs and initiatives to help mitigate risks and safeguard our operations. A familiarity with TPAs is ideal. This is a hands-on role, with guidance and oversight from your manager. Your focus will be doing the work: resolving UK complaints and responding to GDPR data subject access requests (DSARs), Data Protection Act (DPA) requests and Request for Access to Data (RAD1) requests accurately, fairly and within the required timescales, with particular care for vulnerable customers. Who you are: Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org. Passionate Risk & Compliance professional who cares about the customer and their experience. Empathetic. You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with. Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours. Creative. You challenge existing assumptions and find ways of leveraging technology to reimagine the R&C process. Curious. You want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and be decisive when it counts. Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it. Communicative. (we'd love to know what this means to you) And did we mention, a sense of humor. Claims are hard enough as it is. What We Need: We need you to be able to perform the following key responsibilities: Regulatory Compliance Possess awareness of UK requirements, including UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, FCA rules, Consumer Duty and FCA guidance on vulnerable customers, and apply them to day-to-day complaints and data requests. Help translate regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance for claims handlers and UK colleagues, working alongside the wider compliance team. Assist in drafting and updating procedures and training materials, including complaints and data protection. Help document and communicate relevant changes to stakeholders. Compliance Program Management Manage UK complaints from intake through resolution, recognising vulnerable customers and adapting to their needs, and ensuring timely, accurate and fairresponses in line with internal complaints procedures and FCA rules, including Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) referrals. Respond to GDPR DSARs: verify requests, gather data from systems and teams, apply redactions and exemptions, and meet statutory deadlines. Process DPA requests and Request for Access to Data (RAD1) requests, validating each one and issuing accurate, timely responses. Monitor and approve sanctions screening alerts for payments, investigating potential matches, deciding whether to release or block, and escalating true or unresolved matches in line with UK sanctions requirements. Maintain organised records of all complaints and requests, and escalate breaches, vulnerable-customer concerns and potential data incidents promptly. Support responses to audits and regulatory enquiries by preparing materials and gathering documentation. Data Analysis & Reporting Track complaints and DSAR, DPA and RAD1 volumes, turnaround times and outcomes, including cases involving vulnerable customers, and help flag trends and root causes. Prepare regular compliance reports, with oversight from your manager. Risk & Control Oversight Support control testing and documentation for UK claims compliance, and help identify improvements based on complaint trends, audit findings and incidents. Ownership & Execution Take ownership of your assigned compliance areas and seek opportunities to improve processes. Manage your own caseload and deadlines in a fast-paced environment, seeking guidance where needed. Check your work carefully, including complaint responses and data disclosures, before it goes to customers, colleagues or regulators. Adapt quickly to new areas and contribute beyond core responsibilities as needed. Cross-Functional Collaboration …

This is a deeply technical, high-ownership role at the intersection of platform engineering, security, and safety research. Partner with safety researchers and domain experts to translate evaluation designs into reliable, reproducible, and scalable systems. Build eval-orchestration tooling and harnesses that let researchers run high-throughput evaluations against models and agents in isolated environments. Develop infrastructure for measuring AI capability uplift in high-consequence domains, and integrate results into the pipelines that inform release decisions. Implement guardrails, monitoring, and compartmentalization so sensitive work stays appropriately siloed, applying least-privilege, need-to-know, and defense-in-depth principles across compute, data, and tooling. Write production-quality Python (and related tooling) for high-throughput data processing and evaluation systems. Improve the reliability, security posture, and developer experience of the safety team's evaluation platform over time. items.desc: We are currently looking for an Algorithm Engineer to join the team in Delft . You will be part of the Defence & Security business unit, where we develop innovative solutions using space technologies. Within the domain of Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT), our work includes satellite navigation signal quality monitoring, radio-frequency (RF) interference direction-finding, and antenna array technologies for RF interference mitigation. Our solutions support applications in Defence, Space and Critical Infrastructure. In this role, you will develop and implement algorithms to detect, classify and localize and suppress RF-emitters in challenging environments, and combining sensor outputs in an optimal way. Working in a collaborative team of 10 engineers, you will contribute to signal processing and system-control algorithm development and evaluate their performance using custom or off-the-shelf hardware. You will also carry out testing, verification and validation in laboratory environments and during field operations. This position offers the opportunity to design innovative technical solutions, solve complex engineering challenges and contribute to product development in a dynamic, high-tech organisation. Main responsibilities: Translate end-user needs into measurable technical and performance requirements. Design algorithmic processing architectures that combine stochastic analysis, system identification, optimization and data-driven methods. Develop and implement signal-processing and system-control algorithms. Collaborate with software and hardware engineers to balance detection accuracy, computational performance and other product requirements. Keep up to date with scientific developments and state-of-the-art techniques relevant to the field. Design test benches and define and perform testing, verification and validation activities. Take ownership of technical tasks and lead projects within larger programmes. Requirements: Education: A master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience: A good understanding of signal processing, system control and digital communications. Experience in one or more relevant areas, such as RF systems, GNSS and satellite navigation, sensor fusion, system identification, stochastic modelling, constrained optimization (e.g. mixed integer), state-estimation. Experience in data-driven AI modelling is strongly preferred. Knowledge: Programming experience in Python is essential. Experience with Rust, C or C++ is an advantage. Experience: The ability to communicate technical ideas clearly in English, both verbally and in writing. Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage. Interest: An interest in working in the Defence domain and the ability to obtain the required security clearances (Dutch, NATO and EU, as applicable). Important: You do not need to have experience in every technical area listed above. We value the different perspectives and expertise that people bring, whether developed through education, research or practical experience. items.desc: zurück zur Stellenübersicht Die Hochschule für Technik, Wirtschaft und Kultur Leipzig (HTWK Leipzig) ist eine der führenden Hochschulen für Angewandte Wissenschaften in Deutschland. Mit einer Vielzahl an innovativen Studiengängen, interdisziplinären Forschungsprojekten und einer starken Vernetzung in die regionale Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft bieten wir eine lebendige akademische Umgebung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams ist an der Fakultät Informatik und Medien folgende Stelle zum 01.12.2026 zu besetzen: Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin/Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter für Computer Vision und digitales Kulturerbe (w/m/d) Ihre Aufgaben An der HTWK Leipzig ist im Rahmen des Forschungsprojektes „V.E.R.B. - Verschwundenes Erbe - Rekonstruierte Bauwerke. Bauerbe als Ressource für gesellschaftliche Resilienz“ eine wissenschaftliche Stelle mit dem Ziel der Promotion zu besetzen. Das auf 36 Monate angelegte Verbundprojekt der HTWK Leipzig und des Leibniz-Instituts für Raumbezogene Sozialforschung (IRS) untersucht, wie gesellschaftliche Aneignung, digitale Technologien und Erinnerungsprozesse zusammenwirken, wenn gebaute Umwelt sich verändert oder verschwindet. Kultur-, sozial- und geisteswissenschaftliche Forschung wird dabei mit digitalen Methoden verbunden. Im Zentrum des an der HTWK Leipzig angesiedelten Forschungsprojektes steht die maschinelle Analyse und Rekonstruktion baulicher Veränderungen . Untersucht wird zugleich, wie algorithmische Verfahren selbst zu Akteuren erinnerungskultureller Prozesse werden. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere: Recherche und Erprobung von Verfahren des maschinellen Sehens und Machine Learnings für historische Bildbestände; Aufbau und Aufbereitung geeigneter Datensets für maschinelles Sehen; Entwicklung und Training von Machine-Learning-Modellen; Erprobung von Deep-Learning-basiertem Bild-Matching zur Ergänzung fehlender räumlicher und zeitlicher Metadaten; Mitwirkung an Verfahren zur 3D-Rekonstruktion historischer bzw. verschwundener Bauwerke auf Grundlage historischer Fotografien; Arbeit mit digitalen Bildverarbeitungsverfahren, KI-gestützten Qualitäts- und Georeferenzierungsalgorithmen sowie Structure-from-Motion-Techniken (SfM); Literaturrecherche und wissenschaftliche Einordnung. Sie arbeiten in einem interdisziplinären Verbundprojekt an der Schnittstelle von Digital Humanities, Digital Cultural Heritage, maschinellem Sehen, 3D-Rekonstruktion, Architektur- und Erinnerungskulturforschung sowie Forschungsdatenmanagement . Grundlage der technischen Arbeiten sind u. a. historische Architekturfotografien aus den Wissenschaftlichen Sammlungen zur Bau- und Planungsgeschichte der DDR am IRS sowie weitere historische Fotografien, Karten und Pläne. Das bringen Sie mit einen erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Masterabschluss oder einen vergleichbaren Hochschulabschluss in Medieninformatik, Informatik, Bibliotheks- und Informationswissenschaft, Digital Humanities, Data Science oder einer verwandten Disziplin; Interesse an einer wissenschaftlichen Qualifikation und der Anfertigung einer Dissertation im Themenfeld des Projektes; Kenntnisse bzw. Interesse im Bereich Machine Learning, Computer Vision und digitale Bildverarbeitung; Interesse an der Verarbeitung und Analyse historischer Bilddaten; Interesse an Verfahren der räumlichen Zuordnung und 3D-Rekonstruktion; Bereitschaft zur interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit zwischen digitalen Methoden und kultur- bzw. geisteswissenschaftlicher Forschung; Interesse an nachvollziehbaren, dokumentierten und nachnutzbaren Forschungsworkflows sowie am Forschungsdatenmanagement. Wir bieten Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem interessanten und vielfältigen Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum. Sie erhalten eine umfassende Einarbeitung. Individuelle Entwicklungsgespräche und umfangreiche Weiter- und Fortbildungsangebote. Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Gesundheit liegen uns am Herzen. Hierfür bieten wir insbesondere flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, einen familiengerechten Arbeitsplatz und vielfältige Angebote des Hochschulgesundheitsmanagements sowie des Hochschulsports. Sie erhalten eine Jahressonderzahlung und haben die Möglichkeit, ein ermäßigtes Ticket für den bundesweiten Personennahverkehr (Deutschland-Jobticket) zu beziehen. So bewerben Sie sich Bitte bewerben Sie sich bis zum 10.11.2026 über unser Online-Formular mit Ihren aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. Die HTWK Leipzig begrüßt Bewerbungen von Frauen ausdrücklich. Bei Unterrepräsentanz werden Frauen bei entsprechender Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Bewerbungen schwerbehinderter und diesen gleichgestellten Personen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Im Zusammenhang mit der Bewerbung entstehende Kosten werden nicht erstattet. items.desc: Application Deadline: 8 November 2026 Department: Vehicle Science Location: Silverstone Description Turn data into performance. Start your Formula 1 journey at Aston Martin Aramco Formula 1 Team. Are you passionate about mathematics, data science and understanding how complex systems perform? Join our Vehicle Science team as a Graduate Data Scientist , applying mathematical modelling, statistical analysis and machine learning to help improve the performance of our Formula One car. You'll work with data from simulation, wind tunnel testing and the track, developing practical models and analysis tools that help our engineers understand vehicle behaviour, identify trends and make better-informed decisions. Working alongside experienced specialists, you'll build your technical expertise while contributing to the engineering work that drives car development. Key Responsibilities Develop and improve physics-based, reduced-order and data-driven models to support engineering analysis and vehicle performance decisions. Build and maintain Python analysis tools to turn simulation, wind tunnel and track data into meaningful engineering insight. Undertake modelling tasks from problem definition and data preparation through to development, verification, validation and documentation, with guidance from experienced colleagues. Apply mathematical modelling, statistics and machine-learning techniques to identify trends, improve predictions and accelerate engineering workflows. Help integrate data from multiple sources and contribute to reliable data pipelines, shared modelling tools and datasets. Collaborate with Vehicle Science, Simulation and Modelling, Aerodynamics, Vehicle Performance and other engineering teams to understand problems and develop practical solutions. Communicate findings through clear reports, visualisations and presentations, while maintaining good coding practices, testing, version control and documentation. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise BSc or MSc in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or another relevant quantitative discipline. A sound understanding of mathematical modelling, statistics and data analysis, with an interest in applying these to complex engineering problems. Knowledge of regression, optimisation and machine-learning methods; familiarity with surrogate or reduced-order modelling would be advantageous. Programming experience in Python, ideally using libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy and scikit-learn. Understanding of model validation, uncertainty and error analysis, with the ability to investigate unexpected results and draw evidence-based conclusions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn, with the ability to communicate findings clearly. A collaborative, proactive approach, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver work to demanding timescales. An interest in Formula 1, motorsport, aerospace or other high-performance engineering environments would be advantageous. Make an impact At Aston Martin Aramco, data science is an important part of understanding and improving car performance. You'll have the opportunity to apply your mathematical and programming skills to real engineering problems, helping our engineers extract greater value from simulation, wind tunnel and track data. You'll learn from experienced specialists, develop your modelling and data science capabilities, and see how your work contributes to the decisions that shape a Formula 1 car. If you're curious about how things work, enjoy solving complex problems and want to apply your skills where engineering performance is pushed to its limits, we'd like to hear from you. Benefits Investing in your career is paramount. We promote professional and personal development through a provision of learning opportunities and work with you to shape your career and realise your full potential. As part of our high-performing, collaborative team, you'll enjoy a competitive package, including a discretionary bonus scheme, private healthcare, pension plan, life assurance, TEDSgroup childcare benefits, a cycle-to-work scheme, tech scheme, and car scheme. You will also have access to our state-of-the-art facilities at the AMR Technology Campus, featuring a new on-site gym with fitness, spin and yoga classes, a bistro café, and restaurant. Aston Martin Aramco Formula One® Team is committed to making sure our selection methods are fair for all. If you would like to request that reasonable adjustments are made, please share this in your application when asked.

items.desc: Stellenbeschreibung Du willst mit AI etwas bewegen und dabei neue Wege gehen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich im Team Transport & Logistik. Montagmorgen. Ein Kunde hat eine Idee: „Könnte man das nicht mit AI lösen?" Vielleicht. Aber welche Technologie passt? Welche Daten braucht es? Was funktioniert zuverlässig – und was bleibt besser ein Experiment? Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du probierst Neues aus, bewertest das Potenzial und findest heraus, was wirklich funktioniert. Als AI Engineer verbindest du technisches Know-how mit Neugier und Gestaltungswillen. Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und prägst die Umsetzung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als AI Engineer (m/w/d). Aufgaben Du konzipierst und entwickelst AI- und GenAI-Lösungen – von der Auswahl und Entwicklung geeigneter Modelle bis zum produktiven Einsatz. Du integrierst AI-Lösungen in bestehende IT-Umgebungen und stellst ihre Skalierbarkeit sicher. Du bewertest neue AI-Technologien und überführst geeignete Ansätze in konkrete Anwendungen. Du testest und validierst AI-Anwendungen und stellst ihre Qualität, Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit sicher. Du unterstützt Kunden beim Aufbau geeigneter AI-Infrastrukturen und bei deren strategischer Weiterentwicklung. Qualifikation Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als AI Engineer. Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit relevanten AI-/ML-Technologien und Tools (z. B. Deep Learning, LLMs, AI-Services). Du hast Erfahrung in der End-to-End-Entwicklung von AI-Systemen und kennst deren produktiven Einsatz und Weiterentwicklung aus der Praxis. Du trittst souverän auf, vermittelst komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich und bewegst dich sicher im Kundenumfeld. Du bist neugierig, erkennst das Potenzial neuer AI-Ansätze und verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Was wir dir bieten Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Die richtigen Trainings und Zertifikate bringen deine Weiterbildung voran. Unsere E-Learning-Plattform Academia ermöglicht dir das Lernen, wo und wann du willst. Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet, sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Mit Jobticket und Jobbike fördern wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität. Abhängig von deiner Rolle und Projektsituation sind auch Bahncard oder Elektro-Firmenwagen möglich. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir sind an deiner Seite, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir immer zur Verfügung. Eine Vielzahl an gemeinsamen Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

items.desc: Bristol, Darlington, London, Manchester, Wolverhampton Job Summary We are MHCLG Here at the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (MHCLG), we work on things that make a real difference to people’s lives. Whether it's through the homes we live in, the work of our local councils, or the communities we’re all a part of, our work is at the top of the political agenda. We have ambitious and far-reaching outcomes to achieve this year and, if you’re thinking of joining us, there’s never been a more exciting time. The Geospatial Data Scientist will be part of our Digital Planning Programme at MHCLG. The Digital Planning Programme is transforming England’s planning system through modern, user-centred digital services, shared technology capabilities and better use of data. Through this programme, MHCLG is also supporting the National Infrastructure and Service Transformation Authority (NISTA) on the development of the ALIGN tool: a single digital platform bringing together strategies, data, models and tools, including AI, to identify local infrastructure needs for housing, industrial growth and land use scenarios. Depending on your background and professional aspirations, you will be responsible for delivering various geospatial data models related to digital planning and spatial infrastructure. You will also work closely with colleagues in MHCLG, NISTA, No10, other government departments, regulators, industry and academia. You can find out more information about the ALIGN tool here and also explore our Planning Data platform. Find out more about our Digital teams and what they are working on through our MHCLG Digital blog. Please note that MHCLG do not offer visa sponsorship and applicants will need a valid visa for the duration of your employment. Bij Slimsync bouwen we software die dat oplost, met AI erin die werk uit handen neemt en bedrijfsprocessen automatiseert. Daar zoeken we hulp bij. Wij zijn Thom en Kevin. Thom is registeraccountant en zit met de klanten aan tafel. Kevin bouwt de software. Elk bouwbedrijf krijgt bij ons een eigen omgeving met klanten, projecten, planning en offertes. We willen meer bouwbedrijven helpen dan we nu met z’n tweeën kunnen bouwen. Daarom zoeken we jou. Wat ga je doen? Samen met Kevin bouw je maatwerk apps voor bouwbedrijven, van planning en offertes tot koppelingen met hun boekhouding. Je gebruikt AI zelf elke dag om sneller en beter te bouwen. Je denkt mee over wat een klant echt nodig heeft, niet alleen over hoe je het bouwt. Je ontwikkelt mee aan onze bedrijfsspecifieke software welke wij in de markt zetten. Wie zoeken we? Je bent enthousiast over AI en je bouwt er al mee. Denk aan een app, een agent of een koppeling met een taalmodel. Laat het ons zien. Je kunt programmeren. Je weet hoe je via een API met taalmodellen werkt, en hoe je test of het antwoord klopt. Je pakt dingen zelf op. Loop je vast, dan vraag je het. Je wilt veel leren. Wat je vandaag nog niet kunt, zoek je uit. Mooi meegenomen: je vindt het leuk om bij een aannemer achter de schermen te kijken. Wat bieden we? Een klein team, waar je direct meebouwt aan het product. Veel leren: je werkt naast Kevin, met de nieuwste AI-tools. Een werkplek in De Gruyter Fabriek in Den Bosch. Een passend salaris met volop groeimogelijkheden Full time werkverband Persoonlijke PC Wie zijn wij? Slimsync is een Christelijk bedrijf. Dat merk je aan hoe we werken: eerlijk, betrouwbaar en met oog voor mensen. Solliciteren Stuur je cv en een paar zinnen over waarom je dit wilt. items.desc: Over de vacature AI Engineer | Data & AI | Software Engineering | Consultancy | Hybride Weet jij het verschil tussen Machine Learning en Artificial Intelligence, begrijp je dat schaalbaarheid niet vanzelfsprekend is en krijg je energie van programmeren? Als AI Engineer vorm je de verbinding tussen data scientists en software engineers en ontwikkel je schaalbare AI-oplossingen die daadwerkelijk in productie worden gebracht. In deze functie combineer je kennis van Machine Learning met sterke software engineering vaardigheden. Je ontwikkelt AI- en ML-applicaties en vertaalt innovatieve technologie naar concrete oplossingen die waarde toevoegen aan organisaties. Van traditionele Machine Learning-modellen tot Generative AI en autonome AI-systemen. Organisatie Je komt terecht bij een innovatieve consultancyorganisatie waar kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Je werkt samen met ervaren AI-specialisten en software engineers aan uitdagende projecten bij verschillende opdrachtgevers. De organisatie richt zich op het oplossen van complexe bedrijfsvraagstukken met behulp van Artificial Intelligence. Hierbij worden innovatieve ideeën en concepten vertaald naar schaalbare, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen die daadwerkelijk in de praktijk worden toegepast. Binnen de organisatie is volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Denk aan maandelijkse hackathons, tweewekelijkse kennissessies met diner, een ruim opleidingsbudget en de mogelijkheid om relevante conferenties bij te wonen. Je werkt met moderne AI-technologieën en krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren en nieuwe kennis op te doen. Functie Als AI Engineer combineer je jouw kennis van Machine Learning met software engineering om schaalbare en betrouwbare AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met data scientists, engineers en verschillende stakeholders om complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar praktische toepassingen. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces, van het analyseren van een vraagstuk tot het bouwen, testen en implementeren van AI-applicaties. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat oplossingen niet alleen technisch goed functioneren, maar ook onderhoudbaar, uitbreidbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn. items.desc: Description We are looking for a Data Scientist / Data Engineer to support the client’s ADAS organization. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and applied data science, working with large-scale sensor and vehicle data used to develop, validate, and improve ADAS functions (e.g., collision avoidance, lane keeping, adaptive cruise control, sensor fusion). The ideal candidate combines strong technical data skills with the interpersonal drive needed to work across multiple engineering teams and extract the right requirements and context. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in data engineering or data science roles, ideally within automotive or another safety-relevant industry. Demonstrated experience working with ADAS-related data (sensor data, perception outputs, vehicle logs) or strong interest and transferable experience from adjacent domains (robotics, autonomous systems). Strong proficiency in Python and standard data engineering toolchains; hands-on experience with Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Pandas, SQL-based data warehouses). Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) is a plus. Understanding of automotive data standards (CAN, DBC files, AUTOSAR data concepts) is a strong plus. Personal Attributes (Critical for This Role) High drive and initiative — comfortable proactively reaching out across departments (ADAS function teams, test/validation, software, systems engineering) to gather context and clarify ambiguous requirements. Strong communication skills; able to translate between technical data language and functional/engineering language. Curious, self-directed problem-solver who takes ownership of data quality and pipeline reliability end-to-end. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with evolving priorities. Job responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and structuring large volumes of ADAS sensor and test data (camera, radar, lidar, CAN bus logs). Apply data science methods to analyze vehicle and sensor datasets, supporting feature development, algorithm validation, and performance benchmarking of ADAS functions. Collaborate with ADAS function owners, test engineers, and software teams to translate development and validation needs into data requirements. Develop and maintain reusable Python-based tools and scripts for data extraction, transformation, and analysis, version-controlled via GitHub. Support root-cause analysis of ADAS performance issues using data-driven investigation. Contribute to data quality frameworks, labeling standards, and metadata management specific to ADAS datasets. Present findings and data insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. items.desc: Home Human Resources Jobs Postgraduate Research Associate (6337) Postgraduate Research Associate (6337) Postgraduate Research Associate Faculty/Department Department of Life Sciences Salary Scale £33,001.64 - £38,784.49 per annum (pro rata) Contract Type Fixed Term Duration 01/11/2026 - 31/03/2027 Full-time / Part-time Part-Time Weekly Hours 18.25 Employment Visa Non-sponsorable Posted Date 22/10/2026 Closing Date 01/11/2026 Ref No 6337 Documents DLS.26.6337 Disgrifiad Swydd (Word, 1075.64kb) DLS.26.6337 Job Description (Word, 1077.37kb) Job Description The Role What you’ll do Who You Are – Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge And Skills Required How to apply Benefits Employment Visa The Role We are seeking to appoint a highly motivated and enthusiastic Post-Graduate Research Associate on a new project ‘Expansion of cultivated meat research at Aberystwyth University: encompassing texture and accelerating research for economic benefit in Wales’ funded by the Welsh Government. The project seeks to explore the expansion of current cultivated meat research at Aberystwyth through the use of edible scaffolds, 3D bioprinting and AI-Machine Learning (AI-ML) driven methods to create high-throughput research pipelines. To make an informal enquiry, please contact Dr Ruth Wonfor at rec21@aber.ac.uk. Appointments are normally made within 4 - 8 weeks of the closing date. What you’ll do This job description is subject to review and amendment in the light of the changing needs of the University, to provide appropriate development opportunities and/or the addition of any other reasonable duties. The role will largely be desk based to complete a review of the current literature and industry needs to identify gaps in current knowledge, leading to the production of an Innovation plan and target areas for follow on funding or commercialisation. The role will also have some lab work in our cell culture lab to produce proof of concept data of the growth of primary bovine satellite cells on 3D bioprinted scaffolds. The PGRA post will be based in the Department of Life Sciences in Dr Ruth Wonfor’s research group, but will also require collaboration with Prof Tossapon Boongoen in the Department of Computer Science. The project includes collaboration with a Welsh based biotech company, Copner Biotech, who the post-holder will be expected to develop a good working relationship with. There will also be opportunities to connect with other companies in the cultivated meat space to network with experts in the field whilst gaining an overview of current industry needs. The project will be completed over 5 months and is expected to have a full time PGRA post. However, due to the nature of the project encompassing two diverse fields around cell culture/scaffolds and AI-ML, we are open to appointing two individuals on a part time basis to ensure delivery of the diverse aims. Main Duties And Responsibilities: Complete a literature review of the academic and wider industry literature around edible scaffolds and 3D bioprinting and AI-ML for cultivated meat Support development of a professional network with industry collaborators and academic experts to foster future collaborations. Partake in site visits to external companies or academic institutes to assess technologies used and discuss data requirements. Undertake cell culture studies to assess attachment and proliferation of primary bovine satellite cells on selected edible scaffolds produced by an external company. Undertake ordering of lab consumables and supplies, whilst monitoring budget spend Other Duties And Responsibilities: Undertake other duties as assigned by your line manager, commensurate with the role's grade. Engage in university-level projects and initiatives as directed, and undertake any additional duties commensurate with the role, as assigned by the line manager. Demonstrate flexibility by supporting colleagues during periods of high demand, including attendance at key university events such as open days and graduation ceremonies which may include weekend work. Promote equality of opportunity, and to support and uphold the University's commitment to diversity and inclusion in all aspects of your work. items.desc: Job Description A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role Forward Deployed AI Engineers work directly with customers owning Gen AI strategy and implementation. On a daily basis, you will build end-to-end workflows, take them to production, and solve real world problems at the largest scale. You will have ample opportunity to contribute learnings from the field back to the Palantir AIP product suite. You will be on the forefront of extending Palantir's existing footprint and strategy into new markets and problem spaces opened up by Gen AI. Core Responsibilities Forward Deployed AI Engineers’ responsibilities look similar to those of a hands-on AI startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams to own delivery of high stakes projects with clients. A day’s work may include building LLM workflows on a large scale, interacting with customers to understand their needs and set their AI strategy, but the most impact will be driven by implementing solutions into the real world of our partner's organisations. Do you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an Applied AI leader? We believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how! What We Value Engineering mindset, focused on delivering production solutions with Gen AI, data processing pipelines, and advanced analytics tools. Solving real business problems, not academic benchmarks. Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals. Comfort working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and direct iteration with users. What We Require Past experience building solutions with LLMs and a deep understanding of overall Gen AI landscape. Strong foundation in Machine Learning basics (Evaluation, Training, Problem Decomposition). Strong engineering background. Preferred fields include but are not limited to Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Machine Learning. Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar. Ability and interest in travelling up to 25%, as needed to client sites, but flexible based on personal preferences. Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help. Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

items.desc: Data & ML Engineer – Helsinki We’re looking for a Data & ML Engineer to join a growing team developing data-driven products within the real estate sector. Requirements Around 3–4 years of relevant professional experience. Strong Python and SQL skills. Experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. Hands-on experience with AWS data services, such as S3, Redshift and Athena. Professional fluency in Finnish. Experience working in a product company or developing data-driven products. Data Engineering: Python, SQL, Airflow Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, S3, Redshift, Athena, DynamoDB, Lambda, Terraform, AWS CDK Machine Learning & AI: SageMaker, Azure ML, AWS Bedrock, Gemini, Google ADK Development & Deployment: Docker, GitHub Actions, FastAPI, Flask Additional Platforms: Azure App Services, BigQuery What Makes This Opportunity Interesting? Work on data products used by professionals across the real estate and financial sectors. Combine data engineering, machine learning and AI within one role. Contribute to production ML models and new LLM-powered product features. Take ownership across the full lifecycle, from data ingestion to deployment. items.desc: Als AI Inference Engineer baust du die technische Grundlage für produktive AI-Systeme in regulierten Umgebungen. Du entwickelst und betreibst LLM-Inferenzplattformen, die on-premises oder in privaten Cloud-Umgebungen laufen – sicher, skalierbar, beobachtbar und wirtschaftlich. Du sorgst dafür, dass moderne Modelle nicht nur in einer Demo überzeugen, sondern unter realen Produktionsbedingungen zuverlässig funktionieren: mit sauberer GPU-Planung, niedriger Latenz, kontrollierten Kosten, belastbarem Monitoring und klar definierten Betriebsmodellen. Was erwartet dich Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreibst produktive LLM-Inferenzplattformen für Kunden mit hohen Anforderungen an Datensouveränität, Sicherheit und Betriebskontrolle – on-premises, in privaten Cloud-Umgebungen oder souveränen europäischen Cloud-Setups. Gemeinsam mit Cloud-, Plattform-, Security- und Data-Engineering-Teams sowie unseren Kunden überführst du AI-Use-Cases in den produktiven Betrieb. Dabei integrierst du moderne Inferenz-Engines und Open-Weights-Modelle in Kubernetes-, Container- und Plattformumgebungen. Außerdem planst und optimierst du GPU- und Speicherressourcen sowie Inferenz-Workloads: Von Modellgrößen, Quantisierung und Batching bis hin zu KV-Cache-Strategien, Latenz, Durchsatz und Kosten. Du verantwortest die Runtime produktiver AI-Systeme, inklusive Modellserving, APIs, Authentifizierung, Secrets, Observability, Logging Aus Kundenprojekten entwickelst du wiederverwendbare Referenzarchitekturen, Deployment-Templates und Betriebs-Playbooks und stärkst so unsere Applied-AI-Capability. Was erwarten wir von dir Persönlicher Background: Erfahrung in Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, MLOps, LLMOps, DevOps, Backend Engineering oder Machine Learning Engineering. Entscheidend ist deine Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver Systeme und dein Antrieb zu schneller persönlicher Weiterentwicklung Inference Engineering: Du verstehst die technischen und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge moderner LLM-Inferenz, von Model-Serving und GPU-Auslastung über Quantisierung, Batching und KV-Cache-Management bis hin zu Latenz, Durchsatz und Kosten. Cloud & Plattformen: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, Linux sowie Observability gehören für dich zum Arbeitsalltag. AI-Verständnis: Du kannst Transformer-basierte Modelle wie LLMs und Embeddings einordnen und fundierte technische Entscheidungen für produktive AI-Systeme treffen. Security & Governance: Themen wie Identitäten, Berechtigungen, Secrets, Logging, Auditierung und Compliance denkst du, insbesondere in regulierten Umgebungen, von Anfang an mit. Kommunikation & Arbeitsweise: Du vermittelst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich, arbeitest pragmatisch und bewegst dich auch in dynamischen Projektumfeldern sicher. Pluspunkt: Erfahrung mit vLLM, SGLang oder vergleichbaren Inference-Technologien, GPU-Clustern, souveränen Cloud- oder Private-Cloud-Umgebungen. Our client is an ambitious, PE backed business based in Windsor, at the beginning of their journey to become a data enabled company with the adoption of advanced analytics, AI and ML operations. We're looking for a hands-on, numerically strong data professional to join a growing business and help transform its data capabilities. This is an opportunity to work across data science, engineering, AI and visualisation, with plenty of scope to develop your skills and make a tangible impact. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to get hands-on, take ownership and see their work make a genuine difference to business performance. items.desc: Inom IT och Tech är kvinnor fortfarande kraftigt underrepresenterade, och allra tydligast syns det inom de områden som formar framtiden mest just nu: AI, data och cybersäkerhet. Det är här besluten tas om hur tekniken byggs, vem den fungerar för och vem den skyddar. Då kan vi inte ha team där halva befolkningen saknas. Nu vill vi förändra det, tillsammans med dig. Vad handlar det om? Vi söker seniora kvinnor, och allierade som delar vår övertygelse, som vill vara med och driva förändring i branschen. Samtidigt som du tar makten över din egen utveckling. Kanske har du länge funderat på att starta eget men inte vetat var du ska börja. Kanske vill du välja dina uppdrag själv, sätta din egen riktning och slippa vara den enda i rummet som får kämpa för sin plats. Här får du stöd i hela processen: från att starta bolaget, till ekonomi och administration, till att hitta rätt uppdrag hos kunder som är redo för dig. Du driver ditt eget. Du står aldrig ensam. Inom vilka områden? AI Engineer: Du bygger lösningar inom maskininlärning och generativ AI och tar dem hela vägen till produktion. Du vet att en modell som fungerar i en notebook är början på jobbet, inte slutet. Data Engineer: Du designar och bygger dataplattformar och flöden som andra kan lita på. Du är den som ser till att data faktiskt håller när beslut fattas på den. Cybersecurity: Du arbetar med säkerhet i moln, nätverk eller applikationer, kanske med NIS2, incidenthantering eller säkerhetsarkitektur. Du tänker som en angripare och bygger som en försvarare. Vi söker talanger i både Stockholm & Umeå, där hybrid tjänst är möjligt för vissa uppdrag. Vem är du? Du har flera års erfarenhet inom något av områdena ovan och vet vad det innebär när saker måste fungera i produktion. Du är trygg i din kompetens och vill använda den till något större än nästa leverans. Du behöver inte ha drivit eget tidigare. Det viktiga är att du vill, och att du delar vår tro på att branschen blir bättre när fler perspektiv får plats. Varför nu? För att efterfrågan på just din kompetens aldrig har varit större. För att du förtjänar att forma din karriär på dina villkor. För att förändring inte händer av sig själv, den händer när vi går före. Ansökan Vi har löpande samtal, så vänta inte. Har du frågor eller vill veta mer är du välkommen att höra av dig till Hanna på hej@codella.se. Ett första samtal är alltid förutsättningslöst.

We are looking for a strong software engineer who already uses AI to build better software and
items.desc: AI Engineer Engage Solutions Group About the role Engage builds software that helps people across an organisation find information, communicate and get things done. Our customers include businesses with large, distributed and frontline teams. We are now expanding what that software can do through AI, building on a live platform and real customer problems. We are looking for a strong software engineer who already uses AI to build better software and has delivered AI features that people use. You will work across the product, from application code and integrations to AI assistants and automated workflows. You will own the engineering needed to turn a promising idea into something dependable. This is a hands-on role with room to shape how we build. You will work closely with product and engineering, make practical technical decisions and help the team improve its use of AI. Your remit covers practical software delivery and production AI within the Engage product. You will collaborate on architecture and reusable capabilities, while keeping ownership of working code and its behaviour after release. Research and experimentation should lead to a useful product outcome. What you'll be doing Deliver product features across APIs, services, data and user-facing workflows, using sound software engineering alongside AI. Build AI features that use the right context, tools and permissions to solve a clear user problem. Choose a simpler software approach when that is the better fit. Take work from discovery and a working prototype through testing, deployment, monitoring and improvement. Use coding agents and other AI tools throughout development, with clear tasks, useful context, code review and independent verification. Build reusable approaches to prompts, retrieval, tool use and structured outputs where they improve the product. Share what works with the team and explain where AI-generated code or model behaviour needs closer scrutiny. Create tests and evaluation examples that expose failures, including misleading answers, incorrect tool calls and permission errors. Monitor quality, latency and cost as usage grows. Diagnose failures and put appropriate limits, retries, fallbacks and human review in place. Protect customer data and tenant boundaries, and make important behaviour traceable and supportable. What we're looking for Strong experience delivering and maintaining production software, with ownership beyond the initial release. Evidence of an AI feature or workflow you personally built, including the choices you made and what changed after real users tried it. Confidence writing and reviewing production code, including Python for AI work, and working with APIs, data stores and cloud services. Regular, thoughtful use of AI development tools. You can explain how you check their work and recognise when they are wrong. Practical understanding of testing, debugging, access control and the reliability challenges of systems that depend on model outputs. Good judgement about scope and trade-offs, and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to product and engineering colleagues. Useful experience Experience with SaaS products, enterprise integrations or software used by distributed teams. Experience with retrieval, model evaluation, agent tool use or managing model cost and performance in production. A record of improving engineering practices or helping other developers adopt useful tools. Why Engage You will build on a product with established customers, with direct access to the people defining its next stage. There is scope to influence both the features we create and the way engineering works, and to see the effect of your decisions in real customer use. What success looks like First three months: Understand the product and customer context, ship a useful improvement and demonstrate an AI development workflow the team can trust. Establish clear tests and monitoring for the work you own. By six months: Own meaningful product capability in production, show how you have improved its quality or efficiency, and turn lessons from delivery into approaches other engineers can use. Over the first year: Become a trusted technical owner as the platform grows, taking on broader responsibility through the quality of your delivery, judgement and contribution to the team. Package Genuinely competitive compensation package (full details to be disclosed during interviews) Unlimited annual leave policy Flexi-hybrid working (2 days in our stunning office, with roof terrace, in central Manchester) Other perks: Private Healthcare, Pension Scheme, Gym, cycle store and on-site shower facilities, Cycle to Work scheme, Death in Service, Quarterly release parties and fantastic summer and Christmas social events

items.desc: Data Scientist, Permanent, London Join Pay.UK as a Data Scientist and work with data connected to services that millions of people and businesses across the UK rely on every day. This is a role for someone who wants to apply solid data science practice in a clear, meaningful setting, with the chance to help shape how we use data and AI across a trusted payments environment. We are looking for a specialist who enjoys turning complex data into clear insight, practical models and well-structured analysis. You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation, using evidence to support decisions, improve understanding and help us develop our data capability in a way that is thoughtful, transparent and useful. Accountabilities Analyse large and complex datasets to identify patterns, trends and risks relevant to Pay.UK’s services and operations. Build, test and refine statistical and machine learning models that support better forecasting, monitoring and decision-making. Prepare clear visualisations, reports and presentations that explain methods, findings and limitations in a straightforward way. Work with colleagues across business and technical teams to define data questions, shape analytical approaches and agree practical outputs. Translate business problems into structured analytical tasks, including data preparation, feature selection and model evaluation. Improve data quality and analytical processes by documenting methods, validating outputs and supporting good data practice. Use SQL and programming tools to extract, clean and transform data from multiple sources for analysis and modelling. Support the development of Pay.UK’s wider data and AI capability by contributing to repeatable methods, standards and shared learning. Qualifications, Skills and Experience Professional experience in a Data Scientist role, with responsibility for delivering analysis and predictive or statistical models. Solid applied experience using Python and SQL to extract, prepare, analyze, and model data. Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning, with the ability to choose and evaluate suitable methods for real business questions. Experience presenting technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences through reports, visualisations or presentations. Experience working with large, complex datasets and applying clear quality checks, documentation and validation methods. Pay.UK Behaviours At Pay.UK, our behaviours are central to who we are and how we operate. They bring our values to life, shape our culture, and guide how we make decisions, collaborate, and respond to challenges across the payments ecosystem. All interview processes will assess the following behaviours: Listen to Find Win-Wins - Empathy, Listening and Understanding Influence with Courage - Influence, Courage Go Horizontal First - Cross Boundary Collaboration Take Ownership - Self Development Opportunity Mindset - Initiative Simplify - Achievement Orientation Inclusivity At Pay.UK, we value diversity and inclusivity. Research has shown that candidates from underrepresented groups may hesitate to apply unless they meet all the requirements listed. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of how closely their skills and experience match the requirements. We are committed to supporting accessibility needs and creating a welcoming environment for all employees. Become part of our team and contribute to the creation of an inclusive work environment that values everyone's unique input. Who we are Pay.UK is the recognised operator and standards body for the UK's interbank retail payment systems. We provide the infrastructure and services that millions of people and businesses rely on every day, including Bacs, Faster Payments and the Image Clearing System for cheques, the Current Account Switch Service and Confirmation of Payee. Together, these services help keep money moving safely, securely and reliably across the UK and play an important role in supporting the economy. In 2025, the UK's retail payment systems processed more than 12.5 billion transactions worth over £11 trillion. Since its launch in 2013, the Current Account Switch Service has successfully helped consumers and businesses switch more than 12 million current accounts. These services help people receive their salaries, pay their bills, make payments and manage their finances with confidence. Our purpose is to provide the trusted infrastructure, standards and services that underpin UK retail payments. We deliver safe, resilient and efficient payment systems while working collaboratively with industry, regulators and stakeholders to strengthen resilience, tackle fraud, improve access and support innovation across the payments landscape. As the ecosystem evolves, we are continuing to develop our capabilities in areas such as data and AI, enhancing operational insight and helping to build a modern, trusted payments ecosystem. items.desc: AI Product Builder (AI Engineer) – Rotterdam Als AI Product Builder (AI engineer) bij Baan Executives, detacheringsbureau aan de Weena in Rotterdam, bouw je de apps, automatiseringen en AI-agents waarmee we uitgroeien tot dé kennispartner voor arbeidsvraagstukken. Het is een nieuwe rol: jij bepaalt de invulling en bouwt in dagen en weken, niet in maanden. Over de rol Ons doel is helder: Baan uitbouwen tot dé kennispartner voor arbeidsvraagstukken in onze markten. Voor onze opdrachtgevers én voor onze professionals. Dat doel halen we niet door harder te werken. Dat doen we al. We halen het door slimmer te werken. Alles wat een machine beter kan, laten we een machine doen. Zo houden wij tijd over voor waar het écht om draait en waar wij goed in zijn: mensen en advies. Begin dit jaar zijn we volledig in-house gaan verlonen. Nieuwe BV, eigen contracten, eigen systemen. Dat leverde een flinke groei op, en een waslijst aan processen die slimmer kunnen en efficiënter moeten. En nog veel meer ideeën waar we alleen maar van kunnen dromen. Daar kom jij. Jij bouwt de apps, automatiseringen en dashboards die ons sneller, slimmer en scherper maken. Niet in een traject van een half jaar, maar in dagen en weken. Bouwen, testen, live, verbeteren. En staan ze? Dan heb jij al een idee waar we nog verder kunnen automatiseren. Of, hoe we onze klant een stap sneller kunnen helpen. Jouw sollicitatie? Je gebouwde apps. Dit ga je doen Je automatiseert ons recruitmentproces: slimmer searchen, kandidaten voorstellen en matchen op opdrachten; Je bouwt een AI-assistent die vragen van opdrachtgevers en professionals over contracten, cao’s, verlof en loonstroken snel en correct beantwoordt; Je automatiseert onze verloning, van urenverwerking tot controles in Nmbrs en Loket; Je bouwt dashboards met realtime inzicht in onze cijfers en KPI’s, en koppelt onze systemen via API’s: Salesforce (Tigris), RecruitCRM, Nmbrs, Loket en Microsoft 365; Je bepaalt samen met de directie wat de meeste impact heeft, praat met de gebruikers van je tools (consultants, onze HR Officer, opdrachtgevers en professionals) en meet hoeveel tijd en fouten je tools besparen; Je bouwt veilig en verantwoord: privacy (AVG) en de AI Act zitten in je ontwerp, niet in een bijlage achteraf. Dit is geen IT-afdeling met tickets. Jij bent de afdeling. Je krijgt ruimte, vertrouwen en een directe lijn. Werkt iets niet, dan hoor je dat ook direct. Dat vind je juist prettig. Hier ga je werken Baan Executives. Een jong bedrijf met enorm veel passie voor mensen en groei. We detacheren senior professionals in Project Management en Engineering in Bouw, Infra, Maritiem en Energie, bij opdrachtgevers als Heerema, Heijmans, Ballast Nedam, Strukton, Schiphol en Stedin. Denk aan een Cost Estimator voor een gigantisch windpark, een Omgevingsmanager voor een kritisch project in de infrastructuur, of een Electrical Engineer voor een megajacht. Ervaren, mondige professionals met salarissen tussen de 50K en 110K per jaar, met vragen die jouw tools straks sneller en beter beantwoorden. Je komt in een jong, energiek en klein team met veel ambitie. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Chilian, eigenaar van Baan Executives, en werkt nauw samen met onze consultants en HR Officer. Ons kantoor zit in FIRST aan de Weena, midden in Rotterdam. En er komt meer. Onze rebranding lanceert bijvoorbeeld binnenkort. We gaan nieuwe labels opzetten. We gaan onze markten uitbreiden. En, jij bent er vanaf het begin bij. Dit neem je mee Een bouwer met een ondernemershart. Je ziet een handmatig proces en je handen jeuken al. Je diploma interesseert ons minder dan wat je gebouwd hebt. Je hebt: Aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van apps en automatiseringen die in de praktijk gebruikt worden; Ervaring met LLM’s en AI-agents: je weet wanneer AI de oplossing is en wanneer een simpel script volstaat; Ervaring met data en koppelingen: API’s (must), databases, Python, SQL of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring met Salesforce, RecruitCRM en LinkedIn is een pré; Een productmindset en ondernemershart: eerst het probleem, dan de oplossing. En je legt een consultant en een salarisadministrateur in hun eigen taal uit wat je bouwt; Snelheid, pragmatisme, zelfstandigheid en een dikke huid: feedback is direct en prioriteiten verschuiven soms snel. Dit krijg je Ga er even voor zitten. Een salaris tussen € 3.500 en € 6.000 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je ervaring; 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto. Ja, ook in deze rol! Een SARs-regeling: je deelt mee in de waardegroei van het bedrijf dat je zelf mee opbouwt; Pensioenopbouw; 25 vakantiedagen; Een opleidingsbudget, onder andere voor AI-opleidingen, cursussen en bijeenkomsten; Laptop, sportabonnement en alles wat je nodig hebt om goed te werken. Roep maar; Een werkplek in kantoortoren FIRST in hartje Rotterdam, met een 360 graden uitzicht vanaf een meter of 90 hoog richting Den Haag, Amsterdam, De Kuip, Delft - we zijn nog steeds aan het kijken wat we allemaal zien; Korte …

items.desc: Start jouw carrière in Data & AI met een vast contract én een uitgebreid ontwikkelprogramma Ben jij (bijna) afgestudeerd en klaar om jouw carrière in data te starten? Wil je niet alleen theorie leren, maar direct werken aan uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties? Dan is het Data & AI Traineeship van Veneficus de ideale start van jouw carrière. Vanaf je eerste werkdag krijg je een vast contract, een intensief opleidingsprogramma en persoonlijke begeleiding. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf niet alleen tot een sterke data professional, maar ontdek je ook welke richting binnen data het beste bij jou past. Jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal Je start samen met een kleine groep trainees in een intensieve opleidingsperiode van vier weken. In deze periode leg je een stevige basis in onder anderen: Python SQL Power BI AI Machine Learning Daarnaast werk je aan vaardigheden die onmisbaar zijn binnen het werkveld, zoals communiceren, samenwerken, presenteren en stakeholdermanagement. Tijdens een praktijkopdracht pas je jouw kennis direct toe op echte data-uitdagingen en ervaar je vanaf het begin hoe het is om impact te maken met data. Kies jouw richting: Analytics of Engineering Tijdens het traineeship ontdekken we samen waar jouw talenten en interesses liggen. Analytics Kies je voor Analytics , dan ligt de nadruk op de businesskant van data. Je leert hoe je requirements ophaalt bij stakeholders, de vraag achter de vraag herkent en data vertaalt naar waardevolle inzichten. Je werkt aan dashboards, datavisualisaties en businessanalyses met tools zoals Power BI en SQL . Zo help je organisaties beter onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen en word jij de verbindende schakel tussen data en business. Engineering Kies je voor Engineering , dan ligt de focus op de technische kant van data. Je leert hoe je schaalbare en betrouwbare datapipelines ontwikkelt, werkt met Python en cloudomgevingen en bouwt dataoplossingen die klaar zijn voor de toekomst. Daarnaast verdiep je je in Machine Learning en AI : hoe ontwikkel je modellen en hoe zet je deze succesvol in binnen de praktijk? Zo leg je een sterke basis voor een carrière als data engineer of AI-specialist. Mogelijke functies Data Analyst Business Intelligence Specialist Data Engineer Data Scientist AI Engineer Machine Learning Specialist Geen snelle plaatsing, maar de juiste match Bij Veneficus geloven we dat een succesvolle carrière begint met de juiste omgeving. Daarom kijken we verder dan alleen je cv. We leren jou echt kennen, brengen jouw ambities in kaart en zoeken een opdracht die aansluit bij jouw talenten en ontwikkeldoelen. Na de opleidingsperiode ga je aan de slag bij één van onze opdrachtgevers, terwijl wij je blijven begeleiden met trainingen, terugkomdagen en persoonlijke coaching. Zo blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen, ook nadat je bent gestart. Wat bieden wij jou?
