items.desc: IT & AI Specialist Zie jij bij ingewikkelde processen vooral kansen om het slimmer te doen? Krijg je energie van technologie, automatisering, AI én zoek je graag uit hoe systemen beter kunnen samenwerken? Dan leren we je graag kennen. Bij Axentis geloven we sterk in de kracht van technologie. Door technologie slim in te zetten, werken we efficiënter én creëren we meer ruimte om onze klanten te begeleiden, adviseren en vooruit te helpen. Van cijfers naar koers. Daarom zoeken we een IT & AI Specialist die mee wil bouwen aan de digitale toekomst van Axentis. Hier mag jij op rekenen Een functie waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om zelf ideeën uit te werken . De kans om mee te bepalen hoe Axentis de komende jaren omgaat met IT, automatisering en AI. Veel autonomie en korte lijnen, zodat goede ideeën snel van concept naar uitvoering kunnen gaan. Tijd en ruimte om te experimenteren, nieuwe technologieën te ontdekken en opleidingen te volgen die jou helpen om jouw kennis verder uit te bouwen. Moderne software en tools om mee te werken. Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen. Een hecht team van Vooruitkijkers dat openstaat voor innovatie en nieuwe ideeën. Een werkplek in Maaseik en/of Hasselt (Corda Campus) . En misschien nog het belangrijkste: een goed idee hoeft bij ons niet eerst maanden op papier te staan. Zie je een kans? Onderzoek ze. Test ze. Bouw iets. En toon ons wat het kan betekenen voor Axentis. Dit doe je Als IT & AI Specialist word je onze digitale bruggenbouwer . Je kijkt naar onze dagelijkse werking, ontdekt waar het slimmer kan en vertaalt ideeën naar oplossingen die onze collega's écht vooruithelpen. Concreet betekent dit: Je onderzoekt hoe we onze verschillende softwarepakketten en tools beter met elkaar kunnen integreren. Je analyseert repetitieve processen en automatiseert waar dat mogelijk is. Je bouwt en test integraties met bijvoorbeeld API's, Power Automate en webhooks . Je experimenteert met AI-toepassingen en AI-agents die onze medewerkers ondersteunen. Je ontwikkelt kleine tools en toepassingen die het dagelijkse werk eenvoudiger maken. Je helpt collega's wanneer technologie even niet doet wat ze belooft. Je volgt nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen op en kijkt kritisch naar wat voor Axentis écht meerwaarde biedt . Je hoeft dit uiteraard niet allemaal vanaf dag één te kunnen. We vinden het minstens even belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent, logisch denkt en graag zelf op zoek gaat naar oplossingen. Dit zijn wij Axentis is een vooruitstrevend accountancykantoor met vestigingen in Maaseik en Hasselt en meer dan 30 jaar ervaring. We combineren die ervaring met een duidelijke blik op de toekomst. Ons doel? Ondernemers vooruithelpen met inzicht en advies. Van compliance naar kansen, van cijfers naar koers. Technologie speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We werken digitaal en zetten technologie, automatisering en AI slim in om onze werking steeds efficiënter te maken. Zo creëren we meer ruimte voor onze Vooruitkijkers om te doen waar zij het verschil maken: persoonlijk contact met klanten, proactief meedenken en gericht advies geven. En dat doen we samen. Ons hechte team bestaat intussen uit 27 Vooruitkijkers die elk vanuit hun eigen expertise bijdragen aan onze ambitie om ondernemers én Axentis vooruit te helpen. Wat ons typeert? Persoonlijk in aanpak, groots in mogelijkheden. Bij Axentis staan mensen centraal. Onze klanten, maar evengoed onze Vooruitkijkers. We kijken naar waar jij goed in bent, waar je energie van krijgt en waarin je verder wilt groeien. Zo krijg je de ruimte om jouw talenten in te zetten, nieuwe ideeën uit te proberen én jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. We geloven in samenwerken en van elkaar leren. Jouw kennis van technologie komt samen met de expertise van onze accountants, fiscalisten en adviseurs. Zo zoeken we samen naar oplossingen die onze werking slimmer maken en onze klanten nog beter vooruithelpen. Want bij Axentis geloven we dat je het verschil maakt door samen te werken, kansen te zien en vooruit te blijven kijken. Dit verwachten we van jou als Vooruitkijker Je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie, AI en automatisering. Je denkt logisch en analytisch en zoekt graag uit hoe systemen werken. Je neemt initiatief wanneer je merkt dat iets slimmer of efficiënter kan. Je hebt ervaring met of interesse in API's, integraties, databases, scripting of automatisering. Je durft zelf iets te bouwen, testen en opnieuw te proberen. Je kan technische zaken op een begrijpelijke manier uitleggen aan collega's die geen IT'er zijn. Je bent leergierig en werkt graag zelfstandig. Een diploma in IT, toegepaste informatica, AI, Data of een gelijkaardige richting is mooi meegenomen, maar geen must. Kennis van accountancy is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste. Wij leren jou graag onze wereld kennen. Net afgestudeerd? Ook dan willen we je graag leren kennen . Heb je tijdens je opleiding of in je vrije tijd geëxperimenteerd met AI, een automatisering gebouwd of een …

items.desc: Wat ga je doen? Als AI Automation Engineer ben je bij Bouwflow degene die uitzoekt wat er met AI mogelijk is en het vervolgens implementeert in het bedrijf. Je bent op de hoogte van de nieuwste technologieën, bedenkt oplossingen, optimaliseert processen en bouwt volledig nieuwe applicaties vanaf de grond. Je werk zit op twee sporen. Oplossen: je hoort van je collega's waar ze mee worstelen en waar ze tijd aan verliezen. Jij bedenkt een oplossing, bouwt ze, en optimaliseert het proces errond. Bouwen wat er nog niet is: we pakken dingen graag AI-first aan, ook helemaal van nul. Jij zet nieuwe stukken van het bedrijf op met agents in plaats van handwerk. Het blijft niet bij één afdeling. Je bouwt agents van marketing over support tot development. Je zet het zelf live en je neemt er ownership op. Wie ben jij? Je volgt AI op de voet en haalt energie uit wat je ermee kan oplossen. Een proces dat vandaag nog handwerk is en binnen twee weken vanzelf draait: daar doe je het voor. Wat je in huis hebt: Een jaar of drie ervaring als developer Programmeren, in eender welke taal waar je goed in bent Werken met LLM's, agents en API's Git Een must: Diepgaande kennis van AI (skills, commands, modellen, automations, MCP ...) Laravel (PHP) Mooi meegenomen, maar geen must: Next.js (TypeScript) Python Kennis van of voeling met de bouwsector Talen: Nederlands (onze voertaal) Engels Verder: Je bouwt met AI, maar je levert wel hoge kwaliteit oplossingen en neemt er ownership op. Je bent creatief in het oplossen van problemen. Je ziet snel hoe iets anders en beter kan. Je gaat zelf op onderzoek en wacht niet tot iemand je een opdracht geeft. Je werkt graag in een startup-omgeving met korte lijnen en veel autonomie. Wat krijg je ervan? Je werkt elke dag dicht bij de founders. Korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen. Een bedrijf dat AI al gebruikt en er verder in wil. Je moet niemand overtuigen, je krijgt de ruimte om te bouwen. De vrijheid om met de nieuwste technologie te werken en ze meteen in productie te brengen. Een MacBook Pro en een iPhone. Claude Max, en budget voor de tools die je nodig hebt. Je werkt samen met het team vanop ons kantoor in Gent, Vlasgaardstraat 52. Thuiswerk is mogelijk Doordat we een startup zijn, liggen er kansen om door te groeien. Een aantrekkelijk loon- en voordelenpakket, met onder meer: Bedrijfswagen + tankkaart Maaltijdcheques Ecocheques Hospitalisatieverzekering Loon: €2.400,00 - €4.000,00 per maand Voordelen: Bedrijfscomputer Bedrijfswagen Ecocheques Een gsm voor professioneel gebruik Elektronische maaltijdcheques Hospitalisatieverzekering Tankkaart Thuiswerkopties Screeningsvragen: Het indienen van een motivatiebrief is verplicht bij je sollicitatie. Werklocatie: Fysiek

items.desc: The Department of Clinical Medicine at the Faculty of Health, Aarhus University, invites applications for a position as AI Developer for validation and clinical implementation of AI systems, commencing on 1 January 2027, preferably before then, if possible. The position is a fixed-term full-time appointment until 31 December 2028 which aligns with the end date of the project related to the grant agreement. AURA is the radiology research unit at Aarhus University Hospital and is affiliated with the Department of Clinical Medicine at Aarhus University. We conduct research across a broad range of radiological topics and work closely with clinical departments on projects spanning classical statistical methods, artificial intelligence, language models, and advanced image analysis. In recent years, we have expanded our activities within AI and are therefore seeking additional expertise for both existing and new projects. As an AI Developer in AURA, you will play a central role in validating, implementing, and further developing AI solutions for use in healthcare. You will become part of an ambitious research environment with close collaboration between researchers, clinicians, and technical specialists, and you will have the opportunity to influence both projects and your own role. As an AI Developer at the Department of Clinical Medicine, you will become part of what is likely the largest health sciences research institute in Denmark. Clinical research covers all medical specialties and is carried out in close collaboration with the university hospital and regional hospitals in the Central Denmark Region. We have approximately 30,000 square metres of modern research facilities for experimental surgery and medicine, animal facilities, and advanced scanners. The department has overall responsibility for the Master’s degree programmes in Medicine and Molecular Medicine. The department comprises approximately 670 academic staff members, 500 PhD students, and 160 technical and administrative staff, all working collaboratively across disciplines. As an AI Developer, you will be based at Aarhus University Hospital in the Central Denmark Region. Your Job Responsibilities As an AI Developer, your primary responsibilities will be to develop, validate, and implement AI solutions for clinical use, while supporting the research group's activities within data analysis, software development, and advanced image analysis. You will contribute to research and development activities through technical development, project work, and interdisciplinary collaboration. In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with researchers, clinicians, students, and external partners. Your tasks will primarily include: Validation and implementation of AI systems for clinical use. Development, testing, and evaluation of new AI solutions. Software development and data analysis related to research and development projects. Establishment and maintenance of technical workflows and development environments. Responsibility for your own technical sub-projects and development processes. Providing technical and methodological support and advice to researchers and clinicians. Co-supervision and academic support of Master's and PhD students. Collaboration with external partners, including companies and healthcare stakeholders. Contributing to the establishment of new research and development projects within AI and radiology. The position offers a high degree of independence, and we would like you to help shape the content of the role so that it matches your competencies, interests, and career goals. You will report to Clinical Professor, Department Chair of Radiology, Ole Graumann. Your Qualifications You hold a Master's degree in a relevant field, such as computer science, software development, physics, engineering, or a related discipline. We expect that you: Have strong competencies in programming and software development. Are familiar with Linux and command-line based work. Have experience with AI development or similar technical development work. Are able to work independently and drive technical projects and sub-projects. Enjoy collaborating with and supporting researchers and students in their projects. It is an advantage if you have experience with: Research projects or research collaborations. Healthcare data, medical image analysis, or clinical AI systems. Supervision, teaching, or academic mentoring. Your educational background is less important than your technical competencies, experience, and ability to translate technical solutions into practical applications within a clinical environment. As a person, you possess strong collaborative skills, demonstrate initiative, and are able to drive progress in complex projects. You thrive in an interdisciplinary environment and contribute positively to a good working environment. We expect you to speak and write English fluently. items.desc: Informations générales Durée : 4 à 6 mois Rythme : Temps plein Localisation : Paris 2e Télétravail : 1 à 2 jours maximum par semaine Contexte et objectifsDans le cadre de l'amélioration de la productivité de sa DSI, notre client recherche un consultant senior spécialisé dans l'IA appliquée au cycle de développement et d'exploitation informatique. L'objectif est d'identifier, de déployer et d'industrialiser des outils et agents IA adaptés aux différentes équipes : Product Owners, Développeurs, Data Engineers, Infrastructure et équipes techniques transverses. La mission comporte une forte dimension stratégique et opérationnelle : diagnostic de maturité, benchmark des solutions, définition d'une feuille de route, déploiement des outils, développement d'agents IA et accompagnement des équipes. Principales responsabilités1. Benchmark et définition de la stratégie d'outillage IA Analyser les besoins des différentes populations (PO, Dev, Data Engineering, Infra/DT). Évaluer les solutions du marché : GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Copilot Workspace, etc. Comparer les solutions selon leur intégration, leur sécurité, leur coût, leur qualité et leur facilité d'adoption. Recommander les outils et agents les plus adaptés, avec possibilité de combiner plusieurs solutions. Réaliser les POC nécessaires et définir une feuille de route de déploiement priorisée. 2. Déploiement et intégration Déployer les solutions IA retenues dans l'environnement DSI. Assurer leur intégration avec Azure DevOps, les dépôts de code et les pipelines CI/CD. Définir les règles de sécurité, de confidentialité du code et de conformité. Mettre en place le suivi des licences, des usages et des coûts. 3. Développement et industrialisation d'agents IA Concevoir des agents permettant d'automatiser différentes étapes du cycle de développement : Product Owners : amélioration des User Stories, génération de critères d'acceptation, détection des ambiguïtés et aide à la priorisation. Développeurs : préparation et pré-revue des Pull Requests, génération de tests, refactoring et contrôle des standards de code. Data Engineering : génération et optimisation SQL, documentation des pipelines, contrôles qualité des données et mapping multi-sources. Infrastructure / Production : analyse des incidents, identification des causes racines, proposition de correctifs et réduction des délais de résolution. Industrialiser ces agents avec des mécanismes de versionnement, de tests, de supervision, d'évaluation continue et de gouvernance (traçabilité, auditabilité, validation humaine et niveaux d'autonomie). 4. Accompagnement et conduite du changement Former les équipes aux outils IA et aux bonnes pratiques. Définir les standards d'utilisation selon les populations. Accompagner l'adoption et la montée en compétence. Mesurer les gains de productivité et de qualité à travers des indicateurs concrets : qualité du backlog, anomalies, revues de code, résolution des incidents et satisfaction des équipes. 5. Documentation et transfert de compétences Documenter les architectures, agents et standards. Produire les guides d'installation et d'utilisation. Organiser le transfert de compétences vers les équipes internes. Mettre en place un cadre de gouvernance pérenne. Profil candidat: Consultant / Ingénieur senior disposant d'une expérience significative en IA appliquée au développement logiciel et à l'amélioration de la productivité des équipes techniques. Compétences techniques attendues : Solide expérience en développement logiciel, Git, Pull Requests et CI/CD. Bonne compréhension des méthodologies Agile et du rôle de Product Owner. Connaissances en Data Engineering (SQL, pipelines). Maîtrise d'Azure DevOps. Bonne compréhension des environnements Azure, Angular, .NET, PowerShell, Terraform et des outils de supervision. Expérience concrète des outils de développement assisté par IA : Microsoft 365 Copilot, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code ou équivalents. Développement Python et intégration d'API et d'agents IA. Capacité à concevoir et industrialiser des solutions IA robustes et maintenables. Bonne maîtrise des enjeux de sécurité et de confidentialité du code. Qualités recherchées : Profil pragmatique, orienté réalisation et résultats. Capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs techniques variés. Aptitude à accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption de nouveaux outils. Autonomie, pédagogie et capacité à mesurer les impacts des solutions déployées.

items.desc: Job Description: Position’s Summary Location: Ottobrunn, Germany Hours per week: 37,5 Contract: Unlimited Reports to: Team Leader Research and Development Number of openings: 1 Your Tasks We are looking for a versatile and research-oriented Computer Vision & Optical Systems R&D Engineer to join our automated inspection team. In this role, you will be responsible for exploring, developing, and validating optical inspection methods and computer vision algorithms across all stages of technology maturation. You will bridge applied physics, hardware experimentation, and software development—designing experimental test setups, evaluating sensors and illumination techniques, and benchmarking algorithms to transform early-stage concepts into robust, reliable inspection solutions. Technology Exploration & System Prototyping - Evaluate and select optical sensors, 2D/3D cameras, structured lighting, and illumination setups for challenging materials and surface conditions. Design, build, and maintain experimental test benches to evaluate the physical feasibility and optical resolution limits of new concepts. Develop data acquisition routines and hardware-control interfaces to capture high-quality, reproducible test datasets. Algorithm Development & Evaluation Design, implement, and benchmark computer vision and image processing algorithms for automated feature extraction, image enhancement, and surface analysis. Compare classical image processing techniques with data-driven and machine learning approaches. Assess algorithm sensitivity, boundary accuracy, and false alarm robustness against measured ground truth. Experimental Testing & Rig Characterization Plan and conduct comprehensive laboratory test campaigns to assess environmental and physical influences (e.g., ambient light, reflection, distance, vibration, and mechanical stability). Identify and troubleshoot noise sources, optical distortions, and systematic measurement errors within experimental setups. Calibrate sensors and measurement instrumentation to ensure high data integrity. Metrology, Repeatability & Data Quality Apply statistical methods and metrological principles to quantify measurement repeatability, reproducibility, and uncertainty. Define data quality criteria, automated validation checks, and data annotation guidelines to support iterative algorithm training and testing. Establish baseline acceptance thresholds and performance indicators for evolving technologies. Documentation & Cross-Functional Collaboration Document experimental methodologies, trade-off studies, test results, and algorithmic limitations in clear technical reports and white papers. Collaborate with software engineers, robotics specialists, and project managers to support the transition of proven concepts into scalable tools. Present findings, proof-of-concept demos, and technical recommendations to internal teams and engineering partners. What we look for Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Vision, Optics/Photonics, Mechatronics, Physics, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Core Skills: Strong foundation in 2D/3D computer vision, image processing, or optical measurement techniques. Hands-on laboratory and experimental mindset (assembling test rigs, aligning optics, configuring lighting, and handling sensors). Programming & Analysis: Proficiency in Python (NumPy, OpenCV, SciPy, Matplotlib, Pandas) for rapid prototyping, analysis, and automation. Familiarity with hardware interfacing, instrument control, or camera SDKs. Experience with version control and collaborative tools (Git, Jira, Confluence). Problem Solving: Methodical experimental approach, strong analytical capabilities, and attention to measurement accuracy. Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken). An interview with the Hiring Manager will be scheduled. If needed, a last interview with the Hiring Team will be scheduled. The Hiring Team decides on the final candidate. Offer call from HR. A contract is signed. You can always check the status of your application on the Workday website. items.desc: The Purpose of the Role Infants move. Head motion is the single biggest obstacle to functional MRI in the first years of life: it corrupts the BOLD signal, discards large fractions of hard-won data, and biases what survives. The FreezeMotion project tackles this end to end – from the pulse sequence, through image reconstruction, to deep-learning-based signal recovery – so that the functional signal we care about can be measured reliably in awake infants. The existing FreezeMotion team works on the reconstruction and deep-learning side of the pipeline. This post adds the acquisition. The postholder will rethink how the data are collected so that, given a standard reconstruction pipeline and the deep-learning components downstream, the measurement is far more robust to motion than a conventional EPI acquisition. Silent, motiontolerant sequences such as zero-echo-time or non-Cartesian approaches are one promising basis, but the project is not committed to a particular family of sequences: the postholder will help decide. With Professor Cusack and the team, the postholder will take ownership of the acquisition side of the project: surveying candidate strategies, designing and implementing modified sequences on the scanner, validating them in phantoms and adults, co-designing acquisition and reconstruction with the team, defining the metrics that show whether a new acquisition preserves the important parts of the fMRI signal under realistic infant motion, and writing up the results. Context The team is based in the Trinity College Institute of Neuroscience (TCIN), which brings together 60 groups and 250 scientists from a broad range of disciplines, to study the brain from molecules to mind to society. It houses state of the art equipment, including a Siemens 3T Prisma MRI scanner, a CERCA OPM-MEG system, and an NVIDIA GPU cluster. TCIN aims also to span levels from fundamental research to translation (bench-to-bedside). The postholder will report to Professor Rhodri Cusack and work closely with the existing FreezeMotion team on reconstruction and deep learning, as part of a diverse group using brain imaging and NeuroAI to understand the infant brain. Funding Information This post is funded by Research Ireland Frontiers for the Future “FreezeMotion” grant SFI-22/FFPA/11050. Main Responsibilities Survey candidate acquisition strategies for motion-robust infant fMRI (e.g. ZTE/silent methods, non-Cartesian and self-navigated trajectories, multi-echo and low-rank approaches, prospective motion correction) and assess their suitability for infant BOLD Design and implement modified pulse sequences on the Siemens 3T Prisma, and validate them in phantoms and adults before infant use Work closely with the reconstruction and deep-learning members of the team to co-design acquisition and reconstruction, so that the data acquired are what the downstream pipeline needs to recover the signal most reliably Define quantitatively which properties of the fMRI signal matter for the project's questions, and build the metrics and test protocols that show whether a new acquisition preserves them under realistic infant motion Support acquisition during infant scanning sessions and help the wider team run and troubleshoot protocols Be collaborative and constructive, working with the team and Professor Cusack to conduct insightful, original research Apply robust and reproducible methods to produce the highest quality science, and maintain the highest ethical standards Present work at local, national and international meetings (e.g. ISMRM, OHBM) and write clear, authoritative and impactful manuscripts Contribute to the open release of sequences, protocols and analysis code Provide constructive feedback to other team members and Professor Cusack, to strengthen others' work Supervise undergraduate research students as a co-supervisor, and seek opportunities for teaching and mentoring Contribute to the administrative and practical excellence of the lab Person Specification This section sets out the knowledge, skills and attributes the post-holder will need for successful performance in the role. Qualifications A PhD (or near completion) in MR physics, biomedical engineering, physics or a closely related field is essential Knowledge and Expertise Hands-on experience developing or modifying pulse sequences on a clinical or research MR system (e.g. Siemens IDEA, GE EPIC, Philips, or Pulseq) is essential A strong understanding of MR signal formation, k-space sampling, and the physics of BOLD contrast and EPI artefacts is essential Programming skills in at least one of C++ or Python, and comfort working with image reconstruction code, are essential Experience with non-Cartesian, zero-echo-time or silent sequences (e.g. Looping Star, ZTE, spiral, radial), or with prospective/retrospective motion correction, is highly desirable Experience with advanced reconstruction (parallel imaging, compressed sensing, low-rank or model-based methods, or learned …

items.desc: Per sostenere lo sviluppo delle nostre attività e l'evoluzione della nostra infrastruttura digitale, stiamo ampliando il reparto IT con l'inserimento di una nuova figura: Software Engineer specializzato in sviluppo software e automazione dei processi aziendali, con un forte interesse per l'intelligenza artificiale e le tecnologie emergenti. Cerchiamo una persona che non si limiti a sviluppare software sulla base di istruzioni ma che abbia la mentalità dello "smanettone": una persona che ama la tecnologia, sperimenta nuovi strumenti, cerca continuamente soluzioni più intelligenti e sia interessata anche all'intelligenza artificiale, sia come strumento per aumentare la propria produttività nello sviluppo software, sia come tecnologia da integrare concretamente nei processi e nelle applicazioni aziendali. PRINCIPALI RESPONSABILITÀ Progettare e sviluppare sistemi di automazione personalizzati per ridurre le operazioni manuali e migliorare l'efficienza operativa. Integrare software, database, CRM e piattaforme aziendali mediante API e collegamenti personalizzati. Sviluppare, aggiornare e ottimizzare siti web e applicazioni aziendali. Realizzare strumenti gestionali interni. Migliorare le prestazioni, la sicurezza e l'affidabilità delle piattaforme. Gestire attività di testing, debugging, manutenzione e ottimizzazione del codice. Individuare possibili applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale nei processi operativi. Sperimentare e implementare strumenti di AI per automatizzare attività ripetitive, elaborare informazioni e semplificare i flussi di lavoro. COSA OFFRIAMO Inserimento diretto in azienda con contratto iniziale a tempo determinato. Retribuzione annua lorda indicativa di €63.000, commisurata alle competenze e all'esperienza del candidato. Opportunità di lavorare su progetti tecnologici concreti, con un impatto diretto sull'efficienza e sull'organizzazione aziendale. Autonomia progettuale e possibilità di proporre e sviluppare nuove soluzioni. Collaborazione diretta con il reparto IT e le diverse funzioni aziendali. Possibilità di valutare sistemazioni abitative messe a disposizione dall'azienda per candidati provenienti da altre zone, secondo disponibilità e accordi individuali. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 04.11.2026 Sektor Offentlig Vil du bruke data og kunstig intelligens til å gi økt innsikt om forskning og innovasjon? Om stillingen Vil du bruke data og kunstig intelligens til å gi økt innsikt om forskning og innovasjon? Vi ser etter en ny dataviter til Forskningsrådets KI/ML team. Teamet har ansvar for utvikling, monitorering og drift av de internt utviklede KI-løsningene i Forskningsrådet. Vi lager blant annet støtte for søknadsbehandlingen, og ML-løsninger for rapportering og analyse av prosjektporteføljen. Dette inkluderer merking og kategorisering av tekster, topic modeling for analyser, tekstsammenligninger, og statistiske analyser. Du vil få stor medvirkning på beslutninger rundt teknisk oppsett, modell- og metodevalg ved nyutviklinger. Kodingen foregår i all hovedsak i Python. Vi bruker Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket) for planlegging, dokumentasjon, og versjonskontroll. I Azure bruker vi blant annet Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI og databricks. Dataplattformen til Forskningsrådet er i Snowflake, som bruker Matillion for last og dbt for transformering. Vi har Sigma som BI-verktøy. Vi har fokus på ansvarlig og etisk utvikling og bruk av KI. I praksis betyr dette at vi tar ansvar for å kartlegge risiko før vi eventuelt starter ny utvikling, og at vi evaluerer modellene og dokumenterer skjevheter i dataene og modellene vi har utviklet før vi beslutter å sette løsningen i drift. Hva skal du jobbe med? Dine hovedarbeidsoppgaver blir å videreutvikle eksisterende KI/ML-produkter og -tjenester og utvikle nye i samarbeid med interne brukere lage KI/ML-løsninger helt fra utforskningsstadiet til ferdig testet, dokumentert og produksjonssatt system gjøre analyser basert på ustrukturerte data og omsette disse til innsikt for Forskningsrådet Hvem ser vi etter? Du må ha mastergrad innen informatikk, datavitenskap, kunstig intelligens eller lignende fagområde gode programmeringsferdigheter i Python grunnleggende ferdigheter i SQL erfaring med versjonskontroll / git erfaring med trening og evaluering av ML-modeller, inkl. å gjøre vurderinger av datavalg, modellvalg og etiske hensyn erfaring med å lage KI/ML-løsninger helt fra utforskningsstadiet til et ferdig testet og dokumentert produkt Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med konsumering av API'er erfaring med unit-testing i Python jobbet i skyløsninger som f.eks. Azure, Google cloud, AWS erfaring i et eller flere av følgende biblioteker: Scikit-learn, NLTK, spaCy, Transformers. Norsk er arbeidsspråket hos oss, og du må derfor kunne kommunisere godt på norsk - både skriftlig og muntlig. Personlige egenskaper For at du skal trives og lykkes i rollen ser vi for oss at du har evne til å samarbeide godt i team setter pris på tverrfaglig samarbeid i en organisasjon med mange ulike behov liker å sette deg inn i nye tekniske problemstillinger og jobbe systematisk med å finne gode løsninger liker å holde deg faglig oppdatert på KI/ML-feltet Hos oss får du Vi tilbyr fleksitidsordning mulighet til å avtale hjemmekontor mulighet for å trene én time i arbeidstiden per uke personal - og reiseforsikring pensjons - og boliglånsordninger i Statens pensjonskasse sosiale tilbud som idrettslag, kor, kunstforening og aktivitetsdager lokaler sentralt på Lysaker med kort vei til tog, buss og båt lønn etter avtale i samsvar med stillingsnivå og vår lønnspolitikk Vi håper du har lyst til å bli vår nye kollega! Forskning har aldri vært viktigere og vi er stolte av samfunnsoppdraget vårt. Samfunnsoppdraget løser vi sammen, og vi gjør det best gjennom å ha ulike bakgrunner, livserfaringer og perspektiver. Vi ønsker å tilrettelegge for at alle skal kunne lykkes hos oss og oppleve en inkluderende arbeidsplass. Våre tjenester og vår organisasjon er i stadig utvikling, og vi søker deg som ønsker å bidra aktivt til videreutviklingen. Teknologi og digitale løsninger er en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen hos oss. Vi legger vekt på at alle våre ansatte har et bevisst forhold til sikkerhet. Hos oss blir du del av et engasjert og solid fagmiljø og sammen skaper vi verdi for samfunnet. Har du lyst til å bli med på laget? Informasjon til deg som søker Når du trykker på "søk stillingen" kommer du til rekrutteringsportalen Jobbnorge og må logge inn. Vi ber om at du svarer på spørsmålene du får innledningsvis, disse erstatter søknadsbrevet fyller ut feltene for utdannelse og arbeidserfaring laster opp relevante attester og vitnemål Forskningsrådet vurderer bare søknader og vedlegg registrert i Jobbnorge. Offentlig søkerliste utarbeides etter søknadsfristens utløp. Ønsker du å reservere deg fra å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlisten, må du begrunne det. Opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om søker har bedt om å være unntatt søkerlisten. Vi gir deg beskjed dersom vi ikke kan ta ønsket ditt til følge. items.desc: Asystent/ka Zarządu ds. Planowania, Projektów i AI Miejsce pracy: Katowice O nas Jesteśmy polską grupą kapitałową działającą równolegle w kilku branżach: motoryzacji, mobilności, budownictwie mieszkaniowym oraz biurowym, a także w obszarze innowacji technologicznych. Nasz rozwój opieramy na fundamentach ponad 35-letniego doświadczenia i stabilności Holdingu1. Wyznaczamy trendy motoryzacyjne, usprawniamy i automatyzujemy procesy biznesowe, realizujemy inwestycje mieszkaniowe i komercyjne przyjazne środowisku. Działając na kilkunastu rynkach lokalnych, w kilkudziesięciu przedsięwzięciach, daliśmy się poznać jako godny zaufania dostawca i sprawdzony partner. Nasz Zespół tworzą ludzie, którzy nie tylko są najlepszymi specjalistami w swoich dziedzinach, ale przede wszystkim poprzez to, co robią, realizują swoje pasje. Z dumą posiadamy certyfikaty Great Place to Work 2024 oraz Friendly Workplace 2025, które potwierdzają, że tworzymy środowisko pracy oparte na zaufaniu, współpracy i pozytywnej atmosferze. Funciones Como AI Engineer, serás una pieza clave en el desarrollo e implementación de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial, con un enfoque particular en Generative AI (GENAI) y el ecosistema de Microsoft Foundry. Diseñar, desarrollar, entrenar e implementar modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, con especial énfasis en modelos de lenguaje grandes (LLMs) y otras arquitecturas GENAI. Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de producto y negocio para identificar oportunidades donde la IA pueda aportar valor estratégico. Investigar y evaluar nuevas tecnologías, herramientas y metodologías en el campo de la IA y GENAI. Participar activamente en la definición de la arquitectura de soluciones de IA, asegurando escalabilidad, eficiencia y mantenibilidad. Trabajar con plataformas y servicios de Microsoft Azure para la construcción y despliegue de soluciones de IA. Optimizar el rendimiento de los modelos y las aplicaciones de IA. Documentar el proceso de desarrollo, los modelos y las decisiones de diseño. Mantenerse al día de las últimas tendencias y avances en IA, GENAI y Microsoft Foundry. Contribuir a la cultura de innovación y aprendizaje continuo dentro del equipo. Beneficios Seguro médico completo. Oportunidades de formación continua: Idiomas, Certificaciones técnicas relevantes (ej. Azure AI), Bootcamps especializados y mucho más. Participación en multitud de eventos: BETWEEN Night, Torneo de Padel, actividades de team building y mucho más. Retribución flexible: Opciones para optimizar tus beneficios en restaurante, transporte, guardería y otros. Incentivos por validar o recomendar talento. Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo. Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo de carrera. Participación en proyectos innovadores y de vanguardia tecnológica. REQUISITOS Requisitos Experiencia mínima de 4 años en el campo de la Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning. Sólidos conocimientos y experiencia práctica en Generative AI (GENAI) y LLMs. Experiencia con el ecosistema de Microsoft, especialmente con servicios de IA en Azure (ej. Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Machine Learning). Dominio de lenguajes de programación como Python y sus librerías asociadas (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.). Conocimientos en arquitecturas de Deep Learning. Experiencia en el ciclo de vida completo del desarrollo de modelos de ML (desde la experimentación hasta la puesta en producción). Ingeniería Informática, Ciencias de la Computación, Matemáticas, o campo relacionado, o experiencia práctica equivalente.

items.title: Data & AI Engineer
items.card: ABOUT THE JOB Every decision at CAIA, from which shade to restock to which campaign to scale or which market to grow, starts with data. Our data platform turns orders, ad spend and retail sales into numbers the whole company can trust, and our AI assistants let colleagues ask those numbers questions directly. We’re looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join our Tech team. Reporting to our CTO, you’ll work with
items.desc: CAIA Cosmetics is a Stockholm-based global beauty brand, founded in 2018 by beauty industry veterans and experts in social media and content. We create high-performing, top-quality products at accessible price points, always crafted with intention and grounded in our Scandinavian heritage of effortlessness, warmth and clean design. Driven by an entrepreneurial and creative spirit, CAIA blends quality and expertise with creativity and entertainment to make beauty feel inspiring, joyful and easy to use. Our world is aspirational yet attainable - rooted in access, community, inclusivity and our signature “effortless glow.” ABOUT THE JOB Every decision at CAIA, from which shade to restock to which campaign to scale or which market to grow, starts with data. Our data platform turns orders, ad spend and retail sales into numbers the whole company can trust, and our AI assistants let colleagues ask those numbers questions directly. We’re looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join our Tech team. Reporting to our CTO, you’ll work with marketing, finance and operations to build and run the data pipelines, services and AI tooling behind CAIA’s reporting and analytics. From modelling sales data in Dataform to deploying an MCP server that lets AI assistants query BigQuery, you'll help ensure everyone at CAIA works from figures that are correct, documented and on time. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career or with a couple of years of experience who writes solid SQL, enjoys clean and tested code, builds with AI every day, and wants to own real production systems at a fast-growing brand. MAIN TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES Build and maintain data models in Dataform and BigQuery – incremental models, assertions, and cost-aware partitioning and clustering. Ingest data from our source systems – e-commerce, advertising platforms, ERP and retail partners – into BigQuery, with scheduling, alerting and backfills. Write and deploy Python or TypeScript services on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler) with correct IAM, secrets and logging. Work with marketing, finance and operations to turn vague business questions into precise data questions and reliable data models. Build, deploy and maintain MCP servers on Cloud Run that connect AI assistants to our data – with authentication, least-privilege IAM, secrets and monitoring. Keep our semantic layer answerable for AI – define metrics once, write table and column descriptions, catalog entries and test questions, and fix wrong answers at the source. Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as your default way of building – write clear task specs, review the output critically and ship tested code through pull requests and CI/CD. Support the whole organisation in building up its AI toolset – setting up assistants and connectors, and helping teams put AI to work in their daily tasks. Q UALIFICATIONS & PERSONAL SKILLS A university degree (BSc or MSc) in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, information systems or equivalent. Up to around two years of experience in data or software engineering – internships, thesis work and serious side projects count. Solid SQL – joins, window functions, data grain and incremental models. Hands-on coding in Python or TypeScript; you can write, test and debug a small service on your own. Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud. An AI-native way of working – you use coding agents daily and know when not to trust their output. A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain what you built, and why, to non-technical colleagues. Curiosity, a quick learning curve and comfort in a fast-paced environment. Fluent Swedish and English. IT'S A PLUS IF YOU HAVE Production experience with BigQuery, and with Dataform or dbt. Experience with dimensional modelling and data quality testing. An understanding of containers, service accounts, least-privilege access and basic networking. Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer brands. Experience building or integrating LLM-based tooling – MCP, function calling or agents. Side projects count. WHY CAIA? At CAIA, you'll be part of one of Scandinavia's most exciting and fast-growing beauty brands, working in a creative, collaborative and dynamic environment where ideas come to life, and where you'll have the opportunity to grow your skills while contributing to products loved by customers around the world. If you're passionate about data, code and AI, take pride in getting the numbers right and want to build the data and AI platform behind a fast-growing beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you. Send us your application and let's continue building CAIA's story together. Please submit your application by November 9, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the last application day.

items.desc: AI-samordnare, vikariat – Stadsledningsförvaltningen Helsingborg Generativ AI är på väg att bli en självklar del av arbetsvardagen för tusentals medarbetare i Helsingborgs stad. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och forma hur det går till. Som AI-samordnare hos oss driver du stadens AI-vägledning, tjänstefierar generativ AI och transkribering och leder produktutvecklingen av vår egen AI-plattform Eneo. Du blir den som verksamheterna vänder sig till när de vill veta vad som är möjligt, lämpligt och klokt — och den som omsätter svaren i tjänster som faktiskt används. Vill du vara med och göra skillnad på riktigt? Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag! Om arbetsplatsen Helsingborgs stad har cirka 10 000 medarbetare och 470 chefer. Stadsledningsförvaltningen har ett viktigt och spännande uppdrag där vi finns till för andra, för kollegor, andra förvaltningar, helsingborgare och företag. Genom att leda, utveckla och samordna kommunens verksamhet inom övergripande och gemensamma områden skapar vi förutsättningar för en välfungerande organisation. Vi tillhandahåller tjänster och produkter som efterfrågas av kommunstyrelsen, förvaltningar och bolag, samt gemensamma funktioner som riktar sig direkt till helsingborgarna. Som en del av uppdraget samverkar vi även med externa parter för att skapa förutsättningar för en positiv utveckling av Helsingborg. Du kommer att tillhöra avdelningen för digitalisering, som ansvarar för stadens gemensamma digitala utveckling. Här arbetar vi nära varandra och nära verksamheterna — rollen är placerad centralt, men effekten av det du gör märks ute i skolor, vård och omsorg, stadsbyggnad och alla andra delar av staden. AI-arbetet i Helsingborg är inte ett pilotprojekt utan en etablerad del av verksamheten, med en egen plattform, en vägledning och ett internt nätverk. Samtidigt är området ungt nog att du får stort utrymme att påverka riktningen. Du arbetar självständigt i din roll, men aldrig ensam: du har kollegor inom arkitektur, informationssäkerhet, juridik och verksamhetsutveckling att luta dig mot. Arbetsuppgifter Tjänsten benämns som tjänsteägare och innebär att du ansvarar för stadens AI-vägledning: förvaltar den löpande och leder arbetet när den behöver ändras eller byggas ut. Vägledningen är det som gör att verksamheterna vågar och vet hur de ska använda AI, så den behöver vara både aktuell och begriplig. En stor del av vardagen handlar om tjänstefiering. Du tar generativ AI och AI-transkribering från möjlighet till färdig tjänst som verksamheterna kan beställa och använda, med allt vad det innebär av behovsanalys, utformning, införande och förvaltning. Du driver produktutvecklingen av Eneo, stadens egen AI-plattform. Det innebär att prioritera vad som ska byggas, hålla ihop arbetet mot leverantörer och interna resurser och se till att plattformen svarar mot verkliga behov i staden. Du bistår också i framtagandet av stadsgemensamma AI-assistenter. Rådgivning är en återkommande uppgift. Verksamheter och projekt vänder sig till dig för att få hjälp att bedöma idéer, välja väg och undvika fallgropar. Du tar också fram underlag och förslag till ledningen när frågorna är av mer strategisk art. Vad vi erbjuder Vi erbjuder dig ett omväxlande, ansvarsfullt och stimulerande arbete med stora möjligheter till egen utveckling. Du får arbeta med AI i skarp kommunal drift, inte i presentationsform, och du får göra det i en organisation som redan bestämt sig för att området är viktigt. Du får också ett brett kontaktnät — inom staden, inom Familjen Helsingborg och genom samverkan med andra kommuner och regionala aktörer. Du arbetar självständigt och strukturerat, och du är bekväm med att driva frågor framåt i en miljö där allt ännu inte är färdigtänkt. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Through visualisation and clear explanations, we help our users see what the model does, how it
items.desc: About Myrspoven Buildings use a huge share of the world's energy, and most of it is controlled by rules written decades ago. Myrspoven changes that. Our AI controls heating, cooling and ventilation in real time, cutting energy use and emissions while keeping people comfortable. Our products myCoreAI and myLoadShift run in buildings today. We are a growth-stage scaleup in Stockholm, and we are now looking for a software engineer to join our AI team. The role You will join our AI team, which owns the model that optimises our customers' buildings and that our whole product is built on – along with the data and systems around it. The team's mission is to make our optimisation smarter, more reliable and easier to scale to new buildings – and to make it understandable. Through visualisation and clear explanations, we help our users see what the model does, how it works and why it makes the decisions it does. This is a software engineering role: you will improve the model itself and build the data and platform foundation it runs on. Agents write more and more of our code, so what we value most is the engineering judgement around it: framing the problem, designing the system and knowing that what we ship actually works. You will: Work across teams – Platform, Product, Customer Success and partners – to understand the problem before you build the solution Share knowledge and work closely with your teammates – we keep teams small but redundant, so no one is a single point of failure Use AI agents as a natural part of how you work – to write, test, review and ship faster Improve the model – from data and features to training, evaluation and how it performs in real buildings Build and run the data pipelines and platform behind our AI – ingestion, processing, orchestration, deployment and monitoring Visualise building data and the model's decisions so they are easy to explore and understand for internal teams and for customers Own what you build, from idea to production and beyond Who you are A strong software engineer. You have solid experience building and running software in production. You understand how systems fit together, read code critically and know how to dig into the details when something breaks. You are at home in Linux and on the command line. Experienced in data engineering. You have built data pipelines at scale with tools like Spark, Airflow or similar. Self-driven with AI agents. You already use coding agents daily, know their strengths and limits, and work independently with them – steering, reviewing and verifying what they produce rather than just accepting it. Product-oriented. You care about why something is built, not only how. You think in terms of customer value and are happy to challenge a requirement. A clear communicator. You work well across teams, explain technical trade-offs and complex ideas simply – in words and visuals – and you ask early and keep others in the loop. Curious. You like to understand how things work – the data, the buildings, the customers – and you keep learning as the tools change. Ready to pitch in. We are a small company with varied needs, so you jump in where you are needed, even when it is outside your usual area. Excited about what we do. You believe AI can make buildings far more energy efficient, and you want to help make that happen at scale. Nice to have Cloud experience, ideally Azure Experience with time-series data or with taking ML models into production Knowledge of buildings, HVAC or energy systems Experience from a B2B SaaS scaleup Technologies we use You don't need to know all of these from day one, but familiarity with any of them is a plus: Language and tooling: Python, uv, Ruff, mypy, pytest ML and optimisation: JAX, Flax, Optax, scikit-learn, SciPy Data: Apache Iceberg, PyArrow, Polars, pandas, Spark, Kafka Platform: Airflow, Kubernetes and Helm, Docker, Nix, Azure Monitoring and apps: Prometheus, Grafana, FastAPI, Streamlit What we offer Work that cuts energy use and emissions in real buildings, every day A friendly, relaxed workplace with smart, helpful colleagues who enjoy working together A small, senior team where your work goes straight to customers Lots of room to shape how we build with AI – tools, ways of working and architecture Competitive salary and stock options Hybrid work, with at least 3 days a week at our office on Södermalm in Stockholm How to apply Skip the cover letter. Instead, send us your CV with short answers to two questions: Tell us about something you built that ran in production, and what went wrong. We care more about how you handled the problem than about how impressive the project was. How do you use AI agents in your work today? Be concrete: which tools you use, what you use them for, and where they still fall short.

Closing Date Friday 06 November 2026 Reference ENG2659526 About the role We are seeking a highly motivated Research Associate/Fellow to join the Hydrogen Research Group at the University of Nottingham. The successful candidate will become part of a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers working at the forefront of hydrogen materials research. The project will focus on the optimisation of metal and complex hydrides for both the synthesis and decomposition of ammonia. This is an important part of the MariNH3 project which is due to finish on 30th June 2027. We have accumulated significant data on metal and complex hydride systems including neutron studies such as QENS and INS. Here we are looking for suitable candidate who has expertise in both synthesis and characterisation and interpretation of such hydrides from these neutron studies. The post is a short term one (6 months). About the team The Hydrogen Research Group comprises five academic staff members, eight research fellows, and eight PhD researchers. The group brings together internationally recognised expertise in both experimental and computational hydrogen materials research, spanning materials synthesis, characterisation, atomistic modelling, and materials informatics. We maintain strong collaborations with industrial partners and leading research institutions worldwide, enabling impactful and translational research in hydrogen technologies. We are committed to providing a supportive, collaborative, and inclusive research environment and welcome applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and career pathways. About you You will hold, or be close to completing, a PhD (or equivalent qualification) in a relevant discipline such as Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field. You should have expertise in We welcome applicants with a broad range of research interests and experiences who can contribute to our multidisciplinary research programme. Candidates should demonstrate experience in the following areas: 1. Synthesis of metal and complex hydrides including reactive milling 2. Characterisation of neutron and synchrotron data using packages such as Fullprof, Mantid, GsasII or equivalent 3. Experience in analysing neutron and synchrotron data sets The successful candidate will be able to work effectively both independently and collaboratively, and will be enthusiastic about advancing hydrogen storage materials. What we offer A friendly, diverse, and supportive working environment Generous holiday entitlement (plus bank holidays and university closure days) Access to training, development, and career progression opportunities Staff discounts, travel schemes, and a wide range of additional benefits What next This is a Fixed-Term position available for 6 months. items.desc: Use your life-sciences degree to review and improve a cutting-edge medical AI system. Aykua is a Cambridge-based, venture-backed startup developing AI systems to automate medical administration workflows accurately and efficiently. Medical admin is a huge, largely manual burden on clinics and a source of delay and error for patients; we are building the systems that make that exchange fast, accurate, and compliant at scale. We are a lean, fast-paced team with significant opportunities to grow with the company. The Role This role sits at the centre of Aykua’s product quality engine. Your work will help us understand where the system fails and how to improve it. You will review outputs from our proprietary AI system, assessing whether they are accurate, complete, and consistent with the underlying information. Alongside the quality review work, you will run experiments to make the system more accurate, reliable, and efficient. The role is well suited to someone with strong life-sciences knowledge and a genuine interest in growing into more technical work over time. What You’ll Do Review AI-generated outputs against a structured rubric, using source material and general life-sciences knowledge to determine correctness, completeness, and consistency. This is a daily activity required to uphold Service Level Agreements with Aykua’s customers. Identify, classify, and document errors, inconsistencies, and hallucinations. Help refine our core prompts and workflows as the system evolves. Run focused experiments to make the system more accurate, reliable, and efficient. Contribute to internal documentation, examples, and quality-control processes. What We’re Looking For A degree in a life-sciences subject, and the ability to understand medical and biological terminology in context. Exceptional attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Care and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information. Comfortable working independently for sustained periods, staying accurate and motivated through focused solo review work. Curiosity about AI systems and how they can be evaluated and improved. Nice to have Experience reviewing scientific, medical, or technical information. Familiarity working with patient data or healthcare documentation. Experience using AI tools. Basic coding or data-analysis experience. Prior work in a lab, healthcare organisation, research environment, or startup. How to Apply Please send your CV and cover letter to jobs@aykua.com . Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis, and we aim to respond to every applicant within one week. You must have the right to work in the UK, as this is an in-person role near Cambridge. Pay: £30,000.00-£40,000.00 per year Benefits: Employee stock ownership plan Education: Bachelor's (required) Work authorisation: United Kingdom (required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge CB4

items.desc: We're looking for graduates for the 2027 intake, who are curious, collaborative and keen to build a career in Mechanical Engineering and who enjoy working with people, solving problems and learning new things! You will join an established Mechanical Engineering team of 10+ engineers, ranging from Graduate and Mechanical Engineers through to Senior and Principal Mechanical Engineers, giving you access to a broad range of experience, technical knowledge and day-to-day support. Working within an integrated Design & Build environment, you will contribute to live water and wastewater projects and gain practical experience of how mechanical engineering develops from initial concept and design through to safe, operable and maintainable assets. Alongside project experience, you will follow a structured technical and professional development programme designed to progressively build your knowledge, practical experience and engineering judgement. It's your career, let's shape it together! The graduate programme is tailored to your needs with a flexible and varied learning environment, you'll feel empowered to make decisions and harness your knowledge and practical skills. The sky's the limit! Purpose of Role To develop the technical knowledge, practical experience and engineering judgement required to become a capable and increasingly independent Mechanical Engineer, while contributing to the successful delivery of water and wastewater projects. As your capability develops, you will progress from supported engineering activities towards ownership of defined mechanical design packages, supported by experienced engineers and a structured Graduate Development Programme (GDP). Key Responsibilities Collaborate with Process, Civil, EICA, Design, Delivery and other disciplines to develop safe, practical and cost-effective engineering solutions. Produce and contribute to mechanical design layouts, specifications, datasheets, equipment and pipeline schedules, calculations, reports and technical documentation. Support the development and review of 3D models and engineering visualisations, considering construction, operation, access and maintenance requirements. Develop mechanical solutions in accordance with project specifications, client asset standards, WIMES, relevant engineering standards and HSE guidance. Develop practical engineering knowledge of pumps, hydraulics, pipework, valves, materials, mechanical equipment, filtration, disinfection and water and wastewater treatment processes. Attend water and wastewater treatment sites to undertake surveys, condition assessments and design verification, developing an understanding of operational assets and site constraints. Prepare and contribute to design risk assessments, multidisciplinary design reviews, HAZOP studies and Operability & Maintenance (OpMan) reviews. Develop commercial awareness by understanding project deliverables, design allowances, programme, design costs and the impact of engineering decisions on project affordability. Engage with equipment manufacturers and suppliers through technical meetings, factory visits, Lunch & Learns and industry events. Develop deeper knowledge in selected mechanical or treatment areas, with opportunities to become a technical champion as your experience develops. Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing, including lessons learned, technical presentations, engineering guidance and standard templates. Develop awareness of the responsible use of AI and digital tools to support engineering activities, while maintaining engineering judgement and appropriate verification. Graduate Programme Our structured three-year GDP is designed to develop you into a rounded Mechanical Engineer with strong technical foundations and practical Design & Build experience. You will benefit from: A structured development pathway that progressively builds technical knowledge, practical experience, responsibility and engineering judgement. Support from an established Mechanical Engineering team, together with a Mechanical Engineering buddy and professional-development mentor. Support towards professional registration with the Institution of Mechanical Engineers (IMechE) through the Monitored Professional Development Scheme (MPDS) and Graduate Development Log (GDL). Structured technical learning, including online training in hydraulics, pumping systems, pump selection and sizing, pump efficiency and variable-speed pumping, alongside water and wastewater treatment, engineering standards, CDM2015 and design safety. Opportunities to engage with the wider water industry, equipment manufacturers and suppliers, including opportunities to attend the Water Equipment Show (WES) and other technical events. A minimum six-month site placement during the GDP, providing practical exposure to procurement, supplier and contractor interaction, installation, construction, testing, commissioning and handover.

items.desc: About Predikt ‍ Predikt is a dynamic Swiss-Belgian deeptech company at the forefront of innovation, developing cutting-edge AI-driven technology. We are an AI-driven cost & margin intelligence platform built for enterprise procurement and finance teams, providing unmatched visibility into external cost drivers and their impact on margins. We empower organizations to navigate market volatility, proactively manage risks, protect profitability and make confident, data-driven decisions. As an early-stage startup, we are fueled by a strong sense of mission and enthusiasm, striving to make cost intelligence accessible to every procurement and finance leader across the globe. ‍ At Predikt, we are defined by our core values and high ambitions. We are a company that champions integrity, innovation and excellence, creating an environment where everyone supports each other and works collaboratively towards common goals. Our customer-centric approach ensures we deliver exceptional value and service, while fostering a culture of mutual respect, open communication, and continuous improvement. ‍ Join us on this exciting journey as we transform the way procurement and finance teams understand and act on cost and create a future where volatility is no longer a threat, but a challenge every organization is equipped to face with confidence. About the role As a Data Engineer, you're part of the Customer team, working behind the scenes to keep customer implementations and the Predikt platform running smoothly. You work independently based on clear input and requirements. You'll have some contact with the clients but your mainly focused on the engineering side. What you'll do Build, run and maintain data pipelines, including re-running scripts for specific periods when needed Set up and maintain technical environments (including SSO) and support deployments and releases Provide first-line bug fixing and technical troubleshooting Help prepare demos: clean and process data, and load the right data into demo environments Execute technical tasks and think along, working independently based on input gathered by others on the team What we're looking for A can-do mentality: you dive in, figure things out, and don't wait around when something is unclear A Master degree in a technical or IT-related field A first experience with Python and/or SQL and frontend technologies A structured, independent way of working Curiosity about data and systems, and a willingness to learn You are fluent in English, knowledge of Dutch is not required. Candidates must already have an unrestricted right to work in Belgium/EU at the time of application. We are unfortunately not able to sponsor a work permit (single permit) or visa for this role. Nice to have Exposure to cloud environments or deployment tooling An interest in scripting or automating repetitive tasks (real room to grow the role in that direction as you take on more ownership) What we offer Pay & perks A competitive salary and a stock option plan, so you share in the growth you help create. Meal vouchers of €8 per working day. Eco vouchers worth €250 per year. A net allowance per month for working from home and using your own equipment. Getting around Mobility budget or company car via Lizy: you choose what fits your life. Bike lease option. Our Leuven office is a 2-minute walk from the train station. Health Hospitalisation insurance via Alan. Flexibility Hybrid work, split between our Leuven office and home. Bring your own device: work with the tools you know best. A flexible reward plan is planned for 2027, so you can shape part of your package yourself. Team & culture A yearly offsite, sometimes in the Swiss Alps, sometimes closer to home. Plenty of moments together throughout the year: drinks, our Christmas dinner and other team activities. A culture of radical transparency, where open and honest communication is the norm. An early-stage startup that's growing fast, with room to take on more if you want it.

items.desc: Tasks Develop, deploy and maintain the real-time online tool that detects and visualizes global record-breaking and compounding extreme weather events as they occur. Set up, operate and maintain numerical and AI/ML-based climate models and aid in the setup of modeling experiments on MPI-GEA’s HPC systems Build and maintain a climate database, including reanalysis, observational, model and impact data, with reproducible workflows Develop and maintain analytical tools and shared code libraries for the research group (Co-)author scientific publications and present research at workshops and conferences Support group members in efficient data handling, machine learning workflows and good software practice (version control, testing, documentation) Ensure that data, code and tools are documented, and available for use by the wider community Profile PhD in climate, physics, math, data science, or related fields Experience with climate model data and gridded climate data tools and libraries (e.g. xarray, Dask, CDO) Experience with machine-learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) Experience with setting up climate or weather model simulations and with HPC environments Experience in web development and deploying interactive data platforms (e.g. web mapping and dashboards, containers, APIs) Good command of written and spoken English Our offer This full-time or part-time position with at least 34 hours/week will begin on the 1st of January, 2027, though some flexibility in start date is possible. The term is three years, with the option of an extension. Renumeration will follow the public service pay scale (TVöD Bund ) up to paygroup 13, according to the candidate’s qualifications and experience. You are entitled to an annual bonus, 31 days' holiday and time off on 24th and 31st December. We also offer attractive, family-friendly flexi-time and remote-working arrangements. A company pension scheme (VBL), an employer subsidy for public transport, the opportunity for further training, and language and health courses complete our offer. The Max Planck Society is committed to employing more individuals with disabilities and especially encourages them to apply. We are also committed to encouraging diversity and actively challenging biases based on gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion and other components of identity. We were honored with the TOTAL E-QUALITY award for the first time in 2023 for our commitment. The Max Planck Society supports the compatibility of family and career and is certified according to the "berufundfamilie" (“job and family”) audit. Your application should include: A cover letter A CV of no more than 3 pages A summary of research interests with max. 2 pages A list of scientific, peer-reviewed publications or examples of successful coding projects related to the position Contacts of two referees Any relevant certificates Position remains open until filled. About us The Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology (MPI-GEA) was founded in summer 2022 and is a dynamically growing, highly-interdisciplinary and international research institution. The research focuses on modeling and analyzing the interrelationships between biophysical and human-made systems, looking from the deep past to the future. The institute examines how humanity has driven the emergence of the Anthropocene – the period in which human activities began significantly impacting our planet’s climate and ecosystems – and identifying potential intervention points towards a more sustainable future. The Carl Zeiss Stiftung Independent Research Group on High-End Climate Risks (CZS-HECR) at MPI-GEA works towards an end-to-end understanding of worst-case climate outcomes, from unprecedented and compounding extremes to their societal impacts. The group combines fundamental physical process understanding rooted in climate physics and Earth System analyses, targeted climate model experiments, advanced statistics, including machine-learning- and explainable AI to deliver usable climate risk estimates under current and future climates for core societal sectors such as health, food, energy and finance. Contact Dr. Kai Kornhuber Email: kornhuber@gea.mpg.de Max-Planck-Institute for the Science of Human Kahlaische Straße 10 07745 Jena gea.mpg.de Twitter: @MPI_GEA

items.desc: Helse Sør-øst RHF Special Engineer Offentlig forvaltning A research engineer (spesialingeniør) position in molecular and cell biology is available in the research group targeted therapies and immunomodulation headed by Prof. Mouldy Sioud, Department of Cancer Immunology, Institute of Cancer Research, Oslo University Hospital-Radiumhospitalet. items.desc: Band 3 Radiology Department Assistant It is essential that you complete the Care Certificate and cannulation course in order to be up-banded to Band 3 Are you a caring, enthusiastic and hard working person looking to make a big impact? We are looking for dedicated and caring Radiology Department assistants to support our brand new, state of the art Community Diagnostic Centre (CDC) at Milford, Surrey. The CDC Is part of Royal Surrey’s continuing investment in its diagnostic capabilities and follows refurbishment of the Trust’s interventional suite, MRI and X-ray facilities You should have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work well within a team. You will be expected to complete a Care Certificate Induction for your first two weeks in order to bring you up to speed regarding what is required for you in the position. This take up to two weeks (dependent on previous experience.) After a settling in period, you will be offered the opportunity to complete a cannulation course, which will allow you to progress to a band 3 position once competence has been confirmed. Applications are welcome from those with unrestricted right to work in the UK. Sponsorship is not available for this role. This roles provides support to the department in providing patient focused, efficient service in a caring, professional and timely manner. This is a patient focused role. You will assist out-patients during their time in the radiology department from transferring the patients to and from the departments, greeting them on arrival, assisting with their preparation for the examinations, and helping to provide a pleasant experience. You will also take on some admin roles which may include, booking patients in for the appointment, stock management and room preparation for both CT and MRI examinations. Training for all will be provided. Our Radiology department at Royal Surrey is made up of 5 X-ray rooms, 4 CT scanners, 3 MRI scanners, 10 Ultrasound machines, an IR suite and 8 theatre machines. As well as 2 mammography machines and two OPG machines, one of which has CBCT capabilities. This year, we are working on our Interventional strategy which will hopefully see us moving from 1 to 3 interventional suites in the next 5-10 years and restructure the whole department to improve the experience and service we can provide to our patients. Additionally we have 3 community sites situated at Haslemere, Milford and Cranleigh, which provide an additional 3 x ray rooms, 4 Ultrasound rooms, a CT scanner and 2 MRI scanners. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96pMboIYdo Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. They will facilitate an efficient work flow between the scanner and support in an admin position where required. The post holder will provide an efficient and friendly service or patients undergoing Radiology examinations and provide any administrative support required, to ensure that the unit is running efficiently. They will assist with patient and room preparation, perform admin role and support the Radiographers where required. This post works closely and efficiently with the radiology team. Concevoir, développer et évaluer des agents IA experts et des architectures agentiques capables de mobiliser des connaissances scientifiques, de raisonner sur des problématiques métier et d’utiliser des outils, des modèles et des sources de données pour assister les workflows de recherche :
items.desc: Pourquoi a-t-on besoin de vous ? Au sein de la R&D de Saint-Gobain, l’équipe de Data Science développe et déploie des approches d’intelligence artificielle au service des activités scientifiques et industrielles du Groupe. L’équipe combine des compétences en analyse de données, statistiques, machine learning, IA générative, systèmes agentiques et graphes de connaissances pour accélérer la compréhension des phénomènes, la capitalisation des connaissances, la conception des matériaux et des procédés, ainsi que la transformation des pratiques de R&D. Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront les suivantes : Identifier, cadrer et mener des projets de recherche appliquée en IA et data science. Concevoir, développer et évaluer des agents IA experts et des architectures agentiques capables de mobiliser des connaissances scientifiques, de raisonner sur des problématiques métier et d’utiliser des outils, des modèles et des sources de données pour assister les workflows de recherche : recherche bibliographique, génération d’hypothèses, expérimentation, simulation, aide à la décision et production de livrables. Développer des méthodes d’analyse de données et de machine learning adaptées aux données scientifiques et industrielles : statistiques, apprentissage supervisé et non supervisé, modèles probabilistes, optimisation, séries temporelles, traitement d’images ou de signaux. Développer des prototypes robustes et sécurisés avec les équipes scientifiques et IT, en intégrant les usages afin de favoriser leur adoption et la transformation IA de la R&D. Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique, valoriser les résultats et développer des collaborations avec les équipes du Groupe et des partenaires académiques. Des déplacements ponctuels de courte durée sont à prévoir en France et à l’étranger (visites d’usines, conférences, formations…). Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ? Doctorat dans une discipline scientifique avec une forte composante en machine learning / IA, ou doctorat en ML/IA appliqué à des données et problématiques scientifiques ou industrielles. Les candidatures présentant un autre parcours, avec une expérience significative en recherche appliquée, seront également étudiées. Vous avez une bonne compréhension des modèles de langage et de leurs usages. Une première expérience du développement d’agents IA, de systèmes multi-agents ou de l’évaluation de LLM est appréciée, sans être indispensable. Vous maîtrisez Python et les bonnes pratiques de développement ; une familiarité avec le cloud Azure est un plus.
