items.desc: Vill du arbeta i gränslandet mellan den senaste AI-forskningen och praktisk mjukvaruutveckling? Är du en skicklig utvecklare som använder AI och agentbaserade utvecklingsverktyg för att snabbt gå från idé till fungerande prototyp eller system? Vill du dessutom använda din kompetens för att stärka Sveriges totalförsvar? Då kan FOI vara din nya arbetsplats. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med teknik i framkant och omsätta nya forskningsresultat till lösningar med verklig samhällsnytta. Om tjänsten Som forskningsingenjör arbetar du med att utveckla och utforska intelligenta informationssystem för försvar och säkerhet – exempelvis AI-drivna beslutsstöd, agentiska system och lösningar för avancerad informationsanalys. En central del av arbetet är att snabbt omsätta nya idéer, tekniker och forskningsresultat till fungerande prototyper som kan demonstreras, utvärderas och vidareutvecklas. Du arbetar AI-native, där kodagenter och agentisk mjukvaruutveckling är naturliga delar av utvecklingsprocessen. Du följer kontinuerligt forsknings- och teknikfronten, utvärderar nya metoder och tekniska genombrott och prövar lovande resultat i egna experiment och prototyper. Hos oss får du Möjlighet att arbeta i framkant inom AI och agentisk mjukvaruutveckling, där du får experimentera med nya utvecklingsmetoder och utforska nya sätt att utveckla mjukvara där människor och AI-agenter arbetar tillsammans. Du får stort inflytande över arkitektur, tekniska lösningar och val av verktyg och arbetar med komplexa och samhällsviktiga problem inom försvar och säkerhet. Du blir en del av en miljö där forskare och ingenjörer arbetar nära varandra och där kreativitet, utforskande och kontinuerligt lärande uppmuntras. Om organisationen Du kommer att ingå i verksamhetsområdet Ledningssystem. Verksamhetsområdet arbetar med forskning och utveckling av metoder och tekniker för informationshantering och beslutsfattande, främst på uppdrag från Försvarsmakten men även inom europeiska forskningsprojekt och tillsammans med civila myndigheter. Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver? Krav Vi Söker Dig Som Har magister- eller masterexamen inom datateknik, datavetenskap, mjukvaruutveckling (Software Engineering) eller annan närliggande utbildning och erfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig och relevant för tjänsten mycket god programmeringsförmåga och bred och gedigen kompetens inom modern mjukvaruutveckling förmåga att arbeta över hela mjukvarustacken och självständigt ta en idé från koncept till fungerande prototyp eller system gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av agentisk mjukvaruutveckling, där du använder kodagenter för att planera, genomföra och utvärdera mer omfattande utvecklingsuppgifter erfarenhet av att integrera AI-modeller och AI-baserade komponenter i mjukvarusystem erfarenhet av systematisk verifiering och utvärdering av agentgenererad mjukvara, exempelvis genom automatiserad testning, granskning och kvalitetsbedömning förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya forskningsresultat och tekniker, kritiskt utvärdera dem och omsätta dem i praktisk utveckling god förmåga att kommunicera i tal och skrift på såväl svenska som engelska. Som person är du tekniskt nyfiken, initiativtagande och experimentell. Du har god analytisk förmåga, trivs med problem där varken lösningen eller vägen dit är given och tycker om att utforska nya tekniska möjligheter tillsammans med andra. Meriterande Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden: avancerade agentiska utvecklingsflöden där kodagenter självständigt hanterar större, flerstegs- eller repository-baserade utvecklingsuppgifter agentorkestrering och multi-agent-baserade utvecklingsflöden försvars- eller säkerhetsområdet. Vad erbjuder vi dig? Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga. Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringsort: Kista Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld? Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och personligt brev via ansökningsknappen senast den 25 oktober 2026! items.desc: Machine Learning Scientist, Generative Modelling Location: London | Type: Full-time About the company A fast-growing TechBio company that develops new medicines by combining single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning. The team is highly interdisciplinary, with biology, computation, and engineering working side by side in state-of-the-art wet and dry labs. The opportunity Help build the next generation of generative and predictive models of cellular behaviour. Your work will be central to understanding and controlling cellular decision-making, which enables new therapeutic strategies grounded in generative models. You’ll have access to cutting-edge multiomic and interventional datasets, advanced compute infrastructure, and modern ML tooling, including agentic workflows. You’ll also see your models tested directly in experimental biology. What you’ll do Design and implement generative modelling approaches that learn intervention effects from diverse biological data, including single-cell perturbation experiments. Develop models that go beyond correlation, with a focus on generalisation, counterfactual prediction, and experimental design. Work with experimental teams to design and validate computational hypotheses, iterating to identify the highest-signal next experiment. Evaluate models for causal coherence, mechanistic fidelity, and real-world utility, not just fit. Communicate findings clearly to colleagues across disciplines. What you’ll bring A PhD in ML, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field. Deep expertise in generative modelling. Strong foundations in probabilistic modelling, representation learning, or neural network architectures for structured or sequential data. Excellent Python skills and familiarity with scalable ML tooling and high-performance computing. A disciplined approach to model evaluation, including experiments that test real-world utility beyond standard benchmarks. Willingness to engage deeply with biological data. Experience with single-cell or perturbation datasets is a strong plus. Nice to have A track record of impactful ML publications or open-source contributions. Experience in interdisciplinary teams or applying ML in real-world settings.

items.desc: Job Description Version française de l’offre disponible sur demande. Our Perception and Navigation Team is expanding to meet new challenges! To serve new industrial use cases ever more reliably, our humanoid robot must be able to detect multiple objects of interest and estimate their poses. It must also be able to understand its environment in order to navigate safely and autonomously. Our team is responsible for developing the knowledge and the codebase needed to address these challenges. We explore a range of state-of-the-art techniques, whether based on machine learning, classical computer vision, or model-based control. The Perception and Navigation team is part of the AI & Control department and works closely with other members of this department. It also collaborates regularly with other R&D teams: embedded software, electronics, and mechanics. Your Responsibilities May Include Selecting the most suitable vision/perception sensors for our needs Conducting literature reviews related to ongoing projects Presenting the latest innovations from the literature or internally developed algorithms to the team Developing algorithms for object detection, pose estimation, or feature recognition Creating a map of the environment that can be used to understand and navigate it Developing navigation and control algorithms for various robots, including autonomous navigation for humanoid robots and navigation assistance for exoskeletons Working closely with other teams to ensure the overall performance of the algorithms Testing on real robots and in simulation Traveling to customer sites (e.g., healthcare centers or factories) to ensure algorithms function properly in real-world conditions and making corrections as needed Automated testing, code quality, and designing verification pipelines to ensure non-regression Preferred Experience Qualifications : Engineering degree or PhD in perception, navigation, machine learning, robotics, or a similar field. Experience We are looking for various seniority levels. Academic experience will be highly valued, particularly in relation to perception or the use of point clouds, navigation or optimal control, machine learning, etc. Ideally, you have experience in software development (Python/C++), particularly in a team (version control tools, modularity, responding to specifications, continuous integration, etc.). You are creative and innovative. You are comfortable in developing new things with a limited existing base and making prototypes (personal or professional robotics projects are valued). You enjoy experimental work and adapting algorithms to the constraints of real-world environments and commercial products. You are comfortable with general algorithmic, and in particular with linear algebra (matrix calculations), and physical modeling (reference frame changes, odometry, etc.). You are rigorous, able to proofread your work, and explain your calculations or algorithms clearly. You are curious and have good analytical skills, enabling you to monitor technological developments effectively and learn from scientific literature or meetings at conferences. Skills (hard And Softskills) Python - Expert level C++ - Expert level Vision (feature detection, mapping, SLAM) - Expert level Navigation (path planning, path tracking…) - Expert level Machine learning (data analysis, augmentation, labeling, validation) - Autonomous level Robotics (kinematics, odometry, real data analysis) - Autonomous level Linear algebra, numerical optimization - Autonomous level Control systems (observers, controllers) - Basic knowledge Continuous analysis of the state of the art in the field - Autonomous level Software development best practices, continuous integration, automated testing - Autonomous level Who are they? At Wandercraft we pioneer intelligent robotics to help people do what they can’t do. We apply the most advanced robotics and AI to expand what’s possible for humans in the fields of healthcare and now industry. Founded in 2012, Wandercraft is globally recognized for creating the world’s first self-balancing walking exoskeleton, Atalante X, which is used in more than 100 rehabilitation centers across four continents helping individuals with disabilities re-learn how to walk, with over a million steps taken each month. Building on over a decade of real-world experience and a proprietary neural network trained on billions of steps, we’re bringing mobility beyond clinical settings and into the home. Our personal exoskeleton, Eve, is a first-of-its-kind device designed to assist wheelchair users in standing and walking in everyday life. Now we’re expanding our platform to support industrial and assistive tasks with the Calvin family of humanoid robots. Built in just 40 days, Calvin-40 is designed to relieve factory workers from hazardous labor. Future versions of Calvin will assist persons with reduced autonomy in their daily activities. Our growth into home and industrial robotics opens new …

items.desc: Wir sind Oberösterreichs größte Bildungs- und Forschungseinrichtung mit 27.000 Studierenden und 4.500 Mitarbeitenden. Die Tenure-Track Professur wird der Universitätsklinik für Anästhesiologie und Operative Intensivmedizin an der Medizinischen Fakultät erst- und dem Linz Institute of Technology Artificial Intelligence LAB (LIT AI LAB) zweitzugeordnet. Die Stelle ist für hochqualifizierte Nachwuchswissenschafter*innen mit einem Doktorat/PhD aus dem medizinischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Biologie, Biochemie, Informatik, o.ä.) eingerichtet und bietet die Möglichkeit des Abschlusses einer Qualifizierungsvereinbarung und damit – nach positiver Entscheidung – einer Dauerstelle als Assoziierte*r Professor*in (§ 99 Abs 5 und 6 UG). Mit der ausgeschriebenen Tenure-Track- Professur Intelligent Biosignal Processing soll der Aufbau des Erweiterungsstudiums „Medical AI“ an der JKU maßgeblich vorangetrieben und gemeinsam mit dem Zentrum für Medizinische Lehre organisiert werden. Von dem*der erfolgreichen Bewerber*in wird weiters erwartet, im Rahmen der Forschungsaktivitäten an der JKU, mathematische Modellierung, maschinelles Lernen und medizinische Signalverarbeitung zu verbinden, um diagnostische Verfahren zu optimieren. Die Methoden sollen sowohl der Verbesserung der Signalqualität als auch der Untersuchung der Relevanz der Signale im Hinblick auf unterschiedliche pathologische Prozesse dienen. Besonderes Augenmerk wird bei allen Analysen auf die klinische Anwendbarkeit der erhaltenen Ergebnisse gelegt. Sämtliche Analysen sind daher eng mit der klinischen Bedeutung und Aussagekraft verbunden. Der*Die Stelleninhaber*in der Tenure-Track Professur für Intelligent Biosignal Processing soll eine hohe Bereitschaft zur interdisziplinären und zur interprofessionellen Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Fachrichtungen sowie zu Berufsgruppen der Pflege und medizinisch-technischen Diensten mitbringen. Der*Die Kandidat*in muss bereits eine wissenschaftliche Tätigkeit nach dem Doktorat/PhD und sollte weiters exzellente Publikationen und Lehrerfahrung sowie erfolgreiche Drittmittelakquise vorweisen, wobei der Abschluss des Doktorats-/Ph.D.-Studiums höchstens 10 Jahre zurückliegen sollte (Karriereunterbrechungen auf Grund von Elternkarenz, Wehr(ersatz)dienst, usw. sind abzuziehen). Die detaillierte Stellenbeschreibung sowie Hinweise zu den Voraussetzungen finden Sie unter www.jku.at/tenuretrack . Die Johannes Kepler Universität strebt eine Erhöhung des Anteils an Frauen im wissenschaftlichen Personal an und fordert deshalb qualifizierte Frauen nachdrücklich auf, sich zu bewerben. items.desc: Är du en erfaren AI/ML-utvecklare som vill utveckla och produktionssätta lösningar som gör skillnad på riktigt? Då kan du vara en bra match för oss på Softhouse! Då konsultrollen innebär mycket kundkontakt krävs det att du är flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. I Stockholm hittar du oss på Tegnérgatan, högst upp i en härlig vindsvåning, där vi är närmare 40 kollegor. I Uppsala huserar våra konsulter på Svartbäcksgatan med utsikt över Domkyrkan. items.desc: Combineer technologie en innovatie en maak positieve impact op de wereld! Onze oplossingen helpen voedselverspilling te verminderen, productieketens duurzamer te maken en de kwaliteit van voedsel en planten te verhogen. Zo dragen we bij aan een gezondere en efficiëntere wereld. Sluit jij je aan bij ons team en help je mee het verschil te maken? Een klant komt met een duidelijke vraag: kan ons systeem onderscheid maken tussen rijp en onrijp fruit of zelfs rotte exemplaren detecteren, voordat het verpakt wordt? Jij stapt in de auto, laptop in de tas, richting productielocatie. Daar observeer je de lijn. Hoe ligt het fruit op de band? Hoe moet je belichten, kunnen we de juiste data verzamelen? Camera positioneren, belichting afstellen, eerste beelden schieten. Binnen no-time staat er een kleine testomgeving waar jij data verzamelt. Ruwe beelden, maar waardevol. Op kantoor duik je in de beelden. Je zoekt patronen, afwijkingen, bruikbare kenmerken. Je stelt niet alleen vast wat zichtbaar moet zijn, maar ook hoe het visionmodel daarop moet kunnen reageren. Misschien ontwikkel je een eenvoudige pre-analyse, of overleg je met een collega over de keuze tussen een traditioneel algoritme of een neuraal netwerk. Uiteindelijk lever je niet alleen beelddata of een stukje techniek, je selecteert de camera's en lenzen en je configureert de belichting zoals vereist door het project. Technisch inzicht en kennis kan jij vertalen naar gerealiseerde, praktische oplossingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Vision Engineer speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen, analyseren en implementeren van industriële vision-oplossingen binnen geautomatiseerde systemen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige traject: van probleemanalyse en het selecteren van geschikte camera’s, lenzen en verlichting, tot het verzamelen en analyseren van beeldmateriaal en het opstellen van duidelijke eisen voor algoritmeontwikkeling. Je combineert een technische en wetenschappelijke aanpak met een goed gevoel voor praktische toepasbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met onze software developers, system engineers en projectteams om ervoor te zorgen dat de visionoplossing robuust, herhaalbaar en goed te integreren is. Denk aan projecten zoals bovenstaande, een eierinspectiesysteem dat afwijkingen herkent voordat het ei de volgende productiefase ingaat, of een cameraopstelling die plantjes scant op groei en gezondheid. Je combineert je kennis van algoritmen met praktische inzichten om het optimale resultaat te bereiken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Opstellen van functionele en technische requirements voor vision-systemen. Plannen en uitvoeren van beeldacquisities (zowel intern als op locatie), inclusief opstelling en parametrisering. Analyseren van ruwe beelddata en evalueren van algoritmische aanpakken in samenwerking met vision developers. Documenteren van waarnemingen, keuzes en systeemparameters in gestructureerde technische documentatie. Selecteren van geschikte hardware: camera’s, lenzen en belichtingsopstellingen, afgestemd op producttype, snelheid, nauwkeurigheid en omgevingscondities. Samenwerken met software developers aan de implementatie van vision pipelines, inclusief annotatiebehoeften, model keuzes en testprocedures. Afstemmen met system engineers om de visionoplossing integraal af te stemmen op de mechanische en automatiseringsarchitectuur van de machine. Actief bijdragen aan FAT/SAT en validatietesten: je controleert niet alleen of het systeem werkt, maar ook waarom. items.desc: Om stillingen Institutt for informasjonsteknologi ved Fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design har en ledig åremålsstilling som stipendiat innen pålitelig KI med verifikasjon av kunnskap. Nåværende arbeidssted for stillingen er på campus Pilestredet i Oslo. I forbindelse med etableringen av ny campus på Lillestrøm kan det bli aktuelt med endring av arbeidssted på et senere tidspunkt. Dine ansvarsområder og arbeidsoppgaver vil være å Dette prosjektet er banebrytende i utviklingen av et nevro-symbolsk KI-rammeverk som adresserer den kritiske «hallusinasjons»-barrieren i generativ KI (GenAI). Per i dag fungerer GenAI-modeller som probabilistiske «svarte bokser» som ofte produserer plausible, men faktisk feilaktig informasjon uten kildehenvisning. Dette utgjør uakseptable risikoer, særlig i høyrisiko-domener som for eksempel utdanning, trafikksikkerhet og fornybar energi. For å håndtere dette utvikler prosjektet et generaliserbart nevro-symbolsk verifikasjonsrammeverk, med mål om systematisk å transformere GenAI til etterprøvbare, verifiserbare og sosialt ansvarlige systemer for høy-risiko- og datafattige domener. Prosjektet undersøker hybride rammeverk hvor GenAI fungerer som semantiske tolkningsmoduler, mens symbolske logikkmoduler — som resonerer over strukturerte grafer eller regler — fungerer som faktasjekkere. Stipendiaten Vil Utføre Følgende Oppgaver rammeverk design og implementering utvikling av resonneringsalgoritmer og validering. Det primære bruksområdet bygger på en KI-forsterket nettplattform for nord-samisk språklæring. Doktorgradsprosjektet vil utvikle en modulær verifikasjonsmotor integrerti plattformen for å sikre at KI-generert innhold er språklig korrekt og kulturelt passende. To tilleggstilfeller kan velges for å teste generaliserbarheten til det foreslåtte rammeverket: autonom kjøring og informasjonsmodellering for bærekraft. Det forventes at PhD prosjektet involverer akademisk samarbeid med Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT, Germany). Beslutningen om 3- eller 4- årigstilling vil bli diskutert som en del av intervjuene i ansettelsesprosessen. Som stipendiat ved OsloMet har du mulighet til å søke om stipend for lengre forskningsopphold i utlandet. Kvalifikasjonskrav Mastergrad/hovedfag innen informatikk, matematikk, ingeniørfag eller tilsvarende relaterte fagdisipliner. Graden må normalt inneholde 120 studiepoeng (ECTS). items.card: About The Role Applications are invited for a 12 months full-time postdoctoral position (with the possibility for extension) in Experimental Quantum Technology at the University of Sussex. Applicants should have obtained a PhD in experimental quantum information, laser- or atomic physics and be able to demonstrate working experience in this field. The appointment is within the framework of the EPSRC Quantum
items.desc: Salary £38 – £46 pa Job Type Contract Work Pattern Full-time Posted 20 Oct 2026 (Yesterday) {}); } }"> Share Save job Create job alert Salary £38 – £46 pa Job Type Contract Work Pattern Full-time Posted 20 Oct 2026 (Yesterday) {}); } }"> Share Save job Create job alert About The Role Applications are invited for a 12 months full-time postdoctoral position (with the possibility for extension) in Experimental Quantum Technology at the University of Sussex. Applicants should have obtained a PhD in experimental quantum information, laser- or atomic physics and be able to demonstrate working experience in this field. The appointment is within the framework of the EPSRC Quantum Technology Hub: Quantum Computing via Integrated and Interconnected Implementations. The successful candidate will work in a team of experienced researchers led by Prof Matthias Keller. The aim of the project is to combine two of the most successful techniques in quantum information processing, trapped ions and photons, and use them to create a distributed quantum network. The main challenge is the implementation of an efficient ion-photon interface based on strongly-coupled cavity-QED. We have developed a multi-zone ion trap that incorporates zones for loading, quantum information processing, and a cavity-based ion-photon interface. The first part of the project is to test and characterise the ion trap system and implement a highly efficient ion-photon interface. This involves the setting up and testing of the system as well as simulating and implementing novel schemes for ion-photon entanglement. Based on successful testing of the multi-zone trap, a second system will be established to implement a basic quantum network. About You Ideally, you will have a PhD in experimental quantum information, laser- or atomic physics and be able to demonstrate working experience in this field. The project requires working with a complex optical system with diode lasers, ultra-high vacuum systems, and control electronics to operate the experiment. Having experience and a good understanding of such systems is highly beneficial. About Our School We are a research-intensive School that simultaneously delivers outstanding teaching to our students. As such we aim to be consistently recognised as truly world leading in key areas of our science, by extending the international excellence, impact and visibility of our research. We aim to be within the top UK universities in our discipline areas, attracting high-quality students at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. We will establish a reputation as having a particularly open, stimulating, collaborative and supportive working environment for both staff and students, enabling the best possible outcomes for research, teaching and learning. We will further enhance our links with non-academic actors on local, national and international scales, and will maximize the impact of our work. Why work here Find Out More About Our Reward And Benefits Package. Find out about our equality, diversity and inclusion. Further Key Information Please contact Matthias Keller () for informal enquiries. The University is committed to equality and valuing diversity, and applications are particularly welcomed from women and black and minority ethnic candidates, who are under-represented in academic posts in Science, Technology, Engineering, Medicine and Mathematics (STEMM) at Sussex. The University of Sussex values the diversity of its staff and students, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Eligibility The University requires that work undertaken for the University is performed in the UK.

items.desc: Als Data Scientist werk je in een omgeving waarin je bedrijfsproblemen begrijpt en oplost. Daarvoor gebruik je grote hoeveelheden data. Je ontwikkelt oplossingen voor het Delivery & Installation-domein en brengt die succesvol in productie. Zo help je Coolblue betere planningsbeslissingen te nemen. Wat doe je als Data Scientist Delivery Domain bij Coolblue? Het ontwikkelen, industrialiseren en beheren van data-scienceoplossingen is een belangrijk onderdeel van ons werk. Je werkt met moderne methoden, technologieën en grote hoeveelheden data uit verschillende bronnen. Je ontwikkelt forecasts voor capaciteit, workload en transporten en gebruikt SQL om data te ontsluiten. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team van data scientists, data-analisten en analytics engineers. Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en te leren, met begeleiding en coaching van ervaren mede-Coolblue’ers. Zo maak je Coolblue elke dag een beetje beter. Forecasts en modellen ontwikkelen waarmee het Delivery & Installation-domein betere planningsbeslissingen kan nemen, bijvoorbeeld over personele capaciteit, workload en het benodigde aantal transporten. Met stakeholders bespreken wat zij nodig hebben en samenwerken met domeinspecialisten, data-analisten, analytics engineers, data scientists en development teams om tot betere oplossingen te komen. Onze eigen modelleringssoftware ontwikkelen en verbeteren door kwalitatief hoogwaardige, production-ready Python-code te schrijven. Je zorgt daarbij voor goed geteste, onderhoudbare en schaalbare code en betrouwbare pipelines die geschikt zijn voor gebruik in de dagelijkse operatie. Data uit verschillende systemen ontsluiten d.m.v. SQL, zodat complexe operationele vraagstukken helder en inzichtelijk worden. Duidelijke technische documentatie schrijven, zodat modellen, code en pipelines begrijpelijk, onderhoudbaar en overdraagbaar zijn. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je hebt een master in Wiskunde, Informatica, Econometrie, Operations Research, Statistiek of een vergelijkbare kwantitatieve richting. Je woont in Nederland. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal tot in de puntjes. Je combineert inzicht in bedrijfsvraagstukken met sterk analytisch denkvermogen. Je hebt ervaring met SQL Je hebt goede kennis van Python. Je neemt eigenaarschap over je producten en bewaakt zelf de kwaliteit. Je vindt het leuk om samen met collega’s te brainstormen en ideeën en producten steeds beter te maken. Je ziet feedback als een kans om jezelf en je werk verder te verbeteren. Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren en onderhouden van data science-producten in productieomgevingen, met focus op meer waarde voor stakeholders en Coolblue. Je houdt van zowel onderzoek als software-engineering. Je hebt eerder gewerkt in een data-sciencefunctie. Dit zoek jij verder in een baan Geld. Ongekend goede werksfeer. Waar we met elkaar omgaan als vrienden en je gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Maandelijkse borrels, versbereide happen, legendarische Coolblue-feesten en de leukste teamactiviteiten. Een fijne combinatie van werken op kantoor en vanuit huis. Natuurlijk zorgen we dat je thuis een top werkplek hebt. Inclusief bureaustoel, laptop en blauwe slingers. Alle ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën, initiatieven en keuzes. Jij doet je werk op jouw manier. Reiskostenvergoeding, pensioenregeling en een vergoeding voor als je thuiswerkt. 25 vakantiedagen. Als je belooft dat je terugkomt. Een kantoor waar je foto's van wilt maken op een toplocatie. Vanaf Rotterdam Centraal is het 3 keer vallen voor je er bent. Oké, het is 2 minuten lopen. Meer dan 100 trainingen in onze eigen Studiefabriek om elke dag een beetje beter te worden. Korting op alle spullen die we verkopen.

items.desc: The UK Hub for Predictive and AI-Enabled Human Disease Models is a UK national research initiative funded by the Medical Research Council (MRC), which aims to translate academic New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) into validated, industry-ready systems. The Hub brings together leading scientists, clinicians and commercial organisations to accelerate the development, validation and adoption of predictive human disease models for biomedical research, drug discovery and experimental medicine. The Hub is based at the Cambridge Stem Cell Institute (CSCI), University of Cambridge. The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Matthias Zilbauer at the Cambridge Stem Cell Institute. The group specialises in human intestinal stem cell biology, organoid technology and the study of intestinal health and disease, with a particular focus on epithelial biology and epigenetic regulation. We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Postdoctoral Research Associate to contribute to the development, optimisation and validation of human intestinal organoid models as part of this ambitious national programme. The postholder will play a key role in expanding the human intestinal organoid biobank, contributing to the Hub's target of establishing an additional 2,000 organoid lines. They will develop and optimise organoid culture systems, support the introduction of automated culture workflows and undertake molecular and epigenetic profiling, including DNA methylation profiling, spatial transcriptomics and other multi-omics approaches. The role will involve independent and collaborative research, including the development of functional assays and application of molecular and cellular techniques to characterise intestinal organoid models. The postholder will work closely with researchers, clinicians and external partners to support the development of robust, reproducible and predictive human disease models. The Successful Candidate Will Have A PhD in Stem Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology or a closely related discipline. Demonstrated hands-on experience in establishing, maintaining, expanding and cryopreserving human intestinal organoid cultures. Experience with molecular biology techniques and molecular profiling approaches, including DNA methylation, transcriptomics or related multi-omics methods. Experience with CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing or related genetic manipulation techniques. Basic knowledge or experience of bioinformatic analysis. Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to undertake independent research and work collaboratively. Experience with advanced imaging, flow cytometry, organoid-derived monolayers or automated cell culture workflows would be advantageous. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a major national research initiative, working at the interface of human stem cell biology, disease modelling and translational research. The position offers opportunities to develop new experimental approaches, work with academic and industry partners, and contribute to research with applications in biomedical science and drug discovery. Appointment at Research Associate level is dependent on having a PhD, an equivalent research doctorate. Those who have submitted but not yet received their PhD will be appointed at Research Assistant level (Grade 5), which will be amended to Research Associate once PhD has been awarded. Full-time: 1.0 FTE Fixed-term until 31/03/2030 Informal enquiries: Professor Matthias Zilbauer - mz304@medschl.cam.ac.uk To apply online for this vacancy and view further information about the role, please use the University of Cambridge recruitment website. Click the 'Apply' button below to register an account with our recruitment system (if you have not already) and apply online. Applicants must have (or be close to obtaining) a PhD. Appointment at Research Associate level is dependent on having a PhD. Those who have submitted but not yet received their PhD will initially be appointed as a Research Assistant (Grade 5, Point 38 £34,132) moving to Research Associate (Grade 7) upon confirmation of your PhD award. Please ensure that you upload a covering letter and CV in the Upload section of the online application. The covering letter should outline how you match the criteria for the post and why you are applying for this role. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. Please include details of your referees, including email address and phone number, one of which must be your most recent line manager. Please quote reference PS51462 on your application and in any correspondence about this vacancy. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society. The University has a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK.

In questo ruolo, avrà l'opportunità di guidare progetti complessi, dall'ideazione alla messa in produzione, collaborando strettamente con clienti e team multidisciplinari per creare valore attraverso l'innovazione tecnologica. items.desc: Are you a Data Scientist that likes building and owning products? At Pine59, we are developing products for the rapidly growing data industry and the need to know how humans interact with the physical world. We innovate to create products which leverage sources of temporal and spatial data that helps explain human and device movement. Our products are built to help with city planning, making decisions within retail and real estate, emergency planning and more. With the acceleration of AI the opportunity to grow and develop a high quality location data product is optimal. As a result, we are not only developers, we are inventors and product owners! We wish to drive the industry forward by creating tools that have not been possible previously, due to new advances in cloud technology, AI, and location data. Do you want to take ownership and be part of that journey? Come and join us! Pine59 is an equal opportunity employer and we encourage you to apply We are hiring a Data Scientist At Pine59, we are products from the largest communications datasets available. This is a rapidly growing industry, and our product scope and reach is expanding to meet this demand. As a result, we are excited to be expanding our team, and are searching for an enthusiastic Data Scientist with a product mindset to join us. Our teams are multidisciplinary, with product, data engineering, data science, machine learning, and data analysis coming together in one team to develop competitive products. While closely collaborating with various teams and stakeholders within the company, we have the freedom of innovation and experimentation to develop high-quality and privacy-friendly location data insights that can change the location data industry for good. Specifically for the role we are looking for, you will develop and improve statistical data products used by clients around the world. Pine59 emphasizes anonymisation and privacy, ensuring the location events never even have to leave a customer's servers (thus ensuring security). It is important that you have a strong product and value oriented mindset and want to understand the true end value of what we are building. This is an on-site hybrid position (with 3-4 days in the week working in our Oslo office, or more if you want!). Our main office is on Karl Johans Gate in the heart of Oslo, where we meet every week with our international colleagues. Being part of Pine59 means being part of a friendly and efficient workplace, with opportunities to grow and advance within the company. Key Responsibilities Be part of a team owning location data products end to end: methodology, validation, production pipelines, and the quality and usefulness of what clients receive Invent and improve the methods that turn vast quantities of anonymised location data into reliable aggregate data products Validate results against ground truth and external sources, quantify bias and uncertainty, and track down the cause when the numbers shift Build robust data pipelines in BigQuery SQL and Python, with monitoring that detects data drift and quality issues before they reach clients Required Qualifications You have an academic degree equivalent to a Bachelor's or higher in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, computer science, physics or engineering You have at least 2 years of professional experience in data science You have a strong ownership mentality and passion for what you build You have rich experience in using Python and SQL for data processing (preferably within the BigQuery dialect) You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and in person, and can explain technical results to people without a technical background You are a positive force. Adaptable and full of curiosity, you enjoy a high degree of collaboration and working in a team You are value oriented and want to understand how the products you build are used You have some basic Data Engineering skills (Airflow especially) You have experience working with geospatial data You are adept at using AI tooling to be effective Most relevant technologies BigQuery Python Git Apache Airflow Visualization tools: Kepler.gl, matplotlib, + What we expect of you We expect you to be positive-minded with a “can do” attitude to tackle challenges together with your team We are a startup, so things can change fast and you need to be agile and proactive on this journey. We have customers using the product daily, so you will take part in an on-call rotation, during normal working hours only

items.desc: Pricing Data Scientist (PhD – Maths / Statistics / Physics) | London, hybrid | £80,000–£100,000 + up to 20% bonus Finished a quantitative PhD and want your first industry role to be one with real ownership? A fast-growing, well-funded UK consumer business is creating a new pricing data science position. At the moment its prices are largely uniform across customers. The plan is to move to pricing that reflects the risk and value of each customer, and this hire will lead that work from the start. What you’ll do Work out which customer and product characteristics drive cost to serve, and turn them into pricing models that can be explained and defended Design and run controlled price tests, and build the company’s first demand elasticity curves Build customer lifetime value models so pricing decisions weigh long-term value as well as short-term volume Present findings to senior leadership, including board-level stakeholders What they’re looking for A PhD in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science or a related field, with a strong academic record from a leading university Confidence with the maths behind the methods: regression and GLMs, experimental design and causal inference (Bayesian methods a plus) Clean, reproducible Python, plus SQL and Git, or the ability to pick them up quickly The ability to explain technical work to non-technical colleagues Interest in the commercial trade-offs between growth, profit and customer value No pricing or industry experience is needed. Ability, rigour and curiosity matter more than job history here. Why it’s worth a look: a new problem, real data, direct financial impact and strong senior visibility. You’d join a small, hands-on team in a modern cloud data environment. Pricing Data Scientist (PhD – Maths / Statistics / Physics) | London, hybrid | £80,000–£100,000 + up to 20% bonus

items.desc: Vill du använda Data Science för att utveckla ett av Sveriges största paketnätverk? På PostNord får du göra data till beslut. PostNord befinner sig i en förändringsresa med stora investeringar i framtidens paketverksamhet. Nu söker de en Data Scientist som vill använda stora mängder data för att skapa konkreta förbättringar i paketverksamheten. Här får du kombinera Data Science, prognostisering och optimering med ett verksamhetsnära och strategiskt perspektiv. PostNord hanterar dagligen mycket stora volymer paket och samlar in stora mängder data genom hela paketflödet. Potentialen är stor – och mycket av informationen kan användas mer för att förstå, förutse och optimera verksamheten. I den här rollen får du vara med och identifiera möjligheterna, utveckla modeller och omsätta analyser till beslutsunderlag som kan påverka allt från bemanning och kapacitet till terminaler, transporter och framtida nätverksdesign. Du tillhör PostNords affärsområde Paket och arbetar i en central funktion med uppdrag mot hela paketorganisationen för Sverige. Vad du kommer att göra Här arbetar du med frågor där data kan ge bättre förståelse för både dagens paketflöden och framtidens pakethantering. Tillsammans med verksamheten identifierar du vad som behöver lösas och hur data kan bidra. Analyserar stora datamängder och omsätter dem till konkreta beslutsunderlag och strategiska beslut inom paketverksamheten. Utvecklar och implementerar tidsserie- och prognosmodeller för paketflöden och paketvolymer. Använder maskininlärning för att utveckla prognosernas noggrannhet och tillförlitlighet. Arbetar med optimering av exempelvis kapacitet, resursallokering, ruttplanering och bemanning. Identifierar tillsammans med verksamheten vilken data som kan användas för att lösa problem och skapa affärsvärde. Använder geodata för analyser kopplade till exempelvis leveransrutter, terminalverksamhet och nätverksdesign. Samarbetar med bland annat Data Engineers och andra specialistfunktioner kring data, AI och Machine Learning. Vem du är Det viktiga är samtidigt att du inte enbart vill arbeta med modeller och data isolerat. Du är nyfiken på verksamheten och vill förstå vilka problem som behöver lösas och hur dina analyser kan bidra till resultat. Du kan hantera komplex information, se helheten och omsätta analys till tydliga rekommendationer. Rollen innebär många samarbeten, vilket gör att du behöver kunna kommunicera dina slutsatser på ett begripligt sätt och trivas med att arbeta tillsammans med olika delar av organisationen. Vad du tar med dig För att lyckas i rollen har du minst fem års erfarenhet inom Data Science och är van att arbeta med stora datamängder. Du har erfarenhet av tidsserieanalys, prognostisering och optimering samt mycket goda kunskaper i programmering, exempelvis Python. Du har arbetat med relevanta Data Science-bibliotek och verktyg såsom NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn eller TensorFlow och har erfarenhet av matematiska optimeringstekniker. Erfarenhet av geospatial analys och GIS-verktyg är meriterande. Du har en kandidat- eller masterexamen inom datavetenskap, statistik, operationsanalys eller motsvarande område och behärskar svenska och engelska mycket väl. Välkommen med din ansökan I den här rekryteringen samarbetar PostNord med med Ada Digital (TNG). Om du har några frågor, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Sandra Peiper på 0709-56 39 46 eller sandra.peiper@adadigital.se. Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan! Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! För fackliga kontaktpersoner se Fackliga kontakter.

Il/La Data Scientist Expert in Bip gioca un ruolo cruciale nello sviluppo e implementazione di soluzioni avanzate di AI e Machine Learning, contribuendo alla trasformazione digitale delle più grandi aziende a livello internazionale. In questo ruolo, avrà l'opportunità di guidare progetti complessi, dall'ideazione alla messa in produzione, collaborando strettamente con clienti e team multidisciplinari per creare valore attraverso l'innovazione tecnologica. I nostri e le nostre Data Scientist Expert opereranno come leader tecnici e mentori all'interno dei team, assicurando la qualità dei progetti e promuovendo l'adozione delle migliori pratiche. Saranno responsabili di progettare, sviluppare e implementare modelli predittivi e algoritmi avanzati, coordinando l'integrazione e l'ottimizzazione con i Data Engineer. In scenari complessi, guideranno l'architettura del progetto, risolvendo problemi tecnici e strategici e garantendo la consegna di soluzioni scalabili ed efficienti. Inoltre, saranno chiamati a contribuire proattivamente allo sviluppo del business, attraverso attività di thought leadership, partecipazione a conferenze e pubblicazione di articoli, nonché supportando le iniziative di ricerca e sviluppo di nuovi servizi, prodotti, e offerte innovative. Git) e framework di versionamento dati/modelli (es. items.desc: Data Scientist – Conversion Experiences Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid working options available) Contract duration: 12 months Salary: £104,000 per year About the Role We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our Conversion Experiences group. Operating much like a dynamic e-commerce unit centered on product data science, this team focuses on optimizing user interactions, consumer-facing retail models, and offerings across major global consumer platforms. Rather than routing traffic off-site, you will work on product analytics to assess total addressable markets, execute feature experiments involving parameters like shipping or organic materials, and evaluate buyer interactions alongside purchasing trends. Workflow cycles feature initial setup and test preparation, a hands-off execution window, evaluation phases, and resolving key analytical inquiries between testing cycles. This position leverages internal proprietary tools, with scripting performed mainly in Python. Please note that backend software engineering and production model deployment fall outside the scope of this role, as team members rely extensively on automated multi-agent frameworks and advanced tooling to execute analytical tasks efficiently. Key Responsibilities Apply knowledge of statistics, machine learning, programming, data modeling, simulation, and advanced mathematics to recognize patterns, identify opportunities, pose business questions, and make valuable discoveries leading to prototype development and product improvement. Use a flexible, analytical approach to design, develop, and evaluate predictive models and advanced algorithms that lead to optimal value extraction from complex and high-dimensional datasets. Generate and test hypotheses, and analyze and interpret the results of product experiments. Work with product engineers to translate prototypes into new products, services, and features, and provide guidelines for large-scale implementation. Provide Business Intelligence (BI) and data visualization support, including support for online customer service dashboards and other ad-hoc requests requiring data analysis and visual support. Key Skills & Requirements Core Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, SQL, and/or R, big data tools, or data visualization platforms like Tableau. E-commerce & Industry Background: Previous experience in the e-commerce sector, specifically within advertising platforms or alongside major retail enterprises. Experimentation Domain Expertise: Strong domain expertise in advertising along with practical, hands-on knowledge of experimentation methodology. Independent Execution: Strong individual contributor (hands-on) capability to drive work independently, rather than acting as a people manager supervising team members. Communication: The ability to communicate effectively in writing, including conveying complex information clearly. Data Experience: Extensive experience working with large datasets. Education: Relevant degree in computer science or in a relevant field. Nice-to-Have Skills: Previous experience within major consumer technology or e-commerce environments. Experience integrating analytics with machine learning infrastructure to autonomously construct and validate feature recommendations for products. Familiarity with cutting-edge automated agent frameworks and AI tooling. What Makes This Role Interesting? Pioneering Innovation: A distinct opportunity to operate at the forefront of AI-powered e-commerce analytics, a space pioneered by very few global organizations utilizing cutting-edge personal agent and automated frameworks. High-Impact Scope: Shape user experiences and consumer interactions at a massive global scale. Autonomous Environment: A strong focus on individual milestone creation, structured quantitative evaluations, and driving core analytical findings to spur direct business impact.

items.card: About the Role As a Statistical Data Scientist, you'll build the statistical models and machine learning methods behind our origin-verification science, then work with teams across Oritain to get those models running within live products and workflows. You'll partner with scientists, engineers, product teams and business stakeholders to turn complex data into solutions that solve real customer problems. From
items.desc: Department: Data Science & Analytics Location: London Description Oritain is a global leader in forensic origin verification of products and raw materials. With offices in Auckland, Dunedin, London, Paris, Singapore and Washington D.C, our vision is to be the source of truth in global supply chains. Through our proprietary methodology, our mission is to harness cutting edge science, data, and specialized services to create a community of origin verified buyers and suppliers, protecting our people and planet. We empower the world’s leading brands to make positive changes across their supply chain; ensuring product integrity, meeting regulatory demands, and reducing the risk of fraud and unethical sourcing - creating real change in our world. About the Role As a Statistical Data Scientist, you'll build the statistical models and machine learning methods behind our origin-verification science, then work with teams across Oritain to get those models running within live products and workflows. You'll partner with scientists, engineers, product teams and business stakeholders to turn complex data into solutions that solve real customer problems. From developing predictive models to improving analytical approaches and supporting decision-making, your work will have a direct impact on our products, customers and future growth. This role sits in a business that is growing fast. We're building, evolving and scaling. That means you'll have the opportunity to shape how things are done, influence decisions, and contribute well beyond the boundaries of a traditional data science role. If you're looking for an environment where ownership is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and your work can genuinely move the business forward, Oritain is the right place for you. What you'll be doing Collect, clean and process data from a range of sources. Build statistical models and machine learning algorithms that turn data into decisions. Develop and deploy predictive models to solve operational and commercial challenges. Build visualisations, dashboards and analytical tools that make insight easy to use. Work closely with cross-functional teams to embed analytical solutions into existing products and workflows. Evaluate and improve modelling approaches using rigorous quantitative assessment. Track developments in statistics and data science and bring the useful ones into our analytics. Provide expert guidance on data science initiatives across the organisation. What we're looking for Essential: A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field (postgraduate study preferred). A minimum of 2 years of commercial experience applying statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to real-world problems. Solid grounding in probability, statistics, uncertainty, linear algebra and calculus. Experience working with large datasets, data transformation and cleaning. Experience with classification, clustering, dimension reduction and other machine learning methods. Experience using software development tools such as VS Code, Conda and GitHub, and working with command line tools and Unix-based operating systems, including environment management. Experience using Python and R to develop and deploy models in cloud environments (Azure experience is advantageous). Understanding of machine learning lifecycles and MLOps principles. Experience working with databases, APIs and collaborative development tools. Sharp problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and sound judgement. Confident communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. An open, curious and learning-oriented approach, with a commitment to doing great work. Nice to have: Experience working with geospatial data / spatial statistics. Experience with Databricks or similar platforms. Experience with HTML, JavaScript or related technologies. Exposure to supply chain, sustainability or risk-focused analytics environments. What you'll get Hybrid working (minimum 3 days per week in our Farringdon office) 35 days paid leave, inclusive of public holidays Birthday off Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave Life insurance Healthcare Cash Plan Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Pension Monthly Wellbeing Allowance Breakfast, snacks, Friday lunch and barista coffee in the office Learning portal with over 100,000 assets for professional development

items.desc: De rol Als Data Scientist verbind je data, statistiek en technologie om organisaties slimmer te laten werken. Je analyseert complexe datasets, ontwikkelt voorspellende modellen en zet data om in inzichten en intelligente oplossingen die concrete businesswaarde opleveren. Je analyseert complexe datasets en ontdekt patronen, trends en verbanden die organisaties helpen betere beslissingen te nemen. Je ontwikkelt, traint en optimaliseert machine learning-modellen en statistische modellen om voorspellingen te doen en complexe vraagstukken op te lossen. Je werkt met Python, SQL en moderne data science-tools en technologieën om data te analyseren, modellen te ontwikkelen en resultaten te valideren. Je ontwikkelt AI-oplossingen en past technieken zoals predictive analytics, natural language processing en generatieve AI toe op uiteenlopende businessvraagstukken. Je ontsluit, verwerkt en transformeert data uit verschillende bronnen en zorgt ervoor dat datasets geschikt zijn voor analyses en modelontwikkeling. Je experimenteert met algoritmes, machine learning-technieken en AI-toepassingen en vertaalt experimenten naar praktische oplossingen. Je werkt met cloudgebaseerde data- en AI-platformen, zoals Microsoft Azure, Azure Machine Learning en Databricks. Je evalueert de prestaties van modellen en verbetert de nauwkeurigheid, betrouwbaarheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten. Dit ben jij Onze factbuilders combineren verwondering, creativiteit en een gezonde dosis eigenzinnigheid. Je beschikt over WO werk- en denkniveau en jaren werkervaring. Je hebt een positieve en proactieve instelling in combinatie met een groot relativeringsvermogen. Het is uiteindelijk maar werk ;) Je investeert in het team met passie en plezier, en krijgt daar veel voor terug. Je kan goed zelfstandig werken, maar weet ook om hulp te vragen waar nodig. Jij kan ook goed samenwerken en communiceren, zodat jij bij opdrachtgevers de juiste mensen weet te vinden. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, het draait niet alleen maar om eentjes en nulletjes. Dit krijg je ervoor terug Een salaris tussen de €4.400,- en €7.600,- bruto per maand Onbeperkt verlof. Hybride werken. Flexibiliteit. Wil je bijvoorbeeld 32 of 36 uur werken? Dat kan allemaal. Een goed salaris, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en senioriteit. Een ruime mobiliteitsregeling met mogelijkheden voor een leaseauto, NS Business Card en meer. Een sportieve omgeving. Wil je een marathon lopen of een toernooi voor het hele team organiseren? Leuk, wij vergoeden het voor je! Ruimte om je zowel persoonlijk als inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen met diverse trainingen, volledig in lijn met jouw ambities. Passie en plezier. Naast hard werken vieren we successen met borrels, uitjes en sportieve activiteiten, zoals ons jaarlijkse skiweekend in Oostenrijk :) We zijn een scale-uporganisatie. Je staat met ons aan de basis van de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Jouw ideeën doen ertoe Dit zijn wij Wij zijn Forfacts, een sterk groeiende consultancy organisatie. Wij geloven in een eenvoudige wereld zonder bureaucratie en helpen organisaties met verandering, procesverbetering en datagedreven werken. Ons uiteindelijke doel? Eenvoud. Hoe doen we dat? We creëren inzicht, vanuit vrijheid en met realisme. Ben jij onze nieuwe Data Scientist? Neem dan rechtstreeks contact op met Rik Govers via rik@forfacts.nl. Kijk voor meer informatie op www.forfacts.nl

items.desc: Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. Data Scientist Quale sarà la tua sfida? Bip ha creato all’interno del proprio Competence Centre “xTech” il più nutrito gruppo di Data Scientist in Italia (fonte: statistiche LinkedIn), e dall’Italia coordina anche i propri gruppi di Data Scientist locali presso le proprie sedi estere. Il/La Data Scientist in Bip evolve non solo le proprie competenze di AI e Machine Learning, ma anche la comprensione dei fenomeni legati al Business dei nostri Clienti e le proprie capacità di tradurli in algoritmi e poi di comunicare e utilizzare i risultati degli stessi per migliorare ed efficientare i processi. I/Le nostri/e Data Scientist verranno introdotti in contesti progettuali dove comprenderanno le esigenze del Cliente, daranno indicazione ai Data Engineer sulla preparazione desiderata dei dati, sceglieranno o costruiranno i migliori mix di modelli più adatti al caso specifico, discuteranno gli output con il cliente e consegneranno il modello per l’ottimizzazione e passaggio in produzione finale ai Data Engineer. In contesti più semplificati in cui la componente di Data Engineering è meno elaborata, i nostri Data Scientist procederanno in autonomia anche nella data preparation e nel porting in produzione dei modelli ingegnerizzati. Oltre alle progettualità, ai/alle Data Scientist sarà richiesto un contributo attivo per alimentare la Community con attività di ricerca, scouting, concept di nuove soluzioni e business development. Sarai tu ad entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti Indispensabili: Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo Laurea Specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Matematica, Informatica, Statistica o discipline affini (STEM); Forte approccio quantitativo e brillanti doti analitiche; Passione e competenza in ambito data exploration, analisi dati e creazione di modelli: il nostro team disegna e sviluppa sistemi a supporto di decisioni strategiche per il business; Competenze statistiche, di Data Mining, Machine Learning; Solida conoscenza e comprovata esperienza in programmazione e scripting con Python Conoscenza di tematiche di Deep Learning, NLP e analisi dati non strutturati Esperienza con strumenti di version control (es. Git); Comprensione di tecnologie legate ai Big Data come Hadoop, MapReduce, Spark Conoscenza approfondita di database relazionali e di costrutti SQL e SQL Programming; Conoscenza di database non relazionali Esperienza comprovata di gestione tecnica delle risorse (persone) su progetto Indispensabile la conoscenza fluente di italiano e inglese professionali Plus: Conoscenza dei linguaggi PySpark o Scala Esperienza di lavoro su piattaforma Databricks Esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni di Gen AI Conoscenza e l’utilizzo di API Cloud di Intelligenza Artificiale dei principali cloud provider (Google, Microsoft, AWS, IBM) e di altri strumenti di Advanced Analytics di Vendor specializzati Conoscenza di tecniche di semi-supervised e self-supervised learning. Esperienza con framework di lavoro AGILE (esempio: Scrum, Kanban) Soft Skills: Standing consulenziale Spiccate doti comunicative e interpersonali Orientamento al cliente e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi Adattabilità e flessibilità Precisione e stress tolerance nel rispetto delle scadenze Ottime capacità di gestione di progettualità complesse Capacità di coordinamento di un team Disponibilità per trasferte in Italia e all’estero. Perchè Bip? Crescita e Formazione Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale. Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. Salute & Benefits Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati. Famiglia e Genitorialità Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda. Inclusione e Valori Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99). Cosa offriamo / What we offer La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui , in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato. L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL …

items.title: Data Scientist
items.card: Responsibilities Lead product analytics and experimentation initiatives to improve conversion, engagement and purchasing experiences. Design, execute and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments, measuring their impact on customer behaviour and business outcomes. Analyse large-scale datasets to identify purchasing trends, market opportunities and opportunities for product improvement. Apply statistical analysis
items.desc: Contract: 12 months Salary: £104,000 per annum + 15% bonus, paid annual leave and pension Location: Remote within UK About the Opportunity We are recruiting a Data Scientist to join a global technology company, working within a product data science team focused on e-commerce, advertising and conversion experiences. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact consumer-facing products, using advanced analytics, experimentation and AI-powered tools to understand purchasing behaviour, optimise product features and improve conversion performance. The successful candidate will bring strong experience in e-commerce, advertising analytics and product experimentation , alongside the ability to independently translate complex data into actionable commercial recommendations. Key Responsibilities Lead product analytics and experimentation initiatives to improve conversion, engagement and purchasing experiences. Design, execute and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments, measuring their impact on customer behaviour and business outcomes. Analyse large-scale datasets to identify purchasing trends, market opportunities and opportunities for product improvement. Apply statistical analysis and Python/SQL to investigate hypotheses and generate actionable insights. Evaluate product features and customer experiences, using quantitative evidence to recommend improvements. Leverage AI-powered analytics tools and automated workflows to accelerate research and experimentation. Partner with Product, Engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to influence product strategy and decision-making. Present complex analytical findings clearly, connecting recommendations to measurable commercial outcomes. Required Experience Strong background in product data science or product analytics within e-commerce, advertising platforms or large-scale retail environments. Proven experience designing and evaluating product experiments, including A/B testing and statistical analysis. Strong understanding of digital advertising, consumer behaviour, conversion funnels and commercial performance metrics. Hands-on experience using Python and SQL for data analysis. Experience working with large, complex datasets and translating findings into product recommendations. Demonstrated ability to independently own analytical projects from problem definition through to recommendations. Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills. Desirable Experience Previous experience working within major technology companies or large-scale consumer platforms. Experience using AI tools, intelligent agents or automated analytical workflows. Familiarity with machine learning applications for product recommendations and feature optimisation. Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams on large-scale experimentation initiatives. Why Consider This Opportunity? You will join an established product data science function working on innovative e-commerce experiences used at significant scale. The role offers exposure to AI-powered analytical tools, complex product experimentation and commercially meaningful decisions, with the opportunity to directly influence conversion performance. Interested? Apply with your updated CV to discuss the opportunity in more detail. Shortlisting soon!

items.desc: Alma Real Estate Insights tekee data- ja analytiikkapalveluita asuntokaupan, asuntoluototuksen ja kiinteistösijoittamisen ammattilaisille. Asuntopuntari arvioi asuntojen arvoa ja hintakehitystä koneoppimismalleilla, ja Aluepuntari kokoaa asuinalueiden markkinatiedon ja ennusteet yhteen. Palveluitamme käyttävät pankit, välittäjät ja sijoittajat, ja Asuntopuntari valittiin vuoden datatalousinnovaatioksi AI Gaalassa 2025. Etsimme Data & ML Engineeriä Helsinkiin. Tiimimme vastaa datan koko elinkaaresta: keruusta ja käsittelystä malleihin ja tuotteistukseen asti. Roolisi Pidät datan liikkeessä lähteistä tuotteisiin ja koneoppimismallit ajan tasalla. Käytännössä ylläpidät ja kehität Airflow-dataputkia ja niiden takana olevia tietokantoja, hallitset pilvi-infraa koodina, koulutat ja julkaiset Asuntopuntarin malleja Azure ML:ssä ja SageMakerissa ja selvität, miksi niiden tulokset muuttuivat. Lisäksi kehität LLM-pohjaisia ominaisuuksia, kuten aluekuvauksia tai taloyhtiötietoanalyysiä. Arvostamme erityisesti, jos olet kehittänyt ja ylläpitänyt ajastettuja dataputkia tuotannossa kirjoitat sujuvasti Pythonia ja SQL:ää hallitset infran koodina (esim. Terraform tai CDK) ja olet rakentanut CI/CD-putkia olet ylläpitänyt koneoppimismalleja tuotannossa: uudelleenkoulutus, monitorointi, kontitus ja julkaisu tunnet AWS:n datapalvelut (S3, Redshift, Athena ym.). Azure- ja GCP-kokemus on plussaa. Lisäksi eduksi on, jos ymmärrät rajapintakehitystä Pythonilla asuntomarkkinaa ja sitä, miten datalla palvellaan alan eri toimijoita ML- ja AI-mallien kehittämistä. Käytössämme Python, SQL, Airflow, Terraform, CDK, GitHub Actions, Docker AWS (S3, Redshift, Athena, DynamoDB, Lambda, SageMaker, Bedrock) Azure (ML, App Services) GCP (BigQuery, Gemini, ADK) FastAPI, Flask Tutustu Tekemiseemme https://www.almainsights.fi/kaikki-tuotteet-ja-palvelut/asuntopuntari/ https://www.almainsights.fi/blogi/ennennakematonta-lapinakyvyytta-suomen-asuntomarkkinoille/ https://www.almarealestate.fi/tuotteet/aluepuntari/ Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme näköalapaikan ainutlaatuisessa liiketoimintakokonaisuudessa. Alma Real Estateen kuuluvat dataratkaisujen lisäksi muun muassa Etuovi.com ja Vuokraovi.com, kaupallisten kiinteistöjen markkinapaikat Suomessa ja Ruotsissa, kiinteistönvälitysjärjestelmät sekä digitaalisen asunto- ja kiinteistökaupan edelläkävijä DIAS. Pääset työskentelemään datan parissa, jolla on todellista asiakasarvoa ja merkitystä. Ratkaisujamme käyttävät Suomen keskeiset asuntokaupan, pankki- ja kiinteistösijoittamisen toimijat. Tarjoamme Sinulle vastuullisen roolin kokeneessa ja kompaktissa tiimissä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa siihen, miten dataa hyödynnetään tuotteissamme monipuolisia ja kiinnostavia datalähteitä sekä haastavia teknisiä ongelmia Alma Median laajan data-, teknologia- ja kehittäjäyhteisön tuen modernit työskentelytavat ja mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi työskentelyn hybridimallilla ja toimiston hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä Helsingissä tai Tampereella rennon ja mutkattoman työyhteisön, jossa saat olla oma itsesi. Toimimme tuotevetoisesti ja ketterästi. Rakennamme ratkaisuja pitkäjänteisesti, opimme tekemisestä ja kehitämme palveluita jatkuvan palautteen perusteella. Työskentelemme monipaikkaisesti ja joustavasti sekä etänä että viihtyisässä Alma-talossa Helsingin Töölönlahdella. Toimipisteemme ovat esteettömiä. Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi 15.11. mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut heti hakemusten saapuessa. Lähetä hakemus ja kerro siinä taustastasi ja siitä, mikä tässä roolissa kiinnostaa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Rasmus Siljander, AI & Data Lead rasmus.siljander@almamedia.fi Tutustu Almaan Työnantajana https://almamedia.dev/ https://www.almamedia.fi/tyopaikat/ Alma työnantajana Meille almalaisille tärkeitä asioita ovat rohkeus, yhteistyö ja ystävällinen kulttuuri, jossa jokainen saa olla oma itsensä. Rohkeus ei tarkoita vain suuria näkyviä tekoja, vaan myös pieniä arjen hetkiä: uskallusta sanoa mielipiteensä, tehdä asioita uudella tavalla, kokeilla ja oppia virheistä. Työskentelemme jatkuvasti muuttuvassa ympäristössä, ja siksi etsimme ihmisiä, joita innostaa kehittäminen ja halu kasvaa kanssamme. Lupauksemme sinulle 💜 Ystävällinen kulttuuri, jossa saat olla oma itsesi Saat vastuuta ja vapautta työhösi. Arvostamme tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välillä. Monipuoliset henkilöstöetumme tukevat hyvinvointiasi. 🌟 Työ, jolla on merkitystä ja vaikutusta Meillä pääset työskentelemään tunnettujen ja arvostettujen brändien parissa. Palvelumme ovat tärkeitä miljoonille ihmisille arjen päätöksissä. 🚀 Kasvua, jota vauhdittaa tekoäly Saat käyttöösi työsi kannalta oleelliset AI-työkalut ja mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti. Odotamme almalaisilta halua oppia, uudistua ja kasvaa tekoälyn vauhdittamassa arjessa.

items.desc: Date: 21 oct. 2026 Lieu Puteaux, FR Société: CANAL+ TECH Bienvenue chez CANAL+ ! Séries, films, documentaires, émissions, sports, …Ce qui nous tient à cœur c’est de créer les meilleurs contenus et une expérience immersive pour nos millions d’abonnés : émotions et sensations garanties ! Et si vous passiez derrière l’écran ? Vous trouverez forcément votre place parmi nos 15 000 passionnés dans le monde ! Pour être au courant de nos dernières actualités, n’hésitez pas à nous suivre sur LinkedIn et X ! 💻 Les équipes DATA & IA CANAL+ ? + de 100 expertes et experts qui transforment les données en leviers de performance et développent de nouveaux usages innovants. Elles conçoivent des solutions d’intelligence artificielle et des produits data à fort impact pour accompagner nos équipes métiers dans leurs décisions 🔎 Plus précisément, vous rejoindrez notre direction AI Factory d’une quarantaine de personnes qui s’occupent de construire la plateforme agentique IA du Groupe Canal+. La direction est composée de 4 équipes : AI Platform, AI Products, Business Science Portfolio et Business Science Content. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe Business Science Content qui rend la performance des contenus mesurable, prédictible et comparable à l’échelle du Groupe. Elle aide les équipes à mieux acheter, programmer et valoriser les contenus grâce à la donnée. Notre Stack technique : Python, SQL, Dataiku Nos Projets Développer nos modèles de scoring de performance des contenus à destination de nos équipes en France et à l’international (Outre-mer & Pologne) Travailler sur la segmentation de la consommation de nos abonnés 🎯 Votre rôle et vos missions Transformer les enjeux Contenus en décisions data : identifier les besoins, définir les indicateurs clés et formuler des recommandations concrètes. Développer des modèles à fort impact : segmentation, prédiction de performance, valorisation des contenus et tests A/B. Fédérer les expertises data du Groupe : capitaliser sur les travaux locaux, partager les bonnes pratiques et construire une feuille de route commune. Industrialiser les solutions IA : faire passer les prototypes en production avec AI Platform, dans le respect des standards de qualité, de documentation et de réutilisabilité. Mesurer et démontrer la valeur créée : rendre les résultats accessibles, outiller la prise de décision et suivre l’impact dans la durée. 🏆 Et si on parlait de vous ? Bac+5 en statistique, économétrie, data science, mathématiques appliquées ou école d’ingénieurs. Première expérience en data science appliquée, de 0 à 3 ans, stages et alternance compris. Maîtrise de Python, SQL, machine learning, statistiques et tests A/B, avec une première expérience du cloud et des pratiques de développement comme Git, les tests et la documentation. Intérêt pour l’IA générative et les agents IA, idéalement dans les médias, le streaming, le divertissement ou le sport. Vous maîtrisez couramment le français et l’anglais, dans un contexte international. Esprit business, pédagogie, autonomie et goût du travail en équipe dans un contexte international. Une première mise en production d’un modèle utilisé par des équipes métier serait un véritable atout. Et le process ? Un 1er contact avec le tech recruiter + 1 entretien avec le Team Leader + 1 entretien technique + 1 entretien avec notre Directeur de l’AI Factory + 1 café ou déjeuner avec l’équipe, environ 3 semaines en tout, en visio ou en physique comme vous le souhaitez ! 🎁 Les + Un abonnement CANAL+ pour être incollable sur nos univers ! Des avant-premières de films et séries dans notre salle de cinéma Des visites de nos plateaux et des participations à nos émissions Participation & Intéressement Jusqu’à 3 jours d’engagement solidaire par an au profit de nos associations partenaires CSE attractif : chèques vacances et noël, prime mariage / pacs / naissance, réduction abonnement sportif / billetteries / voyages / loisirs, … + de sport et d’activités bien-être à tarif réduit grâce à notre partenariat avec l’application Wellpass Et parce que nous voulons vous aider à vous épanouir et vous perfectionner : des formations régulières, des participations à des conférences en interne ou en externe, … ! 🏡 Et le télétravail dans tout ça ? Vous pourrez en bénéficier jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine ! En tant que média international, CANAL+ est conscient de son impact environnemental, sociétal et éthique. Derrière comme devant la caméra, nous soutenons une création ambitieuse, inclusive et respectueuse des limites planétaires. 🌍 Nous décarbonons notre industrie 🤝 Nous révélons des talents de tous horizons et renforçons la diversité à l’écran 👊 Nous développons l’accessibilité de nos contenus et faisons vivre cette accessibilité en interne, en accompagnant avec attention les personnes en situation de handicap grâce à des aménagements adaptés tout au long de leur parcours chez CANAL+ Si vous voyez cette annonce, c’est que vous avez votre chance et que nous n’avons pas encore trouvé la perle rare ! 👉 …
