items.desc: Tule rakentamaan rokotetutkimuksen data- ja AI-ratkaisuja Koetko vetoa merkityksellistä rokotetutkimustyötä kohtaan? Haluatko hyödyntää dataa ja tekoälyä ratkaisuissa, jotka tukevat tutkimuksen laatua, sujuvaa toimintaa ja terveyttä edistäviä kehitysharppauksia? Meillä on erityistehtävä: sinun terveytesi. Rokotteilla parannetaan ihmisten elämänlaatua ennaltaehkäisemällä sairauksia. Niillä on keskeinen rooli kansanterveyden edistämisessä ja vakavien tautien taltuttamisessa. Me tutkimme rokotteiden tehoa, turvallisuutta ja vaikuttavuutta vuosikymmenten kokemuksella ja kansainvälisesti tunnustetulla, tieteellisesti laadukkaalla osaamisella. FVR – Suomen rokotetutkimus on yksityinen osakeyhtiömuotoinen yritys, joka aloitti toimintansa vuonna 2022. Suomen valtio omistaa yrityksestä 51 % ja Tampereen korkeakoulusäätiö 49 %. Yhtiön omistajaohjauksesta vastaa sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö (STM). Asiakkaitamme ovat suuret kansainväliset lääkeyhtiöt. Ainutlaatuinen mahdollisuus data- ja AI-kehityksen parissa Etsimme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen data- ja AI-asiantuntijaa Tampereen, Oulun tai Helsingin toimistollemme hybridityömahdollisuuksin . Tehtävässä suunnittelet, toteutat ja kehität ratkaisuja, joilla data saadaan luotettavasti tutkimuksen, operatiivisen toiminnan ja liiketoiminnan käyttöön. Tunnistat tekoälyn hyödyntämismahdollisuuksia ja viet käyttötapauksia hallitusti kokeiluista tuotantoon. Työskentelet osana in-house-digitiimiä ja teet työtä tutkimusliiketoimintamme tiedonhallinnan, analytiikan ja AI-ratkaisujen parissa. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä liiketoiminnan, prosessien omistajien, tutkijoiden ja klinikkahenkilökunnan kanssa. Olet mukana rakentamassa ratkaisuja, jotka mahdollistavat uudenlaisia tutkimuspalveluja, laadukasta tutkimustietoa sekä sujuvan, tietoturvallisen ja vastuullisen toiminnan. Pääasialliset tehtävät Suunnittelet, rakennat ja ylläpidät data-alustan ratkaisuja Microsoft Azure- ja Fabric-ympäristössä. Kehität tietomalleja, integraatioita, datan laatua, master dataa sekä raportoinnin ja analytiikan tietopohjaa. Tunnistat ja priorisoit AI-käyttötapauksia yhdessä liiketoiminnan ja tutkimuksen asiantuntijoiden kanssa sekä toteutat kokeiluja ja tuotantoratkaisuja. Rakennat ratkaisuja hyödyntäen SQL:ää ja Pythonia sekä soveltuvia pilvi-, automaatio- ja AI-palveluja. Huolehdit ratkaisujen dokumentoinnista, ylläpidettävyydestä, seurannasta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Varmistat osaltasi datan ja AI:n vastuullisen käytön sekä tietoturvan, tietosuojan, jäljitettävyyden ja sääntelyvaatimusten toteutumisen. Osallistut teknologioiden ja kumppaneiden arviointiin sekä ohjaat palveluntuottajien työtä käytännönläheisesti ja kustannustietoisesti. Mitä odotamme sinulta Soveltuvaa teknistä, matemaattista tai kaupallista korkeakoulututkintoa. Vähintään 3-5 vuoden kokemusta data-, analytiikka- tai AI-ratkaisujen kehittämisestä. Käytännön kokemusta data-alustoista, dataputkista, integraatioista ja tietomallinnuksesta; Microsoft Azure- ja Fabric-osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Kokemusta Power BI -raportoinnista ja sen kehittämisestä. Vahvaa SQL- ja Python-osaamista sekä kykyä rakentaa laadukkaita ja ylläpidettäviä ratkaisuja. Kokemusta generatiivisen AI:n, koneoppimisen tai muun soveltavan tekoälyn käyttötapauksista ja niiden hallitusta käyttöönotosta. Ymmärrystä tietosuojasta, tietoturvasta, datan hallintamalleista ja vastuullisen AI:n periaatteista. Kokemus säädellystä toimintaympäristöstä on etu. Kokemusta toimintaa ohjaavista järjestelmistä, kuten potilastietojärjestelmästä tai ERP-ratkaisusta; käytössämme ovat Acute-potilastietojärjestelmä ja Odoo ERP. Kykyä johtaa omia kehityskokonaisuuksia, viestiä teknisistä ratkaisuista ymmärrettävästi ja työskennellä sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi. Mitä tarjoamme sinulle Monipuolisia data- ja AI-kehityshankkeita tutkimuksen ja liiketoiminnan parissa. Vastuuta ja aitoja vaikutusmahdollisuuksia ratkaisuihin, toimintatapoihin, teknologioihin ja kumppanivalintoihin. Mahdollisuuden kasvattaa osaamistasi yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellisessä toimintaympäristössä. Asiantuntevan työyhteisön sekä kollegoiden ja yhteistyökumppaneiden tuen. Yrityskulttuurin, jossa asiantuntevuus, välittävyys ja vastuullisuus ohjaavat jokapäiväistä toimintaamme. Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, ja siinä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa. Ensisijainen työskentelypaikka on Tampere, Oulu tai Helsinki . Tehtävässä on hybridityömahdollisuus. Tervetuloa joukkoomme! Innostuitko? Hae tehtävään mahdollisimman pian, sillä etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa jo hakuaikana. Haku päättyy 28.10.2026 ja ensimmäinen haastattelukierros tullaan tekemään Recright-videohaastatteluna. Liitäthän hakemukseesi CV:n ja hakemuskirjeen. Toivomme hakijoita erilaisista taustoista ja arvostamme monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytoinnista vastaava esihenkilö Heikki Ojaniemi, Digital Development Manager, puh. 0407591559. Heikin tavoittaa puhelimitse 22.10. klo 9–11.

items.desc: Applied Scientist Position: Applied Scientist Type: Contractor Compensation: $245–$280/hour Location: Remote About the Opportunity We are seeking skilled Applied Scientists to contribute to a data-driven project focused on advanced analytics, statistical analysis, and experimentation. In this role, you will apply your expertise in Python, machine learning, and applied statistics to help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems. Your work will help improve how AI models learn, reason, and perform by providing high-quality, real-world expertise. The opportunity emphasizes quantitative problem-solving, experimentation, and clear technical communication. Prior AI experience is not required; relevant domain expertise is what matters. Develop, validate, tune, and evaluate machine learning models for business and research objectives. Apply data modeling techniques and manage large-scale data transformations using Python and Pandas. Collaborate with stakeholders to establish experimentation frameworks and analyze results. Document methodologies, findings, and recommendations through clear, precise analytical reports. Review peer contributions and provide constructive, high-quality feedback. Deliver reproducible code and well-organized analytical reports. Evaluate AI-generated outputs involving statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative reasoning. Create expert-level prompts, datasets, and reference solutions. Identify flawed methodologies, statistical errors, and weaknesses in quantitative reasoning. Provide structured feedback to improve AI model performance and capabilities. Required Qualifications Proficiency in Python for data analysis, statistical computing, and machine learning. Experience with Pandas and familiarity with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn. Demonstrated knowledge of applied statistics, experimental design, and machine learning. Experience developing, tuning, and evaluating machine learning models in practical settings. Strong data modeling skills and experience working with structured and unstructured data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to produce reproducible code, precise technical documentation, and clear analytical reports. Preferred Qualifications At least one year of experience at a leading company in technology, finance, or research. An advanced academic background or hands-on experience in data science, applied mathematics, statistics, or a related field. Experience collaborating on open or cross-functional data science projects. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to assess complex quantitative problems. Compensation & Engagement Compensation: $245–$280 per hour. Engagement Type: Contractor. Work Arrangement: Fully remote. Project Focus: Applied science, advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical analysis, and experimentation.

items.desc: Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. AI ENGINEER EXPERT Quale sarà la tua sfida? Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti fondamentali Almeno 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo; Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica o discipline affini (STEM). Esperienza nel disegno di soluzioni software e nell’implementazione di strutture dati, algoritmi. Esperienza nell’utilizzo degli strumenti di Code Repository e CI/CD. items.desc: Unsere Unternehmenszentrale in Burgwedel bei Hannover – hier arbeiten rund 3.000 Mitarbeitende mit vollem Einsatz daran, die Zukunft von ROSSMANN zu gestalten. Heute wissen, was uns morgen verbindet! Unser Human Resources Fachbereich besteht aus engagierten Bereichen mit vielen fantastischen Expertenteams und zählt über 300 Mitarbeitende: Ob HR Management, HR Service, Learning & Development, Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding, HR Start Up oder HR Tech, Analytics & Projects – alle Teams arbeiten Hand in Hand mit dem Ziel, unsere Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräfte in den Filialen, der Logistik und der Zentrale zu unterstützen. Wir sind Mehrwertstifter, Kundenbegeisterer und Zukunftsdenker und gestalten die Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mit. Das bewirken Sie bei uns Künstliche Intelligenz ist bei ROSSMANN längst Teil unseres Arbeitsalltags: Kolleginnen und Kollegen probieren neue Tools aus, Fachbereiche entwickeln eigene Use Cases, und in Lern- und Austauschformaten wächst unsere Erfahrung jeden Tag. Die Veränderung ist also schon in vollem Gange. Jetzt geben wir ihr Struktur und eine feste Heimat. Mit unserer HR-Strategie 2030 haben wir uns klar positioniert: Wir wollen eine lernende Organisation sein, die Menschen befähigt, Technologie verantwortungsvoll zu nutzen und daraus echten Mehrwert zu schaffen. Die AI-Adoption ist dabei ein gemeinsames Vorhaben von HR und IT. Uns trägt die Überzeugung, dass technologische, kulturelle und qualifikatorische Veränderung nur interdisziplinär gelingen kann. Deshalb bauen wir im Bereich Learning & Development das neue Team AI People Transformation auf, das mit AI Central (IT) ein festes Tandem bildet. Während AI Central die technologische Seite verantwortet, kümmert sich das neue Team um die menschliche: Es bündelt, was bereits entstanden ist, macht gute Ansätze für alle zugänglich und bildet gemeinsam mit der IT das Rückgrat unserer Transformation. Teamaufbau & Führung: Sie übernehmen die disziplinarische Leitung des neuen Teams, das Expertise aus Learning und Organizational Development vereint. Sie führen unterschiedliche Profile zusammen, schaffen klare Rollenbilder und entwickeln das Team zu einem sichtbaren Treiber der AI-Transformation bei ROSSMANN Schulterschluss: Sie positionieren Ihr Team als zentralen HR-Partner für AI Central und arbeiten eng mit der IT zusammen: Während AI Central Technologie, Plattformen und Use Cases verantwortet, liegt auf Ihrer Seite der Fokus auf der „menschlichen“ Dimension der Transformation. Sie etablieren eine verlässliche Zusammenarbeit, in der Business Value, Enablement und Change integriert gedacht werden. Gemeinsame Roadmaps, abgestimmte Rollenmodelle (u. a. AI Ambassador, AI Adoptioner) sowie eine konsistente Kommunikation sind dabei zentral Strategie & Vision: Sie übersetzen die Demokratisierung von AI in eine klare HR-seitige Strategie und kulturelle Vision entlang der HR-Strategie 2030. Dabei stellen Sie den Nutzen für Mitarbeitende in den Mittelpunkt, fördern eine Kultur der Neugier und stärken durch Beteiligung und transparente Kommunikation die Akzeptanz des Wandels Change & Befähigung: Sie knüpfen an bestehende Formate und Erfahrungen an und skalieren, was sich bewährt hat. Aus der Vision leiten Sie konkrete Maßnahmen ab: Enablement-, Lern- und Beteiligungsformate sowie Beratungsangebote für Fachbereiche in AI-bezogenen Transformationen. items.desc: Descrizione dell'azienda Retoria è un’organizzazione di formazione con sede di lavoro a Milano, che promuove una alfabetizzazione all’intelligenza artificiale critica e centrata sull’essere umano, insieme alle lingue come strumenti fondamentali di autonomia. La metodologia didattica è guidata dai dati e basata sull’evidenza, con percorsi di apprendimento progettati per misurare i progressi reali e sostenere l’autonomia a lungo termine delle persone. Retoria rifiuta mode passeggere e tendenze temporanee, puntando invece su competenze e valori umani duraturi, indispensabili per governare i cambiamenti tecnologici. L’organizzazione collabora con scuole, università, istituzioni culturali e sociali, oltre che con realtà impegnate nella transizione digitale attenta alla centralità della persona. Descrizione del ruolo Human-Centered AI experts contribuiranno alla progettazione e alla realizzazione di percorsi formativi su intelligenza artificiale e linguaggi, garantendo un approccio critico e human-centered per diverse tipologie di studenti e organizzazioni. Nel ruolo, con sede di lavoro a Milano, full time e in presenza, la persona sarà responsabile dell’analisi dei bisogni formativi, della creazione di contenuti didattici data-driven e della definizione di metriche per valutare l’efficacia dei percorsi. Le principali attività quotidiane includono la conduzione di laboratori e workshop, la facilitazione di momenti di confronto con scuole, università e istituzioni partner, e la collaborazione con il team interno per ottimizzare materiali e strumenti educativi. Il ruolo prevede inoltre il monitoraggio dell’evoluzione tecnologica dell’AI, la traduzione di questi sviluppi in pratiche pedagogiche sostenibili e il supporto alle organizzazioni nel gestire la transizione digitale preservando il proprio nucleo umano. Qualifiche Competenze solide in human-centered ai e alfabetizzazione digitale critica, con capacità di tradurre concetti complessi in percorsi formativi accessibili. Esperienza nella progettazione didattica e nella formazione, preferibilmente con metodologie data-driven e evidence-based. Conoscenza delle principali tecnologie di intelligenza artificiale e dei loro impatti sociali, culturali ed etici. Ottime capacità di comunicazione, facilitazione di gruppi e lavoro in team interdisciplinari, con attenzione all’inclusione e alla partecipazione attiva. items.desc: Projektbeskrivning Kemiska föroreningar hotar människors hälsa och ekosystem över hela jorden. Data om kemiska faror är avgörande för att upptäcka och mildra potentiella negativa effekter i ett tidigt skede. På senare tid har beräkningsverktyg, såsom transformers-modeller, använts för att exakt förutsäga bland annat kemisk toxicitet gentemot miljön. Träningen av sådana modeller är beroende av att stora mängder toxicitetsdata extraheras från vetenskapliga publikationer, rapporter och säkerhetsdokument och samlas i öppna databaser, som ECOTOX. Dataextraktion görs för närvarande för hand, oftast av myndigheter, vilket inte hinner med den ständigt växande mängden ny forskning. Detta har blivit en stor flaskhals som inte bara hindrar tillämpningen av beräkningsmetoder för riskbedömning, utan i slutändan också begränsar en effektiv lagstiftning för att skydda både människor och miljö. AI-agenter (LLM-agenter) är lovande alternativ som har potential att ta bort denna flaskhals och automatisera arbetsflödet. Eftersom den genererade datan används i sammanhang med höga insatser krävs dock garantier för både noggrannhet och spårbarhet i extraktionsprocessen. Framför allt är ekotoxikologiska studier ökänt svåra att läsa och förstå, vilket kräver att agenterna kan särskilja relevant data från irrelevant data i publikationer som ofta är fyllda med figurer, tabeller, referenser med mera, baserat på kontext. Huvudsakliga uppgifter Vi söker två studenter som ska utveckla och implementera AI-agenter i syfte att extrahera kemisk toxicitetsdata från vetenskaplig litteratur. Med utgångspunkt i tidigare arbete blir målet att vidareutveckla en pipeline som (1) kan ta emot en lista med publikationer som indata och producera strukturerad data, samt (2) sålla bland tidigare publicerad litteratur som ännu inte har utvärderats. Vi kommer att börja med – men inte begränsa oss till – att använda ECOTOX-databasen som referensdatabas, vilken vi siktar på att återskapa och göra en benchmark för. Det gör att ni kan validera extraktionsprocessen och toxicitetsdatans många olika dimensioner. Därefter kommer vi att tillämpa pipen på nya, outforskade publikationer för att skapa ett nytt öppet dataset med tidigare otillgängliga, strukturerade toxicitetsdata. Kort Sagt Kommer Ert Arbete Att Innebära Att hantera "brusiga" PDF-filer (figurer, referenser, tabeller, OCR-fel). Att utforma utvärderingsmått för extraktionsnoggrannhet och spårbarhet. Att integrera domänspecifik validering (kontrollera konsekvens gentemot ECOTOX). Lärandemål Att lära sig bygga, skala och validera data- och AI-pipelines. Att utveckla färdigheter inom mjukvaruutveckling samt MLOps/DevOps. Vem söker vi? Vi söker studenter som vill skriva ett examensarbete på 30 högskolepoäng under våren 2027. Vi Tror Att Du Läser masterprogram med inriktning Data/AI, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande Har erfarenhet av Python och förståelse för att arbeta med LLM-agenter via API:er (inte bara konversera med ChatGPT). Meriterande Erfarenhet av LLM-arbetsflöden, erfarenhet av docling eller liknande PDF-till-text-pipelines, NLP och databaser. Kunskaper i kemi är såklart till nytta, men det är inget krav! Projektet kommer att utföras på Knightec Groups kontor på Lindholmen i Göteborg, med handledning av professor Erik Kristiansson (Chalmers), doktoranden Styrbjörn Käll (Chalmers, Knightec Group) och doktor Jens Henriksson (Knightec Group). En spännande resa med Knightec Group Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det? Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling. På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort. För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt. Praktisk information Detta är en Master Thesis - tjänst med placering på vårt kontor i Göteborg, Lindholmsallén 2. Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-11-30. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida.

items.desc: Über TradeLink TradeLink baut agentische Plattformen, die europäische Lieferketten auf ein neues Level bringen. Routineaufgaben werden dabei von intelligenten KI-Agenten übernommen, wichtige Entscheidungen und Priorisierungen bleiben in den Teams. Ein Netzwerk, das Unternehmen, Lieferanten und Spediteure verbindet, sorgt für maximale Transparenz, reduziert Zeitverluste und schafft einen sicheren und vertrauensvollen Prozess. Mit TradeLink hat man seine Logistik jederzeit im Griff, statt ihr hinterherzurennen. Über die Rolle Wir sind intern auf dem Weg zur AI-native Org. Unser Firmenwissen liegt in einem Git-Repo, aus dem AI schöpft und arbeitet und das sich über Feedback Loops selbst aktualisiert. Inbound-Anfragen, Pod-Reports, Support-Triage und Call-Recaps laufen über Agenten und Automationen, die wir selbst gebaut haben. Mehr als 20 davon sind in Produktion. In dieser Rolle bist du für das Backbone von TradeLink zuständig: die Systeme und Abläufe in Operations, People, Finance und GTM , auf die sich alle Teams jeden Tag verlassen. Du treibst AI-Projekte in der ganzen Firma voran und machst unsere Abläufe schlanker, schneller und effizienter. Dabei bekommst du Einblick in alle Bereiche des Unternehmens, vom Vertrieb über Produkt und Kunden bis zu People und Finance. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und Gründer Tobias und mit Daniel, unserem Chief of Staff und AI Enablement Manager , zusammen und machst die Firma jede Woche ein Stück besser. Für dich ist die Rolle ein Sprungbrett: Von hier aus kannst du dich in jeden Unternehmensbereich weiterentwickeln, der zu dir passt. Dein Verantwortungsbereich People & Finance Operations AI-first umbauen: Du übernimmst unsere People- und Finance-Abläufe, verschlankst sie und automatisierst sie Schritt für Schritt. Das Ziel: Abläufe laufen pünktlich, haben einen Prüfschritt und finden Fehler, bevor sie beim Empfänger ankommen. Operations schlank und kosteneffizient halten: Du behältst im Blick, wofür wir Geld und Zeit ausgeben, und sorgst dafür, dass wir effizient bleiben. Dafür prüfst du laufend Tools, Verträge und Abläufe, findest Doppelarbeit und Medienbrüche und managst Kündigungen, Nachverhandlungen, Implementierungen und Vereinfachungen Arbeit an Agenten übergeben: Du betreibst laufende Automationen mit (Make, Claude, HubSpot, GitLab) und baust neue für wiederkehrende Arbeit in Vertrieb, Support, Reporting, People und Finance. Vor jedem Projekt legst du fest, woran wir den Erfolg messen, etwa gesparte Stunden, weniger Fehler oder erzeugte Pipeline. GTM-Systeme und Customer Enablement: Du fährst Outbound-Kampagnen für unsere Zielaccounts und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Weg von der Anfrage bis zum ersten Gespräch schnell bleibt. Du baust das Reporting mit, über das unsere Teams ihre Accounts steuern. Außerdem arbeitest du am AI-native Self-Onboarding mit: Aus deinen Analysen leiten wir Builds ab, die Kundenanfragen und damit Tickets reduzieren. Du zeigst Teams, wie sie damit arbeiten, misst, ob sie es tun, und verbesserst es, wenn nicht. items.desc: Description Description Au sein de l'équipe Data Science du Pôle Technique de la Direction Maîtrise des Risques et Expertise de l'usine Orano Recyclage La Hague , vous contribuerez à un projet innovant combinant simulation industrielle, systèmes multi-agents et intelligence artificielle . L'objectif est d'étudier la mise en place d'une plateforme capable de reproduire et d'analyser le fonctionnement de flux de production industriels afin d'identifier automatiquement les situations normales ou dégradées à partir de données historiques. Vous explorerez également la capacité de l'Intelligence Artificielle à proposer des stratégies d'optimisation face à différents aléas de production (pannes, maintenance préventive, variations d'activité...). Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront les suivantes : Analyser les règles métier, contraintes opérationnelles et données disponibles sur le périmètre retenu pour l'étude des flux industriels ; Réaliser une veille technologique et un benchmark des solutions existantes afin d'identifier les leviers permettant d'accélérer le développement d'une maquette fonctionnelle ; Concevoir et développer une plateforme de simulation reposant sur des systèmes multi-agents représentant les différentes unités de production à un niveau macroscopique ; Intégrer et exploiter des données historiques afin de reproduire et analyser différents scénarios de fonctionnement ; Développer des indicateurs de performance permettant d'évaluer l'activité des installations (cadence, disponibilité, temps d'ouverture, etc.) ; Enrichir les agents avec des mécanismes d'Intelligence Artificielle et de Machine Learning afin d'optimiser certains scénarios ou circuits de production ; Évaluer les gains potentiels apportés par ces optimisations à l'aide des métriques définies. Ces travaux seront réalisés au sein de l'équipe Data Science, en étroite collaboration avec les experts métiers des domaines production et maintenance , vous offrant une vision concrète des enjeux industriels et de la valeur apportée par la Data et l'IA. Profil souhaité Vous êtes en formation Ingénieur(e) ou en formation universitaire de type Master orientée statistiques, mathématiques ou informatique décisionnelle, avec une spécialisation en Data Science. Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d’organisation et de réactivité dans votre travail. Vous savez allier travail en équipe et travail en autonomie. Nous aussi. En rejoignant Orano, un acteur international majeur du secteur nucléaire, vous êtes au bon endroit. Chaque jour, nous œuvrons pour produire une énergie performante et bas-carbone, lutter contre le changement climatique, trouver des solutions qui préservent les ressources naturelles et faire progresser le domaine de la santé. Nos atouts ? Sur l’ensemble du cycle du combustible : la maîtrise de technologies de pointe, des produits et services sûrs et à forte valeur ajoutée, une expertise spécialisée et une grande capacité d’innovation. The programme combines an immersive bootcamp with two years of rotational experience, giving you the opportunity to build strong foundations before developing your skills across a range of technology teams and projects. Over two years, you'll rotate through teams working on cutting-edge projects that power millions of customer experiences. Whether it's building software, experimenting with Generative AI, or delivering solutions within agile frameworks, you'll gain hands-on experience with the tools and technologies transforming the industry. You don't need to choose a specialism immediately. This programme is designed to help you explore, grow and find your path, whether that's in software development, networks, broadcast technology, cyber security, artificial intelligence or technology delivery. We're looking for curious, motivated people who want to build a career in technology. You don't need a technical background to apply. What matters most is a genuine interest in technology and the impact it can have on customers. Over two years, we'll help you become a well-rounded technology professional, giving you insight into how our teams create and deliver great customer experiences across Sky's products and services. As you gain experience across different technology teams, you'll discover where your strengths and interests lie and have the opportunity to specialise in the areas that excite you most. What you'll be doing Technology never stands still, and neither do we. From exploring new ideas to delivering solutions used by millions of customers, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects from concept through to launch. If you enjoy learning, adapting to change and solving problems, you'll thrive at Sky. Throughout the programme, you'll rotate across a range of teams and develop a blend of technical, analytical and delivery skills while gaining exposure to Sky's wider technology landscape. You Could Build digital products using technologies such as AI, cloud platforms and modern software development tools. Learn about cyber security, threat modelling and how we protect customers, systems and data from emerging risks. Explore network technologies across physical, virtual and broadcast environments. Help shape the future of new technology solutions as a Product Owner or Technical Product Owner. Use machine learning, large language models (LLMs) and Generative AI to solve real-world business and customer challenges. From day one, you'll work on real projects with real impact, supported by experienced mentors and surrounded by people who are passionate about technology. By the end of the programme, you'll have the confidence, experience and specialist skills needed to take the next step in your career at Sky. What are we looking for? The one essential requirement is that you're currently in the final year of your undergraduate degree, completing a postgraduate qualification, or have already graduated. Your degree can be in any subject. Skills that will help you thrive Demonstrate the ability to learn new technical skills quickly. Be curious about emerging technologies and how they're changing the world. Be passionate about solving problems and building smart, scalable solutions. Feel comfortable learning new tools and working in agile teams. Be excited to explore areas such as AI, data, automation and cloud platforms. Right to work Please be aware that Sky does not offer sponsorship for this role. Employment is contingent on having a valid right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme. You can find information on the length of Sky's programmes on the website. Your application journey Here's what to expect, step by step. Step 1: Apply online Tell us a bit about yourself, your degree and anything else you think Sky should know about you, such as: Part-time jobs Volunteering experience Projects you've worked on Relevant achievements Once you submit your application, keep an eye on your inbox (and junk folder). Sky will send you a link to begin the digital assessment process. Please note that you can only apply to one programme per year. Step 2: Show us your skills You'll complete two online assessments designed to help Sky understand: How you think What motivates you How you might fit into the programme Your technical abilities Don't worry, you'll have an opportunity to practise first and Sky will provide guidance to help you prepare. While you may use AI to help understand Sky and prepare for the application process, the assessments themselves must be completed without AI assistance. items.desc: Hybrid in London, United Kingdom (one day per week in office requirement) We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad. You'll own credit models that decide who iwocaPay can safely fund, on what terms, and how far the product can grow. You'll help shape how risk modelling develops. The Company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Risk Squad owns credit risk and fraud for iwocaPay, iwoca's Buy Now Pay Later product for businesses. The aim is to lend to every business likely to repay, and to spot the ones that aren't. The squad works across three areas: Lending decisions. Building and improving the automated credit model. The portfolio. Tracking losses, chargebacks, and seller performance, and deciding which segments to grow or pull back from. New products. Designing the risk side of each one before it launches. The squad is small and new – two data scientists, a risk analyst and a risk lead. The role As a Data Scientist in the Risk Squad, you'll co-own every credit model with the other data scientist and review one another's work. The job is mostly supervised ML on tabular data, with a fair amount of data engineering as the squad moves onto its own pipelines. You'll start on the automated credit model and take on the invoice financing models over time. You can also test ideas with iwoca's other lending data science teams, who work on similar credit problems. You'll choose what to work on and write the plans you deliver. Much of the squad's work happens in iwocaPay's product and strategy meetings, so your models shape the roadmap. You'll also help set up how the squad works – what it monitors, and the guidelines it follows. Live project examples: Model architecture. Rethinking the model around how iwocaPay actually lends: overlapping facilities, short terms, and a growing set of products a customer can use. Blending datasets. Bringing more iwocaPay-specific data into the models while still drawing on iwoca's larger core lending dataset, through methods such as transfer learning. Invoice financing. Building a credit risk model from scratch for a new product on a segment iwoca hasn’t lent to before. Plus finding the modelling opportunities elsewhere in the funnel, like in our offers... The Requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Production ML. You have built supervised ML models on tabular data end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring. Ownership. You work well in a small, early-stage team where priorities move quickly. You build what you need as you go, and take loosely defined problems from framing to a landed decision. Judgement. You know when a model is good enough to go live, and when it needs more work. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a modelling pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in product, risk, and leadership. Bonus: Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk modelling or lending. Non-linear methods. You have used gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production. Combining datasets. You have used transfer learning, domain adaptation, or similar methods on data sources of different size and relevance. Data engineering. You have built data pipelines and managed datasets alongside your modelling work. Coding. You can write code for analysis. The squad works in Python. The salary We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on …

items.desc: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. 🔍 Dive Into the World of Data — Fever’s Data Graduate Program Awaits Are you a recent graduate ready to jump into the world of data? Fever’s Data Graduate Program is a six-month, full-time rotational experience designed to launch your career in Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Web Analytics . From day one, you’ll work on real projects, use cutting-edge technologies, and learn directly from experts who are shaping how millions of people discover entertainment worldwide. What usually takes years to learn, you’ll get in just six months — through hands-on work, mentorship, and exposure to multiple data disciplines. What’s in it for you? A paid six-month contract in 📍 Madrid with the chance to transition into a full-time role Rotations across key data teams: Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Data Marketing Engineering & Web Analytics Mentorship and training from experts in the field. Real impact from day one — contribute to projects used across the company English lessons. 40% discount on all Fever events. Cigna health Insurance. Flexible compensation with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee. Wellhub membership. If you reside outside of Madrid, we can offer relocation assistance to help make your move and adaptation to the city as smooth as possible. How does the program work? 📍 Location : Madrid, Spain (100% in-person) 🕓 Duration : 6 months 🔄 Rotation: You’ll rotate across 3–4 data teams depending on your skills and interests Rotation Structure: 6 months total, rotating across 3-4 teams depending on your skills and interests: Data Engineering: Learn how to build and manage scalable data pipelines. Work with tools like SQL, Python, and cloud-based databases. Machine Learning: Work on real-world ML models and recommendations. Learn how ML models are developed, trained, and deployed. Data Science: Analyze complex business problems and help drive data-driven decisions. Use A/B testing and predictive modeling to optimize Fever’s platform. Web Analytics & Data Collection: Improve how data is collected across the complex Fever ecosystem (multiple websites and mobile apps) to deliver the best quality inputs to all internal areas and stakeholders to make better decisions. You'll learn about best practices for tracking and analytics using technologies such as GA4 and Mixpanel. Who should apply? We’re looking for motivated, ambitious recent graduates who: Have a bachelor / master's / PhD degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Mathematics or a related field. Rank in the top 10% of their class Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Have all your credits completed. Speak and understand business-level English. How to apply? Submit your application and select your preferred team. Talent interview to assess fit. Technical interview to evaluate skills. Final offer and onboarding. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. items.desc: Ben je net afgestudeerd of toe aan een nieuwe stap? En wil je jezelf ontwikkelen tot AI developer in een omgeving waar je leert van ervaren collega’s en vanaf dag één onderdeel bent van een hecht team? Bij 9altitudes bieden we je een uniek traineeship waarin je alles leert over Python, Microsoft Foundry en Copilot en nog veel meer hoe je dat inzet bij klanten. Je dagelijkse avontuur Wat ga je doen? Je start samen met andere Trainees in een intensief en energiek opleidingsprogramma van drie maanden. Geen droge training vanaf de zijlijn, maar direct aan de slag met de tools, klanten en collega’s van 9altitudes. Je leert hoe je data analyseert, inzichten vertaalt naar een helder verhaal en jouw advies overtuigend presenteert. Alles wat je leert, pas je meteen toe in echte klantprojecten. Stap voor stap krijg je meer verantwoordelijkheid. Tegelijkertijd sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt coaching, feedback en ruimte om te werken aan jouw eigen leerdoelen. Na het programma stroom je door in één van onze teams. En als je later verder wilt groeien richting ERP of BI, dan liggen daar ook volop kansen. Over het team: Ons team in Veenendaal is gespecialiseerd in Business Intelligence & AI en helpt organisaties om meer waarde uit hun data en processen te halen. Vanuit onze Data & Analytics expertise vertalen we data naar heldere inzichten, slimme dashboards en concrete beslisinformatie. Met onze eigen oplossing 9A Smart Insights, ook wel BIRDS, maken we binnen een paar dagen zichtbaar waar andere trajecten vaak maanden over doen. Je komt terecht in een team van 55 collega’s, waar we werken in hechte teams en technologie combineren met samenwerking, nieuwsgierigheid en plezier in wat we doen. Vaardigheden Wie ben jij en wat heb je nodig? Je wordt enthousiast van AI, data, technologie en analytics; Je hebt hbo-denkniveau en zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen; Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands (at least C1); Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor detail; Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en pakt nieuwe informatie snel op; Je kunt jouw ideeën helder uitleggen en wilt groeien in communicatie, ook richting klanten; Je vindt samenwerken belangrijk, maar kunt ook zelfstandig je verantwoordelijkheid pakken; Je denkt in oplossingen en ziet kansen om data slimmer in te zetten; Heb je al ervaring met MS Foundry en Phyton dat is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste. Je travelpack wordt gevuld met Wat krijg jij van ons? Een traineeship dat met jou meegroeit, met persoonlijke begeleiding vanaf dag één; Training in technische tools, adviesvaardigheden en soft skills die je direct in de praktijk gebruikt; De kans om mee te werken aan projecten voor mooie klanten, samen met ervaren BI-specialisten die je graag meenemen in hun vak; Een goed salaris en sterke arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een premievrij pensioen, bonusregeling, winstuitkering, onkostenvergoeding, thuiswerkvergoeding en een aantrekkelijke compensatieregeling; Ruimte voor een gezonde werk en privébalans, met onder andere reistijdcompensatie en flexibele werktijden; Vijf weken vakantie, met de mogelijkheid om een extra week bij te kopen; Een fijne, nuchtere werksfeer waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, kunt leren en kunt groeien op jouw manier. Neem contact op 9altitudes is de internationale proactieve voorloper op technologie en procesoptimalisatie! Vandaag zijn we actief in 8 landen (Nederland, België, Brazilië, Denemarken, Spanje, Turkije, Portugal en Frankrijk). Met meer dan 800 werknemers hebben we een expertise in verschillende domeinen, zoals Microsoft Dynamics ERP en CRM, BI & AI, Document Management, PLM, IOT & Argumented Reality, CAD en e-commerce. Als Europese end-to-end-partner streven we de doelen van onze klanten na, gedreven door geïnspireerd denken. Onze teams en hun kennis zijn samengesmolten om 'echte waarde' te leveren, die verder gaat dan alleen expertise. We zijn er van overtuigd dat dit de beste garantie is voor duurzame bedrijfsresultaten voor onze klanten. Wij gaan ervoor ... jij ook? High time to say hi!

items.desc: As the world leader in cleaning technology, Kärcher is known for innovation, quality, and sustainability. As a family-owned company, we value strong relationships with both our customers and our employees. To drive the success of our autonomous cleaning technology in the region, we are now looking for a highly skilled, commercially driven, and self-starting Regional KIRA Specialist. Location: Banbury, UK About The Role Kärcher is pioneering the future of industrial cleaning with intelligent, autonomous technology. As our Regional KIRA Specialist , you will act as the primary technical and commercial hub driving the adoption and performance of Kärcher’s autonomous robotics (KIRA) across the region. In this role, you will serve as a versatile technical expert and customer advocate. You will oversee the full lifecycle of autonomous deployments—from conducting initial site feasibility surveys and live product trials to managing cloud fleet telemetry and delivering hands-on technical troubleshooting. You will also bridge the gap between regional executive leadership, headquarters engineering teams, and ground-level facility operators. Key Responsibilities Technical Diagnostics & Fleet Operations Deliver expert remote and on-site troubleshooting, software updates, and mechanical or electrical adjustments. Monitor and optimize connected machines using cloud-based fleet management software, IoT telemetry, and web platforms such as KEM or OneView. Provide advanced operational support for autonomous systems, including LiDAR, sonar, optical sensors, 3D cameras, and spatial navigation mapping. Customer Success & Deployment Oversee end-to-end technical machine delivery, onboarding, and site configuration at customer facilities. Design and lead enablement training programs for facility staff, end-user operators, and internal sales/demonstration teams. Maintain active customer feedback loops, proactively resolving operational bottlenecks to ensure satisfaction. Identify successful deployments and collaborate on creating impactful customer case studies. Commercial Enablement & Market Growth Analyze target sectors—including Logistics, Retail, Healthcare, and Public Spaces—to identify high-potential opportunities for autonomous cleaning solutions. Conduct detailed physical site surveys and facility layout feasibility studies to assess infrastructure readiness for KIRA deployments. Deliver customer pitches, product demonstrations, live field trials, and specialized robotics workshops. Cross-Functional Coordination & Performance Reporting Serve as the vital link connecting HQ technical engineers (AKW), regional leadership (@ALG), and client facility teams. Track and evaluate robot operational metrics, providing performance reports directly to regional executive management. Qualifications & Experience We are looking for You hold a degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a technical equivalent—or equivalent hands-on background in industrial automation—with specialized certifications in Autonomous Systems, IoT Telemetry, or Robotics preferred. You bring proven experience in industrial automation, robotics, and cloud-based IoT fleet platforms. Your background demonstrates success leading live customer pitches, product demonstrations, physical site feasibility studies, machinery delivery, and technical training, with prior experience hosting specialized sales workshops or producing customer case studies preferred. You combine robust field and remote troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, and software systems with a deep understanding of sensor suites (LiDAR, sonar, optical, 3D cameras) and autonomous navigation mapping, with advanced data analytics capabilities for performance reporting preferred. Finally, you possess exceptional cross-functional collaboration and English communication skills to resolve issues objectively and partner with diverse stakeholders, with regional vertical experience across Logistics, Retail, Healthcare, or Public Spaces preferred. A valid driver’s license and the flexibility to travel for on-site client trials, field visits, and surveys are required. Does this sound like your next challenge? We look forward to receiving your application! We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your CV and application through the portal as soon as possible.

items.desc: Bij een hightech organisatie in Eindhoven voor engineering, assemblage van modules en machinesystemen en productie van complexe componenten maak je bedrijfsprocessen slimmer met AI en automatisering. Je vertaalt vraagstukken uit engineering, supply chain, kwaliteit, operations en finance naar praktische oplossingen. Denk aan workflowautomatisering, voorspellende analyses en generatieve AI. Daarbij combineer je technische vernieuwing met de eisen aan veiligheid, kwaliteit en compliance in een sterk gereguleerde omgeving. In de dagelijkse praktijk analyseer je processen, bouw je proofs of concept en werk je oplossingen uit tot betrouwbare toepassingen. Je schakelt met data engineers, IT en gebruikers over datakwaliteit, architectuur en integraties. Ook adviseer je het management over digitalisering en help je collega’s nieuwe werkwijzen toe te passen. Je verdiept je in nieuwe AI-methodieken, met aandacht voor uitlegbaarheid, logging, traceerbaarheid en beheersbare wijzigingen. Wat ga je doen? Analyseer en optimaliseer end-to-end bedrijfsprocessen van engineering tot finance. Ontwerp en implementeer workflowautomatisering met AI, low-code/no-code en scripting. Ontwikkel toepassingen voor voorspellende analyses, beslissingsondersteuning en veilige generatieve AI. Werk met data engineers en IT aan data-architectuur, datakwaliteit en systeemintegraties. Borg compliance, uitlegbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid met logging, traceerbaarheid en change control. Initieer proofs of concept en pilots en begeleid gebruikers bij de toepassing. Adviseer het management over digitaliseringsstrategie en relevante nieuwe technologie. Wat vragen we van jou? Je hebt een hbo/wo-diploma, bij voorkeur in Technische Informatica, Data Science/AI, Industriële Automatisering of Bedrijfskundige Informatica. Je hebt ervaring met AI/ML-toepassingen, API’s, webhooks of ERP/MES/PLM-integraties. Je analyseert complexe bedrijfsprocessen en vertaalt deze naar pragmatische technische oplossingen. Je communiceert helder met business, IT en compliance en begeleidt gebruikers bij veranderingen. Je werkt gestructureerd, onderzoekt nieuwe technologie en houdt oog voor risico’s en betrouwbaarheid. Ervaring in een gereguleerde sector zoals aerospace, defensie, medische industrie of semicon is een pre. Wat bieden wij jou? Bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.800 en € 5.000 (indicatie op basis van functie en ervaring) 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen. Een bonusregeling. Reiskostenvergoeding en/of fietsvergoeding. Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een collectieve zorgverzekering. Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling binnen een hightech omgeving. Een informele werksfeer met gezamenlijke activiteiten. #Jobster

items.desc: Type: Full Time, Hybrid Team: Research Focus: AI & Agent Systems Who We Are We're a team of founders, engineers, researchers, creatives, and operators building what we believe will be one of the defining companies of the AI era. Some of us came from startups. Some from academia. Some from hospitality, defense, design, or completely different worlds. We don’t care how you got here - we care about your energy, intelligence, curiosity, resilience, and ambition. Who We Are Not We are not remote. We value the spontaneous moments that happen when we’re together - over dinner, in the hallway, around whiteboards. We like being around each other because the best conversations here rarely happen in meetings. We are not your typical team. It’s not just the 10 countries we’re from, the languages we speak or our non-traditional backgrounds. We’re solving hard problems with people we respect - we make the most of our time together, we make it special. We are not another “polished” SF startup . We value velocity over speed, raw talent over brands, and genuine human connection above all else. We value being successful, not looking successful. What You’ll Own & Build As a Member of Technical Staff within the Research Tribe, you’ll be one of the early engineers shaping the core systems that power Seldon. You won’t just build agents - you’ll design the infrastructure that governs how they operate: how they coordinate, how they’re evaluated, and how their behavior improves over time . This is a deeply technical role bridging distributed systems, machine intelligence, and product - turning stochastic models into reliable, production-grade systems. Multi-Agent Systems Architecture: Design and implement agentic systems, rather than prompt chains, at scale. You’ll define agent topologies, robust orchestration layers, structured state management, persistent and scoped memory, tool-use registries and execution, and build structured, inspectable systems. You’re building a long-running harness-based agentic platform, not wiring together LLM API calls. Behavioral & Persona Modeling: Simulate user archetypes with goal-directed behavior. You’ll design data-grounded personas, enable “computer-use” on real interfaces, and develop agents with critique and reflection loops. You’re producing measurable, actionable behavior. Evaluation & Prompt Engineering: Design prompt schemas and reasoning templates as integrated systems. You’ll build frameworks that measure behavioral fidelity and failure modes, and implement automated and HITL feedback. If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship. Signal & Insight Systems: Build systems that transform raw agent outputs into high-signal insights. You’ll cluster observations across runs, implement severity scoring, and map behavioral signals to product decisions. Turn noisy outputs into decisions. Production Reliability: Build the infrastructure to operate agents in production. You’ll implement tracing, attribution, and cost monitoring, detect failure modes and design fallbacks, circuit breakers, and evaluation pipelines. The bar is production reliability. Who You Are Systems, Not Prompts: You prioritize state machines, orchestration layers, and tool-use contracts over prompt hacking. You build for reliability, inspectability, and improvability - you’re uncomfortable with “it just works sometimes.” If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship. Production Experience: You have 5+ years building complex software and 2+ years shipping agentic LLM systems. You’ve built harnesses where agents manage tool selection, error recovery, and multi-step execution autonomously in production environments that run, break, and evolve. Orchestration Systems: You’re experienced with multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution, and complex backends. You optimize for coordination, scoped memory & context, and how agents degrade gracefully under pressure. Python Mastery: You’re an expert in async programming and structured data modeling (Pydantic), building maintainable, scalable systems designed for extensibility. Fast, Iterative Builder: You thrive when research and product move together. You’re comfortable shipping quickly, learning from real users, and refining systems in tight loops. High Ownership, Low Ego: You take responsibility for what you build. You’re willing to be wrong, change your mind, and prioritize being effective over being “theoretically right. Comfortable at the Frontier: You’re excited by ambiguous problems. You’re not waiting for best practices - you’re helping define them. Product Intuition: You prioritize signal over noise because outputs matter. You care that what you build helps someone make a decision. All Backgrounds Welcome: S ome of us are dropouts, some have PhDs. Some are tech veterans, some are first-timers. What matters - how you think, how you build, and how you work in teams. items.desc: Description du poste Domaine Instrumentation, métrologie et contrôle Contrat CDD Intitulé de l'offre Ingénieur chercheur en physique, instrumentation et systèmes embarqués - CDD - Saclay (91) H/F Statut du poste Cadre Durée du contrat (en mois) 24 Description de l'offre « Rejoignez le CEA pour donner du sens à votre activité, mener ou soutenir des projets de R&D nationaux et internationaux, cultiver et faire vivre votre esprit de curiosité. » EN SYNTHESE, QU’EST-CE QUE NOUS VOUS PROPOSONS ? Nous cherchons un(e) ingénieur(e) chercheur(se) spécialisé(e) dans le développement de systèmes de mesure pour l’instrumentation des rayonnements ionisants. Ce poste de cadre en CDD de 24 mois est basé sur le site Nano-Innov de Paris-Saclay, Essonne (91). Ce poste est à pourvoir dès que possible. QU’ATTENDONS-NOUS DE VOUS ? Dans le cadre du projet FRATHEA, le SIMRI développe plusieurs systèmes de monitoring en dose et en forme de faisceaux. Dans ce contexte, le(la) candidate(e) travaillera sur l’intégration de moniteurs faisceaux dédiés à la mesure des faisceaux de très haut débits de dose (UHDR) et de très haute énergie électron (VHEE), ces moniteurs étant basés sur des éléments de détection différents. En partenariat avec les membres de l’équipe projet CEA ainsi qu’en interaction avec les partenaires du projet, il(elle) définira le design le plus adapté au moniteur faisceau, participera aux discussions du cahier des charges des électroniques multivoies associées et optimisera l’intégration et à la validation du dispositif intermédiaire de preuve de concept ainsi que du système final en tenant compte des différentes contraintes liés à l’environnement de la machine délivrant les faisceaux. Ce processus d’optimisation passera par plusieurs développements d’une version simplifiée intermédiaire vers la finale intégrée et regroupant les contraintes du cahier des charges de l’industriel. Vos missions : Définition et intégration des moniteurs : Preuve de concept et version finale : Design du support, design des PCB ; reprise des contacts etc. Choix des matériaux optimisés pour la mesure des faisceaux, prise en compte des contraintes machine associées Intégration de l’électronique multivoies du POC : discussion avec les partenaires extérieurs en charge du développement de l’électronique Obtention d’un dispositif de mesure intégré POC : prise en compte de l’électronique et des contraintes machines Participation aux essais : Participation active aux essais opérationnels et rédaction de notes de synthèse ou de modification des prototypes Documentation : Rédaction de documentation technique Collaboration avec l’équipe pour assurer la traçabilité et la qualité des livrables Pour en savoir plus sur le laboratoire, cliquez ICI. #CEA-List ; #LI-PV1 ; #Ingénieure ; #Chercheuse ; #Research Engineer ; #Industry4.0 ; #Capteurs ; #Scintillateurs plastiques Profil du candidat Vous êtes spécialisé(e) dans le développement de système de mesure de rayonnement. De formation, master, ingénieur ou docteur en physique, instrumentation ou domaine connexe. Vous recherchez un poste dans une équipe dynamique et pluridisciplinaire. Vous participerez à des projets de recherche et développement innovants dans ce domaine. Une première expérience couvrant la conception, le développement et les essais d’un système embarqué d’instrumentation est un atout. Vos compétences principales : Compétences en CAO pour fabrication additive (SolidWorks, FreeCad ou similaires) Compétences en programmation (Python, C#) Compétences avec les outils de CAO de saisie de schémas électroniques ainsi que de routage de circuits imprimés (Eagle, KiCAD ou similaires), notions de la programmation en C et C++ pour microcontrôleur Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’initiative et qualités relationnelles. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? En intégrant notre équipe, vous aurez l’opportunité de : ✅ Travailler sur un projet Européen à fort impact, ✅ Collaborer avec des partenaires de renom en France et en Europe, ✅ Évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et contribuer à des avancées technologiques majeures. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. items.desc: Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 3 years (Tenure Track) | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: FSMA053/2026 | Deadline: 30.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists. The research activity of the DESY theory group "X-ray Irradiated Materials: Theory and Computation" (FS-CFEL-XM) encompasses computational studies of X-ray irradiated materials and nanoparticles relevant for the areas of materials science, diffractive imaging, plasma, and warm dense matter physics investigated with XFEL and synchrotron light sources, with the focus on possible technology development and potential industrial applications. The group is integrated into the Center of Free-Electron Laser Science CFEL, and collaborates with various experimental and theory groups on the DESY campus and at the European XFEL, as well as with various national and international research partners. items.desc: We believe in the power of process and its potential to unlock growth in teams everywhere. Who we are Process Street is an AI software and compliance operations platform startup from San Francisco. We help our customers build, document, automate, and track recurring workflows. Our platform automates the work, enforces the standards, and proves compliance so our global customers can run their businesses. We service over 3k customers around the world, and are VC-backed by Accel, Salesforce, and Atlassian. Our Mission To make work fun, fast, and faultless for teams everywhere. Our culture Process Street was founded on a strong belief in the work-life benefits of a healthy, collaborative remote culture. We value flexibility because many of us are parents, travelers, or just creatives who aren't inspired by the construct of a mundane 9-to-5. Spread across 9 different time zones, we communicate asynchronously, work autonomously, and take real ownership of our work. We know human connections are what make teams strong, so we regularly do coffee chats, game-playing, story-telling, and more, to build strong relationships. If you're entrepreneurial and seek an environment that values impact, ownership, and flexibility we look forward to meeting you! The Opportunity Dash is a managed AI teammate for small teams, built by Process Street. It picks up the recurring work that falls between people — the follow-ups, the handoffs, the things everyone assumes someone else did — and does it in Slack or Microsoft Teams, checking with a human before anything goes out. Dash is new, and most of the people who'd love it haven't heard of it yet. Your job is to change that, and to turn the attention you create into pipeline. This is demand creation, not demand capture, and the distinction shapes everything. There's no proven channel to scale, no playbook to inherit, and no installed base to build referral or expansion programs on. Every source of growth has to be invented and proven before anyone can optimize it. The role has four connected parts: create attention, produce the content that sustains it, convert it into pipeline, and keep finding the next advantage. They're one job. The campaigns only work because there's a content engine behind them, the content only compounds because there's a conversion engine in front of it, and none of it holds for long without constant experimentation. Dash runs like a startup inside a funded one. Process Street has investors behind it. Dash has a small team, its own budget, and has to earn its next dollar — which is exactly why this role exists. Budget won't be the lever that makes a campaign succeed. Creativity, timing, partnerships, and earned attention will be. We want someone whose instinct is to manufacture reach rather than purchase it, and who treats a small budget as a design constraint rather than an obstacle. The same discipline applies to the direct marketing engine: spend should be deliberate, measured, and defensible against the pipeline it produces. You'll have real leverage behind you. Much of our content, research, and distribution runs on an automated production layer, so one person here can put far more into market than they could at a company doing this by hand. You won't be limited by how much you can produce. You'll be limited by what you decide is worth making — and whether it's good enough to ship, backed by a system that moves as fast as you think. What You'll Do Run stunts that earn attention. Conceive and execute the kind of campaign people stop for and share. This is a distinct craft, and we're hiring for it deliberately. Build launch moments. Time the creative, the paid push, and partner distribution to land together. One well-built moment is worth more than months of steady output. Build creative partnerships. Source, negotiate, and close deals with creators, communities, and complementary brands, including working out what makes each one worth their while. Invent channels, online and off. Prove new routes to an audience that doesn't know us yet, using events and activations as part of an integrated campaign, and be as quick to abandon what doesn't work as to pursue what does. Own the content calendar and the output. We publish at high volume across search, video, social, and community. You own what gets made, when it ships, and whether it's good enough. Direct the automated production layer. Brief the agents, review what comes back, correct what's wrong, and extend the system into new formats and channels. Make modern content — short-form video, images, ads, and written work — at a pace that only works if you use AI as a genuine force multiplier. Own discovery in both directions. Traditional search optimization and AI-assisted discovery, where a growing share of buyers now form their shortlist. items.desc: At SWEP, we believe our future rest on give more energy than we take – to our planet and to our people. As the world´s leading supplier of efficient heat transfer technology, we are driving the conversion to sustainable energy usage in heat transfer. We are dedicated to constantly creating more from less energy, material, and space. We are a growing company and a part of the Dover Corporation family. We are dedicated to supporting our customers with the optimal solutions and we believe in close, rewarding partnerships. We are represented in more than 50 countries and have production facilities in Sweden, USA, Slovakia, China and Malaysia. For us at SWEP, it's more than just a job, it´s a commitment to making a difference and an impact by finding new ways to make energy last longer – globally and locally. We are striving for record-breaking growth and are looking for individuals who think like entrepreneurs, have an open mind, care about the environment, and want to inspire and be inspired. Come and join us! SWEP - Innovation Engineer, Thermodynamics If you love developing advanced mechanical systems and turning thermodynamic research into real products, this is an exciting opportunity for you! Come and join us pursuing engineering excellence. This role focuses on bringing applied research and technology concepts into practical industrial applications. What you will do In this role, you will primarily focus on thermodynamic simulations within technology development in our R&D hub, turning new ideas into practical concepts and driving technical solutions forward. You will collaborate with a talented team of engineers and work closely with cross-functional specialists across our global organization who all share a passion for our products and technological evolution. Key Responsibilities Responsible to, in line with superior manager, participate, start-up and lead projects in applied research, technology and concept development Develop methods and best practices within your area of thermodynamics Plan and perform updates of technology trends within your area of expertise Drive, contribute, participate in conceptual development Based on request participate in sales and marketing activities related to area of expertise On regular basis search and evaluate competition and technology development globally by available methods from databases, conferences and literature You will be based in Landskrona reporting to the Innovation Director and be part of an innovation team consisting of 7 technical multi-disciplinary team members. We offer the flexibility that life sometimes requires, but we believe that collaboration and value creation happen best when we sit and work together from our office. Your background Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field with a focus on Thermodynamics or Fluid Dynamics Relevant experience from CFD, Matlab and or AI usage for mathematical simulations Experience in mechanical design, product development or R&D environments Experience from technical development projects, either in industry or university research Fluent in Swedish and English Who you are You have an open mindset and a strong interest in technology trends and industrial development. You enjoy leading technical projects, solving complex problems, and have the multidisciplinary engineering skills needed to understand both technology and market needs. For more information , please contact Thomas Dahlberg, Innovation Director at thomas.dahlberg@swepgroup.com Sounds interesting? Do not hesitate - apply today! You are welcome with your application and CV in English, not later than 13th November 2026. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law. Fraudulent Recruiting Disclaimer: Dover Corporation and our affiliated operating companies want to alert applicants to internet job posting fraud, where parties posing as Dover employees, recruiters, or other agents, try to engage with online candidates in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. We do not endorse or engage in any recruitment practices that involve payment or personal information outside of our official application and hiring process. Please verify the authenticity of an invitation to apply for a job, or for a job offer by contacting us directly through our Dover and affiliated operating company websites at https://careers.dovercorporation.com/ . To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice on our careers site.

 Do nášho vývojového tímu hľadáme vášnivých a na detail orientovaných testovacích inžinierov a inžinierky (alebo členov či členky testovacieho tímu ), ktorí budú zohrávať kľúčovú rolu pri zabezpečovaní bezchybnej funkčnosti našich produktov. Ak ťa baví odhaľovať skryté nedostatky a navrhovať komplexné testovacie stratégie, si na správnom mieste!
 Čo bude tvojou úlohou v tejto roli v našom tíme:
 Architekt/ka kvality: Budeš navrhovať a definovať testovacie stratégie a plány pre mikroprocesorové zariadenia a zabezpečovať tak ich spoľahlivosť od samého začiatku.
 Tvorca/kyňa test scenárov: Budeš tvoriť prepracované testovacie scenáre, ktoré dôkladne overia funkčné a systémové vlastnosti vyvíjaných produktov s rôznym zameraním:
 Hladká integrácia softvéru a hardvéru;
 Komplexné testovanie softvéru pre embedded systémy a aplikačného softvéru;
 Overovanie interakcie medzi zariadeniami a systémami.
 Praktický tester / testerka: Budeš realizovať manuálne a automatizované testovanie a odhaľovať a analyzovať chyby z pohľadu bezpečnosti, výkonu, funkčnosti a použiteľnosti, aby sme mali istotu, že naše produkty dosahujú najvyššiu kvalitu.
 Analytik/čka a komunikátor/ka: Výsledky testovania budeš prenášať do zrozumiteľných reportov a dokumentácie, aby s nimi mohli pracovať ostatné vývojové tímy.
 Tímový hráč / hráčka: Budeš úzko spolupracovať s inými vývojovými tímami a projektovými manažérmi, koordinovať testovacie aktivity a zabezpečovať bezproblémovú integráciu testovania do vývojového cyklu produktu.

items.desc: About The AI Security Institute The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally. We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action. Expression of Interest - Cyber and Autonomous Systems Team (CAST) CAST is open to expressions of interest from talented cyber security experts and software engineers of all levels of seniority who want to work at the forefront of frontier AI security but do not see a role listed that matches their skills and experience. Our talent team will reach out should a role arise that may be a good match. About The Team AI capabilities in cybersecurity and autonomy are advancing faster than at any point in history. Frontier models can now work through multi-step network intrusions, discover and exploit software vulnerabilities, and carry out long-horizon technical tasks with increasing independence. These are extraordinary tools for scientific and economic progress, but also have the potential for serious harm if misused or deployed without adequate oversight. The team evaluates the capability of both frontier and open-weight AI models in cybersecurity, autonomy and AI R&D, ensuring the UK government and its partners have an accurate view of risks and capabilities. We use realistic cyber ranges and a large CTF suite for our evaluations, run pre-deployment testing of frontier models, and collaborate with our partners across UK government, frontier labs, and NCSC. Your day-to-day work might include building state-of-the-art evaluations (e.g., cyber ranges), running pre-deployment testing exercises (e.g., Claude Mythos Preview), validating novel model behaviours (e.g., models cheating in evaluations), and answering timely research questions (e.g., the capabilities of open-weight models). Working alongside you would be engineers and researchers who care deeply about the impact of their work, take pride in their craft, and have a high level of autonomy. If that sounds exciting to you, we'd love for you to apply! Salary £65,000 - £145,000 GBP What We Offer Impact you couldn't have anywhere else Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues. Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally. Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies. Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security. Resources & access Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute. Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly. Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences. Growth & autonomy If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early. 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations. Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure. Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally. Life & family* Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol. Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment. At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering. Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time). On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension. Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms. These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments. Salary Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary. This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures.
