items.desc: Everfield acquires and holds European software companies for the long term. We own 100% of the Business Units (BUs) we buy, but we do not run them directly. Each BU is led by its own CEO. We support and steer the portfolio through a small set of operating ratios that translate strategy into measurable performance. We believe the software industry is going through a paradigm shift: from tools that help customers do the job to agents that do the job for them . Our portfolio has tens of companies, around 500 product ideas in the pipeline, and tens of thousands of customers across European verticals. The companies that adopt the agent paradigm first will define the next decade of their categories. This is one of the most exciting product surfaces in European B2B SaaS right now, and it needs a builder. We're hiring a AI Builder to be the hands-on engineering force inside Everfield's product team. You'll work as the technical counterpart to the Product Lead: jumping into BU codebases, prototyping with agentic coding tools, and shipping agent-first features end to end on real products with real customers. You will not be short on problems to solve. We have a deep pipeline of customer-validated ideas, a portfolio of BUs that are eager to be first movers, and the freedom to prototype in days rather than quarters. What you will do Build agent-first products end to end inside the codebases of Everfield's BUs. Spec, prototype, ship, iterate, hand off. Drop into any BU codebase, get productive in days, and produce working software fast. Backend systems, data platforms, workflow tools, and the occasional UI heavy product. Run agentic coding (Claude Code, Codex, SpecKit and whatever comes next) as the default mode of work, not as a novelty. Where AI tooling does not yet exist for a problem, you build it. Prototype directly with BU customers and iterate based on what they actually use, not what they say in interviews. Work side by side with BU engineering teams on their own codebase so the BU has first-hand experience of how the product was built and can maintain and extend it after you move on. Translate validated ideas into shipped products in weeks rather than quarters. Hand off cleanly: production-ready code, the documentation a BU engineering team needs to keep it alive, and a short technical narrative the BU CEO can use. Spot the next build opportunity while you're delivering the current one. The Product Lead will run customer discovery, but you will be in the room and your technical instinct on what's actually buildable matters. Help codify what works into a repeatable build playbook so the model can scale to additional builders over time. What we are looking for Senior engineer who has shipped real software to real users. An engineering degree or self-taught, either is fine. What matters is the body of shipped work. Founder or near-founder experience. You have founded or co-founded a tech startup (B2B SaaS preferred but not required), or operated as a near-founder with full ownership of a product. You know what it costs to ship. AI-native ways of working. Daily, hands-on use of agentic coding tools. You build with AI by default. You have a clear point of view on where these tools are strong, where they're brittle, and how to wire them into a real codebase without creating maintenance debt. Polyglot pragmatism. You can work across stacks. You've shipped in at least two languages in production. You're not religious about any of them. You can read an unfamiliar codebase and be useful inside a week. Comfort with messy, legacy code. Many of our BUs run mature, established products with rich histories. You can work inside that reality and choose intelligently between greenfield, brownfield, and "greyfield" (a clean rebuild wired into existing UI and APIs). Direct customer exposure. You're comfortable demoing to customers, watching them use what you built, and changing it on the spot. 3 to 8 years of experience, typically in engineering, founding, or hybrid product/engineering roles. Probably did a stint at a larger company and got frustrated. Comfort with ambiguity and jumping between BUs, codebases, and customer segments without getting stuck. Strongly preferred Experience operating across multiple companies, portfolios, or accelerator-style environments rather than spending years on a single product. General familiarity with B2B SaaS fundamentals. Working in English at the executive level. Other European languages are a bonus. Exposure to post-acquisition or M&A integration environments. Nice to have A failed, acqui-hired, or still-running-on-the-side startup on your CV. Scar tissue is welcome. Public technical work: GitHub, conference talks, technical writing, open-source contributions, or a personal site of side projects that show how you think. Experience integrating LLMs into production systems beyond the demo stage: evals, guardrails, retrieval, tools, cost control. How we work We are AI-native and practice-led. …

items.desc: A Different Kind Of Job Description At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make. Why this is a terrible job This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable. You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall. Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four. And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless. Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise. The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening. The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that. We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win. What You'll Build As a Fullstack AI Developer, you'll build the agentic systems at the heart of Filed: Agentic workflows that mirror how tax professionals actually work, judgment call by judgment call Evaluation and verification systems that measure our accuracy against professional standards, not benchmarks we invented for ourselves The model integrations and tooling that turn probabilistic systems into something firms trust with high-stakes work You'll work at the frontier of applying AI to subjective domains, where two different answers can both be correct, and where shipping means earning the trust of professionals who scrutinize every output. What You'll Be Responsible For Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told Making LLMs work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale Your Hard Skillset Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it Your Soft Skillset Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it A championship team We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together. We measure …

Hallucinaties moeten zoveel mogelijk worden voorkomen, consistentie is belangrijk en de uitkomsten moeten aantoonbaar bruikbaar zijn binnen een publieke organisatie. Je komt terecht in een relatief kleine organisatie waar je breed inzetbaar bent en veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Ook wordt van je verwacht dat je je interne collega’s meeneemt in de ontwikkeling en zorgt voor kennisdeling. Je hoofdtaak zal zijn het doorontwikkelen van onze AI oplossing voor vergunningdata. Daarnaast zal ook je inzet gevraagd worden voor de implementatie van Databricks in onze organisatie. Mocht er ruimte over zijn, kan je gevraagd worden andere AI initiatieven op te pakken. De opdracht Als AI Engineer werk je mee aan de doorontwikkeling van het project AI Vergunningen. Je houdt je bezig met: Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van GenAI-oplossingen op Microsoft Azure. Ontwerpen en bouwen van productieklare AI-workflows. Implementeren van prompt engineering strategieën voor betrouwbare resultaten. Verwerken en extraheren van informatie uit vergunningdocumenten. Verbeteren van de kwaliteit, nauwkeurigheid en reproduceerbaarheid van AIuitkomsten. Ontwikkelen van Databricks-data pipelines voor het verwerken, transformeren en verrijken van vergunningdata. Ontsluiten en voorbereiden van grote hoeveelheden documentdata binnen Databricks voor AI- en LLM-toepassingen. Bouwen van schaalbare backend-oplossingen in Python. Opzetten en onderhouden van CI/CD-processen. Samenwerken met functionele experts en interne medewerkers. Actief kennis delen en collega's meenemen in de mogelijkheden van AI. Meedenken over Azure-architectuur, security en beheer. Wat breng je mee? Eisen Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in Data Engineering of vergelijkbare data-gerelateerde softwareontwikkeling. Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Generative AI / LLM-oplossingen. Aantoonbaar HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau (beta/technisch profiel). Uitstekende kennis van Python waaronder software design patterns en coding standards. Ervaring met Microsoft Azure, waaronder: o Azure Functions o Azure AI Foundry Ervaring met prompt engineering. Ervaring met CI/CD-processen, GitHub Actions en Terraform Ervaring met Data Engineering binnen Databricks. Nice to have Ervaring met entity extraction en documentverwerking binnen Azure AI Foundry. Ervaring met Docker en Azure Container Apps. Ervaring met FastAPI. Kennis van Azure Networking en Security. Wie ben jij? Wij zoeken iemand die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook initiatief neemt en eigenaarschap toont. Je bent: Proactief. Communicatief sterk. Verantwoordelijk en betrouwbaar. Resultaatgericht. In staat om zelfstandig te werken. In staat om technische keuzes helder uit te leggen aan collega's en stakeholders. Bereid om interne medewerkers mee te nemen in de ontwikkelstappen en kennisdeling. Waarom deze opdracht? Deze opdracht biedt de kans om te werken aan een innovatieve AI-toepassing met directe maatschappelijke waarde. Je helpt een publieke organisatie om grote hoeveelheden vergunninginformatie toegankelijk en bruikbaar te maken met behulp van de nieuwste Generative AI-technologieën. Je werkt aan de stap van Proof of Concept naar een toekomstbestendige productieoplossing en hebt daarbij veel invloed op architectuur, techniek en werkwijze. Interesse? Reageer met een recent CV en een korte motivatie waarin je jouw ervaring met Azure, Generative AI en Data Engineering toelicht. #Jobster

items.desc: Why This Team The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) is home to deeply talented colleagues that work to ensure the safety of Citi's clients', our revenue, our employees and our proprietary data. We manage information security as one end-to end program – one with a clear mandate and accountability. Our mission is a program that is fully anchored to modern control and architectural frameworks, is fully aligned with the enterprise architecture of the firm and is deeply integrated into the businesses and functions. AI Security Specialist AI models can now autonomously discover and exploit zero-day vulnerabilities in production software — and we're building the defensive capability to match. We're hiring across four CISO teams working at the intersection of AI and cyber security. What Makes This Different The problems we're solving don't have playbooks yet. AI-driven vulnerability management. When frontier models can generate thousands of findings in a weekend, the bottleneck shifts from discovery to triage, verification, and remediation. We're building the pipeline that makes this sustainable. Security architecture for the AI era. Defining how a global bank deploys, monitors, and governs agentic AI — from standards and evaluation frameworks to production runtime monitoring. AI at scale, not in a lab. Citi has deployed AI tools to 180,000+ employees, equipped 30,000 developers with AI coding assistants, and is rolling out agentic AI capabilities firm wide. Securing that footprint and the platforms that underpin them is the job. Securing AI agents that can behave like insider threats. Frontier models can harvest credentials, escape sandboxes, and adapt when they detect monitoring. We're designing the containment architectures and runtime controls to operate them safely at enterprise scale. Real security engineering. This isn't a cyber seat where you'll spend your time in administration . You will be expected to understand the code, the architecture, the threats, and find solutions. You'll have the mandate and the backing to build something meaningful. What You'll Work On Depending on your background and interests, you could join one of four teams: Offensive Security & Vulnerability Management — AI-assisted pen testing at a scale previously impossible. Automated exploit validation. Bridge the gap from "AI found a vulnerability" to "the application team has a PR to fix it." AI & Emerging Technology Security — Define how the bank deploys AI safely. Security architecture and assurance for new implementations, plus building the next generation of AI-powered tools for our CISO colleagues. items.desc: At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way. We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most. Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be. If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you. What You Will Do Build and maintain hands-on lab scenarios and technical content (YAML- and Markdown-based) that reflect real-world use cases, with support from senior team members. Script and automate parts of the training environment (Bash/Python), and help troubleshoot the delivery platform (e.g. Instruqt, LMS) when issues come up. Help design and deliver training sessions, demos and workshops, starting alongside senior instructors and taking ownership of smaller sessions over time. Write clear, concise courseware and technical instructions, and apply the basics of instructional design to align material with clear learning outcomes. Use AI coding/agent clients (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or equivalents) to help build labs, write scripts and draft content faster, learning when to trust and when to verify their output. Collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams, ask for feedback often, and steadily build both technical depth and presentation confidence. What You Will Bring With You A working understanding of core DevOps and cloud-native concepts (containers, orchestration, CI/CD, Linux, cloud fundamentals), and eagerness to go deeper. Hands-on comfort scripting in at least one language (Bash or Python) and working with YAML/Markdown. Clear written and verbal communication and genuine enthusiasm for teaching and presenting to technical audiences, with room to grow. Comfort experimenting with AI coding/agent CLI clients (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Curiosity, reliability, and a habit of asking for and integrating feedback. Working English, written and spoken (an additional language is a plus). What We Look For Someone who applies newly acquired skills to deliver small components of training independently and connects technical topics to customer use cases. A dependable, collaborative team member who follows best practices, seeks feedback, and shows initiative in improving content and delivery. Growth potential toward a well-rounded enablement professional who can both build and teach. items.desc: About Oper Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency. The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment. A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium. Your Mission We are looking for a Business Analyst (DACH) to join our Customer Success team. You will start with one of our flagship Austrian customers, owning the delivery work that turns their business needs into a configured, live Oper platform. As we continue to grow in DACH, you will expand into a broader portfolio of German-speaking lenders, becoming the trusted delivery partner who guides them from kickoff to value. This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys structuring messy problems, sitting in a workshop with bankers and product owners, and translating what they hear into something concrete the engineering team can build and the customer can run. It is also a role for someone who is AI-native , who uses modern AI tooling as a core part of how they think, write, and ship. Tasks Your Responsibilities Capture and structure customer requirements You will be the bridge between what the customer wants and what Oper delivers. Run discovery workshops with business and IT stakeholders at our DACH customers Capture functional and business requirements in clear, well-structured documentation Map requirements to Oper's product : identify what works out-of-the-box, what needs configuration, and what genuinely needs engineering Translate business needs into user stories and functional specifications the squad can act on Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle Analyze integration points Our customers run on complex banking stacks. You will figure out how Oper plugs in cleanly. Review technical API documentation from core banking systems, CRMs, and online banking platforms Work with Oper engineering to identify and define integration points Document data flows, contracts, and edge cases so nothing surprises us at go-live Make smart, pragmatic recommendations on what to integrate now vs. later Configure workflows and deliver value You will own the hands-on configuration work that makes Oper work for each customer. Configure mortgage products, business rules, and customer journeys inside the Oper platform Validate that configurations match the agreed scope and pass acceptance testing Lead training sessions for end users and customer champions Stay close to the customer through go-live and early adoption, then hand over cleanly to the Customer Success team Work AI-native We expect you to use modern AI tooling as a real lever, not a curiosity. Use AI tools to scaffold documentation, draft specs, summarize workshops, and accelerate analysis, automate processes,… Identify where AI compounds your work and where it does not, and design your workflow accordingly Help us push the bar on what an AI-native delivery function looks like at Oper Requirements Your Profile We are looking for someone with a consulting background who is ready to go deep on a product and an industry and love technology: 2 to 3 years of experience in consulting (Big-4, boutique strategy/tech, or implementation consulting). Fluent in German and English You love structuring problems : messy customer conversations come out of your hands as clean documents, frameworks, and next steps You genuinely enjoy customer and end-user interaction : workshops energize you rather than drain you Technical affinity : you are comfortable reading API documentation, understanding integration patterns, and configuring software. You do not need to code, but you should not be afraid of anything technical either. AI-native : you can name the tools, the workflows, and the concrete recent examples where AI gave you real leverage. You see AI as a default part of how you work. Action-oriented, with a knack for getting things done in ambiguous situations Comfortable in a fast-growing, evolving SaaS environment 🌍 Languages …

DEINE ROLLE Agentic Low Code: Du entwickelst als Agentic Low Code Developer mit Copilot Studio und der Power Platform agentische Geschäftslösungen für die Fachbereiche unserer Kunden – von intelligenten Apps und Hyperautomation bis zu Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Enterprise-Umfeld. Du verbindest Low Code, KI und Prozessautomatisierung zu produktiven Lösungen und unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer Governance-Strukturen. Agentische Low-Code-Entwicklung mit Copilot Studio: Du entwickelst mit Copilot Studio maßgeschneiderte KI-Agenten und Copiloten – inkl. Anbindung an Microsoft 365, Dataverse und branchenspezifische Datenquellen – und etablierst agentische Low-Code-Entwicklungsprozesse als gelebte Praxis: von der Orchestrierung mehrerer Agenten über Qualitätskriterien und Evaluierung bis zur Überwachung im Produktivbetrieb. Intelligente Applikationen entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Geschäftsanwendungen mit Power Apps und setzt dabei konsequent auf KI-gestützte Funktionen wie AI Builder und Copilot-Integration auf Basis unternehmensinterner Datenquellen. Prozessautomatisierung und Hyperautomation: Du entwirfst und implementierst intelligente Workflows mit Power Automate – von klassischen Geschäftsprozessen über RPA bis hin zu KI-gestützten Automatisierungen, die Daten analysieren, klassifizieren und Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Architektur und Integration: Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen, die Power Platform und Copilot Studio mit Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure-Diensten und Drittsystemen nahtlos verbinden. Beratung und Governance: Du führst Envisioning- und Discovery-Workshops durch, priorisierst Automatisierungs- und Agenten-Kandidaten und unterstützt beim Aufbau von Center-of-Excellence-Strukturen sowie Governance-Frameworks für den skalierbaren und sicheren Einsatz der Power Platform im Enterprise-Umfeld. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens drei Jahre im Power Platform-Umfeld und technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Microsoft Copilot Studio im produktiven Einsatz. Fundierte Ausbildung: Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich bildet die theoretische Basis. Power-Platform-Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio und Dataverse mit. Agentische und AI-Kompetenz: Du bist begeistert von Copilot Studio und den Möglichkeiten, die agentische KI in der Low-Code-Entwicklung eröffnet, und bringst Interesse oder erste Erfahrung in der Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Low-Code-Umfeld mit. Integrations- und Architekturkompetenz: Du hast Erfahrungen mit Konnektoren, APIs und der Anbindung von Azure-Diensten oder Drittsystemen sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Power Platform sinnvoll in bestehende IT-Landschaften einbetten. Beratungs- und KI-Kompetenz: Du überzeugst Fachbereiche und IT-Entscheider gleichermaßen, übersetzt technische Sachverhalte in Business-Sprache und nutzt KI-Tools souverän im Fachgebiet – inklusive kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse und Enablement von Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden. Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Agentic Low Code: Du entwickelst als Agentic Low Code Developer mit Copilot Studio und der Power Platform agentische Geschäftslösungen für die Fachbereiche unserer Kunden – von intelligenten Apps und Hyperautomation bis zu Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Enterprise-Umfeld. Du verbindest Low Code, KI und Prozessautomatisierung zu produktiven Lösungen und unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer Governance-Strukturen. Agentische Low-Code-Entwicklung mit Copilot Studio: Du entwickelst mit Copilot Studio maßgeschneiderte KI-Agenten und Copiloten – inkl. Anbindung an Microsoft 365, Dataverse und branchenspezifische Datenquellen – und etablierst agentische Low-Code-Entwicklungsprozesse als gelebte Praxis: von der Orchestrierung mehrerer Agenten über Qualitätskriterien und Evaluierung bis zur Überwachung im Produktivbetrieb. Intelligente Applikationen entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Geschäftsanwendungen mit Power Apps und setzt dabei konsequent auf KI-gestützte Funktionen wie AI Builder und Copilot-Integration auf Basis unternehmensinterner Datenquellen. Prozessautomatisierung und Hyperautomation: Du entwirfst und implementierst intelligente Workflows mit Power Automate – von klassischen Geschäftsprozessen über RPA bis hin zu KI-gestützten Automatisierungen, die Daten analysieren, klassifizieren und Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Architektur und Integration: Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen, die Power Platform und Copilot Studio mit Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure-Diensten und Drittsystemen nahtlos verbinden. Beratung und Governance: Du führst Envisioning- und Discovery-Workshops durch, priorisierst Automatisierungs- und Agenten-Kandidaten und unterstützt beim Aufbau von Center-of-Excellence-Strukturen sowie Governance-Frameworks für den skalierbaren und sicheren Einsatz der Power Platform im Enterprise-Umfeld. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens drei Jahre im Power Platform-Umfeld und technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Microsoft Copilot Studio im produktiven Einsatz. Fundierte Ausbildung: Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich bildet die theoretische Basis. Power-Platform-Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio und Dataverse mit. Agentische und AI-Kompetenz: Du bist begeistert von Copilot Studio und den Möglichkeiten, die agentische KI in der Low-Code-Entwicklung eröffnet, und bringst Interesse oder erste Erfahrung in der Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Low-Code-Umfeld mit. Integrations- und Architekturkompetenz: Du hast Erfahrungen mit Konnektoren, APIs und der Anbindung von Azure-Diensten oder Drittsystemen sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Power Platform sinnvoll in bestehende IT-Landschaften einbetten. Beratungs- und KI-Kompetenz: Du überzeugst Fachbereiche und IT-Entscheider gleichermaßen, übersetzt technische Sachverhalte in Business-Sprache und nutzt KI-Tools souverän im Fachgebiet – inklusive kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse und Enablement von Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden. Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: WHO IS ENGIE? ENGIE puts sustainable development at the center of its activities (electricity, natural gas, energy efficiency, and services) to meet the challenges of the energy transition to a low-carbon economy: access to a sustainable economy, climate change mitigation and adaptation, and resource optimization. ENGIE, a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, relies on its Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management (GBU S&EM) to provide reliable, sustainable, and affordable energy to all its customers. This strategic unit optimizes the Group’s and clients’ production assets and designs tailored energy solutions for our 200,000 professional clients and 15 million consumers. The Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management leverages ENGIE’s assets to deliver secure and sustainable energy to its B2B and B2C customers. It uses its expertise in energy management to provide decarbonized electricity 24/7. Joining Supply & Energy Management means becoming part of a team of over 10,000 passionate experts spread across 20 countries, all united by a shared mission: shaping a greener and more efficient energy future. Together, we push the boundaries of innovation to deliver decarbonized energy 24/7. Join us and be part of those shaping the energy of tomorrow! WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? We are looking for a Forecasting Data Scientist Senior in Supply & Energy Management Italy, based in Milan . The ideal candidate is a data-driven professional with a strong quantitative background and hands-on experience in data science and machine learning, particularly in time series forecasting. The role combines solid programming skills (Python and R) with a practical, business-oriented mindset and the ability to transform complex data into actionable insights. He/she has curiosity for energy markets and the energy transition, along with the willingness to deepen knowledge of market design and regulatory frameworks. He/she has experience with energy supply processes, modern data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Spark), and cloud-based analytics environments. Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-experts complete the profile. WHAT WILL YOU DO? As a Forecasting Data Scientist Senior, you will contribute to the development and delivery of forecasting processes and models that support the energy supply business. Under the guidance of the Digital & Portfolio Modelling Manager, you will collaborate closely with forecasting, portfolio managers, pricers, and other business stakeholders to ensure forecasting models are accurate, timely, and aligned with operational needs. Your work will be based on rigorous data collection and analysis, and will directly contribute to optimizing costing, forecasting, sourcing, and hedging strategies within a defined business mandate. You will be actively involved in the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of forecasting tools and methodologies, ensuring alignment with global standards and contributing to their evolution. Your role will also include cross-functional collaboration within the SPM community and with data and forecasting teams in other countries to promote knowledge sharing and consistency. You will be responsible not only for the technical development of forecasting models but also for ensuring their operational reliability and relevance to business needs. You will provide scientific expertise for bespoke analyses and contribute to the continuous improvement of forecasting practices. Key Responsibilities Model and Process Development: Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of forecasting tools, models, and processes used to support the energy supply business. Commercial Offer Support: Participate in the development of forecasting components for new commercial offers, ensuring alignment with business needs and market dynamics. Customer Insights: Analyze customer behavior using diverse data sources to enhance forecasting accuracy and business relevance. Data Utilization: Leverage a wide range of internal and external data sources to ensure robust and accurate portfolio and consumption representation. Best Practices Promotion: Advocate for good practices in data handling, model development, and coding standards across the team and broader community. Code Quality Assurance: Ensure high-quality, maintainable code by adhering to established development standards and guidelines. Cross-Team Collaboration: Actively engage with other quantitative analysts and data scientists across teams to exchange ideas, models, data, and technical insights, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment. About You Personal Attributes Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to tackle complex forecasting challenges and translate data into actionable insights. Clear and effective communication skills, especially in explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. …

items.desc: Vos missions Dans l’unité Identification, Guidage, Navigation et Contrôle (IGNC) du Département Traitement de l’Information et Systèmes (DTIS), vous contribuerez au développement de méthodes innovantes de commande et de planification de trajectoires pour le Guidage-Pilotage des systèmes aérospatiaux autonomes. Les travaux de l’unité visent à accroître les capacités d’autonomie de plateformes aériennes, spatiales et de défense évoluant dans des environnements complexes, dynamiques et incertains. Vous participerez à des études appliquées et à des activités de recherche amont portant notamment sur la génération de trajectoires sous contraintes, l’optimisation temps réel et la commande de systèmes dynamiques. Les applications visées sont défenses, civiles ou duales et concernent en particulier les drones, les missiles et les véhicules spatiaux. Les études sont réalisées principalement pour le compte de la DGA ou en lien avec les grands industriels français du secteur aérospatial (ArianeGroup, MBDA, Thales, …). Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Concevoir et développer des méthodes de commande et de planification de trajectoires pour le Guidage-Pilotage des systèmes autonomes ; Développer des algorithmes fondés sur l’optimisation, la commande optimale, la commande robuste, la commande prédictive et l’intelligence artificielle ; Évaluer les performances et la robustesse des approches proposées par simulation et sur démonstrateurs ; Participer à des projets de recherche nationaux, européens ou institutionnels en collaboration avec des partenaires académiques et industriels ; Valoriser les résultats obtenus à travers des publications scientifiques, revues et conférences internationales, et des actions de transfert ; Contribuer au montage de nouvelles actions de recherche et au développement de collaborations scientifiques ; Encadrer ou co-encadrer des stagiaires, doctorants et post-doctorants. Le poste offre la possibilité de développer une activité scientifique propre, de proposer de nouvelles thématiques de recherche et d’évoluer vers des responsabilités scientifiques au sein de l’unité et du département. Vos missions sont conditionnées par l’obtention d’une habilitation de défense nationale Votre profil Titulaire d’un doctorat en automatique, robotique, mathématiques appliquées ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur complété par une expérience significative en recherche et développement, vous disposez de solides compétences en modélisation et analyse des systèmes dynamiques. Vous possédez des connaissances dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : navigation-guidage-pilotage, planification de trajectoires, commande optimale, optimisation numérique, systèmes aérospatiaux, intelligence artificielle appliquée à la commande et simulation de systèmes dynamiques. Vous maîtrisez au moins un environnement de calcul scientifique tel que Python, MATLAB/Simulink ou C/C++, ainsi que l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral. Une expérience réussie en développement d’algorithmes embarqués, en rédaction d’articles scientifiques, en encadrement de stagiaires ou doctorants, ou dans le cadre de projets collaboratifs serait appréciée. Engagé, autonome et rigoureux, vous faites preuve d’initiative dans la conduite de vos travaux et êtes capable de développer une vision scientifique à moyen et long terme. Votre capacité d’analyse, votre curiosité scientifique et votre goût pour le travail en équipe vous permettront de contribuer au développement de nouvelles activités de recherche, à l’encadrement de jeunes chercheurs ainsi qu’au rayonnement scientifique de l’unité. Votre environnement Le Département Traitement de l'Information et Systèmes (DTIS) mène des études et recherches pour maîtriser conception, opérations et autonomie des systèmes aérospatiaux (commande systèmes, traitement de l’information, IA, ingénierie systèmes-logiciels, interaction homme-système, math. appl., conception-optimisation systèmes, sûreté-sécurité, robotique-autonomie). L’unité Identification, Guidage, Navigation et Contrôle (IGNC) mène des activités d’études et de recherche visant à élaborer, développer et évaluer des méthodes innovantes pour la chaine de Navigation-Guidage-Pilotage des véhicules aérospatiaux. Rejoignez l'ONERA, façonnez l'avenir ! L'ONERA, expert étatique de la recherche aéronautique et spatiale, façonne l’innovation et la défense de demain. Ses 2200 collaborateurs relèvent les défis du futur et renforcent la compétitivité de l'industrie aérospatiale à travers les grands programmes français et européens, porteurs de l’ADN ONERA. Intégrer l’ONERA, c’est s’engager dans une aventure où chaque jour est une occasion d’innover, de repousser les limites de la connaissance et de construire le futur. Rejoignez l’ONERA, et prenez votre envol vers l’avenir !

items.title: Ingénieur(e) / Chercheur(se) R&D – Propagation, modélisation électromagnétique hyperfréquence H/F
items.card: Dans le cadre des activités de recherche et développement du laboratoire Antennes, Propagation et Couplage Inductif (LAPCI) du CEA-Leti, le ou la candidat.e sera en charge de l’étude, de la caractérisation, de la simulation et de la modélisation de la propagation des ondes électromagnétiques pour des applications de télécommunications sans fil et de capteurs électromagnétiques innovants, notamment de type radar
items.desc: Dans le cadre des activités de recherche et développement du laboratoire Antennes, Propagation et Couplage Inductif (LAPCI) du CEA-Leti, le ou la candidat.e sera en charge de l’étude, de la caractérisation, de la simulation et de la modélisation de la propagation des ondes électromagnétiques pour des applications de télécommunications sans fil et de capteurs électromagnétiques innovants, notamment de type radar hyperfréquence. Les travaux porteront sur la caractérisation et la modélisation du canal de propagation dans différents environnements. Ils viseront à comprendre les principaux mécanismes d’interaction des ondes avec l’environnement, notamment dans des scénarios urbains, industriels, indoor/outdoor, terrestres, aériens ou satellitaires. Le/la candidat.e spécifiera et validera les moyens expérimentaux nécessaires au sondage, à la caractérisation et à l’émulation du canal radiofréquence. Il/elle participera à la conception de bancs de mesure et à la réalisation de campagnes expérimentales en s’appuyant sur les moyens du laboratoire : sondeurs et émulateurs de canal, chambres anéchoïques et instruments de mesure hyperfréquence. En complément des mesures, il/elle développera et mettra en œuvre des méthodes de simulation de propagation basées notamment sur le lancer ou le tracer de rayons, l’optique géométrique et physique et les solveurs électromagnétiques numériques. Les simulations seront confrontées aux données expérimentales afin de développer et valider des modèles déterministes, stochastiques ou hybrides du canal. Un second axe majeur concernera la modélisation des signatures électromagnétiques et radar des objets et des scènes. Le/la candidat.e étudiera les phénomènes de diffusion et de rétrodiffusion et contribuera au développement de modèles physiques permettant de prédire la réponse radar des cibles et leur interaction avec l’environnement. Ces travaux alimenteront le développement de méthodes d’imagerie radar et l’exploitation de données multidimensionnelles pour la détection, la localisation et la caractérisation d’objets et de scènes. Le traitement des données pourra s’appuyer sur des techniques avancées de traitement du signal, de statistiques et d’Intelligence Artificielle. Le/la candidat.e travaillera avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et dans le cadre de collaborations industrielles et académiques, nationaux et internationaux. Il/elle assurera le suivi et la restitution de ses travaux et pourra être amené.e à assurer la coordination technique ou la gestion de projets. Il/elle contribuera à la définition de nouveaux axes de recherche, à l’encadrement de collaborateurs et d’étudiants, ainsi qu’à la valorisation scientifique des résultats au travers de publications, conférences et de propositions de brevets. Profil du candidat Niveau école d’ingénieur ou doctorat, avec une formation en systèmes de télécommunications, radar, électromagnétisme ou électronique hyperfréquence. Une première expérience, académique ou industrielle, dans la caractérisation et la modélisation du canal radio, la simulation électromagnétique, les mesures hyperfréquences, la modélisation de signatures radar ou le traitement du signal est souhaitée. items.title: Affiliated Researcher position in the project ‘Solving the integration challenge of high-skilled migrants: the central role of merits’ – at the Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research
items.card: you will be expected to independently and together with the other researchers in the project contribute to: Conducting the analysis of a unique, large-scale recruitment database from a major Nordic company, containing applicant-level information across different positions Mapping and relating to current research on recruitment, discrimination, and labor market inclusion in Sociology and Management studies Conducting
items.desc: About The Position As an affiliated researcher joining an existing project, you will be expected to independently and together with the other researchers in the project contribute to: Conducting the analysis of a unique, large-scale recruitment database from a major Nordic company, containing applicant-level information across different positions Mapping and relating to current research on recruitment, discrimination, and labor market inclusion in Sociology and Management studies Conducting the analysis of the data from our survey experiments from a nationally representative sample using the Swedish Citizen Panel. The experiments investigate perceived integration merits of immigrants in Sweden Publishing original research on the basis of the recruitment database and the survey experiment Being part of the Center for Migration and Integration Research -CMIR is optional. If you wish to be part of CMIR, you will be expected to participate in the Center’s research activities (e.g. research seminars) and multistakeholder activities (e.g., workshops, roundtables, and dialogue forums) Your profile The successful candidate will have built a research agenda during their PhD, as evidenced by publications or conference papers, in the broad field of migration and integration. Their general disciplinary background should be within the social sciences, preferably in sociology or management with a focus on migration and integration. They master quantitative methods and have a very good understanding of survey experiments. Candidates should thrive in a collaborative environment while driving their contribution to the project independently. The applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment. They have shown ability and ambition to publish manuscripts in highly ranked, international scholarly journals. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm and to be physically present in the office. How To Apply Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest November 1st, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application: A curriculum vitae A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings). Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5) Names and contact information for three people willing to provide references. We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before November 1st, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around December 2026. The employment is up to the end of December 2027. For further questions on the position, please contact Laurence Romani: laurence.romani@hhs.se or Andrea Voyer: Andrea.voyer@sociology.su.se The position is formally at the Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research About Stockholm School Of Economics Institute For Research Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research is an independent research foundation, founded in 2010. The overall aim is to conduct qualified academic research within the economic sciences, which aims to unite scientific stringency with empirical relevance. The purpose of the Institute’s publications is to disseminate research concerning corporate enterprises and society. About The Center For Migration And Integration Research The Center for Migration and Integration Research (CMIR), housed at the SSE House of Governance and Public Policy (GaPP), aims to create a platform to support the sustainable integration of third-country nationals in Sweden. Together with key stakeholders in the migration and integration process, experiences and insights are researched and incorporated into a systemic perspective. The Center emphasizes the importance of the collaboration of multiple stakeholders in the governance of migration and integration, at multiple levels, and focuses not only on employment, but also on other dimensions of sustainable migration and integration. The research team collects, creates, and disseminates multiple-actor, science-based knowledge on the governance of migration and integration in Sweden for societal and social sustainability.

About the job
 Build the framework support that helps AI developers unlock Graphcore hardware.
 You will help Graphcore accelerators work seamlessly with state-of-the-art ML frameworks, including Triton and PyTorch. Reporting to a Team Lead in Frameworks, you will design, implement, optimise and support critical software.
 Your work will shape how researchers and engineers use Graphcore hardware for demanding machine learning workloads. You will improve performance, quality and usability across a complex software stack.
 You will join our Triton team, delivering new features, reviewing code, writing technical documentation and working with upstream communities. You will also help coordinate open-ended technical work across teams.
 This role offers deep technical ownership and visible impact as the ML software landscape evolves. You will keep learning and may contribute across other framework teams.
 The team and culture
 The Frameworks team connects Graphcore hardware with the tools ML engineers and researchers rely on. We work across PyTorch, Triton, JAX and TensorFlow, focusing on usability and performance.
 Work happens through agile practices, close technical discussion and clear ownership. Engineers are trusted to speak up, solve hard problems and move work forward with pace.
 Decisions are shaped by evidence, code quality and business outcomes. You will work across Graphcore and with open-source communities to deliver software developers can trust.
 What we’re looking for
 · Strong software engineering skills, with the judgement to manage quality, complexity and technical debt.
· Experience developing in Python and C++.
· Experience in compiler development.
· Ability to manage complex technical tasks with cross-team dependencies.
· Clear communication skills, with a proactive approach to collaboration and technical leadership.
· Interest in AI, ML frameworks, performance optimisation or computationally intensive engineering.
 Benefits
 · Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn
 We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
 Join the Team at Graphcore
 Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
 As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
 Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.
 If you want to shape the frameworks developers use to push AI compute forward, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.

items.desc:
We are hiring builders to define how people talk to, show things to, and hear from AI

In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We've scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action.

The Multimodal team builds the experiences and infrastructure that move AI interaction beyond touch and text — realtime voice, vision, and the platform systems behind them. We own the full path from a user speaking into a device to an answer coming back: the realtime session infrastructure that connects clients to frontier audio models, the backend orchestration that routes, records, and supervises live sessions, and the SDK that powers voice and multimodal experiences across Perplexity's apps.



As a backend engineer on Multimodal, you will design and scale the distributed systems that carry live voice sessions in production — and drive entirely new products at the intersection of voice, vision, and agents.




WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT

 - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious.

 - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it.

 - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users.

 - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products.

 - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and scale the backend session-worker architecture that powers realtime voice: durable per-session workers, provider routing, and stateful streaming over gRPC.

 - Own distributed-systems problems end-to-end — session lifecycle, crash recovery, reconnection and replay, multi-region deployment, and graceful degradation under real production load.

 - Build provider-agnostic streaming protocols from our backend to the Rust SDK that powers voice across every client stack.

 - Drive new products and initiatives in voice and multimodal AI from problem definition through technical design, implementation, and launch.

 - Build the orchestration layer that lets live voice models delegate work to tools, agents, and long-running tasks — safely, asynchronously, and at scale.

 - Partner closely with SDK, client, infrastructure, and model teams; work across the stack when the product demands it, from backend services to client-facing APIs.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend or distributed systems.

 - Strong experience in Rust, Python, or Go (we work primarily in Rust and Python).

 - Experience designing and operating production distributed systems: streaming RPC (gRPC or similar), stateful services, message-driven architectures, and failure recovery.

 - Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure — deploying, scaling, and operating services on AWS or equivalent.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to translate user problems into simple, effective technical solutions.

 - Genuine interest and adoption of AI products and willingness to learn quickly.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with realtime media systems: voice, audio streaming, WebRTC, or low-latency transport.

 - Full-stack range — comfort building end-to-end, from backend services through client SDKs or web frontends.

 - Experience integrating LLMs, speech models, or computer vision into production systems.

 - Experience with agent frameworks, tool-calling architectures, or sandboxed execution environments.

 - Time spent at a fast-growing startup or on a high-ownership engineering team.




OUR MISSION

Perplexity’s mission is to power curiosity. Curious people are the people who drive change in the world. Driving change is a continuous cycle of learning, building, and integrating.

Learn: curious people constantly learn new things by asking more. They question the status quo in their own expertise and they constantly learn outside of it. Research is essential to them and never ending.

Build: curious people make and create things, to show the world their new answers to problems no one else ever questioned. They take action on what they’ve learned. Makers need tools to create their products, their companies, their reality.

Integrate: they must interact with the world as it is to drive change and adoption. True leaders do not simply build something and hope. They must have armies of agents and workers who can constantly work in millions of small ways.

Repeat. For curious people this is a cycle that never ends.

About the role

Perplexity's fraud prevention team protects our products, users, and infrastructure from fraud and abuse across the whole lifecycle: sign-up, authentication, payments, API usage, and product features. We build and operate a real-time decisioning platform together with the surrounding systems: data pipelines for detection and model training, integrations with product and payment systems, and internal tooling for investigation and response. As a software engineer on the team, you will own services end to end, from design to production operations, and work closely with fraud analysts, ML engineers, and product teams to make abuse expensive and legitimate usage frictionless.


Responsibilities

 - Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend services for fraud detection and prevention

 - Build data pipelines and real-time feature computation that power detections and ML models

 - Collect and process trust signals

 - Integrate fraud decisions into product, auth, and payment flows across Perplexity

 - Own reliability of production services: observability, alerting, safe rollouts, incident response

 - Build internal tooling for investigation, enforcement, and auditability

 - Partner with fraud analysts to turn new abuse patterns into production detections quickly

Qualifications

 - 5+ years building and operating high-throughput, latency-sensitive backend systems in production

 - Strong systems programming skills; Rust, Go, or C++ experience preferred (we write Rust)

 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud infrastructure

 - Solid data fundamentals: stream/batch computations, caching and storage trade-offs

 - Pragmatic, ownership-driven approach: ship incrementally, measure, and make failures degrade safely

Nice to have

 - Fraud prevention, anti-abuse, or payments-risk domain experience

 - Experience serving ML models in production

 - Client-side experience (web or mobile) for signal collection

items.desc:
About Huawei 
 Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.
 At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. We have more than 200,000 employees, of which 55% are employed in R&D, and we operate in more than 170 countries and regions. 
 Huawei invests more than 20% of revenues in R&D every year: in the past 10 years our total R&D investments exceed 150B USD. 
 By the end of 2025, Huawei held +150.000 active patents. 
 Huawei’s Pisa Research Institute is a core innovation hub in the field of automotive software and embedded systems 
 We are looking for a: 
 Researcher in Operating System architecture 
 The opportunity: 
 You will lead design efforts across smart cockpit and autonomous driving domains. The successful candidate will own system architecture design from kernel to framework, tackle reliability, safety isolation, and AI acceleration challenges, and lay the groundwork for the next-generation vehicle computing platform. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Automotive-Grade Reliability Architecture : Build a high-reliability OS framework with strong fault-tolerance for cockpit, driving, and vehicle control scenarios.
 • Smart Cockpit OS Architecture : Contribute end-to-end architecture design and evolution of the cockpit OS, from kernel to framework, ensuring industry-leading performance and robustness.
 • Multi-Domain Convergence : Contribute to the design of virtualization, isolation mechanisms, and efficient resource sharing architectures to support convergence of cockpit, vehicle control, and autonomous driving domains . 
 • Next-Gen AI-Centric OS : Develop key OS technologies to support efficient AI-Agent and heterogeneous resource scheduling and sandboxing enabling a solid foundation for onboard AI applications.
 Required Qualifications: 
 • Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
 • 3+ years of OS kernel development experience in embedded systems
 • Good understanding of low-level system performance and reliability optimization
 • Experience with kernel sub-systems such as scheduling, memory management, device drivers, and system debugging
 • Excellent cross-cultural communication and strategic thinking
 • Fluent in English and confident in public technical discourse
 Nice to have: 
 • Publications or patent record in system software
 • Publications in top-tier conferences (OSDI, ASPLOS, EuroSys, etc.)
 • Contributions in mainstream OS kernels, real-time systems, or embedded OS
 • Familiarity with automotive functional safety standards (ISO 26262, ASIL levels)
 • Expertise in OS safety, virtualization, and domain isolation

 What We Offer

items.desc:
This post is part of ESA’s Junior Professional Programme. We are looking for enthusiastic candidates with up to 3 years of relevant professional experience after their Master's degree to join ESA for a four-year assignment. During this time, you will be actively working and learning on the job and will benefit from valuable mobility and developmental opportunities that will prepare you for a successful career at ESA. Subject to performance, it is therefore the intention to offer you an indefinite contract which will start at the end of the four years. 
 Recruitment will take place at the A1 grade on the Coordinated Organisations’ salary scale . At the end of the fourth year and if you are offered an indefinite contract at the end of your Junior Professional assignment, you will be upgraded to the A2 grade. 
 Location 
ESOC, Darmstadt, Germany 
 Developmental assignments form an integral part of the Junior Professional Programme and may entail a temporary relocation to another ESA establishment or other location. 
 Description 
 Junior Professional in Resilient and Secure Ground Operations Services. If selected for this position, you will report to the Head of the Mission Operations IT (MOI-IT) and Operations Control Centre (OCC) Section in the Ground Facilities Operations Division, Mission Operations Department, Directorate of Operations.
 The unit is responsible for the coordination and end-to-end provision of services and facilities to all users of the mission operations infrastructure, which consists of the following elements that support routine spacecraft operations and launches:
 The Operations Control Centre deployed at ESOC and in the ESA network of ground stations, such as data centres, or dedicated and main control rooms;
 Mission Operations Infrastructure IT services and facilities, such as managed IT services, cybersecurity operations, local and wide area networks, or platform services.
 You will work under the functional guidance of senior staff responsible for cybersecurity, operations resilience, and satellite telemetry, tracking and command (TT&C) services. In the context of system accreditation and system certification, you will interface with the ESA Security Office, as required.
 Within the context of ESA’s ESTRACK TT&C services to third-party customers and partners, you will help improve the dependability and resilience of ground operations services by applying methods drawn from the complementary fields of site-reliability engineering (SRE) and cybersecurity. In doing so, you will support ESA’s ability to continue service delivery in the presence of disruptions and to reduce recovery times following operational incidents. 
 As a Junior Professional, you will support this transformation by promoting SRE and cyber security best practices across the ground operations environments, while gaining hands-on experience in operational contexts and working closely with experienced engineers and stakeholders.
 Duties 
 During your first year, you will work closely with experienced engineers to enhance the resilience and cybersecurity of TT&C services delivered by ESA to external entities, both commercial and institutional.
 By the end of the first year, you will be expected to:
 analyse aspects of solution architecture and operational behaviour of the selected services, identifying cybersecurity and resilience risks based on a systematic assessment of cyber threats and potential systemic failures;
 contribute to the refinement of service reliability and cybersecurity objectives, availability expectations and recovery targets appropriate for mission operations;
 propose candidate enhancements to the target architecture to strengthen the overall security and reliability posture, such as applying automation-based solutions to replace repetitive manual activities, including system provisioning, configuration enforcement or operating system upgrades;
 support improved observability and recoverability by refining procedures with the Cybersecurity Operations Centre at ESOC, including monitoring of signals, recovery workflows and rollback mechanisms;
 support controlled security and reliability testing, such as safe disruption or incident simulations in non-operational environments, to validate assumptions and improve recovery readiness;
 produce and maintain integrated, version-controlled documentation that accurately reflects the design, operation and recovery processes of the services. 
Clear goals, success criteria and milestones for this first-year assignment will be defined prior to your start, ensuring a structured and successful introduction to the role.
 Development programme 
 In addition to your daily work, you will take part in an extensive learning and development programme. From day one, you will learn on the job and benefit from tailored development opportunities, including participation in technical and key skills training courses.

items.desc: #StormYourCareer ? Rejoins STORM GROUP et construis ta carrière avec nous ! Industrialise le potentiel algorithmique et propulse les modèles d?apprentissage en productionDans le cadre de l?industrialisation globale de ses modèles de Machine Learning, un grand compte recherche un(e) Machine Learning Engineer. Ton rôle sera technique et stratégique : tu assureras la transition des modèles algorithmiques du stade expérimental (Proof of Concept) vers des environnements de production haute disponibilité, tout en garantissant leur scalabilité, leur monitoring continu et leur maintien en conditions opérationnelles. Ton futur environnementTu évolueras au sein d?un pôle d?ingénierie data et IA de pointe, à la jonction entre la Data Science, le génie logiciel et les opérations (DevOps). En interface quotidienne avec les data scientists, les data engineers et les équipes de production informatique, tu interviendras sur des flux d?inférence critiques. C?est le cadre idéal pour appliquer les standards les plus stricts du génie logiciel à l?écosystème du Machine Learning, exploiter des infrastructures de calcul accéléré (GPU) et déployer des pratiques MLOps avancées. Tes missions clésIndustrialisation, Packaging & Services d?Inférence (Mode BUILD) : Reprendre, refactoriser et packager le code issu des équipes de data science selon les standards de production (modularité, robustesse, tests unitaires et d?intégration). Développer et optimiser les microservices et APIs d?inférence temps réel et batch (Python, FastAPI). Assurer la conteneurisation (Docker) et le déploiement sur des clusters orchestrés (Kubernetes) exploitant des ressources de calcul accéléré (GPU). Concevoir et automatiser les pipelines d?entraînement, de réentraînement continu (CT) et de validation automatisée des modèles. Piloter le versioning des jeux de données, des artefacts et le tracking des expérimentations via MLflow et du stockage objet (S3). Observabilité, Monitoring & Optimisation (Mode RUN & MLOps) : Mettre en ?uvre les mécanismes de surveillance continue en production : détection de la dérive des données (data drift) et de la dérive des concepts (concept drift) via des outils spécialisés (Evidently, Grafana). Configurer le système d?alerting et assurer le maintien en conditions opérationnelles des services exposés. Optimiser les performances d?inférence (latence, débit) et maîtriser les coûts de calcul liés aux infrastructures GPU. Rédiger la documentation technique et diffuser les bonnes pratiques logicielles au sein des équipes data. Ton profilFormation : Diplôme d?Ingénieur ou Bac+5 universitaire en informatique, génie logiciel ou Data Science. Expérience : Tu justifies d?une expérience confirmée de 3 à 5 ans en développement logiciel intégrant une spécialisation concrète en Machine Learning et pratiques MLOps. Expertise Développement & Machine Learning Impérative : Excellente maîtrise de la programmation en Python et du développement d?APIs performantes (FastAPI). items.desc: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid) About the Department Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare's edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization. About the Team We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable , powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce. Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted. Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard. About the Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Agentic Commerce team to build the core systems, protocols, and customer-facing tools powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization. In this role, you will design and ship scalable software across edge infrastructure, transaction engines, protocol layers, and developer tooling (such as our Monetization Gateway). You will work on cutting-edge standards, cryptographic authentication, and commerce controls that enable businesses to define pricing terms, authenticate agents, verify outcomes, and manage agent-generated revenue streams. What you'll do Design and ship production-ready, low-latency services that make web resources Payable for autonomous agents using emerging standards (x402, WBA, ACP, UCP). Build high-precision systems for usage metering, pricing definition, outcome verification, and value attribution tailored for agentic workflows. Build secure protocols and capabilities for authenticating and authorizing buyers, sellers, and autonomous agents across host-agnostic endpoints. Develop capabilities and APIs that give businesses granular visibility, telemetry, and control over agent-generated revenue, billing, and settlement. Build resilient bridges between mainstream fiat commerce rails, digital wallets, and decentralized/cryptographic payment protocols for Internet-scale micropayments. Write clean, secure, well-tested code, maintain strict accounting/financial precision, and advocate for high reliability, security, and low-latency performance. Partner with software engineers, researchers, product managers, design engineers, and cross-Cloudflare stakeholders to take capabilities from concept to production. Examples of Desirable Skills, …
