items.desc: As a Scientist in Radiochemistry you will be responsible for the development of radiopharmaceutical products in line with the company's strategy. You will participate in the elaboration of the specifications of the products to be developed, design and carry out the useful experimental plans and ensure the conformity of the results with the specifications of each product. When the development is finalized, you ensure the technology transfer and follow-up with the first customers. Your responsibilities : In charge of the design of the processes and consumables necessary for the synthesis of radiopharmaceuticals. Implement and optimize the automated synthesis of radiopharmaceutical tracers. Participate in the definition of research protocols, develop experimental designs necessary for product development, evaluation of their robustness, and their continuous improvement. Develop and write the specifications for each product. Maintain the laboratory notebook and complete and structured experiment reports Write the different reports (development, tests and analyses…) Write and maintain technical documentation and user manuals for TRASIS compounds and chemical material. Design, implement and validate methods for product quality control. Carry out conformity controls. Consult and master the technical characteristics of equipment and consumables, and define processes compatible with them. Communicate and manage the necessary actions in case of anomaly and suggest ways to improve. Carry out installations at the customer’s site when required and necessary. Participate in the research and selection of suppliers. Participate in regulatory inspections (FAMHP,…) and others if necessary. Participate in the drafting of patents. Compile information on a technology, product or application, write scientific reports and communicate them to the team. Write scientific publications, participate in conferences. Work in compliance with radiation protection and laboratory rules. Your profile : Master or PhD in chemistry. A first experience in radiopharmaceutical industry is an asset. Fluency in English is essential (Minimum C1-C2). Knowledge in organic synthesis. Good knowledge in quality control techniques (HPLC, GC, MS, NMR…). Knowledge in radiation protection is an asset. Attractive to work in a laboratory environment. Able to work independently and in a team. Proactive, pragmatic and result oriented. Scientific spirit: precision, rigor, synthesis and analysis. Organization and sense of priorities. Innovative and interested in technological evolution. We offer : Do you want to become a major player in the global fight against cancer? At Trasis, we give you the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and to contribute to the improvement of cancer diagnosis and therapy techniques. Through your actions, you will have the opportunity to have a positive impact on the services provided to users and patients. The opportunity to participate in building and improving processes in a growing company. We offer a young and friendly work atmosphere, a flexible and dynamic environment. An attractive and flexible salary according to your experience and performance, with extra-legal benefits.

items.desc: L’ENAC, École Nationale de l’Aviation Civile, est la plus importante des Grandes Écoles ou universités aéronautiques en Europe. Elle forme à un spectre large de métiers : des ingénieurs ou des professionnels de haut niveau capables de concevoir et faire évoluer les systèmes aéronautiques et plus largement ceux du transport aérien ainsi que des pilotes de ligne, des contrôleurs aériens ou encore des techniciens aéronautiques. Ses laboratoires de recherche sont à la pointe de l’innovation et travaillent activement en coopération avec des universités internationales de haut niveau pour un transport aérien toujours plus sûr, efficace et durable. L’ENAC est un établissement public à caractère scientifique, culturel et professionnel – grand établissement (EPSCP-GE), sous tutelle de la DGAC (Direction Générale de l’Aviation Civile), Direction du Ministère de la Transition Écologique et Solidaire. L’ENAC comprend une direction générale localisée à Toulouse et 8 sites en France. Pour soutenir sa dynamique en faveur de la promotion de la diversité, l’ENAC facilite l’accueil et l’intégration des travailleurs en situation de handicap. The SIGNAV research group, part of ENAC's TELECOM laboratory, has activities in signal processing and satellite navigation for civil aviation. One important source of degradation of airborne civil aviation GNSS receiver is Radio Frequency Interference. Civil aviation standards currently under preparation are standards for Dual Frequency Multi Constellation GNSS receivers, and the assessment of jamming and spoofing threats to these receivers is an important part of the activity for the elaboration of these standards. ENAC contributions to these standards mostly relate to the prediction of bounding of the impact of radio-frequency interference. ENAC is therefore opening a position for a resarch engineer for 1 year, for which the overall goal would be to contribute to the development, validation, and application of models characterizing the impact of radio-frequency interference on GNSS receivers used in civil aviation, addressing both established and emerging interference sources: DME/TACAN pulsed interference in the L5/E5a band JTIDS/MIDS Intra- and inter-GNSS interference, including cross-correlation and spectral separation between GPS, GALILEO, and other constellations signals Terrestrial emitters Portable electronic devices (PEDs) carried on board aircraft LEO PNT The main tasks to cover would be : Develop and refine models of interference-to-noise power spectral density ratios, spectral separation coefficients (SSC), and their impact on receiver acquisition, tracking, and demodulation performance Implement and validate simulation tools (MATLAB/Python) assessing aggregate interference impact under realistic operational scenarios Contribute to defining interference protection criteria and thresholds supporting standardization activities (ICAO, RTCA, EUROCAE) Analyze measurement campaigns and/or spectrum monitoring data to characterize real-world interference environments Present results in technical working groups, contribute to deliverables for institutional and industrial partners (DGAC, EUSPA), and publish in international conferences and journals Required Profile Master's degree or PhD in signal processing, telecommunications, aerospace engineering, or a related field Solid background in digital signal processing, statistical modeling, and/or GNSS signal structure and receiver architectures Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python for scientific computing Familiarity with radio-frequency interference, spectrum compatibility analysis, or link-budget modeling is a strong asset Good written and spoken English; working knowledge of French is a plus Rigorous, autonomous, comfortable working within a multidisciplinary research team

items.desc: About the Role Soil is one of the largest carbon sinks we have, and one of the hardest to measure. Our growing team is looking for a Solutions Engineer to deliver that measurement for the companies and project developers investing in regenerative agriculture. In this role, you'll own client projects from first conversation to delivered result, shape how our science is applied in the field, and turn what each project teaches us into a stronger product. We're looking for someone curious about the science, rigorous with data and code and comfortable in front of a client: someone who enjoys owning a problem and seeing it through. You'll work alongside business development, data scientists and engineers, applying our methodology to real farms, real data and real deadlines. You will join a cross-functional, mission-driven team dedicated to bringing transparency and integrity to climate action. Impact You’ll Own Solutions Engineers provide a variety of services and deliverables to clients and internal stakeholders, owning the long-term success and impact of the solutions we build and use. Own client projects end to end: from scoping to delivered results, reports and maps, as the client’s technical counterpart in workshops and results presentations. Shape how carbon gets measured: design the sampling strategy and estimation approach for each project, from design-based to model-based, and make the calls that let our results stand up to the scrutiny of verifiers and carbon standards. Turn project work into product: identify what our pipeline should learn from each project, and build it into the shared codebase the team relies on. Sharpen our methodology: run the analyses that show how our methods perform and where they can improve, drawing on the latest research and standards in soil carbon. Enable long-term impact: results that can be traced and reproduced years later, with ex-post analyses showing how estimates hold up as new data comes in. Help set the standard: over time, lead projects with new approaches, define the practices our team builds on, and help clients and the industry raise the bar on how soil carbon is measured. What You Bring 3+ years working with geospatial data in Python (e.g. GeoPandas, Rasterio, GEE) and GIS software (e.g. QGIS), in industry or applied research A solid foundation in statistics and machine learning applied to spatial or environmental data, such as sampling design, spatial modelling, model validation or uncertainty estimation Experience writing clean, collaborative code (Git, code reviews, reproducible workflows), using AI tools effectively and critically, and finding your way quickly in an existing codebase Experience owning projects end to end and making sound decisions when not everything is known Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and a genuine drive to contribute to climate action Fluency in English What Makes You Stand Out Geostatistics (e.g. kriging) or digital soil mapping Experience with soil, agricultural or remote sensing data Familiarity with carbon markets or standards such as Verra’s VM0042 or the EU CRCF Hands-on experience training and validating ML models for spatial prediction Client-facing experience, e.g. in consulting or technical pre-sales Production engineering practices such as CI/CD, testing or pipeline tooling Benefits While Working At Seqana Real ownership, and a direct line from your work to measurable climate impact Be part of our highly motivated, committed, and international team with flat hierarchies that is working on solving one of society’s biggest challenges: climate change Witness and shape the evolution of a new business being built Hard, open problems, tackled with design docs, honest debate and scientific integrity Remote-friendly: up to 4 days/week remote when based in Berlin, or fully remote from elsewhere in Germany, with flexible hours Drinks, snacks, team events, and your choice of hardware Seqana is committed to building a workplace culture based on the values of proactivity, authenticity, creativity, and empathy, where equal employment opportunity is guaranteed to all applicants and team members regardless of their race, color, ethnicity, sex, sexual identity, religion, or disability. If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all of the qualifications, please do apply anyway. We are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute in more ways than just what is listed in this job description. We are excited to build a team that celebrates diversity in all its forms. Join us if you want to advance climate action in your daily work and are open to new insights and opportunities everyday.

items.desc: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: €34.000,00 - €62.000,00 Location: Treviso,ITA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . We are seeking multiple Technical Training Instructor Engineers to deliver high‑quality training to our Field Service Engineers on installation, start‑up, maintenance, and commissioning of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This role combines technical expertise, classroom and hands-on instruction, global collaboration, and project leadership. The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and a passion for developing others in a high‑tech environment. General Profile We offer selected candidates advanced training pathways, including comprehensive hands‑on and classroom learning experiences delivered worldwide. In this position, after training, you will deliver both theoretical and hands‑on courses, support global training initiatives, and maintain expert-level knowledge of our semiconductor equipment. You will work independently with minimal guidance, solve complex technical and instructional challenges and serve as a key technical resource for colleagues worldwide. Key Responsibilities Deliver high-quality technical training classes—both theoretical and hands‑on—on advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment at our Global Technical Learning Center in Treviso, Italy. Collaborate with the global technical training team to develop, implement, and maintain training and certification programs, as well as ongoing learning activities. Leverage modern learning technologies to enhance both online and in‑person training experiences. Support the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of training lab equipment and tools at the local site. Manage day-to-day operational activities related to the training organization at the Treviso facility. Deliver technical training both in-house and at customer sites, with a focus on specialized and customized courses; this includes domestic and international travel, as well as occasional off‑shift or weekend training as required. Stay current with internal technology advancements and partner with business units to ensure the latest systems, tools, and processes are incorporated into all training programs. Lead and manage multiple projects with diverse scope and complexity, including coordination of project team members. Collaborate with Technical Publications and Product Business Groups to optimize technical documentation; create or enhance documentation to address gaps; evaluate instructor performance; and train others in standard course development processes, including Instructional System Design (ISD). Provide advanced technical expertise and troubleshooting support for system repairs; ensure training systems meet course requirements and adhere to all safety retrofits and standards. Maintain deep technical knowledge of assigned products to prepare and deliver product-specific courses; share new information with the training team; complete and maintain certifications across multiple platforms and processes, including safety modules; and participate in certifying others. Review published training materials and recommend updates or revisions to maintain accuracy and relevance. Provide coaching, leadership, and mentorship to other instructors; support their technical development, classroom delivery, and certification; and proactively address customer satisfaction issues. items.desc: A strong breeding pipeline starts with translating molecular insights into practical breeding decisions. In this role as Junior Molecular Breeder Open Field Crops, you will support the development and implementation of strategic traits within our global breeding programs. Working at the intersection of molecular science and breeding, you will help bridge research and practical breeding applications, contributing to the development of innovative vegetable varieties for the future. Make a difference as Junior Molecular Breeder Open Field Crops As a Junior Molecular Breeder Open Field Crops, you will play an important role in supporting breeding teams around the world. Based in Enkhuizen, the Netherlands, you will work in an international environment where science, innovation, and collaboration come together to develop the next generation of vegetable varieties. While your primary focus will be on Brassica crops, you will also contribute to projects involving leek, radish, beetroot, onion, carrot and others. Working closely with breeders, molecular scientists, and researchers, you will support breeding programs globally and help accelerate the implementation of strategic traits in breeding pipelines. You will divide your time between data analysis, greenhouse and field evaluations, and project coordination activities. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience while translating scientific insights into practical breeding solutions. In this role, your work will include: Supporting pre-breeding and molecular breeding projects focused on strategic trait development; Analyzing molecular and phenotypic data to support breeding decisions and trait introgression; Contributing to the development, validation, and implementation of molecular breeding tools and methodologies; Supporting the establishment and optimization of breeding pipelines for complex traits; Collaborating with breeders, researchers, and other specialists across international teams; Supporting the coordination of activities across projects and global breeding programs. What you bring as our future colleague As a Junior Molecular Breeder Open Field Crops, you are curious, analytical, and eager to translate scientific insights into practical applications. You have a connection with plants and are excited to see how molecular insights translate into improvements in the greenhouse and field. You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and are comfortable balancing multiple priorities in an international environment. With a proactive mindset and strong collaboration skills, you know how to connect data, people, and breeding objectives. In addition, you have: An MSc degree in Plant Sciences, Plant Breeding, Biotechnology, Genetics, or a related field; Preferably 0-3 years of experience in plant breeding, molecular breeding, genetics, biotechnology, or applied research; Knowledge of genetics, molecular biology, marker technologies, and data analysis; Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously; A proactive, collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills in English and an eagerness to learn and develop; Willingness to travel internationally 1-3 times per year. Enza Z aden as your employer Enza Zaden is an international family-owned company that has been developing innovative vegetable varieties since 1938. Together with more than 3,300 colleagues worldwide, we work on vegetable seeds with better flavor, higher yields and strong resistances. We do this from our mission: “Breeding to feed the world.” Every day, more than 480 million people eat vegetables grown from our seeds, and that is something we are very proud of. We are passionate about our work and care about one another. Good ideas are given room to grow and together we keep moving forward. This is how we continue to grow and innovate, both as a company and as colleagues. What you can expect from us We believe it is important that you can grow in your work and feel good about what you do. That is why we invest in your development, well-being, and job satisfaction. Through our Great to Grow development program, our focus on vitality, and activities that bring colleagues together, we create a work environment where you can keep learning and contribute with energy and enjoyment. You can also count on: A position for 38 hours per week; A gross monthly salary between €3,629 and €4,746 (Scale 7, Collective Labor Agreement for Vegetable Seed Companies), based on a full-time workweek of 38 hours and aligned with your knowledge and experience; 8.33% vacation allowance and an attractive annual bonus program of 10% of your annual salary, depending on your job level and company performance; 25 vacation days, the option to purchase additional vacation days, and one paid vitality day per year, with extra vacation days granted as you get older; A laptop and mobile phone provided by Enza Zaden; A contribution …

items.desc: Would you like to help publish interesting science and liaise with the scientific community to develop a portfolio of Life Sciences journals? About our team You will join a team of publishers, led by a Publishing Director, who together manage around 100 journals in the life sciences. We are part of Elsevier’s STMJ (Science, Technology and Medical Journals) division, which publishes peer-reviewed research across scientific and medical disciplines. About the role You will manage and develop a portfolio of 10–12 life sciences journals, taking responsibility for their publishing performance. You will build strong relationships with editors, editorial boards and societies, and develop your journals in partnership with them, using market data and community insights. This role combines a clear interest in academic publishing with commercial awareness, data-driven decision-making and strong relationship-building skills. You will work independently while collaborating on wider team projects. Responsibilities Follow the market: Keep up to date with developments in publishing and research, identifying needs and opportunities for your journals and the communities they serve. Set portfolio strategy: Use market knowledge and data analysis to develop strategies that meet STMJ targets and keep your journals competitive. Gather, present and interpret data to support decisions. Develop the portfolio: Grow content and financial performance through existing journals and acquisitions, while exploring new content formats, extensions and channels. Manage contracts with editors: Negotiate and manage contractual relationships with journal editors. Manage budgets: Take responsibility for the editorial fees budget. Build relationships: Maintain regular contact with editors and editorial boards and engage with research institutes, societies, funding bodies and the wider research community. Contribute to wider projects: Participate in projects across STMJ and Elsevier, including pilots for new products, services or business models and improvements to ways of working. Qualification: A university degree or PhD Minimum two years of journal publishing experience, equivalent relevant industry experience. Strong English communication and networking skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently and collaboratively across cultures and locations. A data-driven mindset with commercial and financial awareness. Adaptability and an interest in the changing publishing landscape. Good judgement when using AI tools and evaluating their outputs. Willingness to travel, averaging 3–4 trips per year. Work in a Way That Works for You We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. Working Pattern Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. About the Business A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world. Primary Location Base Pay Range: NLD Amsterdam (Radarweg) €49,000 - €81,700. This role is covered by the Collective Labor Agreement Publishing Industry. items.desc: At BMAT Music Innovators, we connect music usage data with the information needed to identify rights holders and support accurate royalty distribution. Our work combines music expertise, data, technology, and operational delivery. We're looking for an Operations Specialist who enjoys analyzing how things work, solving complex problems, and finding better ways to get things done. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of clients, data, operations, and technology. You'll assess customer needs, coordinate operational delivery, and collaborate with technical teams to turn challenges into practical, scalable solutions. What you'll do Understand and deliver: Learn our services and operational workflows, grasp client needs, and ensure reliable execution. Bridge business and technology: Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Analyze data and solve problems: Investigate datasets, identify inconsistencies, uncover root causes, and turn findings into actionable improvements. Improve and automate: Spot repetitive tasks, streamline inefficient workflows, and partner with relevant teams to implement automation. Collaborate across teams: Work closely with clients, Operations, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders to resolve issues and improve service delivery. Drive scalability: Look for opportunities to reduce operational effort and enhance quality as our services and customer needs evolve. Requirements What we're looking for 3+ years of experience in project management, technical account management, or client support within technical environments. Highly organized multitasker with strong attention to detail. Initiative, drive, enthusiasm, and entrepreneurial attitude. Excellent decision-making, critical thinking, and problem-solving. Passion for listening, asking, understanding, and communicating. Love for teamwork and learning. Technical literacy: you can follow technical discussions, understand concepts such as backend and frontend systems and data pipelines, and read and write technical documentation. Coding experience is welcome but not required. Be comfortable dealing with a large amount of data and numbers. Fluency in English is a must. Proficiency in Indonesian or Filipino are a plus but not mandatory. Based in Europe or APAC region Knowledge or experience about music publishing and internal CMOs documentation and distribution processes is highly desired. What success looks like Within 30 days: Understand BMAT's services, the team's operational responsibilities and the main data and technical workflows. Within 60 days: Take ownership of assigned operational responsibilities, lead client communication and deliver a straightforward assignment using existing processes and guidance. Within 90 days: Work independently on core responsibilities, contribute to problem-solving and identify opportunities to improve or automate existing workflows. Benefits You Can Enjoy Flexible working hours and location Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest. You can make the role your own and run your own development Flat hierarchy Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/ Who the FAQ are BMAT BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 200 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, Nairobi, Oslo, Tel-Aviv, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos. We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music, the excitement for innovative technology and Barcelona as a backdrop has proven to make a good combination. Join us from wherever you are on our mission to help make music live forever. Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.

items.desc: FEA Engineer Reference 2026-FIX-39 Deadline 22/11/2026 Division Engineering Institution ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges. Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage. Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. One of the goals of our gender equality plan is to reach parity within the Consortium’s different divisions and offices, and several actions have been taken to encourage applications from women mostly in scientific, engineer and technical job positions. Located close to Barcelona in a natural park and well connected by car and public transportation, with excellent connectivity to the world and an employer who understands the importance of life-work balance. Facing an upgrade to ALBA II, a 4th generation facility, which will increase dramatically brightness and coherent flux, ALBA is in a phase of growth and dynamics. Being a part of the ALBA team will promote your career and will give you the opportunities to explore new territories. items.desc: A position exists for a Research Assistant in the Department of Engineering, to work on mechanics of fusion materials. The post holder will be located in Central Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, UK. We are starting a new research project focused on developing damage-tolerant materials for space and fusion-energy applications with an emphasis on refractory, body-centered cubic alloys, and high stacking fault energy alloys. Materials used in space and fusion systems must retain their structural integrity under extreme combinations of mechanical loading, temperature, and irradiation. These materials are often very brittle, but new processing techniques, including but not limited to additive manufacturing, can potentially mitigate this issue. The project will investigate the fundamental mechanisms that govern deformation and damage in these materials and use this understanding to identify new approaches to their design. The role holder will conduct experimental research to characterise how candidate materials deform plastically (if at all) and resist fracture. The work will involve performing mechanical characterisation including tensile, toughness and fatigue testing at room and elevated temperatures, performing electron microscopy characterisation including electron backscatter diffraction and transmission electron microscopy, and analysing/interpreting the resulting data. The candidate will be familiar with ASTM E399, E1820, and E647, dislocation mechanics, and microscopy techniques. The job will also include developing equipment including a micronotcher, vacuum-furnace and cryogenic testing system. The findings will be used to establish a first principles understanding and for the development of materials with improved resistance to damage and neutron irradiation. The role holder will work closely with other members of the research group at Cambridge and with external collaborators, including at Lawrence Livermore National Labs. They will be expected to contribute to group meetings, present their findings, prepare research publications, and assist with grant administration. The skills, qualifications and experience required to perform the roles are wide. The specific skills include excellent laboratory skills and data analysis capabilities. The applicant is expected to have at least a Bachelor's degree in Engineering Science or Materials Science and Engineering. A Master's degree is preferable. Salary Range: £33,662 - £36,320 Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available for 4 months in the first instance. Please ensure that you upload your Curriculum Vitae (CV), a covering letter and publication list in the Upload section of the online application. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. items.desc: Can robots and machine learning help us outsmart antimicrobial resistance? Join a pioneering international project – Nanoheal, from bench to bedside – developing the next generation of antimicrobial and wound-healing materials. You will combine laboratory automation with computational design to discover advanced delivery systems, taking formulation discovery from slow, manual trial and error to rapid, data-driven optimisation. Antimicrobial resistance is one of the greatest threats to global health, and discovering new antimicrobials is only half the battle. They also need to reach the site of infection, stay active, and work alongside the body’s own healing mechanisms. This project tackles that challenge by developing biocompatible eutecto-gels: multifunctional, non-dehydrating gels built from deep eutectic solvents, combining antimicrobial agents with healing factors. You will use automated, programmable high-throughput screening technology to build and test a broad library of candidate gel formulations. You will then pair the experimental data with quantum mechanical calculations, molecular dynamics, and cheminformatic descriptors to train machine-learning models. Ultimately, you will optimise gel performance against targets defined with partners across the wider project. Join us and be part of a vibrant community at Loughborough University delivering high-impact science. Here’s more about the role and what we’re looking for: What you will be doing: Adapting formulation methods for on-platform gelation and rapid functional assessment using automated screening. Preparing and characterising gels, including rheology, viscometry and thermal analysis, to build a high-quality experimental property database. Integrating experimental and computational data to build predictive models and identify promising new formulations. Using machine learning to optimise gels across a range of functional parameters. Working with partners across the globe to align your results with project needs and present your findings. What we are looking for: A PhD (or close to completion) in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, soft matter physics, computational chemistry, or a related discipline. Hands-on experience with laboratory automation or high-throughput experimentation, and/or strong skills in computational modelling or machine learning (Python experience is highly desirable). A background in formulation, soft materials, ionic liquids, deep eutectic solvents or gels is a plus, as is familiarity with rheology or thermal analysis. The ability to work independently, think across disciplines, and move comfortably between the in-lab experimentation and computation. Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working in an international team. You don’t need to tick every box; we welcome applicants strong in either the experimental or the computational side who are keen to grow into the other. What we offer A leading role in a high-impact, EU-funded international project tackling one of the greatest current global health challenges. Access to state-of-the-art automation and computational facilities, and the chance to build a distinctive skillset across both experimental and data-driven research. Collaboration with partner groups across the network, with opportunities for joint training and knowledge exchange. A strong launchpad for your next step. You will have the opportunity to establish a publishable dataset, gain hands-on experience with automated and machine-learning-driven discovery, make international connections, and be supported in developing fellowship and grant applications or follow-on funding. A supportive, interdisciplinary research environment and support for your career development. An excellent benefits package. This is a full-time, fixed-term post for 10 months, with part-time working considered pro-rata. Candidates who have not yet been awarded their PhD will be appointed at Research Assistant level. For an informal discussion about the role, please contact Professor Anna Croft, a.k.croft@lboro.ac.uk. For more information refer to the Job Description and Person Specification. We are happy to consider any reasonable adjustments that candidates may need during the recruitment process. If there are additional adjustments, you’d like to request please contact Sarah Hawker s.a.hawker@lboro.ac.uk. We also offer reasonable adjustments on the job. Doświadczenie w pracy w środowiskach regulowanych lub instytucjach publicznych.

items.desc: Nous ouvrons un poste de Data Scientist pour renforcer l’équipe de notre client basé à Genève . Vous interviendrez sur des projets de valorisation de données et d’intelligence artificielle, depuis la préparation des données jusqu’à la mise en production de modèles avancés. Le poste combine expertise technique, compréhension des enjeux métiers et collaboration avec différentes équipes. Responsabilités du poste Collecter, consolider et préparer des données issues de sources variées, notamment en automatisant leur extraction, leur intégration et leur actualisation. Réaliser des analyses exploratoires afin d’identifier les tendances, relations et informations pertinentes au sein des données. Concevoir et faire évoluer des modèles de Data Science et d’IA exploitant notamment le Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision ou Reinforcement Learning. Mesurer la performance des modèles à l’aide d’indicateurs adaptés et les optimiser afin d’améliorer leur précision et leur capacité de généralisation. Assurer avec les équipes d’ingénierie l’intégration et le déploiement sécurisé des modèles au sein des applications et systèmes existants. Accompagner les équipes métiers dans la traduction de leurs besoins en objectifs Data et IA réalistes et exploitables. Identifier les risques associés aux solutions proposées et contribuer activement à la définition des approches les plus pertinentes. Restituer les analyses et résultats de façon claire et synthétique auprès des différentes parties prenantes. Prérequis du poste Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la Data Science, avec une solide maîtrise de la conception et du déploiement de modèles. Master ou formation jugée équivalente en Data Science ou dans un domaine connexe. Excellente maîtrise de Python et Jupyter, ainsi que des principaux outils et bibliothèques de l’écosystème : PyTorch, TensorFlow, Conda et Scikit-learn. Expertise en Machine Learning, Deep Learning et traitement du langage naturel, avec une bonne compréhension des autres approches avancées d’intelligence artificielle. Très bonne maîtrise des problématiques de qualité des données, complétée par de bonnes connaissances des technologies de bases de données. Bonne compréhension des principes d’organisation des services IT et de l’approche ITIL. Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, à prendre des décisions, à anticiper les risques et à proposer des solutions adaptées aux problématiques métiers. Excellent esprit d’équipe, aisance rédactionnelle et capacité à synthétiser et présenter des sujets complexes, avec adaptabilité et efficacité dans des environnements exigeants. Rejoindre Sword, c’est… 💼 Formation continue : Un budget formation qui croit tous les mois à utiliser dans un large catalogue de formation 🏝 25 jours de congés payés : Tous nos employés ont droit à 25 jours de congés payés par an 🚑 Une couverture assurance-accident internationale 🎉 Evènements réguliers : Des événements mensuels pour se retrouver en petit ou grand comité 🌍 Environnements internationaux : Des missions dans des groupes d'envergure internationale 🛠 Innovation : Contribuez à des projets impactants et innovants dans de nombreux secteurs d'activité 🎁 Des petits plaisirs : Nos employés bénéficient d'un programme d'avantages et remises très intéressantes

items.desc: At Kramp, we are continuously improving how we manage and use product information across our organization and for our customers. In this role, you will lead the applied AI capability for product content automation. You will translate business challenges into practical solutions using large language models, AI agents and intelligent workflows. The focus is on applying and improving existing models—not training new machine-learning models—and working with internal engineers to deploy successful solutions securely and reliably on Google Cloud. Your role You will design, build, evaluate and improve LLM-powered solutions that support product content processes, such as extracting, enriching, classifying, validating and generating product information. Working closely with Product Content Automation team, business stakeholders, and internal engineering specialists, you will take ideas from an initial problem through experimentation and validation to production use. Your Responsibilities Will Include Shape and validate AI use cases by exploring business problems, clarifying desired outcomes and defining measurable success criteria before deciding whether an LLM-based approach is appropriate. Build LLM-powered agents and workflows by designing prompts, tool use, structured outputs, context management and orchestration logic, and by connecting solutions to internal data, APIs, search systems and business processes. Collaborate on deployment and integration by working with engineers and architects on APIs, cloud architecture, security, CI/CD and operational reliability, and by continuing to improve solutions after release. Your team You will join the newly established Product Content Automation team, consisting of a Team Lead, Data Analyst and Data Scientist. Accurate and complete product content is essential to helping customers find and select the right parts from 3.5 million highly technical and diverse products. The team develops smart automation and AI solutions to maintain this content at scale, working closely with business stakeholders across Kramp. Who are you? You are an experienced applied AI specialist or data scientist with a strong engineering mindset. You combine hands-on knowledge of LLM applications with pragmatic business judgment and a systematic approach to quality. What You Bring Masters degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Computer Science or related fields Strong Python skills Experience building LLM applications within Gemini Agent Platform or comparable services.. Strong communication and business-awareness skills Experience with CI/CD, observability, guardrails and evaluation. The Following Experience Would Be Beneficial Experience building backend services, APIs and integrations in TypeScript, Java or a comparable language. Familiarity with Google Cloud, containers, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. Understanding of event-driven and batch architectures, IAM, secrets management and observability. What do we offer? At Kramp, we believe meaningful rewards help people grow, perform and thrive. Our reward package is designed to be fair, transparent, and competitive, giving you confidence and support to do your best work. We offer an attractive salary of €5,062 – €6,328 gross per month, based on 40 hours per week, depending on your experience, qualifications and location (Utrecht). The compensation package also includes an 8% holiday allowance on top of your gross monthly salary. 25 vacation days and 12 ADV days (based on a fulltime contract) Flexible working policy in hours and location Travel- and working from home allowance Profit sharing bonus Great budget for training and courses Opportunities to work with modern cloud technologies, automation, and AI solutions A collaborative international environment where you can make a visible impact Generous pension plan Procedure and contact If this role and its requirements excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply via the application button and submit your CV and motivation letter. Even if you don’t meet every requirement but believe you’re a strong fit, we encourage you to apply and tell us why. Do you have a question about this role? Please don’t hesitate to contact Karina Nistor (Talent Acquisition Specialist/HR Business Partner) at karina.nistor@kramp.com. About Us Thanks to our ambitions we are active throughout Europe: a leading position in the agricultural market for parts. We heavily invest in E-Business and innovations. Our aim is to make it easy for our customers to run their business. Working at Kramp means working with over 3500 international colleagues. The people at Kramp are enthusiastic, professional and involved. We speak our customers’ language, understand their challenges and earn their trust to exceed their expectations. Our promise “It’s that easy” is embedded in our culture and DNA. Working At Kramp Means you belong here! Being part of our open business community your work makes a difference! We’re looking for an Associate Data Scientist to join Rightmove’s growing Data, Analytics & AI team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at an early stage in their career to apply machine learning and AI to real problems in the UK property market, while building strong foundations in data science. You’ll work closely with experienced data scientists, machine learning engineers and data engineers, contributing to well-defined pieces of larger projects while receiving close support and guidance as you build your skills. This role would suit someone who is keen to learn, enjoys solving practical problems, and wants to develop their skills within a collaborative, product-focused environment. What You’ll Be Doing A typical week may involve: Building, training and evaluating machine learning models using standard libraries and techniques, under the guidance of more experienced colleagues data quality checks Applying descriptive statistics and creating clear visualisations to summarise data and highlight meaningful patterns Supporting the design and evaluation of experiments and the monitoring of key product metrics Working with machine learning engineers and data engineers to prepare data and support the move of models from experimentation into production Helping monitor deployed models, flagging issues such as performance degradation or data drift Exploring new techniques, including LLMs and generative AI, through small prototypes and proofs of concept Writing clear, maintainable code and following team practices such as version control, code review and reproducibility Using AI tools responsibly and reliably to work more efficiently, while reviewing, testing and taking ownership of anything, they help you produce Following our AI model standards, so that the models we build are robust, well documented and responsibly deployed Keeping your team informed about progress and challenges, and sharing what you learn across the data and AI community Collaborating with product, engineering, and data teams to support delivery of AI features We’re Looking For Someone Who Has a solid understanding of core machine learning concepts, including standard algorithms, loss functions and evaluation metrics Has some experience with Python and SQL (through academic work, projects, or early commercial experience) Is familiar with at least one ML library or framework (e.g. scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow) Has a working knowledge of descriptive statistics and data visualisation, and can interpret results sensibly Is comfortable using Git and basic development workflows Has strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a curious, items.desc: Vuoi iniziare una nuova avventura professionale come Autonomous Systems Software Engineer in una delle nostre opportunità nel settore Defense & Aerospace a Roma ? 👉 Cosa farai? Ti occuperai della progettazione, dello sviluppo e dell'integrazione di soluzioni software per sistemi robotici autonomi e interoperabili. Svilupperai applicazioni e componenti software complessi in Python , adottando moderne pratiche di ingegneria del software. Lavorerai su architetture software distribuite, utilizzando paradigmi di programmazione asincrona, multi-threading e multi-processing. Contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'integrazione di sistemi robotici attraverso ROS2 e middleware di comunicazione. Utilizzerai ambienti di simulazione come Gazebo, AirSim o Isaac Sim per attività di sviluppo, testing e validazione. Collaborerai allo sviluppo di funzionalità per la navigazione autonoma, il coordinamento multi-agente e l'interoperabilità tra piattaforme. Parteciperai alle attività di integrazione e validazione del software su piattaforme hardware reali. Lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con team multidisciplinari e con le altre sedi del laboratorio, contribuendo all'evoluzione delle soluzioni sviluppate. ✍️ Cosa richiediamo? Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica, Automazione, Aerospaziale, Elettronica, Telecomunicazioni, Robotica, Intelligenza Artificiale, Meccatronica o discipline affini. Esperienza professionale di 3-5 anni per profili Expert o 5-10 anni per profili Senior , preferibilmente maturata nello sviluppo di sistemi robotici autonomi. Solida conoscenza dell'ingegneria del software, con esperienza nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di sistemi complessi. Ottima padronanza di Python , utilizzato per lo sviluppo di applicazioni e architetture software complesse, non limitatamente ad attività di scripting. Esperienza con programmazione asincrona, multi-threading e multi-processing. Ottima conoscenza di ambienti Linux e strumenti di sviluppo come Git e Docker . items.desc: Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Adanola and Huel use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin. About The Role We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Fospha's Data Science team in London. Fospha builds marketing measurement products for ecommerce brands — attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact measurement. Our Data Science team owns the models behind all of it, from methodology through to production code. You will work across our technical stacks and own maintaining and growing the codebases that power our product and solutions. This role suits an established data scientist who wants to own things properly. You'll lead larger production projects, choose the modelling approach rather than being handed it, and talk to clients as the modelling expert in the room — supported by a team that reviews each other's work seriously, and a company that rewards high agency with ownership. Team: Data Science Level: Career (Data Science Career Development Framework) Location: London What you'll do Lead larger production projects end to end — scoping, building, and shipping production-level code, rather than working through tickets someone else has specified Choose the modelling approach — independently selecting and applying the right method within our suite, across attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact. You will be given time to keep up-to-date on the latest methodologies in the industry Resolve bugs and queries independently — including in parts of the codebase you didn't write, without needing to route them upwards Use AI as leverage, not as a crutch — solving coding tickets quickly, unblocking yourself on product and engineering dependencies, and building automation workflows that save the team time Work with QA properly — using our automated tooling efficiently and flagging the gaps in it rather than working around them Communicate as a modelling expert — confidently and independently, with clients and with colleagues, including when the message is that a number they like is wrong Help develop the people around you — code review, methodology critique, and hands-on support for less experienced colleagues. Breaking down tickets and helping those more junior is essential What we're looking for Essential Solid commercial data science experience — typically 3–5 years, with a track record of shipping models into production Strong ML knowledge across multiple algorithm families, and the judgement to pick the right approach for the problem rather than the one you know best Strong Python and SQL, with the ability to lead on production-level code and set the standard others work to Able to debug and resolve issues independently across unfamiliar repositories, using AI tooling to accelerate rather than to guess, while still understanding the problem fully Strong AI fluency — you solve tickets quickly with it, you unblock cross-department dependencies with it, you build automation workflows with it, and you never send AI-assisted output without checking it Confident, independent communication with clients and stakeholders as the technical authority on the work Emerging mentorship — you're ready to develop junior colleagues, and you want to Initiative in accepting and planning your own work, rather than waiting to be allocated it Genuine attention to detail — much of this work involves noticing when a number is wrong Nice to have Bayesian modelling experience, particularly hierarchical models Experience with AWS or comparable cloud tooling Familiarity with automated QA tooling and test coverage practices Experience with marketing, ecommerce, or advertising data Not required Experience with attribution methodology, MMM, incrementality testing, or Bayesian modelling is genuinely an advantage at this level — but it isn't a filter. Our stack takes time to learn regardless of what you arrive with, and we'd rather hire strong modelling judgement and teach the domain. How You'll Grow We run a published Data Science Career Development Framework with six levels. items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Audio & Voice AI)
items.card: Role Overview We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to own the technical journey of our customers and partners , from understanding their problems and proving the value of our technology to integrating it successfully in production. Sitting between GTM, Product Engineering, and R&D, you will be the technical authority in customer engagements and turn what you learn in the field into product and research
items.desc: Voice is becoming the primary interface for technology. For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “teaching machines to hear like human beings.” At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, Retell, LiveKit or AssemblyAI use the ai-coustics SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month. We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital , as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity . We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in production, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics. Role Overview We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to own the technical journey of our customers and partners , from understanding their problems and proving the value of our technology to integrating it successfully in production. Sitting between GTM, Product Engineering, and R&D, you will be the technical authority in customer engagements and turn what you learn in the field into product and research input. This is not a role for someone executing an established playbook: you will help create it, operate strategically, and remain deeply hands-on. Speed of response matters here, since a blocked customer is one we can lose. The role is on-site in Berlin. Tasks Drive customer deployments: Run technical discovery, agree on evaluation and deployment plans, and keep customers and internal teams aligned through production rollout. Demonstrate value: Design and run rigorous evaluations using representative datasets, meaningful baselines and metrics. Turn the results into compelling benchmarks, demos and qualitative examples for engineers and decision-makers. Get customers into production: Move fast. Integrate and configure our technology inside customer Voice AI stacks; write code, debug real-time audio pipelines, validate latency and compute constraints, and resolve SDK issues that block rollout. Build a scalable technical GTM engine: Over time, turn recurring customer work into standardized workflows, tools, reference implementations and documentation so we can evaluate and deploy with more customers without increasing effort linearly. Shape the product from the field: Understand customer problems and identify recurring failure modes, integration friction and unmet needs. Reproduce and structure them into actionable input for Product Engineering and R&D. Support technical communication: Contribute to case studies, product education, technical content, talks, or product launches. Requirements 3+ years of full-time experience in a technically demanding engineering role, with evidence that you have independently owned complex projects from an ambiguous starting point through a real-world outcome. Hands-on experience with audio, speech, Voice AI, audio DSP, or a closely related field. You can reason deeply about audio systems, evaluation data, model behavior, and the way these affect downstream applications. A master’s degree in a STEM field , such as computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related quantitative discipline. Excellent communication. You can earn the trust of highly technical engineers, explain complex findings to non-specialists, ask incisive questions, and communicate an uncomfortable technical conclusion clearly when necessary. Understanding of production ML systems. You can reason about inference, latency, CPU and memory use, concurrency, streaming state, reliability, and the practical constraints of deploying models in real-time applications. Solid engineering skills. You can quickly understand unfamiliar systems, write clean and reliable code, and build tools and experiments that others can reproduce. Python is required; Rust is a plus. Excellent command of agentic engineering workflows. Coding agents and AI tools are a core part of how you work. You use them to move substantially …

items.desc: Avanda est une société de services Franco-Suisse. LE ROLE Au sein du service Data science, vous collectez les données pertinentes, les nettoyez et les préparez pour l'analyse, puis appliquez des techniques statistiques et des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique pour en extraire des informations utiles. Vous développez des modèles de data science et d'IA (Deep Learning, Computer Vision, langage naturel, Reinforcement Learning ou autres méthodes avancées selon les besoins du projet). Collecter et analyser des données issues de sources variées (automatiser l'extraction, l'intégration et la mise à jour des données). Réaliser l'analyse exploratoire des données avec des outils statistiques et des visualisations. Concevoir et développer des algorithmes et des modèles de data science et d'IA, et en améliorer les résultats. Évaluer la performance des modèles avec des mesures appropriées et les ajuster pour améliorer leur précision et leur généralisation. Collaborer avec des ingénieurs logiciels pour intégrer les modèles dans des applications ou des systèmes existants, et assurer leur déploiement efficace et sécurisé en production. Présenter et partager les résultats de manière claire et compréhensible aux parties prenantes. Démarrage prévu en janvier 2027. Très bonnes connaissances de Python et de Jupyter, des bibliothèques PyTorch, TensorFlow, Conda et Scikit-learn. Très bonnes connaissances du traitement du langage naturel, du Machine Learning et du Deep Learning, ainsi que de la qualité des données. Bonnes connaissances de la technologie de gestion des bases de données et de l'organisation orientée service (approche ITIL). Important: aider les métiers à définir des objectifs réalistes à partir de leurs besoins et de leurs données; autonomie dans la réalisation et le déploiement des algorithmes et des modèles de data science et d'IA. Qualités: travail en équipe et partage des connaissances, excellente capacité rédactionnelle, de synthèse et de présentation, capacité à prendre des décisions, à challenger les besoins et à être force de proposition, autonomie, dynamisme, capacité à travailler sous stress, gestion des risques. items.desc: Graag motivatiebrief toevoegen m.b.t de eisen Bouw mee aan een productiewaardige AI-oplossing voor vergunningverlening De Omgevingsdienst Brabant Noord werkt aan een innovatieve AI-oplossing waarmee duizenden omgevingsvergunningen automatisch worden geanalyseerd en vertaald naar betrouwbare karakteristieken en metadata. De eerste Proof of Concept staat. Nu zoeken wij een ervaren AI Engineer die deze oplossing verder mee ontwikkelt naar een schaalbaar, beheersbaar en productiegeschikt platform. Hierbij ligt de focus niet alleen op het toepassen van (Generative) AI, maar vooral op de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en controleerbaarheid van de resultaten. Hallucinaties moeten zoveel mogelijk worden voorkomen, consistentie is belangrijk en de uitkomsten moeten aantoonbaar bruikbaar zijn binnen een publieke organisatie. Je komt terecht in een relatief kleine organisatie waar je breed inzetbaar bent en veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Ook wordt van je verwacht dat je je interne collega’s meeneemt in de ontwikkeling en zorgt voor kennisdeling. Je hoofdtaak zal zijn het doorontwikkelen van onze AI oplossing voor vergunningdata. Daarnaast zal ook je inzet gevraagd worden voor de implementatie van Databricks in onze organisatie. Mocht er ruimte over zijn, kan je gevraagd worden andere AI initiatieven op te pakken. items.desc: About This Position A liveable future for everyone that is what we contribute to as the Naval and Offshore Structures department. We design, analyse and test a wide range of mechanical structures for the maritime and offshore industries and for defence applications. Our primary focus is the safety of these structures under the most extreme conditions and throughout their entire service life. We support the Dutch and European maritime industry in becoming more sustainable through the safe introduction of alternative fuels and energy sources, such as methanol, ammonia and nuclear energy. This requires a systematic approach that combines safety, sustainability and affordability. Drawing on our expertise in naval architecture and materials science, we contribute to a TNO-wide approach, including in-depth knowledge of new material ageing and damage mechanisms. Would you like to help create the sustainable and safe ships of the future? Then this position could be for you. What will be your role? As a Medior Scientist Materials Science, you will contribute to a safe and affordable fuel transition. You will develop materials science models and conduct experiments to understand material ageing and degradation. You will use these insights to develop better solutions for the application of new energy systems. You will work in a multidisciplinary team of experts from across TNO and collaborate closely with customers and partners. Drawing on your expertise, you will provide technical direction for projects and help initiate new research projects. You will also enhance TNO’s visibility through publications and presentations. You will join the Naval and Offshore Structures department, which comprises 60 dedicated experts with backgrounds in naval architecture, civil engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics and mechanical engineering. The principal application areas of our research are defence and the maritime and offshore sectors. Our well-equipped laboratories for mechanical testing combine practical and theoretical knowledge, enabling us to solve highly complex problems and validate innovative structural solutions. Our research ranges from the safe use of alternative fuels on board ships and the structural safety of offshore wind turbines to shock- and blast-resistant ship structures. We work on today’s key challenges the energy transition and the growing focus on safety at sea. What we expect from you You hold a university degree in technical disciplines, such as Naval Architecture, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Civil Engineering, with a specialization in materials science. You have substantial experience—more than five years—in the maritime and/or offshore sector and combine a strong theoretical foundation with practical insight into material behavior. Or, you are an expert in material science and would like to translate this to the maritime and offshore sector. In addition to technical expertise, we place great value on communication skills and a customer- and results-oriented approach, enabling you to work effectively as part of a team towards outcomes that are useful and applicable for our customers. You have a proven ability to translate customer needs into concrete research questions and a clear plan of action. You have experience providing technical leadership to small teams and successfully delivering complex projects. You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written. What you'll get in return Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between € 4.819,- and € 6.884,- (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself. TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field. The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs. 33 days annual leave plus a flexible holiday that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing (on a full-time basis). An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics. items.desc:
Meta is seeking Security Engineers with Privacy and Data protection expertise to join our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) organization. You will apply deep privacy engineering expertise to hard, real-world problems in how systems collect, use, retain, expose, and delete data. Your work is AI-augmented from day one: you leverage AI tools and agents to accelerate your impact, and where the models fall short, your expertise directly drives their improvement.
The problems that matter here are the ones a capable engineer cannot solve by reading the code in front of them: which jurisdiction's deadline applies to a deletion request, whether a derived dataset clears an anonymity threshold, where a deletion has to cascade. Models already handle the privacy obligations that are stated as ordinary good engineering practice, so the work is the obligation they cannot derive.
This role is for privacy engineers who want to operate at the intersection of deep privacy expertise and frontier AI, not just applying AI to privacy work but shaping what it is capable of.
Apply deep privacy and data protection expertise to identify, scope, and solve complex problems that require multi-step reasoning, novel approaches, and expert judgment Build privacy capabilities, tools, and evaluation environments, prototyping AI-driven solutions to real-world privacy problems at Meta's scale Design and execute privacy obligation analysis, de-identification assessment, data lifecycle review, or data access reasoning augmented by AI tools and agents Identify where AI models lack privacy reasoning capability and directly contribute to improving them through expert-generated signals, evaluation, and feedback Collaborate with model researchers to translate privacy expertise into training signals, decomposing hard problems into structured challenges that teach models to reason like privacy engineers Partner with legal, policy, product, and infrastructure teams to translate obligations into engineering requirements Own complex privacy initiatives end to end, from problem definition through delivery, and contribute to technical direction within the team Disseminate findings through internal publications, knowledge sharing, and contributions to the broader privacy and security community
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent experience 5+ years of hands-on engineering experience in technical privacy, data protection, or privacy-adjacent security engineering Deep expertise in at least one privacy subdomain with demonstrated ability to advance the state of the art: purpose limitation, retention and deletion, data access control, jurisdictional obligations, de-identification, consent, or ML and model privacy Experience implementing privacy obligations in production systems, in addition to reviewing or advising on them Software engineering proficiency, including code review and maintenance, with experience coding in Python, PHP, Java, C/C++, or an equivalent language Track record of architecting privacy systems, controls or programs that operate at scale and influence how others build Demonstrated ability to define and drive complex, ambiguous problem spaces with group-level impact Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies Experience applying differential privacy, k-anonymity, or other formal de-identification techniques in production rather than in research only Experience with pseudonymization lifecycle, including deletion of the user-to-pseudonym mapping Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Experience implementing obligations conditioned on jurisdiction, age band, or cohort: regional carve-outs, regulatory deadlines, minor and parent-initiated request handling Experience improving AI model performance through expert feedback, red teaming, or evaluation design Background in ML and model privacy: memorization, membership inference, training-data extractability, disclosure through model outputs Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Contributions to the privacy or security community (original research, tools, conference presentations, publications) Experience with privacy review or privacy incident response at scale

***Due to the nature of this role, candidates must be UK nationals or hold British citizenship.***
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

items.desc:
Are you interested in applying scientific research to real-world challenges in CO₂ transport, storage, and emissions measurement?
 In this role, you will investigate chemical processes relevant to CO₂ systems and the measurement of methane, hydrogen, and CO₂ emissions. Working alongside scientists, engineers, and consultants, you will turn experimental research into practical insights that can support the development of industry standards, measurement methodologies, and new technologies for a lower-carbon future.
 What you’ll do 
 Lead and carry out experimental research on chemical reactions in CO₂ systems.
 Plan and conduct measurement activities related to methane, hydrogen and CO₂ emissions.
 Design experiments and develop new test and measurement methods.
 Analyse and interpret complex experimental datasets.
 Translate scientific findings into practical recommendations and technical solutions.
 Prepare clear technical reports, scientific publications and presentations.
 Present research findings at conferences and other technical forums.
 Collaborate with scientists, engineers, consultants and customers on multidisciplinary projects.
 Contribute your technical expertise to the development of new projects and future work.
What we offer: 
 You will benefit from the support that comes from being part of a large and experienced community of auditors,
 Wide range of benefits: flexible working hours, pension scheme, profit share bonus,
 Calibration workshops for auditors,
 Very varied working weeks – your workday is never the same,
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
About you 
 We are looking for someone who brings:
 Doctoral-level qualification or equivalent specialist expertise in emissions measurement, chemical sciences, or a closely related field.
 Experience working with CO₂ composition, CO₂ systems, or emissions measurement.
 Experience designing experiments and interpreting complex scientific or technical data.
 Ability to communicate technical findings clearly through reports, publications, or presentations.
 Experience working collaboratively in multidisciplinary technical or scientific environments.
 Experience working with customers or other external stakeholders.
 Experience contributing to technical project development or new project opportunities.
Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.
