items.desc: About the job The prompt is the easy part. Maybe this is your situation. You got a Claude Code or Copilot license at work this year. Everyone did. But you aren’t satisfied with simply using it to complete your tasks faster. You want to do more. You compare harnesses. You try a new model the day it is released. You build a loop of agents, then a graph of them. You put a workflow behind an endpoint, try a vector database just to see how it behaves, build a semantic index over your own notes, ship a small app nobody asked for. You want this to be your real job, but you have to take that next ticket anyway. Or maybe it is this. You are past that. You have the Max accounts and the API keys. Your AI bill is in the tens of thousands of kronor a month and you think it is cheap. You are building the foundations, pushing what an autonomous model can actually do, and you are good at it. The problem is that you are alone. Nobody at work does what you do, and when you figure something out there is no one to argue with about it. If either of these is you, keep reading. If you have been both, a year apart, we should talk today. What we do Prompting stopped being the hard part a while ago. Everyone does it now. The hard part is the step after: building the structure that lets autonomous models like Claude Fable and GPT-6 plan, build, test, deploy and ship a complete application, with no human writing code, and with code, architecture and tests of a quality no developer sustains by hand. That is TokenTek's whole job. We have migrated millions of lines of legacy code this way, fully autonomously. Independent external code reviews have given the code and architecture our structures produce their highest rating, and we will show you the reports in the first interview. Nobody here writes code by hand. When something is manual, we build the workflow that does it. The tools change with the client. The way we work does not. We have shipped apps with a millions of downloads and a banking app with a million users. Our systems run inside companies in finance, automotive and shipping. You would work forward deployed: inside the client's team, with their management, from first idea to running system. What you would do here You design the checks the model cannot game: the specification, the evals, property and differential tests, and the gates between build, deploy and release. When the model writes both the code and the tests, your job is to make sure the tests mean something. You decide what each model is for, what goes in its context and what it retrieves, and you read the traces when a run goes wrong. You run legacy migrations at the scale of millions of lines, autonomously, and you prove the result is correct. You build the data layer: retrieval, embeddings, vector search and knowledge graphs, exposed as tools and endpoints the client's systems can call, with evals that show it works. You are responsible for quality. What you ship is built to pass an external review, not just a demo. You sit with the client's team, understand the actual problem, and take it from vision to production. If you like teaching, there is room for that too. Together with Hubbau we run a twelve-month AI engineering program for M.Sc. graduates, with our engineers as coaches. What we need from you M.Sc. in computer science, systems architecture, informatics or similar. At least two or three years of building production software, preferably also with experience from data integrations or ML models. There is no upper limit. Being able to present something you built with AI where the model did the work and you built the structure. A repo, a demo, a workflow. Preferably something with real users. Opinions. You know how the models and harnesses differ, and you can argue for your choices. Judgment. Models will hand you working code all day. You know the difference between working code and good architecture, and you insist on the second. Swedish and English, spoken and written. Several of our clients require both. What you get This work, all day, on the company's account instead of your own. Colleagues who read the same release notes you do and are passionate about AI. Exciting projects where you can grow your skills in a small specialized team. Generous vacation, pension and insurance benefits, plus team trips worth closing your laptop for. Practicalities Full-time, based at our office in Göteborg. We work mostly from the office, with flexibility when you need it. How to apply: Send your CV and a link to the thing you built to hello@tokentek.ai, with "AI Engineer" in the subject line. We read every application ourselves.

items.desc: Är du en student som är ivrig att tillämpa dina teoretiska kunskaper och nya perspektiv på verkliga utmaningar? På Saab tror vi att innovationer växer på nya idéer, och ditt examensarbete kan vara gnistan som tänder vårt nästa tekniska genombrott. Din roll Vi ser det enorma värdet som studenter tillför vårt företag. Din akademiska precision, i kombination med din entusiasm för avancerad teknik, gör att du kan närma dig problem med en unik och insiktsfull lins. På Saab får du möjlighet att samarbeta med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister, få ovärderlig praktisk erfarenhet och samtidigt bidra till vår tillväxt och utveckling. Bakgrund Programkod kan genereras av AI-modeller. Vi vill undersöka vad den senaste forskningen visar eller möjligen har missat vad gäller automatiska tester med avseende på säkerhet, prestanda, robusthet, beroenden, drift och underhåll m.m. Beskrivning av examensarbetet Syftet med examensarbetet är att undersöka vilka verktyg och algoritmer som har använts för att angripa denna typ av problem och frågeställningar. Din uppgift blir att ta reda på vad som skulle behöva göras utöver det man redan vet. Vi vill också att du implementerar en prototyp kring det du har kommit fram till. Ett exempel på vad man redan vet är att man skulle kunna använda en separat agent som testar kod som har skrivits av en annan agent. En sådan lösning flyttar dock bara problemet från vad en agent gör till vad en annan agent gör och man har egentligen inte löst någonting eller väldigt lite. Osäkerheten finns där fortfarande. Detta gäller framför allt verktygsstöd. Själva processen (den manuella) spelar visserligen en roll, men i slutändan vill man kunna automatisera tester så långt det går. Processen har då en underordnad roll och det viktiga blir tekniska lösningar för att säkerställa säkerhet, robusthet, prestandakrav, minska eller eliminera externa beroenden, ha en möjlighet att kunna underhålla koden och drifta den osv. Du kommer utföra arbetet på sektionen för Data & AI. Du får en handledare. Personer som aktivt jobbar med dessa frågor kommer kunna ge feedback på ditt arbete allt eftersom det fortskrider. Din profil Arbetet är lämpligt för två studenter med intresse för AI, forskning och utveckling. Du/ni är i slutet av en master-utbildning inom datavetenskap (CS), datateknik (CE) eller motsvarande och ska påbörja ett examensarbete om 30 HP. Du måste ha erfarenhet av programmering så att du är väl bevandrad i olika problemställningar som kan uppstå vad gäller kodstruktur, algoritmanalys (ordo-komplexitet), integration mot andra system via API:er osv. Vi ger dig det stöd och den vägledning du behöver för att omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiska lösningar. Bli en drivande kraft bakom Saabs tekniska framsteg! Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut. Kontaktperson och tentativ handledare Mikael Hillborg, Chef Data & AI e-post: mikael.hillborg@saabgroup.com +46 (0)72 970 2648 Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

items.desc: What Makes Us a Great Place to Work We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. Who You’ll Work With You will be part of a team building Bain’s integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI. You will work inside Bain’s standing product team, building software that helps the world’s largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release. The platform has two layers working together: an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient. This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain’s global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm. We are looking for engineers who see how to make the platform’s evaluations sharper and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. The work involves evaluation frameworks for LLM-based and agentic systems, integration testing, and data problems with no off-the-shelf answer. Experience with agentic systems matters: tool and context protocols such as MCP, evaluation harnesses, and entity resolution across messy enterprise data. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. The field is moving quickly and the team is built to move with it, so the willingness to keep learning counts for as much as what you already know: real-time decision engines, cloud-native infrastructure, and data challenges without off-the-shelf answers. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. Native AI fluency matters here, and so does the drive to keep learning: because the field is moving fast and this team is built to move with it. Where You’ll Fit Within the Team The AI Engineer, Evals and Systems Integration works directly under the AI Engineering Lead, Evals and Systems Integration, contributing to the evaluation framework and integration testing infrastructure across the Growth AI Performance System platform. This is a hands-on implementation role: you will build and run the test suites, evaluation pipelines, and data quality checks that the evaluation framework depends on, working across the data ontology, Agentic Core, and platform and security layers under the direction of the Evals Lead. You will develop broad exposure to the full Growth AI Performance System stack: from the knowledge graph and semantic layer through agentic orchestration and retrieval pipelines to the product module outputs that clients see. This cross-cutting view makes it an excellent role for an engineer who wants to develop deep expertise in how complex AI systems fail, how to measure quality systematically, and what it takes to make a production AI platform reliable enough for enterprise clients to depend on. You will work across the platform and product modules focused on marketing ROI, brand, and pricing strategy, building the evaluation datasets, regression tests, and integration checks that validate quality at each layer and across the integration points between them. The role has developing client proximity. As you grow into the position, you will engage with consulting teams to understand where system outputs fell short in live engagements, and contribute to the structured feedback loops that translate client experience into evaluation improvements. What You’ll Do Building evaluation infrastructure Build and maintain automated test suites and evaluation pipelines for components of the Growth AI …

items.desc: We are looking for a consultant to join Devleaps and work together with us on our client's project. Our client, an international company in the retail and e-commerce industry, is building agentic workflows in its Finance domain. The first end-to-end journey is purchase-to-pay (P2P): it starts in Coupa and ends in the payment system, with AI agents handling the steps in between. As a Devleaps consultant, you will be part of the team delivering this journey, working with the client's Finance team alongside a Product Owner, an Engineering Manager and data colleagues who support you as the work develops. At the same time, you are part of the Devleaps team, with colleagues to collaborate with, learn from and share your experience with. What you will do Build agents that move money, safely. Design and build agentic workflows across the full P2P journey, from Coupa through to payment. Create the missing connections. Build MCP servers on top of Finance systems, such as Coupa and payment platforms, where none exist yet. Plug in what's already out there. Integrate and configure vendor-provided MCP servers where they are available. Own the integration layer. Take ownership of the MCP layer for the Finance domain, including reliability, security, versioning and documentation. Go end to end. Build the supporting application components, from backend services and APIs to lightweight front ends where users need them. Keep humans in the loop. Build logging, audit trails and human-in-the-loop steps into every workflow that touches financial transactions. Turn process into product. Work directly with Finance users to translate their process steps into workflows that can be tested. What you bring Experience: Medior level, with roughly 3 to 5 years of hands-on development experience. Full-stack skills: A strong backend and integration focus, working in Python and/or TypeScript. Agentic AI in practice: Hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based workflows, for example tool calling, orchestration frameworks, and prompt and evaluation design. MCP knowledge: Working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol), or clear evidence that you can pick it up quickly. Integration expertise: Experience with REST APIs, authentication and integrating third-party SaaS platforms. Cloud and CI/CD: Comfortable working in a cloud environment with CI/CD pipelines. The right attitude: A clear communicator who is easy to work with. You ask for help early and share what you learn. Nice to have Exposure to finance or procurement processes, such as P2P, invoice matching and approvals. Experience with Coupa or ERP integrations. Experience testing and evaluating non-deterministic systems. Why Devleaps At Devleaps you are not just placed on a project. You join a team of engineers who work together, share knowledge and support each other across client assignments. You get to work on meaningful, technically challenging projects like this one, with the backing of a company that invests in your growth and keeps you connected to a wider engineering community. Ready to build the future of finance with AI? We'd love to hear from you.

items.card: you will have the opportunity to work within a world-renowned research environment. Our teams consist of passionate and dedicated experts, providing an ideal setting for learning and collaboration. You will have access to state-of-the-art equipment and top-tier research resources to carry out your assignments. The work conducted may potentially lead to a scientific publication. Context : Complex technical documents
items.desc: As an intern at the CEA, you will have the opportunity to work within a world-renowned research environment. Our teams consist of passionate and dedicated experts, providing an ideal setting for learning and collaboration. You will have access to state-of-the-art equipment and top-tier research resources to carry out your assignments. The work conducted may potentially lead to a scientific publication. Context : Complex technical documents combine heterogeneous information such as text, tables, diagrams, figures and equations, often distributed across multiple pages. They include technical manuals, maintenance procedures, user guides, datasheets, product specifications, engineering documents, and technical or scientific reports. Understanding such documents raises several challenges: retrieving relevant information across long documents, jointly interpreting heterogeneous modalities, linking information distributed over multiple pages, and performing multi-step reasoning. This internship aims to develop multimodal agentic AI capable of planning and orchestrating specialized models and tools for complex document understanding and reasoning. What do we expect from you? To address these challenges, the internship will investigate the following research directions: Review existing benchmarks and, if necessary, develop a benchmark covering a fine-grained taxonomy of technical documents and multimodal reasoning tasks. Evaluate recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for technical document understanding. Design an agentic architecture able to decompose complex queries and plan multi-step reasoning. Dynamically retrieve relevant pages and select appropriate tools or models. Combine and reason over information from text, tables, figures, diagrams and equations across multiple pages. items.desc: Job Description Are you passionate about the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and robust software development practices? Do you have a foundational understanding of DevOps principles and a keen interest in applying them to AI solutions? We are looking for an Associate DevOps Engineer to join our team and contribute to developing, deploying, and maintaining AI-powered tools that streamline and enhance the daily workflows of our R&D engineers across hardware, software, architecture, and test functions. In this role, you will work closely with experienced engineers, learning to bridge the gap between AI development and operational excellence. You will help ensure our R&D teams can leverage AI tools safely, effectively, and efficiently, gaining valuable hands-on experience in a supportive environment. How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn Support AI Solution Development & Integration: Assist in the development and integration of AI-driven tools and platforms (e.g., internal LLM chatbots, specialized applications) into existing R&D workflows and systems. Collaborate with AI experts and R&D engineers to understand their needs and contribute to building effective AI solutions. Learn about and contribute to use cases such as initial code drafting, test scaffolding, refactoring, documentation generation, test plan generation, script generation, log analysis, debugging, and design option exploration. Contribute to DevOps Pipelines for AI: Support the building, maintenance, and optimization of CI/CD pipelines for AI models and applications, focusing on automated testing, deployment, and continuous integration. Gain hands-on experience with tools like GitLab, Artifactory, Argo CD, and SonarQube for efficient and secure software delivery. Learn and apply DevSecOps practices to embed security throughout the AI solution lifecycle. Assist with Infrastructure & Cloud Management: Help manage and provision cloud infrastructure (e.g., Azure, NESC, AWS) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with tools like Terraform and Kubernetes. Support the configuration and access for approved AI tools and environments, adhering to corporate policies and security baselines. Assist in the deployment and lifecycle management of containerized AI applications. Monitor, Log & Optimize Performance: Contribute to implementing monitoring and logging solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack) for AI tools and their underlying infrastructure. Learn to identify and help resolve performance bottlenecks, ensuring the reliability of AI services. Participate in the continuous improvement of AI-assisted R&D processes by analyzing metrics and feedback. Develop AI/ML Understanding & Application: Apply academic knowledge or project experience in machine learning fundamentals, algorithms (e.g., Linear Regression, Neural Networks, Deep Learning), and data science techniques. Develop skills in prompt engineering to maximize the effectiveness of large language models for R&D tasks. Understand basic data preprocessing, feature selection, model evaluation, and deployment strategies in cloud and local environments. Collaborate & Communicate: Work effectively within R&D teams, learning from architects, product owners, and the PSE AI Council to align AI initiatives with business objectives and technical standards. Provide support to R&D engineers on the effective and safe use of AI tools. Learn about and report suspected policy violations or data leakage related to AI usage through established channels. Key Skills And Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or graduating soon). Academic projects, internships, or demonstrable personal projects showcasing an understanding of DevOps principles and practices. Foundational knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including basic model development or application. Familiarity with at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) and an eagerness to learn relevant AI/ML libraries. Basic understanding of cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, OpenStack) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Awareness of IaC concepts (e.g., Terraform, Ansible). Basic understanding of monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Interest in secure coding practices and DevSecOps principles. Strong problem-solving aptitude, analytical skills, and clear communication. Eagerness to learn and adapt in an agile, fast-paced R&D environment. items.desc: Hybrid | Vienna, Austria We build Miyon AI, an agentic AI platform for voice. Telecommunications and UCaaS providers offer it to their customers under their own brand, and enterprises connect it to the systems they already use. We’re looking for an engineer who enjoys both building things and talking to the people who need them. Someone who can join a customer conversation, work out what’s needed, and take it from an initial idea to a working integration. The work You’ll work with our white-label partners, prospective customers, and enterprise clients. Some conversations will start with a clear technical brief. Others will start with “could we make this work?” You should be comfortable with both. You’ll help shape proofs of concept, build custom extensions and integrations into our core platform, and see them through to production. That means writing code, asking questions, working through tradeoffs, and staying involved once real users arrive. In practice, you’ll: Join technical conversations with partners, leads, and enterprise customers Turn open-ended problems into practical designs and working software Build proofs of concept that give customers something concrete to evaluate Connect Miyon AI agents to customer APIs, systems, and data sources Build custom extensions and production-ready integrations within the Miyon AI core platform Run workshops and work through integration questions with client teams Take responsibility for deployment, reliability, performance, and ongoing improvements Test with real data and use the results to improve what you’ve built Work closely with Engineering, Sales, and Product, bringing what you learn from customers back into the platform Document useful patterns and build tools that make the next integration easier What you bring You have several years of software engineering experience and have built systems that run in production. You know your way around APIs, cloud infrastructure, and the details that come up when connecting different systems. You enjoy working directly with customers. You can explain a technical decision clearly, ask useful questions, and keep moving when the requirements aren’t fully worked out yet. You take ownership of your work and care about whether it solves the customer’s problem. You’re interested in voice AI and enjoy getting things working in practice. For this position, you need to be comfortable communicating in both German and English, including technical discussions, workshops, and day-to-day collaboration. A few things that would be useful, but aren’t requirements: Experience in customer-facing technical role Familiarity with AI agents, MCP, automation, or conversational systems Experience with SIP trunking, VoIP systems, or telephony integrations Experience with Python, Ruby, or TypeScript Having worked in a growing startup Working here You’ll work on integrations for telecommunications providers, UCaaS companies, and enterprise customers, alongside a team with experience at leading tech companies. There’s room to make technical decisions, own delivery, and influence the product through what you learn in the field. Our office is in Vienna’s 9th district. We work hybrid, with home office flexibility and occasional travel to partner and client sites. If that sounds like your kind of work, let’s talk. The collective agreement minimum for this full-time role is €64,554 gross per year. We’re happy to pay above that.

Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In …

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate, to continuously advance science, and to ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Together, we’re creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
 That’s what makes us Roche.
 Roche Diagnostics presents an exceptional opportunity for you to leverage your technical expertise while providing vital, life-saving support to our valued customers. As an integral member of the South Region Customer-Centric Field Support Team in the UK, this role offers the possibility of field-based assignments across the Kent area.
 The Opportunity: Technical Excellence in the Field 
 As a Field Service Engineer, your focus is to ensure the seamless operation and maximum uptime of Roche’s innovative Systems/Products, ranging from molecular, tissue and serum work areas, plus pre/post analytics and our digital portfolio. You will utilise a combination of on-site support and remote diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex electro-mechanical faults efficiently. Additionally, you will perform preventive maintenance and generate insightful reports to enhance operational efficiency across assigned customer sites.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Deliver Essential Support: Deliver electro-mechanical hardware support, including routine proactive and reactive tasks and technical training.
 Resolve Complex Faults: Perform troubleshooting and fault resolution, conduct preventive maintenance, and generate reports to enhance operational efficiency.
 Customer Training: Provide technical training and guidance to customers, enabling them to excel in the use of Roche diagnostic systems.
 Compliance & Administration: Maintain rigorous administration and regulatory documentation to ensure compliance and efficient service delivery.
 Stakeholder Management: Build productive relationships with peers and key stakeholders to align service and sales objectives seamlessly.
 Service Excellence: Attend internal review meetings to showcase progress, discuss objectives, and ensure service excellence.
 Who you are 
 We are seeking resilient, adaptable, and customer-focused individuals who thrive on solving technical challenges and exceeding expectations. Ideally, you will bring:
 Educational Qualifications: A degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering is preferred. Candidates with equivalent experience at the HNC/HND level with a proven track record are also encouraged to apply.
 Experience: Extensive experience within the IVD industry, with a history of delivering exceptional technical support.
 Skills: Excellent analytical ability, self-motivation, advanced troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a collaborative team environment.
 Customer Focus: A confident, customer-centric mindset with the ability to navigate complex matrix environments and build productive relationships. 
 Attributes: Resilience, tenacity, motivation to exceed customer expectations, and the ability to grow and mentor others through training, coaching, and continuous development.
 Flexibility: Willingness and capability to work within a 7-day support model to meet customer and patient needs across the region. 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Engineering Manager 2 
 __
 Your role and responsibilities 
Plan and ensure execution of Local Business Line projects for ST/ GTs Turbine Control. Complete assignments on multiple Turbine Control System projects of moderate size or portions of major projects, cost- effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, and safety
The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid 
 In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact, as you will be accountable for:
 Coordinating engineering discipline across several Turbine projects, provides technical support for testing, installation and commissioning activities.
 Designing and conducting experiments, analyzes and interprets data, prepares complete project documents in one’s area of responsibility.
 Improving effectiveness of work plan in collaboration with other functions.
 Collaborating with the Supply Chain function to ensure that technical requirements for equipment or services are communicated and agreed to with potential suppliers.
 Providing technical evaluation of supplier proposals and accepts as fit for purpose supplied equipment or services.
 Developing, selecting and applying standard techniques, procedures and tools. Ensuring that engineering activities comply with required safety regulations and contractual requirements.
 Assisting in preparing proposal/presentation of engineering projects/programs (provision of bills of materials, estimated engineering hours, etc).
 Creating work plans and cost estimates in one’s area of responsibility. Reviewing and approving scope, budget and schedule for assignments and ensures quality deliveries on time and within targeted cost.
 Qualifications for the role 
 You have a technical diploma or a Degree in Electrical or Automation Engineering and a minimum of 3 years of experience in Steam/Gas Turbine control applications and projects or in Industrial Automation.
 You have technical experience working with Automation and Electrical products and solutions in the Oil & Gas and/or Power Generation domains. Previous experience with Automation projects involving Turbine OEMs is a plus.
 You have a strong background in Automation, including DCS, Instrumentation & Control (I&C), and Protection systems. Knowledge of ABB Control Systems is considered a plus.
 You have a general understanding of network engineering and IT/IS, including PC handling, Windows applications, PC configurations, virus scanners, interfaces, backups, and cybersecurity.
 You have strong proficiency in Microsoft Suite applications and related business and engineering software such as CAD/AUTOCAD, Visio, Excel, PowerPoint, and Adobe.
 You have a customer-focused mentality that fosters strong relationships and long-term commitments, both internally and externally to ABB.
 You have availability to participate in commissioning activities, both in Italy and abroad, if and when required. You are at ease communicating in both English and Italian.

 Benefits as per policy 
 Flexible working hours, hybrid work options, and a strong focus on work-life integration and Wellbeing support for employees and their families
 Welfare plan with a wide range of personalized services
 Canteen or meal vouchers provided
 More about us 
 The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

items.desc:
Introductie 
 Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar softwareontwikkeling, AI en innovatieve technologieën? Wil je leren hoe slimme digitale oplossingen dagelijkse werkzaamheden eenvoudiger, efficiënter en effectiever kunnen maken? Bij ASML combineer je een Hbo deeltijd ICT opleiding met praktijkervaring binnen een van de meest innovatieve hightechbedrijven ter wereld. 
 Binnen Digital Engineering Solutions werk je in een internationale omgeving waar technologie en innovatie centraal staan. Het team onderzoekt hoe AI en digitale oplossingen kunnen bijdragen aan slimmer werken. Denk hierbij aan het optimaliseren van werkprocessen, efficiënter organiseren van meetings, ondersteunen van administratieve werkzaamheden en het ontwikkelen van slimme toepassingen met behulp van AI. 
 Tijdens jouw leer-werktraject krijg je de ruimte om nieuwe ideeën te onderzoeken, te experimenteren met AI-tools en samen met collega's praktische oplossingen te ontwikkelen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen aan de organisatie. 
 Jouw rol en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Als IT Engineer werk je vier dagen per week bij ASML en ga je één dag per week naar school. Je combineert leren en werken door mee te draaien in het team en bij te dragen aan innovatieve oplossingen voor dagelijkse uitdagingen. 
 Onderzoeken waar AI en automatisering dagelijkse werkzaamheden kunnen verbeteren. 
 In gesprek gaan met collega's om behoeften, uitdagingen en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen. 
 Vertalen van gebruikerswensen naar functionele of technische oplossingen. 
 Ontwikkelen, testen en verbeteren van AI-gedreven toepassingen en softwareoplossingen. 
 Experimenteren met AI-tools en nieuwe technologieën. 
 Bijdragen aan het digitaliseren en optimaliseren van werkprocessen. 
 Leren hoe technologie op een veilige, verantwoorde en effectieve manier wordt toegepast binnen een hightech organisatie. 
 Wat bieden wij? 
 Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €2.600 en €2.850. 
 8,33% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. 
 40 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. 
 Volledige vergoeding van je collegegeld en een betaalde studiedag. 
 Begeleiding door een vaste mentor en coach. 
 Praktijkervaring binnen een internationale hightechorganisatie. 
 Baangarantie bij succesvolle afronding van het programma. 
 Wie ben jij? 
 Voor deze rol zoeken we een enthousiaste student die graag leert en nieuwe technologieën wil ontdekken. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in de volgende eigenschappen: 
 Je bent gemotiveerd om zowel te leren als te werken. 
 Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed. 
 Je woont op maximaal 45-kilometer afstand van ASML. 
 Je voldoet aan de toelatingseisen om te starten aan een hbo-bachelor opleiding. 
 Je bent nieuwsgierig naar softwareontwikkeling, AI en digitale innovaties. 
 Je weet gemakkelijk verbinding te maken met anderen en bouwt actief aan je netwerk. 
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you'll build and run the ElevenLabs partner academy for systems integrators, hyperscalers and technology partners. You'll create curricula across sales, pre-sales and technical implementation, starting with ElevenAgents and expanding across ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI. You'll work closely with our regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who bring the technical expertise and set the technical quality bar. Your mission is to grow the program to 10,000+ certified partner professionals by the end of 2027, and to make the ElevenLabs certification a credential the tech ecosystem respects.



As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you can expect to:

 - Build curricula for partner sellers, pre-sales and implementation engineers: courses, hands-on labs and assessments.

 - Turn expert knowledge from our FDEs, sales and product teams into a world-class online academy.

 - Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call.

 - Scale the program through automation, from automated agent review to bots and emails that support learners.

 - Deliver training online and in person, including sales and technical sessions at our partner hackathons.

 - Run program administration: the learning platform, partner onboarding tracks, reporting and learner feedback.




REQUIREMENTS

We're looking for an enablement builder who is comfortable with both commercial and technical topics. You don't need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you need enough depth to work with senior engineers and sellers as subject matter experts and turn their knowledge into great learning. You'll thrive with us if you:

 - Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

 - Have built enablement or training programs at scale for partners, sellers or technical teams.

 - Learn technical products quickly and can explain them to both technical and commercial audiences.

 - Can run a program end to end: learning platforms, timelines, stakeholders and reporting.

 - Can lead a session or workshop in front of sellers and engineers.

 - Have strong instructional design skills: you can turn expert content into clear courses, labs and assessments.

 - Enjoy turning repeat work into automations, …

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Global Onboarding & Enablement Operations Program Manager at ElevenLabs, you’ll help keep our global GTM onboarding and enablement programmes running smoothly as we grow. You’ll lead the day-to-day delivery of onboarding, making sure every new GTM hire gets a consistent, engaging start, while building the structure and processes that help the wider Enablement team work more effectively and scale its impact.

You’ll bring structure to how we plan, deliver and measure enablement, from tracking OKRs and roadmaps to coordinating the enablement calendar, launches and certifications. You’ll also help keep the team aligned on priorities, manage cross-functional dependencies and use reporting to understand what’s working and where we can improve. Working closely with the Sales Enablement lead and partners across GTM, RevOps, Product Marketing and People, you’ll help turn priorities into well-run programmes that meet the needs of the business.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys bringing order to complex projects, delivering engaging training and finding practical, creative ways to solve problems.

 - Own GTM onboarding: Manage onboarding cohorts end to end, from scheduling and communications to facilitating live sessions, coordinating speakers and gathering feedback. Ensure new hires across regions have a consistent, engaging experience.

 - Develop and maintain learning content: Create training materials and e-learning modules, and keep existing content across WorkRamp and Enablement OS accurate, relevant and easy to navigate. Work with subject matter experts to turn complex topics into practical learning experiences.

 - Coordinate certifications and enablement launches: Own the launch and certification calendar, keeping new programmes, certifications and learning initiatives moving and tracking milestones, completion and follow-up actions.

 - Measure programme performance: Maintain dashboards and reporting on onboarding, certifications, ramp metrics and team OKRs. Use the data to highlight progress, identify gaps and help the team understand where to focus.

 - Own Enablement operations: Run OKR and roadmap tracking, the enablement  calendar, and the team’s operating rhythms (planning, check-ins and reviews). Track dependencies across RevOps, Product Marketing, People …

 Principales tâches et responsabilités
 Les places d’apprentissage pour les apprenti.es laborantin.es en chimie sont proposées dans deux unités : au Laboratoire-Ecole Apprentis de l’Institut des Sciences et de l’Ingénierie chimique (ISIC) à la Faculté des sciences de base (FSB) et au Laboratoire Central Environnemental (CEL) de la faculté de l’Environnement Naturel, Architectural et Construit (ENAC) .
 En tant qu’apprenti·e laborantin (e) en chimie au laboratoire-école , vous serez impliqué.e dans une variété d'activités :
 - Préparer des composés chimiques organiques et ou inorganiques
- Déterminer leur pureté par différentes méthodes analytiques
- Identifier les structures des molécules synthétisées par différentes méthodes spectroscopiques
 Vous serez amené·es à travailler avec :
 - différentes verreries de laboratoire
- des instruments analytiques tels que (HPLC ; GC, titrando, …)
- des instruments spectroscopiques (MS, RMN, UV-Vis,…)
Vous bénéficierez dans tous les cas de l’un encadrement de formateurs et formatrices expérimenté·es.
 Profil
 L'apprentissage de Laborantin·e orientation Chimie est accessible aux jeunes en fin de scolarité obligatoire (VP, VG2, gymnase ...), et qui montrent un intérêt marqué pour les sciences et les métiers de laboratoire.
 Afin de compléter la procédure de postulation, merci d'ajouter à votre postulation : 
 lettre de motivation
 curriculum vitae
 copie de vos bulletins scolaires des 3-4 derniers semestres
 copies de vos certificats, diplômes obtenus, attestations de stages
 Nous offrons
 En devenant apprenti·e à l’EPFL, vous bénéficierez de :
 un environnement de travail exceptionnel
 6 semaines de vacances quel que soit votre âge
 un salaire supérieur aux propositions du canton
 la possibilité de faire un stage à l'étranger de 6 mois grâce à la bourse Movetia
 une aide au financement des trajets en transports publics 
 l’accès aux modules de formation spécifiques, proposés par l’EPFL aux apprenti·es, pour travailler sur l’autonomie, la responsabilisation et le succès de l’apprentissage
 l’accès au centre sportif et aux différentes activités qui y sont proposées

Nous ne formons pas pour la maturité professionnelle en 4 ans, modèle intégré.

Overview 
 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more. 
 Imagine helping some of Switzerland's leading organizations change how work gets done, with an impact that reaches across industries, communities and lives worldwide. As a Cloud Solution Architect for Copilot and Agents, you will do exactly that with Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents and artificial intelligence.
 You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to turn modern cloud and AI capabilities into real-world scenarios that drive innovation and measurable value. Your role sits where strategy meets execution. You will shape how customers adopt, scale and govern AI as part of their digital transformation.
 You will combine your understanding of customer goals, market trends and Microsoft cloud architectures to guide organizations from first experiments to lasting transformation. You will help customers:
 Find the use cases that matter most
 Design adoption approaches that work for their people
 Remove the blockers that slow them down
 The result is measurable productivity gains and better business outcomes.
 Your impact goes beyond a single engagement. You will work across Microsoft and bring customer feedback to the product teams that shape the platform. You will also contribute to best-practice guidance and reusable patterns that help many more customers succeed.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Focus on customer and partner experience through efficient delivery, ensuring a seamless and connected engagement that supports value realization, improved satisfaction, and acceleration of transformation.
 Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback, insights, success stories, and strategic or technical input with internal teams, and contribute to identifying patterns across customers or industries that inform actionable insights and product improvements.
 Contribute to identifying, escalating, and mitigating technical and business blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, usage, and business outcome realization.
 Help customers adopt and use solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy by translating business problems into industry solutions, explaining the business value and return on investment.
 Collaborate across Microsoft and customer or partner teams to deliver on-strategy engagements, manage business and technical risks in line with governance principles, and ensure work complies with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures.

items.desc:
Nekünk a mobilitás jövője. Neked a szakmád csúcsa. 
 A BMW csoportnál minden az elhivatottsággal kezdődik, amely képes egy szakmát hivatássá változtatni. Elhivatottságunk késztet bennünket arra, hogy folyamatosan újra értelmezzük a mobilitást, és innovatív ötleteket vigyünk az utakra. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés alakít egy csapatot erős egységgé, ahol minden ötletet és véleményt értékelünk. Csak ha a szakértelem, a professzionális folyamatok és a munka élvezete egyesül, akkor alakíthatjuk együtt a jövőt. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan elhivatottak, mint mi. A szakértelmed, a készségeid, a motivációd és az egyéniséged visznek minket előre. Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen, Konténer menedzsment specialistája , kulcsfontosságú szerepet töltesz be abban, hogy forradalmasítsuk azt, ahogyan az autózásról gondolkodunk. 
 Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet – a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen területén elhelyezkedő Kommunikációs Központban, korszerű, digitalizált, „open office” jellegű munkakörnyezetben fogsz dolgozni a többi irodai munkavállalóval és közvetlen csapattársaiddal együtt. A Kommunikációs Központ teakonyhákkal, kávézókkal, ergonomikus munkaállomásokkal felszerelt modern iroda, ahol egy vállalati étkezde is helyet kap. 
 Csapat – konténer menedzsment csapatunk tagjaként nemzetközi környezetben dolgozol. Helyben egy kb. 3 fős csapathoz csatlakozol, miközben szoros kapcsolatban vagy a debreceni gyár logisztikai részlegével. 
 Folyamatok elemzése és projektek megvalósítása – üzleti folyamatokat és igényeket elemzel a területi szakértőkkel együttműködve, hogy növeld a minőséget és a hatékonyságot. Digitalizációs megoldásokat tervezel és bevezeted azokat, például dashboard-okat, RPA-megoldásokat vagy Smart App-okat. 
 Dashboardok készítése és rendszertesztelés – Cloud Data vagy Tableau segítségével követed a folyamatok KPI-mutatóit. Rendszerteszteléseket végzel, optimalizálod a meglévő IT rendszereket és digitalizációs megoldásokat, illetve felhasználói képzéseket tartasz. Szakmai támogatást nyújtasz a központi konténer-menedzsment rendszerrel (CMS) kapcsolatban. Munkafolyamathoz kapcsolódó IT dokumentációkat, valamint oktatási anyagokat készítesz. 
 Együttműködés – szoros kapcsolatot tartasz más telephelyek csapattagjaival, különösen a müncheni kollégákkal. 
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Végzettség – műszaki vagy gazdasági területen szerzetél felsőfokú végzettséget, vagy ennek megfelelő szakmai tapasztalatod van. 
 Szakmai tapasztalat – legalább egy év releváns szakmai tapasztalattal rendelkezel ellátásilánc-menedzsment/logisztika területén, operatív működésben, vagy csomagolástechnológiában szerzetél projektmenedzsment ismereteket. 
 Munkarend – a munkavégzés a szokásos irodai munkarendben, on-site történik, távmunkára a közvetlen vezetővel történő egyeztetés alapján van lehetőség. 
 Szakmai ismeretek – magabiztos programozási tudással és kiváló digitalizációs eszközismerettel rendelkezel. Erős vagy az elemzésben, strukturálásban, priorizálásban, kommunikációban és vizualizációban. Logisztikai ismeret és SAP (R3, HANA) tapasztalat előnyt jelent. 
 Soft skill-ek – könnyen együttműködsz különböző kultúrákból érkező kollégákkal egy interdiszciplináris, nemzetközi csapatban. Rugalmas, motivált és nyitott vagy a bel-és külföldi üzleti utakra is. 
 Nyelvtudás – folyékonyan beszélsz angolul és magyarul , a német nyelvtudás kifejezetten előnyt jelent. 
 Mit kínálunk?
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll:
 Bérfejlesztés – évente, teljesítményértékelés alapján . 
 Bónusz – vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónuszok. 
 Cafeteria – éves cafeteria keretösszeg havi folyósítással. 
 Támogatott munkába járás – ingyenes, a műszakbeosztáshoz igazított, közvetlen busz és vasút járatok a régió nagyvárosaiból. Gépkocsi használat esetén a törvényben előírt mértékű költségtérítés. 
 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások – magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészség központban. 
 Magán egészségbiztosítás – próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást. 
 Baleset és életbiztosítás – munkaidőben és azon kívül is bekövetkező eseményekre csoportos baleset és életbiztosítás. 
 Kedvezményes étkezés – napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében. 
 Munkavállalói autóbérlési program. 
 Tudj meg többet juttatásainkról ezen a linken : https://www.bmwgroup.jobs/hu/hu/about-us/our-benefits.html.

items.desc:
Global innovation for us. Personal development for you. 
 At the BMW Group, everything starts with passion. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Enthusiasm for joint projects turns a team into a strong unit where every opinion is valued. It is only when expertise, highly professional processes and enjoyment of work unite that we can shape the future together. All employees can and should contribute with their special skills to the unique culture of the BMW Group. We're searching for people who are as passionate as we are. Your expertise, your skill set, your motivation, and your individuality are what drive us forward. 
 As a Container Digitalisation Management Specialist within BMW Group's logistics division, you're a crucial part of our vision to revolutionize the way we think about cars. Your work helps to ensure that deliveries are always made on time and in the correct order. 
 What awaits you? 
 International environment - you will be responsible at a group level across multiple locations and entities (global plant sites of the BMW AG and suppliers all over the world). 
 Shared activities - you will be integrated in an international operating team and perform also for other BMW Group entities. 
 Team – as a member of our Container Management Specialist Team you’ll be working in an international environment. Locally the team consists of around 3 people, but you will be a member of the bigger logistics organization of Plant Debrecen. 
 Analyzing and implementing – analyzing business processes and business requirements to improve quality and efficiency together with relevant process experts. Design and implement digitalization concepts, such as dashboards, RPAs, Smart Apps. 
 Creating dashboards and testing systems – implementing dashboards and utilizing Cloud Data or Tableau to monitor process KPI. Performing system tests optimazing existing IT systems and digitalisation solutions user training. Providing support regarding the central container management system CMS. Creating process and IT documentation, and training materials. 
 Cooperation – you have intensive exchange with team members at other sites especially in Munich. 
 What should you bring along? 
 Education – you obtained university degree in a technical or business-related field or you have equivalent professional experience. 
 Work experience – you have minimum one year experience in supply chain/logistics, as well as project management, operation or packaging technology. 
 Work schedule – willingness to work on-site during regular business hours. Remote work may be considered based on alignment with your line manager. 
 Technical knowledge – programming skills with excellent knowledge of Digitalisation tools . Strong skills especially in analysing, structuring, prioritizing, communicating, and visualizing. Knowledge of logistics and SAP (R3, HANA) would be an advantage. 
 Soft skills – you have a bility to interact with other cultures and to work in inter-disciplinary and cooperate with international teams. You are flexible, motivated and willing to travel both domestic and international business trips. 
 Language Skills – you speak fluent English and Hungarian, German language would be highly beneficial.
 What do we offer?
 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance, which is why our benefits package includes the following elements in addition to the base salary:
 Bonus – performance-based bonus calculated based on corporate and personal results. 
 Cafeteria – annual cafeteria allowance paid out monthly. 
 Commuting Support – free, direct bus and train services from major cities in the region, aligned with shift schedules. Travel cost reimbursement for personal car usage is provided at the legally prescribed rate. 
 Healthcare Services – high-quality healthcare services, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise options are available at the on-site health center. 
 Private Health Insurance – after probation time, all associates entitled for health insurance, which contains outpatient care, laboratory- and diagnostics tests, outpatient and one-day surgery, screening tests, patient transport. 
 Accident and Life Insurance – in work and out of work group accident and life insurance. 
 Subsidized Meals – one daily discounted hot meal at the company cafeteria. 
 Employee car rental programme . 
 Learn more about our benefits via this link: BMW Group Plant Debrecen Careers | About us | What we offer, 
 Type of employment:
 Full-time, permanent employment.
 Please kindly be aware that we can only consider applications in English. If you have any further questions, please contact our recruitment partner at +3652333603 on weekdays between 8:00 AM and 4:30 PM.

items.desc:
Telefónica Defensa y Seguridad es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica especializada en el diseño, desarrollo, implantación y gestión de soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas en los ámbitos de la defensa y la seguridad. Contribuimos al propósito del Grupo de ser la mejor vía de acceso de ciudadanos, empresas e instituciones a las tecnologías digitales, acercando la innovación a la protección de personas, infraestructuras críticas y activos esenciales. 
 Acompañamos a las Fuerzas Armadas, las Fuerzas y Cuerpos de Seguridad, las administraciones públicas y las organizaciones de sectores estratégicos con soluciones adaptadas a sus necesidades. Integramos tecnología, inteligencia y capacidad operativa para anticipar y responder a amenazas, reforzar la continuidad operativa y la resiliencia, y generar confianza en entornos de alta exigencia. www.telefonica.es 
 Buscamos una persona metódica, organizada, orientada al detalle y con mentalidad de seguridad, con capacidad para entender los riesgos, traducir requisitos en controles, gestionar documentación y evidencias, hacer seguimiento y detectar incumplimientos. Y con potencial para evolucionar hacia una posición de mayor responsabilidad. 
 Dar soporte a la organización en la gestión de la Seguridad de la Información, el cumplimiento normativo y la gestión documental asociada, contribuyendo al mantenimiento y mejora del sistema de gobierno de seguridad, los controles, las políticas y los procedimientos internos. 
 Gestionar ante el cliente y organismos oficiales que regulan la normativa aplicable en el ámbito nacional, UE y OTAN, así como a proyectos en clientes con alto nivel de exigencia y con motivaciones e intereses contrapuestos y procesos de seguridad de materias clasificadas y calidad, muy rigurosos. 
 FUNCIONES: 
 El puesto trabajará estrechamente con el responsable de Seguridad de la Información, con las áreas de IT, Legal, Riesgos, Calidad y Operaciones 
 Gestión junto con los responsables del área de la actividad relacionada con la seguridad de la información del Grupo Telefónica. 
 Asegurar el cumplimiento de la Normativa de Seguridad que aplica al Ministerio de Defensa la UE y la OTAN. 
 Relación con el organismo que regula y aplica la normativa de seguridad en esta materia. 
 Elaboración de normativa interna, flujos de trabajo, gestión de accesos, etc. 
 Control documental y trámites de seguridad de la información de los contratos, siguiendo metodologías reconocidas que permitan mantener del ciclo de vida, la calidad, la veracidad, la seguridad y el flujo del creciente volumen de documentos que se generan, definiendo los procesos y la normativa interna y externa, asegurando la disponibilidad. 
 Creación, modificación y evolución de las aplicaciones y procesos del sistema de Gestión de seguridad del Grupo Telefónica. 
 Apoyo en la realización de las auditorías internas y externas de seguridad, documentación, interlocución y atención a los auditores, cierre de no conformidades y seguimiento de los resultados de las auditorías). 
 EXPERIENCIA: 
 1-3 años de experiencia en alguna de las siguientes áreas: 
 Seguridad de la Información. 
 Protección de datos. 
 Gestión documental. 
 Auditoría IT. 
 Sistemas de gestión ISO. 
 Consultoría de seguridad o cumplimiento 
 Conocimiento del sector Telecomunicaciones, Defensa, OTAN y UE, así como su entorno normativo. 
 FORMACIÓN : 
 Imprescindible : Grado o formación superior en cualquiera de las siguientes disciplinas de Seguridad; Ciberseguridad, Información y Documentación, Derecho, Compliance o disciplinas relacionadas. 
 Deseable : Conocimiento de la Normativa de Seguridad aplicable a proyectos militares, UE y OTAN. 
 OTROS CONOCIMIENTOS: 
 Necesaria experiencia o conocimientos en procesos generales de gestión de concursos públicos en el ámbito de la UE y la OTAN. 
 Requisitos de seguridad, ciberseguridad y gestión de riesgos. 
 Normativa relacionada con protección de datos (RGPD). 
 Se valorará experiencia o conocimiento de: ISO 9001, AQAP, ISO 31301, ISO 27000, ENS. 
 COMPETENCIAS PERSONALES: 
 Confidencialidad y criterio en el tratamiento de información sensible. 
 Capacidad de organización y atención al detalle. 
 Capacidad para trabajar con procedimientos y requisitos normativos. 
 Pensamiento analítico y orientación al riesgo. 
 Comunicación fluida con perfiles técnicos y de negocio. 
 Capacidad para trabajar de forma estructurada y mantener trazabilidad. 
 Iniciativa, predisposición y proactividad 
 IDIOMAS: 
 Imprescindible: inglés hablado y escrito (C1 / C2) 
 Deseables conocimientos de otro idioma de la UE

Wo lieben Menschen, was sie tun, und sind darin großartig? 
 Bei Swisslog natürlich! Unsere Teams sind das Herzstück eines weltweit führenden daten- und robotergesteuerten Unternehmens, welches die Kraft der Technologie nutzt, um die Zukunft der Intralogistik zu gestalten. Das Ergebnis? Wir erbringen Leistung und Effizienz für unsere Kunden auf der ganzen Welt und verschaffen ihnen damit den entscheidenden Vorteil in ihren Märkten.
 Hier bewirkst du etwas 
 Du bist unser Gesicht beim Kunden – mit deinem Know-how sorgst du dafür, dass unsere hochautomatisierten Intralogistikanlagen zuverlässig laufen.
Nach deinem umfangreichen Onboarding übernimmst du spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben.
 Elektrische und mechanische Wartungen an unseren Anlagen
 Selbstständige Durchführung von Reparaturen, Instandhaltungsarbeiten und Sicherheitsprüfungen direkt vor Ort
 Unterstützung bei Kundenprojekten sowie Installationen und Inbetriebnahmen in Deutschland
 Bestandsaufnahmen und Ersatzteil-Inventuren an bestehenden Kundenanlagen – inklusive Beratung vor Ort
 Du sicherst die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden durch kompetenten Service und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten
 Dein Beitrag ist entscheidend, um die reibungslose Funktionalität der Anlagen sicherzustellen und den Kunden bestmöglich zu unterstützen
 Das bringst du mit 
 Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Mechatroniker, Elektroniker, Mechaniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Mit deinem mechanischen Verständnis und handwerklichen Geschick meisterst du technische Herausforderungen souverän.
 Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung in der Paletten- und Behälterfördertechnik mit.
 Weil du schwindelfrei bist und die G41-Tauglichkeit erfüllst, kannst du auch in großer Höhe sicher arbeiten.
 Deine hohe Reisebereitschaft und dein Spaß an selbstständigem Arbeiten machen dich zum perfekten Außendiensttechniker.
 Du nutzt digitale Tools wie Smartphone und Notebook ganz selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag.
 Mit deinem Führerschein der Klasse B (alt: Klasse 3) bist du mobil und flexibel und dir steht dafür ein neutraler Dienstwagen zur Verfügung (auch zur privaten Nutzung) 
 Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse, und wenn du Englisch sprichst, ist das ein zusätzliches Plus
 Unser Versprechen an dich 
 Swisslog ist eine Welt voller Möglichkeiten. Mit uns gestaltest du die Zukunft der Intralogistik mit daten- und robotergesteuerten Automatisierungslösungen. Damit schaffen wir einen außergewöhnlichen Mehrwert für unsere Kunden. 
 Begleite uns auf dieser Reise und werde Teil eines globalen Unternehmens, das auf seine Schweizer Wurzeln stolz ist. Als globales Unternehmen freuen wir uns, auf die Chancen, die sich für jeden in der Swisslog Familie bieten. Entfache dein Potenzial in einem Team, das durch Leidenschaft vereint und vom OneSwisslog Teamgeist angetrieben wird.
 Über Swisslog 
 Swisslog gestaltet die Zukunft der Intralogistik. Als Teil der KUKA Group arbeiten wir an den neuesten Technologien, die die Welt der Logistik neu erfinden. Wir sind ein Team von 3.000+ Experten aus 50 Ländern und bedienen einige der größten und aufregendsten Marken der Welt. Gemeinsam setzen wir smarte und innovative Ansätze um, einschließlich flexibler daten- und robotergesteuerten Automatisierungslösungen, die die Lieferkette transformieren. Ergänze unser Team und teile deine einzigartige Perspektive.
 Gehe mit uns auf die Reise! 
 Wenn du glaubst, dass eine Karriere bei Swisslog das Richtige für dich sein könnte, würden wir gerne von dir hören. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

items.desc:
Discover your impact with KUKA 
 KUKA offers an enormous spectrum of possibilities to advance your career, live your passions and unlock your potential. We´re one of the world's leading automation specialists, offering global opportunities in areas such as robotics, automation, logistics, software solutions and electronics. If you´re a go-getter, a visionary with bold ambitions and believer in collaboration and mutual respect, then you're poised for success here at KUKA.
 Make an impact 
 Strong understanding of log pipelines, schema mapping and telemetry quality 
 Own and maintain the Microsoft Sentinel SIEM platform, including log source onboarding, data ingestion, normalization, and connector management, while ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 Analyze log sources to ensure data quality, normalization and completeness 
 Ability to analyze and interpret complex security data and trends and Skills in developing actionable insights from data patterns and anomalies 
 Tool integration and relevant data on-bording 
 Maintain technical documentation , architecture patterns and operational procedure and security standard 
 Experience building security automation using Azure Logic Apps as part of the incident response (SIEM/XDR/SOAR). 
 Monitoring ingestion costs, and optimizing retention policies to balance security needs with operational expenses. 
 Proficiency in scripting languages like PowerShell and Python is required for automating tasks and developing custom integrations. You should understand Sentinel's automation and orchestration capabilities and know how to leverage them. 
 Evaluate new Microsoft security features and contribute to security architecture standards and guidelines 
 Design automated integrations for Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIP) 
 Enable and operationalize Microsoft Defender AI capabilities across the security ecosystem. Extend detection coverage to the company's own AI, Copilot, custom AI applications, agent and non-human identities.
 What you need to succeed 
 Degree in Computer Science or a related technical degree, or strong IT 
 Experience in Microsoft Sentinel and Defender 
 Must be willing to work in major incident 
 previous hands-on experience in the information security field 
 Hands on experience with cyber security tools such as SIEM, XDR, SOAR, IDS/IPS, antivirus, endpoint protection, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for endpoint, various open source solutions 
 Supporting cyber engineering and operational security initiatives across infrastructure and applications 
 Collaborating with global cyber security teams on strategic security projects 
 Deploy and own Sentinel in the Defender portal, data connectors across Entra, Defender XDR, M365 and SaaS sources, plus the retention and tiering decisions that keep ingestion cost defensible 
 Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, Python, KQL) and familiarity with Sentinel automation/orchestration or similar tools 
 Experience implementing automation using Logic Apps and Playbooks for alert enrichment and incident response 
 Ability to analyze and interpret complex security data, develop actionable insights, and perform threat hunting 
 Experience generating compliance and security posture reports and ensuring logging/monitoring meet regulatory requirements 
 understanding of modern detection and response concepts, including alerting, analytics and basic incident response workflows 
 understanding of Threat Intelligence, landscape, attacker behavior, MITRE ATT&CK and pattern recognition is a plus 
 Strong analytical skills and ability to translate security requirements into technical solutions 
 Strong initiative and willingness to take ownership of technical tasks and projects and grow responsibility over time 
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams 
 Very good written and spoken English, German is a plus 
 Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, SC-401) is a plus 
 Place of work:
 Budapest

 Our culture is deeply rooted in our passion to make robotics and automatic solutions accessible and easy to use. The result? We make peoples´ lives easier and safer, across the world. Diversity is the beating heart of our company - and we appreciate every single one of our bright and bold brainiacs. We encourage everyone to bring their full selves to work, fostering an environment where inspiration, expertise, and personal growth can flourish. Our collective goal? To achieve greatness and ignite innovative, positive change - not only within the automation industry but also beyond its boundaries. And in return, we prioritize creating a supportive, empowering, and caring environment for all.
