VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 500 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 300 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov!
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti
 prax v práci s hotovosťou
 Počet rokov praxe: 1
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš minimálne SŠ vzdelanie s maturitou,
 máš minimálne 1 rok praxe v práci s hotovosťou,
 Ťa baví komunikovať,
 si priateľský/á a vieš pracovať individuálne aj v tíme,
 máš v sebe ducha obchodníka,
 si dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.
 ... všetko ostatné Ťa naučíme my :)
 Informácie o výberovom konaní
Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.
Tešíme …

Sobre nosotros: 
 Today Mobility facilita la propiedad de vehículos proporcionando soluciones de movilidad para toda la industria automotriz. En esencia, transportamos los vehículos de nuestros clientes hacia y desde la inspección técnica, el cambio de neumáticos, el mantenimiento, la reparación, etc.

Como resultado, los propietarios de automóviles disfrutan de una gran comodidad, las empresas mantienen su flota en excelente estado mientras ahorran tiempo y dinero, y los fabricantes de automóviles logran una distribución equilibrada en sus talleres, ofreciendo un servicio aún mejor a sus clientes.
 El ADN de Today Mobility: 
 Exigimos altos estándares de personalidad, espíritu de servicio y un fuerte sentido de responsabilidad en la gestión de proyectos.
 Today Mobility es una empresa amigable. Nos movemos con rapidez y hacemos lo necesario para ayudar a nuestros clientes, colegas y socios a tener un mejor día a día. Formamos equipos que actúan con un enfoque de "nosotros" en lugar de "yo", priorizando personas sin ego que valoran los resultados colectivos por encima de los individuales.
 Nuestro ADN impregna todo lo que hacemos, y nuestra identidad se demuestra con acciones más que con palabras. Por eso, nuestros socios nos eligen.
 ------------ 
 Conductor: 
Como conductor, es importante que te sientas cómodo interactuando con clientes.
En Today Mobility, nuestros clientes son grandes empresas y, en ocasiones, sus clientes finales.
El rol de conductor es dinámico y cada jornada laboral es diferente, por lo que es fundamental que disfrutes estar en movimiento y viajar.

Fecha de inicio: 1 de Julio

items.desc: Description du poste Le contexte fonctionnel Dans le cadre d'une mission auprès de l'un de nos clients, une banque de financement et d'investissement, vous interviendrez en tant que MOA CRM en environnement de salle de marché, avec un axe fort sur l'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle et des outils de communication. La mission s'inscrit dans un environnement de salle de marché couvrant les activités sales, trading, middle office et back office. Elle porte sur l'évolution et la modernisation des outils CRM utilisés par les équipes front office, dans un contexte de transformation digitale et d'intégration de nouvelles technologies. Le besoin La mission requiert une expertise en maîtrise d'ouvrage pour les outils CRM en salle de marché. Le consultant prendra en charge le recueil des besoins, la rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles, la gestion de projet et la coordination de la recette. Un axe central de la mission porte sur l'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle dans le CRM ainsi que sur la connexion avec des outils externes tels qu'Outlook, la téléphonie Cisco, Teams, Zoom et Webex. Une expérience confirmée de 3 à 5 ans en MOA IT est attendue. Vos missions Recueil des besoins métiers et rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles pour les évolutions CRM Pilotage de l'intégration de l'IA dans le CRM et coordination des connecteurs avec les outils externes Organisation et garantie de la recette fonctionnelle : tests de non-régression et contrôle des évolutions Support fonctionnel et opérationnel en lien avec les équipes de développement Suivi des plannings, reporting d'avancement et animation des réunions d'arbitrage projet L'environnement Domaines : salle de marché, front office, sales, middle office, back office Outils & données : CRM, Outlook, Cisco, Teams, Zoom, Webex Le consultant Formation Bac+5 - Master 2 ou école d'ingénieur, idéalement avec une spécialisation en finance. Une expérience de 3 à 5 ans en MOA IT est requise, avec une maîtrise avérée des outils CRM, d'Outlook, de la téléphonie Cisco, de Teams, Zoom et Webex, ainsi qu'une bonne connaissance de la relation client en environnement de salle de marché. Apprécié : expérience en intégration d'intelligence artificielle (IA, MCP, Agents), pratique du support fonctionnel et de la recette fonctionnelle. items.desc: Frankfurt am Main | Vollzeit | keine Reisetätigkeit | ab 1 Jahr Erfahrung | Einstieg ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Entwickle KI-Agenten und LLM-Anwendungen, die Deine Kolleg:innen schon wenige Tage später in ihrer täglichen Arbeit einsetzen – und gestalte die Architektur dahinter von Anfang an mit. Wer wir sind EUROGROUP CONSULTING ist eine auf den Finanzdienstleistungssektor spezialisierte Managementberatung mit rund 120 Mitarbeiter:innen. Wir begleiten unsere Kund:innen bei strategischen, organisatorischen und technologischen Veränderungsvorhaben – von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Als etablierter Partner unterstützen wir die Genossenschaftliche Finanzgruppe bei zukunftsweisenden Transformations- und Optimierungsprojekten. Warum diese Rolle so besonders ist KI ist bei uns im Arbeitsalltag angekommen: In allen Teams entstehen Ideen für KI-Agenten, Skills und Knowledge Packages – und die Nachfrage nach KI-Werkzeugen wächst schnell. Du baust das technische Fundament, auf dem unsere KI-Anwendungen laufen, und bist die erste Adresse für alle Teams, die ein neues Werkzeug brauchen. Anders als in der Beratung üblich ist die Stelle eine reine Expertenrolle: Du arbeitest intern und konzentrierst Dich voll auf die Entwicklung. Deine Aufgaben KI-Agenten entwickeln: Auf Basis von LLMs baust Du Agenten und Knowledge Packages als wiederverwendbare Bausteine für Beratung, Vertrieb und Verwaltung – vom ersten Prototyp bis zum produktiven Einsatz. Architektur gestalten: Du baust unsere KI-Agentenarchitektur auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Mit einer sauberen Repository-Struktur (GitHub) sorgst Du für Versionierung und Übersicht – und dafür, dass aus Einzellösungen ein zusammenhängendes System wird. Systeme verbinden und Prozesse automatisieren: Du bindest KI-Anwendungen über Schnittstellen und APIs an unsere bestehenden Systeme an und automatisierst wiederkehrende Abläufe – in unserer Cloud- und Kollaborationsumgebung, mit Workflow- und Automatisierungsplattformen und den KI-Diensten, die wir einsetzen. Qualität sichern: Du setzt Standards für Tests, Evaluation und Dokumentation, legst fest, wann eine Anwendung produktiv gehen darf, und sorgst für ihren zuverlässigen Betrieb. Ansprechpartner:in für die Teams: Du nimmst Anforderungen aus Projekt-, Vertriebs- und Kundenteams auf, übersetzt sie in Werkzeuge, die wirklich genutzt werden, und machst sie auch für nicht-technische Kolleg:innen einfach bedienbar. Das bringst Du mit Hintergrund: Ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung – oder gleichwertige Praxiserfahrung. Ein Jahr einschlägige Erfahrung genügt: Entscheidend ist, was Du bereits gebaut hast. Technisches Know-how: Du verstehst, wie moderne KI-Anwendungen funktionieren: LLMs, KI-Agenten, Tool Use, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt- und Context-Engineering. Du programmierst sicher, idealerweise in Python, arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Git und weißt, wie Systeme, Daten und Schnittstellen zusammenspielen. Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Cloud- und Kollaborationsplattformen, Workflow-Automatisierung, API-Integration oder Frameworks für Agenten und RAG. Persönlichkeit: Du arbeitest gern eigenverantwortlich und bringst Dinge zu Ende. Du überzeugst durch lösungsorientierte Hands-on-Mentalität, Umsetzungsstärke und Lernbereitschaft. Kommunikation & Sprache: Deine Stärke ist es, fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen und dein Wissen an unser Team weiterzugeben. Dazu sprichst Du sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch. Das bieten wir Dir Gestaltungsspielraum: Du arbeitest in ambitionierten, kollegialen Teams, die gemeinsam mit Kunden wirksame Lösungen entwickeln. Hybrides Arbeiten: Flexibles Arbeiten vor Ort beim Kunden, in unserem Office in der Frankfurter Innenstadt oder im Home Office. Coaching & Entwicklung: Individuelle Weiterentwicklung unterstützt durch Deinen persönlichen Coach und gezielte Fortbildungen – ohne Projektalltag. Starkes Netzwerk: Bei unseren Events und Trainings lernst Du schnell unser starkes Netzwerk kennen. Weitere Benefits: Firmenwagen, Wellpass, Jobrad, EAP Assist, Mobilitätszuschuss, modernes Equipment. BLust, unsere KI-Landschaft mit aufzubauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! Zeig uns gern, was Du gebaut hast – zusätzlich zu deinem CV. Ein GitHub-Repository, ein Projekt oder ein Tool sagt uns mehr als ein Anschreiben.

items.desc: What You’ll Do Support the development, verification, and documentation of fluid delivery systems in accordance with system requirements. Create concepts, 3D CAD models, drawings, and technical designs for mechanical and chemical fluid systems with guidance from experienced engineers. Contribute to component selection, design calculations, engineering analyses, and technical evaluations. Support the preparation and maintenance of BOMs, engineering documentation, and design releases. Help define and coordinate interfaces with adjacent modules, subsystems, and facility connections. Prepare engineering deliverables such as technical specifications, FMEAs, risk assessments, test plans, and validation documentation. Participate in design reviews, prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous design improvements. Collaborate with experienced engineers, suppliers, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to develop safe, reliable, manufacturable, and cost-effective solutions. Learn and apply company engineering processes, CAD/PLM standards, safety requirements, and best practices while gradually taking ownership of defined design tasks. Who We’re Looking For Completed technical education in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, fluid engineering, or a comparable field; a Technical High School (HTL, FH) qualification is welcome. First practical engineering experience through internships, projects, apprenticeships, or previous employment is beneficial but not essential. Good understanding of mechanical design principles and a strong interest in developing fluid delivery systems. Familiarity with 3D CAD software such as Inventor, Siemens NX, AutoCAD, or a comparable tool. Basic understanding of technical drawings, tolerances, materials, manufacturing methods, and engineering documentation. Structured, hands-on approach to problem solving and willingness to learn new engineering methods and tools. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Occasional travel may be required What You Can Expect Structured onboarding and practical learning from experienced engineers. Exposure to the complete product-development cycle, from requirements and concepts through design, testing, and release. Opportunities to build expertise in mechanical design, fluid systems, CAD/PLM tools, engineering analysis, safety, and technical documentation. Increasing technical responsibility as your experience and capabilities grow. A higher payment is negotiable depending on education, expertise and skills. The monthly salary is paid 14 times per year. items.desc: Job Summary Ben jij analytisch sterk en gepassioneerd door procesoptimalisatie binnen een hoogtechnologische productieomgeving? IFF is een wereldleider in smaken, geuren, food ingredients en health & biosciences. Wij ontwikkelen duurzame innovaties die dagelijkse producten verbeteren. Health & Biosciences: We combineren onze passie voor natuur en bioscience met duurzame technologieën die innovatieve oplossingen mogelijk maken binnen gezondheidszorg, voeding, consumenten- en industriële markten. IFF Brugge, ook gekend als “De Gistfabriek”, is een internationale productiesite gelegen in het historische Brugge. Onze enzymen worden wereldwijd toegepast in onder andere bier, brood, veevoeding, biobrandstoffen, textiel en detergenten. Het produceren van enzymen is een hoogtechnologisch en complex biochemisch proces waarin expertise, innovatie en samenwerking centraal staan. De rol is gebaseerd in Brugge, België (on-site rol). items.desc: Join Orise as a Digital Asset Consultant Are you passionate about bridging the gap between industrial operations and cutting-edge digital solutions? At Orise, we specialize in real-time data management , helping industries transform their operational data into valuable business insights. As a Digital Asset Consultant , you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting real-time data systems that drive efficiency and innovation. What Does a Digital Asset Consultant Do? Extract and manage real-time plant data from industrial control systems (Honeywell, Siemens, ABB...) to MES platforms and cloud environments . Implement and support historian data systems like AspenTech IP21 and AVEVA PI , ensuring high-frequency data collection and storage. Enable data visualization and analysis , integrating real-time data into business intelligence (BI) tools, SAP, ... Facilitate IT/OT convergence , ensuring seamless data flow between operational technology (OT) on the plant floor and enterprise IT systems. Assist customers in transitioning from on-premises to cloud-based infrastructures . Contextualize raw industrial data using asset frameworks (AF) , making it more accessible and actionable for operators, engineers and management. Who Are We Looking for? We seek dynamic professionals with a passion for data integration, industrial processes, and IT systems . Ideal candidates have: An engineering or IT-related background , such as Chemical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematical Engineering . A results-driven and entrepreneurial mindset with excellent organizational skills. A strong interest in data (collection , contextualization, analysis) and industrial operations (how are processes working?) First software development experience ( .NET (C#), Python ) and first familiarity with cloud platforms like Azure or AWS . Why Join Orise? You’ll work on diverse projects across industries like petrochemicals, specialty chemicals, and power generation. You’ll be at the forefront of IT/OT integration, helping businesses optimize processes through smart data solutions. If you love solving technical challenges, working with advanced data systems, and making an impact in industrial digitalization, this is the role for you! Ready to shape the future of industrial data? Let’s talk!

items.desc: Recently graduated or one to two years into your career? Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets About the job At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets. We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve. As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets. This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and help shape how we work. What you will do As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work within one of our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled. Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data. You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take responsibility for your own tasks. At the same time, you will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices. Your responsibilities will include Helping identify and document Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data points with stakeholders and assessing which are critical for Saxo Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and contribute to root cause investigations Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved Collaborating with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation. Who you are You have recently graduated or have around one to two years of professional experience. We imagine that you bring: A relevant degree in finance, economics, business analytics, information systems, data science or a similar field An interest in data and how it is used in business processes Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or projects Hands on experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation It would be an advantage if you have Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services Familiarity with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar tools Just as important as your experience is how you approach your work. We are looking for someone who: Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative. Collaborates naturally. You build relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas. Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working. Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You adapt as priorities develop, bring structure to areas that are still taking shape and contribute to building solutions together with the team. Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work. You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is your curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn. What we offer The opportunity to help build a new data function from the ground up A steep learning curve across Markets, critical data and data governance, supported by experienced colleagues Hands on guidance, regular feedback and an introduction to both your Markets domain and our governance practices Real responsibility from the beginning, with the opportunity to take on more as you develop You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, so your role will develop …

items.desc: Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Logiciel et Système d'Information pour rejoindre nos équipes à Toulouse. Vous contribuerez à définir et faire évoluer l’architecture de notre système d’information et de nos produits digitaux : plateforme immobilière, application mobile, sites Internet, APIs, services et outils internes. Vous ferez le lien entre vision d'architecture et réalité du terrain. Vous contribuerez aux décisions structurantes du SI tout en restant proche des développeurs et des problématiques concrètes de conception, de réalisation et d'exploitation. Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec les développeurs, Product Owners, SRE, QA, équipes Infrastructure et Sécurité. Le poste combine une vision transverse du SI avec une forte proximité avec les équipes techniques. Vos missions Concevoir et faire évoluer l’architecture de nos applications, services et produits numériques en cohérence avec les besoins métiers et la trajectoire du SI. Accompagner les équipes de développement dans leurs choix de conception, questionner les solutions proposées et garantir la cohérence entre les différents composants. Faire évoluer l’existant en identifiant les possibilités de simplification, de modernisation et de restructuration, avec une approche pragmatique de la dette technique. Intégrer les exigences non fonctionnelles dès la conception : performance, disponibilité, résilience, capacité à monter en charge, maintenabilité et sécurité. Participer aux choix de technologies, frameworks, patterns et solutions techniques. Faire progresser les pratiques d’architecture en contribuant aux choix technologiques et en définissant des principes, règles et méthodes de documentation partagés. Travailler avec les équipes SRE, Infrastructure et Sécurité sur les problématiques Cloud, infrastructure, observabilité et sécurité. Travailler sur les enjeux transverses du SI avec les équipes infrastructure, sécurité et qualité : cloud, conteneurisation, observabilité, sécurité et évolutions technologiques, notamment autour de l’IA. Vos compétences Vous avez une solide expérience en développement logiciel et avez progressivement élargi votre champ d'intervention vers des problématiques de conception et d’architecture. Vous savez concevoir et faire évoluer des applications en ligne, des systèmes distribués et des APIs, dans un contexte cloud et conteneurisation. Vous savez adapter les méthodes d'échange entre applications et les modes d'intégration en fonction des contraintes de l'existant. Vous prenez en compte les problématiques de sécurité applicative, de performance, de disponibilité et de montée en charge dès la conception. Vous savez analyser un système existant et proposer une trajectoire d’évolution réaliste, en arbitrant entre qualité architecturale, complexité, dette technique, coûts et contraintes opérationnelles. Vous documentez et expliquez vos décisions, y compris auprès d’interlocuteurs ayant des niveaux de technicité différents. Vous aimez transmettre, questionner les choix et accompagner les équipes sans imposer une architecture déconnectée de leurs contraintes. Vous êtes capable de prendre de la hauteur tout en conservant une vraie proximité avec le code et les problématiques d’ingénierie. Compétences recherchées Appréciées : Expérience avec Kubernetes et AWS. Expérience des architectures orientées événements et des systèmes asynchrones. Connaissance des problématiques d’observabilité, de fiabilité des systèmes et plus globalement SRE. Formalisation des décisions d'architecture (par ex : ADR) et de la modélisation (par ex : C4). Expérience de modernisation d’applications ou de SI existants. Utilisation d’IA appliquée au développement, à la documentation ou à la conception d’architecture.

items.desc: Über die Rolle Wir bauen mit NXT Applied ein AI-native Unternehmen, das KI in reale operative Prozesse bringt. Die meisten Unternehmen scheitern nicht an der Technologie. Sondern daran, sie sauber in produktive Abläufe zu überführen. Genau dort setzen wir an. Wir deployen AI Operators in echte Workflows — und machen sie messbar wirksam. Für diese Phase suchen wir dich: Du bringst diese Systeme in die Realität. Nicht als Konzept. Sondern in Produktion. Aufgaben Was du bei uns tust Du übersetzt Operator Playbooks in laufende Systeme Du deployest AI Operators in reale Kundenumgebungen Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden und verstehst ihre Prozesse im Detail Du integrierst Systeme (ERP, Accounting, Inbox, Legacy-Workflows) Du definierst klare Grenzen zwischen agentischer Logik und deterministischer Ausführung Du stellst sicher, dass Systeme stabil, nachvollziehbar und steuerbar laufen Du identifizierst Edge Cases und machst Systeme robuster Kurz gesagt: Du bringst AI aus dem Konzept in die Realität. Was diese Rolle ist – und was nicht Diese Rolle ist: eine produktionsnahe Engineering-Rolle nah am Kunden und an echten Prozessen stark in Umsetzung, Integration und Systemdenken entscheidend für den tatsächlichen Erfolg von AI-Systemen Diese Rolle ist nicht: reine Prototypen- oder Demo-Entwicklung ein klassischer Backend-Job ohne Kontext Forschung oder Modellentwicklung Support oder Ticket-Abarbeitung Qualifikation Für wen die Rolle besonders gut passt Du bist ein starker Engineer mit Sinn für reale Systeme Du denkst in Workflows, nicht nur in Code Du kannst mit unklaren, “messy” Umgebungen umgehen Du willst sehen, wie dein System tatsächlich genutzt wird Du arbeitest gerne direkt mit Kunden und baust Vertrauen auf Warum diese Rolle schwierig ist Die meisten AI-Systeme scheitern nicht an den Modellen. Sondern an: unstrukturierten Daten Edge Cases unsauberer Integration fehlender Kontrolle in der Ausführung Genau dort arbeitest du. Zwischen Systemdesign und operativer Realität. Was du mitbringen solltest Starke Backend-Skills (Node / Python / TypeScript) Erfahrung mit APIs, Workflows, Queues und State Verständnis für produktive Systeme (Logging, Idempotenz, Retries, Monitoring) Erfahrung mit LLM-Systemen oder die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch (kundennahe Rolle) Wie wir arbeiten AI-native. Das bedeutet für dich: Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding Agents Du bewegst dich schnell von Idee Umsetzung Du baust Systeme, in denen AI zentral ist – nicht add-on Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, direkt und ohne unnötige Komplexität. Arbeitsmodell Die Rolle ist auf Verantwortung und Ergebnis ausgelegt. Nicht auf Präsenz. Hohe Eigenverantwortung Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Founder Viel Gestaltungsspielraum Schnelle Iteration statt langer Planungsphasen Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist In vielen Unternehmen entsteht genau hier der Bruch: gute AI-Ideen funktionierende Prototypen aber keine stabile Produktion Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Lücke zu schließen. Und Systeme zu bauen, die wirklich laufen. Wenn du AI dort deployen willst, wo sie wirklich Wert schafft — melde dich.

items.desc: Join our cutting-edge Industrial Energy Technology team Our Industrial Energy Technology team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production, and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. We collaborate with teams to solve technical challenges and design future innovations. Talamona manufacturing plant is the center of excellence for high tech turbomachinery components, and takes advantage of top notch technology in the industry such as additive manufacturing, advanced coatings, precision machining, robotics and automation. Partner with the best As a Manufacturing Engineering Experienced professional at Baker Hughes, you will support the development, improvement, and execution of manufacturing processes for high-tech turbomachinery components. You will work with cross-functional teams to improve productivity, quality, safety, and operational performance, contributing to the introduction of new products, processes, and technologies. Key Responsibilities: Support the development, optimization, and standardization of manufacturing processes to improve quality, productivity, cost, and cycle times. Collaborate with engineering, production, quality, and operational teams to ensure robust, efficient, and repeatable manufacturing solutions. Contribute to the introduction of new products, processes, equipment, and technologies within the manufacturing environment (Production Cycles, CAD/CAM). Analyze process performance, production feedback, and technical data to identify improvement opportunities and support decision-making. Prepare, maintain, and update technical documentation, standards, work instructions, and process-related information, including inspection criteria and critical spare requirements for assigned fixtures. Act as the first technical point of contact for operators in assigned areas, supporting setups, changeovers, production restarts, and troubleshooting to reduce downtime and ensure product quality. Identify program, fixture, tool, machine, or method-related causes of production issues and coordinate technical escalation when needed. Own the technical condition, configuration, and suitability of assigned fixtures, monitoring wear, accuracy, reliability, and safety and defining restoration or improvement actions. Support continuous improvement initiatives and promote best practices across manufacturing activities. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and company requirements. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role ideally you should have: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent proven experience. Experience in manufacturing, production engineering, machining, or technical process support within an industrial environment. Good technical understanding of manufacturing processes, process optimization, and industrial operations. Knowledge of CAD/CAM systems, CNC machining, automation, robotics, or digital manufacturing tools is considered a plus. Problem-solving mindset, analytical approach, and attention to detail. Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Ability to manage priorities, work independently, and support multiple technical activities. Fluent in English and Italian. Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns: Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive smart working opportunities. Working with us Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. Working for you Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect: Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbing activities Comprehensive private medical care options Safety net of life insurance and disability programs Tailored financial programs Additional elected or voluntary benefits For Italy:The initial pay range for this position will be EUR 38,605 To 59,000. You expand your expertise, continuously develop yourself, and contribute to innovative solutions within a growing organization. About The Member Company We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as: Technology & Engineering Energy & Renewables Life sciences & Pharma Digital & IT About this vacancy As an Environmental Advisor, you will conduct administrative research for one or more environmental disciplines, such as explosive remnants of war, archaeology, and ecology, and develop advice based on this research. Where necessary, you will involve external parties and procure specialized products and studies. You will work within a project team under the leadership of a project manager. Together, you are responsible for the quality, planning, and progress of the projects. You are decisive and solution-oriented, even when limited time is available to provide suitable advice. Thanks to your knowledge of the challenges surrounding the energy transition, you understand the impact environmental factors can have on projects. From your expertise, you will engage in discussions with municipalities, water authorities, and provinces. You will be part of a dynamic work environment that expects a high degree of independence while giving you the space to contribute to improving processes and developing yourself. You contribute to the energy grid of the future. Your responsibilities will include: Conducting administrative research on environmental disciplines such as explosive remnants of war, trees, nitrogen, archaeology, ecology, and permits; Preparing and delivering products such as environmental analyses and conditioning studies, taking into account risks, costs, and lead times; Coordinating conditioning studies by outsourcing tasks to suppliers and critically reviewing the delivered products; Engaging in discussions with municipalities, water authorities, and provinces regarding energy transition projects; Identifying bottlenecks and contributing ideas for solutions and improvements within projects and processes. What we expect from you Working on an organization that is future-proof. You do this by leveraging your own strengths and talents. items.desc: Overview: Job Description: Are you looking for the right project where your skills in industrial or mechanical engineering can make the difference? Would you like to design and build the automated equipment we use in our production processes, and then see them working at a stone's throw from your desk? Our small but rapidly growing Automation Engineering team is looking for a fulltime colleague to join us at our European Headquarters to support the manufacturing of our advanced medical devices! In this exciting position, you will design and develop automated equipment used in our manufacturing plant in Amersfoort, supporting different teams including Production, Maintenance, and Engineering. You will work closely with our internal Automation Engineers based in the US, who will train you during the startup phase, and maintain a close collaboration with you throughout all the project phases. Within Applied Medical, this role has the title of Automation Design Engineer. Where and When This fulltime position is based in Amersfoort (NL) To allow collaboration with the colleagues in California (US), you will work on a flexible work schedule (between 8.00 and 21.00) During the design phase you can work from home 1 or 2 days a week, while the build, troubleshooting and testing phases will require you and the team to work from the office. Evening calls can always be done from home. Key Responsibilities Be part of the automation and improvement of our manufacturing processes to produce medical devices Create SolidWorks models, drawings, and assemblies Provide technical support, carry out root cause analysis, and take corrective/preventive actions Perform process capability studies, evaluations, and cost analysis Develop, update, and review engineering documents such as instructions, drawings, test procedures, and reports Investigate new tooling, materials, prototypes, manufacturing processes, and technologies Research and qualify new suppliers/vendors, including setting the technical requirements including requirements settings Follow internal and external trainings to ensure you follow safety and quality rules (e.g. CE, ISO, etc.) Requirements: Engineering degree (HBO/HTS/BSc/MSc) within industrial, manufacturing or mechanical engineering, or equivalent engineering experience Experience in a highly regulated environment with planning and coordinating machine design automation processes Technical analytical skills combined with a hands-on approach Understanding of technical reasoning, prototyping, and manufacturing processes Experience in 3D modeling software such as SolidWorks,AutoCAD or equivalent Experience with ERP, SAP, and/or Product LifecycleManagement applications is preferred Excellent in English both verbal and written We Offer: An international working environment, fueled by respect and a healthy work-life balance tailored to the business and team member’s needs 27 paid vacation days (based on fulltime contract) with option to purchase five additional days This is mainly an on-site role with hybrid options Commuting allowance of €0,25/km or full coverage of public transportation costs A wide variety of internal trainings and development possibilities and a tuition program for external trainings The opportunity to pro-actively work on your vitality and fitness State-of-the-art facilities, including green areas, in-house restaurant and gym Additional benefits, such as: Attractive pension scheme (your contribution at 4%, ours at 12%) €50 net monthly health insurance contribution Two (paid) days per year dedicated to volunteering activities Several fun company events and meaningful initiatives organized throughout the year At Applied Medical, we are committed to make a meaningful, positive difference, each and every day. Within our European headquarters in Amersfoort (NL), we develop, manufacture and support the implementation of our advanced medical devices across Europe and the MENA region. Applied’s team members enjoy working in an environmentally friendly and international environment, in which people of diverse backgrounds are valued, challenged, and acknowledged. We support our team members by giving them opportunities of ongoing learning and education, possibilities to take part in community volunteering activities and a variety of onsite exercise classes and health activities. Title: FP&A Specialist Location: Legnica Position Purpose Provide expert support for SAP product costing, standard cost maintenance, manufacturing variance analysis, and FP&A activities, ensuring accurate cost flows, reliable reporting, and actionable business insights for a manufacturing environment. This is a temporary replacement contract. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate SAP standard cost calculations, including new products, material changes, and annual cost updates. Analyze production, material, labor, and overhead variances and identify root causes. Maintain and validate costing inputs including BOMs, routings, material prices, labor rates, overhead rates, and cost component structures. Support month-end closing activities related to production costs, inventory, variances, and result explanations. Support budgeting and forecasting by providing standard cost, rate, cost center, and operational impact inputs. Support FP&A projects, KPI reporting, cost analysis, and margin improvement initiatives. Requirements Minimum 3 years of experience in manufacturing controlling, product costing, FP&A, or a related finance role. Strong knowledge of SAP / Product Costing and standard cost, material ledger, BOM, routing, and production order settlement processes. Experience with variance analysis, production cost controlling, inventory valuation, and financial reporting. Advanced Excel skills; Power BI, SAP, HFM, or similar reporting tools are an advantage. University degree in finance, accounting, controlling, economics, or industrial engineering. Fluent written and spoken English (B2). Soft Skills Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect SAP details to business performance. Proactive approach to identifying risks, data issues, and improvement opportunities. Strong communication skills with finance and operational stakeholders. High accuracy, ownership, and documentation discipline. Ability to prioritize and work under deadlines during month-end close, planning, and audit cycles. items.desc: Projektant Procesów Biznesowych (Handel) Warszawa Sprawdź co możemy Ci zaoferować! dofinansowanie do kart sportowych opieka medyczna ubezpieczenie na życie karty przedpłacone biblioteka firmowa konkursy JESTEŚ CIEKAWY/A, JAK BĘDZIE WYGLĄDAŁA TWOJA PRACA? TWOJE ZADANIA TO: Analiza i optymalizacja procesów handlowych, w szczególności związanych z zarządzaniem cenami, marżą, promocjami i warunkami handlowymi. Identyfikowanie nieefektywności, luk procesowych, zbędnych czynności i ryzyk wpływających na wyniki handlowe organizacji. Projektowanie nowych procesów oraz usprawnianie istniejących rozwiązań, z uwzględnieniem ich wpływu na efektywność operacyjną i wyniki biznesowe. Samodzielne prowadzenie powierzonych obszarów projektów transformacyjnych – od analizy stanu obecnego i przygotowania rekomendacji po wdrożenie oraz ocenę efektów. Analizowanie danych i wskaźników handlowych, szacowanie kosztów i korzyści proponowanych zmian oraz przedstawianie rekomendacji opartych na liczbach. Opracowywanie wymagań biznesowych i funkcjonalnych oraz współpraca z IT i dostawcami przy realizacji, testowaniu i odbiorze nowych rozwiązań. Prowadzenie uzgodnień z interesariuszami, prezentowanie i uzasadnianie rekomendacji oraz egzekwowanie przyjętych ustaleń. items.desc: Change the world of tomorrow with us. Our Siemens business unit Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world's leading providers of products, systems, solutions, and services in the field of Automation. This includes around 20,000 employees and four business segments. With its global production sites, R&D, and service locations, AUT is close to its customers and at home in a wide range of industries. At our factory network Siemens AG develops and manufactures electric motors for the global market. Our target customers are in the field of automation technology, in the automotive industry, and in the field of intra-logistics. Based in Oradea, we are looking for a Test Design Engineer to ensure the flawless operation of our complex motor testing systems, drive architecture modifications, and lead design changes for New Product Introduction (NPI) and optimization of existing test equipments. This will be your impact: Test System Operations & Reliability: You will ensure that our complex electric motor testing systems run smoothly, troubleshooting anomalies, resolving issues, and guaranteeing high availability for production. Architecture & Design Changes (NPI): You know the architecture of our test systems inside out and can perform design changes, upgrades, and adaptations as needed, especially for New Product Introduction (NPI) or product variants. Implementation & Validation: You will independently implement hardware and software modifications, thoroughly validate the updated testing systems, and ensure they meet all quality and safety standards. Test Software Development: You will develop, maintain, and optimize test software and measurement applications (primarily using LabVIEW and complemented by C# scripting language). Project Management & Procurement: You will act as technical project manager for test equipment procurement and transfer, keeping in touch with external suppliers of testing equipment when needed. Digitalization & Data Integration: Together with our central DEV/OPS team, you will connect machines, test benches, and sensors to our data ecosystem, supporting decision-making and optimization through data analytics, visualization, and modern technologies. This is how you'll win us over: You have successfully completed a degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, automation, or a comparable technical field, backed by professional experience in a production or design testing environment. Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in LabVIEW for test measurement and automation, complemented by experience with medium-level programming languages (such as C, C++ or C#). System Understanding: Deep understanding of test bench architecture, data acquisition (DAQ) systems, sensors, power electronics, and drive technology. Design & Validation Mindset: Proven ability to analyze test setups, design and implement hardware/software changes, and perform rigorous validation (ideal for NPI processes). Language Skills: Very good proficiency in English (spoken & written) is an absolute must since you work in an international environment. Autonomy & Problem Solving: Able to work autonomously and act as a proactive problem solver with effective diagnostic and implementation skills. Teamwork & Continuous Learning: You value teamwork and openness, bring a high willingness to learn, and are passionate about improvements, digitalization, and innovation. Mobility: Business trips to Germany for alignment and technology transfer are not a problem for you. What do we offer: In addition to exciting work opportunities in a brand-new, state-of-the-art engineering environment, we place special emphasis on a healthy work-life balance; continuous learning and development of our employees is important to us - we believe this is key to our success. Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens! Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Having different types of talent and experiences makes us more result-oriented and better prepared to respond effectively to the demands of society. Therefore, we value candidates that reflect the diversity that we enjoy in our company.

items.desc: About Blueprint Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters. About the Role As a UX/CX Designer , you'll join our client's U.S.-based Experience Strategy & Design Studio. It's a small, horizontally structured team that brings strategy, design, and research together around customer experience. The team is building an internal AI experiences hub for about 10,000 enterprise users. You'll design end-to-end experiences for it, from early concepts to working prototypes. The team uses user-centered design as its core methodology, so you'll already know it well. You'll work in a fast, iterative environment with direct executive engagement, and you'll partner with stakeholders across the organization. Success here means taking an ambiguous problem, setting a clear design direction, and delivering work at the level your portfolio shows, with minimal oversight. What You'll Do Design end-to-end experiences for internal AI tools, from early concepts and task flows to high-fidelity, working prototypes Build and iterate quickly in Lovable using AI-assisted and vibe-coding workflows, moving work into VS Code and merging it with existing projects when needed Apply user-centered design methods to frame problems, identify the right questions, and connect user insights to design decisions Create design artifacts at different levels of fidelity, including storyboards, wireframes, journey maps, task flows, scenarios, and personas Use and contribute to an established design system, including UI controls, content templates, icons, form design, and navigation models Plan and facilitate remote and live design thinking workshops with stakeholders and users Present design direction and future-state concepts to stakeholders, including executives, in a clear and compelling way Validate work with peers, stakeholders, and users through lightweight research and usability checks, then iterate based on what you learn What You'll Bring Training or certification in user-centered design or design thinking from a recognized program such as IDEO, IBM, Stanford, LUMA, or Forrester 3+ years of hands-on UX/UI, product, or service design experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience Strong UX/UI design skills demonstrated through a portfolio of shipped work Hands-on experience designing and prototyping in Lovable The ability to gather user context independently and turn it into design strategy and execution without detailed direction Strong communication and storytelling skills, including presenting complex concepts to executive audiences Preferred Qualifications A degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field Experience shipping products or delivering to customers through an end-to-end design process Hands-on primary UX research experience, including planning and conducting 1:1 user interviews Experience designing, planning, and facilitating live and virtual design thinking workshops Experience in the technology sector with enterprise (B2B) customers Experience with VS Code, GitHub, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or Sketch Portfolio Requirements A portfolio is required to be considered for this role. It should show your design process, your role on each project, and examples of shipped or delivered work. Compensation At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. items.desc: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job As a Data Architect, you will shape the future architecture of Alfa Laval’s Global Data & Analytics Platform. You will work across business domains, source systems, data products and technical teams to create a connected, scalable and governed data landscape. Combining strategic architecture with hands-on data modelling, you will assess the current landscape, define the target architecture and help teams bridge the gap between the current and future states. Alfa Laval’s global data landscape spans research and development, sales, service, operations, supply chain, finance, HR and sustainability, with data distributed across multiple source systems and structures. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise and solution architects, data product teams, developers and platform engineers to establish common standards, models and architectural principles. Your work will make enterprise data easier to find, understand, integrate and reuse, creating a scalable foundation for reporting, analytics, digital products and AI. Key responsibilities Define and drive a coherent data architecture for Alfa Laval’s Global Data & Analytics Platform—creating one connected architectural direction across business domains, systems, products and value streams, including ERP, CRM and domain-specific solutions. Establish and promote common architectural principles, standards and guardrails for data modelling, governance, integration, interoperability, security, quality, scalability and reuse across the platform. Shape the target architecture and roadmap by assessing the current landscape, identifying gaps and dependencies, and defining practical steps towards a unified future state. Create and maintain consistent, reusable data models across business domains, supporting common definitions and enabling data to be used across multiple analytics and business use cases. Translate business requirements into enterprise-level data architecture, ensuring that data products and platform capabilities align with the overall architecture rather than creating isolated solutions. Work hands-on with architects, data engineers and developers to implement data models, integration patterns and shared platform capabilities. Partner with business and technical stakeholders to align priorities, explain architectural decisions, resolve trade-offs and build support across organizational boundaries. Collaborate with other architects and evaluate technologies to ensure the platform can support future analytics, AI and digital business needs. Who are you You are a strategic and hands-on data architect who is comfortable working with ambiguity, navigating complex organizations and making decisions with incomplete information. You are pragmatic and structured, with a focus on implementable outcomes and long-term business value. Rather than creating isolated solutions, you are motivated by building reusable capabilities that can support the organization over time. You are curious and forward-looking, while remaining grounded in practical delivery. You build strong working relationships with business and technical stakeholders and are comfortable working with people at different levels and in different disciplines. You explain complex architectural topics clearly and practically, facilitate discussions, create alignment across organizational silos, and use communication and influencing skills to drive change. You are collaborative and approachable, while also being prepared to constructively challenge existing assumptions and approaches when this helps create better outcomes across a global, matrixed organization. What you know To succeed in this role, you bring strong experience in data architecture and modelling, combined with the technical expertise needed to shape and implement scalable cloud-based data platforms. We believe you have: At least five years of experience in data architecture, enterprise data architecture, data platform architecture or a related senior data role. Proven experience designing and implementing modern cloud-based data and analytics architectures in enterprise environments, preferably using Microsoft Azure and Azure data services. Strong experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including translating business requirements into data architecture and …

items.desc: Your Impact As a HIL Testing & Quality Technician , you will join the growing department of HIL Systems and be part of the HIL Testing team. In the position of a HIL Testing Technician, you closely collaborate with engineering, development, and assembly teams, as well as other departments and customers. You will ensure that our Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test systems and electronic assemblies meet our functional and quality requirements before they reach our customers. You will perform manual and automated testing from PCBA to complete system level, inspect electronic assemblies for manufacturing and workmanship quality, and support troubleshooting and rework when issues are identified. Working closely with our engineering, assembly, HW development, and project teams, you will play an important role in delivering reliable, high-quality HIL test systems to our customers. Along with the testing activities, you are constantly engaged in internal improvements for automation of testing tasks. Your Contribution: Execute manual and automated tests at PCBA, subsystem, and complete HIL test bench level. Perform end-of-line testing and document test results, deviations, and identify defects. Perform QA/QC inspections of PCBAs and electronic assemblies, including solder joints, component placement, connectors, wiring, and overall workmanship. Perform THT and SMD soldering, rework, modification, and repair of electronic assemblies. Troubleshoot electrical and electronic issues using schematics, wiring diagrams, test results, and measurement equipment. Use oscilloscopes, mustimeters, power supplies, signal generators, and other laboratory equipment for functional verification and fault isolation. Support electrical safety testing and system-level verification. Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) when required. Collaborate closely with hardware engineers, assembly technicians, system engineers and project managers to resolve identified issues. Maintain test equipment, fixtures, tools, and workstations and follow ESD, electrical safety, and quality procedures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of test procedures, quality processes, and test automation. Your Background What you bring Completed apprenticeship or technical education in electronics, electrical engineering, or a comparable technical field. At least 2 years of hands-on experience in electronics testing, production testing, electronics manufacturing, quality control, or a related environment. Strong practical knowledge of electronics and the ability to read and understand electrical schematics and wiring diagrams. Hands-on experience with electronic measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and signal generators. Good THT and SMD soldering and rework skills. Experience with PCBA inspection, electronic assembly, and identifying manufacturing or workmanship defects. Structured and systematic approach to testing, troubleshooting, and documentation. Team player with a high degree of ownership, independence, accountability, flexibility and reliability Fluent English communication skills Eligibility to work in Switzerland Strong plus / nice-to-have Experience with automated testing or test automation. Knowledge of IPC-A-610 or other electronics workmanship/quality standards. IPC soldering/rework certification or equivalent practical experience. Familiarity with MATLAB® and Simulink®. Experience with communication interfaces such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, or serial communication. Familiarity with Altium Designer. German communication skills What We Offer Work with state-of-the-art tools in a high-tech environment and collaborate with renowned customers worldwide. Join an experienced team of innovators committed to advancing technology, science, and sustainability. Contribute to an inclusive, supportive work culture where collaboration and continuous learning matter. Enjoy attractive vacation entitlement, flexible working arrangements with home office options. Benefit from comprehensive pension plans that reflect individual seniority. Invest in your growth with an annual professional development budget. Thrive in a modern workplace that values your personal and professional development, empowering you to make a meaningful impact. About us Speedgoat provides ready-to-use systems that make it easy to test and fine-tune control designs. Whether it is in cars, aircraft, energy systems, or industrial machines, engineers and researchers rely on Speedgoat to test their innovations in real time, under real-world conditions, before anything is built. Trusted by industry leaders since 2007, based in Switzerland, and with offices in the US, Germany, and China, Speedgoat supports faster, safer, and more confident development, helping new products reach the market faster and perform better from day one.

A logical head. Coding isn't needed, though you'll learn to build with AI tools. You don't need any Salesforce experience. We'll teach you. Daily one-to-one mentoring for your first year. Laptop and the tools you need, AI tools included. 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, and a company pension. Five days a week in the Wimbledon office while you train, moving to a mix of office and home once you're up to speed. items.desc: AI Engineer – RAG Platform | Utrecht | Hybrid Location: Utrecht, Netherlands (Hybrid) Hours: 36 hours per week Contract: Until 31 August 2027 Start Date: ASAP Experience: Minimum 3 years Language: English Application Deadline: 28 October 2026 The Opportunity Are you an experienced AI Engineer passionate about improving the performance of Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems? We are recruiting an AI Engineer – RAG Platform for a leading Dutch financial institution in Utrecht. This is an opportunity to work on a strategic, production-grade AI platform used by thousands of employees. Your focus will be on improving retrieval accuracy, answer quality and the overall effectiveness of enterprise AI systems through data-driven experimentation, evaluation and optimisation. Unlike traditional AI development roles, this position is not primarily about building chatbots, new AI applications or infrastructure. It is about making an existing, large-scale RAG platform measurably better. Key Responsibilities Continuously improve RAG performance, retrieval accuracy, answer quality and user experience. Investigate poor-quality AI responses to identify retrieval, grounding and relevance issues. Design and implement automated evaluation frameworks for GenAI systems. Experiment with embedding models, chunking strategies, retrieval methods and prompt optimisation. Analyse large datasets, user feedback and production telemetry using Databricks. Develop automated feedback loops to identify weaknesses and drive continuous improvements. Define, track and optimise quality metrics across the RAG platform. Translate experimental findings into scalable, production-ready engineering solutions. Collaborate closely with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and Product Managers. Ensure improvements are measurable, reliable and maintainable. Required Skills & Experience Minimum 3 years' experience in Machine Learning, Applied AI or Data Science. Proven hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Large Language Models. Strong Python development skills. Practical experience with Databricks and large-scale data processing. Experience developing evaluation frameworks and quality metrics for Generative AI. Knowledge of embedding models, retrieval techniques and prompt optimisation. Experience with data pipelines, workflow automation and CI/CD. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure. Demonstrated ability to improve production-grade AI or retrieval systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Master's degree or equivalent academic level in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline. Excellent English communication skills. Desirable Experience Fine-tuning Large Language Models. Search ranking and information retrieval algorithms. AI observability, monitoring and performance optimisation. Large-scale enterprise AI platforms. Synthetic evaluation datasets and AI benchmarking. Statistical experimentation and model performance analysis. Why Consider This Opportunity? Work on a business-critical AI platform serving thousands of users. Make a direct, measurable impact on enterprise AI quality and performance. Work with an experienced, multidisciplinary AI engineering team. Gain exposure to complex production AI challenges and modern GenAI technologies. Hybrid working arrangements in Utrecht. Long-term assignment running until August 2027. Interested? If you have strong experience with RAG systems, Python, Databricks and Generative AI evaluation, we would be pleased to hear from you. Please send your English CV , together with a brief overview of your relevant RAG engineering experience, availability and salary or rate expectations.

items.desc: Stellenbeschreibung: Die Sparda-Bank Hannover ist eine genossenschaftliche Bank. Wir kümmern uns seit 1903 um unsere Mitmenschen. Dabei sind wir entsprechend unserem Leitbild in allen Fragen rund um das Thema „Finanzen“ der faire und sympathische Ansprechpartner, der mit einfachen und leistungsstarken Angeboten überzeugt. Maßgebend für den Erfolg unseres Hauses sind unsere Mitarbeiter (m/w/d). Deshalb ist uns deren Zufriedenheit und gute Ausbildung ein besonderes Anliegen. Wir unterstützen sie dabei, persönliche und fachliche Kompetenzen auszubauen. Am Standort Hannover suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Termin in Voll- oder Teilzeit einen KI-Plattform-Experten (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Data Science und LLM Engineering für unseren Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz Damit unterstützen Sie uns – so gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft Aufbau, Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung einer skalierbaren und modularen Infrastruktur (KI-Plattform) zur Entwicklung und produktivem Betrieb von KI-Lösungen Sie konzipieren und entwickeln eigenständige KI-Anwendungen, von klassischen Machine-Learning-Modellen bis hin zu modernen KI-Agenten; dabei schaffen Sie insbesondere Lösungen, wenn am Markt keine geeigneten Standardprodukte verfügbar sind oder bestehende Lösungen gezielt erweitert werden sollen Sie gestalten und etablieren Prozesse, Standards und Governance-Richtlinien für die bankinterne Eigenentwicklung von KI-Lösungen und fördern deren nachhaltige Verankerung, beispielsweise durch professionelle Code-Versionierung und moderne Entwicklungsstandards Stets enger Austausch und Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und KI-Fachkräften bei der Pilotierung und Einführung neuer KI-Use-Cases auf der KI-Plattform Das wünschen wir uns von Ihnen Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im Bereich der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Operationalisierung von Machine-Learning-Modellen, insbesondere für Prognose- und Zeitreihenanalysen, sowie in der Umsetzung generativer KI-Anwendungen; Kenntnisse im Umfeld von Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) und KI-Agenten setzen wir voraus Gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie praktische Erfahrungen mit Code-Versionierung, Git-basierten Entwicklungsprozessen und CI/CD-Pipelines Praktische Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb einer modularen und skalierbaren KI-Entwicklungsplattform – idealerweise Databricks oder eine vergleichbare Lösung Kenntnisse im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenarchitekturen für Generative-AI-Anwendungsfälle, insbesondere im Kontext von Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vektordatenbanken, semantischen Suchverfahren und dem Model Context Protocol (MCP) zur Anbindung von Datenquellen, Anwendungen und KI-Agenten Vertrautheit mit Cloud-Technologien, insbesondere im Kontext KI – idealerweise mit Microsoft Azure oder einem vergleichbaren Hyperscaler wie AWS oder Google Cloud Darauf können Sie sich freuen Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem engagierten Team Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem leistungsstarken und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen Sie arbeiten bei einem Arbeitgeber, der in 2023, 2024 und 2025 mit dem KUNUNU Award als TOP ARBEITGEBER ausgezeichnet wurde Die Vergütung erfolgt auf Grundlage unseres Tarifvertrages Mit unserem Paket aus Vergütung, festen Sonderzahlungen und der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge zahlen wir in Summe mehr als 14 Monatsgehälter, das entspricht bei Vollzeit einen Bruttojahresgehalt bis zu 80.400,00 Euro Großzügiger Fahrgeldzuschuss und vermögenswirksame Leistungen Gezielte Fortbildungsmaßnahmen Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und individuelle Teilzeitmodelle 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr plus zusätzliche Urlaubstage bei persönlichen Anlässen, Heiligabend und Silvester sind frei Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterveranstaltungen und gemeinsame Feiern Regelmäßige After-Work-Angebote (z. B. Rückenfitness, Kreativkurse, Ernährungsberatung und Persönlichkeitstraining) Bike-Leasing Corporate Benefits Haben Sie Lust auf eine neue Herausforderung? items.desc: A LIRE ATTENTIVEMENT AVANT DE POSTULER ⬇ 🏠 2 jours de télétravail / semaine - 📍 Lyon (03) - 🛠 Expérience de 5 ans minimum Vous êtes Data Scientist expérimenté.e et souhaitez travailler sur des problématiques qui combinent analyse statistique, traitement de données massives et industrialisation ? Nous recherchons un.e Data Scientist capable d’intervenir de bout en bout : de la compréhension du besoin métier jusqu’à la mise en production de traitements de données, avec un enjeu particulier autour de Python et PySpark. Votre rôle Vous travaillerez directement avec les experts métiers pour comprendre leurs problématiques, identifier les données pertinentes et construire les traitements permettant d’y répondre. Concrètement, vous serez amené.e à : participer aux ateliers avec les experts métiers pour recueillir et préciser leurs besoins rechercher les données pertinentes et réaliser les analyses exploratoires concevoir et développer les traitements de données mener des études statistiques développer, lorsque le besoin le nécessite, des modèles de Machine Learning restituer vos analyses sous forme de rapports d’étude ou de tableaux de bord porter des codes d’expérimentation ou d’étude vers PySpark afin de permettre leur industrialisation. Vous contribuerez également à la veille sur les méthodes et outils de Data Science, ainsi qu’au partage des bonnes pratiques. Un rôle qui ne s’arrête pas à la modélisation Le poste comporte une dimension importante de cadrage et d’industrialisation. Vous pourrez intervenir directement auprès des métiers, sans participation systématique d’un Product Owner ou d’un Product Manager. Vous devrez donc être à l’aise pour recueillir un besoin, animer des ateliers et traduire les problématiques rencontrées en solutions data. Vous participerez également à la rédaction des documents de cadrage et pourrez proposer des architectures de traitements et des modèles de données destinés à la production. Environnement technique Vous travaillerez principalement avec : Python - PySpark - Hadoop - PostgreSQL - Power BI - GitLab - GitLab CI/CD - Jira - Confluence Côté Python, l’environnement comprend notamment : Pandas - Polars - Scikit-learn -Matplotlib - XGBoost - Pandera - GeoPandas Profil candidat: Les compétences indispensables pour cette mission Trois critères sont particulièrement importants : Une expérience confirmée en Data Science Vous justifiez de plus de 5 ans d’expérience en Data Science et avez déjà travaillé sur plusieurs dimensions du métier : recueil des besoins, analyse statistique, Machine Learning et traitement de données massives pouvant représenter plusieurs dizaines de millions de lignes. Une expertise Python Vous maîtrisez Python et ses principales librairies de Data Science. Une expérience concrète de GeoPandas et de traitements spatiaux lourds, portant sur plusieurs dizaines de millions de géométries, est un plus. Vous avez également déjà développé des traitements avec PySpark. Une expérience de l’industrialisation Vous avez déjà industrialisé des traitements Data Science lourds et êtes capable de contribuer aux choix d’architecture concernant les traitements et les modèles de données. Cette expérience doit notamment concerner au moins l’un des types de données suivants : données spatiales, textuelles, séries temporelles ou graphes. Ce qui sera également apprécié Une expérience sur l’un ou plusieurs de ces sujets constituera un plus : modélisation Machine Learning appliquée aux séries temporelles données modélisées sous forme de graphes MLOps connaissance du secteur de l’énergie. Vous êtes également à l’aise pour présenter vos analyses de manière pédagogique, notamment à travers des tableaux de bord Power BI, et pour animer des groupes de travail autour des organisations et processus métiers. Si vous êtes prêt.e à relever ce défi et à contribuer à des projets stimulants, n'hésitez pas à postuler dès maintenant ! 🚀
