items.desc: A LIRE ATTENTIVEMENT AVANT DE POSTULER ⬇ 🏠 2 jours de télétravail / semaine - 📍 Lyon (03) - 🛠 Expérience de 5 ans minimum Vous êtes Data Scientist expérimenté.e et souhaitez travailler sur des problématiques qui combinent analyse statistique, traitement de données massives et industrialisation ? Nous recherchons un.e Data Scientist capable d’intervenir de bout en bout : de la compréhension du besoin métier jusqu’à la mise en production de traitements de données, avec un enjeu particulier autour de Python et PySpark. Votre rôle Vous travaillerez directement avec les experts métiers pour comprendre leurs problématiques, identifier les données pertinentes et construire les traitements permettant d’y répondre. Concrètement, vous serez amené.e à : participer aux ateliers avec les experts métiers pour recueillir et préciser leurs besoins rechercher les données pertinentes et réaliser les analyses exploratoires concevoir et développer les traitements de données mener des études statistiques développer, lorsque le besoin le nécessite, des modèles de Machine Learning restituer vos analyses sous forme de rapports d’étude ou de tableaux de bord porter des codes d’expérimentation ou d’étude vers PySpark afin de permettre leur industrialisation. Vous contribuerez également à la veille sur les méthodes et outils de Data Science, ainsi qu’au partage des bonnes pratiques. Un rôle qui ne s’arrête pas à la modélisation Le poste comporte une dimension importante de cadrage et d’industrialisation. Vous pourrez intervenir directement auprès des métiers, sans participation systématique d’un Product Owner ou d’un Product Manager. Vous devrez donc être à l’aise pour recueillir un besoin, animer des ateliers et traduire les problématiques rencontrées en solutions data. Vous participerez également à la rédaction des documents de cadrage et pourrez proposer des architectures de traitements et des modèles de données destinés à la production. Environnement technique Vous travaillerez principalement avec : Python - PySpark - Hadoop - PostgreSQL - Power BI - GitLab - GitLab CI/CD - Jira - Confluence Côté Python, l’environnement comprend notamment : Pandas - Polars - Scikit-learn -Matplotlib - XGBoost - Pandera - GeoPandas Profil candidat: Les compétences indispensables pour cette mission Trois critères sont particulièrement importants : Une expérience confirmée en Data Science Vous justifiez de plus de 5 ans d’expérience en Data Science et avez déjà travaillé sur plusieurs dimensions du métier : recueil des besoins, analyse statistique, Machine Learning et traitement de données massives pouvant représenter plusieurs dizaines de millions de lignes. Une expertise Python Vous maîtrisez Python et ses principales librairies de Data Science. Une expérience concrète de GeoPandas et de traitements spatiaux lourds, portant sur plusieurs dizaines de millions de géométries, est un plus. Vous avez également déjà développé des traitements avec PySpark. Une expérience de l’industrialisation Vous avez déjà industrialisé des traitements Data Science lourds et êtes capable de contribuer aux choix d’architecture concernant les traitements et les modèles de données. Cette expérience doit notamment concerner au moins l’un des types de données suivants : données spatiales, textuelles, séries temporelles ou graphes. Ce qui sera également apprécié Une expérience sur l’un ou plusieurs de ces sujets constituera un plus : modélisation Machine Learning appliquée aux séries temporelles données modélisées sous forme de graphes MLOps connaissance du secteur de l’énergie. Vous êtes également à l’aise pour présenter vos analyses de manière pédagogique, notamment à travers des tableaux de bord Power BI, et pour animer des groupes de travail autour des organisations et processus métiers. Si vous êtes prêt.e à relever ce défi et à contribuer à des projets stimulants, n'hésitez pas à postuler dès maintenant ! 🚀

items.desc: Remote · Full-time · $4,000–$5,000 USD/month · US Eastern Time overlap About the Company Our client is a fast-growing, AI-first startup based in San Francisco, building intelligent automation systems that transform how businesses operate. The company uses AI agents to automate complex business workflows, reduce manual work, and deliver measurable results for customers. We're looking for a hands-on Forward Deployment Engineer who can turn real business problems into reliable, production-ready AI solutions. The Role As a Forward Deployment Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and business operations. Your responsibility is to understand operational challenges, design practical solutions, and build AI-powered systems that solve them. This is a highly hands-on engineering role. You'll work closely with the founding team and business operations colleagues to develop, deploy, troubleshoot, and continuously improve AI agents and automated workflows. We're looking for someone who can move quickly, work independently, and take full ownership of solutions from initial problem identification to production deployment. What You'll Do Build and deploy AI agents: Develop AI-powered workflows that automate repetitive and complex business processes. Integrate systems: Connect AI agents with APIs, databases, CRMs, spreadsheets, and third-party platforms. Own end-to-end implementation: Translate business requirements into working technical solutions, from prototyping to production. Improve agent reliability: Debug failures, refine prompts, implement validation mechanisms, and improve accuracy. Work directly with operations teams: Understand how processes work in practice and identify opportunities for automation. Build quickly and iterate: Develop prototypes, test them with real users, and improve them based on feedback. Monitor production workflows: Identify bottlenecks, investigate errors, and ensure automated processes run reliably. Measure business impact: Focus on reducing manual effort, improving execution speed, and increasing operational efficiency. What We're Looking For Strong hands-on software engineering experience, ideally with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Practical experience building AI agents, LLM-powered applications, or automated workflows used in real business environments. Experience working with LLM APIs and tools such as Claude, OpenAI, or similar technologies. Ability to integrate external APIs, databases, and business software. Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier is a plus. Understanding of prompt engineering, tool calling, agent orchestration, and AI output validation. Ability to troubleshoot technical problems independently and deliver working solutions without extensive supervision. Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, business-oriented engineering mindset. Comfortable working in an early-stage startup where priorities change and speed matters. Strong written and spoken English. Availability for several hours of overlap with US Eastern Time. What Makes You Stand Out You've independently built AI agents that are actively used in production. You've automated business processes and can explain the measurable impact. You regularly use Claude Code, Cursor, or other AI-assisted development tools. You've implemented safeguards such as confidence thresholds, human-in-the-loop reviews, automated tests, or monitoring. You can understand a business problem, propose a solution, and deliver a working implementation without waiting for detailed instructions. You enjoy building practical solutions more than discussing theoretical architectures. Not for You If You prefer managing engineers rather than building solutions yourself. Your AI experience is limited to using ChatGPT for writing, research, or basic productivity tasks. You enjoy experimenting with AI but haven't deployed working solutions. You need detailed specifications and constant guidance before starting work. You prefer long development cycles over rapid prototyping, testing, and iteration. What We Offer Compensation: $4,000–$5,000 USD gross per month. Fully remote, full-time position. Direct collaboration with an experienced Silicon Valley founding team. Opportunity to build and deploy AI systems used in real business operations. Significant ownership and autonomy. Fast-paced environment with minimal bureaucracy. Opportunity to grow alongside an ambitious AI-first company.

items.desc: Notre activité est en très forte croissance. Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous créons l'équipe Platform & Transformation , avec deux ambitions complémentaires : Platform : construire et maintenir une couche data (pipeline ETL) et des outils modernes, robustes et fiables (CRM, ERP, CMS). Transformation : comprendre les opérations des équipes métier, construire avec elles des solutions qui améliorent leur quotidien, puis leur en transférer l'ownership. Notre manière de travailler : des fondations robustes, du focus et des livraisons rapides qui créent un impact mesurable . Ton métier : comprendre comment nos équipes travaillent, et en faire des outils, des automations et des agents IA qu'elles s'approprient. Ta mission Tu transformes le contexte métier en systèmes fiables et utiles. Tu t'intègres à une équipe (ADV, Supply, Logistique, Growth...) et tu comprends comment elle travaille vraiment : ses process, ses règles, ses exceptions et tout le savoir tacite qui n'est documenté nulle part. Tu identifies ce qui peut être simplifié, amélioré ou automatisé, puis tu construis les solutions adaptées : automations, agents IA, apps internes, outils d'aide à la décision... Tu es un builder autonome techniquement, avec une forte sensibilité métier . Tu ne te contentes ni de recueillir des besoins, ni d'exécuter des demandes : tu challenges les problèmes, proposes des solutions et les construis toi-même. Ton objectif n'est pas de devenir indispensable aux équipes. C'est de leur permettre de travailler mieux, durablement, et avec un maximum d'autonomie. Ta réussite se mesure à l'impact créé et à l'autonomie des équipes après ton passage . Ce que tu feras Tu travailles par cycles courts, en immersion dans une équipe métier, en suivant cinq étapes : Comprendre. Participer aux rituels, observer les opérations, interviewer les équipes et formaliser leurs règles, leurs exceptions et leur savoir tacite - bref, créer du contexte. Prioriser. Cartographier les process, repérer les tâches manuelles et les irritants, puis choisir les sujets à plus fort impact. Et savoir dire non. Construire. Développer des agents IA, des automatisations, des apps internes et des connexions entre nos outils (API, MCP, Odoo, CRM, Shopify…). Transférer. Documenter, former et donner aux équipes la maîtrise de leurs règles métier et de l'usage quotidien des outils. Scinder maintenance opérationnelle et technique. Mesurer. Suivre les gains de temps, la qualité des opérations, l'adoption des outils et leur fiabilité dans la durée. En parallèle, tu contribues à faire monter les équipes en compétences sur l'IA, et tu travailles étroitement avec l'équipe Data pour t'appuyer sur des fondations solides. À quoi pourraient ressembler tes projets ? ADV / B2B Care : automatiser une partie du traitement des commandes pharmacies reçues par email. Growth : construire un Growth OS qui réunit Influence, Gifting, Creative Strategy, Media Buying. Logistique : automatiser des imports de commandes. Tu as 3 à 6 ans d'expérience à l'interface entre business et tech : Solutions Engineer, BizOps, RevOps, Product Engineer, Product Manager, Analytics Engineer, Software Engineer... Ton parcours précis nous importe moins que ce que tu sais construire. Tu te reconnais dans ces points : Tu construis vraiment. Tu as déjà livré des outils, applications ou automatisations utilisés au quotidien, et tu sais expliquer tes choix. Tu es autonome techniquement. Tu maîtrises SQL, tu sais écrire et comprendre du code (Python ou JavaScript), travailler avec des API et utiliser Git/GitHub. Tu développes avec l'IA. Claude Code, Codex ou équivalent font partie de ta boîte à outils, mais tu gardes la maîtrise de ce qu'ils produisent. Tu comprends les métiers. Tu aimes poser des questions, découvrir des règles implicites et clarifier des besoins flous. Tu sais livrer des systèmes fiables. Tu testes, gères les erreurs et sais quand une validation humaine est indispensable. Tu cherches l'impact et aimes transmettre. Tu privilégies les solutions utiles et tu veux que les équipes puissent se les approprier. Ce serait un plus si tu connais un ERP, un CRM ou Shopify ; si tu as utilisé dbt, BigQuery ou un outil BI ; ou si tu as déjà accompagné des équipes non techniques dans l'adoption d'outils ou d'agents IA. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un rôle nouveau et transverse , avec des résultats visibles dès les premières missions. Forte exposition aux équipes et enjeux business - tu vas apprendre vite. Les mains libres : l'équipe se crée, la stack n'est pas figée et t'es là pour nous faire passer à la vitesse supérieure. La possibilité de changer concrètement les façons de travailler chez Respire. Process de recrutement Un premier échange de 30 minutes avec Olivier (Lead Platform & Transformation). Un cas pratique avec restitution Un entretien avec Antoine (Head Of Digital). [Facultatif] Un échange avec un membre de l'équipe Data.

items.desc: About Us Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide. In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence. With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions. Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers. Role Overview This is a long-term fixed-term contract designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project. Planet is scaling AI-first engineering across its technology organisation, and the AI Enablement team is helping turn that ambition into day-to-day reality. We are looking for Senior AI Developer Experience Engineers to join the team and help drive adoption across Engineering. This is a hands-on role focused on AI Fluency, developer experience, internal enablement tooling, and measurable improvement across the software delivery lifecycle. You will work closely with teams across Engineering, partnering directly with developers, QAs, product owners, scrum masters, business analysts, and managers to help them adopt better ways of working with AI. This is not a role from the sidelines. You will spend time with teams, understand where they struggle, coach them in practical contexts, and help embed better habits into real delivery work. We are looking for people with strong engineering foundations who also bring a strong human touch. You should be someone who communicates clearly, builds trust easily, works well with different personalities, and knows how to bring people with you. Success in this role depends as much on credibility with engineers as it does on your ability to explain, facilitate, coach, and create momentum across the organisation. You will help enable more than 300 engineers, alongside a broader set of SDLC roles, through structured AI Fluency sessions, hands-on pairing, internal agents and workflows, reusable guidance, and support for priority initiatives. Over time, the role will also help drive adoption of broader platform and toolchain capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness across Planet. What You'll Do Deliver AI Fluency sessions across Engineering and SDLC roles, from prompt engineering fundamentals to more advanced agentic coding workflows and practical AI-first ways of working Work closely with teams across Engineering, building strong relationships, understanding where they struggle, and helping them adopt AI and better workflows in a practical, team-friendly way Pair directly with developers and teams to improve adoption in real delivery work, helping them use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations, and related capabilities effectively and responsibly. Help maintain and improve internal enablement tooling, including AI agents, automations, templates, prompts, workflows, and supporting assets used across the organisation. Create high-quality enablement content, including guides, templates, examples, recorded sessions, best practices, and role-specific learning material that teams can actually use. Assess and track AI maturity across teams using Planet’s AI Fluency model, helping identify where support is needed and where stronger patterns can be scaled. Support priority initiatives with dedicated AI-first coaching, helping delivery teams apply better workflows, better prompting, and more effective use of internal tools in live projects. Collaborate closely with Architecture and Platform teams so enablement stays aligned with engineering standards, platform capabilities, system landscape, and the way Planet builds software. Capture adoption signals, usage insights, and learning feedback, and feed these into the AI Centre of Excellence and broader leadership reporting. Over time, help expand enablement beyond AI tooling into broader developer experience and platform adoption across the engineering toolchain. Who You Are Strong software engineering background, with experience building or maintaining production systems and a solid understanding of the full SDLC. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cody, Claude Code, or similar. Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly, run hands-on workshops, and adapt your style to different audiences across Engineering. Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine human touch. You build trust, work well with different personalities, and enjoy helping teams improve in a practical and collaborative way. items.desc: Forget typical junior positions where you're sidelined to observation and slide decks. This is a high-intensity, "builder-first" role designed for proactive profiles ready to automate and execute from day one. You will work side-by-side with senior leaders across Sales, Product, and Operations to redefine our company’s operating model using Artificial Intelligence. You will take ownership of real-world business problems with the goal of automating workflows, deploying AI agents, and generating tangible business impact. Tareas Process Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and solve them by combining AI with no-code/low-code tools. Practical AI Implementation: Deploy AI agents and custom solutions using models such as Claude, OpenAI, and Codex. Internal Consulting: Function as part of an "AI Strike Team" reporting directly to senior executives. Rapid Execution: Move from "idea" to "functional prototype" within days, with the freedom to test and iterate quickly. Requisitos Proactive Mindset: High energy, a "let's solve it" attitude, and a hunger for constant learning. AI Tool Fluency: Hands-on experience with Claude, ChatGPT, or OpenAI APIs and prompt engineering. No-Code/Low-Code Basics: Familiarity with tools like Zapier, Make, or Retool to connect AI models with workflows. Availability: 100% on-site presence at our Madrid, Spain offices. Mindset: We value what you can build and how fast you learn over titles or specific brands on your CV. Beneficios Competitive Compensation: 100% paid position from day one. Real Impact: Direct leadership over projects that affect the company's bottom line Zero Bureaucracy: Direct interaction with senior leaders without middle management layers. Career Path: 6-month initial period with a specific intent to transition to a permanent contract.

Wir arbeiten als international agierendes Unternehmen in sehr diversen Teams bei größtmöglicher Flexibilität für unsere Mitarbeitenden. Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt durch Chancengerechtigkeit, Wertschätzung und Respekt. Du hast bei uns die Chance, neue Entwicklungen voranzutreiben, an Lösungen für eine moderne, nachhaltige und zukunftsgerichtete Energieversorgung zu arbeiten und Veränderungsprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten. Interesse? Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich! Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, etablierst und operationalisierst plattformweite Sicherheits-, Ethik- und Compliance-Rahmenwerke über den gesamten Lebenszyklus der KI-Plattform hinweg (Funktionalitäten, Services und Betriebsmodell). Du definierst und pflegst Governance-Kontrollen für Plattformfunktionalitäten wie das Onboarding und die Freigabe von Modellen, die Registrierung von Agenten und die Durchsetzung von Richtlinien, den einheitlichen Modellzugriff über ein Gateway sowie Freigabemechanismen und Kontrollpunkte über die Entwicklungsphasen Dev, UAT und Prod hinweg. Du stellst sicher, dass die Plattform die Anforderungen der DSGVO, des EU AI Act und weiterer anwendbarer gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Vorgaben erfüllt, indem du diese in verbindliche technische Kontrollen und operative Prozesse übersetzt. Du etablierst und pflegst Governance-Anforderungen für Modelle und die Liste der zugelassenen Modelle. Dabei berücksichtigst du die Herkunft und Nachvollziehbarkeit der Modelle, Lizenzbedingungen, regionale Vorgaben und Hosting-Beschränkungen, das Änderungsmanagement sowie die kontrollierte Außerbetriebnahme von Modellen. Du definierst und überprüfst die Sicherheitsanforderungen der Plattform. Dazu gehören Richtlinien für die Inhaltssicherheit (Filterung von Ein- und Ausgaben), Schutzmaßnahmen gegen Prompt Injection und Datenlecks sowie sichere Standardeinstellungen für den Einsatz von Agenten und Tools. Du definierst die Anforderungen an Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement auf Plattformebene, beispielsweise die Integration von Microsoft Entra ID, das Schlüsselmanagement einschließlich regelmäßiger Schlüsselrotation, das Prinzip der geringsten Berechtigungen (Least Privilege) und die Trennung von Umgebungen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle Zugriffe eindeutig zugeordnet und revisionssicher nachvollzogen werden können. Du definierst die Anforderungen an Beobachtbarkeit, Auditierbarkeit und Nachweisführung auf Plattformebene. Dazu gehören Protokollierung, Telemetrie, Nachvollziehbarkeit sowie die transparente Zuordnung von Kosten und Nutzung, um Governance-Berichte und die Sicherheitsüberwachung zu unterstützen. Du führst KI-Risikobewertungen mit Schwerpunkt auf Plattformfunktionalitäten und gemeinsam genutzten Services durch. Dabei berücksichtigst du mögliche Missbrauchsszenarien, Robustheit, Risiken entlang der Lieferkette und durch Drittanbieter sowie die Sicherheitslage der eingebundenen Modelle. Du unterstützt interne und externe Audits von KI-Systemen, indem du die erforderlichen Plattformnachweise koordinierst. Dazu gehören die Konzeption und Prüfung von Kontrollen, Protokolle, Freigaben, dokumentierte Ausnahmen sowie die Nachverfolgung von Korrektur- und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Zusätzliche Verantwortlichkeiten (optional) Du unterstützt Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen (Data Protection Impact Assessments, DPIAs), Interessenabwägungen bei der Verarbeitung auf Grundlage berechtigter Interessen (Legitimate Interest Assessments, LIAs) sowie weitere Datenschutz- und Compliance-Bewertungen, die sich speziell auf die Nutzung der Plattform beziehen. Dazu gehören beispielsweise Konnektoren, Daten für Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), die Auswahl von Modellregionen und die Funktionalitäten von Agenten. Du wirkst an der Entwicklung und Pflege von Plattform-Dashboards und Kennzahlen (KPIs) mit, um die Einhaltung von Responsible-AI-Anforderungen, die Wirksamkeit von Kontrollen, die Qualität des Modell-Onboardings, Richtlinienverstöße und die Audit-Bereitschaft zu messen und transparent darzustellen. Du unterstützt die Reaktion auf Sicherheitsvorfälle im Zusammenhang mit KI-Services. Dazu gehören Untersuchungen, die Kommunikation mit relevanten Stakeholdern sowie die Umsetzung und Nachverfolgung von Korrekturmaßnahmen nach einem Vorfall. Dein Profil Du hast einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik, Informationssicherheit, Data Science, Rechtswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Du verfügst über nachgewiesene Expertise in den Bereichen Informationssicherheit, Privacy Engineering, Datenschutz und Enterprise Risk Management. Darüber hinaus besitzt du fundierte Kenntnisse der DSGVO, des EU AI Act und anerkannter Responsible-AI-Prinzipien wie Fairness, Transparenz, Verantwortlichkeit und menschlicher Aufsicht. items.desc: Dans le contexte actuel de développement des codes de calcul 💻 pour la filière de quatrième génération, afin de permettre à la France de répondre aux besoins de décarbonation et à l’évolution de sa production énergétique, le laboratoire LCAN souhaite renforcer son équipe en recrutant un ingénieur de recherche en CDI 👨‍💻 Le poste requiert de solides compétences en physique des réacteurs à sodium, en modélisation diphasique et, surtout, en méthodes numériques adaptées à ce type de problématiques . Vous devrez également posséder une expertise confirmée en développement de codes massivement parallèles, afin de vous intégrer pleinement à l’équipe de développeurs et développeuses du laboratoire. Enfin, la personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe du CEA en charge du développement de l’OCS pour la simulation des réacteurs de quatrième génération, avec pour objectif de contribuer à leur optimisation et d’en renforcer la robustesse et la fiabilité. Profil du candidat PARLONS DE VOUS ! Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat (Bac+8) en mathématiques appliquées et informatique, avec une expérience de 1 à 2 ans dans le domaine de la simulation parellèle, le développement des méthodes numerique en thermohydraulique ou nouvelles technologies de l'énergie. Vous maîtrisez les langages de programmation C++ et Python, et vous êtes à l’aise avec les systèmes d’exploitation Linux et Windows. Vous faites preuve de rigueur et du sens du détail. 🔍 Vous avez un esprit critique et une excellente capacité d’analyse. Vous démontrez de l’autonomie et un bon sens de l’organisation dans votre travail. Vous faites preuve d’innovation et de créativité dans vos approches et vos solutions. 💡 English level required ! « Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l’inclusion des travailleurs handicapés » Localisation du poste Site Saclay Localisation du poste France, Ile-de-France, Essonne (91) Ville Saclay Critères candidat Langues Anglais (Courant) Formation recommandée Bac + 8 Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 01/07/2026

items.title: Quantum R&D Engineer - TWPA Design
items.card: you will act as a domain expert on the physics and architecture of our Josephson Travelling Wave Parametric Amplifiers and will translate product specifications into TWPA architectures. You will focus on pushing the fundamental limits of our microwave engineering, solving complex simulation-to-fabrication mismatches, and spearheading the integration of advanced on-chip components. What You'll Be Doing Translate
items.desc: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Quantum R&D Engineer - TWPA Design , you will act as a domain expert on the physics and architecture of our Josephson Travelling Wave Parametric Amplifiers and will translate product specifications into TWPA architectures. You will focus on pushing the fundamental limits of our microwave engineering, solving complex simulation-to-fabrication mismatches, and spearheading the integration of advanced on-chip components. What You'll Be Doing Translate product specifications & features into TWPA layouts and circuit designs through simulations. Drive the miniaturisation of our TWPA architectures and successfully design and integrate critical peripheral components on-chip Research directions include extending bandwidth, improving noise performance, and integration of peripheral functions like pump coupling and isolation. Present findings and technical proposals clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing roadmap and product decisions. Stay informed of relevant literature and state-of-the-art techniques in parametric amplification, actively contributing new ideas and approaches to the team. Your Profile PhD or equivalent industry experience in quantum-limited amplification, parametric amplifiers (e.g. TWPAs, JPAs), or closely related superconducting microwave circuits. Deep expertise in non-linear metamaterials, Josephson circuits, and mixing processes. >3 years of hands-on experience with advanced microwave design and simulation (e.g., CST, HFSS) with a proven track record of matching simulations to cryogenic measurement data. Track record of independent, creative problem-solving in a research and development setting. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly present technical findings and influence decisions across disciplines. Passionate about qubit readout amplification; pushing amplifier performance to the physical limits and thrive in a fast R&D environment. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. What We Offer At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Vi ser utbildning i nära koppling till forskning som en viktig modell för att skapa genomslag. Kvalifikationer Krav Avlagd doktorsexamen eller utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara en doktorsexamen. Bli en del av KTH KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet. Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH. Fackliga representanter Kontaktuppgifter till fackliga representanter. Ansökan Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in. Ansökan ska innehålla: CV inklusive relevant yrkeserfarenhet och kunskap. Kopia av examensbevis och betyg från dina tidigare universitetsstudier. Översättningar till engelska eller svenska om de ursprungliga dokumenten inte utfärdas på något av dessa språk. Kortfattad redogörelse för varför du vill bedriva forskning, dina akademiska intressen och hur de relaterar till dina tidigare studier och framtida mål. max 2 sidor lång. Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (CentralEuropean Time/Central European Summer Time). Om anställningen Anställningen gäller tidsbegränsat enligt avtal - i upp till 12 mån, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Övrigt För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering. Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

items.desc: L’établissement d’Ugine élabore à partir d’éponges de zirconium livrées par l’établissement de Jarrie, des demi-produits en zirconium : largets, barres et ébauches filées, qui seront utilisés dans les usines de Rugles, Montreuil-Juigné et Paimboeuf. Ugine produit et transforme des produits dans d’autres nuances comme des bases fer, des bases nickel et des base titane. Dans ce contexte, l’établissement d’Ugine recherche un(e) ingénieur(e) pour développer des modèles en simulation numérique sous le logiciel COMSOL Multiphysics® pour les différents procédés de fusion d’alliages métalliques utilisés dans le groupe FRAMATOME. Le poste est basé au Centre de Recherche Composants (CRC) de Framatome Ugine. Dans le cadre des projets de R&D en soutien aux usines de production vous participerez à l’étude et à l’optimisation des procédés de fusion de l’usine d’Ugine. Le poste à pourvoir consistera plus particulièrement à : Réaliser des études bibliographiques sur les procédés de refusion. Modéliser via le logiciel éléments finis COMSOL Multiphysics® les phénomènes : d’écoulement fluidique, de mécanique des structures, de génie du procédés (transport des espèces, électrochimie), de transfert de chaleur, d’électromagnétisme et électrostatique (équations de Maxwell). Utiliser les données de production et issues d’essais de recherche afin d’optimiser le développement des modèles. Réaliser des études de sensibilité (paramètres matériaux, procédé et numérique). Simuler des productions réelles Profil Titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau BAC+5 (école ingénieur) et/ou BAC+8 (Doctorat) avec des connaissances en matériau, métallurgie, thermique, thermodynamique, mécanique des fluides Une expérience (>3 ans) dans le domaine de la modélisation est requise et une maîtrise forte de l’outil COMSOL Multiphysics® est indispensable Compétences en programmation souhaitée La connaissance de procédés d’élaboration d’alliage métallique serait un plus Capacités d'apprentissage rapide de nouveaux domaines scientifiques Maîtrise de l’anglais indispensable les aptitudes nécessaires à la tenue du poste sont : la rigueur scientifique, l'autonomie, une bonne aisance relationnelle, et être force de proposition.

Our Czechowice-Dziedzice site is a fast-growing, multi-product R&D hub equipped with cutting-edge prototype centers and technical testing laboratories. What You’ll Do (The Mission) As the Platform R&I Technical Engineer, you will be the core technical catalyst for next-generation electric mobility. Your mission spans from blank-canvas concepts to physical proof of concepts: Bridge Lab to Reality: Turn advanced theoretical research and innovation (R&I) concepts into functional, physical prototypes. Pre-Simulate & Optimize: Run early-stage thermal and mechanical pre-simulations to ensure product survivability before physical build. L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Techniques de l'Informatique et de la Microélectronique pour l'Architecture des systèmes intégrés Type de Contrat CDD Doctorant Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 38031 GRENOBLE Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Postuler Date limite de candidature : vendredi 13 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Sujet De Thèse La caractérisation de la sécurité des systèmes embarqués en 'boite noire' ou 'boite grise' face aux attaques Side-Channel requiert fréquemment une phase préparatoire de Reverse-Engineering, qui peut être particulièrement chronophage, notamment sur un Sytem-on-Chip (SoC) complexe que l’on peut retrouver sur smartphone ou dans l’automobile. Cette phase peut, par exemple, consister en la détection d’une primitive cryptographique au sein de mesures Side-Channel pour une future attaque par observation, ou d’une routine cible pour une attaque par perturbation. L’objectif de cette thèse est de développer une méthodologie et des outils non-profilés permettant l’automatisation de cette phase de détection, tout en permettant d’exploiter la connaissance a priori d’un potentiel attaquant. La thématique du Reverse-Engineering non-profilé via Side-Channel gravite autour de problèmes bien connus en traitement de 'timeseries' comme la découverte de motifs, découverte d’anomalies, ou la segmentation sémantique. Un des objectifs de cette thèse sera ainsi de traiter ces problématiques en prenant en compte les particularités des attaques par Side-Channel sur SoC, comme le bruit et le jitter dans les mesures, et l’a priori d’un attaquant sur le code exécuté et les données manipulées. De ce fait, l’investigation d’une méthodologie alliant machine learning, modèles probabilistes et métriques exactes sur les 'timeseries', constitue une des pierres angulaires de cette thèse. Les scenarii couverts par les problématiques de recherche posés par cette thèse sont multiples. Quelques exemples significatifs, en plus de la préparation à des attaques physiques classiques, sont le reverse-engineering de bootloader ou la découverte d’architecture de réseaux de neurones. Votre Environnement de Travail Le laboratoire TIMA est un laboratoire public de recherche sous la tutelle du CNRS, de Grenoble INP et de l’UGA. Il est situé à Grenoble, sur le site Viallet de Grenoble INP-UGA (46 avenue Félix Viallet). TIMA est une équipe cosmopolite de 150 personnes environ, avec des chercheurs du monde entier (chercheurs permanents, enseignants-chercheurs, doctorants, post-doctorants, CDD ingénieurs, collaborateurs scientifiques, invités et stagiaires). Les sujets de recherches couvrent la spécification, la conception, la vérification, le test, les outils CAO et méthodes d’aide à la conception pour les systèmes intégrés. Une grande partie de la recherche s’effectue dans le contexte de projets coopératifs, avec des partenaires industriels et académiques, financés par des contrats régionaux, nationaux et européens. Le laboratoire entretient ainsi de forts contacts avec le milieu industriel et académique qui réclament une implication professionnelle tant sur le plan logistique que relationnel. Contraintes et risques Le poste est localisé en Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR), ce qui implique une procédure administrative préalable d’autorisation d’accès. Le CNRS est le seul organisme français actif dans tous les domaines scientifiques. Sa position unique de multi-spécialiste lui permet d’associer les différentes disciplines pour affronter les défis les plus importants du monde contemporain, en lien avec les acteurs du changement. items.desc: The Role We are looking for a Photonics Engineer to join our team developing the semiconductor structures and devices at the heart of Aegiq's next-generation quantum computing systems. You will design, model and optimise advanced III-V semiconductor heterostructures, with a focus on InP and GaAs-based materials systems. Your work will span bandgap engineering, strain management, device physics and thermal modelling, helping develop high-performance quantum light sources and other photonic devices. Working closely with our quantum science, photonic design and device engineering teams, as well as external epitaxy and semiconductor fabrication partners, you will translate device requirements into practical epitaxial designs that can be manufactured reliably and at scale. This is an opportunity to take ownership of challenging semiconductor design problems, contribute to the development of advanced quantum photonic devices and see your designs progress from simulation through wafer manufacturing to experimental validation. Depending on experience, the position may be offered at Senior or Principal Engineer level. What You'll Be Doing Epitaxial Structure Design: Design and optimise complex III-V semiconductor heterostructures, including quantum dots, quantum wells, superlattices and metamorphic buffer layers, with a focus on optical and electronic performance, material quality and manufacturability Device Modelling & Simulation: Model electronic band structures, carrier confinement and transport, optical emission and electro-optical behaviour. Investigate device characteristics such as emission wavelength, optical confinement, carrier dynamics, current-voltage behaviour and quantum-confined Stark shifts Bandgap Engineering: Apply semiconductor physics and quantum mechanical modelling to engineer electronic band structures, quantum confinement, heterojunction offsets and optical properties for advanced photonic and quantum devices Strain Engineering: Analyse lattice mismatch, strain distribution and critical layer thicknesses in pseudomorphic and metamorphic structures. Develop strain-management approaches that achieve the required electronic and optical properties while minimising defects and dislocations Thermal Modelling: Investigate heat transport, thermal resistance and temperature-dependent device behaviour, including the effects of material interfaces and operating conditions on device performance and reliability Simulation & Design Tools: Develop and maintain semiconductor modelling workflows using TCAD and numerical simulation tools such as nextnano, Crosslight, Silvaco, Sentaurus or equivalent software, alongside Python-based modelling and data analysis Epitaxy & Manufacturing: Work with external MOCVD/MOVPE and MBE growth partners to translate epitaxial designs into material specifications and growth requirements. Collaborate with fabrication engineers to understand process constraints, investigate manufacturing challenges and improve device reproducibility Material & Device Characterisation: Interpret structural, optical and electrical characterisation data, including techniques such as high-resolution X-ray diffraction (HR-XRD), photoluminescence (PL), secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Use experimental results to validate models, investigate performance limitations and refine designs Technical Collaboration: Work across quantum physics, photonic design, semiconductor fabrication and experimental testing teams to understand device requirements, make design trade-offs and support the development of reliable quantum photonic hardware About Aegiq Aegiq is a Sheffield-based quantum technology company developing scalable, fault-tolerant photonic quantum computers. Founded in 2019, we work across the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor chips and photonic hardware to software and real-world applications. In 2025, we delivered our first-generation quantum computer to the UK's National Quantum Computing Centre. We're now developing our second-generation platform and expanding our team to tackle the scientific and engineering challenges involved in building quantum computers at scale. We're a growing team of scientists, engineers and specialists who enjoy solving difficult problems and turning new ideas into working technology. At Aegiq, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, contribute directly to the technology we're developing and help shape the future of the company. We value different backgrounds, experiences and ways of thinking. If you're excited about the work we're doing, we'd encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't match every requirement listed. items.title: Data Quality Specialist - Swedish, AGI Data Services - G T Quality
items.card: responsibilities * Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows * Create prescriptive actions for quality issues * Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality * Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements * Analyze data trends and develop solutions * Monitor quality performance and coach operations
items.desc:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows 
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues 
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality 
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions 
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams 
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports 
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations 
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools 
* Support process documentation and implementation
A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams. 
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams). 
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality. 
About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish
- Intermediate-level proficiency in English (B2+ or equivalent fluency by CEFR standards)
- 1+ years of experience in a quality assurance, quality control, or data quality role
- Experience defining, tracking, and reporting quality metrics or KPIs
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
- Experience working with data to identify trends, patterns, and quality issues
- Ability to create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines
- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience with external customer interaction
- Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline)
- Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops
- Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams
- Ability to adapt to fast-paced environments with evolving workflows, priorities, and quality targets
- Experience in machine learning data operations, annotation quality, or content review workflows

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 Technical Specialist (Solution Support - Engineering) 
 Do you want to use your technical expertise to directly impact patient care?
 Do you thrive on working with customers to solve their problems?
 Are you ready to grow your career in a collaborative and supportive team?
 Our team mate has been promoted so we are looking for a new Technical Specialist in Engineering to join our Molecular Diagnostics remote support team. Based within our state-of-the-art Regional Customer Support Centre (RCSC) in Burgess Hill, you will provide high-value engineering support to customers. By contributing to this vital team, you ensure that healthcare providers across the UK, Ireland, Nordics and the wider EMEA-LATAM region can seamlessly deliver the diagnostic results that patients rely on every day.
 The Job Details 
 The Position:
 Technical Specialist (Solution Support - Engineering) - Regional Customer Support Centre (Molecular Diagnostics)
 Location: Burgess Hill, Sussex (Hybrid: Minimum 2 days per week in office)
 Position Type: Full-time, Permanent
 Who You Are 
 You are a natural problem-solver who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. You are comfortable bridging the gap between tricky technical issues and what our customers actually need, acting as a helpful bridge for both internal teams and our customers. With a solid scientific, biomedical or engineering background, you are the sort of person who will thrive in our diverse, collaborative team. Above all, you are someone who works with integrity, not afraid to step up when challenges arise, and always committed to delivering high-quality results.
 What You’ll Do 
 As a Technical Specialist in Engineering, you will be the go-to person for our customers, offering the technical and scientific support they need to keep things running smoothly. You will handle enquiries and complaints from start to finish, diagnosing faults and finding the right solutions.
 Beyond daily support, you will also help train customers and staff, support new product launches, and use your technical expertise to help our sales team. Ultimately, you will play a big part in keeping our lab systems running at their best and ensuring our customers have a brilliant experience, wherever they are.
 Your core responsibilities will include: 
 Customer Support & Troubleshooting: Process and troubleshoot enquiries/complaints via phone or written channels, utilizing remote diagnostic tools. Handle complex complaints and maintain accurate documentation within the CRM system.
 Escalation Management: Identify product quality issues or complex failures that require escalation to 2nd Level Support or Technical Product Management (TPM) teams.
 Knowledge Transfer & Training: Perform training for Roche systems for staff and customers. Coordinate service-related topics during product launches.
 Sales &Technical Assistance: Assist the sales process through tender responses and customer meetings by leveraging your product and laboratory knowledge.
 On-site Expertise: Provide on-site troubleshooting for complex situations, assist with system installations, and configure installed systems as needed.
 Governance & Safety: Ensure compliance with IT security and data governance standards.
 Cross Functional RCSC Support: Provide assistance across RCSC support teams when needed. Develop T shaped skills and a solution support mindset.
 What You Bring 
 Experience: Qualified Engineer with a proven track record servicing high-value capital equipment. A specialized background or technical familiarity with Molecular Diagnostics workflows is advantageous.
 Education: Equivalent qualification to HNC/HND level or above in Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering is highly desirable.
 Language Skills : Fluent in English (written and verbal). Proficiency in a Nordic language at a business level is desirable but not required.
 Technical Aptitude: Strong troubleshooting experience, IT literacy, and an understanding of the Diagnostics industry. Knowledge of CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) is advantageous.
 Role Requirements: Ability to work in an office-based role with some flexibility. Readiness to provide out-of-hours telephone support if required.
 Attributes: 
 To thrive in our team your friends would describe your attributes as being analytical and sharp, with a real knack for getting to the bottom of problems. You are the person who stays calm when things get hectic, helping others keep their cool too. They would say you are a fantastic listener …

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Position: Technical Service Apprentice (Early in Career Program) 
 Location: Zagreb, Croatia 
 Duration: 2 Years (Structured Development Pathway) 
 Paid Working Time: Part-time (20 hours per week, flexible around university schedules) 
 About the Program: 
 Roche Adriatic has launched the Apprenticeship Program in Technical Service , a dedicated 2-year initiative designed to empower exceptional university students during their final years of study. This program bridges the gap between academic theory and real-world biomedical engineering, positioning you to become part of our permanent talent pool. 
 Your 2-Year Journey: 
 Year 1 (Foundations & Tooling): Deep dive into Roche standard onboarding (mQMS, SHE, biohazard safety). Get introduced to laboratory environments, shadow senior field service engineers across at least 5 full Preventive Maintenance Visits (PMV), and master logistics/spare parts management. 
 Year 2 (Advanced Specialization & Autonomy): Achieve official technical certification (e.g., cobas e411 system), log actions via ServiceMAX, utilize remote diagnostics via the ThingWorx Platform (RTP), and take complete charge of maintenance checks under expert mentorship. 
 Who You Are: 
 A student in their final years of study at a Croatian University (Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing - FER, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture - FSB, or similar technical/biomedical curriculum). 
 Eligible to work 20 hours per week via a valid Student Contract (Studentski Centar) . 
 Highly curious, technically-minded, and fluent in both Croatian and English. 
 What We Offer: 
 Structured, paid student engagement that respects your exam periods. 
 Direct 1-on-1 mentorship and official global industry certifications. 
 Talent Capture Pipeline: An evaluation at the end of Year 2 for conversion into full-time employment or a long-term contract role upon graduation (subject to headcount availability). 
 Please submit your CV in English.
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Regulatory Affairs Assistant 
 At Roche, we believe it is critical to deliver medical solutions now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are fearless in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world. 
 That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. 
 Purpose 
 As a Regulatory Affairs Assistant at Roche you will play a crucial role in supporting the Regulatory Affairs team in ensuring compliance with regulations and guidelines set by regulatory authorities. This role plays a significant part in helping Roche navigate a complex regulatory landscape and ensure that products meet all necessary regulatory standards. 
 Responsibilities 
 You will provide operational and administrative support to the Regulatory Team 
 You will get acquainted with Medical Devices, Law of Medical Devices and registered portfolio 
 You will update all Regulatory Records and systems 
 You will collect relevant registration request documentation and submit Requests in ALIMS application 
 You will process and communicate Regulatory Team notifications on newly issued MAs to stakeholders 
 You will process tender participation/customs Authorization requirements 
 Requirements & Qualifications 
 You are graduate of the Faculty of Pharmacy (preferred Master of Pharmacy - Medical Biochemist) 
 You have advanced knowledge of MC Office package 
 You have good knowledge of the English language 
 You are precise, accurate and you have a thorough approach to tasks and responsibilities 
 You are ready to be fully committed during the working week 
 You are ready to learn and collaborate with the team 
 You have good communication skills and high level of self-organization 
 Should you answer the above challenges and requirements with YES then this is the right position for you! 
 Who we are 
 At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. 
 We believe in the power of diversity and inclusion, and strive to identify and create opportunities that enable all people to bring their unique selves to Roche. 
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

items.desc:
Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies. 
 Rejoignez la révolution technologique du véhicule autonome et connecté au sein de Valeo ! 
 Leader mondial des aides à la conduite, Valeo réinvente la vie à bord du véhicule et révolutionne l’expérience de conduite. Des solutions de connectivité et de commande intérieure aux systèmes de détection, la Division Valeo Brain du Groupe vise à rendre la mobilité plus sûre et plus intuitive. 
 Le Site de Valeo basé à Nogent-le-Rotrou (28) est un Site de production. Il regroupe 340 collaborateurs autour de la fabrication de capteurs à ultrasons pour l’aide au stationnement automatique, et également d’appareils de chauffage et de climatisation (Division Valeo Power). 
 Pour accompagner l'industrialisation de nos nouvelles technologies, nous recrutons un(e) : Chargé(e) d'affaires industriel / Ingénieur(e) Méthodes industrialisation machines (H/F) — CDI 
 Vos missions 
 Au sein des équipes industrielles du site, vous pilotez des projets techniques liés à la transformation de lignes de production existantes et à l’intégration de nouveaux équipements automatisés (notamment sur les gammes de capteurs à ultrasons et d'affichages tête haute / HUD). 
 Piloter vos projets d'industrialisation du cadrage du besoin jusqu’à la mise en production, dans le respect des jalons clients, des coûts et des standards du Groupe (IProM, V5000). 
 Rédiger les cahiers des charges et coordonner les fournisseurs de machines spéciales automatisées (suivi technique, planning, budget, réception, installation et mise en service sur site). 
 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes (production, méthodes séries, qualité, maintenance, achats, logistique) et les équipes projets internationales (R&D et chefs de projets basés notamment en Allemagne). 
 Assurer les essais pré-série, la montée en cadence (Full Day Production Run, Safe Start Checklist) et la résolution des problèmes techniques sur le terrain. 
 Veiller au respect des exigences de sécurité machines, des normes HSE, de la démarche VPS (Valeo Production System) et des dossiers qualité (P-FMEA, plans de contrôle, SPPC). 
 Déplacements ponctuels chez nos fournisseurs et sites partenaires (France et international) 
 À propos de vous : 
 Formation supérieure Bac+5 en ingénierie (Génie Industriel, Méthodes, Mécanique ou Automatisme). Vous justifiez d'une expérience minimale d'une dizaine d'années en industrialisation, méthodes process, gestion de projets industriels ou intégration d'équipements automatisés. 
 Bonne compréhension des machines spéciales automatisées et des enjeux de sécurité machines. Une curiosité technique élevée vous permet d'analyser la logique des programmes automatisés, de diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements et d'échanger efficacement avec les experts (automaticiens, roboticiens, fournisseurs). 
 Une expérience dans l’industrie automobile est un atout. Les profils issus d’autres secteurs industriels soumis à des exigences élevées en matière de cadence, de qualité et de maîtrise des coûts sont également considérés. 
 Autonomie, pragmatisme, réactivité et agilité pour évoluer dans un environnement industriel dynamique. 
 Anglais professionnel/courant indispensable pour les échanges internationaux (Allemagne, Chine). 
 Nos avantages : 
 Plan d’actionnariat, Action Logement 
 Présence d’un comité social & économique (CSE) 
 Restaurant d’entreprise 
 Pourquoi Valeo ? 
 Pour rejoindre un leader technologique et industriel, pionnier français dans l’innovation automobile 
 Pour une carrière dynamique avec des possibilités de mobilité nationale ou internationale, adaptée à vos aspirations 
 Pour contribuer au développement d’une mobilité plus propre, plus sûre et plus intelligente 
 Valeo accorde une grande importance à la diversité, qu’elle soit culturelle, intergénérationnelle, de genre ou qu’elle concerne les personnes en situation de handicap.

Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies. 
 We are an automotive supplier, partner to all automakers worldwide. As a technology company, Valeo proposes innovative products and systems that contribute to the reduction of CO2 emissions and to the development of intuitive driving. Since 2013 we have been developing in our Prague R&D Center advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) for smarter cars. Valeo is a leading supplier of components and systems for the world's automakers. In our R&D (Research & Development) Center in Prague we develop Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) for intelligent cars. 
 We are looking for a Cybersecurity & Data Privacy Analyst to join our R&D Center in Prague and support our global projects in ensuring strong cybersecurity, data privacy, and compliance standards. 
 YOUR CHALLENGES? 
 Cybersecurity Activities 
 Cybersecurity risk analysis 
 Project cybersecurity advice and control 
 Audits, governance, and compliance activities 
 Data Privacy Activities 
 Drafting data privacy documentation, including contracts, and managing related databases 
 Providing data privacy support to internal teams globally 
 Communicating with project teams worldwide to obtain the required inputs and information 
 Regularly reviewing and updating existing project data privacy documentation 
 Contributing to streamlining internal processes and establishing new standards 
 LET'S TALK ABOUT YOU... 
 Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Computer Science and/or Cybersecurity 
 At least 3 years of relevant experience in Cybersecurity 
 Experience reviewing completed self-assessments and validating technical evidence (e.g., policies, network diagrams, pentest reports) submitted by suppliers. 
 Network & Systems Architecture: Hands-on experience with network design (firewalls, VLANs) and server environments (Windows/Linux) to accurately evaluate a supplier's infrastructure and perimeter defenses. 
 Vulnerability & Security Operations: Practical knowledge of security tools (EDR, SIEM) to effectively interpret penetration test reports and vulnerability scans submitted as evidence. 
 Identity & Data Protection: Technical expertise in Access Management (Active Directory, MFA) and encryption. 
 WE OFFER: 
 Work in a stable international company in a multinational team 
 Work with cutting-edge technologies in Automotive 
 Possibility to see the whole development process in one place - from an idea (customer requirement) to a product (e.g. automated parking ECU)

 Flexible working hours and home office possibility

 Meal vouchers and free time vouchers on Flexi Pass card 
 Possibility of Multisport card 
 Fitness room and external sports ground (football, basketball, volleyball) on site 
 Mobility support for commuting, accommodation and moving services if you live over 20km away 
 Company canteen offering a selection of international cuisine 
 Easy access to work by Prague metro line A, car parking for all employees 
 Personal development program through technical trainings and language courses

items.card: Job Description: In order to support the Component Loads Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a High-Lift Component Loads Engineer (d/f/m) We are calculating and analysing the relevant external high-lift static, fatigue and dynamic loads for all major Airbus aircraft programmes, from preliminary design through to certification. You will be working at the interface between the engineering domains of Flight
items.desc:
Job Description: 
 In order to support the Component Loads Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a 
 High-Lift Component Loads Engineer (d/f/m) 
 We are calculating and analysing the relevant external high-lift static, fatigue and dynamic loads for all major Airbus aircraft programmes, from preliminary design through to certification. You will be working at the interface between the engineering domains of Flight Physics and Airframe, which is an excellent opportunity to discover and contribute to the integrated wing aero/loads/stress/design process. 
 In addition, we are working on many Research and Technology projects for future aircraft programmes and are engaged in creating and defining the tools and processes of tomorrow. A key focus of our team is the parallel development of our analysis capabilities and the bespoke engineering tools required to perform these calculations efficiently. 
 We value our trustful and transparent working environment based on mutual respect and inclusivity. We value autonomy but recognise that success is never achieved in isolation. We take wellbeing seriously, safety first starts with us. We want you to grow and develop, in this role and for the future; you can expect our support in making this happen. 
 Your location 
 Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 To provide support on all commercial programmes. 
 Calculate, interpret and deliver external static and fatigue loads acting on the high-lift devices in adherence with the relevant airworthiness regulations, quality processes and programme assumptions. 
 Support the airframe design (wing & high-lift) and high-lift systems teams in their use of this data. 
 Support flight test campaigns to validate load calculations. 
 Contribute to continuously improving our analysis capabilities. 
 Managing & interacting with local and trans-national project stakeholders: project managers, specialists, airframe customers, suppliers, etc. 
 Support airlines through Airbus Customer Services by carrying out Loads & Aeroelastics (L&A) analyses of in-service events. Contribute to Loads In-Service Support with trouble shooting activities in the L&A design office context for development and production flight test and in-service aircraft, perform related L&A assessments. 
 Engage for timely response to engineering queries as on-call engineer for Loads In-Service Support. 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 University degree in Aeronautical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering. 
 You share our values in working in an environment favouring transparency, diversity and collective success. 
 A good understanding of flight physics. 
 Knowledge in Static/Fatigue/Systems analysis would be an advantage as would Dynamic analysis. 
 Basic knowledge of python and version control (i.e. Git) 
 A team working mindset, combined with interpersonal and communication skills 
 Willingness to learn and share knowledge with your colleagues. 
 The ability to develop effective customer relationships. 
 Basic project management experience. 
 Fluent in English. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung sucht Airbus einen 
 Entwicklungsingenieur Statik/Festigkeit Composite - Design Task Responsible (d/m/w) 
 Bist du bereit, die nächste Ära der Flugzeugstruktur Entwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten? 
 Dann werde Teil unseres Engineering-Berechnungsteams in Hamburg! 
 Als Teil der Airframe Analysis sind wir ein hochmotiviertes Stress-Team. 
 Wir verantworten die gesamte Strukturanalyse für den Flugzeugrumpf über alle Phasen hinweg – vom Konzept über die Zulassung und den Produktionsstart bis hin zur finalen Serienproduktion. Bei uns verbindest du klassisches Engineering mit neuen Methoden der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung. 
 Dein Standort 
 Du arbeitest in der größten Produktionsstätte für zivile Flugzeuge in Hamburg. Durch die Lage am südlichen Elbufer besteht die Möglichkeit, mit der Fähre zu pendeln. Erleben Sie in Ihrer Freizeit das besondere Flair Hamburgs, wo pulsierende Weltstadt Kultur auf nautisches Erbe trifft. 
 Unsere Benefits für dich 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. 
 Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) 
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten 
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird 
 Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Prüfung & Freigabe: Du prüfst und genehmigst Berechnungsunterlagen gemäß den etablierten Prozessen, Methoden und Richtlinien von Airbus. 
 Zertifizierung & Zulassung: Du erstellst und validierst die technischen Nachweisdokumente, um die Zulassung von Flugzeugen und Modifikationen (MODs) sicherzustellen. 
 Fachliche Führung & Schnittstelle: Du treibst technische Innovationen voran, erarbeitest optimierte Engineering-Lösungen und stimmst dich eng mit dem Design, der Fertigung und allen relevanten Stakeholdern ab 
 Experten-Netzwerk: Du interagierst souverän auf Augenhöhe mit hochrangigen technischen Experten, wie Chief Skill Engineers, Technical Authorities und Chief Engineers. 
 Machbarkeitsstudien: Du führst interdisziplinäre Trade-Studies durch, um die optimale Balance zwischen struktureller Performance und effizienter Herstellbarkeit zu finden. 
 Digitalisierung aktiv mitgestalten: Du treibst die Prozessverbesserung, Automatisierung und die digitale Transformation unserer Tools und Workflows aktiv voran. 
 Teamspirit: Du förderst eine offene, kollaborative Arbeitsweise im Team und unterstützt deine Kollegen durch fachlichen Austausch und gegenseitige Hilfestellung. 
 Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen 
 Als Berechnungsingenieur bringst du ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor/Master), z.B. im Bereich Maschinenbau, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Bauingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung mit Schwerpunkt Berechnung/Strukturanalyse, mit 
 Du verfügst über fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Strukturanalyse und Auslegung von Faserverbundstrukturen (CFK/Composite) – Statik, gerne auch im Bereich Ermüdung und Schadenstoleranz (F&Dt) 
 Ebenso verfügst du über ein ganzheitliches Systemverständnis: Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Festigkeitsbewertung von Strukturkomponenten, die sowohl hinsichtlich des Gewichts als auch der Fertigungsprozesse optimiert sind 
 Know-how in Materials & Processes für CFK/Composite sowie fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit globaler und detaillierter Finiten-Elemente-Methode (Global/Detailed FEM) 
 Vertrauter Umgang mit gängigen Stress-Methoden, Lufttüchtigkeitsforderungen ( Airworthiness Requirements ), Nachweisverfahren ( Means of Compliance ) und Zertifizierungsgrundlagen der Luftfahrt 
 Routinierter Umgang mit den etablierten Berechnungs-Tools der Luftfahrtindustrie, insbesondere ISAMI und HyperWorks sowie Programmierkenntnisse (z.B. Python) sind wünschenswert 
 Du zeichnest dich durch eine strukturierte, zielorientierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise aus 
 Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse. Gute Deutsch-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil
