 Are you looking for the ideal start to your career with an exciting, global company? Are you passionate about engineering and love understanding how things work? Are you interested in developing solutions for the future environmentally sustainable aircraft? If so, joining Landing Gear within the Airbus Internship Programme could be the ideal start to your career. 
 Landing Gear Engineering is part of the wider Systems Centre of Competence (CoC), providing Airbus Commercial with excellence in Landing Gear definition, integration, industrialisation and in-service support. A complex area of aerospace engineering, Landing Gear engineering comprises control systems, mechanical systems & structures, integrated into the overall aircraft design for the key functions of take off, landing and taxiing.
 A significant proportion of Landing Gear activities are focused on aircraft programmes including A350XWB, A320 family, A330 family and A380 aircraft, but there is also significant focus on Research & Technology (R&T) for future aircraft development, as a result work activities are varied and interesting. We are embracing the data revolution, and bringing digital technology and data science to the forefront of what we do in each of our technical disciplines.
 We collaborate with other business functions to deliver on programmes and maintain technical excellence for Landing Gear topics:
 Landing systems definition and vendor management for new programmes, incremental developments and to support continuous product development.
 Proactive product support for industrialisation, production and in-service.
 Execution of product, technology and innovation strategies to deliver Landing Gear related Research and Technology (R&T) for future and current Airbus products.
 What you will be doing: 
 You will be given the opportunity to work with experienced teams across the Airbus aircraft family, from new development through to in-service aircraft, as well potentially working alongside suppliers, customers and manufacturing assembly. You are expected to contribute to the creation of optimum solutions for the landing gear product, to own projects where possible and to support on-going activities. You will also join our early careers community who support your professional development and to help integrate into life in the vibrant city of Bristol.
 As an Airbus Intern in a Landing Gear role, you may find yourself :
 Consulting with experts during the validation and verification of systems design by defining requirements both at system and equipment level prior to the testing phase, which is completed through the use of models, simulations and test rigs.
 Developing relationships with in-service and production teams to investigate and evaluate the stress experienced by a damaged component or providing feedback to the Final Assembly Line, enabling efficiency improvements.
 Building collective knowledge in the team, problem solving, reporting your findings, presenting progress and results to stakeholders, enabling teamwork across functions and sites.
 We look to tailor the work you will be involved in based on your previous experience, interests and development needs to maximise the value you can add to the business.

 About us: 
 Join the Operations and Failure Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) team within the Functional Avionics group in Stevenage. Our team is responsible for looking over the Spacecraft operation in all nominal and contingency situations, from launch until end of life.
 We answer critical questions like: How do we power on the spacecraft? How do we communicate with it? How do we detect a malfunction and what actions should we take if something breaks?
 To achieve this, we collaborate with a wide range of disciplines to gain a complete understanding of the satellite. Specifically, we work with other Functional Engineering teams, including Software, to define telecommands and data parameters; Functional Verification, to test our Flight Operation Procedures; and Database, to implement and tune FDIR parameters.
 What you will be doing: 
 This role is a great opportunity to learn all about how the spacecraft works, since you’ll be collaborating with all of the other subsystem architects to make sure it does! 
 Your objective is to make sure the satellite operates in all nominal and failure situations. 
 We work on a range of missions, from telecoms missions such as OneSat Payload to Earth Observation, Science and Exploration missions such as Vigil and ExoMars Rover.
 In the early design phase you might be helping to define the initial operational and FDIR concept including mission scenario, operational constraints, recovery levels and actions etc. On an implementation-phase project you might be going into the detail of the FDIR monitors, or working on the interfaces with software, or writing and testing Flight Operations Procedures (basically, instructions for the operator).
 In any case you’ll gain great exposure to satellite design and the opportunity to exchange with and learn from a host of passionate engineers.

You will bridge the gap between daily operations and long-term strategic evolution, managing initiatives that directly enable production, drive safety culture, and optimise our industrial systems to meet critical ramp-up targets.

 Risk & Safety Management: Treating safety as a core project constraint by conducting risk assessments, leading incident investigations, and implementing corrective action plans to champion our zero-accident culture;

Job Description: 
 Are you eager to pioneer cutting-edge simulation technologies for the future of sustainable aviation? 
 In order to support the intersection of Aerospace Engineering and Software Development , Airbus is looking for a 
 Software Development Engineer for Flight Physics Capabilities / Loads & Aeroelastics 
 (d/f/m) 
 About Us & Locations 
 The Flight Physics domain is at the core of aircraft architecture and system integration. Within our team, we develop, maintain, and advance our internal in-house simulation software for aircraft loads & aeroelastics . 
 You will ideally be working in Hamburg , the largest production site for civil aircraft. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe offers unique perks, such as the option to commute by ferry, allowing you to experience the special flair of Hamburg where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets maritime legacy. 
 As our team operates across international engineering hubs, Bremen (Germany) and Filton (UK) are also possible locations for this role. Across all sites, close collaboration and team spirit are central to how we work, which is why regular on-site presence at your chosen location is required. 
 Your Mission 
 You will be a key developer for our internal loads simulation software. In this role, you will bridge the gap between flight physics domain knowledge and software engineering. You will participate in all phases of the software lifecycle—from defining simulation requirements and architectural design to implementation, automated testing, and deployment. Your code will directly enable engineering teams across Airbus to calculate and evaluate aircraft loads accurately and efficiently. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 In-House Simulation Tool Development: Design, code, test, deploy, and continuously enhance our internal simulation software dedicated to aircraft loads and aeroelastics. 
 Algorithm & Architecture Design: Implement advanced numerical methods and physical models into clean, high-performance, and modular code. 
 Requirements Translation: Collaborate closely with Flight Physics loads engineers to translate complex aerodynamic and structural load requirements into efficient software algorithms.

We are responsible for ensuring smooth operations and delivery, which plays a major part in the success of the OneSat programme and our space business.
 Our Industrial Management team is at the heart of Programme Management, with members working on every aspect of the industrial process—supply chain, operations, stock, logistics, and scheduling. Solving issues and anticipating them are key parts of the team's day-to-day activities.

 Tracking of equipment delivery to programme (internal and external) in line with production schedule requirements;

 Analytics & Performance Steering: Collect, streamline, and analyze critical financial, operational, and technical data. Actively monitor leading KPIs on business health and initiate corrective measures. Transform historical data into forward-looking trends to enable timely, informed decision-making.

 Change Agent: Brings fresh ideas, challenges the status quo, and suggests highly efficient, scalable workflows rather than settling for the status-quo

 Resilience & Decision-Making: Strong business acumen, maturity, and self-confidence. Ability to juggle multiple topics simultaneously and make firm, data-driven decisions. 
 A diplomatic and strategic mindset.

Job Description: 
 AIRBUS Commercial Aircraft recherche un Technicien de maintenance Avion / GTE* expérimenté (all genders) appelé aussi Point Fixeur. Ce sont des Techniciens Essais et Qualité Avion Vivant h/f au sein des équipes Qualité en pistes FLIGHT LINE WB A350 en France prés de Toulouse. 
 (*GTE= Ground Test Engineer ) 
 A ce poste, le collaborateur est le responsable technique et sécurité de l'avion pendant la phase opérationnelle avant vol. Vous êtes responsable de l'intégrité de l'ensemble de l'aéronef lors des tests opérationnels avant la phase de livraison. Vous êtes aussi en charge de la sécurité des personnes et de l’aéronef lors des tests opérationnels et des interventions avions (retouche, dépannage, intervention…). 
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Ces postes sont majoritairement des postes en extérieur. Vous interviendrez au sein d'une équipe multifonctionnelle où les différents métiers d'un groupe de production sont représentés: production, compagnons et team leaders, les support techniques, les support logistiques. Vous collaborez aussi avec le bureau d'étude, les bureaux de préparation, les équipes des essais en vol, les services attestation / conformité. 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! Les postes seront basés à St Martin ou Colomiers, en périphérie immédiate de Toulouse et sont desservis par des transports en commun, navettes entreprise, pistes cyclables. 
 Vos challenges 
 ◻Vous serez un Technicien Essais et Qualité (h/f) chargé d'exécuter et d'attester la réalisation des essais au sol “PATM” (*Production Aircraft Test Manual) avant les premiers vols ( et ceci sous délégation du département des essais en vols "Production Flight Tests") : 
 Essais statiques, 
 Déstockage de l'Auxiliaire Power Unit (APU) 
 1er démarrage moteurs 
 Essais Frein, Direction 
 Essais fonctionnels moteurs, 
 Essais de roulage à basse vitesse, 
 Préparation de l'environnement avion pour réaliser les essais au sol

 Our world is changing. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight (#ZEROe) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the heart of our purpose.
 Join our Wing Analysis Engineering Team 
 By applying to this job advert, we will consider your skills for all relevant positions. If selected, we will determine the most suitable position that fits your skills and experience during the interview stage. 
 Located alongside the Broughton Wing assembly lines, you will have the fantastic opportunity to see the physical product every day. You will join a team of technical specialists passionate about finding solutions for the main wingbox, leading edge, and control surfaces across the A400M and civil programs, including Single Aisle, Long Range, and the A350.
 Nightshift hours of work are Monday - Thursday 20:45 - 06:00. 
 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM 
 Perform, approve, or authorise static structural deliverables, ensuring solutions meet rigorous safety and certification standards.
 Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve engineering challenges and introduce disruptive changes to support manufacturing quality and efficiency.
 Define and manage technical project scopes, providing guidance to engineers and suppliers while acting as a liaison for Technical Authorities.
 Influence and innovate the future of aerospace by collaborating across teams to integrate automated workflows and optimisation tools into the development lifecycle, leading or supporting initiatives appropriate to your level of experience.
 Drive the professional growth of the team and shape the next generation of engineers by fostering both technical expertise and leadership behaviours.
 ABOUT YOU 
 Hold a degree in Engineering with a Structural Analysis background.
 Proficient in Static analysis processes, methods, and toolsets (such as ISAMI, GISEH, and Finite Element Analysis).
 Understanding of aircraft structural layouts, loading, and the mechanics of materials.
 Requirements on Delegated Technical signatories, when applicable to the position: Lead Static Stress Engineers: Industry recognised Stress Approval (Check) Signatory or the capability to achieve this within a short timeframe. 
 Ability to collaborate and influence within a dynamic team to drive decisions; As a Lead and Senior Engineer you should be able to collaborate with stakeholders and influence decisions within a complex network at a strategic level.
 Interest in developing digital solutions associated with engineering activities; Python proficiency is advantageous
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customised development solutions.
 HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOU 
 Many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you need and we will always do our best to accommodate your request.
 Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments for the selection process - you can share this with your Talent Acquisition Partner if you are invited to interview. Job Description: 
 Innovative contracting position 
 We are looking for a contracts officer to join our Contracts, Legal and Compliance team. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in contract management, work alongside seasoned professionals,learn from industry experts, and make a real difference enabling space exploration by bringing fresh energy to our department. 
 The job: 
 You will collaborate with engineers, experts and other stakeholders to ensure contract requirements in your projects are met. If issues with a commercial or legal element arise, you advise and solve it. 
 You design the contractual set-up and negotiate contract solutions fit to the project concerned. 
 In the Commercial Contracts and Legal department, you ensure we stay current with industry trends, regulations and best practices in contract management. 
 For smaller bids, you coordinate proposals within the given proposal budget and schedule. 
 What it takes: 
 You are enthusiastic about the space industry, bring fresh energy and are willing to take on new challenges. 
 You are not afraid to challenge the status quo, but you do so with tact and political sensitivity. You can hold your own with experienced colleagues and enjoy bringing new ideas to the table in a constructive way. 
 You have a common-sense mindset, resulting in business savvy, creative solutions. 
 You have around one to five years of relevant experience, a very strong drive to learn more. and are looking for a long-term role where you can plant roots and grow with our team. 
 You have a Bsc or MSc degree in Law, Business Management or another related discipline.

 A chance to collaborate with an experienced team with focus on innovative contract solutions and identification of regulatory opportunities for our business

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Mission & Scope 
 Airbus Aerostructures treibt seine digitale Transformation voran. Wir suchen einen proaktiven SAP Specialist mit starker Projektleiter-Mentalität. Sie schlagen die Brücke zwischen Architektur Konzepten und praktischer Umsetzung, stellen die unterbrechungsfreie Betriebskontinuität unserer Altsysteme sicher und treiben gleichzeitig die operative Einsatzbereitschaft für unsere S/4HANA Cloud-Transformation voran.
 Geltungsbereich (Scope): Core ERP, EWM, GTS, Technische Lösungen, S/4HANA Cloud und SAP BTP.
 Tätigkeiten: 
 Technische Führung & Betrieb (On-Premise und Cloud): Sie agieren als primärer technischer Fachexperte (SME) und leiten die tiefe Systemadministration, SAP HANA-Datenbankoptimierung, Trace-Analysen sowie die Orchestrierung zentraler Infrastrukturen (Cloud Connector, Web Dispatcher, STMS/ChaRM, SSO) in hybriden Umgebungen.
 Erweiterter S/4HANA-Betrieb & Migrationen: Sie leiten technische S/4HANA-Konvertierung Aktivitäten (einschließlich fortgeschrittener SUM/DMO-Operationen) und veranlassen S/4HANA Cloud-Testumgebungen, System-Refreshes sowie die Bereitstellung von Zielumgebungen.
 Lifecycle-Management, Monitoring & Automatisierung: Sie steuern Systemerweiterungen und Release-Zyklen, verwalten Hochverfügbarkeits- und Disaster-Recovery-Setups, implementieren integrierte Monitoring-Frameworks (SAP Cloud ALM / BTP) und entwickeln Infrastructure-as-Code-Workflows zur Automatisierung manueller BASIS-Routinen.
 Sicherheit, Compliance & Audit-Integrität: Sie setzen Systemwartungs-Protokolle, Patch-Orchestrierung und SSL/TLS-Zertifikat Verwaltungen durch. items.desc:
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team is one of the most exciting examples of Apple’s long-held passion for combining art and technology. These are the people who power the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, and Apple Books. And they do it on a massive scale, meeting Apple’s high expectations with high performance to deliver a huge variety of entertainment in over 35 languages to more than 150 countries. These engineers build secure, end-to-end solutions. They develop the custom software used to process all the creative work, the tools that providers use to deliver that media, all the server-side systems, and the APIs for many Apple services.
Thanks to Apple’s unique integration of hardware, software, and services, engineers here partner to get behind a single unified vision. That vision always includes a deep commitment to strengthening Apple’s privacy policy, one of Apple’s core values. Although services are a bigger part of Apple’s business than ever before, these teams remain small, forward-thinking, and cross-functional, offering greater exposure to the array of opportunities here.
Apple Services Engineering infrastructure is BIG. Operating at our scale, across multiple geographically dispersed data centers and servicing hundreds of millions of users presents unique challenges. As an SRE at Apple, you'll need to solve these problems using data, teamwork, and your own expertise. SREs at Apple own the full infrastructure stack; from device driver performance debugging to content delivery network traffic management — our responsibilities are both broad and deep.
ASE runs the majority of its systems on Linux. We run a mix of open source, vendor licensed, and internally developed tools to perform functions such as system configuration management, provisioning, software deployment, logging, and monitoring. You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. Our team is collaborative; we work closely with the development teams we support to deliver the best results for Apple. We think critically and strive to balance the best solution with the need to get things done for each engineering challenge we face. Good ideas are heard and results are rewarded. Culturally we believe in a close partnership with our development teams and aim to design & build new services together. We're passionate about software and automation in SRE and develop a variety of tooling and infrastructure. Our services run on mixed & hybrid platforms.
Advanced experience with programming languages (Go, Python, Ruby, Bash) and a passion for designing and building reliable systems
Strong sense of ownership and integrity demonstrated through clear communication and collaboration with a deep systems and infrastructure knowledge
Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience with source code and artifact management systems, CI/CD infrastructure (GitHub, Artifactory, Jenkins)
Automation advocate - you truly believe in removing operation load with software
Understanding of the Linux operating system, standard networking protocols, and components
Experience in managing and scaling distributed systems in a public, private, or hybrid cloud environment
Hands-on experience managing large numbers of diverse systems with configuration management or software delivery platforms (Puppet, Ansible)
Experience with deploying, supporting and monitoring new and existing services, platforms, and application stacks (Grafana, Splunk)
Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills, both with and without AI assistance

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As Systems Engineer, Land, you own systems engineering for one of Helsing's land programmes , with a focus on software-intensive systems. You cover the full V-cycle, from requirements and architecture to integration, verification, validation and release. You work daily with software architects, AI engineers and hardware developers to keep the system coherent. You work directly with French industry partners, the DGA and land forces to turn their needs into systems for tomorrow's battlefields. You run system-level tests, trace failures to root causes and shorten design iterations. You are accountable for delivering all systems engineering activities on time, to quality and within budget. 
 The day-to-day 
 Own the V-cycle for your land programme, from requirements capture to release, and deliver every systems engineering activity on time, to quality and within budget 
 Design the system architecture and manage interfaces with software architects, AI engineers and hardware developers, so the integrated system stays coherent 
 Plan and run system-level tests, analyse test data and find the root causes of failures to cut design iteration time 
 Represent engineering in technical exchange meetings, milestone reviews and demonstrations with land forces, DGA and industry partners 
 Produce requirements traceability matrices, verification evidence and RAMS analysis (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety) that support qualification, certification and operational release 
 You should apply if you 
 Have delivered an integrated software and hardware product end to end to a defence, B2G or B2B customer, and worked directly with that customer's stakeholders and end users 
 Have applied the full V-cycle (requirements, architecture, design, integration, verification, validation, release) to software-intensive systems, including system-level tests and root-cause analysis that shortened design iteration cycles 
 Have worked with software architects, AI engineers and hardware developers to keep interfaces and requirements consistent across disciplines 
 Are fluent in both French and English 
 Are ready to meet the requirements for a French security clearance (habilitation) under national law 
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 Have worked with DGA or land forces to shape requirements, or applied Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and SysML 
 Have used Python, Palantir or similar data tools, and AI tools, to speed up test data review, requirements analysis and documentation 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy …

items.title: Data Center Hardware Engineer
items.card: You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters. Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure. You'll
items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE MISSION

You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters.

Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure.

You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (H100/H200-class and next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond.

Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end.

Location: On-site at one of our data center in Bessé-sur-Braye, Pays de la Loire.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs, and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand).

 - Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas.

 - Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on.

 - Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors.

 - Help us get better — feed recurring anomalies into monitoring, alerts and SOPs; contribute small scripts (Python/Bash) if you have those skills.

 - Be a good teammate — clear status updates, honest handovers, and respect for the people depending on the cluster.




ABOUT YOU

 - Hands-on comfort in data centers or server hardware — you can (or will quickly learn to) work cleanly in racks: rails, cabling, labeling, mounting.

 - Disciplined and meticulous: checklists aren't bureaucracy to you, they're craftsmanship.

 - Practical electrical basics: power-off procedures, PPE, short-circuit risk awareness.

 - Basic Linux (boot checks, logs) — scripting is a plus, not a requirement.

 - Physically able to work in racks (lift, mount, maneuver) in a data center environment.

 - Comfortable in a 24/7 operation, including a rotating on-call with emergency response expectations.

 - Driver's licence (B) for travel between our sites.




EVEN IF YOU DON'T MATCH EVERY CRITERION

Many of our best hardware engineers came from research labs, telecoms, IT services or the military. If you are rigorous, curious and genuinely motivated by hardware at scale, we would be glad to hear from you — we assess demonstrated scope rather than keyword matching.




NICE TO HAVE

 - HPC/AI/cloud production experience at scale; large-fleet server install and maintenance.

 - Networking fundamentals (Ethernet/InfiniBand) beyond basics.

 - Vendor/RMA tooling, ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory systems.

 - Python/Bash automation for checks, capture, inventory or reporting.

 




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries.
 
In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features that span both product and business teams. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
 
At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

Develop data-driven strategies to support the growth of Spotify’s active users and subscribers 
 Create and communicate impactful findings and recommendations that improve the Premium product
 Model and forecast the impact of new business initiatives
 Work closely with business partners to understand the changes they are driving and help them discover new opportunities for growth
 Analyze experiments (A/B tests; quasi-experiments) to measure the impact of new features and go-to-market initiatives
 Present your findings to senior leaders, influencing the course of our business
Who You Are:
You have 5+ years of professional experience in data science or analytics, ideally at a consumer tech company or top-tier consulting firm.
 You are fluent in SQL and Python or R, and have a strong grasp of statistical methods and causal inference. Direct experience with product analytics or experimentation is a plus.
 You enjoy partnering with a range of cross-functional stakeholders and working on varied projects involving different products and problem spaces.
 You have a strategic mindset and an eye for cleanly extracting the “so what” from complex, technical analyses.
 You are an excellent communicator adept at presenting to senior leadership and audiences of varying levels of technical knowledge.
 You are comfortable working through ambiguous, complex problems and don’t get discouraged when the path forward isn’t immediately clear.
 You hold at least a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Where You'll Be:
This role is based in London
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

items.desc:
We are offering a position in the Physics Software Engineering section of the Computing for Experiments group in the CERN IT department (IT-CE-PSE) on Performance Software Engineering in the realm of high energy physics data simulation.
 The work on this post will be carried out in the context of the NextGen project, a collaboration between the LHC experiments and the CERN Research and Computing Departments. NextGen explores the use and impact of high-performance computing architectures in data simulation and data processing for the LHC experiments with a focus on the upcoming High Luminosity (HL-LHC) data taking phase at the CERN Large Hadron Collider.
 The simulation of particle collisions is one of the main consumers of computing resources for LHC experiments. Given the expected increase in the required statistics, accuracy and complexity for future simulation, and to stay within the forecasted computing budget, the throughput of simulation software packages needs to increase substantially.
 The successful candidate will join a team of software engineers and physicists that addresses this challenge. Together, you will speed up software packages for Monte Carlo (MC) event generation with a focus on the Madgraph event generator suite. Current and future tasks tackled by the team are at the intersection of theoretical/computational physics and computer science. In order to profit from the latest computing hardware, adaptations or re-engineering of software in aspects such as data structures, parallelisation of the workflow or task scheduling are needed. This work is guided by the requirements of experimental analyses and takes into account the latest developments in theoretical predictions.
 In case of interest, training on data science, programming languages, software engineering concepts and computing architectures is available and can be provided via various training programs.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Analyse and profile existing simulation code bases and develop strategies for improving their throughput.
 Implement latest software engineering concepts, leveraging on compute accelerators such as GPUs, modern CPU architectures and heterogeneous compute platforms.
 Interact and collaborate with experts in the theory, experimental physics and software engineering communities at CERN and world-wide.
 Supervise students on software development tasks and projects.
 Your profile: 
 Preferably a PhD in Theoretical or Particle Physics or Master's Degree with equivalent work experience with a strong background in numerical simulation.
 Proficiency in working with computing hardware accelerators and modern computing architectures, including heterogeneous compute platforms.
 A proven track record in performance software engineering for simulation applications in C++ and GPU programming languages such as CUDA or HIP.
 Knowledge of state of the art profiling tools for heterogeneous computing architectures.
 Experience with the Madgraph event generator software as a developer or user is highly valued.
 Skills: 
 Proficiency in modern C++ (up to C++23), GPU programming with CUDA and HIP, and Python for scripting, analysis and tooling is essential.
 Knowledge of hard scattering processes and the perturbative order of their matrix element calculations in Monte Carlo event generators is strongly desirable.
 Familiarity with Fortran is an advantage.
 Fluent in English.
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You have a professional background in Theoretical or Particle Physics (or a related field) and have either: a Master's Degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

The role covers requirements analysis, configuration, implementation, validation and integration of Ericsson NFVI and Cloud Native Infrastructure (CNIS), including deployments, upgrades, migrations, expansions and related network/application functions.

 Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment, integration and acceptance phases.
 Coordinate with project stakeholders and cross-functional teams to integrate VNFs/CNFs, OSS/BSS and orchestration components.

 Experience with CNFs/VNFs and understanding of telecom network architectures.
 Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work in cross-functional, multi-country teams.
 Proactive mindset, able to manage complex tasks independently and improve tools, automation and delivery practices.
 Preferred technologies and vendors include: 
 Ericsson NFVI/CNIS, Kubernetes and OpenStack platforms.

items.card: Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société. En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui. Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115
items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 La mise en boîtier des puces électroniques constitue un levier majeur de différenciation et de création de valeur pour le portefeuille de produits de ST. Cette activité est au cœur de la stratégie d’innovation du Groupe.
 L’ Ingénieur Support R&D Développement Boîtier s’intègre à l’organisation centrale Développement Boîtier R&D de ST, basée à Grenoble et composée de plus de 100 collaborateurs . En tant que support des Technical Package Leaders (chefs de projets techniques), vous contribuerez localement aux activités de développement de boîtiers microélectroniques, jusqu’à l’industrialisation de nouveaux produits à la pointe de la technologie.
 Basé(e) sur le site de ST Malte , dédié aux boîtiers avancés et à des clients stratégiques, vous jouerez un rôle clé d’interface entre les équipes R&D de Grenoble et le site de production .
 Vous êtes motivé(e) par les défis techniques, le travail en équipe et évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement international en anglais.
 Vos principales mission seront de :
 Contribuer au suivi technique des développements de boîtiers en lien avec les équipes R&D, industrialisation et production ;
 Appuyer les Technical Package Leaders dans la coordination et le pilotage des activités techniques liées aux projets ;
 Participer au développement et à l’amélioration de nouveaux procédés d’assemblage , en support aux activités de conception et d’industrialisation ;
 Contribuer à l’évolution de l’architecture boîtier , en analysant les contraintes techniques et en participant à la recherche de solutions innovantes ;
 Participer à la préparation, à la mise à jour et au suivi de la documentation technique projet ;
 Définir et suivre les actions techniques , identifier les points de blocage et contribuer à leur résolution ;
 Analyser les besoins techniques et les données disponibles afin de proposer des solutions pertinentes et d’alimenter les retours d’expérience ;
 Participer aux échanges avec les interlocuteurs internes et, si nécessaire, avec les partenaires externes ;
 Soutenir les activités de validation et de qualification des solutions de packaging ;
 Intervenir régulièrement en salle blanche et en laboratoire afin d’observer, comprendre et analyser les problématiques techniques sur le terrain ;
 Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des règles de fabrication et au support technique du site de production.
 Les boîtiers couverts : BGA / SiP / FCBGA / FCCSP / LGA / WIRE BOND …. pour des applications du type :
 Automobile (MCU, ADAS, Radar…), Spatial , Communication , AI , Centre de donnée, Microcontrôleurs ..
 Digital , Analogique, Mixtes, Haute Fréquences 
 Vous serez accompagné.e tout au long de votre VIE par un plan de montée en compétence et de formation.
 Ce que ce VIE vous apportera 
 Une expérience internationale au sein d’un environnement industriel de premier plan.
 Une exposition directe à des projets R&D techniques à forte valeur ajoutée.
 Une collaboration avec des experts du développement boîtiers et des équipes multi-sites.
 Une opportunité de développer une vision globale du cycle de vie d’un produit, de la conception à l’industrialisation.
 A propos de vous 
 Un bon niveau d' anglais est souhaité
 Curiosité technique et esprit d'analyse : intérêt pour les technologies de packaging et pour l'innovation, capacité à comprendre une situation technique, identifier les causes et proposer des solutions.
 Rigueur : méthode dans le suivi des activités et de la documentation.
 Esprit d’équipe : aptitude à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés, en local et à distance
 Autonomie : capacité à avancer sur les sujets, à prendre des initiatives et à gérer les priorités.
 ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche …

items.title: Especialista en Reporting y Automatización de Procesos
items.card: En Sabadell Zurich formarás parte del equipo de Life Actuary, donde tu principal objetivo será gestionar la herramienta de reporting de los actuals de IFRS17. Tu contribución será clave para procesar el cierre de los actuals de IFRS17, interactuando directamente con los equipos de Finance. Además, serás responsable del diseño, la implementación y el mantenimiento de los procesos de automatización del departamento
items.desc:
En Sabadell Zurich formarás parte del equipo de Life Actuary, donde tu principal objetivo será gestionar la herramienta de reporting de los actuals de IFRS17. 
 Tu contribución será clave para procesar el cierre de los actuals de IFRS17, interactuando directamente con los equipos de Finance. 
 Además, serás responsable del diseño, la implementación y el mantenimiento de los procesos de automatización del departamento actuarial. 
 Para ello, sus principales funciones serán: 
 Gestionar reporting y almacenamiento de los datos de los actuals de IFRS17. 
 Interacción y coordinación entre los equipos de finance y los equipos técnicos para aplicar y validar los cambios necesarios. 
 Identificar los procesos actuariales manuales candidatos a una automatización. 
 Desarrollo técnico, UAT y documentación del proceso usando herramientas para automatización. 
 Formación a los equipos actuariales en las herramientas y los procesos implementados. 
 ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? 
 Buscamos una persona con actitud positiva, ganas de aprender y que cuente con las siguientes habilidades y experiencias. 
 Experiencia y conocimientos esenciales 
 Experiencia en optimización de flujos y procesos, preferiblemente en el área de Finanzas. 
 Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en diseño de procesos, codificación y pruebas. 
 Experiencia de programación en Python, SQL. 
 Experiencia en VBS y Power Query para automatización y análisis de datos. 
 Valorable experiencia en PowerShell, C++ y .NET. 
 Valorable conocimiento de herramientas de Workflow y Database Management (Microsoft SQL Server). 
 Nivel alto de inglés, tanto escrito como hablado. 
 Qué marcará la diferencia en tu perfil 
 Organización, planificación y priorización del trabajo, con autonomía, flexibilidad y orientación a la mejora continua. 
 Compromiso con la organización y alto sentido de la responsabilidad, con rigor en el desempeño diario. 
 Habilidades comunicativas, relacionales y de trabajo en equipo. 
 Orientación al cliente y capacidad de resolución de problemas, en entornos operativos y regulados. 
 Alta capacidad de concentración y atención al detalle, especialmente en la ejecución de tareas repetitivas. 
 Interés por la digitalización y automatización de procesos, incluyendo el uso de nuevas tecnologías y de la Inteligencia Artificial. 
 Actitud de aprendizaje continuo, con disposición para adquirir y actualizar conocimientos técnicos. 
 ¿Qué te ofrecemos? 
 Modelo híbrido y flexibilidad tras el primer mes de tu incorporación. 
 Seguro de salud y ventajas exclusivas. 
 Retribución flexible. 
 Acceso a formación continua y plan de desarrollo. 
 26 días de vacaciones + día de cumpleaños. 
 Beneficios sociales y entorno inclusivo. 
 Sobre nosotros 
 Sabadell Zurich es la alianza entre Banco Sabadell y Zurich Insurance Group. Somos más de 350 profesionales en España con un propósito común: Estar para cuidar. 
 Promovemos un entorno inclusivo basado en la igualdad de oportunidades, sin discriminación por género, edad, origen, discapacidad, orientación sexual u otras circunstancias personales. 
 Si buscas un entorno exigente, colaborativo y con impacto real en negocio, queremos conocerte. 
 En Sabadell Zurich, el talento se convierte en valor.

items.desc:
Wir verstärken ab sofort unser Vertriebsteam Außendienst in Salzburg, Tirol und Vorarlberg. Du sprichst gerne mit Menschen und bringst ein gewisses Verkaufstalent mit? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! In dieser Position betreust du unsere Kundinnen und Kunden - mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Flexibilität. 
 Was macht dich zum perfekten Match für diese Rolle? 
 Deine Freude an der Zusammenarbeit und am Verkauf sorgt für gute Stimmung und Erfolg im Team.
 Empathie und Kommunikationsstärke zeichnen deine Persönlichkeit aus. Du verstehst es, auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundinnen und Kunden einzugehen und ihnen auf Augenhöhe zu begegnen.
 Deine Einsatzbereitschaft und deine Überzeugungskraft bilden die Grundlage für eine erfolgreiche Karriere im Vertrieb. Du setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für deine Ziele ein und überzeugst durch dein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.

 Durch kontinuierliches Netzwerken wirst du zur ersten Ansprechperson rund um das Thema Versicherung und Vorsorge. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und pflegst diese nachhaltig.
 Du begleitest und unterstützt deine Kundinnen und Kunden im Schadensfall und bei sämtlichen Anliegen. Mit deinem Fachwissen stehst du ihnen in schwierigen Situationen zur Seite und findest gemeinsam die beste Lösung.

 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und einen flexiblen Arbeitsort, der die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie unterstützt

 Attraktive und leistungsabhängige Entlohnung

 Attraktive Konditionen für Versicherungsprodukte

 …und das ist nicht alles!

Abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation machen wir dir ein passendes Angebot. Dabei orientieren wir uns an aktuellen Marktgehältern.
Dieser Position liegt der Kollektivvertrag Versicherungsunternehmen Außendienst zugrunde.

 Unsere rund 1.300 engagierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen setzen sich miteinander dafür ein, für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bestmöglich da zu sein. Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe und gehen dabei auch unkonventionelle Wege, um herausragende Lösungen zu bieten. Das bleibt nicht unbemerkt: Unsere innovativen Produkte und Services wurden mehrfach ausgezeichnet und wir zählen zu den Top Ten der Versicherungen Österreichs. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine neue, aufregende Zukunft der Versicherungsbranche.

items.title: Pricing Analyst
items.card: you will contribute to pricing projects, applying advanced analytical and modelling techniques to assess risk, understand customer behaviour and improve portfolio performance. You will act as a trusted partner to the business, providing expert analytical support and contributing to the continuous improvement of our pricing capabilities. Your role As a Pricing Analyst , your main responsibilities will involve:
items.desc:
Our opportunity 
 Pricing Analyst 
 Join our Retail Transformation team and partner with General Insurance Pricing teams across the world to support strategic pricing and analytical initiatives. 
 As a Pricing Analyst, you will contribute to pricing projects, applying advanced analytical and modelling techniques to assess risk, understand customer behaviour and improve portfolio performance. 
 You will act as a trusted partner to the business, providing expert analytical support and contributing to the continuous improvement of our pricing capabilities. 
 Your role 
 As a Pricing Analyst , your main responsibilities will involve: 
 Preparing and analysing complex data using scripting languages such as Python 
 Designing, developing and validating pricing models, including risk and demand models, across P&C insurance products 
 Applying advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to solve pricing problems 
 Performing portfolio and profitability analyses to identify pricing opportunities 
 Developing impact analysis, monitoring and decision-support tools 
 Contributing to the design and development of tariff engines 
 Contributing to R&D activities, including testing new methodologies, technologies and analytical approaches 
 Providing consultation and analytical support to business partners 
 Collaborating with colleagues and sharing analytical and pricing expertise 
 Communicating analytical findings and recommendations clearly to business stakeholders 
 Your Skills and Experience 
 As a Pricing Analyst , your skills and experience will ideally include: 
 Master’s degree in Financial Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Quantitative Methods, Computer Science or a related field 
 At least 3 years of relevant experience in Non-life insurance pricing or Data Science 
 Solid knowledge and practical experience in risk and/or demand modelling and portfolio analysis using WTW EMBLEM and Radar 
 Good programming skills in Python, R and/or SQL 
 Knowledge of statistical modelling and Machine Learning techniques 
 English proficiency at B2 level or above, both written and spoken 
 A proactive, open-minded and solution-oriented approach, with a willingness to learn and develop 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders 
 We offer 
 Compensation for roles at Zurich depends on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific role, skill set, level of experience, and subject to applicable law. Zurich thus provides a range of compensation aligned to internal job architecture and market benchmarks to ensure fair and consistent pay for comparable roles. The starting base salary range for this position is 2330 Eur. 
 Working time benefits 
 Personal days off, Concentrated work week, Additional vacation, Home office, Extra days off at occasion of childbirth, Sabbatical leave, Workation 
 Monetary benefits 
 Life insurance from Zurich Austria, Compensation for salary loss during sick leave, 3rd pension pillar contribution, Risk Life Insurance, Meal contribution on top of the legally required minimum, Years of service bonus, Wedding bonus, Baby bonus 
 Other benefits 
 Electronic cafeteria, Maternity leave benefits, Massages in the office 
 Learning/Development 
 Professional Certifications, Online Education Portals, Extensive Onboarding program, Strengths based culture (GALLUP) 
 Location: Bratislava 
 Schedule: full-time 
 Form: hybrid – min. 3 times in the office per week 
 About us 
 At our company, we recognize the importance of fostering an open-minded, safe and inclusive environment for everyone. We stand with diversity and respect different backgrounds and lifestyles. That's why we've implemented numerous initiatives to ensure our employees feel comfortable, accepted, and respected at all times.

items.title: Junior Pricing Analyst - suitable for fresh graduates
items.card: you will analyse pricing data, support the development of predictive models to estimate customer risk and behaviour using advanced modelling techniques, and build dashboards and impact analysis tools to support risk analysis and performance tracking. This is a great opportunity for a recent graduate or junior professional who wants to grow in pricing, data science and insurance. Your role As an Junior Pricing
items.desc:
Our opportunity 
 Junior Pricing Analyst – suitable for fresh graduates 
 Join our Retail Transformation team and work with General Insurance Pricing teams across the world on a variety of analytical activities.
 As a Junior Pricing Analyst you will analyse pricing data, support the development of predictive models to estimate customer risk and behaviour using advanced modelling techniques, and build dashboards and impact analysis tools to support risk analysis and performance tracking.
 This is a great opportunity for a recent graduate or junior professional who wants to grow in pricing, data science and insurance. 
 Your role 
 As an Junior Pricing Analyst , your main responsibilities will involve: 
 Preparing data for pricing analysis using scripting languages such as Python 
 Assisting in the development of predictive models for various insurance products, reflecting the risk the company is taking on and analysing customer behaviour 
 Applying data science and statistical techniques, including machine learning, to identify patterns in available data 
 Exploring and analysing new data sources to enhance our understanding of risk and customer behaviour 
 Contributing to profitability analyses and helping to interpret the results 
 Helping to build and maintain impact analysis and monitoring tools 
 Communicating analytical findings in a clear and structured way to business partners 
 Your Skills and Experience 
 As an Junior Pricing Analyst , your skills and experience will ideally include: 
 University education (Master's degree) in Financial Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Quantitative Methods, Computer Science or a similar field 
 Suitable for a fresh graduate or someone with up to one year of experience in Pricing or Data Science 
 English language – Upper intermediate (B2 or better), spoken and written 
 Strong interest in data research, predictive modelling, statistical analysis, data transformation and/or other analytical role generating insights for business decisions 
 Technical experience in analytics, data management or insurance industry is an advantage 
 Knowledge of programming languages is a plus (e.g. Python, R, SQL) 
 Experience with tools such as Databricks, Visual Studio Code or WTW software is an advantage 
 A creative, open-minded and proactive approach 
 Strong communication skills and team player

Zurich thus provides a range of compensation aligned to internal job architecture and market benchmarks to ensure fair and consistent pay for comparable roles. items.title: Facilities Engineer
items.card: RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned. Review work completion data and contractor recommendations for changes to PM procedures. Review equipment logs to evaluate trends and make recommendations to reduce operating costs and downtime Review production downtime data and performs or participates in root cause analysis to reduce downtime due to facilities failures. Ensure lessons learned
items.desc:
The Facilities (FCM) Engineer is responsible for monitoring, supervising, and evaluating performance of contractors who provide maintenance, repair, and replacement of FCM equipment and systems; production equipment installation and moves; and construction activities. 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
 Review work completion data and contractor recommendations for changes to PM procedures.
 Review equipment logs to evaluate trends and make recommendations to reduce operating costs and downtime

- Colaborar com diferentes utilizadores, gerindo e conciliando expectativas de múltiplos stakeholders.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. You can help us achieve our mission.
 Microsoft Treasury supports the digital transformation journey of Microsoft’s customers, partners and vendors by providing competitive credit and payment solutions to support revenue growth while managing credit risk.
 We are a compliance-first organization with customer obsession and deal economics focus. We support over $150B in trade and receivables and $11B in payment solutions per year in global markets. The team is also charged with managing over $130B of investment portfolio, currency risk, bank account infrastructure and business risk insurance.
 As Safeguarding Payment Analyst, you will manage and execute the day-to-day management of daily safeguarding activities. You will also act as a key finance partner to the Head of Safeguarding, providing analysis, planning and broader financial management support while working closely with the Treasury Manager, Head of Safeguarding, Financial Manager and other key Treasury contacts.
 Responsibilities 
 Daily Safeguarding Calculations and Reconciliations 
 Perform daily safeguarding calculations to identify client-fund liabilities using payment flows, settlement data and internal ledger records.
 Reconcile calculated client-fund liabilities to internal ledgers, external bank statements and safeguarding account balances.
 Verify that safeguarding account balances provide complete and adequate coverage of client funds in line with the approved methodology.
 Complete daily activities within agreed cut-off times and retain clear evidence of preparation, review and completion.
 Safeguarding Transfers and Account Monitoring 
 Prepare and support timely safeguarding transfers to ensure full coverage of client-fund liabilities.
 Monitor balances and movements across safeguarding accounts, identifying unusual transactions, shortfalls or excess balances.
 Support the coordination of settlements, funding movements and permitted intercompany transfers in line with approved authorities and segregation-of-duties requirements.
 Break Investigation and Escalation 
 Investigate reconciliation breaks and data discrepancies promptly, documenting the cause, impact and corrective action.
 Work with Finance, Treasury, IT, and banking partners to resolve outstanding items within agreed timelines.
 Escalate safeguarding shortfalls, unexplained differences, missed deadlines and control failures promptly in accordance with governance procedures.
 Track open breaks and remediation actions through to closure, providing clear status updates to relevant stakeholders.
 Controls, Records and Reporting 
 Operate safeguarding controls accurately, including required checks, approvals and segregation of duties.
 Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready records of calculations, reconciliations, transfers, approvals, investigations and remediation actions.
 Prepare routine safeguarding reports and management information for the Head of Safeguarding and other relevant stakeholders.
 Support internal and external audits, regulatory submissions and Central Bank of Ireland information requests by providing accurate records and explanations.
 Process Support and Continuous Improvement 
 Follow documented safeguarding procedures and keep process notes, checklists and control evidence up to date.
 Identify recurring breaks, manual inefficiencies and data-quality issues, and suggest practical improvements to processes and controls.
 Support testing and implementation of system, data and process changes affecting safeguarding calculations or reconciliations.
 Participate in cross-training, contingency arrangements and daily handovers to support continuity of safeguarding operations.
 Qualifications 
 Required qualifications 
 Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business OR equivalent experience.
 Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to deadlines.
 Ability to build effective relationships with senior stakeholders, auditors and cross-functional partners.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business, OR Master's Degree in Business Administration or Finance, OR equivalent experience.
 Experience in payments, e-money, financial services, technology, cloud services or online platforms.
 Experience operating in a regulated entity or supporting safeguarding or operational-resilience requirements.
 Experience with treasury management systems, analytics, automation, modelling or large-scale cash and reconciliation environments.

 The Global Consumption & Delivery Acceleration team is looking for a FastTrack Full Stack Engineer to help accelerate customer deployment, adoption, consumption, and value realization across the Microsoft AI Business Solutions portfolio.  With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft products, services and partnerships. 
 Microsoft's Detection and Response Team (DART) is seeking a skilled and experienced Cybersecurity Infrastructure Engineer to join the team. DART is the first port of call for many customers during a security incident. This pivotal, customer-facing position helps customers contain, recover from and build resilience against high-impact cybersecurity incidents. 
 You will lead infrastructure recovery and identity containment workstreams, establish technical priorities and act as a trusted technical partner for customers during urgent response activity. Working with lead investigators, threat hunters, reverse engineers and incident coordinators, you will help customers make evidence-led recovery decisions and improve security outcomes. 
 As part of a globally distributed, mission-driven team, you will share practical recovery expertise, mentor colleagues and help shape the future of Defender Experts Cybersecurity Incident Response. 
 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Employees are expected to demonstrate a growth mindset, innovation, collaboration, respect, integrity, accountability and inclusion. 
 Responsibilities 
 As a Cybersecurity Infrastructure Engineer, you will lead and support evidence-driven infrastructure response, identity recovery and technical hardening workstreams across enterprise on-premises and cloud environments.

Overview 
 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft products, services and partnerships. 
 Microsoft's Detection and Response Team (DART) is seeking a skilled and experienced Cybersecurity Threat Hunter to join the team. DART is the first port of call for many customers during a security incident. This pivotal, customer-facing position identifies adversary activity, determines compromise scope and turns findings into clear response actions. 
 You will lead hypothesis-driven hunts, establish technical priorities and act as a trusted technical partner for customers during urgent response activity. Working with lead investigators, infrastructure engineers, reverse engineers and incident coordinators, you will help customers understand adversary activity, visibility gaps and durable security improvements. 
 As part of a globally distributed, mission-driven team, you will share research, mentor colleagues and help shape the future of Defender Experts Cybersecurity Incident Response. 
 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Employees are expected to demonstrate a growth mindset, innovation, collaboration, respect, integrity, accountability and inclusion. 
 Responsibilities 
 As a Cybersecurity Threat Hunter, you will lead evidence-driven hunt workstreams across customer environments, identify adversary activity and communicate clear findings, confidence and response recommendations. 
 Set hunt objectives, hypotheses, priorities and evidence requirements using threat intelligence, adversary tactics, techniques and procedures, and customer-specific risk context. 
 Develop, test and refine hunts using large-scale correlation of endpoint, cloud, identity, network and third-party telemetry. 
 Operate as a platform- and vendor-agnostic hunter across Windows, Linux, macOS, multi-cloud and third-party technologies, using the telemetry, forensic artefacts and security tooling required by each customer environment. 
 Determine adversary presence, compromise scope and visibility gaps; establish what is known, what remains uncertain and what additional collection or analysis is needed. 
 Author and optimise queries, automation and responsible AI-enabled workflows to improve hunt scale, analytical quality and time to detection. 
 Convert investigations and research into durable detections, analytics, mitigations, threat intelligence and product or architectural improvements. 
 Lead multiple hunt workstreams during high-impact incidents, coordinate priorities and dependencies, maintain evidentiary documentation and support post-incident and root-cause analysis. 
 Brief customer technical teams, executives, internal stakeholders and partners with clear findings, coverage, limitations and response options. 
 Provide technical guidance, share research and mentor other hunters while protecting DART information, tools and operational security. 
 Qualifications 
 Required / Minimum Qualifications 
 Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security or related field OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security or related field AND experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale data analysis or security research; OR equivalent practical cybersecurity experience. 
 Demonstrated hands-on experience in threat hunting, Windows forensics, Linux or macOS analysis, or investigating identity-based attacks across Active Directory, Entra ID or other enterprise identity platforms. 
 Demonstrated experience authoring queries against large-scale security telemetry, including scripting or automation. 
 Ability to correlate and assess evidence from multiple sources, identify compromise scope, assess visibility gaps and clearly explain findings and uncertainty. 
 Strong customer-facing written and verbal communication, including executive briefings. 
 Flexibility to work non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Proven hypothesis-led threat hunting at enterprise scale, correlating endpoint, cloud, identity and network telemetry to identify adversary activity and visibility gaps. 
 Advanced Kusto Query Language (KQL) skills, with ability to transform data at scale. 
 Strong forensic capability across Windows, Linux and macOS, including analysis of endpoint artefacts and memory where required. 
 Platform- and vendor-agnostic security experience across Microsoft, AWS, GCP and third-party SIEM, EDR, identity, network and email technologies.

Geprom – Soluciones Industriales y Transformación Digital 
 En Geprom somos una compañía especializada en ingeniería, automatización y digitalización industrial. Trabajamos para impulsar la innovación en entornos industriales, desarrollando soluciones tecnológicas que ayudan a nuestros clientes a avanzar hacia la fábrica del futuro. 
 Únete a un equipo dinámico, multidisciplinar y comprometido con la excelencia. 
 ¡Únete a nuestro equipo! 
 Geprom, Part of Telefónica Tech desde 2021, somos una ingeniería de base tecnológica especializada en el ámbito de la automatización industrial y la transformación digital, desarrollando e integrando proyectos llave en mano en las áreas de planificación, producción, calidad, logística y mantenimiento especializados en la Industria 4.0. 
 Buscamos un/a Diseñador/a Mecánico/a con experiencia en el diseño y desarrollo de soluciones mecánicas para proyectos de automatización industrial, maquinaria e intralogística. 
 La persona seleccionada participará en el diseño mecánico de equipos y soluciones industriales, desde la definición conceptual hasta la elaboración de planos de fabricación y montaje, trabajando de forma coordinada con los equipos de automatización, electricidad y proyectos. 
 Funciones principales 
 Diseño mecánico: Diseñar y desarrollar conjuntos, subconjuntos y componentes mecánicos para maquinaria y sistemas de automatización industrial. 
 Modelado 3D y planos: Realizar modelos 3D, planos de fabricación, montaje y despieces mediante herramientas de diseño CAD. 
 Desarrollo de soluciones: Participar en la definición y desarrollo de soluciones mecánicas adaptadas a las necesidades técnicas de cada proyecto. 
 Gestión de documentación: Elaborar listas de materiales (BOM), planos, especificaciones y documentación técnica necesaria para la fabricación y montaje. 
 Coordinación interdisciplinaria: Colaborar con los departamentos de automatización, electricidad, producción y gestión de proyectos para garantizar la correcta integración de las soluciones. 
 Selección de componentes: Definir y seleccionar componentes mecánicos y comerciales adecuados para cada aplicación. 
 Optimización del diseño: Analizar y mejorar los diseños para garantizar su funcionalidad, fabricabilidad, montaje, mantenimiento y optimización de costes. 
 Validación y soporte: Dar soporte técnico durante las fases de fabricación, montaje, instalación y puesta en marcha de los equipos. 
 Requisitos y conocimientos 
 Software de diseño CAD: Experiencia en herramientas de diseño mecánico 3D y elaboración de planos técnicos. 
 Diseño mecánico industrial: Conocimientos sólidos de diseño de maquinaria, conjuntos mecánicos, estructuras y elementos de automatización. 
 Interpretación de planos: Capacidad para interpretar y elaborar planos mecánicos, tolerancias, ajustes y especificaciones técnicas. 
 Procesos de fabricación: Conocimientos de procesos de mecanizado, soldadura, fabricación de estructuras y montaje industrial. 
 Selección de materiales y componentes: Conocimientos para la selección de materiales, elementos comerciales y componentes mecánicos. 
 Automatización industrial: Se valorará experiencia en proyectos de automatización, intralogística, transportadores, paletizado, final de línea, AGVs/AMRs u otras soluciones industriales. 
 Responsabilidades adicionales 
 Participar en la mejora continua y estandarización de soluciones y diseños mecánicos. 
 Colaborar en la resolución de incidencias técnicas durante la fabricación, montaje y puesta en marcha. 
 Velar por el cumplimiento de los estándares técnicos, de calidad y seguridad aplicables a los diseños. 
 Participar en la optimización técnica y económica de las soluciones desarrolladas. 
 Ofrecemos: 
 Horario flexible. 
 Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional. 
 Proyectos con clientes referentes del sector industrial. 
 Formación especializada. 
 Desarrollo de nuevos productos y funcionalidades en las tecnologías más avanzadas de la industria 4.0. 
 Seguro médico a cargo de la empresa y retribución flexible. 
 Sobre Geprom 
 En Geprom tenemos oportunidades de desarrollo profesional en un entorno donde tú eres quién pone el límite a tu crecimiento. 
 Te ofrecemos el reto de asumir nuevas responsabilidades y participar en proyectos de gran trascendencia, mediante el desarrollo e integración de las tecnologías más avanzadas en el ámbito de la industria 4.0 y de la automatización industrial. 
 En Geprom, entendemos que cada empresa, sea del tamaño que sea, pone en marcha su revolución digital de un modo único, integrando en sus modelos de negocio a personas, datos, máquinas y procesos. 
 Sobre esta base, acompañamos a nuestros clientes ofreciendo soluciones, servicios, y productos de forma integral para hacer realidad la transformación digital y superar juntos las barreras de la cuarta revolución industrial. 
 Geprom apuesta por el talento y la igualdad de oportunidades. 
 Si te apasiona la tecnología y quieres crecer en un entorno innovador, …
