items.desc:
Fedezd fel a benned rejlő lehetőségeket a KUKA-val 
 A KUKA számos lehetőséget kínál, melyek által előremozdíthatod karriered, átélheted álmaidat és kibontakozhat a benned rejlő potenciál. A világ egyik vezető automatizálási szakértői vagyunk, globális lehetőségeket kínálunk a robotika, automatizálás, logisztika, szoftvermegoldások és az elektronika területén. Ha motivált vagy, merész ambíciókkal és elképzelésekkel, aki hisz az együttműködésben és a kölcsönös tiszteletben, akkor a KUKA-nál biztos lehetsz a sikerben!
 Feladatok 
 a termelésben található sajtológépek és szerszámok beállítása a műszaki dokumentáció alapján, 
 a termelés folyamatosságának biztosítása (gép és szerszám rendelkezésreállás), 
 műszaknapló folyamatos vezetése, naprakészen tartása, 
 a kábelkonfekcionáló részlegek által használt gépek szerelése, javítása, rendszeres karbantartása a gépkönyvben és a karbantartási utasításban foglaltak szerint. 
 Elvárások 
 középfokú végzettség, előnyt jelent a műszaki szakirányú végzettség (pl.: műszerész, elektromechanikai műszerész),
 finommechanikai berendezések üzemeltetésében és javításában szerzett tapasztalat,
 MS Office alapismeretek,
 pontos, precíz, igényes munkavégzés,
 minőség iránti elkötelezettség,
 2 műszakos munkarend vállalása.
 Amit mi ígérünk 
 Kultúránk gyökere a robotika és a könnyű, felhasználóbarét automatizálási megoldások iránti szenvedélyünkben rejlik. Az eredmény? Világszerte egyszerűbbé és biztonságosabbá tesszük az emberek életét. Vállalatunk lelke a sokszínűség – nagyra értékelünk minden egyes ragyogó és merész ötletet. Mindenkit arra bíztatunk, hogy munkája során legyen teljesen önmaga, ezáltal egy olyan környezet tud létrejönni, ahol az inspiráció, a szakértelem és a személyes fejlődés kibontakozhat. Közös célunk? A nagyszerűség és az innovatív, pozitív változások beindítása és elérése – nem csak az automatizálási iparágon belül, hanem annak határain túl is.
 Juttatások és támogatások 
 Elkötelezettek vagyunk munkatársaink jóléte iránt, ezért juttatások széles skáláját biztosítjuk, a versenyképes juttatási csomagoktól a rugalmas munkarenden át a szakmai fejlődési lehetőségekig. Mindezzel célunk, hogy munkavállalóink elégedettek legyenek. Hiszünk abban, hogy munkatársaink elkötelezettségét és kemény munkáját elismerés illeti, és juttatásaink tükrözik ezt a hozzáállásunkat. Célunk, hogy olyan munkahelyet hozzunk létre, ahol az alkalmazottak értékesnek érzik magukat, inspiráltak és motiváltak, hogy a legjobbat hozzák ki magukból. Csatlakozz hozzánk, és élvezd az előnyeit egy olyan vállalatnak, amely a csapatának a jóllétét és fejlődését helyezi előtérbe!
 Sokszínűség, méltányosság és elfogadás 
 Alapvető meggyőződésünk, hogy kedvesen, nyitottan és kölcsönös tisztelettel egymás iránt egy olyan környezetet teremthetünk, ahol mindenki önmaga lehet a munkája során. 
 A KUKA az esélyegyenlőség iránt elkötelezett vállalat. Minden jelentkezést aprólékos gondossággal és odafigyeléssel kezelünk – olyan döntéshozatali folyamattal, amelyet nem befolyásol a származás, az iskolai végzettség, az életkor, a nem, a szexuális irányultság, továbbá a vallási vagy a politikai meggyőződés sem. Ha csatlakozol a KUKA-hoz, rengeteg lehetőséged lesz arra, hogy megoszd, mi motivál téged, és mi határozza meg egyéniségedet, ha szeretnéd.
 Csatlakozz az utazáshoz! 
 Ha úgy gondolod, hogy a KUKA által kínált karrier az, amit keresel, szívesen hallanánk felőled.
 Várjuk jelentkezésedet!

Discover your impact with KUKA Group 
 KUKA Group offers an enormous spectrum of possibilities to advance your career, live your passions and unlock your potential. We´re one of the world's leading automation specialists, offering global opportunities in areas such as robotics, automation, logistics, software solutions and electronics. If you´re a go-getter, a visionary with bold ambitions and believer in collaboration and mutual respect, then you're poised for success here at KUKA Group.
 Make an impact 
 Employee Master Data Administration: you will be responsible for keeping employee information accurate and up-to-date; from updating personal details (such as addresses, bank account information, contact details or nationality) to processing name changes and other employee record updates. 
 Employment Data Administration: you will support a wide range of employment-related changes. This includes updating job titles, departments, cost centers, managers, work locations, grades and contractual information, ensuring that all changes are reflected accurately and in a timely manner. 
 Organizational Management: you will help maintain the organizational structure; whether by creating new positions, managing reporting line changes, or supporting organizational redesign initiatives, your work will help ensure that our systems accurately reflect the way our organization operates. 
 Data Quality & System Maintenance: you will regularly perform validation checks, investigate and correct data inconsistencies, support data cleansing initiatives and execute mass updates when required.

 familiarity with HR systems such as SAP, Workday or SuccessFactors,

items.desc:
Cleanroom Fabrication Engineer at the Quantum Device Lab 
 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Cleanroom Fabrication Engineer at the Quantum Device Lab
 100%, Zurich, fixed-term 
 print 
 Drucken 
 At the Quantum Device Lab , led by Prof. Andreas Wallraff at the Department of Physics of ETH Zurich, we fabricate quantum devices using micro- and nanofabrication techniques. We use the devices to conduct state-of-the-art experimental research in quantum information science and technology. In particular, we work on scaling the developed technologies to build large-scale error-corrected quantum computers. We operate across various cleanrooms in the Zurich area, and develop new technology and approaches which benefit from a coherent, farsighted vision. We collaborate closely with academic and industrial partners within the quantum community.
 Project background
 We are looking for a Cleanroom Fabrication Engineer to join our interdisciplinary team doing research and development at the forefront of quantum technologies. You will play a crucial role in the development of quantum processor chips, working on devices that incorporate tens to hundreds of qubits. A primary goal of work will be the scaling of micro-fabricated chips, including the development of Through-Silicon-Vias (TSVs), connecting the front to back surface of the chips with high-quality superconducting films. These will reduce the impact of parasitic box modes, and enable alternative signal routing paths, enabling the scaling up in device size.
 Job description
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Device fabrication: Execution and refinement of micro and nano-fabrication runs using existing fabrication processes.
 Process development: Development and optimization of novel fabrication processes for scalable architectures (such as high-aspect-ratio TSVs deep reactive-ion etching and conformal coating).
 Yield improvement: Systematic metrology inspection to continuously improve fabrication yield.
 High-coherence compatibility: Collaboration with other fabrication engineers of the lab and the measurement researchers to evaluate impact of processes on qubit coherence metrics, and guarantee high-quality device outputs.
 Documentation: Preparation of technical and scientific documentation of your work. Tracking of run logs and process metrics shared with scientists from the Quantum Device Lab who have the lead in characterizing and operating the fabricated devices.
 Profile
 We are looking for a highly motivated fabrication engineer to lead the fabrication and process development of devices that advance our capabilities in large-scale quantum computing.
 Candidates must have experience in an academic and/or industrial setting in a number of the following areas:
 Hands-on cleanroom experience : Proven record with semi- or superconductor processing techniques, such as electron beam lithography, photolithography, dry and wet etching, thin film deposition
 Process control: surface characterization, metrology (optical-, scanning-electron microscopy, atomic force microscopy), material science, statistical process control, yield improvement, failure analysis.
 Specialized equipment: practical technical knowledge of vacuum technology, (pumps, UHV systems, ...), leak detection, or cryogenic systems.
 Research experience: ability to demonstrate high-quality reporting examples.
 Further Requirements:
 You are expected to be skilled in communicating your findings to collaborators in a multidisciplinary environment. You should have high attention to details, structured work habits, and the ability to handle complex workflows.
 You must hold a Master degree or equivalent in micro- and nanofabrication, material science, physics, electrical engineering or a related field. A PhD degree can be helpful but is not required.
 You must possess excellent English communication skills; knowledge of German is a plus.
 Workplace
 Workplace
 We offer
 In depth exposure the rapidly developing field of quantum technology, and opportunity to tackle a wide range of fabrication challenges, combined with ample learning opportunities.
 A collaborative, interdisciplinary R&D environment. A rewarding, inspiring working environment with a flat hierarchy and open culture in a diverse and international team.
 Access to state-of-the-art cleanroom fabrication facilities located at ETH Hönggerberg (FIRST), at IBM Rüschlikon (BRNC) and at PSI Villigen (PICO).

items.desc:
Ferrari has a most desirable track record, in Formula One as well as in GT production cars, record business results and voted one of the World's most powerful brands. Working with Ferrari means working with engineering excellence and innovation on the highest level. Above all Ferrari is an international team working with the highest level of professionalism and dedication, based on performance, meritocracy and continuous development, with innovation at the heart of our future.
We are looking to hire an Inverter HW Design Specialist based in Maranello (Italy).
In this role, you will contribute to inverter hardware design, simulation and testing, from requirements gathering and electronic circuit design to component testing, working closely with multidisciplinary teams.
In this position, you will be responsible for:
 Identifying and gathering technical requirements for inverter hardware development.
 Designing electronic circuits, including electrical schematics and PCB layouts.
 Performing functional and circuit-level simulations.
 Supporting the definition and implementation of test setups and test plans.
 Independently carrying out component-level tests in-house.
 Providing support during testing at external laboratories, at both vehicle and component level.

Knowledge of simulation tools such as MATLAB, PLECS and LTspice, as well as electronic design software such as Altium, is also required. You will be able to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams, collaborating across different areas of expertise.
Fluent English is required for the position and Italian language skills are an advantage. We appreciate individuals with experience outside their country of origin, allowing for a multicultural mindset.

items.card: The role involves working in an industrial environment as part of a team that is responsible for improving operating efficiency, machine effectiveness and overall improvement projects to support the manufacture and quality assurance of rubber compound, textile and metallic fabric components used in the production of tyres. Main duties include: Collation and analysis of production data and key performance indicators
items.desc:
Pirelli is a truly international group and is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of high performance tyres. Pirelli UK Tyres Ltd is the company responsible for all of the Pirelli Tyre related operations in the UK. For more information on the company please visit www.pirelli.co.uk . 
 A 12- month placement is available within the Materials Industrial Department. The role involves working in an industrial environment as part of a team that is responsible for improving operating efficiency, machine effectiveness and overall improvement projects to support the manufacture and quality assurance of rubber compound, textile and metallic fabric components used in the production of tyres. 
 Main duties include: 
 Collation and analysis of production data and key performance indicators and encourage continual improvement 
 Liaise with some site services providers 
 Aid the team in implementing and maintaining LEAN processes 
 Participate in problem solving groups to improve efficiency 
 Ensure that the relevant safety procedures and standard operating procedures are maintained 
 Taking responsibility for a work based project 
 Machine and method of work studies in factory for purposes of data collection/correlation for improving efficiency whilst maintaining high safety and quality standards 
 Our requirements: 
 Studying to degree level 
 Good keyboard skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite. 
 Willing to get ‘your hands dirty’ in re-designing more efficient lay-out etc in the factory. 
 Organisational skills and self-motivated, able to work on your own initiative in a fast-paced environment. 
 Good communication skills, and able to work effectively as part of a team 
 Flexibility and adaptable to change 
 A full, clean driving licence is desirable, as there may be an opportunity to travel to our Carlisle site. 
 Previous student insight on the role: 
 Before starting the role I wasn’t aware of just how many different tasks I would be doing and how many people from different departments I would be in communication with. This has been a good thing as it has kept the job interesting and has meant that I’m constantly learning new things and never bored. 
 I also didn’t realise how much involvement I’d have with the factory. Part of my job is to go into the factory for meetings, to make observations on machines and to talk to people from various roles within the factory in order to make improvements. Although this sounds daunting, I went into the job with no knowledge of the factory and was never expected to understand straight away and be thrown into the deep end. Doing this also makes the job more interesting as I’m not stuck at my desk all day! 
 Using Excel is a big part of the job, and one I didn’t have a huge amount of knowledge/experience with. However, having been in the job for around 8 weeks now, I am much more proficient and can successfully analyse data in lots of different ways, which I have learnt from my colleagues and the student before me. I also think that this will be useful going when I continue with my Business Degree. 
 Many of my tasks involve data analysis, which largely consists of creating graphs of losses we’ve had in the factory, and either collaborating with other departments to try to reduce the losses or closely monitoring the problem and trying to find the source of the problem. 
 Other things I have taken part in so far are weekly meetings, re-arranging layouts in the factory, and performing small tests on machines to identify the cause of a problem, just to name a few. 
 These are some of the things that a placement at Pirelli can provide. Are you ready to be challenged? 
 Employee benefits include: 
 33 days holiday per year (inclusive of bank holidays) 
 Pension scheme with linked life insurance 
 Employee discount scheme 
 Employee assistance programme 
 Discounted tyre vouchers 
 The successful candidate must, by the commencement of employment, have the right to work in the UK. 
 Application deadline 31.12.2026, please be aware that applications may close sooner due to significant volume.

 Overview 
 Entrerai nella Divisione Banca dei Territori, all’interno della Rete Imprese del Gruppo, dove ti occuperai della gestione contabile e amministrativa delle fatture cedute. Monitorerai scadenze e flussi di incasso, mantenendo un costante presidio sul credito commerciale e contribuendo alla gestione del rischio. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Gestire la contabilità e l’amministrazione delle fatture cedute 
 Monitorare costantemente scadenze e flussi di incasso 
 Curare il rapporto con i debitori ceduti e con i cedenti 
 Presidiare le dinamiche del credito commerciale 
 Supportare la gestione e la valutazione del rischio di credito

items.desc:
VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 050 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1650 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1200 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch je možné získať jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Ak máte máte skúsenosti s prácou so živnostníkmi a malými podnikateľmi a máte v sebe ducha obchodníka, ste skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku pre VÚB! 
 Čakajú Vás u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie. 
Na pozícii Poradca/Poradkyňa pre podnikateľov bude Vašou úlohou:
 zabezpečovať servisné činnosti pre klientov - malých podnikateľov,
 identifikovať potreby právnických osôb a analyzovať ich potreby,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom s cieľom nájdenia optimálneho riešenia,
 proaktívne zabezpečovať a rozvíjať dlhodobé obchodné vzťahy v segmente Small Business,
 aktívne vyhľadávať nové obchodné príležitosti,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti:
 minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máte minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov,
 dokážete sa jednoducho orientovať v účtovných výkazoch malých podnikateľov,
 viete aktívne využívať MS Office, 
 Vás baví komunikovať a dokážete pomôcť klientom s nájdením optimálneho riešenia,
 máte argumentačné schopnosti a obchodného ducha,
 výhodou je anglický jazyk a vzdelanie ekonomického zamerania,
 si dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.
 ... všetko ostatné Ťa naučíme my :)
 Informácie o výberovom konaní
 Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.
Tešíme sa na Teba !
 Ak Vás tento popis zaujal, pošlite nám svoje CV a my sa Vám ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na online/osobnom stretnutí. Tešíme sa na Vás!

items.desc:
Digital Workplace Endpoint Hardware Certification Engineer | Swiss Re 
Digital Workplace Endpoint Hardware Certification Engineer
Regular Employment
Apply now
 Share 
 Location: 
Madrid, M, ES
 Are you passionate about shaping the future of workplace technology? Do you love the idea that the decisions you make today will define how thousands of colleagues experience their digital workplace tomorrow? If you enjoy hands-on technical work with real strategic impact, this could be the role for you. 
 About the Role 
 As our Digital Workplace Endpoint Hardware Certification Engineer, you will be at the heart of defining which endpoint devices are approved, supported and deployed across our global environment. From laptops and desktops to peripherals, docking stations and collaboration hardware - you will ensure every device in our portfolio is secure, reliable, sustainable and truly fit for the way people work today and in the future. 
 This is a role where structured engineering thinking meets real-world impact. The standards you help define will directly shape the digital experience for thousands of colleagues worldwide. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead the hardware certification lifecycle for endpoint devices including laptops, desktops, peripherals, docking stations and selected workplace collaboration hardware 
 Validate drivers, firmware, BIOS/UEFI settings and operating system compatibility to ensure device stability, security and supportability across the enterprise environment 
 Design and execute integration, compatibility and user experience testing across platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot and Microsoft Entra ID 
 Maintain and evolve the approved hardware catalogue, ensuring standards remain scalable, secure, cost-effective and aligned with business and workplace needs 
 Collaborate with OEMs, technology suppliers and internal teams to manage certification requirements, review product roadmaps, resolve technical issues and assess emerging technologies 
 Support hardware lifecycle planning by tracking market trends, vendor roadmaps, device availability, sustainability considerations and evolving workplace requirements 
 Use endpoint analytics, incident trends and operational feedback to assess device reliability, performance and user experience 
 Identify opportunities to automate testing, validation, reporting and documentation to improve consistency and reduce manual effort 
 Partner with IT operations, security, procurement, workplace services and business stakeholders to ensure hardware standards are practical, supportable and aligned with organisational goals 
 About the Team 
 We in Digital Workplace (DWP) set out to make it easy for more than 14,000 employees to seamlessly connect with people, ideas, and expertise — within and beyond Swiss Re. 
 Our team is built around Microsoft 365, Workplace AI solutions, and related services — spanning design, architecture, development, integration, and orchestration across teams and internal partners. We believe the key to success lies in deeply understanding the business needs of our internal clients, identifying where technology can add real value, and focusing on how people will adopt and embrace change. 
 To support this, we are continuously redefining the way we work. DWP is an early adopter of agile methodologies and agile leadership within Swiss Re — and we're proud of it. We are a diverse, passionate team of experts who genuinely welcome professionals who bring curiosity, drive, and experience to help us deliver world-class solutions. Come join us on our journey! 
 About You 
 You are a curious, structured and hands-on technology professional with experience in enterprise endpoint hardware, workplace technology or device lifecycle management.  About the role 
 As a Workday Digital Product Owner - Time within our Digital People Services team, you'll drive the end-to-end digital product lifecycle of Time Tracking solutions across Sanofi's global footprint, ensuring reliable, compliant platforms that directly impact tens of thousands of employees worldwide. Ready to get started? 
 You'll join Sanofi's Digital Delivery & Operations unit, a key enabler of our People & Culture strategy. Operating within a portfolio-based model, you'll manage diverse solutions including Workday Time Tracking and a number of regional and local systems. This role sits at the critical intersection of HR operations and digital technology, where accurate time tracking and compliant absence management express our commitment to our people and legal obligations across complex, multi-country environments. 
 About Sanofi  
 Sanofi is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to supporting people through their health challenges, committed to chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team across some 100 countries transforms the practice of medicine — providing life-changing treatments and life-saving vaccines to millions globally, with sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions. Our values —  Aim Higher, Act for Patients, Be Bold, and Lead Together  — guide everything we do.  
 Main responsibilities: 
 Own product decisions for Time Tracking applications, including budget planning, service requests, and management across the global portfolio 
 Configure and maintain the Workday Time Tracking module hands-on, including building time templates, managing time calculations and creating advanced calculated fields. Knowledge of payroll earning/deductions breakdowns for multiple countries is a big plus 
 Manage stakeholder relationships as primary contact between HR, Legal, Payroll, and Digital teams, ensuring clear communication and effective prioritization 
 Oversee vendor partnerships with third-party time and attendance providers, managing SLAs, performance reviews, and contract negotiations 
 Ensure compliance with local working time legislation, labor laws, collective agreements, and data privacy requirements (including GDPR) across all supported countries 
 Lead change management for system upgrades, regulatory changes, and process transformations, including release notes, testing coordination, and adoption monitoring 
 Drive operational excellence through incident management, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives across integrated HR platforms 
 About you 
 Experience: Proven background in HR technology, time and attendance systems, or digital product management in multinational environments, with demonstrated experience managing Time Tracking solutions at regional or global scale 
 WD Pro certification: Workday Time Tracking certification (and its prerequisite, Core HCM certification) - this is an essential requirement. Noncertified candidates that can demonstrate significant years of experience strictly in the WD Time Tracking field will be considered. Candidates with General HCM experience and only occasional Time Tracking configuration work will be discarded

Strong knowledge of Workday HCM integrations and understanding of time-to-payroll data flows, across multiple countries if possible 
 Configuration skills: At least one year of hands-on experience as Tier 3 (L3) Support specifically within the Workday Time Tracking domain 
 Stakeholder management: Ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders across HR, Legal, Finance, and IT in matrix organizations, with experience managing third-party vendors and SLAs 
 Compliance knowledge: Familiarity with multi-country working time complexity, including local directives, shift regulations, collective agreements, and data privacy frameworks 
 Product management skills: Experience with Agile methodologies, backlog management, and end-to-end product lifecycle oversight 
 Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, or Business Administration. Workday Core HCM Admin and Time Tracking certifications required 
 Languages: Strong English communication skills for global collaboration. Working French language is a bonus.

 Description and Requirements
 En Endesa tenemos un firme compromiso con la formación y captación del talento. Por eso ofrecemos un Plan de Becas a recién titulados/as universitarios que quieran formar parte de un modelo de aprendizaje colaborativo orientado a adquirir competencias profesionales. 
 Para esta beca, buscamos personas recién graduadas en Ingeniería o que estén a falta de su TFG, para incorporarse a través de una beca al departamento de TRL Mantenimiento Predictivo en Endesa Madrid. 
 ¿Qué hace la Unidad? 
 En nuestro equipo de Mantenimiento Predictivo, explotamos todos los datos disponibles de los parques eólicos y centrales hidráulicas para optimizar sus costes de mantenimiento gracias a la detección de comportamientos anómalos y/o de averías. 
 Afrontamos el constante crecimiento de la industria energética con un equipo que aúna experiencia y pasión por el análisis de datos de los activos, y un marcado carácter innovador, imprescindible para mejorar nuestras capacidades de detección y la necesidad de optimizar nuestro trabajo por la competitividad existente en el sector. 
 Nuestro trabajo se fundamenta en el conocimiento profundo de los activos, el know-how en análisis de datos para predictivo y las capacidades para aplicación de inteligencia artificial. 
 Buscamos con esta vacante un líder en análisis de datos y con motivación para la aplicación de inteligencia artificial. 
 ¿En qué colaborarás? 
 El becario dará apoyo en tareas relacionadas con: 
 Supervisión de alarmas y análisis de primer nivel de datos de vibraciones, aceites y sistemas de control principalmente para mantenimiento predictivo en aerogeneradores. 
 Uso de IA generativa como apoyo para ser capaz de producir código y herramientas de visualización que permitan extraer datos, reportar resultados y automatizar trabajos. 
 Soporte a los expertos de mantenimiento predictivo en trabajos de mejora continua. 
 ¿Qué formación y conocimientos van a ser considerados? 
 ● Ingeniería Superior. Preferencia por perfiles industriales, aeronáuticos o de telecomunicaciones. 
 ● Formación en componentes mecánicos: rodamientos, cajas de engranajes. 
 ● Programación en Python. 
 ● Conocimientos de turbinas eólicas. 
 ● Español e inglés C1. 
 ¿Qué ofrecemos? 
 Prácticas en ENDESA, Programa SWING: 
 ● Ayuda de estudio de 900,00 € brutos mensuales. 
 ● Horario: Modelo de trabajo Híbrido - Jornada completa. 
 ● Centro de trabajo en España: Madrid - Ribera del Loira, 60. 
 Las becas de Endesa tienen una duración de 9 meses. Constan de dos partes, una Formación Práctica en la Empresa y una Formación Académica. 
 La Formación Práctica en la Empresa tendrá una jornada completa de lunes a viernes, un periodo de descanso de 22 días laborables al año y una ayuda al estudio de 900€ brutos. De forma paralela, se realiza la Formación Académica: Máster en Gestión Organizacional, Competencias Clave y Analítica de Datos, de la Universidad Camilo José Cela (120 ECTS ), en formato online, cuyo objetivo principal es el aprendizaje y la mejora del perfil competencial. 
 Si crees que esta beca supone una oportunidad de desarrollo para ti, ¡no dudes en postularte!

 A key part of building our business is ensuring we do it ethically and sustainably. As a financial institution, we need to know at all times what happens on our platform and whether this aligns with regulations and our risk appetite - and all of this in a scalable way.

 You have excellent communication skills in English , both written and verbal.
 You are naturally curious , you have a keen eye for detail, a proactive approach to your work, and a strong drive to understand the “why” behind what you see.
 You have a continuous improvement mindset - you proactively identify inefficiencies, suggest improvements to workflows or tools, and are motivated to help the team and processes evolve as we scale.

items.desc:
Sobre nosotros: 
 Today Mobility ofrece soluciones de movilidad de última milla para toda la industria automotriz. En esencia, transportamos con un equipo profesional de conductores los vehículos de nuestros clientes hacia y desde concesionarios, talleres y otros puntos y prestamos cualquier servicio relacionado a nuestros clientes.
 Actualmente, Today Mobility ofrece servicios a algunos de los fabricantes de automóviles más grandes del mundo y a empresas con sus propias flotas de vehículos. Como resultado, los propietarios de automóviles disfrutan de servicios de valor añadido, las empresas obtienen eficiencias en la gestión de su flota ahorrando tiempo y dinero, y los fabricantes de automóviles logran una distribución equilibrada en sus talleres y concesionarios, ofreciendo un servicio aún mejor a sus clientes.
 El ADN de Today Mobility: 
 Exigimos altos estándares de profesionalidad, espíritu de servicio y un fuerte sentido de responsabilidad en nuestro trabajo diario.
 Today Mobility es una empresa amigable. Nos movemos con agilidad y hacemos todo lo necesario para ayudar a nuestros clientes, colaboradores y socios a tener un mejor día a día. Formamos equipos que actúan con un enfoque de "nosotros" en lugar de "yo", priorizando personas que valoran los resultados colectivos por encima de los individuales.
 Nuestro ADN impregna todo lo que hacemos, y nuestra identidad se demuestra con acciones más que con palabras. Por eso, nuestros socios nos eligen.
 ------------ 
 Conductor: 
 Como conductor, además de la conducción profesional y responsable exigida para el puesto, es importante que te sientas cómodo interactuando con clientes. En Today Mobility, nuestros clientes son grandes empresas y, en ocasiones, sus clientes finales, por lo que el trato con el cliente es necesario en el día a día.
 El rol de conductor es dinámico y cada jornada laboral es diferente, por lo que es fundamental que disfrutes estar en movimiento y viajar.
 Tipo de empleo: Media Jornada con opción a Jornada Completa
 Aplicación móvil (iOS, Android): Todas las tareas de conducción y turnos de trabajo se presentan en nuestra aplicación propia. Es la herramienta de trabajo básica. Es fundamental sentirse cómodo y con soltura en el manejo de aplicaciones móviles.
 Criterios clave: 
 ✅Licencia de conducción categoría B (transmisión manual), al menos 12 puntos
 ✅Buen nivel de conducción.
 ✅Mayor de 25 años
 ✅Interés genuino por el servicio al cliente de primera calidad
 ✅Comprensión técnica de aplicaciones móviles
 ✅Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y actitud orientada a la solución
 ✅Fluidez total de español y valorable buen manejo de inglés
 ✅Buen conocimiento local
 Estás cordialmente invitado a ponerte en contacto para obtener más información sobre el puesto.
 La solicitud debe enviarse en forma de CV y carta de presentación en la aplicación a continuación.

items.card: Responsibilities: Working directly with customer teams to understand operational requirements, constraints, and failure modes, and translating those into concrete technical problems. items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Role Description NestAI builds the software and intelligence layer for autonomous defense systems: technology deployed in live operational environments where "it worked in the demo" isn't good enough. We're looking for an AI Engineer (Forward Deployment Engineering) to sit at the center of that mission: embedded directly in customer environments, at the intersection of advanced machine learning and real-world execution. This is a high-agency role with no clean spec. You'll shorten the distance between prototype and fielded capability, validating our technology against operational reality, adapting it on the fly to the constraints and data of each deployment, and feeding what you learn back into the core product. Most of what you encounter here won't have a known answer yet; you'll work it out alongside a small, senior team that has full ownership of the problems in front of it, and a product organization that takes field feedback seriously enough to ship it back into the platform in days, not quarters. We're looking for strong AI/ML engineers with real breadth across machine learning, deep learning, decision-making, and increasingly LLM-driven or agentic workflows — people who can adapt to whatever a deployment demands. Solid grounding in signal processing, whether from classical methods or modern learned/deep approaches, is particularly valuable given the sensor-heavy, real-time nature of our operating environments, but we don't expect mastery of both AI and signal processing in one person. Squads are built so that complementary backgrounds cover the full stack — you'll regularly be the strongest voice in the room on one half of a problem and learning from a teammate on the other. Day-to-Day Responsibilities: Working directly with customer teams to understand operational requirements, constraints, and failure modes, and translating those into concrete technical problems. Designing and implementing algorithms for sequential decision-making, autonomous behavior, or specialized application workflows — drawing on whichever combination of ML, LLMs, control, or signal processing the deployment calls for, often alongside teammates with complementary backgrounds. Adapting and fine-tuning models to perform reliably against real operational data, which is often noisier and more constrained than anything you've seen in the lab. Rapidly building and iterating on prototypes in the field or in customer development environments, then hardening the ones that prove out for production. Collaborating with our internal platform, embedded, and perception teams to bring field learnings back into NestOS and ensure deployed solutions are supportable long-term. Building lightweight simulations, test harnesses, or data pipelines on-site to validate algorithms before they scale. Adapting state-of-the-art research in deep learning, signal processing, reinforcement learning, or NLP/LLMs into working, production-ready code under real deployment pressure. Qualifications: Working knowledge of signal processing: either a strong background in classical Digital Signal Processing (filtering, spectral analysis, estimation) or in modern learned/deep approaches to signal data, with genuine curiosity about the other side. Strong working knowledge of machine learning theory and common deep learning architectures, with the ability to pick up new subfields (decision-making, reinforcement learning, LLMs, or signal processing) as a deployment requires. Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and modern LLM tooling (e.g., Ollama, LangChain). Strong communication skills and genuine comfort engaging with customer or non-ML stakeholders; a consultative mindset is a plus but can be developed on the job with support from the team. Ton futur environnementTu évolueras au sein d?un pôle d?ingénierie IA et Computer Vision d?excellence, en lien direct avec les data scientists, les ingénieurs MLOps et les équipes métiers. Dans un cadre de recherche appliquée et d?industrialisation sur serveurs de calcul accéléré (GPU), tu travailleras sur des corpus documentaires massifs et hétérogènes. C?est le cadre parfait pour concevoir des chaînes de traitement d?images complexes, exploiter la puissance des VLMs de dernière génération et intégrer des algorithmes de pointe au sein d?architectures conteneurisées. Tes missions clésTraitement d?Images & Modélisation Multimodale (Mode R&D & BUILD) : Développer des pipelines de prétraitement et d?analyse d?images avancés : redressement géométrique, binarisation adaptative, recalage et alignement de documents complexes (OpenCV, Python). Concevoir et entraîner des architectures de segmentation sémantique, de détection d?objets et d?extraction de zones d?intérêt (YOLO, PyTorch). Mettre en ?uvre et optimiser des solutions de reconnaissance optique et manuscrite de caractères (OCR / HTR). Explorer, évaluer et intégrer des modèles Vision-Language (VLM, écosystème Hugging Face) via des techniques de prompting multimodal et le fine-tuning de modèles open-weight. Définir des métriques d?évaluation sur mesure, caractériser les erreurs et implémenter des scores de confiance robustes pour la validation automatique. items.desc: Chez Lumys, nous développons des logiciels pensés pour les photographes professionnels. Notre mission est de simplifier leur quotidien, automatiser les tâches chronophages et leur permettre de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils aiment vraiment : CRÉER. Depuis plus de 10 ans, notre solution accompagne de nombreux studios et photographes, et certains de nos produits se sont imposés comme des références incontournables du secteur. Nous accélérons notre développement avec pour ambition d'enrichir notre offre, conquérir de nouveaux marchés et renforcer notre positionnement. Pour continuer cette aventure, nous recherchons un(e) AI Product Engineer qui a fait de l'IA son premier outil de travail : vous pilotez des agents de code pour livrer des fonctionnalités complètes, de l'idée à la validation client, en passant par les spécifications et la mise en production. Vous rejoignez une équipe pluridisciplinaire en pleine transformation. Vos missions 1 - Livrer des fonctionnalités fullstack avec l'IA (coeur du poste) piloter des agents de code comme Claude Code sur le front, le back et les données, dans le respect de l'architecture et des conventions de l'équipe, écrire des spécifications et des critères d'acceptation vérifiables, que l'agent et les tests automatisés peuvent tenir, repérer ce qui bloque et le faire corriger par l'agent : tests unitaires et de bout en bout, conventions de l'équipe, lecture des diffs quand il le faut, faire progresser l'outillage des agents — skills, instructions, workflows — à partir de ce que vous observez, mettre en production vous-même, à un rythme soutenu, puis suivre l'usage réel et itérer, documenter ce que vous livrez, pour l'équipe comme pour les utilisateurs. 2- Participer au produit comprendre le besoin à la source : échanger avec les parties prenantes, arbitrer valeur et effort, et proposer la solution la plus simple qui règle le problème, prototyper vite pour valider une idée avant de l'industrialiser, contribuer à la feuille de route, qui fixe les priorités de vos projets. Notre stack : Nouvelle plateforme : Nuxt 4 · Vue 3 / Quasar · TypeScript · Vitest · Playwright · MongoDB / Mongoose · Sentry Application en place : TypeScript · JavaScript · Node.js · Express · Vue 3 / Quasar · AngularJS · Jest · Cypress Outils : Claude Code · Git · Docker · Jira · Basecamp Profil recherché Compétences une pratique avancée et quotidienne des agents de code (Claude Code), savoir outiller vos agents (skills, instructions, workflows) et les améliorer à l'usage ; être prêt(e) à en organiser plusieurs et à vérifier que leurs contributions s'intègrent, une expérience de fonctionnalités web fullstack livrées en production sur un produit SaaS, savoir vérifier plutôt que tout relire : critères testables, lecture d'un diff et de tests TypeScript / JavaScript, cas limites et failles, assumer ce qui est livré, même quand tout le code vient des agents : seule compte la fonctionnalité livrée, le sens du besoin utilisateur, le goût des petites livraisons fréquentes ; autonome dans un cadre défini, rigoureux(se), à l'aise à l'écrit. Ce qui fera la différence connaître, voire maîtriser, Nuxt 4, Vue 3 / Quasar, Vitest, Playwright et MongoDB / Mongoose, l'envie d'évoluer vers davantage de responsabilités projet, une sensibilité à la photographie ou à l'image. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? une PME SaaS en forte croissance, un produit reconnu et utilisé par de nombreux professionnels de l'image, des projets stimulants, de l'idée à leur usage réel, une équipe technique où vos idées ont un impact réel sur le produit. Lumys entre dans une nouvelle phase de son développement, portée par une dynamique de croissanceet par une transformation profonde de notre façon de concevoir et de livrer nos produits avec l'IA. items.desc: Drive the transformation of FAMAR’s business and industrial processes by combining Lean methodologies, data engineering, artificial intelligence and automation. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you will work directly with operational teams to identify inefficiencies, redesign workflows and develop practical AI-powered solutions through to production deployment. You’ll connect fragmented systems and build reliable, secure and reusable data integrations that make enterprise data accessible. Using generative AI, intelligent agents, document intelligence and workflow automation, you’ll simplify complex processes, eliminate repetitive tasks and help teams work more effectively. What You’ll Do Work alongside business and manufacturing teams to identify bottlenecks and simplify processes using Lean principles. Build and deploy AI applications, intelligent agents, RAG solutions and automated workflows that solve practical operational challenges. Connect enterprise systems through reliable data pipelines, APIs and reusable integrations, improving data quality and accessibility. Develop document automation solutions supporting activities such as customer quotations, quality reviews and reporting. Take solutions from prototype to production using Microsoft Azure and sound engineering practices, including testing, monitoring and appropriate human oversight. Partner with IT and Quality to ensure security, data integrity and regulatory compliance where applicable. Train users, drive adoption and work with IT to establish ongoing support and maintenance. Measure results through time saved, shorter lead times, improved quality and validated savings, scaling successful solutions across FAMAR. What Makes You a Great Fit Min. 3 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI development or intelligent process automation. Proven ability to map, analyse, challenge and simplify end-to-end processes together with business teams. Strong collaboration skills, with a track record of delivering results jointly with operational, IT and Quality teams. Demonstrated experience developing and deploying production-ready AI applications in operational environments. Strong hands-on engineering capabilities, including application development, data pipelines, APIs, automated workflows and production deployment. Experience integrating diverse enterprise systems, data sources and AI solutions into business processes. Practical experience with LLM applications, intelligent agents, RAG architectures or workflow automation. Experience with cloud technologies and data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure. Ability to translate business requirements and operational challenges into practical technical solutions. Experience with ERP, QMS, CRM or other enterprise systems would be advantageous; MES or LIMS experience would be a plus for future initiatives. Experience with document intelligence or enterprise workflow platforms would be advantageous. Knowledge of GxP, Computerized System Validation and data integrity principles would be an asset. Exposure to Lean methodologies or business process improvement would be advantageous. Why join FAMAR? Bring your engineering skills to a European pharmaceutical manufacturing and development group with more than 75 years of expertise and products supplied to 80 international markets. See your work in action. Build solutions alongside the people who use them, with visible results in manufacturing, quality and everyday business operations. Make an impact across borders. Develop solutions that can be adopted across FAMAR’s European sites and corporate functions. Expand your expertise. Receive dedicated Lean training and deepen your experience at the intersection of AI, data engineering and pharmaceutical operations. Own the journey. Take projects from understanding the problem to deploying the solution and measuring the improvement. We’d love to hear your story — what you’ve built, what you’ve learned and what you’d like to do next. Apply and let’s connect.

items.desc: KeyBiz è una società di consulenza specializzata in trasformazione digitale e servizi IT per clienti enterprise. La risorsa si occuperà della progettazione e dello sviluppo di soluzioni di machine learning, pipeline dati e applicazioni GenAI su piattaforma Microsoft Azure e Microsoft Fabric, a supporto dei processi operativi e dei servizi digitali. Lavorerà su grandi volumi di dati, dalla costruzione di pipeline scalabili alla realizzazione di modelli predittivi (forecasting, anomaly detection) e di automazioni basate su LLM, integrando i risultati negli ambienti Microsoft del cliente, con una conoscenza di base delle dinamiche di Service Management. Competenze tecniche Machine Learning: LightGBM, scikit-learn, forecasting, time series, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation; Python: Python, pandas, numpy, matplotlib; Data Engineering: PySpark, Spark, ETL/ELT, data pipeline, large datasets; Microsoft Fabric: Fabric, Lakehouse, Fabric Notebooks, Spark, Delta Lake; GenAI / LLM: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, prompt engineering, RAG; Azure: Azure services, Entra ID, App Registration, authentication; Microsoft integration: Microsoft Graph API, SharePoint API, OAuth2/MSAL; Software Engineering: Git, modular Python, APIs, testing, exception handling, CI/CD. Requisiti preferenziali Minima esperienza, anche pregressa, in ambito Service Management / IT Operations (ticketing, KPI, processi ITSM); Conoscenza di ITIL- (certificazione considerata un plus); Esperienza con strumenti ITSM come ServiceNow (preferibile), Jira, Zendesk o OTRS; Esperienza nel settore telecomunicazioni; Competenze nella programmazione e integrazione sistemi. Competenze trasversali richieste Eccellente comunicazione chiara ed orientamento al cliente; Adeguate capacità di problem solving nonché gestione efficace del tempo e delle priorità; Cura tecnologica costante con attitudine all’apprendimento continuo; Mentalità internazionale ed esperienza nel lavoro in contesti multiculturali. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un ambiente internazionale con servizi digitali ad alta visibilità; Percorsi formativi dedicati su AI/GenAI e ITIL/ITSM; Sperimentazione concreta su automazioni innovative con contributo a iniziative di miglioramento continuo; Sistema welfare aziendale completo; Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa. items.desc: Date: Oct 23, 2026 Location: Warszawa, Masovian, PL, 02-146 Company: Bunge City : Warsaw State : Mazowieckie (PL-MZ) Country : Poland (PL) Requisition Number : 48930 Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for an AI Security Engineer. In this role you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed. Overview: The person in this role demonstrates a high level of professionalism, prioritizing the management and successful delivery of moderately complex AI security projects. This role will actively contribute to defining and implementing the necessary guardrails for AI usage across Bunge, and ensure our IT platforms are robust and ready for the future AI environment. Responsibilities include providing leadership to AI security professionals, contributing to resource and policy development, and addressing complex security challenges within Bunge's AI environment. Main Accountabilities: Lead and manage significant operational plans and large-scale AI security projects and initiatives with substantial independence, contributing to their successful execution and strategic alignment, including playing a key role in developing and enforcing AI usage guardrails. Provide leadership and guidance to a team of AI security professionals and support staff, supporting their growth and ensuring their effective contribution to securing AI systems. Hold accountability for the successful results of large and/or moderately complex AI security projects, ensuring objectives are met within established parameters, and actively contributing to the readiness of Bunge's IT platforms for future AI integration. Contribute valuable input on resource planning and the development of security policies specifically tailored for AI/ML systems, ensuring these policies incorporate the established guardrails for AI use and consider future IT landscape requirements. Develop strategic plans and roadmaps for AI security within the Cyber Security department, recognized as an internal expert whose contributions have significant organizational impact. Contribute to the short to mid-term (1-3 years) talent optimization plans within the AI security domain, helping to execute on strategic objectives for talent growth and development. Education and Experience: In-depth knowledge of AI/ML security principles, frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, OWASP ML Top 10), and best practices. Bachelor's degree is required, with a Master's preferred. 6 to 10 years, or an equivalent combination of education and experience Strong understanding of machine learning model vulnerabilities, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and privacy-preserving ML techniques. Proficiency in cloud security principles and architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) as they apply to AI workloads. items.desc: About Umain At Umain, we're not just creating software; we're crafting the future, one innovative project at a time. With our motto "Shape, Ship, Scale," we empower our team to not only envision the future but also play a pivotal role in building it. We're a dynamic team where you can shape the future, ship groundbreaking solutions, and scale your abilities in many different ways. The role We’re looking for a full stack developer who already works agentically. You write clear specs, run multiple agents in parallel against them, choose the right model for each job, and take full ownership of what ships. You’ll work on client products end to end, from shaping requirements with stakeholders through to production. You’ll also help define how Umain builds software with agents: the practices, tooling and standards the rest of the team uses. How we build We start from a clear spec, break the work into tasks agents can complete, run those agents in parallel, verify the output with tests, evals and review, then ship. The spec is the source of truth. Agents do much of the implementation. You own the spec, the orchestration and the quality of the result. What you’ll do Spec driven delivery Define requirements in a structured way: identify the actors, describe their use cases, then derive the features that serve them. Turn client needs into specs that both people and agents can build against: clear scope, acceptance criteria, interfaces and constraints. Keep specs, tests and code in step as the product changes. Break work into units that agents can complete and verify independently. Agent orchestration Run and coordinate agent swarms: parallel agents, subagents and specialised roles (planning, implementation, review, testing). Build and maintain the supporting tooling: MCP servers, agent skills, prompts, context files and isolated workspaces. Design the checks that keep agent output trustworthy: test coverage, evals, guardrails and human review points. Model selection and mixing Combine frontier and open-weight models to deliver results. Route work by capability, cost, latency and data sensitivity, including self-hosted or private deployments where client data requires it. Measure model performance on real tasks and change the mix when the evidence says so. Full stack engineering Build secure, scalable web applications with TypeScript, React and Next.js. Build backend services and APIs with Node.js and NestJS. Create reusable UI components using design system principles. Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS or Azure), infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines. Build observable systems with metrics, logging and tracing, including for LLM and agent behaviour in production. Clients and team Work directly with clients and cross-functional teams across design, product and data. Explain agentic delivery, its trade-offs and its limits to technical and non-technical audiences. Share what works: pair with colleagues, document patterns and help raise the agentic practice across Eidra. What we’re looking for 3+ years of professional full stack experience, with strong TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js and core web fundamentals. Hands-on experience delivering production software with coding agents (for example Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar), beyond autocomplete. Strong requirement definition experience, working from actors to use cases to feature definitions with clear acceptance criteria. A working spec driven development practice. You can show specs you’ve written and what agents built from them. Experience running multiple agents in parallel and coordinating their output. Practical experience using both frontier and open-weight models, with a view on when each is the right choice. Strong engineering judgement. You read and review agent output critically and you own the result as your own code. Comfort with ambiguity, and the consulting instinct to work it through with clients. Curiosity. The tools change monthly and you enjoy keeping up. Nice to have Building agentic features into client products: tool calling, RAG, MCP servers, multi-agent workflows. Running open-weight models in production (for example vLLM, Ollama or managed inference). LLM evaluation and observability tooling. Contributions to open source agent tooling or published writing on agentic engineering. Tailwind CSS, Storybook and design system work. Experience in a consultancy or agency setting. Don’t match every point? Apply anyway. We care more about how you think and what you’ve built than about ticking every box.

items.desc: Vi söker dig som vill vara med där utvecklingen förändras snabbast just nu – och som samtidigt vill bygga system som måste fungera på måndag morgon. På Qronos jobbar du i team hos kunder där fel kostar: banker, försäkringsbolag, energi, industri och offentlig sektor i Skåne och Europa. Just nu är det finanssektorn som växer mest hos oss. Teamen sitter i Malmö och arbetar direkt i kundernas plattformar, i .NET och Azure, med stora datamängder och system som många människor är beroende av varje dag. Våra kunder förlänger och utökar inför 2027, och därför behöver vi bli fler. Vi arbetar AI-first, tillsammans med kunderna. AI-verktygen är med i hela flödet – när vi skriver krav, kod och tester och när vi granskar varandras arbete – och vi ser skillnaden i takt och kvalitet. Men vi ser också att det ställer högre krav på utvecklaren, inte lägre: du måste veta vad du ska lita på och vad du ska läsa två gånger. Det är den kombinationen vi letar efter. Någon som tycker att det är den roligaste tiden att vara utvecklare på länge, och som ändå står för varje rad som går i produktion. Vad du kommer att göra Du bygger backend i C#/.NET i Azure – tjänster, API: er och integrationer mot kundens övriga system. Data är en stor del av arbetet: relationsdatabaser, lagrade procedurer, stora volymer och frågor som måste vara snabba och rätt. Du sätter upp pipelines, följer koden hela vägen ut i produktion och felsöker när den beter sig oväntat. Varje ändring går via pull request, och du granskar lika mycket som du blir granskad. Allt oftare bygger du också nya saker med språkmodeller i kärnan: agenter som anropar verktyg, integrationer, utvärdering och spårbarhet så att det håller i en reglerad miljö. Det är här mycket av innovationen hos våra kunder sker just nu, och du är med från början. Du arbetar på engelska med kundens arkitekter, produktägare och utvecklare, och på plats i Malmö med dina kollegor. Vem du är Du har byggt i C#/.NET i produktion – från ett år och uppåt. Vi har plats både för dig med åtta år bakom dig och för dig som är tidig i karriären men redan levererar på riktigt. Det som avgör är vad du har byggt och hur, inte antalet år. Du har jobbat i Azure eller har egna projekt som visar att du snabbt tar dig dit. Du är trygg i SQL och tycker att data är intressant, inte bara något som ligger bakom API: et. Du har arbetat i tjänstebaserade arkitekturer, eller förstår dem tillräckligt väl för att kunna säga när de är rätt och när de bara blir krångliga. Du skriver tester för att du vill sova gott, inte för att någon kräver det. Du använder AI i ditt dagliga utvecklingsarbete – Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot eller något annat – och har egna åsikter om var det hjälper och var det skapar skuld. Du har byggt eller provat något med språkmodeller, verktygsanrop eller RAG, även om det bara var på fritiden. Och du vill lära dig mer: nya domäner, nya verktyg, nya sätt att arbeta. Det är det som gör att man håller i det här yrket. Du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande – högskola, universitet eller yrkeshögskola. Du talar och skriver svenska och engelska obehindrat, har EU-medborgarskap, och bor i Skåne eller vill flytta hit. Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet från bank, försäkring eller annan reglerad verksamhet, om du kan TypeScript och React, om du har byggt LLM-integrationer som faktiskt används, och om du har en civilingenjörs- eller masterexamen. Inget av det är krav. Ett team, flera roller Vi anställer både utvecklare som vill gå djupt i .NET, Azure och data i kundernas kärnsystem, och utvecklare som vill bygga nya AI-drivna applikationer och verktyg. Vi behöver också någon som trivs mitt emellan – som ser till att det ena teamet lär sig blir vardag i det andra. Att jobba hos oss Uppdragen här räknas i år, inte månader. Det är så man blir riktigt bra på en domän, och det är så kunderna lär sig lita på en. Vi är ett litet, ägarlett bolag sedan 2010. Du träffar VD varje vecka, inte varje kvartal, och kollegorna runt dig har levererat affärskritiska system i decennier och svarar när du ringer mitt i ett problem. Kontoret ligger på EDEN i Hyllie, två minuter från stationen och tolv från Kastrup. Frukost tillsammans på torsdagar, fredagsmys i huset varje vecka. Mer om hur vi tänker kring uppdrag och utveckling: qronos.se/work-at-qronos Vi läser ansökningar löpande och tillsätter när vi hittar rätt, så skicka in din i dag hellre än i morgon. Vi undanber oss kontakt från annonssäljare och rekryteringsbolag.

items.desc: Are you passionate about pharmacometrics and model-informed drug development? Do you have experience with translational and clinical population PK/PD modeling and support of regulatory submissions? If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician. We are looking for a hands-on pharmacometrician who combines scientific excellence with strategic thinking and wants broad ownership across programs. Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs. At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets. Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions. We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup. The team includes in-house pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and external consultants working remotely. Your key responsibilities will be to: Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design. Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions. Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure–response analysis, and quantitative benefit–risk assessment. Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations. Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements. Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department’s modeling and reporting environment. Qualifications and Skills: You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development. Furthermore, you have: Hands-on experience with NONMEM and R applied to population PK/PD model development, simulation, and model-informed drug development. Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard. Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions. Additional experience that would be an advantage : Industrial experience supporting regulatory interactions or submissions, including knowledge of relevant FDA, EMA, and ICH expectations for pharmacometric analyses. items.desc: Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing. That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building. Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time. One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion. That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch. If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters. We're looking for people who want to build that future with us. The role You'll be the person who takes a video from idea to finished file — on your own. Say we need a product walkthrough of a new Veo feature. Here's what that looks like for you: Plan: Set the shoot date and book the product designer who built the feature. Find the story: Interview them and write the script. Set up: Light and frame the set. Shoot: Run the shoot on our two Blackmagic Pocket Cinema Camera 6Ks and direct the person on camera. Finish: Edit, grade, mix, subtitle, and export every format we need. Nobody hands you a shot list. Nobody needs to check in halfway. You'll also use AI throughout your work. Some shots you'll generate in tools like Higgsfield instead of filming them. Some steps — transcripts, rough cuts, subtitles, versioning — you'll hand to AI so you can spend your time on the parts that need your eye. You'll join Veo's Owned & Creative team in Copenhagen, working alongside graphic designers, a video producer focused on AI-generated ads, and the wider marketing team. What you'll do Own production end-to-end Take a brief (or spot the need yourself) and turn it into a production plan: concept, timeline, locations, people, and gear. Write scripts, talking points, and storyboards. Run the shoot Set up the set: lighting, sound, framing, and camera settings. Operate our 2× Blackmagic Pocket Cinema Camera 6K setup, including multi-camera interviews and B-roll. Direct and interview people on camera — most of them aren't actors — so they come across confident and natural, and stick to the script when they need to. Shoot on location, in studio, and out on the pitch. Finish the video Edit in DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro: story, pacing, color grading, sound mix, graphics, subtitles, and CTAs. Deliver multi-format versions for paid social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Instagram), YouTube, veo.co, and email. Organize and archive footage and finished assets in our DAM (Frontify) so the whole team can find and reuse them. Make AI part of how you work Generate shots, B-roll, and scenes with AI video tools such as Higgsfield, and blend them with live-action footage. Use AI to speed up your workflow — automated transcripts and rough cuts, text-based editing, AI subtitles, script drafts, and fast versioning for different markets and formats. Keep testing new tools and share what works with the team. L'entreprise Sopra Steria recherche actuellement des profils : Sopra Steria, acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe avec 56000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services numériques et d’édition de logiciels. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des technologies innovantes à une approche résolument collaborative. Sopra Steria place l’humain au centre de son action et s’engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du digital pour construire un avenir positif. En 2023, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 5,8 milliards d’euros. The world is how we shape it \n\n Description de l'entreprise La Business Line Cybersécurité de Sopra Steria est présente en Europe avec plus de 2500 experts - dont plus de la moitié en France -, notre mission est d’apporter des solutions et des services de confiance aux acteurs publics et privés les plus exposés pour assurer la résilience de leurs systèmes critiques et protéger leur patrimoine numérique sensible. Au-delà de la forte présence européenne, la division cybersécurité se positionne et se développe en Amérique du nord (Toronto), ainsi qu’en Asie Pacifique (Singapour). Nous proposons 3 domaines d’offres : Prévention, Protection & détection et réponse. Ces 3 domaines s’articulent les uns avec les autres pour apporter à nos clients une information homogène et des capacités de décisions éclairées par la réalité opérationnelle. Cette approche s’appuie sur notre méthodologie transverse centrée sur Mitre Att&ck. Sopra Steria se base sur des capacités souveraines éprouvées et reconnues pour renforcer votre résilience face aux cyberattaques et accélérer votre transformation digitale. Une solution de confiance de bout-en-bout Une approche « security by design » centrée sur les risques métiers et transverse à l’organisation. Un engagement dans le développement de solutions souveraines innovantes. Chaque individu peut avoir un impact sur la réponse à ces nouveaux défis en matière de cyber risques. Chacun contribue à la fois individuellement et collectivement à sécuriser nos clients et la société tout en maintenant sa croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Description du poste Au sein de la value center Protect, rejoignez une équipe experte en cybersécurité pour concevoir, sécuriser et faire évoluer les architectures de connectivité (LAN, WAN, Cloud, Internet) pour des clients majeurs. Vous garantissez un accès réseau fiable, sécurisé et conforme aux exigences de cybersécurité (Zero Trust, segmentation, micro-segmentation, protection des flux). Votre rôle et vos missions : Vous assurez la conception et le déploiement d’architectures sécurisées (LAN/WAN/Cloud/SASE/SDWAN/Interconnexions). Vous réalisez la mise en œuvre et la gestion des firewalls, VPN, Proxy, SASE/SSE, inspection TLS, IDS/IPS, NAC. Vous appliquez les principes Zero Trust et de segmentation. Vous prenez en charge la gestion des incidents, audits, revues de configuration, amélioration continue. Vous produisez la documentation technique et d’exploitation. Vous accompagnez les équipes projets et clients sur leurs besoins de connectivité sécurisée. Vous contribuez à l’industrialisation des solutions (automatisation, IA). Des livrables attendus incluent des architectures sécurisées, des politiques de sécurité, des dossiers d’exploitation, des rapports d’audit ainsi que des recommandations associées. Le poste peut nécessiter des astreintes et HNO. Ce que nous vous proposons : Un accord télétravail pour télétravailler jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine selon vos missions. Un package avantages intéressants : une mutuelle, un CSE, des titres restaurants, un accord d’intéressement, des primes vacances et cooptation. Des opportunités de carrières multiples : plus de 30 familles de métiers, autant de passerelles à imaginer ensemble. Des centaines de formations pour développer vos compétences et évoluer au sein du Groupe. Des plateformes de formations en autonomie pour préparer vos certifications et accompagner votre développement personnel. La possibilité de s'engager auprès de notre fondation ou de notre partenaire « Vendredi ». L'opportunité de rejoindre le collectif Tech'Me UP (formations, conférences, veille, et bien plus encore…).
