items.desc: Chez Smile, on construit des solutions numériques ouvertes, performantes et durables, pour des acteurs majeurs de l’industrie, des services et du grand public. Ici, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la conception et l'évolution de leurs plateformes digitales à très forte audience et forte charge. Pas de techno imposée pour l’effet vitrine — les bons outils, maîtrisés de bout en bout. 1 500 experts à travers l’Europe, et une vraie culture de la qualité logicielle. La Mission En régie, intégré(e) à une équipe pluridisciplinaire en méthodologie Agile (Scrum / SAFe), vous concevez et développez les API et les microservices back-end en Node.js au cœur des écosystèmes applicatifs. Votre rôle se joue en trois temps : Concevoir et développer le back-end Vous concevez et développez des API REST et GraphQL performantes et hautement scalables en Node.js (TypeScript / Express / NestJS) pour supporter les fortes montées de charge. Vous mettez en œuvre une architecture orientée événements et microservices (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Redis) : couplage lâche, faible latence et cohérence des données. Vous appliquez les principes SOLID, les design patterns et l’architecture hexagonale / DDD — c’est vous le garant de la solidité de la conception. Garantir la qualité et fiabiliser Vous pratiquez le TDD / BDD et construisez une stratégie de test complète : unitaires, intégration, contractuels et E2E (Jest, Supertest, Mocha). Vous appliquez le Clean Code, le refactoring continu et les bonnes pratiques de sécurité (OWASP, gestion des identités et accès). Vous documentez l’architecture (Confluence, OpenAPI/Swagger) et livrez des services prêts pour la production. Déployer et faire progresser Vous déployez et gérez les microservices dans un environnement Cloud (AWS / GCP / Kubernetes) via une chaîne CI/CD automatisée (GitLab CI / GitHub Actions). Vous intégrez les assistants de code IA (GitHub Copilot) à votre quotidien : accélération, génération de tests et refactoring, avec un regard critique sur les résultats. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes Front, Ops et produit. Smile s’engage pour un environnement où la diversité est une force et l’inclusion un pilier. Chaque talent est reconnu, respecté et encouragé à aller plus loin. Votre environnement technique Langages / Frameworks : Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Express.js Architecture : Microservices, Event-Driven (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Pub/Sub), REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI/Swagger, architecture hexagonale Bases de données : PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis Cloud & DevOps : AWS / GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) Qualité & Tests : Jest, Supertest, SonarQube, TDD Outillage IA : GitHub Copilot, assistants LLM Votre Profil Vous avez 4 ans d’expérience minimum en développement back-end Node.js / TypeScript et le goût du code propre, scalable et testé. On parie que vous cochez aussi ces cases : Maîtrise experte de Node.js, TypeScript et de la conception d’API RESTful et GraphQL. Expérience des architectures microservices, de la gestion du cache (Redis) et des flux événementiels. Pratique poussée du TDD et d’une stratégie de test complète. Sensibilité aux problématiques Cloud / DevOps (Docker, CI/CD) et d'optimisation de performances. Pratique des méthodes Agiles (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe). Rémunération : Selon profil et expérience. Votre future Agence Avec plus de 400 passionnés, l’agence d'Asnières-sur-Seine (notre siège) est un véritable terrain de jeu pour les experts et les curieux qui veulent progresser et innover. Pourquoi Smile ! Notre management de proximité par des pairs favorise l’échange et la mise en place d’un parcours de carrière adapté. Parce que le secteur du numérique est en perpétuel mouvement, Smile s'engage à faire de vous un expert dans votre domaine, grâce à une offre de formation complète : accès à une plateforme d'e-learning, financement de certifications, outils de partage de connaissances... Vous pourrez participer au développement de Smile via notre programme de cooptation interne rémunéré, allant jusqu’à 3000 €. Votre année sera animée par des événements groupe et agence : convention annuelle, participation à des salons, summer party, afterworks formels & informels. Et aussi : mutuelle & transports pris en charge à 50 %, minimum 9 RTT/an, prime de vacances, Tickets Restaurant (9,50 €, pris en charge à 55 %), CSE dynamique. Les prochaines étapes Premier contact : Un échange téléphonique pour discuter de vos aspirations et de ce que nous pouvons vous offrir. Rencontre : L'occasion de faire connaissance et d'explorer votre parcours professionnel. Échange métier : Une discussion avec un de nos experts pour évaluer vos compétences et définir vos objectifs. Bienvenue dans l'équipe ! Et si ça matche entre nous, nous serons ravis de vous accueillir pour une aventure passionnante. Alors, prêt(e) à rejoindre l'équipe ?

items.card: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Techniques de l'Informatique et de la Microélectronique pour l'Architecture des systèmes intégrés Type de Contrat CDD Doctorant Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 38031 GRENOBLE Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Date limite de candidature : vendredi 13 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste
items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Techniques de l'Informatique et de la Microélectronique pour l'Architecture des systèmes intégrés Type de Contrat CDD Doctorant Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 38031 GRENOBLE Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Date limite de candidature : vendredi 13 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Sujet De Thèse La caractérisation de la sécurité des systèmes embarqués en 'boite noire' ou 'boite grise' face aux attaques Side-Channel requiert fréquemment une phase préparatoire de Reverse-Engineering, qui peut être particulièrement chronophage, notamment sur un Sytem-on-Chip (SoC) complexe que l’on peut retrouver sur smartphone ou dans l’automobile. Cette phase peut, par exemple, consister en la détection d’une primitive cryptographique au sein de mesures Side-Channel pour une future attaque par observation, ou d’une routine cible pour une attaque par perturbation. L’objectif de cette thèse est de développer une méthodologie et des outils non-profilés permettant l’automatisation de cette phase de détection, tout en permettant d’exploiter la connaissance a priori d’un potentiel attaquant. La thématique du Reverse-Engineering non-profilé via Side-Channel gravite autour de problèmes bien connus en traitement de 'timeseries' comme la découverte de motifs, découverte d’anomalies, ou la segmentation sémantique. Un des objectifs de cette thèse sera ainsi de traiter ces problématiques en prenant en compte les particularités des attaques par Side-Channel sur SoC, comme le bruit et le jitter dans les mesures, et l’a priori d’un attaquant sur le code exécuté et les données manipulées. De ce fait, l’investigation d’une méthodologie alliant machine learning, modèles probabilistes et métriques exactes sur les 'timeseries', constitue une des pierres angulaires de cette thèse. Les scenarii couverts par les problématiques de recherche posés par cette thèse sont multiples. Quelques exemples significatifs, en plus de la préparation à des attaques physiques classiques, sont le reverse-engineering de bootloader ou la découverte d’architecture de réseaux de neurones. Votre Environnement de Travail Le laboratoire TIMA est un laboratoire public de recherche sous la tutelle du CNRS, de Grenoble INP et de l’UGA. Il est situé à Grenoble, sur le site Viallet de Grenoble INP-UGA (46 avenue Félix Viallet). TIMA est une équipe cosmopolite de 150 personnes environ, avec des chercheurs du monde entier (chercheurs permanents, enseignants-chercheurs, doctorants, post-doctorants, CDD ingénieurs, collaborateurs scientifiques, invités et stagiaires). Les sujets de recherches couvrent la spécification, la conception, la vérification, le test, les outils CAO et méthodes d’aide à la conception pour les systèmes intégrés. Une grande partie de la recherche s’effectue dans le contexte de projets coopératifs, avec des partenaires industriels et académiques, financés par des contrats régionaux, nationaux et européens. Le laboratoire entretient ainsi de forts contacts avec le milieu industriel et académique qui réclament une implication professionnelle tant sur le plan logistique que relationnel. Contraintes et risques Le poste est localisé en Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR), ce qui implique une procédure administrative préalable d’autorisation d’accès. Sites de travail : TIMA, CEA Grenoble Rémunération et avantages Rémunération La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Congés et RTT annuels 44 jours Pratique et Indemnisation du TT Pratique et indemnisation du TT Transport Prise en charge à 75% du coût et forfait mobilité durable jusqu’à 300€ À propos de l’offre Référence de l’offre UMR5159-VIVGIO-008 Section(s) CN / Domaine de recherche Sciences informatiques : signaux, images, langues, automatique, robotique, interactions, systèmes intégrés matériel-logiciel À propos du CNRS Le CNRS est un acteur majeur de la recherche fondamentale à une échelle mondiale. Le CNRS est le seul organisme français actif dans tous les domaines scientifiques. Sa position unique de multi-spécialiste lui permet d’associer les différentes disciplines pour affronter les défis les plus importants du monde contemporain, en lien avec les acteurs du changement. Nous avons aujourd'hui une vingtaine de solutions SICONIA déployées en Europe, Afrique du Nord, Australie, Brésil et Canada. Nous engageons une évolution majeure de SICONIA en reconstruisant la plateforme sur de nouvelles bases Cloud Native et avec une approche de développement AI-native. Cette nouvelle architecture permettra notamment la collecte et le traitement en temps réel des données issues des compteurs communicants, avec de forts enjeux de montée en charge et de résilience. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Contribuer à des solutions Smart Grid permettant une gestion plus efficace des réseaux et des ressources énergétiques. Concevoir une plateforme Cloud Native répondant à des problématiques de systèmes distribués, IoT et traitement de données à grande échelle. Vous intervenez sur les différentes dimensions de l’architecture : découpage fonctionnel, microservices, données, échanges entre services, interfaces, sécurité, résilience, observabilité et infrastructure Cloud Native, et portez les choix d’architecture auprès des équipes. Définir l’architecture des traitements distribués et des flux de données à forte volumétrie, notamment avec Kafka. Définir les principes d’architecture autour de Kubernetes : déploiement, résilience, sécurité, observabilité et capacité à monter en charge. Définir les exigences de performance, disponibilité et sécurité de la plateforme. Piloter les choix technologiques et les revues d’architecture, et accompagner techniquement les équipes de développement. Garantir la cohérence des choix d’architecture dans la durée. Profil recherché : Vous disposez d’une solide expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de l’architecture de suites logicielles Cloud Native complexes. Vous avez une vision d’ensemble de l’architecture logicielle et ne vous limitez pas aux dimensions Kubernetes, Cloud ou DevOps. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : L’architecture de microservices et systèmes distribués. Java / Spring Boot et les problématiques de performance et de concurrence associées. Kafka et les architectures basées sur l’échange asynchrone de données et d’événements. Les architectures de données, notamment autour de PostgreSQL. Kubernetes, Docker/Podman et Helm, ainsi que les principes de déploiement, résilience, sécurité, observabilité et scalabilité associés. La définition et le pilotage des exigences non fonctionnelles : performance, …

items.desc: À propos de Via Sana Médecins généralistes et spécialistes, kinés, psychologues, ostéopathes…, tous les professionnels de santé font face au même problème : trouver un espace où exercer. Via Sana repense l’expérience de la santé en libéral en proposant de magnifiques cabinets tout équipés, louables d’une journée par semaine jusqu’au temps plein, des outils digitaux et une véritable communauté de professionnels. Depuis la création en juin 2020, Via Sana est devenu le leader de son secteur avec plus de 70 superbes centres ouverts dans les grandes villes de France, plus de 650 professionnels de santé hébergés et une levée de fonds de près de 16 millions d’euros pour accélérer notre développement dans toute la France. Chaque mois, ce sont près de 45 000 patients qui se rendent dans un cabinet Via Sana. Notre mission ? Améliorer le quotidien de dizaines de milliers de professionnels de santé en les déchargeant du non-médical afin qu’ils puissent enfin se concentrer sur leurs patients. Vos missions Un centre qui tourne bien, c’est un lieu impeccable, sûr et fonctionnel : les équipements marchent, les incidents sont compris rapidement, les interventions sont bien coordonnées et les praticiens peuvent se concentrer sur leurs patients. Chez Via Sana, chaque Care Ops est responsable d’un portefeuille de centres . Le nombre de centres, la complexité des sujets confiés et le niveau d’autonomie attendu évoluent selon votre expérience, votre séniorité et votre maîtrise démontrée. Si vous êtes junior, vous démarrez avec un portefeuille adapté pour apprendre vite et bien. Si vous avez déjà de l’expérience, vous prenez rapidement plus d’autonomie, des sujets plus complexes et un périmètre plus large. Votre métier ressemble souvent à une enquête : une photo, un message incomplet, un bruit décrit au téléphone, l’historique d’un équipement, un retour d’agent technique ou le plan d’une installation… À vous de rassembler les pièces du puzzle, de distinguer les faits des hypothèses et de construire le bon plan d’action. Concrètement, cela passe par les missions suivantes : Piloter votre portefeuille de centres : prendre en charge les incidents du quotidien, les prioriser et suivre chaque dossier jusqu’à sa résolution complète, sans rien laisser disparaître entre deux relances. Enquêter et poser un diagnostic à distance : poser les bonnes questions, analyser les photos, vidéos, plans et historiques, formuler des hypothèses et distinguer ce qui peut être résolu immédiatement de ce qui nécessite une expertise terrain. Apprendre et renforcer vos fondamentaux techniques : progresser sur les sujets d’accès, plomberie, chauffage, climatisation, électricité, équipements et petits travaux, jusqu’à pouvoir piloter en autonomie les incidents courants et certains dossiers plus complexes. Transformer le diagnostic en action : choisir le bon intervenant, produire un brief précis, organiser son passage, anticiper les informations et accès nécessaires, suivre les délais et contrôler la qualité de la résolution. Rendre les problèmes techniques compréhensibles : structurer les faits, expliquer votre raisonnement, clarifier les incertitudes et formuler des consignes ou prochaines étapes suffisamment claires pour que chaque interlocuteur puisse agir sans ambiguïté. Piloter des dossiers longs ou multi-interlocuteurs : selon votre niveau d’autonomie, coordonner équipes internes, agents techniques, prestataires, propriétaires et syndics sans perdre l’historique ni les prochaines étapes. Escalader avec discernement : identifier les informations manquantes, exposer ce qui a déjà été vérifié et solliciter la bonne expertise avec une question précise plutôt que transmettre un problème brut. Faire progresser les standards de l’équipe : renseigner les outils de suivi, enrichir les procédures et FAQ, documenter les causes récurrentes et partager vos apprentissages avec l’équipe. Maîtriser l’IA comme un outil de travail professionnel : l’utiliser pour structurer une enquête, challenger un diagnostic, croiser des informations, produire de meilleurs briefs et automatiser les tâches répétitives — tout en restant responsable du raisonnement, des sources et de la qualité finale. Rémunération : 34 000,00€ à 40 000,00€ par an Avantages : Prise en charge du transport quotidien RTT Travail à domicile occasionnel Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (75009 Paris)

items.desc: Type de recrutement : ‎ Stage ‎ Domaine de compétences : Donnée ‎ Ville : Paris ‎ Département : Paris ‎ Description du poste: ‎ Présentation du service La Direction Générale des Statistiques, des Études et l’International (DGSEI), est l'une des directions générales cœur de métier de la Banque de France. Elle a pour missions principales de contribuer à la prise de décision du gouvernement de la Banque en matière de politique monétaire et financière, d'exploiter, analyser et diffuser des statistiques dans un grand nombre de domaines tels que les statistiques monétaires et financières, les enquêtes de conjoncture, la balance des paiements. La DGSEI est composée de 8 directions, d'une cellule dédiée aux relations IA avec les métiers, ainsi que d'une cellule dédiée à l'économie du climat et d'un pôle scientifique. Au sein de la Direction de l’Informatique métiers et des Moyens (DIM) en charge des fonctions support (RH, formation, communication, budget, maîtrise d’ouvrage informatique, appui aux réunions internationales), le Service de Maîtrise d’Ouvrage pour les Études, l’International et les Statistiques (SMEIS) de la DGSEI assure la déclinaison opérationnelle de la stratégie d’évolution du système d’information de la Direction Générale en liaison étroite avec les métiers de la Banque de France. Pour ce faire, nos principales missions sont de : Décliner la Stratégie DGSEI en une trajectoire d’évolution du système d’information par paliers de création de valeur en cohérence avec les orientations DGSI (Direction Générale du Système d’Information) Piloter le portefeuille des actions d’évolution du SI : suivi des instances de gouvernance, du planning, des risques et des budgets associés. Conduire des activités projets et maintenance : recueil des besoins, rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles, travaux de qualification et d’acceptation de logiciel, conduite du changement Description de la mission confiée dans le cadre du stage Au sein de l’équipe chargée de la refonte des systèmes de gestion des référentiels des entités légales, vous contribuerez aux travaux liés à la reprise des données : Extraction des données présentes dans les bases Oracle et Hive des systèmes actuels, essentiellement via des requêtes SQL ; Analyse de la qualité de ces données, notamment par des contrôles fonctionnels et métiers et la comparaison avec des données de référence présentes dans d’autres gisements de données, via des scripts Python ou R et des requêtes sur les données, avec des outils IA si applicables ; Propositions de remédiation des anomalies de qualité détectées, via des scripts Python et R ou des injections de données ; Préparation des fichiers d’import vers le nouveau système, en Python et R ; Exécution des tests et des recettes des procédures développées ; Mise en place de tableaux de bord et d’indicateurs pour le suivi des actions ; Participation aux ateliers et points de suivi avec les acteurs impliqués ; Rédaction de la documentation ; Le poste est à pourvoir à partir de novembre 2026 pour 4 à 6 mois ‎ Profil recherché: ‎ Apports du stage Préparation à la prise d’un poste d’analyste de données / data engineer : Participation aux phases de qualification d’un logiciel produit dans le cadre d’un projet informatique dans une perspective maîtrise d’ouvrage ; Approfondissement de la démarche de tests d’application en vue d’accroître la qualité du logiciel ; Participation aux phases opérationnelles d’initialisation et de reprise de données en prévision de la mise en production d’un projet informatique ; Profil Diplôme préparé : école d’ingénieur ou Master liés à la donnée et au développement informatique Compétences : bases de données relationnelles et requêtes SQL, Python et R Qualités : appétence pour la donnée, capacité d’analyse, rigueur, autonomie, goût pour le travail en équipe, aisance à l’oral et à l’écrit Lieu du contrat : Paris, 37 rue du Louvre, 75002 PARIS ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ La Banque de France est une institution socialement responsable , attachée au respect de la diversité sous toutes ses formes, à la lutte contre les discriminations, à favoriser la parité Femme/Homme et à garantir un environnement de travail de qualité. C?est un cadre idéal pour relever des défis de modélisation à grande échelle, participer à l?instruction d?enjeux métiers majeurs et évoluer au sein d?une organisation agile orientée vers l?excellence technologique. Réaliser les analyses de l?existant et les études d?impacts sur le SI Risques et Finance. Élaborer la StoryMap des besoins, proposer les chiffrages associés et définir le planning des travaux. Contribuer activement aux comités de projet et assurer le reporting de l?activité. Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles générales et détaillées pour les données implémentées. Organiser et animer les ateliers de travail, puis produire les notes de synthèse et comptes-rendus associés. Homologation & Qualité : Définir la stratégie d?homologation et concevoir les scénarios de tests. Piloter les phases de validation et formaliser les procès-verbaux (PV) de d?homologation. Expérience : Tu justifies d?une expérience significative dans le domaine de l?IT, avec une forte composante data. Compétences Techniques Impératives : Maîtrise des environnements Big Data (Hadoop) et des bases de données NoSQL. Excellente pratique de la modélisation objet (UML). Maîtrise de la méthodologie Agile Scrum. Utilisation experte de la suite Office 365 (Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint). Langues : Anglais professionnel opérationnel. Tes atoutsEsprit d?Analyse et de Synthèse : Capacité à modéliser des flux de données complexes et à en extraire des spécifications claires. items.desc: Job Description About Cognex Cognex Corporation is the world’s leading provider of industrial machine vision systems, sensors, and enterprise barcode readers. Our technology infuses artificial intelligence and advanced optics into manufacturing and logistics processes, helping global automation leaders eliminate defects and track parts seamlessly. We operate in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment where innovation, persistence, and teamwork drive our unmatched industry success. Role Overview As an Account Development Representative, you will own the localized execution of our Account-Based Marketing (ABM) outbound strategy . Operating within your assigned geographic region (e.g., Americas, EMEA, or Greater China), you will partner intensely with regional sales teams to break into high-priority enterprise accounts. In addition to traditional high-value outbound prospecting, you will act as a modern revenue technologist. You will monitor, manage, and optimize automated digital agents executing front-line sequences, scaling our reach while maintaining brand and conversion quality. Essential Functions & Responsibilities ABM Outbound Strategy Execution: Execute highly tailored multi-channel outbound campaigns (phone, personalized email, social selling) targeting tier-one accounts within your assigned geographic region. AI & Automation Agent Management: Supervise, review, and optimize automated outbound and inbound digital agents. Tweak sequences, manage intent-trigger responses, and continuously refine performance data. Tight Sales & Marketing Alignment: Maintain a high cadence of collaboration with Field Sales Directors and Account Engineers to align on active campaigns, account priorities, and target buying centers. On-Site Seminar Management: Drive attendance for on-site seminars at top-tier corporate accounts. Partner with local Field Sales and Technical Application Engineers who deliver the content. Intent-Driven Prospecting: Utilize intent intelligence platforms to identify accounts showing active buying signals and deploy rapid-response outreach. Account Mapping: Research and navigate highly complex industrial organizations to pinpoint key decision-makers—such as Plant Managers, Automation Engineers, Maintenance and Quality Directors. Data & Tooling Integrity: Rigorously track and log all prospect interactions, account hierarchies, and pipeline metrics within our modern sales technology stack. Technical Product Expertise : Develop and maintain knowledge of Cognex machine vision systems, AI software, industrial sensors, and barcode reading solutions to effectively qualify customer applications. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Your performance and impact will be measured across the following core metrics: Target Account Engagement: Number of net-new relevant contacts and qualified meetings secured within designated target ABM accounts. New Target Account Acquisition: Success rate in penetrating and opening up previously unengaged priority target accounts. Pipeline Contribution: Total dollar value of qualified sales pipelines generated through outbound efforts and optimized automation sequences. Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Language Proficiency: Must be fluent in English and German. High Technology Fluency: Advanced proficiency in navigating enterprise-grade revenue tech stacks. You must be comfortable managing workflows across systems like Salesforce CRM, 6sense, Qualified, ZoomInfo, and Gong. Automation Familiarity: Comfort or direct experience monitoring automated sales sequences, marketing automation tools, or AI-driven outreach platforms. ABM Methodology Mastery: Deep understanding of Account-Based Marketing concepts, including multi-threaded prospecting, persona-based messaging, and identifying buying committees. Analytical Mindset: Ability to read data dashboards, spot drop-offs in sequence performance, and proactively pivot messaging to optimize open and conversion rates. Technical Solution Knowledge : Ability to understand and articulate complex technical products and qualify customer applications. Minimum Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related industrial discipline. Fluency in English (C1 or C2) Fluency in German (C1 or C2) 1–3 years of experience in an outbound B2B tech BDR/SDR role, with a documented track record of executing ABM frameworks. Experience selling into industrial manufacturing, logistics, automation, or enterprise hardware sectors is highly desirable. Office location: An der RaumFabrik 33 B. 76227 Karlsruhe

items.desc: About the role At Agile Robots, we build intelligent robotic systems that learn from high-quality human demonstrations. As we scale our data collection site, we are looking for a Project Coordinator (m/f/d) to organize daily operations and make sure the site delivers the right data, on time and at the right quality. In this role, you will plan and supervise daily work on site, coordinate teleoperators and engineers, track KPIs, and keep tasks, materials, equipment and robots ready for production. Depending on your strengths, you will take ownership of one focus area: site operations & KPIs, new task setup & quality control, site administration, or production & resource planning. This position is ideal for an organized, proactive person who enjoys working with people and numbers, and who wants to help build a new kind of operation at the intersection of robotics and AI. Your Responsibilities New Task Setup & Quality Control (Main Focus) Own the end-to-end setup of new data collection tasks together with R&D: requirements, task instructions, scene and object setup, and pilot runs. Translate research requirements into clear, step-by-step SOPs and success criteria that operators can follow consistently. Train and onboard teleoperators on new tasks, and verify they reach the required quality before production starts. Define quality standards and run regular QC on collected data (sampling, reviews, labeling checks); document defects and root causes. Give structured feedback to operators and R&D, track quality metrics, and follow up until issues are resolved. Continuously improve task procedures and QC workflows to raise data quality and collection efficiency. Site Operations & KPI Tracking Support daily site planning and shift coordination for teleoperators. Contribute to KPI tracking and reporting (e.g., output volume, success rate, robot uptime). Site Administration Support materials and equipment inventory, site logistics and staff administration. Production & Resource Planning Support robot deployment planning and spare part coordination with service engineers. Essential Skills Degree in business, engineering, industrial engineering or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 1+ years of experience in project coordination, operations, production planning or team supervision. Strong organizational skills; able to manage several priorities in a fast-moving environment. Confident with Excel / Google Sheets and data-driven KPI reporting. Good communication skills in English. Beneficial Skills Experience in data labeling / data collection operations, manufacturing or lab environments. Knowledge of quality management, lean or process improvement methods. Interest in robotics, AI or technical products. Experience with project management or ticketing tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Notion). What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment About us Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us! We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

SUPO, where required) Why this role matters: The SAR Training Specialist within ICEYE’s Data line of business will support the development, customization, and global delivery of technical training programs to customers across the world. This role enables customers, particularly in the Defence and Intelligence (D&I) sector, to effectively understand and apply ICEYE’s SAR capabilities, products, and services to support mission-critical objectives. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Your day-to-day responsibilities Develop, maintain and tailor training programs covering remote sensing principles, SAR fundamentals, and the practical application of ICEYE’s technology across operational use cases. Deliver both in-person and virtual training sessions to a global customer base, adapting materials and delivery approaches to suit varying levels of technical proficiency and requirements. Align training content with evolving product features and customer needs, ensuring materials reflect the latest advancements in ICEYE’s portfolio of offerings. Support customer adoption and operational readiness through hands-on instruction, live demonstrations, and scenario-based learning that emphasizes real-world use. Collaborate with internal teams, including Product and Engineering, to ensure training materials are accurate, current, and aligned with broader customer engagement strategies Represent ICEYE at customer workshops, briefings, and industry events, acting as a trusted technical educator and advocate for the effective use of SAR data What we’re looking for Must haves: Experience in technical training and curriculum development Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience of D&I sector use of satellite imagery/SAR e.g. IMINT analyst Proficiency with satellite imagery/SAR processing tools and GIS platforms desirable Willingness to travel internationally regularly Ability to work effectively across diverse cultural and operational environments - prior experience engaging with international customers is strongly preferred Bachelor's degree (or higher level) or equivalent in Remote Sensing, Geography, Engineering or a related technical field. items.desc: Kleinanzeigen reaches 36M+ monthly users and is Germany’s leading online classifieds market. We are a sustainability-focused platform where you won't just write code; you will power the services that bridge our high-traffic backend with seamless user experiences. Joining the Edge team means working on the bedrock of Kleinanzeigen, dealing with high-throughput, low-latency and highly-efficient services that require a 'you build it, you run it' mindset, offering you deep exposure to modern infrastructure and platform architecture. What You’ll Own As a Backend-Heavy Full Stack Engineer, you’ll be a central driver for the services that power user privacy and media delivery at scale. You will own the full development lifecycle: from design and implementation to deployment and maintenance. Your impact will include: Core Systems Architecture: Designing and scaling critical microservices using mostly Java and Spring Boot that support 36M+ monthly users. Full Lifecycle Responsibility: Applying "build it, run it" mentality—you aren't just writing code; you’re ensuring robustness, scalability, and observability in production. End-to-End Delivery: Crafting seamless user experiences by integrating our robust backend APIs with high-quality, maintainable frontends in TypeScript and React. Strategic Engineering: Driving improvements in our development practices, testing standards, and CI/CD pipelines to keep our team velocity high and our systems healthy. For frontend components, you will maintain high standards using tools like Vitest and Playwright. Our Tech Toolbox We believe in picking the right tool for the job. Our core environment is built on modern technologies, including: Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Golang, python Frontend: NextJs, React, TypeScript Infrastructure & Messaging: AWS, Kafka, CloudFormation, Kubernetes We value technology-agnostic engineers who are comfortable navigating this stack and are open to learning new technologies as our systems evolve. How We Work Autonomy: We operate in a highly autonomous, cross-functional environment where teams own their services end-to-end. Methodology: We follow Agile methodologies with a focus on code quality, pair programming, and CI/CD best practices. Balance: We work in a hybrid configuration that values flexibility, deep focus time, and collaborative problem-solving. Who You Are Architectural Mindset: You have proven experience building systems at scale (load balancing, service discovery, dynamic routing, circuit breakers). You understand not just how to build features, but how they perform under load. Owner’s Mentality: You seek out challenges, take the lead on troubleshooting complex production issues, and are proactive in proposing long-term technical solutions. Technical Mentor: You elevate the engineers around you through thoughtful code reviews, collaborative pair programming, and a commitment to sharing best practices. Effective Communicator: You can navigate trade-offs between speed and technical debt and explain your decisions clearly to the wider team. Tech Stack: You have strong experience in Java/Go, and you are comfortable balancing that deep backend work with frontend execution using React/TypeScript. At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive. ✨ Flexibility 26 business days of paid annual holidays 20 days “work from anywhere” Flexible working time (hybrid) Paid additional parental leave for both parents Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move) ❤️‍ Wellbeing & Support Private health insurance Gym Pass (may cover up to 70% of gym membership fees) 40€ per month as a remote working allowance. Growth & Development Personal development budget Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career A unique position in an international and dynamic environment A flat, collaborative culture where your feedback actively shapes our processes ️ Perks & Everyday Benefits Competitive compensation package (Base salary + annual bonus) Flexible Remuneration Program (tax-efficient options for transport, restaurant vouchers and childcare) Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts An attractive referral program Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability status. If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway!

As part of Reflex Aerospace, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the trajectory of the space industry's future. This is an opportunity to contribute your expertise and enthusiasm to a team
items.desc: Your Mission: Join the Pinnacle of Satellite Technology Advancement in Germany! Reflex Aerospace is at the forefront of propelling high-performance satellite technology to new heights within the German aerospace landscape. As part of Reflex Aerospace, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the trajectory of the space industry's future. This is an opportunity to contribute your expertise and enthusiasm to a team that stands for innovation and excellence. As Structural Analyst – Satellite Missions, you will ensure the structural integrity and mechanical performance of our satellite platforms. You will work closely with mechanical design, systems, and test engineering teams to develop and validate structural models, perform dynamic loads analyses, define and support mechanical testing, and optimize spacecraft structures for minimum mass and maximum performance. Your Background: You hold a university degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. You bring at least 3 years of experience in structural analysis, particularly static, modal, sine, and random vibration analyses. You are proficient with HyperMesh and OptiStruct for FEM modeling, meshing, simulation, model validation, and post-processing. You have experience with Craig-Bampton reduction, superelements, and coupled-load analyses . You have a strong foundation in analytical methods and hand calculations , covering structural mechanics, dynamics, vibrations, and verification of simulation results. You have strong Python skills for analysis automation, data processing, and engineering tool development. You have experience defining mechanical test specifications , deriving qualification environments, and supporting vibration testing and test-analysis correlation. You are familiar with ECSS and NASA structural standards , load paths, failure mechanisms, and bolted joint assessments. You work independently, communicate effectively in English, and collaborate well across engineering teams. A strong plus is hands-on experience in structural optimization , including sizing, shape, and topology optimization, preferably using OptiStruct. What We Offer: Work directly on complete satellite systems and products, with significant technical ownership from early design through qualification and operations. Help establish engineering capabilities used across multiple Reflex satellite missions and product lines. Work closely with specialists across Systems Engineering, AIT, software, electronics, structures, thermal, AOCS and power. Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation and a special company holiday on April 12th, celebrating the International Day of Human Space Flight and the spirit of exploration. We provide a hybrid work model along with flexible working hours, empowering you as the owner of your time management. An annual training budget of 1.500€. A contribution to your Urban Sports membership as well as a discount on public transportation. A 20% contribution to your private pension plan. Access to Corporate Benefits - a website with many discounts for various brands. We exclusively offer permanent employment contracts, reflecting our commitment to building long-term relationships and supporting sustainable career growth within our organization. About us Reflex Aerospace, a NewSpace startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Munich and Berlin, has been leading the charge to provide advanced dual-use satellite technology at unparalleled speed. The company is leveraging the latest techniques to modernize payload-centric satellite development and production, achieving significantly faster delivery times and enhanced reliability. By applying algorithmic engineering and streamlined system design processes, Reflex accelerates the delivery of satellites enabling lightning-fast innovation for our customers.

items.desc: The End User Computing (EUC) department is dedicated to providing employees with the best possible IT experience. Whether it is laptops, desktops, mobile devices, or virtual workplaces, the team ensures that employees across the organization have the technology and services they need to work securely, efficiently, and productively. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Citrix Architect (m/f/d).In this role, you will provide the architectural foundation for a secure, resilient, and standardized Citrix platform supporting business-critical workloads. You will directly influence the platform’s transformation, operational stability, security, and future delivery model. Your responsibilities: Design secure, scalable, and highly available cloud, on-premises, and hybrid Citrix solutions. Define the architecture of core platform components, including Citrix DaaS, Virtual Apps and Desktops, VDAs, PVS, WEM, StoreFront, Cloud Connectors, NetScaler/ADC, Delivery Controllers, FAS, profiles, images, policies, Machine Catalogs, and Delivery Groups. Create and review high-level and low-level designs, architecture diagrams, technical standards, security concepts, decision papers, and migration concepts. Define reusable architecture standards, patterns, and governance principles that can be applied across Helios and other Fresenius business segments. Drive platform harmonization, standardization, cloud migration, license consolidation, and the retirement of legacy components. Translate business, clinical, security, and operational requirements into reliable and supportable Citrix solutions, considering availability, performance, latency, data residency, sensitive-data protection, and service continuity. Define identity and access requirements, including Active Directory and Entra dependencies, MFA, privileged access, service accounts, session recording, and role-based authorization. Coordinate dependencies across network, cloud, hosting, identity, security, monitoring, and application teams, and provide architectural governance and technical direction to internal delivery teams and external service providers. Plan and support platform implementations, pilots, migrations, testing, capacity planning, cutovers, rollback scenarios, decommissioning, business continuity, disaster recovery, and high-availability concepts. Provide technical leadership for complex incidents and problems, maintain architecture and handover documentation, and contribute to capacity, license, and cost planning as the technical basis for commercial decisions. Your qualifications: Academic qualification in information technology or comparable professional experience. Extensive experience with large, distributed, and business-critical Citrix environments. Strong knowledge of Citrix DaaS/Cloud, Virtual Apps and Desktops, PVS, WEM, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, FAS, Citrix Workspace, and Azure integration. Proven experience in hybrid cloud and on-premises architecture, including HLD and LLD creation, capacity planning, lifecycle management, migrations, security, and identity integration. Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into sustainable, secure, and supportable solutions. Strong analytical, risk-management, and problem-solving capabilities, as well as clear, structured, and audience-appropriate communication. Experience with healthcare IT, clinical applications, regulated environments, or similarly business-critical infrastructure is an advantage. Fluent German skills and good English skills, both spoken and written; relevant Citrix, Microsoft Azure, ITIL, or architecture certifications are an advantage. Why join our team: A key architecture role within a business-critical technology environment. The opportunity to shape the future Citrix platform and transformation roadmap. Collaboration with international infrastructure, security, cloud, application, and service-management teams. Work across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-based delivery models. A high level of technical responsibility and visibility. Drive the future of our End User Services — join #futurefresenius and apply now through our online portal to make an impact!

items.card: Deine Aufgaben Backlog und Tickets Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen. Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen. Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können. Konzeption Du
items.desc: Über uns CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende. Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern. Deine Rolle Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform. Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success. Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge. Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten. Deine Aufgaben Backlog und Tickets Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen. Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen. Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können. Konzeption Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt. Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden. Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko. Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen. Planung und Steuerung Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines. Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter. Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person. Schnittstellen Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität. Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt. Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet. Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene. Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing. Deine ersten Monate In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt. Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht. Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld. Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings. items.desc: About the Role At Agile Robots, we build intelligent robotic systems that learn from high-quality real-world data. To keep our data collection site running at full capacity, we are looking for a Robot Service Engineer (m/f/d) who keeps our robots, teleoperation devices and recording systems operational every day. In this role, you will be the first technical contact on site. You will diagnose and fix hardware and software issues, maintain the robot fleet, and work closely with our R&D teams to resolve deeper technical problems quickly. Your work directly determines how much usable data the site can produce. This position is ideal for someone with a hands-on technical mindset who enjoys troubleshooting, works systematically, and wants to grow with cutting-edge robotics and AI technology. Your Responsibilities On-site Technical Support Provide daily first-line technical support for robots, teleoperation devices, cameras and data recording systems on site. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network and calibration issues to minimize downtime. Support teleoperators and project coordinators with technical questions during data collection. Maintenance & System Setup Install, set up and calibrate robots and teleoperation workstations for new tasks. Perform preventive maintenance, replace parts and keep the robot fleet in working condition. Maintain records of faults, repairs and spare parts usage. R&D Collaboration & Issue Resolution Escalate complex issues to R&D with clear reproduction steps, logs and data. Test and deploy software updates, fixes and new features on site, and give feedback on results. Identify recurring problems and propose improvements to hardware, software and workflows. Safety & Documentation Ensure robots and equipment are operated in line with safety and operational guidelines. Write and update troubleshooting guides, SOPs and setup instructions for the site team. Essential Skills Degree or vocational training in mechatronics, electrical engineering, robotics, computer science or a related field. Hands-on experience troubleshooting electromechanical systems, robots or industrial equipment. Basic knowledge of Linux, command line tools and reading system logs. Structured, independent way of working with strong attention to detail. Good communication skills in English; able to explain technical issues clearly to engineers and non-technical colleagues. Beneficial Skills Experience with robotic arms, ROS/ROS 2, or teleoperation systems. Scripting skills in Python or Bash. Knowledge of cameras, sensors, networking or data pipelines. Experience in field service, technical support or a production / lab environment. What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment About us Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us! We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

items.desc: Role highlights: SAR Training Specialist Location: EU Department: Data Reports to: Earth Observation Application Lead Employment type: Permanent Workplace model: Hybrid or remote Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. items.desc: Location Dublin, Leinster, Ireland Job ID R-262478 Date posted 21/10/2026 Are you ready to turn complex biology into reliable, regulatory-grade analytics that keep life-changing medicines moving to patients who need them most? Join a rare disease-focused team within AstraZeneca where your analytical expertise directly safeguards product quality, accelerates batch release, and strengthens our pipeline. Based in our College Park labs, you will collaborate across manufacturing, development, quality, and regulatory functions to design, validate, and transfer robust analytical methods. From day one, your work will underpin decisive investigations, confident decision-making, and a culture of scientific rigor and data integrity. How will you leverage your bio-analytical experience to elevate method performance and deliver results that matter? Accountabilities: Analytical Method Development and Optimization: Develop and refine analytical methods for biologics to improve specificity, sensitivity, and throughput, enabling reliable product characterization and release. Method Qualification, Validation, and Transfer: Lead and support method qualification, validation/co-validation, and transfer between laboratories and sites, aligning with cGMP/GLP and regulatory expectations. Method Capability and Data Trending: Perform capability analyses and trend data to establish control strategies, detect drift, and drive continuous improvement in method performance. Study Design and Execution: Create protocols, execute studies in the laboratory, analyze data, and produce clear, defensible reports and technical assessments that inform program decisions. Analytical Investigations and Troubleshooting: Provide hands-on testing and root-cause analysis to resolve manufacturing and method issues, supporting deviations, CAPAs, and change controls. Manufacturing Support: Deliver targeted analytical testing to de-risk processes, remove bottlenecks, and support robust process control across the manufacturing network. Laboratory Operations and Readiness: Manage consumables and reagents, maintain equipment, and perform daily operational activities to keep the lab inspection-ready and safe. Compliance and EHS: Uphold site EHS policy, cGMP/GLP, and business processes; champion data integrity and scientific rigor to ensure compliant, audit-ready outcomes. Flexibility and Responsiveness: Support ongoing lab studies that may require periodic out-of-hours work or weekend rota participation to maintain program momentum and timelines. Essential Skills/Experience : Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in biochemistry, chemistry, microbiology or a relevant scientific discipline. Demonstrated experience in (bio)pharmaceutical manufacturing or development. Previous experience and technical knowledge of analytical methodologies on biologicals in either research or biopharmaceutical manufacturing roles in Technical, R&D, or Process Development/Optimisation. Previous hands-on experience of Bio-analytical techniques and methodologies for biologicals. Proven knowledge of cGMP/GLP requirements and implementation of standard methodologies to ensure technical excellence. This is an on-site role, the duties of which are generally conducted in a lab environment. As is typical of a lab-based role, employees must, with or without an accommodation, be capable to: lift/carry items in accordance with manual handling principles; work comfortably in a controlled environment with and around biological, infectious, and hazardous materials; gown/degown PPE; use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; engage in problem solving and non-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; maintain general availability during standard business hours. Desirable Skills/Experience : Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in a relevant scientific discipline. Hands-on experience with biologics analytical techniques such as HPLC/UPLC, CE-SDS, icIEF/cIEF, ELISA, qPCR, LC-MS, peptide mapping, and potency assays. Demonstrated expertise in method lifecycle management, including authoring and executing protocols/reports for qualification, validation, co-validation, and transfer across internal and external sites. Familiarity with ICH guidelines and current expectations for method validation and analytical control strategies. Proficiency with statistical analysis and experimental design tools (e.g., JMP, Minitab) for capability assessment, trending, and robustness studies. Experience with LIMS/ELN systems and strong understanding of ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Research Ireland will drive world class research and innovation in Ireland, funding research and innovation excellence in all disciplines across the spectrum of Arts, Engineering, Humanities, Mathematics, Science, Social Sciences, Technology and others. Role Purpose To deliver high-quality operations across the full programme lifecycle, from call development and proposal review to post-award management, reporting and close-out. The team also leads the stewardship of the recently launched Rinn Network, a €460 million national investment comprising seven large-scale research centres across areas including AI, energy, advanced therapies, medical devices, quantum science, semiconductors and pharma/biopharma. Designed as a new model of radical collaboration, the Rinn Network aims to strengthen Ireland's ability to mobilise research capability at scale and address major societal and economic challenges. Reporting to a Programme Manager, the Programme Officer will take ownership of varied operational activities as part of a team delivering key aspects of Research Ireland's strategy. The role offers the opportunity to coordinate complex programme processes, turn evidence and stakeholder input into effective delivery and contribute practical ideas that improve how the team works. Identify operational risks, issues and process gaps early, escalating material matters and proposing practical mitigations. items.desc: A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential Financial Inc. (PFI), we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can! What you can expect: The Global Stock Plan Administration team is responsible for the administration and operational execution of Prudential's employee equity compensation and stock purchase programs. This team manages the systems, processes, data, and vendor relationships that support stock plan participants across the organization while ensuring operational excellence, compliance, and a positive employee experience. Within this organization, a unique opportunity exists for a Stock Plan Analyst to support critical operational processes across equity plan administration, reporting, data management, and participant services. This role partners closely with internal stakeholders, vendors, and team members to ensure accurate and timely execution of stock plan activities in a controlled and highly regulated environment. Location: This role will be hybrid, 2 days a week in the Letterkenny office . What you will do: Execute daily stock plan administration activities, including transaction processing, participant requests, account maintenance, trading restrictions, and operational controls. Manage daily imports, file transmissions, data exchanges, reporting, reconciliations, and validation activities across internal systems and external vendors. Support recurring stock plan processes, including daily exercises, grant administration, releases, PSPP activities, estimates, sandbox creation, and share ownership reporting. Coordinate with external vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve operational issues, support participant service needs, and maintain audit-ready documentation. Support testing, implementation, annual stock plan activities, and continuous improvement opportunities that enhance operational efficiency and reporting quality. What you will bring: Experience supporting stock plan administration, equity compensation programs, employee stock purchase plans, or related financial operations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify discrepancies, perform validations and reconciliations, and drive resolution. Ability to manage multiple priorities with strong organization, accuracy, attention to detail, and adherence to established controls and procedures. Experience working with external vendors and internal business partners, with effective communication and relationship management skills. Knowledge of compliance, audit support, documentation requirements, reporting tools, spreadsheets, and data management processes within a regulated environment What will set you apart: Experience with E*TRADE’s Equity Edge Online platform including Workflows. Familiarity with payroll and tax implications associated with stock compensation programs. Experience supporting testing and validation activities for system enhancements or implementation projects. Knowledge of public company stock plan governance and compliance requirements. Exposure to global stock plan administration and international participant populations. Experience with Power Query in Excel. Comfortability and curiosity with leveraging AI. PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. What we offer you : Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employees day to day medical and hospital expenses. Annual Leave of 23 days at full pay. Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme. Annual Bonus Programme & Shop LK Vouchers / CleverCards (subject to eligibility): Along with an annual bonus employees are rewarded with Shop LK Vouchers/ CleverCards which are paid tax free. Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary. items.desc: DESCRIPTION We are the Display Protocols team behind Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Applications, the cloud desktop platform that lets millions of users provision secure Windows or Linux desktops and access them from any device or browser. If you like working on problems where latency, security, reliability, and scale all collide at once, this is your kind of role. You'll be joining the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, where our mission is to build intuitive, differentiated business applications — powered by Amazon's real-world experience — that millions of companies use to run their day-to-day operations. We build opinionated, turnkey solutions that customers choose to buy over build, and we aim to be the trusted partner they don't have to think twice about. The End User Computing market is growing at an incredible pace right now, which means you'll be solving some of the most interesting problems in providing secure, fast, highly scalable streaming infrastructure — while working across industry-leading AWS services. Our team is innovating across multiple areas to deliver the best-in-class interactive streaming platform, and as an SDE you'll own features end-to-end, ship to real enterprise and ISV customers, and have a direct hand in shaping what world-class application streaming looks like next. We are looking for passionate SDEs who want to build their career in End User Computing. If this sounds interesting to you, talk to us! Key job responsibilities As an SDE on the Display Protocols team, you'll design and build features for our cloud desktop and interactive streaming platform — end to end, from scoping through production. You'll write clean, maintainable code that runs at scale, optimize real-time streaming paths for latency and reliability, and operate what you ship (including on-call). You'll work across multiple AWS services to deliver secure, highly available infrastructure that enterprise and ISV customers depend on daily. Expect to dive deep into performance — profiling, benchmarking, identifying bottlenecks — and collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions. You'll participate in code reviews, raise the bar on engineering standards, and contribute to operational excellence across the team. When something's broken or could be better, you take initiative and fix it. You'll also help us figure out how to scale — both technically (millions of concurrent desktops) and as a team (mentoring, improving processes, writing useful documentation). The End User Computing space is evolving fast, so you'll frequently evaluate new approaches and help decide where we invest next to keep our streaming platform best-in-class. A day in the life On a typical day, you'll balance executing on our long-term roadmap with responding to emerging customer issues and finding inventive ways to satisfy new customer needs. You'll work closely with engineers, product managers, and partner teams across AWS like networking and security. Your customers are enterprise IT organizations and ISV partners who need desktops that are reliable, secure, and fast — so the feedback loop is tight and the problems are real. Beyond regular engineering work, there's always room to stretch into areas like mentoring or shaping team direction. About the team As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to …

items.desc: At Scalapay, we're shaping a culture with high standards, independent and critical thought, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning . We operate in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment , and we're looking for people who thrive in change, think boldly, and take initiative. If you're ready to put your potential to the test in a hiring process designed to spotlight exceptional talent, this is your chance to stand out and grow with one of Europe's most ambitious fintech teams . #MakeItHappen #PlayAsATeam #StayCurious #FocusOnCustomer. THE MISSION As part of their duties, the Data Analyst - Financial & Payments Controller shall assume full responsibility for the end-to-end management of projects, covering the entire payments and financial data lifecycle from analysis through to execution. In performing these duties, the Employee shall operate at the intersection of people, processes, and data, and shall be specifically required to: Ensure operational accuracy; Safeguard payment integrity; Secure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs); Mitigate risks within a regulated environment. Key Responsibilities Reconciliation oversight: Ensure timely and accurate reconciliations across multiple workflows, maintaining data integrity and collaborating closely with the finance team; SLA monitoring of third-party providers: Track and validate the performance of external providers (e.g., processors, acquirers, banking partners) against contractual SLAs. Ensure service levels are met, escalate deviations, and contribute to reporting for internal stakeholders and audits; Stakeholder collaboration: Work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners (banks, acquirers, processors) to address inquiries, optimize processes, and identify improvement opportunities; Continuous process improvement: Collect and refine business and technical requirements to improve accuracy and streamline operations; Risk control and issue resolution: Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks. Conduct checks on bank and acquirer integrations, manage incidents, and troubleshoot processing errors using internal tools; Invoice reconciliation: Validate invoices from acquirers, processors, and card schemes, ensuring accuracy in charges and proper revenue attribution. Why you should join Scalapay Attractive packages based on skills and experience, the salary band we have for this position is of EUR 40'000 - 47'000 (Gross Annual Salary); International environment with significant challenges to be met every day; Lots of opportunities to work with a team of industry tech leaders who are focused on delivering products that offer exceptional user experiences; Personalised support to accelerate your professional growth and take ownership of the products you deliver: we want to help you grow! Latest technologies and being encouraged to bring your flair to the role. Recruitment Process: A quick chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members; The first interview with Head of Financial Operations and the Data Team to deep dive into your experiences and better understand your motivation; A case study to test your hard skills; A final chat with Simone (our CEO) where he will share and assess the Scalapay Values Want to learn more? Don't hesitate to explore our Careers website, our LinkedIn and Glassdoor pages. Pro tip: send your CV in English Super Pro tip: we know that application processes can be scary and frustrating but… we look for talent, not people that tick all our boxes.

items.desc: Jij bouwt wat mensen rust geeft op het moment dat het ertoe doet. Een dochter belt de zorgorganisatie omdat haar vader niet meer opneemt. Iemand die vastloopt, zoekt midden in de nacht contact met een hulplijn. Een productielijn ligt stil en de storingsdienst moet direct worden bereikt. Of dat via de telefoon, chat, een portaal of een app gaat, maakt op zo’n moment niet uit. Wat telt, is dat er iemand bereikbaar is. Pegamento ontwikkelt en beheert de eigen producten die dat mogelijk maken, voor onder meer zorginstellingen, gemeenten, onderwijsorganisaties, industrie en hulplijnen. Steeds vaker zetten we daarbij AI in: om vragen sneller bij de juiste persoon te krijgen, medewerkers te ondersteunen en klantcontact menselijk te houden, ook als het druk is. Wie dat bouwt? Dat ben jij. Waar je terechtkomt Je komt in het Research & Development-team, dat onze eigen producten ontwikkelt en beheert. Die producten draaien bij veel klanten tegelijk, in omgevingen met hoge eisen aan privacy, security, performance en continuïteit. We draaien op eigen infrastructuur en maken technische keuzes niet voor de volgende sprint, maar voor de komende jaren. Wat we vandaag ontwerpen, moet morgen nog beheersbaar, veilig en uitbreidbaar zijn. De implementatie bij klanten ligt bij een ander team. Jij bouwt aan het product zelf en gebruikt wat er in de praktijk gebeurt om het beter te maken. Wat de functie is Je krijgt zelfstandig eigenaarschap over een deel van ons landschap. Je denkt na voordat je bouwt, maakt technische keuzes inzichtelijk en zorgt dat kwaliteit geen toevallige uitkomst is. Naast code lever je overzicht, onderbouwing en oplossingen die collega’s kunnen begrijpen, beheren en verder ontwikkelen. Waar je aan meebouwt Je werkt met Python en React. Je bent in een van beide het sterkst en voelt je in de andere voldoende thuis om zelfstandig een volledige feature te bouwen. Je komt in een team dat: eigen neurale netwerken traint op onze on-premise GPU-infrastructuur; private LLM’s en open-weight modellen inzet, in het datacenter en op-device; SIP en andere real-time communicatieprotocollen integreert; multisiteplatformen bouwt die duizenden gebruikers ondersteunen. AI-tooling zoals Cursor en Claude Code gebruiken we dagelijks. Je zet die hulpmiddelen kritisch en efficiënt in, en blijft zelf verantwoordelijk voor ontwerp, codekwaliteit, security en het resultaat in productie. Wat we in het eerste jaar verwachten De eerste 90 dagen Je levert zelfstandig werkende functionaliteit op in een bestaande codebase en brengt die, in afstemming met design en backend, naar productie. Je neemt volwaardig deel aan reviews, refinements en architectuursessies en geeft onderbouwde feedback op het werk van anderen én op je eigen werk. Je werkt je in een domein in en maakt vroeg zichtbaar wat technisch, in de samenwerking of in onze werkwijze beter kan. Binnen 12 maanden Je hebt eigenaarschap over een component, service of domein en legt architectuurkeuzes helder uit aan collega’s en, via het implementatieteam, aan klanten. Je draagt bij aan herbruikbare componenten, patterns, CI/CD en security-by-design en helpt ad-hocoplossingen terug te dringen. Je begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s en vertaalt mogelijkheden in AI, LLM’s, SIP en real-time events naar bruikbare oplossingen. Wat je meebrengt Ervaring als software engineer in een productieomgeving waar echte gebruikers afhankelijk zijn van jouw code, en waarin je zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid droeg voor het resultaat. Je bent sterk in Python of in JavaScript/TypeScript met React, en hebt genoeg ervaring met de andere kant om een feature van database tot gebruikersinterface te bouwen. Je werkt dagelijks met relationele databases en API’s en begrijpt schemaontwerp, migraties en schaalbaarheid. Je weegt alternatieven en technische schuld af en schrijft onderhoudbare, testbare software.
