L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Techniques de l'Informatique et de la Microélectronique pour l'Architecture des systèmes intégrés Type de Contrat CDD Doctorant Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 38031 GRENOBLE Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Postuler Date limite de candidature : vendredi 13 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Sujet De Thèse La caractérisation de la sécurité des systèmes embarqués en 'boite noire' ou 'boite grise' face aux attaques Side-Channel requiert fréquemment une phase préparatoire de Reverse-Engineering, qui peut être particulièrement chronophage, notamment sur un Sytem-on-Chip (SoC) complexe que l’on peut retrouver sur smartphone ou dans l’automobile. Cette phase peut, par exemple, consister en la détection d’une primitive cryptographique au sein de mesures Side-Channel pour une future attaque par observation, ou d’une routine cible pour une attaque par perturbation. L’objectif de cette thèse est de développer une méthodologie et des outils non-profilés permettant l’automatisation de cette phase de détection, tout en permettant d’exploiter la connaissance a priori d’un potentiel attaquant. La thématique du Reverse-Engineering non-profilé via Side-Channel gravite autour de problèmes bien connus en traitement de 'timeseries' comme la découverte de motifs, découverte d’anomalies, ou la segmentation sémantique. Un des objectifs de cette thèse sera ainsi de traiter ces problématiques en prenant en compte les particularités des attaques par Side-Channel sur SoC, comme le bruit et le jitter dans les mesures, et l’a priori d’un attaquant sur le code exécuté et les données manipulées. De ce fait, l’investigation d’une méthodologie alliant machine learning, modèles probabilistes et métriques exactes sur les 'timeseries', constitue une des pierres angulaires de cette thèse. Les scenarii couverts par les problématiques de recherche posés par cette thèse sont multiples. Quelques exemples significatifs, en plus de la préparation à des attaques physiques classiques, sont le reverse-engineering de bootloader ou la découverte d’architecture de réseaux de neurones. Votre Environnement de Travail Le laboratoire TIMA est un laboratoire public de recherche sous la tutelle du CNRS, de Grenoble INP et de l’UGA. Il est situé à Grenoble, sur le site Viallet de Grenoble INP-UGA (46 avenue Félix Viallet). TIMA est une équipe cosmopolite de 150 personnes environ, avec des chercheurs du monde entier (chercheurs permanents, enseignants-chercheurs, doctorants, post-doctorants, CDD ingénieurs, collaborateurs scientifiques, invités et stagiaires). Les sujets de recherches couvrent la spécification, la conception, la vérification, le test, les outils CAO et méthodes d’aide à la conception pour les systèmes intégrés. Une grande partie de la recherche s’effectue dans le contexte de projets coopératifs, avec des partenaires industriels et académiques, financés par des contrats régionaux, nationaux et européens. Le laboratoire entretient ainsi de forts contacts avec le milieu industriel et académique qui réclament une implication professionnelle tant sur le plan logistique que relationnel. Contraintes et risques Le poste est localisé en Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR), ce qui implique une procédure administrative préalable d’autorisation d’accès. Salary Range: 
€57,900.00 - €107,500.00 
 Job Description Summary 
The Associate Director DDIT ISC Risk Governance & Enablement is accountable for defining, governing and continuously improving the enterprise processes and enabling capabilities for managing DD&IT risks, issues and exceptions.
The role establishes simple, consistent and effective governance across DD&IT and enables its adoption through fit-for-purpose processes, technology, automation, artificial intelligence, data and insights. The role evaluates existing processes and tools and drives sustainable improvements that strengthen transparency, accountability, user experience and risk-based decision-making.
Working in close collaboration with stakeholders across DD&IT, ISC and other relevant Novartis functions, the role ensures that risk governance processes and enabling capabilities remain aligned with applicable Novartis requirements, external standards and regulatory requirements, evolving business needs and DD&IT strategic priorities. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities : 
 Define and continuously improve DD&IT risk, issue, and exception governance processes aligned with policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
 Establish clear governance frameworks, including roles, accountabilities, decision rights, approvals, and escalation paths.
 Manage the lifecycle and relationships between risks, issues, exceptions, controls, and remediation actions.
 Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, reporting, renewal, and closure with strong auditability and transparency.
 Drive timely escalation of material risks and systemic concerns to appropriate governance bodies.
 Lead process simplification, standardization, harmonization, and continuous improvement across DD&IT risk governance.
 Evaluate and optimize tools, workflows, and technology solutions, including integration, consolidation, and modernization initiatives.
 Identify and implement automation and responsible AI opportunities while ensuring appropriate oversight, security, traceability, and accountability.
 Define and enhance risk data, metrics, analytics, reporting, and actionable insights to support informed decision-making.
 Drive stakeholder adoption, capability building, and cross-functional collaboration to strengthen risk governance, automation, and process excellence across DD&IT.
 Essential Requirement :

 To support the Aircraft Development Safety team in Getafe, we are looking for a System Safety Engineer who will ensure that Airbus products are designed, developed and supported according to the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations).
 Tasks 
 As a member of the Aircraft Development Safety team, you will develop the following challenging tasks and activities:
 Performing System Safety Assessment activities for military aircraft systems, supporting the development phases until certification.
 Performing a systematic and comprehensive examination of System functions to identify and classify failure conditions of those functions according to their severity.
 Establishing the System Safety requirements and performing preliminary evaluations to determine that the proposed architecture can reasonably be expected to meet the safety objectives.
 Generating evidences to demonstrate in front of the Airworthiness Authorities that the final system architecture meets required System Safety requirements.
 Performing analyses of Common-Cause (Particular Risk Analysis, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analysis).
 Performing Risk Analyses, according to the applicable guidance and standards, which are required to demonstrate the Continuous Airworthiness of the platform.
 Manage and establish safety requirements at the interface to interacting systems.
 Manage input from and output to interfacing technical domains and technology (processes, maintenance, human factos, aircraft performance, structures, quality, etc.).
 Review, approval and application of supplier data regarding Safety and Reliability.
 All these activities comprise all levels of development, from Aircraft level down to detailed requirements regarding hardware and Software.

 Master degree of Aeronautical or Industrial Engineer (or similar discipline).

Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams in der Fertigung sucht Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH eine/n 
 Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) der Arbeitsvorbereitung zivile Montage / MRO 
 Ihr Arbeitsort in Calden 
 Die Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH mit Sitz in Kassel-Calden ist ein weltweit agierendes High-Tech-Unternehmen für die Entwicklung, Herstellung und Wartung luftfahrttechnischer Systeme, Komponenten und Präzisionsteile. Wir begeistern uns für hochwertige Technik und arbeiten mit Leidenschaft für Sicherheit und faszinierende Innovationen in der Luftfahrt. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Arbeit und teilen unsere Fachkenntnisse gepaart mit langjähriger Erfahrung für die gemeinsame Erfüllung zukunftsorientierter Spitzenleistungen. Wir sind der Ansprechpartner für internationale zivile sowie militärische Programme und Entwickler neuer Schlüsseltechnologien. 
 Ihre Vorteile bei Airbus: 
 Spannende und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben rund um die Getriebe- und Antriebskomponenten, dem Herzstück des Helicopters 
 Eine sehr gute Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die von unseren Produkten begeistert sind 
 Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen nach Tarif der Metall- und Elektroindustrie, Hessen 
 30 Tage Urlaub, 35 Stunden/Woche sowie Gleitzeit (außer im Schichtbetrieb) geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Job und Privatleben ideal miteinander zu vereinbaren 
 Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und interne Entwicklungsperspektiven für unseren gemeinsamen Blick in die Zukunft 
 Weitere Benefits wie arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Fahrradleasing, Gesundheitsangebote sowie eine werkseigene Kantine runden unser Angebot ab 
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: 
 Sie sind die entscheidende Schnittstelle zwischen der Konstruktion und der Montage und stellen sicher, dass unsere Produktionsprozesse reibungslos, effizient und in höchster Qualität ablaufen. 
 Prozessplanung und -steuerung: Sie planen und definieren die technologischen Bearbeitungsschritte für komplexe Bauteile 
 Erstellung von Arbeitsunterlagen: Sie erstellen und pflegen Arbeitspläne, Stücklisten und Fertigungsanweisungen im ERP-System (z. B. SAP). 
 Werkzeug- und Vorrichtungsauswahl: Sie wählen die passenden Werkzeuge und Vorrichtungen aus und beschaffen diese in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Einkauf. 
 Kalkulation: Sie ermitteln Vorgabezeiten und führen Vorkalkulationen für die Fertigungskosten von Neu- und Bestandteilen durch. 
 Prozessoptimierung (KVP): Sie analysieren bestehende Fertigungs-/Montageabläufe, identifizieren Verbesserungspotenziale und setzen Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit um. 
 Technische Unterstützung: Sie agieren als technischer Ansprechpartner für die Mechaniker (m/w/d) und unterstützen bei der Erstbemusterung und bei fertigungstechnischen Herausforderungen. 
 Stammdatenpflege: Sie sind für die Anlage und Pflege aller fertigungsrelevanten Stammdaten im ERP- und CAM-System verantwortlich. 
 Ihre Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen: 
 Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z. B. als Zerspanungsmechaniker, Industriemechaniker) mit Weiterbildung zum Meister/Techniker (m/w/d) oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Produktionstechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. 
 Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Arbeitsvorbereitung oder Fertigungsplanung, idealerweise in einem metallverarbeitenden Unternehmen. 
 IT-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit einem gängigen ERP-System (Infor LN, BaaN, SAP) sowie den MS-Office-Anwendungen. 
 Persönlichkeit: Eine strukturierte, analytische und selbstständige Arbeitsweise zeichnet Sie aus. Sie sind ein kommunikationsstarker Teamplayer, der lösungsorientiert denkt und handelt. 
 Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch-, und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich. 
 Kein 100%-iges Match? Kein Problem! Airbus unterstützt Ihr persönliches Wachstum mit individualisierten Entwicklungslösungen.

 évaluer les risques associés aux défaillances du système, 
 évaluer et contribuer au choix des solutions d’architecture en fonction des exigences de sûreté applicables, 
 contribuer aux analyses de causes communes, 
 établir la conformité du système aux exigences de sûreté.

Are you an experienced systems administrator with strong Microsoft 365, Azure and endpoint management expertise? Do you have experience managing on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including hybrid environments and migrations? Would you enjoy managing and improving the IT services that support a world-leading research organisation? 
 EMBL’s European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI) is hiring for two Systems Administrators to help deliver, maintain and develop our Microsoft and cloud services. Our Systems Administrator will primarily work across Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune and hybrid infrastructure but also assist in supporting our Linux desktop environment, combining hands-on technical administration with project delivery, service improvement and user support.
 This is an opportunity to take ownership of key systems, contribute to technical design and implementation, and help ensure our IT environment remains secure, reliable and responsive to the needs of our scientific community.
 About the Team 
 You will join the IT Services (ITS) Service Desk team at EMBL-EBI in Hinxton, working alongside colleagues who provide technical services and support across the organisation.
 The team supports EMBL-EBI staff, visitors and guests, maintaining the systems and services that enable our research and operations. You will play a key role in managing our Microsoft environment, working collaboratively with colleagues across IT to deliver projects, improve services and provide effective technical support.
 What you will do 
 You will manage and develop Microsoft on-premises and cloud services, ensuring they are secure, reliable and fit for purpose. With a primary focus on Microsoft 365, Azure and endpoint management, you will take ownership of Windows infrastructure, contribute to technical projects and migrations, and support the wider desktop environment where needed. In particular, you will lead a project on our 2027 roadmap to review and potentially retire or greatly reduce the existing Linux desktop service offering. This will involve consulting with users, assessing alternative desktop solutions and helping to implement an appropriate replacement, potentially supported by Linux server-based infrastructure.
 Your key responsibilities will include: 
 Manage Microsoft and cloud services: Design, install, administer and maintain Microsoft 365, Azure and associated enterprise services.
 Lead endpoint management: Administer Microsoft Endpoint Manager / Intune, including device enrolment, configuration, application deployment and compliance policies.
 Maintain hybrid infrastructure: Administer and support on-premises Active Directory and its integration with Microsoft cloud services, alongside Windows servers and infrastructure running on physical and VMware platforms.
 Deliver technical projects and migrations: Plan and implement Windows infrastructure projects, including migrations to Microsoft 365, Azure and hybrid or cloud environments.
 Monitor and improve services: Take the lead in managing Windows infrastructure, monitoring service performance and making informed decisions about system maintenance and improvement.
 Maintain security and documentation: Ensure systems comply with IT security requirements and policies, maintaining clear documentation of the environment and application configurations.
 Provide technical support and expertise: Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues for staff, visitors and guests, and provide systems training to helpdesk technicians and users where required.
 Support the wider desktop environment: Provide assistance and cover across systems administration functions, including Linux desktop installation, administration and automation where required.
 You will have: 
 A bachelor's degree, or equivalent in Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Extensive experience in user support and Microsoft Windows systems administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file and print services, and Windows deployment tools.
 Strong practical experience administering and managing Microsoft 365 enterprise services, including tenant configuration and the services required to support users and devices.
 Experience administering Microsoft Azure services and identity management, with an understanding of cloud infrastructure and services.
 Strong experience with Microsoft Endpoint Manager / Intune, including device enrolment, configuration, application deployment, compliance and endpoint policies.
 Experience designing, building and managing Microsoft 365 / Azure tenants, managing hybrid Microsoft environments and supporting migrations from on-premises services to cloud or hybrid environments. Candidates should have experience supporting migrations or building and preparing a tenant for migration.
 Knowledge of IT service management processes, including incident, change and problem management, and the use of service management or ticketing systems.

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As an Electronics Engineer on the Physical Products team, you will design and build the electrical systems that bring Helsing's platforms to life. From component selection and electrical architecture definition through to bespoke PCB design and hands-on prototype bring-up, you will shape how our systems are powered, connected, and controlled. Working at the intersection of hardware and systems engineering, you will translate complex requirements into robust, field-ready electronics, iterating rapidly to de-risk designs and validate concepts early. Your work will directly advance Helsing's mission to equip democratic societies with capable, reliable defence technology.
 The day-to-day 
 Design, build, and validate bespoke PCBs from schematic through to hands-on bring-up, covering power, digital, and mixed-signal electronics using tools such as Altium Designer or KiCad
 Define the electrical architecture of UAV platforms, producing wiring diagrams, power distribution schemes, and interface definitions that underpin system integration across mechanical, software, and avionics boundaries
 Select and specify components across sensors, actuators, controllers, and power systems, trading off performance, cost, availability, and integration effort to make well-reasoned, documented design decisions
 Integrate communication interfaces such as CAN Bus, Ethernet, and RS422/485, and support RF and radio systems, ensuring robust data and power distribution across the platform
 Define and execute unit-level tests, contribute to reliability and safety analyses such as FMEA, and produce clear design documentation including wiring diagrams, schematics, PCB layouts, and BOMs
 You should apply if you 
 Have designed and integrated electrical and electronic systems in a professional engineering context, ideally within aerospace or a similarly demanding domain
 Are proficient in PCB design and layout, with hands-on experience using ECAD tools such as Altium Designer or KiCad and simulation tools such as LTSpice
 Can interpret complex third-party datasheets and technical documentation, translating electrical characteristics and constraints into sound, well-reasoned design decisions
 Have experience designing cable harnesses and defining communication interfaces, and have worked with RF or radio systems in a hardware integration context
 Collaborate effectively across mechanical, software, and systems engineering disciplines, and communicate clearly in written and spoken English
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to have 
 Experience with ECAD/MCAD co-design workflows and the integration of electrical systems into complex electromechanical assemblies
 Experience contributing to reliability or safety analyses such as FMEA in a production or pre-production engineering context
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

You will also shape how we prove compliance, developing qualification strategies that
items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 You will own the environmental definition for our weapon systems, from the Manufacture-to-Target-Disposal-Sequence through to the evidence that supports certification. You will set system-level environmental requirements, decompose them to subsystem and equipment level, and use analysis to find and design out risks early. You will also shape how we prove compliance, developing qualification strategies that use new technologies and methods to cut cost and time, then securing agreement from the stakeholders who depend on them. Working with supply chain, production and test facilities, you will see campaigns delivered on time, on cost and on quality, and help build our environmental engineering capability as it grows.
 The day-to-day

Lieu : Palaiseau, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. 
 En nous rejoignant, vous intégrer le laboratoire d’analyse des technologies et procédés industriels (LATPI). Le LATPI est un laboratoire de référence pour le groupe Thales, intégré au centre de recherche Thales Research&Technology. Il a pour mission d’expertiser, diagnostiquer, résoudre tout type de problématique technologique liée à un composant, une carte électronique, un équipement. Son domaine d’intervention couvre toutes les phases du cycle de développement et de production.
 Vous aurez pour objectif de développer au sein du laboratoire une expertise dans le domaine des matériaux, accès sur le domaine mécanique et le traitement de surface des matériaux. Pour cela vous aurez besoin d’une connaissance technique approfondie à terme et sans cesse renouvelée. Vous interagirez avec l’ensemble des unités Thales.
 Dans ce cadre vous aurez pour missions principales :
 Développer une expertise concernant l’analyse des revêtements de surface (protection des tôles, pièce acier, carte imprimées, …)
 Caractériser les propriétés mécaniques des boitiers de composants électroniques en particulier les composants de type SIP (System In Package).
 Mettre en place des moyens d’essais nécessaires pour les activités décrites
 Prendre en compte des demandes clients, la compréhension de leurs besoins, la réalisation de devis. Réaliser des essais afin de résoudre le problème posé. Puis présenter les résultats au client.
 Participer aux actions Qualité menées au laboratoire permettant d’obtenir et de conserver l’accréditation Cofrac
 Développer son activité (expertises, investissements, démarches commerciales, …)
 Notre site est reconnu par le label Employeur Pro-Vélo Argent ! Nous mettons ainsi à disposition un parking vélo, des douches, vestiaires et du matériel pour entretenir son vélo.
 Votre profil 
 Ingénieur de recherche matériaux, mécanique et traitements de surface (H/F) 
 Votre priorité est d’apporter vos connaissances en analyse de défaillance ?
 Vous avez l’ambition de contribuer à l’innovation au sein de Thales ?
 Vous avez envie de découvrir le centre de recherche de Thales ?
 Vous disposez d’un bac +5 d’une école d’ingénieur ou formation équivalente avec une spécialité en matériaux (ou électronique), vous justifiez d’une 1ère expérience en laboratoire d’analyse ou dans les domaines de la micro-électronique ou des assemblages électroniques et avez de l'expérience sur :
 Connaissances des matériaux et des processus industriels lié aux composants électroniques
 Maitrise des principales techniques d’analyses
 Connaissance en physique, physico-chimie
 Connaissance en mécanique et traitement de surface
 Anglais (Niveau C1 attendu)
 Sens de l’organisation, rigueur, capacité à travailler en équipe et excellent sens de communication sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
 Le mot de l’équipe 
 Au sein du LATPI, vous aurez l’opportunité de développer une expertise sur les équipements électroniques réalisés par l’ensemble du groupe Thales dans le domaine des matériaux, axé sur la mécanique et le traitement de surface des matériaux. Vous aurez ainsi l’occasion de travailler sur des systèmes très variés et dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant. Vous serez également amené à participer sur des projets européens pour la caractérisation de matériaux dans le cadre de développement de nouveaux composants ou systèmes.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE MISSION

You will work every day on the racks that power one of Sweden's largest AI clusters.
Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure.
You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond.
Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end.

Location: On-site at our data center in Dalarna region.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand).

 - Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas.

 - Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on.

 - Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors.

 - Help us get better — feed recurring anomalies into monitoring, alerts and SOPs; contribute small scripts (Python/Bash) if you have those skills.

 - Be a good teammate — clear status updates, honest handovers and respect for the people around you.


ABOUT YOU

 - Hands-on comfort in data centers or server hardware — you can (or will quickly learn to) work cleanly in racks: rails, cabling, labeling, mounting.

 - Disciplined and meticulous: checklists aren't bureaucracy to you, they're craftsmanship.

 - Practical electrical basics: power-off procedures, PPE, short-circuit risk awareness.

 - Basic Linux (boot checks, logs) — scripting is a plus, not a requirement.

 - Physically able to work in racks (lift, mount, maneuver) in a data center environment.

 - Comfortable in a 24/7 operation, including a rotating on-call with emergency response expectations.

 - Driver's licence (B) for travel between our sites.

Even if you don't match every criterion
Many of our best hardware engineers came from research labs, telecoms, IT services or the military. If you are rigorous, curious and genuinely motivated by hardware at scale, we would be glad to hear from you — we assess demonstrated scope rather than keyword matching.



NICE TO HAVE

 - HPC/AI/cloud production experience at scale; large-fleet server install and maintenance.

 - Networking fundamentals (Ethernet/InfiniBand) beyond basics.

 - Vendor/RMA tooling, ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory systems.

 - Python/Bash automation for checks, capture, inventory or reporting.

 




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

About the Team

The Privacy Engineering team builds secure, reliable systems that help OpenAI meet its legal obligations while protecting user data. We partner closely with Legal and Engineering teams across OpenAI to support lawful data access requests and other critical legal workflows. Our work turns complex, high-stakes processes into auditable and dependable technical systems with clear human oversight and strong privacy and security controls.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full-stack Software Engineer to build the internal tools and data pipelines that power lawful data access request workflows and Legal Operations. You will work across product and data systems to make authorized retrieval and case handling accurate, efficient, and auditable. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys translating ambiguous operational requirements into durable systems, cares deeply about sensitive-data handling, and wants to improve both technical reliability and the day-to-day experience of the people operating these workflows.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with two additional locations under consideration: London, UK, and Dublin, Ireland. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Design, build, and operate backend systems and workflow tooling for the full lifecycle of lawful data access requests, from intake and scoping through authorized retrieval, review, preparation, and audit.

 - Build reliable data pipelines and interfaces across products and data stores so authorized teams can locate and handle the right records accurately and reproducibly.

 - Implement least-privilege access, approval gates, provenance, audit trails, data minimization, and safe failure modes for sensitive workflows.

 - Partner with Legal and Legal Operations to translate legal and operational requirements into clear technical designs and intuitive operator experiences.

 - Identify responsible automation opportunities that reduce repetitive work while preserving human review, judgment, and accountability.

 - Own production systems through testing, observability, incident response, documentation, and continuous reliability improvements.

 - Help define the architecture and roadmap for reusable privacy and legal-infrastructure foundations as OpenAI’s products and obligations evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have experience building or operating systems for lawful data access requests and understand the domain’s legal-process lifecycle, privacy and security constraints, auditability requirements, and operational sensitivities.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production services or data-intensive systems.

 - Ability to reason carefully about correctness, authorization, security, and privacy when working with sensitive data.

 - A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into pragmatic plans and communicating technical tradeoffs clearly.

 - End-to-end ownership, including operating what you build, and comfort learning unfamiliar products and domains.

 - Care for operator experience and a drive to make complex workflows safer, clearer, and more efficient.

 - Experience collaborating across Engineering, Legal, operations, Privacy, and Security stakeholders.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The work mixes greenfield features with polish on the existing editor. An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required.

 - Strong frontend engineer who has built complex, interactive UIs.

items.desc:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.
 Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.
 Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé . 
 Au sein de l'équipe Supply Chain basée à Issy-les-Moulineaux, nous recherchons un·e Junior Supply Chain Engineer – Opérations en CDI. Vous serez le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France et aux États-Unis, et le référent des opérations physiques : rework, reconditionnement, opérations à valeur ajoutée et retours B2B et B2C. En collaboration avec les équipes ADV, Planning, Qualité et Service Client, ainsi qu'avec nos collègues aux États-Unis et en Chine, vous veillerez à la fiabilisation de ces flux, à l'évaluation de leur performance et de leurs coûts.
 Vos missions principales : 
 1. Entrepôts et stocks 
 Être le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France, aux États-Unis et en Asie, et veiller au respect des process.
 Garantir la fiabilité des stocks : inventaires tournants et trimestriels, réconciliation 3PL / ERP, traitement du stock dormant.
 Mettre en place les opérations à valeur ajoutée : rework, kitting, personnalisation.
 2. Retours et reconditionnement 
 Gérer les retours B2B et B2C, et harmoniser les process entre l'Europe, les États-Unis et l'Asie.
 Piloter la chaîne de refurb (diagnostic, tests qualité, remise en stock) et le suivi des pièces détachées.
 3. Performance et coûts 
 Suivre les KPIs opérationnels (stocks, délais, retours, transporteurs) et produire le reporting mensuel.
 Analyser les coûts logistiques, contrôler la facturation des prestataires et identifier des leviers d'économie.
 4. Automatisation et process 
 Automatiser les flux de données avec nos prestataires (Python, API, Shopify Flow) et maintenir les tableaux de bord de l'équipe.
 Rédiger et tenir à jour les procédures opérationnelles (SOP).
 Requirements 
 Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +5 spécialisé dans la Supply ou issu d’une école d’ingénieur ou équivalent.
 Une première expérience (stage, alternance ou 0 à 2 ans) en logistique, entreposage ou opérations.
 Vous maîtrisez Excel, savez travailler avec SQL et analyser des bases de données ; des connaissances en Python sont un vrai atout.
 Vous connaissez le fonctionnement d'un ERP et d'un WMS, et vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques (Pack Office, Google Suite, IA).
 Anglais professionnel courant : vous travaillerez au quotidien avec des prestataires et des collègues en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Asie.
 Rigueur, proactivité, autonomie, sens de l'organisation et adaptabilité : vous êtes force de proposition et d'amélioration.
 Vous avez une aisance relationnelle pour faire avancer des sujets avec des partenaires externes et des équipes internes variées.
 Benefits 
 Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :
 Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
 Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
 Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen 
 Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
 Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
 Participer à la Withings Med Academy en assistant à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
 Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !
 Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Leonardo is an international industrial group and one of the world's leading companies in the Aerospace, Defence, and Security sectors, delivering multi-domain technological capabilities in the fields of Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cyber Security, and Space. With more than 60,000 employees worldwide, the company has a strong industrial presence in Italy, the United Kingdom, Poland, and the United States, and operates in 150 countries through subsidiaries, joint ventures, and equity investments. A key player in major strategic programs at the global level, Leonardo is a technology and industrial partner to governments, defence administrations, institutions, and businesses.
 For our Helicopters Division we are looking for a System Integration Specialist.
Reporting to the Technology & Innovation (T&I) Management of Leonardo Helicopters, the candidate will support multiple R&D projects in the field of electrification and propulsion. In this role the candidate will have the opportunity to deal with innovative solutions at the cutting edge of helicopter industry. More specifically, the candidate will integrate the contributions coming from the different specialists and manage the system configuration through the design review process, up to in flight demonstration of new electrical and propulsion system concepts. 
Main activities:
• Participate to the technology incubation process up to the industrialization handover (TRL 1-6)
• Lead the system integration process from requirement capture, through architecture definition, to interface specification 
• Manage the sys. prototype configuration, development, qualification, installation and acceptance (either in house or externally - by contract) 
• Keep track of the numerical simulation and experimental test results as means of compliance to the system requirements
• Support the project reviews with technical reports, presentations and system integration status 
• Coordinate with internal and external partners or suppliers, on the assigned projects 
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 HARD SKILLS:
• STEM degree (preferably master in Aeronautical or Electrical Engineering).
• Aircraft installation and qualification standards knowledge (e.g. DO160).
• MATLAB/Simulink and/or NI/LabVIEW knowledge. 
• Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Power Point).
• Fluent English, both written and spoken.
• Italian mother tongue, or full proficiency.
 SOFT SKILLS:
• Proactive, motivated, creative and willing to innovate.
• Familiarity with project management principles
• Excellent communication skills including presentation and active listening.
• Capable to build relationships / engage stakeholders in complex environments.
• Entrepreneurial attitude.
• International mindset.
 NICE TO HAVE:
• Interest / willing to learn about Electrical Engineering* (if Aeronautical) or Aeronautical Engineering (if Electrical)
* with focus on Electrical Machines - principles of operation, modeling and simulation
• Computer Aid Design (CAD) understanding and software primer (preferably CATIA)
• Familiarity with the company product portfolio 
• Strategic thinking
WHAT WE OFFER
Engagement, recognition of skills, and a strong focus on people's well-being and safety are the cornerstones of our corporate culture.
Every day, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and stimulating work environment by actively promoting the principles of inclusion, equity, and diversity enhancement.
Our reference collective labor agreement is the National Collective Labor Agreement (CCNL) for the Private Metalworking Industry and Plant Installation Sector.
 • Working arrangement: Hybrid
 • Employment category: White-collar employee
 • Contract type: Permanent contract
 • 13th-month salary
 • Performance bonus linked to business results
 • Welfare vouchers worth €250 per year
 • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities, including both technical and soft skills
 • Well-being: We place the economic, physical, social, and psychological well-being of our people first, offering a variety of solutions tailored to their needs.
The company reserves the right to assess the appropriate employment level and compensation package based on objective criteria emerging during the selection process and in line with the seniority of the selected candidate and the position itself, in accordance with the principles of fairness, transparency, and equal opportunities established by applicable legislation.
THE SELECTION PROCESS
We look forward to receiving your application: please submit your CV within three weeks of the job posting date.
How does the selection process work?
Following the application collection phase, the CVs that best match the required qualifications will be evaluated and shortlisted.
Selected candidates will take part in an introductory interview with the Human Resources …

Posting Description for Internal Candidates 
 Header for Internal Candidates 
 Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 Responsibilities and Qualifications for Internal Candidates 
 A propos de vos missions 
 Garantir que la qualité et la fiabilité des produits livrés répondent aux exigences des clients : 
 Appliquer les procédures ST et celles du client relatives à l’évaluation de la fiabilité des produits.
 Définir et négocier avec les divisions et le client le plan de qualification ainsi que les conditions des essais de fiabilité.
 Mettre en œuvre les évaluations de fiabilité des nouveaux produits.
 Analyser les résultats des essais de fiabilité en fonction des objectifs internes et des applications clients.
 Utiliser les équipements adaptés pour les essais de fiabilité ainsi que les outils logiciels d’analyse de données.
 Gérer les fournisseurs (relations, offres, problématiques techniques).
 Assurer les capacités de diagnostic et d’analyse des causes racines : 
 Communiquer les résultats des essais et les premières analyses dans une démarche constructive.
 Améliorer la robustesse et la qualité de la conception en réalisant des essais sur des produits complets.
 Déboguer les composants matériels (Hardware), logiciels (Software) et micrologiciels (Firmware) lors des essais réalisés sur le produit complet.
 A propos de vous 
 Vous intégrerez l’équipe Fiabilité afin de réaliser les qualifications produits 
 Le poste est basé à Castelletto (Italie) .
 La durée de la mission est de 24 mois .
 Footer for Internal Candidates 
 ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025. 
 Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.
 Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.
 Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. La diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sont des valeurs fondamentales qui façonnent notre culture d’entreprise.
 Pour découvrir toutes nos opportunités, rendez-vous sur st.com/careers.

 A bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, information technology, telecommunications or a related field.

 Experience with infrastructure automation using Terraform or similar tools.

 A proactive and structured approach to problem-solving and service improvement.
 Fluency in written and spoken English and willingness to participate in 24/7 support.

items.desc:
Join our Team
 Join us to build, and run the storage services behind Ericsson R&D 
Reliable storage helps Ericsson’s research and development teams design, test and deliver what’s next. Join the RCE NES Data Storage team and help evolve the services and infrastructure they depend on, from design and implementation to secure, dependable day-to-day operations. 
This is an opportunity in our Data Storage team. We welcome recent graduates and candidates with up to around five years of relevant experience in storage systems or DevOps. You don’t need to be a security specialist: we’re looking for someone who wants to build and operate services with security built in. DevOps and infrastructure candidates are encouraged to apply. 
 What you’ll do 
• Turn requirements into practical, cost-effective storage service designs, and contribute to service architecture and improvements. 
• Help install, configure, upgrade, patch, repair and retire storage hardware and software, primarily in on-premises environments, with growing connections to hybrid cloud. 
• Automate repeatable tasks and improve how services are delivered and operated. 
• Support service availability through proactive monitoring, alerts, audit and log reviews, and 2nd- and 3rd-line troubleshooting. 
• Coordinate data migrations and work with users, operations teams, suppliers and vendors to deliver changes and resolve issues. 
• Take part in asset, change, incident, problem and request handling; help manage access, identities, certificates and security zones. 
• Apply Ericsson security requirements and good practice through risk and security assessments, quality assurance and business continuity planning. 
• Keep service, system, project and operating documentation current; identify risks and impediments and suggest better ways of working. 
 Skills you’ll bring 
• A BSc or MSc in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or a related field—or equivalent knowledge. 
• Relevant experience, study or hands-on projects in storage, infrastructure, systems administration or DevOps; early-career applicants are very welcome. 
• Interest in storage technologies such as SAN, NAS, DAS and cloud storage, and protocols such as SCSI, NFS or SMB. 
• Familiarity with platforms such as NetApp, Dell, Pure or HPE, or the motivation to learn them. 
• Interest in scripting and automation. Python, PowerShell and Ansible are useful; other languages and tools are welcome. 
• A service-minded approach to reliability, security and ownership, plus clear communication and documentation skills in English. 
• A collaborative, curious, can-do attitude and care for well-built services. 
 Experience with virtualization, containers, cloud, microservices, software architecture, agile development or continuous integration is beneficial, not essential. 
 Why Ericsson Lab Operations? 
 Work with an open team supporting services used by R&D around the world. You’ll contribute across the service lifecycle, collaborate with stakeholders and suppliers, and help make storage more reliable, secure and efficient. 
 Security clearance, references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates.

Als Support Process & Maintenance Engineer für Probecards (w/m/div) unterstützen Sie das Team aktiv dabei, die reibungslose Funktionsfähigkeit und Qualität der Probecards sicherzustellen.
 Sie assistieren erfahrenen Kollegen bei der Durchführung von einfachen Inspektions-, Wartungs- und Reparaturaufgaben an Probecards und zugehörigen Baugruppen zur elektrischen Kontaktierung im Prüfbereich.

items.desc:
Fedezd fel a benned rejlő lehetőségeket a KUKA-val 
 A KUKA számos lehetőséget kínál, melyek által előremozdíthatod karriered, átélheted álmaidat és kibontakozhat a benned rejlő potenciál. A világ egyik vezető automatizálási szakértői vagyunk, globális lehetőségeket kínálunk a robotika, automatizálás, logisztika, szoftvermegoldások és az elektronika területén. Ha motivált vagy, merész ambíciókkal és elképzelésekkel, aki hisz az együttműködésben és a kölcsönös tiszteletben, akkor a KUKA-nál biztos lehetsz a sikerben!
 Feladatok 
 Komplexebb, hosszabb szerelési idejű, elektromos szekrények szerelése műszaki rajzok alapján.
 Széleskörű cikk és termékismeret.
 Prototípus gyártás gyártásfejlesztési támogatással, a termékhez kapcsolódó gyártási dokumentumok elkészítésében való részvétel.
 Hibák, hiányosságok feltüntetése az erre a célra használatos nyomtatványon és jelzése a közvetlen felettesnek, továbbá javaslat nyújtása a javító intézkedésre.
 A rendelkezésre álló szerszámok és gépek rendben tartása, rendeltetésszerű használata, tisztán tartása, állapotuk ellenőrzése. Meghibásodásuk esetén azok cseréltetése és a közvetlen vezető tájékoztatása. 
 A beépítendő anyagok ellenőrzése beszerelés előtt. Az elkészített félkész, illetve késztermék ellenőrzése ellenőrzési lista alapján.
 A gyártási tevékenységhez kapcsolódó minőségbiztosítási és termelési dokumentumok pontos vezetése.
 Elvárások 
 Villamos vagy egyéb műszaki végzettség
 Rajzok és munkautasítások olvasásának képessége
 Mérő eszközök szakszerű használata
 Csapatjátékos, ugyanakkor önálló munkavégzésre képes
 Alapvető mechanikai és elektronikai szerelési készségek
 Amit mi ígérünk 
 Kultúránk gyökere a robotika és a könnyű, felhasználóbarét automatizálási megoldások iránti szenvedélyünkben rejlik. Az eredmény? Világszerte egyszerűbbé és biztonságosabbá tesszük az emberek életét. Vállalatunk lelke a sokszínűség – nagyra értékelünk minden egyes ragyogó és merész ötletet. Mindenkit arra bíztatunk, hogy munkája során legyen teljesen önmaga, ezáltal egy olyan környezet tud létrejönni, ahol az inspiráció, a szakértelem és a személyes fejlődés kibontakozhat. Közös célunk? A nagyszerűség és az innovatív, pozitív változások beindítása és elérése – nem csak az automatizálási iparágon belül, hanem annak határain túl is.
 Juttatások és támogatások 
 Elkötelezettek vagyunk munkatársaink jóléte iránt, ezért juttatások széles skáláját biztosítjuk, a versenyképes juttatási csomagoktól a rugalmas munkarenden át a szakmai fejlődési lehetőségekig. Mindezzel célunk, hogy munkavállalóink elégedettek legyenek. Hiszünk abban, hogy munkatársaink elkötelezettségét és kemény munkáját elismerés illeti, és juttatásaink tükrözik ezt a hozzáállásunkat. Célunk, hogy olyan munkahelyet hozzunk létre, ahol az alkalmazottak értékesnek érzik magukat, inspiráltak és motiváltak, hogy a legjobbat hozzák ki magukból. Csatlakozz hozzánk, és élvezd az előnyeit egy olyan vállalatnak, amely a csapatának a jóllétét és fejlődését helyezi előtérbe!
 Sokszínűség, méltányosság és elfogadás 
 Alapvető meggyőződésünk, hogy kedvesen, nyitottan és kölcsönös tisztelettel egymás iránt egy olyan környezetet teremthetünk, ahol mindenki önmaga lehet a munkája során. 
 A KUKA az esélyegyenlőség iránt elkötelezett vállalat. Minden jelentkezést aprólékos gondossággal és odafigyeléssel kezelünk – olyan döntéshozatali folyamattal, amelyet nem befolyásol a származás, az iskolai végzettség, az életkor, a nem, a szexuális irányultság, továbbá a vallási vagy a politikai meggyőződés sem. Ha csatlakozol a KUKA-hoz, rengeteg lehetőséged lesz arra, hogy megoszd, mi motivál téged, és mi határozza meg egyéniségedet, ha szeretnéd.
 Csatlakozz az utazáshoz! 
 Ha úgy gondolod, hogy a KUKA által kínált karrier az, amit keresel, szívesen hallanánk felőled.
 Várjuk jelentkezésedet!

items.desc:
Where do people love what they do, and being great at what they do? 
 At Swisslog, that’s where! Our teams are the heart of a world-leading Robotics company that’s harnessing the power of technology to shape the future of intralogistics. The result? We’re transforming performance and efficiency for customers across the globe, giving them the vital edge in their markets.
 Make an impact 
 Swisslog is expanding its maintenance team at our customer’s new automated warehouse in Barendrecht. We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Resident Engineer to join our dedicated team. In this position, you will work 40 hours in extended (mainly) 2-shifts. You will work in a team with 6 colleagues, the operating hours are between 6am - 11pm, 5 days per week including weekends on rotation.
 Please note: This is a permanent position, starting with a 12-month contract. 
 Performing electro-mechanical preventive and corrective maintenance on automated material handling systems, including Autostore and conveyors, in line with Swisslog quality standards.
 Diagnose and resolve mechanical and electronic faults, escalating to remote specialists when needed.
 Ensure safe, efficient operations by following planned preventive maintenance (PPM) schedules.
 Act as the on-site representative of Swisslog, building and maintaining strong customer relationships with Albert Heijn.
 What you need to succeed 
 Technical education in mechanical / electrical maintenance or mechatronics
 Customer and service oriented mindset and strong communication skills
 Knowledge of preventive maintenance methods and schedules
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.)
 Experience working on automated equipment such as conveyors and robots is an advantage but not strictly required
 Reside within less than 1 hour driving distance from Barendrecht
 Hold a valid driving license
 Comfortable communicating in English (main team language); knowledge of Dutch is a strong plus.
 Our promise to you 
 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.
 Join us on this journey and you’ll be part of a global enterprise that’s proud of its Swiss roots - and hugely excited by the worldwide opportunities open to everyone in the Swisslog family. So come and realize your potential, in a team that’s united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit.
 About Swisslog 
 Swisslog is shaping the future of intralogistics. As part of the KUKA Group, we work on the latest technologies that are reimagining the world of logistics. We’re a team of 3,000+ experts from 50 countries, serving some of the world's largest and most exciting brands. Together, we’re implementing smart and innovative approaches - including flexible robot-based and data-driven automation solutions that are transforming the supply chain. So join our team and share your unique perspective.
 Join the journey! 
 If you think a career with Swisslog could be what you are looking for, we´d love to hear from you.
 We´re looking forward to receiving your application!

items.desc:
Overview 
 Ready to democratize AI transformation of work in the German Mittelstand? 
Do you enjoy working on a high-performing, fast-paced sales team? Are you insatiably curious and do you lean into uncertainty, take risks, and learn quickly from your mistakes? If so, we are looking for you!   At Small, Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team - one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation. 
SME&C is more than a sales organization - it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business. 
In the AI Workforce Specialists team, we are looking for passionate, experienced, and credible specialist sellers with a drive for developing and winning strategic opportunities that deliver end-to-end AI Workforce transformation at scale through high-impact, value-driven customer engagements—helping organizations achieve meaningful business outcomes and unlock the full potential of AI-powered productivity. As a Digital AI Workforce Specialist, you will lead the charge in transforming how organizations adopt and scale AI-powered productivity across AI Workforce solutions (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Chat, Agents, ME3, ME5, Frontline Worker) and build strategies with customers, collaborating across different groups inside the Customer environment to successfully enable customers to drive and adopt AI transformation. You will lead consultative customer conversations and collaborate on the planning, orchestration and execution of end-to-end AI Workforce solutions opportunities with internal stakeholders and partners to cross-sell and up-sell. This opportunity will allow you to learn and accelerate your career growth, honing your solution sales and collaboration skills, and deepening your AI Workforce end-to-end expertise.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 You will drive customer conversations around modern workplace transformation by showcasing how Microsoft 365, Copilot, and AI-powered solutions can enhance productivity, employee engagement, and business outcomes—tailored to industry-specific needs and priorities.
 You will collaborate with the partner ecosystem to co-sell and co-innovate, identifying opportunities to integrate AI and modern work capabilities into customer scenarios, and supporting partner onboarding where relevant.
 You will use data-driven insights and business analysis (e.g., whitespace analysis, identify industry trends) to pursue high-potential customers and develop a target list of potential business.
 You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end business of the assigned territory as you conduct forecasting for accounts and develop a portfolio and territory plan to drive intentional selling aligned with strategic priorities.
 You will apply the orchestration model to proactively drive deal closure by identifying and align internal stakeholders, leverage and expand relationships with partners.
 Qualifications 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications 
 Several years of technology-related sales or account management experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, or related field AND several years of technology-related sales or account management experience
 OR Master's Degree in Business Administration (e.g., MBA), Information Technology, or related field AND several years of technology-related sales or account management experience
 Full proficiency in English (both written and verbal) AND German (Level C1 or higher)
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Several years of solution sales or consulting services experience
 Experience with AI technologies and change management/adoption is an asset.

items.desc:
Overview 
 As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running. This could be anything from coordinating with supplier/vendors, recognizing safe versus unsafe work environment, having a hands-on understanding of how critical environment equipment works, performing various types of maintenance, responding to onsite incidents while coordinating with other critical facilities professionals, and using telemetry and other platforms to monitor equipment performance and operations.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as an operations specialist in one major area of CE operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators) and works on advanced tasks independently.
 Inspect and supervise critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions and escalate per applicable policies and standards. 
 Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
 Safely and quickly respond to and lead onsite incident response teams for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs, without supervision.
 Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.
 Under minimal oversight, perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for one or more types of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems), correct procedures.
 Have a hands-on understanding of how equipment works and how to troubleshoot equipment, systems, subsystems, and components independently within their trained discipline.
 Provides consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems. 
 Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], environmental health and safety (EH&S), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable within Microsoft requirements.
 Embody our culture and values

 Required Qualifications: 
 High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields) OR equivalent experience.
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications :

 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 Responsibilities 
 Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.
 Participates in daily safety briefings, completes required training aligned to the role and workload including safety training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
 Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians.

 Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.
 Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work. 
 Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data center facilities.
 Embodies our culture and values .

 Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.

 Some experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
 Within CE&S, the Customer Service & Support (CSS) organization builds trust and confidence for every person and organization through delivering a seamless support experience. In CSS, we are powered by Microsoft’s AI technology to help consumers, businesses, partners, and more, resolve their issues quickly and securely, helping prevent future problems from occurring and achieving more from their Microsoft investment.

Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

items.desc:
FUNDACIÓN TELEFÓNICA 
 El lado humano de la tecnología 
 Fundación Telefónica es la fundación corporativa del Grupo Telefónica, cuya misión es contribuir a la construcción de una sociedad digital más inclusiva, justa y sostenible. Con sede en Madrid y actuación principal en España y Europa, la Fundación trabaja para que las personas tengan acceso a las oportunidades que ofrece el entorno digital, con especial atención a la educación, el empleo, la cultura digital y la solidaridad. 
 En el marco de su vocación transformadora y de su creciente foco europeo, Fundación Telefónica desarrolla proyectos e iniciativas en colaboración con instituciones públicas y privadas, organizaciones de la sociedad civil y entidades del tercer sector, orientados a reducir la brecha digital, impulsar la empleabilidad en el ámbito tecnológico, promover el conocimiento y la reflexión crítica sobre el impacto de la tecnología en la sociedad, y apoyar a los colectivos más vulnerables. 
 Con esta visión, la Fundación se articula en torno a una estructura organizativa orientada a proyectos y apoyada por áreas transversales que garantizan el correcto funcionamiento institucional y el cumplimiento normativo. 
 El Área de Asesoría Jurídica y Compliance de Fundación Telefónica presta también soporte jurídico a Fundación ProFuturo, entidad constituida por Fundación Telefónica y Fundación Bancaria "la Caixa". Fundación ProFuturo tiene por objeto la mejora de la calidad educativa de niños y niñas en situación de vulnerabilidad en países en desarrollo, a través de la educación digital. Con presencia activa en más de 40 países de África, Asia y América Latina, y programas que llegan a millones de alumnos y docentes, ProFuturo constituye uno de los principales proyectos de educación digital a escala global. 
 ¿Qué hacemos en el equipo de asesoría jurídica y compliance? 
 El Área de Asesoría Jurídica y Compliance de Fundación Telefónica tiene como misión ofrecer asesoramiento legal sólido, práctico y proactivo a todas las áreas de la organización, velando por el estricto cumplimiento de la legalidad vigente y por las mejores prácticas éticas en el ámbito fundacional. El área actúa como interlocutor jurídico de referencia de todas las áreas de proyecto y de soporte de la Fundación, promoviendo una cultura de cumplimiento transversal y colaborativa. 
 Su ámbito de actuación abarca el asesoramiento en contratación, propiedad intelectual e industrial, protección de datos, régimen fundacional y del tercer sector, cumplimiento normativo (compliance), regulación de inteligencia artificial, gestión de riesgos legales y soporte a los procesos de gobernanza institucional. El área trabaja de forma estrecha y coordinada con el resto de las áreas de soporte de la Fundación (Finanzas, Recursos Humanos, Comunicación, Tecnología, entre otras), siendo la integración con el equipo de Compliance un eje prioritario y diferencial. 
 ¿Cuál será tu misión? 🎯 
 Serás parte integrante del Área de Asesoría Jurídica y Compliance, desarrollando, entre otras, las siguientes funciones: 
 Asesoramiento legal integral a las áreas de proyecto y áreas de soporte de Fundación Telefónica, así como a Fundación ProFuturo, identificando en cada caso el modelo de relacionamiento jurídico más adecuado e identificando y gestionando los riesgos asociados. Ello implicará: 
 Acompañamiento integral a los equipos de proyecto desde la fase de diseño, participando en reuniones de trabajo para definir marcos jurídicos, proponer modelos de intervención y anticipar riesgos. 
 Coordinación transversal entre las áreas de proyecto y las áreas de soporte de la Fundación, actuando como punto de enlace jurídico e impulsando una visión integrada del riesgo legal. 
 Gestión de la interlocución con contrapartes externas (entidades colaboradoras, proveedores, asesores externos, administraciones públicas), así como con otras entidades del ecosistema Telefónica. 
 Redacción, revisión y negociación autónoma de acuerdos y contratos de diversa naturaleza: convenios de colaboración, contratos de prestación de servicios, contratos de mecenazgo, licencias de propiedad intelectual, acuerdos de confidencialidad, donaciones modales, cesiones de derechos y demás instrumentos jurídicos necesarios para el desarrollo de la actividad de la Fundación. 
 Elaboración de documentación de contratación de bienes y servicios conforme a la normativa interna aplicable, incluyendo la preparación de pliegos de condiciones, elaboración de informes de necesidad y apoyo en procesos de licitación y selección de proveedores. 
 Gestión del flujo documental de los acuerdos suscritos por la Fundación: tramitación de aprobaciones internas conforme a la normativa de gobierno interno, coordinación del proceso de firma (incluyendo firma digital), archivo y seguimiento del cumplimiento de obligaciones contractuales. 
 Apoyo en la gestión de la protección de datos de carácter personal, incluyendo la atención y gestión de solicitudes de ejercicio …

SEGURIDAD DE PRODUCTO 
 ¿Quieres unirte a una empresa líder en la industria tecnológica? 
 Sabemos que estás en búsqueda de un cambio…
