 LUGAR DE TRABAJO: MADRID. 
 Nº DE VACANTES: 1. 
 QUEREMOS GENTE COMO TÚ... 
 Que le atraigan los retos para velar por la protección continua del software de Canales Digitales de Telefónica España con un rol de Seguridad de Producto . 
 La misión principal será acompañar a los equipos de desarrollo en la construcción de software seguro, ayudando a integrar la seguridad en el día a día del producto, desde el diseño hasta la operación. Actuarás como punto de conexión entre el equipo de producto y el equipo de Seguridad, facilitando que las necesidades, criterios y buenas prácticas de seguridad se apliquen de forma realista, útil y sostenible. 
 No buscamos únicamente una persona experta en una tecnología concreta, sino alguien con criterio de seguridad, capacidad de colaboración y ganas de impulsar una cultura de seguridad por diseño dentro de un entorno de desarrollo software. 
 QUE RETOS ENFRENTARÁS EN EL DÍA A DÍA: 
 Impulsar y velar por el S-SDLC , ayudando a que la seguridad forme parte natural del ciclo de vida de desarrollo software.
 Realizar seguimiento de vulnerabilidades internas, trabajando con tickets en Jira y ayudando a priorizar su resolución según criticidad, impacto y esfuerzo.
 Revisar y auditar la de seguridad de nuestro entorno cloud GCP, principalmente en Security Command Center .
 Actuar como interlocutor/a con el departamento de Seguridad , trasladando criterios, riesgos, necesidades y decisiones entre Seguridad y los equipos de producto.
 Participar en decisiones de diseño de arquitectura , aportando una visión de seguridad desde fases tempranas.
 Colaborar en la configuración o mejora de controles de seguridad como autenticación y autorización, OAuth, WAF, Cloud Armor, Model Armor u otros mecanismos de protección.
 Promover la cultura de seguridad en el equipo de desarrollo mediante píldoras formativas, buenas prácticas, sesiones de evangelización y ejemplos prácticos sobre ataques comunes, seguridad por diseño o nuevas amenazas.
 Mantenerse al día en tendencias de seguridad aplicadas a nuevas tecnologías, especialmente en ámbitos como inteligencia artificial, APIs, automatización y servicios cloud.

 Se valorará formación técnica relacionada con ingeniería informática, telecomunicaciones, ciberseguridad, desarrollo software, arquitectura cloud o ámbitos equivalentes.
 Se valorarán certificaciones relacionadas con seguridad o cloud, como GCP Security Engineer, CISSP, CISM u otras equivalentes.
 CONOCIMIENTO Y HABILIDADES: 
 Se valorarán los siguientes conocimientos y habilidades: 
 Conocimiento de prácticas de desarrollo seguro y seguridad en el ciclo de vida del software.
 Familiaridad con el enfoque Security by Design y capacidad para aplicarlo de forma práctica en equipos de desarrollo.
 Capacidad para entender arquitecturas software , identificar riesgos de seguridad y proponer mitigaciones razonables.
 Conocimiento de amenazas habituales en aplicaciones web y APIs, como OWASP Top 10 , abuso de tokens, inyección, SSRF, exposición de datos o ataques automatizados.
 Familiaridad con entornos cloud , especialmente GCP, sin necesidad de ser especialista en todos sus servicios.
 Conocimientos generales de controles de seguridad como autenticación, autorización, OAuth, WAF, protección de APIs, gestión de secretos o control de accesos.
 Capacidad para analizar vulnerabilidades , entender su impacto y ayudar a priorizar su resolución junto con los equipos técnicos.
 Habilidad para comunicar seguridad de forma clara, cercana y adaptada a diferentes interlocutores: desarrollo, arquitectura, operaciones y áreas corporativas de Seguridad.
 Interés por aprender y mantenerse actualizado/a en nuevas tecnologías y amenazas emergentes, especialmente en inteligencia artificial y seguridad de productos digitales.

items.desc:
¿Quiénes somos? 
 Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales (TSA) es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica creadora de soluciones audiovisuales broadcast desde 1993. 
 Con sede central en España y oficina en Latinoamérica, TSA destaca por su carácter internacional ofreciendo servicios y soluciones broadcast y multimedia en cualquier parte del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones de consultoría, diseño e integración de proyectos audiovisuales broadcast end-to-end, soluciones integrales para la producción de televisión, proyectos de innovación como los basados en IA y servicios de plataformas de video DTH, IPTV, OTT, emisión de canales, etc. Nuestros proyectos y servicios se complementan además con formación, coaching y soporte con diferentes niveles de servicio. 
 También gestionamos el mayor telepuerto totalmente privado de España, mediante el cual se distribuyen más de 700 canales de televisión y radio, además de ofrecer accesos a Internet, Starlink, LAN, Voz IP y datos. 
 Nuestra experiencia se ha forjado a lo largo de los años a través del diseño, ejecución y soporte de numerosos proyectos y servicios, tanto propios como de nuestros clientes. 
 Creemos en la orientación al cliente, la innovación y la flexibilidad, y nuestro compromiso es promover soluciones tecnológicas para nuestros clientes, que se ajusten a las necesidades cambiantes de un mundo audiovisual en constante evolución. 
 Área de la Vacante 
 El portfolio de TV de pago y entretenimiento de Telefónica en Brasil y Europa tiene como objetivo ofrecer una experiencia de entretenimiento excepcional a nuestros clientes. 
 La persona que ocupe este rol formará parte de un equipo con una misión clara: crear productos multimedia excelentes para móvil, web y TV. El foco está en aumentar el engagement de los usuarios mediante un servicio de entretenimiento avanzado, basado en insights de usuario. 
 Misión 
 Este rol forma parte del equipo de eXperience Design (XD) y tiene como objetivo impulsar la eficiencia operativa, la adopción de procesos y la escalabilidad del Design System, contribuyendo a una mejor experiencia de usuario en los productos de entretenimiento de Telefónica. 
 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones? 
 Entre tus principales funciones destacan: 
 Design Operations – procesos, gobernanza y adopción: 
 Analizar la situación y madurez del equipo de eXperience Design, identificando oportunidades de mejora en capacidades, procesos, comunidad y cultura. 
 Diseñar, documentar y evolucionar los procesos de trabajo del equipo (briefing, handoff, revisiones, QA de diseño, gestión de dependencias, etc.). 
 Liderar iniciativas de mejora continua que permitan incrementar la eficiencia operativa y la entrega de valor. 
 Gestionar y realizar el seguimiento de proyectos de diseño en colaboración con equipos de Producto, Desarrollo, Project Management y Operaciones.

items.desc:
Information Security Engineer - two positions 
 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Information Security Engineer - two positions
 80%-100%, Lugano, fixed-term 
 print 
 Drucken 
 The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates the compute and data infrastructure behind much of Switzerland’s computational science, from climate and weather to materials and large-scale AI. We are now extending the flagship Alps to compute on sensitive data, including medical data and other regulated datasets, through a Secure Computing Environment built for partners whose data must stay inside a tightly controlled perimeter. For that work, trust is what we deliver.
 Project background
 We are building an ISO/IEC 27001-certified information security management system, first for the Secure Computing Environment and then across the whole centre. Our Management Board and Director have approved a lasting expansion of CSCS’s security capability, and we are growing the team that runs it, starting with two Information Security Engineers to strengthen our security operations.
 We have two positions to fill, both initially offered on a two-year contract. The preferred work location is Lugano , although Zürich may also be considered. These positions are funded through ETH Zurich's strategic HPCN-28 initiative, which supports the continued development of key institutional capabilities in line with ETH Zurich's strategic objectives. Following the initial contract period, the contracts may be extended and, subject to organisational needs and funding, could potentially become permanent over time.
 Job description
 As an Information Security Engineer, you will play a key role in protecting CSCS services, infrastructure and research environments. You will work closely with infrastructure, platform and application teams to strengthen CSCS’s security posture and keep its operating environment resilient and secure.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Design, implement and continuously improve security controls across the infrastructure.
 Monitor, detect, investigate and respond to security incidents using SIEM platforms (e.g. Wazuh or equivalent) and other security tools, including on-call duties where applicable and subject to an agreed operational arrangement.
 Extend security monitoring to the Secure Computing Environment: onboard log sources, manage retention, and operate its circuit-breaker and audit trails.
 Conduct threat hunting and security investigations using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
 Lead and coordinate vulnerability management, including identification, prioritisation, remediation tracking and risk assessment.
 Secure containerised and Kubernetes-based environments, integrating security throughout the platform lifecycle.
 Develop and maintain security monitoring, detection and response capabilities, automating wherever it pays off.
 Collaborate with internal teams to prevent, identify and mitigate security risks.
 Promote a strong security culture through awareness initiatives, training sessions and engagement across the organisation and our user community.
 Profile
 Required 
 Several years of hands-on experience in security operations or security engineering.
 Strong knowledge of security monitoring, threat detection, incident response and security investigations
 Experience with SIEM technologies (Wazuh or comparable platforms).
 Solid understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and modern adversary tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs).
 Proven experience with vulnerability management processes and tools.
 Experience securing Kubernetes and containerised environments.
 Solid Linux skills and fluency in scripting and automation (Python or similar; detection-as-code is a plus).
 Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 A proactive mindset, strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently.
 Fluent English.
 Nice to have 
 Experience with threat intelligence platforms, processes and threat-informed defence.
 Knowledge of AI security, including risks, governance and controls for AI-based systems and workloads.
 Experience in research, academic, HPC or large-scale distributed computing environments.
 Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, GIAC GSEC/GCIA/GCIH, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist).

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 650 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 450 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,

Bankunk az olasz Intesa Sanpaolo Csoport leányvállalata. Univerzális hitelintézetként a hazai pénzpiac egyik meghatározó szereplőjeként több mint 45 éves tapasztalattal rendelkezünk. Folyamatosan keressük az innovatív, ügyfeleinkre szabott megoldásokat, melynek kollégáink is aktív részesei. Ha fontos számodra a nemzetközi háttér, a barátságos és szerethető légkör, és egy olyan munkahelyet keresel, ahol a fejlődésed és jólléted tényleges figyelmet kap, ne várj tovább! 
 Fiókigazgatóként kulcsszereped lesz: 
 A fiók értékesítési és operatív tevékenységének irányításában. 
 A teljesítményértékelési rendszer működtetésében – a fióki munkatársak célkitűzésében és teljesítményük értékelésében. 
 Az akvizíciós lehetőségek fejlesztésében és kiterjesztésében. 
 A partnerhálózat fejlesztésében és a fiók aktív képviseletében. 
 A fióki szakértők szakmai fejlődésében és motiválásában. 
 A szakmai utánpótlás megszervezésében , valamint a toborzás és kiválasztási folyamatok támogatásában. 
 A fiók eredményesebb és hatékonyabb működését támogató fejlesztési javaslatok megfogalmazásában és megvalósításában . 
 A fióki ügyfélpanaszok professzionális kezelésében . 
 Neked való mindez, ha: 
 Felsőfokú végzettséggel és legalább 3-5 év bankszakmai tapasztalattal rendelkezel. 
 Szereztél már tapasztalatot olyan vezetői pozícióban , ahol aktívan koordináltad egy szakmai egység munkáját. 
 Naprakész szakmai ismeretekkel rendelkezel a jelzáloghitelezés és a befektetési termékek területén. 
 Erős tárgyalási és kapcsolatépítési készségekkel rendelkezel. 
 Előremutató, üzleti szemléletű gondolkodás jellemez , mert szívesen keresed a hatékonyságot növelő lehetőségeket és analitikus készségeiddel jól átlátod az üzleti helyzeket. 
 Fontos számodra, hogy a kollégák a szakmailag fejlődése és aktívan támogatod őket benne. 
 Előnyök: 
 Angol nyelvtudás. 
 Értékeljük a tehetséged: 
 Éves bruttó 500 000 Ft-os cafeteria keretet biztosítunk, melyet gyakorlatilag minden jól ismert elemre felhasználhatsz. 
 Próbaidő után kamatmentes lakáscélú hitelfelvétel lehetősége is adott lesz. 
 Beilleszkedési bónusszal ismerjük el a kezdeti időszak kihívásaiban tanúsított kitartásodat: fél éves és egy éves munkaviszonyodat egyaránt bruttó 150 000 - 150 000 Ft-tal jutalmazzuk a szabályzatban megadott feltételek teljesítése esetén. 
 Teljesítményed alapján negyedévente és évente bónusz kifizetésben részesülhetsz . 
 Támogatjuk testi és lelki jól-léted: 
 Egészségbiztosítási szolgáltatást nyújtunk. 
 Anyabankunknak köszönhetően, súlyos betegségek esetén térítésmentes második orvosi szakvélemény és kezelés nemzetközi orvos szakemberek által . 
 Pszichológiai tanácsadás a Szakértő Segítség Program keretén belül. 
 Nyári szünetekre táborok támogatása. 
 Banki, partneri kedvezmények vásárlásokra és egyéb szolgáltatásokra . 
 Csatlakozz hozzánk, mert: 
 Egy nemzetközi bankcsoport magyar leányánál biztos munkahelyed lesz . 
 A munkatársaiddal minden problémára megoldást találtok majd, hiszen a támogató közösség nálunk alap. 
 Számunkra fontos a szakmai fejlődésed, ezért széleskörű képzés palettát nyújtunk minden munkavállalónak. 
 Online és személyes programokkal színesítjük a hétköznapokat. 
 Szeretnél többet megtudni arról, hogy milyen nálunk tanácsadóként dolgozni a mindennapokban? Látogass el a Karrier a fiókhálózatban oldalunkra is! 
 Légy te is CIB-es, hogy megtaláld a helyed!

 Éves bruttó 500 000 Ft-os cafeteria keretet biztosítunk, melyet gyakorlatilag minden jól ismert elemre felhasználhatsz.

items.desc: About us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world About the team: The Data & AI Governance department enables extending the governance theme of policies, standards, processes and technology for governing data and AI to driving excellence in our approach to leveraging secure, trusted, accessible data for data driven decision making through: An overarching Data & AI Policy to include associated standards Data & AI Governance including meta and master data management Data & AI Delivery Governance Data & AI Quality including both technical and business quality measures This enables the maturity of Data and AI capabilities across Booking.com, unlocking data and algorithms as assets for delivering innovative growth opportunities and cost saving operational efficiencies. Role Description: As a Data & AI Governance Specialist focused on Master and Reference Data, you will help define, implement and continuously improve the standards, guidelines and governance practices that make shared data consistent, understandable, trusted and fit for purpose. You will work across business and technology domains to ensure common definitions, ownership models, quality expectations, lifecycle rules and change processes for master and reference data. You will translate governance principles into practical guidance that teams can adopt in their data products, platforms and operating processes. This role combines data governance expertise, standards development, operating model design and stakeholder enablement. Success requires the ability to turn complex data management challenges into clear, actionable and scalable practices. Key Job Responsibilities and Duties: Define, review and maintain standards and guidelines for master and reference data, including principles, minimum requirements, roles needed, lifecycle, data quality, controls and implementation guidance. Establish common approaches for identifying, scoping and prioritising master and reference data domains and data products. Develop guidance for defining business terms, data elements, authoritative sources, golden records, reference values, critical data elements and other key metadata. Partner with Data & AI Stewards, Owners, Product Managers, Data & AI Engineers, Architects, Privacy, Security, Risk, Compliance and Legal to embed the standards into delivery and operational processes. Ensure master and reference data standards are aligned with the Data & AI Governance Framework, Data & AI Policy, classification requirements, privacy obligations, information security principles and applicable regulation. Contribute to the development of reusable templates, playbooks, patterns, checklists and training materials that help teams apply the standards consistently. Identify gaps, risks and inconsistencies in master and reference data practices, and coordinate proportionate remediation with accountable stakeholders. Role Qualifications and Requirements: 5+ years’ experience in designing and implementing Data Governance and Management in large-scale organisations; AI Governance experience preferred. Experience designing, implementing or operating Data Governance, Data Management or Master Data Management capabilities in a complex organisation. Practical experience creating and maintaining data standards, policies, guidelines, playbooks or control frameworks. Strong understanding of master data and reference data concepts, including domains, entities, attributes, identifiers, hierarchies, taxonomies, code sets and authoritative sources. Understanding of metadata, data cataloguing, data classification, lineage, critical data elements and data lifecycle management. Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into clear, usable standards and implementation guidance. Experience working across business and technology stakeholders, with the ability to influence without relying solely on formal authority. Experience facilitating working groups, resolving definition or ownership disputes, and building alignment across domains. Familiarity with data management and governance tooling; experience with tools such as Collibra, Informatica, Alation, Atlan, Microsoft Purview or equivalent is beneficial. Familiarity with relevant regulatory and control considerations, such as GDPR, DMA, SOX and the EU AI Act, is beneficial. Good knowledge of Jira and Confluence. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to make complex topics clear for both specialist and non-specialist audiences.  Informazioni sulla posizione 
 Sanofi è un'azienda della salute, innovativa e globale, guidata da una ragion d'essere: sfidare i confini della scienza per migliorare la vita delle persone.
 La Franchise Rare Diseases rappresenta uno degli ambiti più strategici e distintivi di Sanofi, in cui l'impegno verso i pazienti con bisogni terapeutici non soddisfatti si traduce in ricerca scientifica avanzata, innovazione terapeutica e presenza capillare sul territorio. All'interno di questa realtà, l'area Rare Hematology è focalizzata sulla Mastocitosi, una patologia rara e complessa, caratterizzata da un'elevata eterogeneità clinica e da un percorso diagnostico e terapeutico ancora oggi sfidante per la comunità medica.
 In questo contesto, la linea Rare Hematology è alla ricerca di un/una Clinical Science Associate da inserire nel proprio organico, all'interno di un team ambizioso, agile e orientato all'impatto concreto per i pazienti. Un'opportunità unica per contribuire attivamente alla formazione scientifica, alla costruzione di relazioni scientifiche solide con i centri specialistici di riferimento e al miglioramento della gestione clinica di una patologia ancora poco conosciuta.
 Responsabilità principali 
 Garantire un'informazione e una comunicazione scientifica di alto livello sui prodotti e sulla patologia di competenza, rivolta agli specialisti di riferimento (ematologi, allergologi, immunologi, onco-ematologi e altri professionisti sanitari coinvolti nella gestione della Mastocitosi), nel pieno rispetto delle normative vigenti e del codice deontologico.
 Costruire e mantenere relazioni solide e durature con i principali esperti e centri specialistici del territorio, promuovendo una partnership scientifica autentica e orientata al miglioramento della gestione del paziente.
 Contribuire attivamente alla disease awareness, supportando la comunità medica nella conoscenza e nel riconoscimento della patologia, con l'obiettivo di ridurre i ritardi diagnostici e migliorare l'appropriatezza terapeutica.
 Monitorare le dinamiche del mercato locale, l'andamento della patologia nel territorio di competenza e la disponibilità dei farmaci, identificando opportunità e aree di intervento prioritarie.
 Proporre e contribuire allo sviluppo di iniziative e progetti scientifici locali, in collaborazione con i principali interlocutori clinici e con le funzioni aziendali di riferimento (Marketing, Medica, Market Access).
 Partecipare ai principali congressi, convegni e seminari dell'area terapeutica di riferimento, rappresentando Sanofi con competenza e professionalità.
 Lavorare in modo trasversale e collaborativo con i colleghi delle diverse funzioni aziendali, contribuendo a una visione integrata del territorio e affermandosi come punto di riferimento credibile per gli interlocutori interni ed esterni.
 Profilo del candidato / della candidata 
 Esperienza : Esperienza nella promozione scientifica di prodotti farmaceutici specialistici in ambiente ospedaliero; la conoscenza dell'area ematologica, onco-ematologica o delle malattie rare costituisce un requisito preferenziale. 
 Competenze tecniche e “soft skill” : Spiccate capacità relazionali e comunicative, con attitudine a costruire relazioni di fiducia autentiche con gli interlocutori scientifici; orientamento al risultato e proattività; agilità nell'apprendimento scientifico e capacità di aggiornarsi rapidamente in contesti terapeutici complessi e in continua evoluzione; forte attitudine alla collaborazione in team e al lavoro trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali; conoscenza delle dinamiche di mercato e dei meccanismi di accesso ospedaliero in ambito specialistico; familiarità con la lettura e l'interpretazione di dati clinici e con il contesto della ricerca clinica; approccio orientato ai dati per la pianificazione e la gestione del territorio; buona padronanza degli strumenti digitali e informatici.
 Istruzione : Richiesta la laurea in discipline scientifiche, quali Biologia, Farmacia, Chimica e Tecnologie Farmaceutiche (CTF) o Medicina e Chirurgia.
 Lingue : Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (parlata e scritta).
 Altro : È richiesta la residenza nell'area geografica di riferimento.

This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Internal Control Specialist, Non-Financial Compliance Risks 
 Adyen is looking for an Internal Control Specialist with a focus on non-financial risks (with a focus on integrity) in our Amsterdam office. You will join the global Internal Control team, which contributes to powering Adyen’s sustainable growth. You are experienced in risk management and internal control and have the ability and eagerness to operate proactively and independently in a complex and fun global environment.
 You will mainly focus on assessing and strengthening Adyen’s global operational processes and internal control framework (with a focus on integrity), to meet internal and external expectations and to enable controlled growth. You will support the company in building a great business, preserving the company culture, and achieving its long-term goals by taking our risk management to the next level.
 We don’t hide behind email. Instead, we pick up the phone. This is one of the values in our Adyen Formula, which is the foundation of our strong culture and an essential guiding principle for the way we work. We always ask why, are critical, don’t just tick the box and always look for improvement and automation. These are some of the values incorporated in the Adyen way of being in control, promoted by the Internal Control team globally.
 What you’ll do: 
 Strengthen and manage the global internal control framework (with a focus on integrity risk) and support management with internal control matters.
 Evaluate Adyen’s operational processes, risks and controls (with a focus on integrity risk) to identify opportunities for improvement and automation.
 Coordinate and perform testing of controls (with a focus on integrity risk), and report on the effectiveness of Adyen’s risk and control systems.
 Manage requests from auditors to ensure successful audit cycles (e.g. SOC1/SOC2 audits).
 Create a network and be an advisor for the business e.g. with members of the Compliance and Regulatory teams to strengthen the Compliance control framework and contribute to various projects (e.g. the SIRA).
 Collaborate with your Internal Control team peers to manage the global internal control framework and contribute to various projects (e.g. new products, new licences and RCAs).
 Who you are: 
 Relevant working experience (approximately 4 - 7 years) within an external audit, (operational) risk management or internal control function. Experience within a big-4 and/or the financial services industry is a plus.
 Knowledge of operational (with a focus on integrity risk) processes, risks and building internal control frameworks.
 Critical thinking skills and eagerness to solve challenges.
 Eager to work in an innovative technology company within the financial sector.
 You thrive in an unstructured, fast-paced environment, challenging the status-quo and have a ‘can-do’ mentality.
 Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

 Do you want to help shape the future of graphics on billions of Arm-powered devices worldwide? We are building leading solutions in mobile rendering: combining the best of classic rendering techniques with the exciting new possibilities of neural graphics!
 As part of our team, you’ll investigate technologies that help shape the future of Arm GPUs while also contributing to optimization guidance for developers working with current-generation platforms and tools.  We are looking for a curious and motivated software engineer who is excited to learn about computer and neural graphics with the aim to help developers around the world deliver great products on Arm.

items.desc:
Als Business Strategist bij Framna help je organisaties hun uitdagingen en ambities te vertalen naar strategische richting. Je ontdekt waar digitale innovatie écht waarde toevoegt, adviseert klanten over hun digitale toekomst en speelt een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol in commerciële trajecten. Je werkt vanuit Zwolle of Amsterdam.
 Word onderdeel van ons team 
 Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en product. Waar onze teams digitale producten ontwerpen en bouwen, kijk jij een stap eerder: Welke groeikansen zie je bij onze partners, en hoe kan een digitaal product daar optimaal in faciliteren?wat heeft een partner nodig om te groeien, en welk product hoort daarbij?
 Wat je gaat doen 
 Je ziet waar partners groeipotentie hebben en neemt zelf het initiatief om die kansen uit te werken.. Je overziet wat er nodig is om die kansen te realiseren; je brengt de input van stakeholders en disciplines samen, weegt belangen af en komt met een onderbouwd voorstel voor de volgende stap.
 Je dagen wisselen tussen partners en de studio. Bij partners voer je gesprekken en faciliteer je workshops en sessies, vaak met management en directie aan tafel. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit de Strategy & Consulting Hub en het salesteam. Samen duiken jullie in complexe klantvraagstukken, voeren jullie strategische analyses uit en ontwikkelen jullie overtuigende commerciële voorstellen.
 Jouw belangrijkste taken zijn:
 Complexe businessvraagstukken vertalen naar een heldere visie en concrete oplossingsrichtingen
 Partners adviseren over digitale strategie, businessmodellen, transformatie en groei
 Markten, concurrenten en technologische ontwikkelingen analyseren en daar kansen uit halen
 Meewerken aan commerciële trajecten: van eerste gesprek en workshop tot pitch en voorstel
 Samen met business development en andere disciplines nieuwe partnerrelaties en kansen ontwikkelen
 Strategisch gesprekspartner zijn voor de klant.
 Framna's strategische dienstverlening en proposities verder vormgeven
 Wie jij bent 
 Klaar om deze rol helemaal eigen te maken? Wij denken dat je goed bij ons past als je:
 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring hebt in een strategische of adviserende rol, bijvoorbeeld als Business Strategist, Digital Strategist of Business Consultant.
 In het bezit bent van een HBO- en/of WO Diploma.
 Verschillende belangen en disciplines samenbrengt tot één heldere richting.
 Complexe businessvraagstukken weet te doorgronden en te vertalen naar concrete strategische kansen en overtuigende adviezen.
 Een sterk gevoel hebt voor business en begrijpt hoe digitale oplossingen bijdragen aan strategische en commerciële doelstellingen.
 Energie krijgt van commerciële trajecten en graag bijdraagt aan pitches, klantpresentaties en overtuigende voorstellen.
 Ervaring hebt met strategische analyses, markt- en concurrentieonderzoek en het ontwikkelen van businesscases.
 Een stevige gesprekspartner bent voor klanten en gemakkelijk schakelt met stakeholders op management- en directieniveau.
 Vloeiend Nederlands spreekt.
 Over Framna 
 Framna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren.
 Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega's aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen.
 Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product.
 Wat je krijgt 
 Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.500 - €6.300 afhankelijk van je ervaring.
 Pensioenbijdrage van 67% vanuit Framna.
 27 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.
 Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.
 Een Macbook en telefoon in bruikleen.
 Dagelijkse lunch in de studio.
 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen we niet op prijs.

Ton futur environnementTu évolueras au sein d?un pôle d?ingénierie d?excellence dédié à la cybersécurité offensive et aux technologies d?IA émergentes. En collaboration directe avec les équipes de Red Team, les architectes de sécurité IA et les data scientists, tu interviendras sur un périmètre technique hautement novateur. C?est l?environnement idéal pour explorer les vulnérabilités de rupture, manipuler des frameworks d?évaluation offensive automatisés et impacter directement la mise en place des garde-fous de sécurité (guardrails) sur des cas d?usage métiers critiques. Tes missions clésTests d?Intrusion & Sécurité Offensive IA : Conduire des campagnes de tests d?intrusion offensifs sur des applications basées sur des modèles de langage (LLM Pentesting) : exploitation de failles de type prompt injection (directe et indirecte), jailbreaking, empoisonnement de contexte et contournement des filtres de sécurité. Évaluer la robustesse et la confidentialité des architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) face aux scénarios d?inférence non autorisée, de fuite de documents et d?exfiltration de données sensibles. Compétences indispensables Solides connaissances théoriques et pratiques en intelligence artificielle, acquises durant la formation et mises en application dans des projets concrets. Capacité à concevoir des agents IA, des automatisations et des solutions digitales fonctionnelles. Connaissances en développement informatique, API et outils d'automatisation. Maîtrise des bases des logiciels de PAO et sensibilité à la création graphique. Capacité à gérer et développer des projets de manière autonome ou collaborative. Vos qualités Curiosité technologique, créativité, autonomie, polyvalence, rigueur, esprit d'analyse, sens de l'initiative et capacité à travailler en équipe. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne force de proposition, capable de transformer une idée ou un besoin en projet concret et fonctionnel. Notre processus de recrutement 1. items.desc: Athens (Center), Attiki, Greece | IT Drive the transformation of FAMAR’s business and industrial processes by combining Lean methodologies, data engineering, artificial intelligence and automation. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you will work directly with operational teams to identify inefficiencies, redesign workflows and develop practical AI-powered solutions through to production deployment. You’ll connect fragmented systems and build reliable, secure and reusable data integrations that make enterprise data accessible. Using generative AI, intelligent agents, document intelligence and workflow automation, you’ll simplify complex processes, eliminate repetitive tasks and help teams work more effectively. What you’ll do: Work alongside business and manufacturing teams to identify bottlenecks and simplify processes using Lean principles. Build and deploy AI applications, intelligent agents, RAG solutions and automated workflows that solve practical operational challenges. Connect enterprise systems through reliable data pipelines, APIs and reusable integrations, improving data quality and accessibility. Develop document automation solutions supporting activities such as customer quotations, quality reviews and reporting. Take solutions from prototype to production using Microsoft Azure and sound engineering practices, including testing, monitoring and appropriate human oversight. Partner with IT and Quality to ensure security, data integrity and regulatory compliance where applicable. Train users, drive adoption and work with IT to establish ongoing support and maintenance. Measure results through time saved, shorter lead times, improved quality and validated savings, scaling successful solutions across FAMAR. What makes you a great fit Min. 3 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI development or intelligent process automation. Proven ability to map, analyse, challenge and simplify end-to-end processes together with business teams. Strong collaboration skills, with a track record of delivering results jointly with operational, IT and Quality teams. Demonstrated experience developing and deploying production-ready AI applications in operational environments. Strong hands-on engineering capabilities, including application development, data pipelines, APIs, automated workflows and production deployment. Experience integrating diverse enterprise systems, data sources and AI solutions into business processes. Practical experience with LLM applications, intelligent agents, RAG architectures or workflow automation. Experience with cloud technologies and data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure. Ability to translate business requirements and operational challenges into practical technical solutions. Experience with ERP, QMS, CRM or other enterprise systems would be advantageous; MES or LIMS experience would be a plus for future initiatives. Experience with document intelligence or enterprise workflow platforms would be advantageous. Knowledge of GxP, Computerized System Validation and data integrity principles would be an asset. Exposure to Lean methodologies or business process improvement would be advantageous. Why join FAMAR? Bring your engineering skills to a European pharmaceutical manufacturing and development group with more than 75 years of expertise and products supplied to 80 international markets. See your work in action. Build solutions alongside the people who use them, with visible results in manufacturing, quality and everyday business operations. Make an impact across borders . Develop solutions that can be adopted across FAMAR’s European sites and corporate functions. Expand your expertise. Receive dedicated Lean training and deepen your experience at the intersection of AI, data engineering and pharmaceutical operations. Own the journey. Take projects from understanding the problem to deploying the solution and measuring the improvement. We’d love to hear your story — what you’ve built, what you’ve learned and what you’d like to do next. Apply and let’s connect.

items.desc: Overview NCG is seeking a Senior AI Test Engineer to join our ITES sector team in England. This role is pivotal in ensuring the quality and reliability of our AI-driven solutions, aligning with our commitment to innovation and excellence. The Senior AI Test Engineer will be responsible for developing and executing test plans that validate and verify AI algorithms and systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards. This position involves collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure integrated AI solutions are robust and effective, contributing to the overall success of our projects. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in AI testing to drive improvements in our testing processes and methodologies, enhancing the quality and performance of our products. As a senior member of the team, you will mentor junior engineers and contribute to the strategic direction of AI testing initiatives. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for AI models and algorithms. Collaborate with AI developers and data scientists to understand requirements and ensure test coverage. Automate testing processes using industry-standard tools and frameworks to improve efficiency and accuracy. Analyze test results, identify defects, and work with development teams to resolve issues promptly. Conduct performance testing of AI systems to ensure scalability and reliability under different conditions. Maintain detailed documentation of test procedures, results, and improvements for future reference. Stay updated on the latest AI testing tools and methodologies and integrate them into the testing processes. Mentor junior test engineers, providing guidance and support in AI testing best practices. Requirements 3-6 years of experience in AI testing or related fields, with a strong understanding of AI and machine learning concepts. Proficient in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++ for test automation and scripting. Experience with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras. Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues effectively. Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and version control systems like Git. Excellent communication skills to articulate testing strategies and results to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks efficiently. Education Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field is required.

The Role We are looking for a hands-on Software AI Engineer to design, build and support production-grade AI agent solutions for one of our Financial Services clients. You will develop Python services, agent orchestration, secure integrations and retrieval pipelines, while contributing to cloud-native delivery, testing, observability and operational stability. The role suits an engineer with strong software fundamentals and practical experience building LLM-based applications in an enterprise environment. Preferably from a Financial Services background. Responsibilities but not limited to; Develop and support AI agent components, orchestration logic and workflow automation. items.desc: Data is de motor van elke digitale transformatie. Werk je graag mee aan de meest innovatieve data oplossingen van de toekomst? Dan heeft Cegeka de uitdaging voor jou! We zijn binnen ons Data & AI team binnen Cegeka op zoek naar een Snowflake Data Engineer. Naast ons partnership met Snowflake zijn we ook Microsoft- en Databricks-partner. Heb je zin om ons team van specialisten te vervoegen? Solliciteer dan zeker en laat je talent en ervaring bijdragen aan onze missie! In je rol als Snowflake Data Engineer werk je nauw samen met collega's aan data- en AI-projecten voor bedrijven in verschillende sectoren. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt robuuste, schaalbare ELT-pipelines met dbt (ook native via dbt Projects on Snowflake), georkestreerd met Apache Airflow of Snowflake Tasks, Streams en Dynamic Tables, met een sterke focus op automatisering en herbruikbaarheid. Een bepaalde flexibiliteit naar verplaatsingen is vereist aangezien er regelmatig van bij de klant wordt gewerkt. Als je aanwezigheid bij de klant niet vereist is dan kan je in het Cegeka-kantoor dichtst bij je woonplaats werken (Antwerpen, Brussel, Gent, Hasselt of Leuven) in combinatie met thuiswerk. Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud & Infrastructure Services en Network & Connectivity. items.desc: Refnr: 61217 Functieomschrijving Als medewerker Asset Liability Management & Modelling maak je deel uit van een gespecialiseerd team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer en de opvolging van het rente- en liquiditeitsrisico van de bank. Daarnaast werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling en het onderhoud van de modellen die deze risico's ondersteunen, evenals andere belangrijke modellen binnen de bank, zoals credit scoring- en IFRS9 modellen. Je staat in voor de maandelijkse risico-rapportering en analyseert de evolutie van de verschillende risico's binnen de balans. Bovendien speel je een actieve rol gedurende de volledige modellevenscyclus: van ontwikkeling en kalibratie tot monitoring, documentatie en periodieke herziening. Zo draag je rechtstreeks bij aan een robuuste meting en beheersing van onder meer renterisico (IRRBB) en kredietrisico, en ondersteun je strategische beslissingen binnen de bank. Tot je takenpakket behoren onder andere: - het controleren, analyseren en rapporteren van de rente- en liquiditeitsrisicoposities van de bank, het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en verbeteren van statistische modellen, het testen van de performantie, stabiliteit en robuustheid van modellen en het bewaken van hun blijvende geschiktheid voor het beoogde gebruik, het analyseren en interpreteren van modelresultaten, inclusief het beoordelen van de impact van gewijzigde aannames, klantgedrag en marktomstandigheden, het uitvoeren van periodieke reviews, herkalibraties en de implementatie van modelwijzigingen, het opstellen van risicoanalyses, managementrapporteringen en modeldocumentatie ter ondersteuning van besluitvorming en governance binnen de bank. Profiel studieniveau master wiskunde of gelijkwaardig, ervaring in soortgelijke functie is een pluspunt maar geen vereiste, je bent vertrouwd met SQL en R, kennis van Python is een pluspunt, je weet de modellen op een begrijpelijke manier over te brengen aan een niet-gespecialiseerd publiek en weet de opgestelde modellen goed te documenteren, je kan zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken, je werkt gestructureerd en planmatig, je beschikt over verantwoordelijkheidszin en een positieve attitude. You'll operate at the intersection of regulation, business and technology, advising clients on data protection, AI governance, risk management and regulatory
items.desc: Your role We are looking for a Data & AI Compliance Consultant who can help organizations navigate the evolving regulatory landscape around data, privacy and artificial intelligence, translating complex requirements into practical, workable solutions. You'll operate at the intersection of regulation, business and technology, advising clients on data protection, AI governance, risk management and regulatory compliance. You will support organizations in navigating European digital regulations, including the GDPR, EU AI Act, Data Act and Data Governance Act , while helping them establish effective governance frameworks, processes and controls. Building on your expertise in privacy, compliance, risk management or governance , you will help clients conduct compliance and risk assessments, identify regulatory and operational risks, and translate findings into concrete actions and improvements. This is more than a traditional compliance role. You will help organizations adopt AI responsibly while enabling innovation, ensuring that governance and regulatory requirements are embedded into existing business and technology processes. You'll work closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, IT, Security, Data and Business stakeholders , bridging regulatory expectations with operational realities. You will also contribute to client discussions, identify opportunities for further advisory support and help develop our growing Data & AI Governance and Compliance practice. Location: Our headquarters are located in Antwerp. As you'll be working with clients across different locations, we offer a flexible and hybrid working model, combining work from our office (flexible), client sites and home, depending on the needs of the project. Job requirements Required Experience Experience in data protection, privacy, regulatory compliance, risk management, IT governance or AI governance, preferably in a consulting or complex organizational environment. Strong understanding of GDPR and the EU AI Act, including their practical implications for organizations. Familiarity with the broader European digital regulatory landscape, including the Data Act, Data Governance Act, DORA and other relevant regulations. Experience in translating regulatory requirements into governance frameworks, policies, processes and internal controls . Hands-on experience with compliance assessments, risk assessments, impact assessments (such as DPIAs or FRIAs), or regulatory implementation projects. Understanding of AI Governance, Responsible AI and AI-related risks , including the implications of Generative AI and emerging AI technologies. Understanding of data governance principles, including data sharing, data access, data ownership and responsible data use. Familiarity with related domains such as information security, IT risk, operational resilience and third-party risk management. Experience identifying compliance gaps, defining remediation actions and supporting ongoing risk and compliance monitoring. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Legal, Compliance, Risk, IT, Security, Data and Business teams. Ability to translate regulatory and governance requirements into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Languages: Fluent in English and either Dutch or French , with a good working knowledge of the other language. What sets you apart A background as a DPO, Privacy Consultant, Compliance Officer, IT Risk Consultant, AI Governance Specialist or Regulatory Advisor, combined with practical knowledge of data and AI-related regulatory challenges. Ability to bridge data protection, AI governance, risk management and broader data governance and compliance challenges. Pragmatic, hands-on and solution-oriented, with experience making governance and compliance requirements workable in practice. Experience supporting organizations with AI risk classification, governance operating models, third-party risk assessments or regulatory compliance monitoring. Comfortable advising clients and engaging with senior stakeholders across business and technology functions. Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex regulatory and technical topics in a clear and accessible way. Interest in AI technologies, responsible innovation and emerging European digital regulations. items.desc: 1 - Werken bij de VUB De Vrije Universiteit Brussel staat al meer dan 50 jaar voor vrijheid, gelijk(waardig)heid en verbondenheid , en dat leeft sterk op onze campussen bij zowel studenten als personeel. Bij de VUB vind je een diverse verzameling aan persoonlijkheden: innovators pur sang, maar vooral mensen die 100% hun authentieke zelf zijn . Met zo’n 4.000 medewerkers zijn we de grootste Nederlandstalige werkgever, in de privésector, in Brussel ; een internationale stad waarmee we ons maar al te graag verbinden en waar(rond) onze 4 campussen gelegen zijn. Voeg daarbij ons beginsel van vrij onderzoek - waarin zelfreflectie, een kritische houding en een open, creatieve geest rond wetenschappelijke en maatschappelijke vraagstukken centraal staan - en je hebt een universiteit die fundamenteel grensverleggend en pionierend is op het vlak van onderwijs en onderzoek. Kortom: de VUB ten voeten uit . De VUB is bovendien lid van EUTOPIA , een alliantie van gelijkgestemde Europese universiteiten, allen klaar om zichzelf opnieuw uit te vinden. 2 - Functie Momenteel zijn we voor de Onderzoeksbursalen van de Faculteit Ingenieurswetenschappen , vakgroep Toegepaste mechanica , onderzoeksgroep Thermodynamics and Fluid Mechanics op zoek naar een doctoraatsbursaal . Meer concreet zal je takenpakket, ter voorbereiding van een doctoraat , er als volgt uitzien: Wij bieden een voltijdse doctoraatspositie aan in het kader van het ERC Starting Grant-project “Energising the future with clean plasma-based technologies” (ESCAPADE, proposal number 101302707). Plasma-assisted combustion (PAC) biedt veelbelovende perspectieven voor een schonere en efficiëntere verbranding van duurzame brandstoffen. De verdere industriële toepassing wordt echter beperkt door het ontbreken van voorspellende computermodellen die de complexe interacties tussen plasmaontladingen, chemische reacties en vlamdynamica nauwkeurig kunnen beschrijven. ESCAPADE pakt deze uitdaging aan door een innovatief multiphysics-simulatiekader te ontwikkelen dat modellering op basis van eerste principes combineert met machine learning, reduced-order technieken en computational fluid dynamics (CFD). Het project zal een nieuwe generatie voorspellende tools opleveren voor het ontwerp en de optimalisatie van verbrandingssystemen met lage emissies die werken op zowel duurzame als conventionele brandstoffen. De onderzoeksgroep FLOW van de VUB beschikt over uitgebreide expertise in zowel fundamenteel als toegepast onderzoek naar de modellering van thermo-fluid systemen, met toepassingen in de luchtvaart (aerodynamica, flow control), ruimtevaart (atmosferische terugkeer, ruimtevaartplasma's) en energie (windenergie, bio-energie, waterstof, warmtenetten en verbranding). Sinds 2021 werkt FLOW samen met de ATM-onderzoeksgroep van de ULB binnen de gezamenlijke onderzoeksgroep BRITE (Brussels Institute for Thermal-fluid Systems and clean Energy, https://brite-research.be). Plasma-assisted combustion combineert plasmaontladingen met verbrandingsprocessen om ontsteking, vlamstabiliteit en emissies van verontreinigende stoffen te verbeteren voor duurzame brandstoffen. Hoewel gedetailleerde state-to-state plasmaverbrandingsmodellen een ongeziene beschrijving bieden van de onderliggende fysica, blijft hun rekenkost te hoog voor multidimensionale simulaties en industriële toepassingen. Dit doctoraatsproject heeft als doel de volgende generatie computationele tools voor plasma-assisted combustion te ontwikkelen door gedetailleerde state-to-state kinetische modellering, mechanismereductie en physics-informed machine learning te combineren. De onderzoeker zal bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde simulatiecodes die plasmaontladingen, chemie en verbrandingsprocessen expliciet kunnen modelleren over een breed scala aan operationele omstandigheden. Een centraal doel van het project is de ontwikkeling van nieuwe reductiemethodologieën voor omvangrijke state-to-state kinetische mechanismen met honderden tot duizenden soorten en reacties. Voortbouwend op recente ontwikkelingen zoals plasma-directed relation graph-technieken (P-DRGEP), principal component analysis en machine-learninggebaseerde lumping-strategieën, zal de doctoraatsstudent reduced-order modellen met hoge nauwkeurigheid ontwikkelen die de essentiële plasma-verbrandingsinteracties behouden en tegelijk de rekenkost aanzienlijk verminderen. De ontwikkelde methodologieën zullen worden geïntegreerd in intern ontwikkelde plasma-assisted combustion solvers en gevalideerd aan de hand van experimentele benchmarkdatasets die worden aangeleverd door toonaangevende internationale projectpartners. Bijzondere aandacht gaat uit naar ammoniak- en waterstofverbrandingssystemen, die worden beschouwd als veelbelovende koolstofvrije brandstoffen voor toekomstige energie- en voortstuwingssystemen. De resulterende gereduceerde modellen zullen de rechtstreekse integratie van gedetailleerde plasmachemie mogelijk maken binnen geavanceerde CFD-omgevingen, …

As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Du kommer i første omgang til at arbejde med RoSy (Road System) og DriftWeb. Produkterne bidrager til planlægning, drift og vedligeholdelse af samfundskritisk infrastruktur og bliver brugt af kommuner, forsyninger og virksomheder i Danmark og resten af Norden. items.desc: Location: Humlebæk, DK Job Family: Research & Development Country/Region: Denmark Mechanical Design Engineer: Develop robust medical devices from concept to production Would you like to use your mechanical engineering expertise to develop medical devices that make a real difference for people with intimate healthcare needs? Working with engineers, scientists and project managers, you will turn product requirements and concepts into robust mechanical solutions, combining creative problem-solving with engineering rigour from concept evaluation through to production. Welcome to CC & BC Mechanical Engineering At our headquarters in Humlebæk, Denmark, you will join CC & BC Mechanical Engineering within Product Development, developing products for Continence Care and Bowel Care. Mechanical design connects what users need with how a product performs and how reliably it can be manufactured. Our work brings together functionality, materials, tolerances and production considerations to create practical solutions that perform consistently in everyday use. You will work closely with colleagues across Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Technical Design, Materials, Systems Engineering, Usability and Test Engineering, as well as Manufacturing Systems Development and Centre of Excellence specialists. Turn product concepts into reliable, manufacturable solutions As our new Mechanical Design Engineer, you will plan and deliver mechanical design activities in Product Development projects. Your work will span concept development and evaluation, detailed design, verification support and transfer to production. You will take ownership of your mechanical deliverables and provide clear technical conclusions and recommendations. Working within the agreed project scope, you will identify risks early, make design trade-offs visible and bring in the right expertise to move decisions forward. More specifically, you will: Develop and evaluate mechanical concepts, translating product requirements into practical design solutions in collaboration with Systems Engineering and relevant specialists. Develop and document mechanical designs using 3D CAD, working closely with Technical Design on drawings and specifications. Apply robust design methods and tolerance analysis to understand variation and secure reliable product performance. Apply Design for X principles to balance performance, manufacturability, sustainability and cost, involving manufacturing specialists early. Use calculations, simulation, prototypes and test evidence to evaluate solutions and support timely design decisions. Contribute mechanical expertise to risk assessments, verification planning, technical reviews and design documentation. Plan and deliver your activities against agreed project commitments, communicating risks, dependencies and the impact of proposed changes early. Share technical learning and help improve mechanical design practices across projects. A mechanical engineer with practical judgement and a collaborative approach You enjoy both exploring concepts and working through the details that make a design reliable. You can turn analysis into clear recommendations, explain design trade-offs and challenge unclear assumptions constructively. You take a structured approach without making solutions more complex than necessary. You understand when further analysis is needed and when the available evidence supports moving forward. Above all, you take responsibility for your work while recognising that strong product solutions depend on contributions from several disciplines. We imagine that you: Hold a BSc or MSc in mechanical engineering, mechanical design, product development or a related discipline. Have experience developing mechanical solutions, including plastic components for injection moulding and high-volume production. Work confidently with 3D CAD, preferably SolidWorks. Have experience with robust design, tolerance calculations and design for manufacture. Can apply engineering theory, calculations and data analysis to practical design challenges. Communicate technical ideas and conclusions clearly, both visually and verbally. Work effectively across disciplines and document your work clearly. Communicate confidently in English. Experience in medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage. We also value experience with simulation and an interest in using digital tools, including AI where relevant, to improve engineering analysis and development efficiency. You do not need to know every method from the outset. Curiosity, sound engineering judgement and a willingness to develop your expertise are important. Interested? If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Jesper Bruun Jensen, Head of Continence Care & Bowel Care Mechanical Engineering, at DKJBRJ@coloplast.com. We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate …

items.desc: Do you want to lead the ecological interpretation of complex offshore bird-monitoring projects? Can you turn radar, video, acoustic and environmental data into scientifically defensible conclusions for clients and regulators? Join DHI and take scientific ownership of projects at the intersection of avian ecology, technology and offshore wind. Responsibilities and challenges We are looking for a Biologist to support the scientific delivery of DHI MUSE and avian ecology projects. You will contribute to biological reviews, ecological analyses, reporting, and project coordination, working with experienced biologists, data scientists, instrumentation specialists and project managers. You will take increasing ownership of routine project-level scientific tasks, with guidance from senior colleagues and the Scientific Lead. Your main responsibilities and challenges will include: Prepare, organise and analyse radar, video, acoustic, weather and system-status data needed for scientific deliverables. Contribute to ecological analyses of flight trajectories, bird flux, species distribution, phenology, avoidance behaviour and collision risk. Work with data scientists and analysts to review results and interpret them in their ecological context. Draft report sections, technical notes, presentations, figures, tables and responses to review comments. Document assumptions, uncertainty, limitations and other performance aspects clearly and consistently. Participate in project meetings and support communication with clients, suppliers, subcontractors and other DHI teams. Follow approved methods and quality procedures, and escalate unsupported conclusions or non-standard methods to senior colleagues. Qualifications and personal skills We are looking for a colleague with the following qualifications: Required: Master's degree in biology, ecology, ornithology or a closely related discipline, equivalent relevant qualifications or other proven merits and references in ornithology. A strong foundation in avian ecology, species identification, animal behaviour, migration ecology or environmental monitoring. Ability to analyse scientific information and communicate findings clearly in writing and orally. Careful and consistent approach to biological classification, quality assurance and documentation. Good data-handling skills and willingness to work with radar, video, acoustic and environmental datasets. Excellent written and spoken English. Ability to collaborate across biological, analytical, technical and project-management disciplines. Ability to use AI to speed up delivery without loss of quality. Desirable: Relevant professional, internship, thesis or research experience in bird monitoring, ecological consultancy or offshore wind. Experience reviewing wildlife video or acoustic recordings, identifying birds, or working with behavioural annotations. Experience in R, Python or other tools used for data analysis. Knowledge of environmental impact assessment, collision-risk modelling or remote-sensing methods. Personal qualities: Curious, methodical and keen to learn. Self-motivated and comfortable asking for guidance when needed. Strong attention to detail and scientific integrity. Collaborative, service-minded and able to communicate with colleagues from different disciplines. We offer To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that addresses complex challenges in water and the environment. We will offer you: A role where ecological science is applied directly to offshore wind and environmental decision-making. Collaboration with biologists, data scientists, analysts, instrumentation specialists and project managers. Professional and personal development, with room to grow your scientific and client-facing responsibilities. Flexible working opportunities. A diverse, international network of highly skilled colleagues. The opportunity to contribute to the continued development of DHI MUSE and avian ecology services. About DHI and DHI MUSE DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge MIKE and MUSE technologies and products to the market. At DHI, we are constantly looking for passionate and talented people who are eager to join our team. DHI MUSE specifically is dedicated to managing the interplay between avian fauna and offshore wind energy. The product and associated work ultimately aim to automate bird monitoring, and as an add-on do curtailment of specific turbines when there is a risk of collision. By joining DHI, you will not only become part of a dynamic and collaborative global team of experts; you will be empowered to innovate, engage and grow in your area of expertise. DHI is committed to disseminate our knowledge effectively and across our worldwide network of offices. Office …

items.desc: Biomarker Scientist, Preclinical Fluid Biomarkers and Occupancy Can you turn advanced bioanalytical data into decisions that accelerate neuroscience drug discovery? Connect fluid biomarkers with in vivo pharmacology and clinical translation. Your new role You will develop and apply fluid biomarker strategies that inform critical decisions across Lundbeck's discovery and translational neuroscience programmes. Using LC-MS/MS, quantitative proteomics, peptidomics and other emerging methods, you will design, qualify and implement targeted and untargeted bioanalytical workflows for CSF, plasma, blood, brain and other relevant tissues. You will plan and lead in vivo pharmacology studies, linking drug exposure, target engagement and pharmacodynamic effects to biological readouts. You will critically interpret complex datasets and translate the findings into clear project recommendations. As scientific lead or Study Director, you will take ownership of internal and external studies, working with discovery, DMPK, translational medicine, clinical biomarkers, CROs and academic partners. Your future team You will join our 13-person Preclinical Fluid Biomarkers and Occupancy department at Lundbeck's R&D headquarters in Valby, Copenhagen. Our team brings together scientists, research assistants, laboratory technicians and students to investigate compound effects in mechanistic animal models and measure related fluid biomarker changes. We combine hands-on science and a translational mindset to generate data that support project decisions. The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. What you bring to the team You enjoy solving scientific problems, working across disciplines and turning complex findings into clear recommendations. We are looking for: A PhD in neuroscience, pharmacology, biochemistry, bioanalytical sciences, biomedical sciences or a related field. Strong hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS and mass spectrometry-based proteomics, including the development and qualification of bioanalytical assays in biological matrices. Experience designing, planning and executing in vivo pharmacology studies, together with FELASA B certification or equivalent. Understanding of translational biomarkers, PK/PD and target engagement, and the communication and collaboration skills to lead studies and work effectively with project teams and external partners. items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Vil du bruge data, modeller og teknologi til at forme fremtidens prissætning? Pricing Analyst / Data Scientist | Privat Danmark Vær med til at bygge næste generation af pricing i Danmark. Du kommer ind i et miljø, hvor tariffer, prismodeller, analyseplatform og arbejdsprocesser skal videreudvikles, og hvor dine analyser kan omsættes til konkrete forretningsmæssige resultater. Om rollen I Gjensidige bruger vi data og statistiske modeller til at træffe bedre beslutninger, udvikle konkurrencedygtige produkter og skabe lønsom vækst. Vi udvider nu vores team i Danmark og søger derfor en Pricing Analyst / Data Scientist, som vil være med til at videreudvikle vores prissætning på det danske privatmarked. Hos os kommer du til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem analyse, teknologi og forretning. Du vil arbejde med prismodeller og tariffer, analysere portefølje og lønsomhed, udforske nye metoder og bidrage til at udvikle den måde, vi arbejder med pricing på. Det betyder, at du ikke kun kommer til at analysere data. Du får mulighed for at følge arbejdet hele vejen fra data og modellering til implementering, opfølgning og målbare resultater for både kunder og forretning. Du bliver en del af Prisanalyse Privat Danmark og samtidig af et stærkt nordisk fagmiljø inden for pricing, analyse og forsikring. Vi deler viden, udfordrer hinanden fagligt og udvikler metoder og løsninger på tværs af lande og fagområder. Hvem er du? Du er analytisk og nysgerrig og motiveres af at forstå, hvorfor ting sker, og hvordan data kan omsættes til bedre beslutninger. Du trives i krydsfeltet mellem analyse, teknologi og forretning og motiveres af at se dine indsigter skabe konkrete resultater.
