items.desc: Ben jij onze nieuwe collega? Wil jij werken aan techniek die letterlijk de grenzen van de aarde overstijgt? Bij SRON werk je aan instrumentatie voor ruimteonderzoek: van testopstellingen en toepassingen voor grondtelescopen en stratosferische ballonnen tot instrumenten die uiteindelijk met een satelliet de ruimte in gaan. Ben jij een gedreven fijnmechanisch werktuigbouwer met een passie voor het ontwerpen en numeriek analyseren van complexe mechanieken? En krijg je energie van technische vraagstukken waarvoor niet meteen een standaardoplossing bestaat? Als constructeur bij SRON zet je jouw vakkennis, creativiteit en technische inzicht in om wetenschappers te ondersteunen bij baanbrekend onderzoek. Je werkt mee aan instrumenten die daadwerkelijk de ruimte in gaan en daarmee een bijdrage leveren aan onze kennis van het heelal. Klinkt dit als een uitdaging die bij jou past? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Jouw functie Als constructeur ontwerp en analyseer je complexe onderdelen en samenstellingen voor instrumenten voor ruimteonderzoek. Daarbij krijg je te maken met een unieke combinatie van technische eisen. Denk aan extreme temperaturen, cryogene omstandigheden, vacuüm, straling en zeer hoge betrouwbaarheid. Bovendien moeten de instrumenten bestand zijn tegen de enorme krachten die tijdens een lancering optreden. Je werk beperkt zich niet tot het instrument zelf. Je draagt ook bij aan de ontwikkeling van laboratorium- en testopstellingen waarmee we onze instrumenten onder deze omstandigheden kunnen testen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega-constructeurs en ontwerpers uit andere disciplines, fysici en instrumentmakers. Samen onderzoek je mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen en vertaal je complexe wetenschappelijke en technische vraagstukken naar betrouwbare technische oplossingen. Kwaliteit loopt als een rode draad door je werk. Je hebt oog voor zowel de kwaliteit van het ontwerp als voor de processen waarmee het product wordt ontwikkeld, geproduceerd, samengesteld en getest. Je wordt onderdeel van het team Mechanica en bent regelmatig betrokken bij het produceren, samenbouwen en testen van jouw ontwerpen. Een groot deel hiervan vindt in-house plaats. Hierdoor zie je jouw ontwerp niet alleen op papier of in een CAD-model, maar daadwerkelijk tot leven komen. Binnen deze functie ligt het zwaartepunt op het numeriek analyseren van ontwerpen. Je werkt onder andere met Finite Element Methods (FEM) voor structurele analyses, zoals vibratie- en shock-spectra. Daarnaast voer je thermische en magneto-dynamische analyses uit. Je vertaalt de resultaten van deze analyses naar concrete verbeteringen en onderbouwde ontwerpkeuzes. Tegelijkertijd blijf je constructeur in hart en nieren. Je ontwerpt en werkt oplossingen uit, legt deze technisch vast en maakt ze productierijp. Zo combineer je analytische diepgang met praktisch technisch inzicht. Jouw team Deze functie valt binnen de Sectie Mechanica van SRON’s Engineering Group (EG). Werken binnen een technische afdeling van een ruimtevaartinstituut is bijzonder. Hier draait het niet alleen om het realiseren van een goed ontwerp, maar vooral om zekerheid en betrouwbaarheid. Zodra een instrument de ruimte in gaat, is er immers geen mogelijkheid om het even open te maken, te repareren of een onderdeel te vervangen. Dat maakt het werk uitdagend én betekenisvol. Binnen ons engineeringteam werken we aan technische puzzels die soms bijna onmogelijk lijken. We ontwerpen, bouwen, testen, analyseren, leren en verbeteren. En als het nodig is, beginnen we opnieuw. Net zo lang totdat het werkt én we er volledig op kunnen vertrouwen. Juist die combinatie van uitdaging, vakmanschap en maatschappelijke en wetenschappelijke impact maakt het werk binnen onze Engineering Group zo interessant. Je werkt samen met gedreven specialisten die hun kennis willen inzetten voor iets dat groter is dan alleen het product: het vergroten van onze kennis over het heelal. Binnen de Engineering Group ontwikkelen, bouwen en testen we hightech mechanica en elektronica voor innovatieve wetenschappelijke instrumenten. We werken in kleine, dynamische teams waarin verschillende technische disciplines nauw samenwerken. Als constructeur word je onderdeel van het team binnen de Sectie Mechanica. Vanuit dit team werk je mee aan verschillende projecten die op dat moment binnen SRON worden uitgevoerd. Dat kunnen interne projecten zijn, maar ook projecten binnen internationale samenwerkingsverbanden met collega-instituten en hightech industriële partners. De projecten variëren sterk in omvang en looptijd: van enkele maanden tot projecten die zich over bijna twee decennia uitstrekken. Die variatie zorgt ervoor dat je steeds met nieuwe technische uitdagingen en samenwerkingspartners te maken krijgt. Bij het verdelen van projecten kijken we niet alleen naar wat er nodig is, maar ook naar jouw kennis, interesses en ambities. We vinden het belangrijk dat je werk aansluit bij jouw ontwikkeling en groeipad. Je krijgt veel ruimte om …

items.desc: Now As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. We are the people who give possibilities purpose BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. Job Description The Systems Verification and Validation (V&V) Engineer plays a pivotal role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of complex systems through structured testing and validation processes. This position focuses on translating identified risks into actionable test strategies, creating detailed test plans, and driving defect resolution in collaboration with cross-functional teams. By leveraging both manual and automated testing approaches, the engineer ensures that system functionality and performance meet stringent requirements throughout the development lifecycle. In addition to executing comprehensive test cases, the role emphasizes efficiency and scalability through the development and maintenance of automated test solutions using industry-standard tools. Responsibilities include conducting risk and impact assessments, organizing defect review meetings, and maintaining a robust test environment that mirrors real-world conditions. Through meticulous documentation and proactive communication, the Systems V&V Engineer provides clear visibility into test progress and outcomes, ultimately safeguarding system integrity and user confidence. Main responsibilities will include: Participate in risk and impact assessments to identify potential system vulnerabilities. Translate identified risks into a comprehensive and executable test strategy. Estimate and plan verification and validation activities across the development lifecycle. Specify detailed and traceable test cases based on system requirements and risk analysis. Implement manual and automated test cases to verify system functionality and performance. Document test results, findings, and defects in a clear and structured manner. Develop and maintain automated test scripts to improve test efficiency and coverage. Organize and lead defect review meetings with relevant team members. Provide timely updates on test progress, defect status, and overall V&V activities. Define and maintain the test environment, ensuring it reflects the intended use conditions. About you Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience, will also be accepted. Certified in ISTQB (preferably beyond Foundation level) or TMap Several years of experience working in SAFe, Scrum and/or Agile environments Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written) Shown experience in system-level testing, preferably in a regulated or high-tech environment. Experience with ISO 13485 or similar standards is a plus Familiarity with risk-based testing methodologies and test automation tools Experience with test management and defect tracking tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Detailed and focused approach. Proactive and structured approach to planning and execution. Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams. Strong documentation and reporting skills. Click on apply if this sounds like you! Why Join Us? To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face …

items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Role Requirements Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. You Should Apply If: You're excited about iterating on a strong program foundation and thinking creatively about enabling Support on highly technical topics. You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging. You want to stay close to the frontline work you're training people to do, not just design programs from a distance. You're data-driven and want to tie training effectiveness to real performance and customer outcomes. You love coaching …

From autonomous cars to to solutions against wildfires, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. Do you enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and solving complex engineering challenges? As a Connectivity Design Engineer through Capgemini Engineering at ASML, you will contribute to the development of next-generation lithography machines within the EUV and DUV programs. You will design and realize electrical connectivity solutions that enable reliable power and signal distribution across complex systems, including cabling, connection modules, racks, and related infrastructure. Design and document the qualification tools for integration purpose. Preferable experience with executing measurements on test set-up or prototype machine and document results to ensure that the electrical architecture of the infrastructure meet the requirements. Able to Interfacing and transfer knowledge with other electrical engineers Design overview of all electrical connectivity like detailed wiring diagrams and functional breakdown diagrams. Broad technical knowledge on electronics / cabling / mains / safety / diagnostics / electronics cooling. Experience with general electrical engineering principles and electrical development methods and processes. Knowledge of electrical connection methods, AC mains power and DC distribution and signal transmission. Basic knowledge on EMC and electrical safety standards (IEC) and US standards (NFPA, UL) Ability to set up wiring and cabling concepts. Your Profile Education & Experience Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in electrical or electronic system design. Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering teams. Strong knowledge of electronics, electrical connectivity, cabling, and power distribution. Familiarity with electrical safety and EMC standards is a plus. Knowledge of mechatronics, vacuum technology, or process control systems is an advantage. Personal Competencies Proactive, self-starting, and comfortable taking ownership. Strong communicator with excellent collaboration skills. Structured, organized, and detail-oriented. Analytical and solution-driven, with a systematic approach to problem-solving. Decisive, persuasive, and able to influence stakeholders. Flexible and pragmatic in a dynamic environment. Quality-focused with a continuous improvement mindset. What We Are Looking For A hands-on engineer who combines electrical and mechanical expertise. Someone who can translate requirements into practical, reliable, and manufacturable solutions. A collaborative professional who thrives in multidisciplinary teams and drives continuous improvement. items.desc: Job Description: Mars is delivering a global Product Lifecycle Management transformation program (cPLM) to replace our existing process and system used to capture and evolve knowledge about our products. This role serves as the critical functional bridge between global External Manufacturing team and the cPLM team, securing the foundational data integrity of external manufacturing recipes before and during all FN site deployments. By driving hands-on system validation, enforcing data compliance standards, and directly enabling EMs, this position ensures that our external manufacturing recipes are digitized accurately and compliantly. In this role, you will work closely with the Food Nutrition (FN) Scope Lead, the FN SMEs and FN cPLM leadership team. You will also occasionally need to collaborate with Enterprise POs, Corporate DT and other segment scope Leads. You will also need to engage with external partners including Co-Manufacturers, Co-Packers, and Supplier teams to ensure seamless deployment and capability building. This is a project-role for the Food cPLM program. The role is funded through June 2028. As we approach the funding end date, your manager will be in touch with additional information including funding for next phases, including pilot and deployment. Based country: UK or Netherlands External Manufacturing Discovery Support External Manufacturing Discovery Scoping: Participate in discovery workshops with External Manufacturing, Commercial, Product Development and other functions. Capture, consolidate and translate requirements from FN and share with the enterprise team. Provide Day-to-Day Functional Suppor: Act as the primary functional point of contact for External Manufacturing, Commercial leads, and external supplier technical contacts to troubleshoot process, system or data issues. Triage Issue Resolution: Rapidly diagnose and categorize user inquiries from external and internal co-manufacturing stakeholders, resolving functionalhow-to questions and partnering with technical teams for bug resolution. Coordinate External Deployment Readiness: Drive EM site specific deployment checklists, ensuring external partners and internal co-man data teams complete legacy data cleansing, access setup, and onboarding activities prior to go-live. .External Manufacturing Data Quality, Governance Compliance Audit External Manufacturing Legacy Data Readiness: Conduct rigorous audits on legacy external manufacturing specifications, recipe structures, and packaging records, identifying missing, obsolete, or non-compliant attributes prior to cPLM migration. Remediate Data Gaps Enrich External Specs: Directly assist internal external-manufacturing teams and external suppliers in gathering missing technical parameters, filling data gaps, and enriching specification records for seamless ingestion. Enforce Global Standardization Governance: Partner with global data stewards to enforce strict naming, classification, and taxonomy rules across all external supplier records, proactively identifying unauthorized workarounds or process deviations. Testing and Continuous Improvement Validate External Bill of Materials (BOM) Specifications: Build, configure, and validate raw material, recipe, packaging, and trade item specifications for external manufacturing streams in test environments to verify accurate data flows. Execute End-to-End Testing (UAT) for External Scenarios: Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by following test scripts, logging defects, and providing feedback on system KPIs. Support FN Pilot and Future Deployments: Support the initial pilot deployment and subsequent Food Nutrition site deployments by establishing reusable templates, checklists, and gathering learning for continuous improvement. Drive Process Interface Optimizations – long term: Analyze support ticket trends, supplier onboarding bottlenecks, and partner feedback to propose proactive improvements to external data exchange templates, workflows, and guidelines. External Partner Enablement, Support Community Engagement Design Deliver Targeted Partner Training: Partner with enterprise change and training leads to create and deliver role-based training, interactive demos, and step-by-step guides for external partners and internal co-man teams. Lead On-Site and/or Virtual Hypercare for External Go-Lives: Act as the dedicated hypercare lead during external manufacturing deployment waves, working shoulder-to-shoulder with our technical teams to resolve any issues. Prepare Stakeholder Communications: Translate deployment milestones, system release updates, and risk escalations into concise, impact-oriented summaries for External Manufacturing and RD leadership. . As the program evolves, your responsibilities may need to shift to support the team where needed most.

items.desc: 3-5 jaar, > 5 jaar 40 uur Data & AI, Enterprise IT Solutions, Tech €70.000 - €90.000 Deel op social media: Data Engineer (Agro Energy) Eneco - Rotterdam Data & AI, Enterprise IT Solutions, Tech 3-5 jaar, > 5 jaar €70.000 - €90.000 40 uur Apply Good to know: you can easily save this vacancy using the print button at the top of the page. After the closing date, this vacancy will be removed from our website. Data that drives real decisions - at pace. New energy products are being developed at high speed to respond to a fast-moving market. The pipelines you build and the models you feed directly power forecasting, optimization, and trading decisions for AgroEnergy and B2B Flex Services clients. When your pipeline runs, growers and traders make better decisions. That is the feedback loop. Hands-on and in charge of what comes next. You are not implementing someone else's architecture. In the coming year you will expand EPEX day-ahead forecasting from hours to quarters, introduce AI-assisted data transformations in C#, lead a migration toward Snowflake using OneLake with Iceberg tables, and modernize the Azure landscape to align with Eneco's new Azure Policy Framework - covering NIS2 (Network and Information Security Directive 2) and current security and compliance standards. Both the code and the direction are yours. In-house ownership, from day one. Eneco is actively bringing critical data and technology capability back in-house. You are joining at the point where ownership actually transfers - which means you shape what the platform becomes, not inherit what it was. Why choose Eneco? Eneco is one of Europe's leading sustainable energy companies, working toward climate neutrality by 2035. Our One Planet strategy - committed to electrification and the elimination of fossil fuels - is one of the most ambitious sustainability commitments in the sector. AgroEnergy sits at an unusually direct intersection of data and real-world impact. Dutch greenhouse horticulture is one of the most energy-intensive sectors in the Netherlands, operating in an increasingly complex and volatile energy market. AgroEnergy's ambition is clear: to be the best electricity supplier and a complete, strategic energy partner for its clients - delivering smart, innovative solutions to complex energy challenges. The data platform you build is what makes that ambition operational. This is not data as a support function - it is data as the product. What you’ll do As an Experienced Data Engineer in the AgroEnergy team, you combine deep hands-on data engineering with technical leadership. You design, build, and improve cloud-native data solutions in Azure - powering predictive models and a self-built dimensional data warehouse that supports energy optimization and trading decisions for agricultural clients and B2B Flex Services. You take a leading role in defining the technical direction of the data platform: identifying debt, shaping improvement initiatives, setting architecture and engineering standards, and mentoring the engineers around you. The coming period brings a concrete set of technical challenges - expanding forecasting models, introducing AI tooling, migrating toward Snowflake, and aligning the Azure landscape with Eneco's new security and compliance framework. This is a role for someone who wants to be deeply involved in the technology and trusted to raise the bar for the whole team. Is this about you? You are equally comfortable working alone in the code as you are in the daily rhythm of a scrum team — pair reviewing, joining refinement, keeping the team moving. The best solutions here come from the group, and you know that.You are a data engineer with enough depth to own the architecture and enough pragmatism to get your hands dirty. You like working close to the business - understanding what a forecasting model actually needs, or why a particular data flow matters to an energy trader - and you translate that understanding into technical solutions that hold up in production. You are comfortable setting direction and comfortable writing the code that proves it. You stay current: AI-assisted development, modern lakehouse patterns, and evolving cloud compliance standards are not abstract concepts to you - they are part of how you work. items.desc: Ready to scale your career in a high-growth scale up where your results drive real world change? We’re Sensorfact , Europe’s #1 smart monitoring platform for the industry , on a mission to make industry smarter, cleaner, and more efficient. Every day, our technology helps thousands of manufacturers cut energy waste, reduce costs, and lower carbon emissions through intelligent data insights and automation. Today, we’ve joined forces with ABB, a global leader in electrification and automation. This partnership has propelled us onto the world stage, enabling us to expand rapidly and help more businesses optimize their energy efficiency, cut costs, and make a positive impact on the planet. Apply today and help shape a smarter and more sustainable industry. As an analytics engineer you build, scale and optimize data pipelines your colleagues use every day to make data-driven decisions. You design pipelines that extract, load, transform and monitor data from both internal and external sources in a way that’s easy to draw conclusions from. In this role you will build a deep understanding of the drivers of Sensorfact and how we work, because you can’t model a business you don’t understand! To make that more concrete: You’ll build scalable pipelines with Prefect that extract data from external sources, model it with dbt on Clickhouse in order to empower people to create meaningful visualisations in Metabase You’ll standardise how data gets ingested into our data warehouse, so that adding a new source is a known path rather than a fresh implementation You’ll raise the bar on our testing practices across all data pipelines, so stakeholders get high-quality datasets and we spot changes in data ourselves instead of hearing about them from colleagues You’ll drive AI adoption through improving documentation, clearer semantics and richer context so that both humans and models can answer questions accurately. You’ll work closely together with stakeholders to understand the questions being asked, spotting the gaps in our data and figure out together what would genuinely help About the team You join a small analytics team, working closely with stakeholders, data engineers and data analysts and data scientists, picking up projects independently. We share knowledge, discuss tech solutions and review each other's code. Being part of a scale-up, you are proactive and pragmatic in prioritising the needs of the business. That means you are able to make judgement calls about what to build properly and what to build quickly, and being comfortable making these decisions. We work in 2 week sprints with planning, retrospectives and daily standups. We keep track of things in Linear, Miro, Google Drive and Outline and stay in touch with each other over Slack. We work from home about 60% of the time and enjoy meeting each other in the office in Utrecht or Amsterdam on a regular basis. What you bring 3+ years of experience building and maintaining production data pipelines Strong SQL skills that allow you to write readable and maintainable queries that leverage the underlying data architecture Proactive and pragmatic approach to problem solving Familiarity with cloud data warehouses like Clickhouse, Snowflake or BigQuery Experience with data orchestration tools like Prefect, Airflow or Dagster Familiar with professional software engineering practices (version control, merge requests, testing, code standards, CI/CD) Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and Glassdoor to stay updated on our journey.

items.desc: Netherlands Infrastructure & Energy 2 - 5 years Nijmegen On-site A good project starts long before execution. Are you the one who transforms a question into an accurate price and a plan that works? With our client, you do this for technical projects in port areas and the energy sector. About The Member Company We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as: Technology & Engineering Energy & Renewables Life sciences & Pharma Digital & IT About this vacancy The emphasis of your role lies in work preparation, but you are involved right from the very start. You ensure that a project is technically, organizationally, and financially solid. Specific tasks: you prepare calculations, budgets, and quotations based on drawings, specifications, and client requirements; you determine the necessary materials, resources, and subcontractors; you create work plans and schedules, and gather all required drawings, calculations, and documents; you handle price inquiries, orders, and deliveries, and make arrangements with suppliers and subcontractors; you also ensure permits and other prerequisites are in place to start; you hand over the well-prepared project to the supervisor; you process changes during execution and regularly visit the site yourself. You work on a diverse mix of projects: think of heavily loaded terrains, foundations and concrete structures, and tasks related to energy infrastructure. In these environments, safety and thorough preparation are crucial. You don’t just work behind your desk. By regularly visiting project sites and staying in touch with the execution team, you gain practical insights and incorporate them into your next preparations. You collaborate closely with project managers, supervisors, clients, and suppliers. What we expect from you You derive satisfaction from thorough preparation. You enjoy puzzling with numbers just as much as figuring out how to best approach the work in practice. Furthermore: you have a technical education at mbo 4 or hbo level, preferably in civil engineering, architecture, or a similar field; you have at least two years of experience as a project preparer, estimator, or in a similar technical role; you have an affinity with infrastructure, ports, industry, or energy; you work independently and take responsibility for your own tasks; you communicate easily with colleagues, suppliers, and other parties; you have excellent proficiency in the Dutch language, both spoken and written; you don't mind traveling frequently to project locations. What you can expect from us What you can expect from us At TMC, you won’t work in a single fixed environment, but you’ll have the opportunity to gain experience across various innovative energy projects. Through our Employeneurship model, you combine the certainty of a permanent contract with the freedom to shape your technical career in a targeted way. You’ll become part of a strong network of technical professionals, share knowledge with colleagues, and have ample opportunities to further develop yourself within the energy transition. Excellent conditions: A permanent contract, with a gross monthly salary between €4300 - €6000, depending on experience. An individual profit-sharing scheme A training budget of €2,200 per year, allowing you to continuously develop yourself. The chance to collaborate with experienced professionals within our Business Cell. Access to our TMC Entrepreneurial Lab, where you can bring your own ideas and projects to life. #LI-SN1 The 5 basic principles of employeneurship As pioneers in employeneurship, we have redefined the traditional work model. We offer our employeneurs the opportunity to combine the security of a permanent contract with their passion for entrepreneurship. items.desc: We’re building the next generation of Schibsted’s media products Schibsted’s product ambition is to reinvent our media destinations for the AI era to make our journalism a relevant daily habit for more people. Most of that work happens in our existing product organisation, where we continuously improve and reinvent products used by millions of people every day. But some opportunities require something different: more freedom from today’s products and business models, longer horizons, greater uncertainty and permission to challenge the core. That's why we're setting up Schibsted Product Lab . Product Lab is a small, autonomous product environment that builds, launches and tests the next generation of Schibsted’s media products with real users. We start small, increase investment as evidence grows, stop ideas that do not prove themselves, and help successful products become part of, or reshape, Schibsted’s core. We are now looking for an Editorial Developer to join the Product Lab core team! How we want to work Our ambition is to make Product Lab an AI-enabled, high-velocity product environment where we can move from idea to execution at high speed. We want to push the boundaries of how emerging technologies can transform the way we discover, design and build products, equipping small teams with the tools and capabilities to turn ambitious ideas into real user experiences in days rather than months. We embrace experimentation, challenge established ways of working and prioritise learning over perfection. And we see the ability to confidently stop an idea that doesn't work as just as important as knowing when to invest further. The role and mission As Editorial Developer in Product Lab, you will work at the intersection of journalism, technology, product and design to explore what the next generation of media destinations could look like. You will combine deep editorial understanding with technical curiosity and hands-on experimentation, turning emerging technologies, changing user behaviours and new ideas into concrete editorial experiences. This is a role tasked with challenging assumptions about how journalism works, exploring entirely new ways of bringing journalistic value to people, and making those possibilities real enough to test. You will be part of Product Lab's small permanent core team, working across early-stage initiatives alongside product managers, designers, engineers and colleagues from Schibsted's editorial organisations. What you will do Identify new editorial opportunities, exploring how emerging technologies and changing user behaviours could transform how journalism is created, distributed and experienced. Develop, prototype and test new editorial concepts, working hands-on with Product, UX and Tech to turn ideas into tangible experiments with real users. Define the editorial logic of new products, including what information they provide, how it is selected, produced or transformed, and how humans and AI systems collaborate. Shape editorial quality and principles, navigating questions of accuracy, trust, transparency, accountability and editorial independence in new product concepts. Assess editorial and operational feasibility, identifying the capabilities, workflows, resources and organisational changes needed to bring promising concepts to life. Connect Product Lab with Schibsted's editorial environments, bringing relevant newsroom expertise into initiatives and helping promising concepts find pathways into existing brands and organisations. Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who combines strong journalistic understanding, technical fluency and a genuine drive to build what comes next. You might come from editorial development, digital journalism, newsroom innovation, interactive storytelling, editorial product development or a related field. Your exact background matters less than your ability to move between journalistic ideas, technological possibilities and practical experimentation. You are equally comfortable discussing editorial principles with an editor, exploring technical possibilities with a developer and making something tangible enough to test with users. We believe you need to bring: Deep understanding of journalism and editorial environments, including hands-on experience with editorial decision-making, journalistic methods and newsroom workflows. Experience developing and testing digital editorial products, formats or experiences, with a user-oriented approach to turning ideas into tangible solutions and learning from feedback. Technical fluency and hands-on prototyping skills, with the ability to independently build, configure or experiment with digital solutions using code, AI tools, low-code platforms or other relevant technologies. Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies, combined with curiosity about how they could reshape journalism, editorial workflows and audience experiences. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 13.11.2026 Sektor Privat Antall stillinger 2 stillinger WK Entreprenør vokser og har god tilgang på spennende prosjekter – vil du bli med som formann? WK Entreprenør har høy aktivitet og god tilgang på prosjekter i Oslo-området. Nå styrker vi laget med flere formenn som vil være med på den videre veksten og ta ansvar for den daglige produksjonen ute på byggeplassen. Som formann er du tett på mennesker, fag og produksjon. Du sørger for at arbeidet flyter, at folk vet hva de skal gjøre og at nødvendige materialer, tegninger og avklaringer er på plass. Du samarbeider tett med anleggsleder og får et tydelig ansvar for gjennomføringen innenfor ditt område. Dine viktigste oppgaver blir å: Lede og følge opp den daglige produksjonen på byggeplassen. Fordele oppgaver og koordinere egne medarbeidere og underentreprenører. Planlegge kommende aktiviteter og følge opp fremdrift og ressursbehov. Sørge for at tegninger, materialer og nødvendige avklaringer er på plass. Følge opp HMS, kvalitet, orden og avvik. Fange opp utfordringer tidlig og bidra med praktiske løsninger sammen med anleggsleder. Arbeidsstedet er ute i prosjektene, hovedsakelig i området fra Jessheim til Drammen. Er du klar for mer ansvar på byggeplassen? Vi ser etter deg som har god praktisk erfaring fra byggeplass og som trives med å få mennesker og produksjon til å fungere godt sammen. Du kan allerede jobbe som formann, bas eller arbeidsleder, eller være en erfaren fagarbeider som er klar for neste steg. Vi ser gjerne at du har: Relevant byggfaglig bakgrunn, gjerne Teknisk fagskole eller fagbrev som tømrer eller forskalingssnekker. God praktisk forståelse for bygg, konstruksjoner og arbeidsrekkefølge. Evne til å lese tegninger og planlegge arbeid og materialbehov. Erfaring med å lede eller følge opp andre på byggeplass. Du er tydelig, løsningsorientert og trygg på å stille krav når det er nødvendig. Samtidig samarbeider du godt med andre, tar ansvar og er opptatt av at jobben blir gjort skikkelig. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 13.11.2026 Sektor Privat Antall stillinger 2 stillinger Vil du være med på veksten? WK Entreprenør søker 2 anleggsledere i Oslo WK Entreprenør er i sterk vekst i Oslo og søker nå to anleggsledere som vil være med på den videre utviklingen av avdelingen. Med økende aktivitet og nye prosjekter styrker vi laget med flere som kan ta ansvar for den daglige driften og bidra til gode prosjektgjennomføringer. Som anleggsleder får du en sentral rolle ute i prosjektene og samarbeider tett med prosjektleder, prosjektingeniører og formenn. Du sørger for at mennesker, materialer og arbeidsunderlag er på plass når de trengs, ligger i forkant av produksjonen og fanger opp utfordringer før de påvirker fremdriften. Dine viktigste oppgaver blir å: Lede og koordinere egne medarbeidere og underentreprenører. Utarbeide og følge opp fremdriftsplaner, bemanning og ressursbehov. Følge opp HMS, kvalitet og avvik i prosjektet. Sikre nødvendige tegninger, arbeidsunderlag og avklaringer før arbeidene starter. Følge opp innkjøp og bidra til økonomistyring og kostnadskontroll sammen med prosjektleder. Identifisere og følge opp endringer og behov for varsling. Delta i og lede relevante drifts- og byggemøter. Bidra med praktisk gjennomføringskompetanse i kalkulasjon og tidligfasearbeid. Erfaren anleggsleder eller klar for neste steg? Vi er åpne både for deg som allerede har erfaring som anleggsleder, og for deg som er klar for å ta steget inn i rollen. Du kan eksempelvis komme fra en rolle som prosjektingeniør, produksjonsleder eller tilsvarende. Det viktigste er at du kjenner entreprenørvirksomhet, forstår produksjonen på byggeplassen og har vist at du tar ansvar og driver oppgaver fremover. Rollen gir deg mulighet til å ta et tydelig ansvar i prosjektgjennomføringen, samtidig som du har erfarne kolleger og et bredt fagmiljø rundt deg. Vi ser gjerne at du har: Relevant utdanning innen bygg. Bachelor- eller mastergrad er ønskelig, men teknisk fagskole eller annen relevant bakgrunn kombinert med solid erfaring kan også være aktuelt. Flere års relevant erfaring fra entreprenørvirksomhet og byggeprosjekter. Erfaring fra boligprosjekter, næringsbygg, offentlige bygg eller rehabilitering. God forståelse for byggeprosesser, fremdrift, kontrakter, kvalitet og HMS. Gjerne erfaring med betong- og trekonstruksjoner. Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig. Som person er du tydelig, selvstendig og trygg på å stille krav. Du kommuniserer presist, tar tak i utfordringer og følger dem opp. Samtidig er du åpen for innspill og opptatt av å legge til rette for at andre lykkes. Bli med på den videre veksten i WK I Oslo blir du en del av et etablert fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og korte beslutningsveier. Avdelingen er i vekst, og som ny anleggsleder kommer du inn i en organisasjon med økende aktivitet og behov for flere dyktige folk som kan ta ansvar i prosjektene. Hos WK får du handlingsrom til å påvirke gjennomføringen av egne prosjekter. Kulturen bygger på frihet under ansvar, tett samarbeid og tillit til at medarbeiderne tar eierskap til egne oppgaver. items.desc: Responsibilities Societe Generale Global Solution Center Poland is a new and growing area of the SG Warsaw Branch. Within the Global Banking and Advisory business unit (GLBA), the Business Transformation Office (BTO) supports the strategy, development and transformation of the business while maintaining a solid and secure operating framework. As part of the business rather than the IT department, the team combines strong IT expertise with a strong interest in functional topics. The successful candidate will manage the full development lifecycle of applications dedicated to business users, including needs analysis, development, user support, training and technical advisory. The initial mission will focus on taking over existing applications, understanding their functional and technical scope, identifying improvement opportunities, organizing support, reviewing backlogs with product owners and delivering enhancements. During your VIE, your main mission will be: Collaborate with business users and stakeholders to understand and analyze their needs and translate them into functional applications that improve operational efficiency and user experience. Design, develop, test, debug and maintain high-quality software applications, APIs and tools throughout the software development lifecycle. Take over existing applications by learning their functional and technical scope, identifying improvement areas, performing root-cause analysis, organizing support and delivering backlog enhancements with product owners. Produce clear technical documentation and reporting, and provide technical advice, user support and training. Apply sound database design, risk awareness and attention to detail to deliver robust, secure and reliable solutions. Stay current with industry trends and advances in data engineering and rapid prototyping, including BI, low-code and no-code solutions. Promote data-driven approaches and innovation among business users while collaborating effectively across teams. A questionnaire will be provided to you in order to check your VIE (Société Générale and Business France) eligibility. For an efficient analysis of your application, please make sure to truthfully answer all the questions. Please note that it is mandatory to provide us a formal proof of your M2 diploma validation before the assignment start date. No VIE mission will start without this document. *Grade sheets are not accepted as justification of diploma. Profile required PLEASE NOTE that since this program is primarily an international development program, candidates cannot apply to a VIE assignment in their own country of citizenship. To facilitate the examination of your application by our English-speaking managers, we thank you for applying in English. Studies & experience: Graduate with a Master's degree from an engineering school, business school or university, preferably with a specialization in software development, computer science, data engineering or a related field At least five years of software development experience, including practical experience as a Python developer Language skills: Fluent in English Technical, operational & Soft skills: Proficiency in Python and experience with web frameworks such as Django or Flask. Experience designing REST APIs and working with OAuth 2.0 authentication. Knowledge of PostgreSQL, object-relational mapping (ORM), and database design and management. Knowledge of Java, Spring Boot and Tomcat is appreciated. Familiarity with front-end technologies such as Angular or React. Proficiency in Excel and Power BI; experience with low-code or no-code solutions is appreciated. Knowledge of data engineering is essential; knowledge of data science is a plus. Autonomous, curious, rigorous and organized, with very strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving, testing and debugging, and time-management skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder-management and team-collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Strong interest in functional business topics, business analytics and user-interface design, with an understanding of Rapid Application Development, the software development lifecycle, project management, reporting and documentation, risk management and root-cause analysis. The VIE assignment in a nutshell This VIE in Warsaw is to begin as soon as possible, but you need to plan 3 months between your application date and the beginning of your VIE assignment. It will last 12 months . The VIE is a specific contract, under Business France’s eligibility criteria, opened to candidates under 28 and from the member states of the European Economic Space. For further information (including your financial indemnities), please see Mon VIE-VIA Business France. Szukamy kogoś, kto dobrze rozumie fundamenty pracy w chmurze, potrafi pracować z IaC oraz chce rozwijać się w kierunku Cloud & Platform Engineering. Istotnym elementem roli będzie również analiza i obsługa zgłoszeń związanych z bezpieczeństwem środowisk chmurowych, w tym vulnerability management na poziomie L3. Kogo szukamy? Osób, które jest już kimś więcej niż juniorem, potrafią samodzielnie rozwiązywać problemy techniczne, nie boją się zagadnień bezpieczeństwa i chcą rozwijać się na styku Cloud, DevOps oraz Security. Szukamy kogoś, kto nie tylko potrafi wykonać zadanie według instrukcji, ale również samodzielnie przeanalizuje problem, zaproponuje rozwiązanie i doprowadzi temat do końca. Twoja rola w Zespole: Będziesz : rozwijać i utrzymywać infrastrukturę opartą głównie o AWS , tworzyć i rozwijać rozwiązania Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), wspierać rozwój oraz utrzymanie procesów CI/CD w oparciu o GitHub i GitHub Actions, analizować oraz adresować podatności i rekomendacje bezpieczeństwa dotyczące środowisk chmurowych, współpracować z zespołami developerskimi przy wdrażaniu najlepszych praktyk w zakresie bezpieczeństwa i automatyzacji, diagnozować problemy infrastrukturalne i wspierać działania operacyjne, uczestniczyć w analizie oraz remediacji incydentów i zgłoszeń związanych z bezpieczeństwem chmury, dbać o standardy techniczne, dokumentację oraz jakość wdrażanych rozwiązań. Poziom wiedzy i wymagań: Około 2-4 lata doświadczenia w obszarze Cloud / DevOps / Platform Engineering. Dobra znajomość jednej z chmur publicznych, preferencyjnie AWS . Praktyczne doświadczenie z Terraformem i Python lub innym rozwiązaniem IaC. Znajomość GitHub , pracy z repozytoriami, pull requestami oraz podstaw CI/CD. Doświadczenie w analizie i obsłudze podatności bezpieczeństwa w środowiskach chmurowych. Dobra znajomość zagadnień takich jak: IAM, network security, secrets management, vulnerability management, security posture management, hardening środowisk chmurowych. Umiejętność samodzielnej analizy i prowadzenia remediacji zgłoszeń bezpieczeństwa na poziomie L3 . J. angielski min.B2 Mile widziane: Doświadczenie z narzędziami bezpieczeństwa chmurowego (np. Security Hub, Inspector, GuardDuty, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Defender for Cloud). Znajomość GitHub Actions. Doświadczenie z Dockerem oraz podstawowa znajomość Kubernetes. Skrypty automatyzacyjne w Pythonie lub Bashu. Founded in 1999 by Rafał Brzoska, InPost provides delivery services through a network of over 64,000 Automated Parcel Machines (APMs) and more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO) points across nine European countries: Poland, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg, alongside to-door courier and fulfilment services for ecommerce merchants. InPost’s extensive OOH network supports rapidly growing parcel volumes across its markets, with 1.4 billion parcels delivered in 2025. Its locker solutions offer consumers a delivery option that is cheaper, more flexible and convenient, environmentally friendly and contactless. As a leading OOH logistics provider, InPost is recognised for transforming parcel delivery economics in Europe, appealing to both consumers and merchants through its flexible, technology-driven solutions. Job Description We’re looking for a Billing System Engineer who will help us develop and ensure the stability of our billing systems. In this role, you’ll work closely with the Comarch BSS platform, combining technical expertise with a good understanding of business processes. This is a role for someone who enjoys working in a complex system environment, likes getting to the root cause of issues, and wants to have a real impact on the reliability and further development of billing solutions. What will you work on? maintaining and configuring the Comarch BSS platform, particularly Product Catalog, Billing and Billing Mediation, monitoring platform performance, system jobs, error logs and runtime incidents, investigating data issues and identifying their root causes, monitoring system interfaces and integrations to ensure uninterrupted end-to-end data flows, supporting backup and recovery processes and solutions that strengthen system availability, configuring data connections and integrations and taking technical ownership after implementation, supporting audit controls, security requirements and compliance-related activities, following the BSS roadmap, running Proofs of Concept and maintaining technical documentation, contributing to platform upgrades, patches, new functionalities and technical issue resolution. Collaboration with experts across technology and business areas in an international environment. items.desc: About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance. We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution. About the Role We are looking for a technical specialist who owns the performance of the Improvado website end to end: how it is found (SEO and GEO), how fast and healthy it is, and how well it converts visitors into pipeline. This is an analytics-driven, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in Google Search Console, GA4, and the browser dev tools as in a keyword report. Because the website is our main product-facing marketing surface, you will also shape how the product is presented on it. In practice, the role covers part of what product marketing would otherwise do. What You Will Do Technical SEO and GEO Own the technical health of the site: crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, page speed, structured data and schema, rendering, redirects, internal linking, and site architecture. Optimize the site for AI search (generative engine optimization): make Improvado understandable, citable, and recommended in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar engines. Monitor visibility in both classic and AI search, and turn the findings into prioritized fixes. Website optimization and conversion Continuously improve page performance, UX, templates, and key conversion paths (demo requests, sign-ups, high-intent pages). Plan and run experiments (A/B tests, template and layout changes, messaging tests) and measure their impact on conversions and pipeline. Work with engineering, design, and external contractors to ship improvements to the website stack (CMS, CDN, caching, tracking). Analytics and measurement Build and maintain dashboards that connect organic and on-site behavior to leads, pipeline, and revenue. Own tracking quality: events, attribution, and data accuracy across GA4, Search Console, and related tools. Analyze data to find growth opportunities, and report findings in clear, decision-ready form. Product and messaging input Use search demand, AI-visibility, and on-site behavior data to guide positioning, messaging, and landing page strategy. Work with stakeholders so website content reflects ICP needs and the product’s value propositions. What We Are Looking For Must have 3+ years in SEO and/or website optimization, with measurable results in organic growth or conversion. Strong technical SEO skills and a good understanding of how websites are built, served, and rendered. Ability and willingness to work in the Eastern Time (EST) time zone, with working hours aligned to the US East Coast. Hands-on experience with GEO or AI search optimization, or a clear, demonstrable track record of working on it. Strong analytics experience: GA4, Google Search Console, and BI or dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Superset, or similar). You build your own reports and draw conclusions from the data. Proficiency with SEO tooling (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalents). Ability to work effectively with developers, designers, and marketers in a distributed team. Nice to have B2B SaaS or marketing technology background. Experience with Webflow or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS and JavaScript. SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills; experience with AI-assisted or automated workflows. Experience with CRO and experimentation platforms. Exposure to product marketing, positioning, or messaging. You are Analytical, curious, and driven by measurable outcomes. Self-directed and comfortable owning a channel without heavy supervision. A clear communicator across time zones. What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement HAVkWB50SQ

items.desc: TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions. As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US. Requirements: Must have End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions. Nice to have Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation. EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness. Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards. Brand: TripleTen What you will do: Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on. Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off. Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive. Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers. Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed. Be our customer to engineering. items.desc: You will join our Post-Trade Program and work with the newly established Post-Trade Harmonization Initiative. The program addresses post-trade harmonization requirements and develops future-ready solutions that support our member banks in making informed decisions and remaining compliant. The QA engineer role offers the opportunity to help secure post-trade harmonization for our member banks. You will join a dedicated team with colleagues in Denmark and Poland. Primary tasks and responsibilities include: Drive testing and quality within the team by establishing a clear testing vision and strategy and supporting its implementation. Begin with a strong focus on manual testing and gradually contribute to test automation, moving towards a balanced mix of manual and automated testing, with approximately 30-50% automation over time. Collaborate closely with team members and BEC's QA service team to adopt best practices, streamline testing processes and initiate automation activities. To succeed you will have: Ability to analyse complex end-to-end flows across integrated systems, select an appropriate testing approach, manage defects end to end, advocate for quality across the software development life cycle and communicate quality risks and results to technical and business stakeholders. Solid understanding of key non-functional testing types, including performance, reliability and security testing, and the ability to identify when they should be applied based on system context and risk. Hands-on experience with test management tools such as Xray or similar, as well as practical experience with API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI or Bruno, including validation of request and response structures and error handling. Ability to work with message queues, including IBM MQ, understand message flows, validate XML and JSON payloads, interpret XSD and JSON Schema, and test data structures and variations in message-based integrations. Experience with Playwright is preferred; experience with Cypress or a similar automation tool is also relevant. Familiarity with TypeScript and Java is desirable, although experience with other programming languages is acceptable. Ability to analyse application and system logs to support defect investigation, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, together with a willingness to learn and apply AI-based tools to improve testing effectiveness and support test automation. A self-motivated and structured approach, strong communication skills, the ability to organise and drive the testing agenda, and experience helping teams clarify requirements towards an acceptance test-driven development (ATDD) setup. ISTQB Foundation certification is required. It's nice-to-have: Familiarity with investment products, the trade life cycle and settlement processes. Working knowledge of CI/CD tools and processes, including basic integration of testing into CI/CD pipelines. Be your best self with BEC's benefits! items.desc: This role sits within the Directs & Sites Risk, Compliance and Data team and will lead and contribute to a range of initiatives across these three domains. Working with procurement teams, subject matter experts, data owners and technology partners, the role will help strengthen risk management, maintain effective compliance practices and advance trusted, accessible data capabilities. Its contribution across each domain is outlined below. Across risk, the role will strengthen risk identification, assessment and mitigation across Directs & Sites Procurement. It will use risk-based analysis to identify actionable opportunities, support current risk programmes, develop key risk indicators and monitoring capabilities, and prepare clear insights and reports for stakeholders and Governance Boards. Across compliance, the role will partner with relevant Risk Subject Matter Experts, Global Ethics & Compliance, Audit & Assurance and Quality to ensure policies, procedures and practices remain aligned with legislative, regulatory and GSK requirements. It will challenge unnecessary customization, promote effective process design, and create or maintain the policies, processes, controls, written standards, monitoring, learning and communications required to embed sustainable compliance. It will enable data-driven materials risk assessments by bringing relevant data into the Nina data model for AI-supported access, automating the pre-population of inputs, creating a self-service experience for team members, and connecting internal parameters with external Altana data to strengthen risk insights. Delivery will require close partnership with data owners, technology teams and business stakeholders. Work arrangement This role is hybrid. You will be expected to work from the GSK office at least two days per week. Your responsibilities: Drive effective risk identification and de-risking programs Support the execution of the policy, risk, quality and compliance agenda Effectively collaborate with stakeholders in policy, risk & compliance groups such as Global Ethics & Compliance, Audit & Assurance and Quality Coach and support Global Procurement employees on expectations for effective control of policy, risk and compliance, including writing and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures, risk guidelines and keeping our My Learning trainings curriculum up to date Own the integration and preparation of relevant procurement and risk data within directs data model , enabling appropriate access for AI-supported use cases. Automate the pre-population of materials risk assessment inputs using trusted existing data, improving efficiency, consistency and data quality. Design and maintain a self-service experience that enables team members to complete materials risk assessments using clear workflows, guidance and governed data. Connect internal risk parameters with external supply chain risk intelligence platform to strengthen materials risk assessments and generate more comprehensive insights. Partner with data owners, technology teams and risk subject matter experts to define data requirements, controls, quality standards and sustainable operating processes. Qualifications & Skills: 3+ years working in complex global corporate environment 2+ years working in procurement, risk management or project management Experience in regulated environments or a good working knowledge of manufacturing quality Demonstrate excellent English written and verbal communication skills Demonstrate excellent MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills Strong influencing skills Motivate colleagues and work in partnership with others to drive, implement and support change Managing project execution Working in a matrix environment Procurement or related certifications (e.g. CPSM, CPIM, PMP, CIPS) useful but not essential Experience working with data models, data quality, workflow automation, analytics or digital self-service solutions. Ability to translate risk and business requirements into clear data, process and technology requirements in partnership with technical teams. items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Role Requirements Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. Excellent communication skills with proven ability to act as a facilitator. Conflict resolution skills. Strong organizational skills with the ability to effectively manage priorities in dynamic conditions. Ability to adapt to changes and act accordingly, flexible approach. Practical ability to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, including use of basic risk management tools and practices. Responsibility for ensuring successful delivery outcomes, including alignment with SAFe practices, meeting stakeholder expectations, proactive risk management, and driving continuous improvement. items.desc: Location Calle Bergara 13 8002 Barcelona Employment Area IT - Development Level Experienced professionals Working Model Full-time Reference ID 48363 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Your Tasks You design and operate the one or the other sovereign cloud services with focus on pure excellence. You ensure the reliability, performance, and fault tolerance of the messaging infrastructure by implementing robust disaster recovery and failover strategies and tune operating system configurations for low-latency delivery. You are on the forefront of setting standards which allow our Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to be continuously met, ensuring system stability. You define best practices for application developers and build a self-service platform that makes it easy for internal teams to independently configure their integrations. You conduct regular Chaos Engineering tests and incident response simulations to detect vulnerabilities early and guarantee resilient production services. You lead structured post-mortems and root cause analyses for production incidents and implement sustainable corrective measures. Your Profile You have a strong passion for Site Reliability Engineering, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and full automation. You bring solid experience with Go, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, and automating production environments. You are familiar with SRE concepts such as Error Budgets, SLAs/SLOs/SLIs, and Chaos Engineering methods. You understand the operational requirements of complex platform services (i.e. PubSub, KMS, Secrets Manager, DNS, MailOut) and know how to make them highly available and reliable. You enjoy exploring new technologies (e.g., OpenTelemetry) and enthusiastically share your knowledge with the community and team. You look beyond dashboards to understand the underlying data structures and how to optimize them for high-cardinality environments.

items.desc: Join our Team About the Opportunity Help build and run the network infrastructure that enables Ericsson’s R&D teams to develop and test what’s next. As part of the Network Evolution Unit, you’ll work across network and lab environments to deploy and operate reliable infrastructure. This is an infrastructure-led DevOps role: you’ll use software, automation and secure ways of working to improve services throughout their lifecycle. This is an opportunity for a curious, hands-on problem solver. Recent graduates and candidates with up to around five years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. DevOps candidates are welcome: you don’t need to be a security specialist, but you should care about building and operating services securely. What you’ll do Investigate issues in dedicated lab and network environments, find root causes and help resolve service requests and reported problems. Install, configure, upgrade and deploy network systems and services, supporting a reliable, business-like lab environment. Develop and improve automation to reduce manual tasks and make operations more consistent. Support both new and existing services, including maintaining and adapting configurations created by others. Help monitor service health, communicate performance, changes and risks, and contribute to timely incident resolution and escalation. Work with stakeholders and third-party vendors to support deployments and improve the services delivered to users. Apply security and compliance practices throughout development and operations, and contribute to reliable, well-documented ways of working. What you’ll bring A degree or relevant coursework in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical knowledge. A foundation or strong interest in IP networking, network topologies, data-centre infrastructure and network services. Relevant coursework, projects or hands-on experience are valuable. Some experience through work, studies, projects or internships in network or systems infrastructure, operations, or DevOps and software development. Early-career applicants are very welcome. A willingness to code and automate. Python is used frequently; experience with Bash, Java, scripting or other programming languages is useful. Familiarity with Linux or Unix, troubleshooting, and APIs such as REST. A security-aware mindset, collaborative approach, and clear communication skills. Experience with cloud technologies, containers, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, microservices, Spring Boot, SQL or agile methods is beneficial. You don’t need to know every technology listed; curiosity and the ability to learn matter. Network infrastructure is at the heart of this role. You’ll combine infrastructure knowledge with development and operations, using automation to improve delivery while helping maintain service availability and resolve issues. Security is built into the work, not a separate specialty. Security clearance, references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates. What happens once you apply?
