items.desc: Join Telavox as a Network Engineer - Platform & Technical Enablement Are you a network engineer with solid routing fundamentals who also feels at home in a Linux shell? At Telavox, our infrastructure team is growing, and we’re looking for a Network Engineer to help scale and secure the backbone of our global communication services. More and more of our network runs on open source routing software on standard servers, managed as code, alongside traditional network gear. You’ll join a highly skilled, collaborative team that likes automation-first thinking and continuous learning. If you want hard problems with real impact and enjoy working across teams, this role is for you. About the job As a Network Engineer at Telavox, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and operating our core network infrastructure. That covers data center networking, edge PoPs, cloud native integrations, and infrastructure automation. You’ll work with experienced engineers who share a DevOps mindset and work with autonomy, quality, and speed. Your day-to-day work may include: Designing and implementing scalable network solutions, both on-prem and across distributed global environments Building and operating Linux-based routing alongside our existing network platforms Automating configuration, monitoring, and provisioning with tools like Ansible, Python, and Bash Expanding and maintaining our international edge network of PoP sites Managing our hybrid infrastructure and private cloud, with Kubernetes networking at the core Supporting our infrastructure APIs so product teams can self-serve Ensuring high availability and performance with OSPF, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN and WireGuard/IPsec Collaborating across product and platform teams to turn complex requirements into practical, robust infrastructure This role can be based in either our Malmö HQ or in our Stockholm office. About you You’re a systems thinker with deep networking expertise and a drive to simplify, automate, and scale. You’ve run production networks at scale and know Linux well enough to troubleshoot and build on it, whether you already route on Linux or want to go further in that direction. You’re structured in your approach but flexible in how you find solutions. Key skills and experience we’re looking for: Extensive experience designing and operating production-grade network environments Solid working knowledge of Linux and Linux networking Strong command of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), overlays (VXLAN, EVPN), and secure networking (WireGuard, IPsec) Comfortable with automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash) Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as NetBox, Prometheus, and Grafana Good understanding of network segmentation, zero trust principles, and security practices for critical infrastructure Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset; you enjoy sharing knowledge across team boundaries Good to have: Experience running routing or packet forwarding on Linux with open-source software Experience with Juniper or similar carrier-grade platforms Hands-on experience with hypervisor and container-based workloads, especially Kubernetes on-prem Network or cloud certifications (JNCIE, CCNP, AWS, etc.) Join us at Telavox Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect. Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication. We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture. Read more about our new HQ in Malmö ! How to apply! At Telavox, we don’t focus on fitting in. We focus on making room for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or who you are. We’re always looking for great talent, and we review applications on an ongoing basis. If you’re excited about joining an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, we’d love to hear from you! Apply with your CV and cover letter in English. Please note that, in accordance with GDPR, we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email. For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson at emil.nilsson@telavox.com Learn more about what we do! ️

items.card: About the Role We are looking for a Project Delivery Specialist to join our global team, owning the end-to-end implementation journey with large enterprise customers across our growth markets - from the moment a customer signs with Tandem to the point where they are fully up and running. You will work with large complex organisations across markets, each with its own health system, IT landscape, governance
items.desc: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role We are looking for a Project Delivery Specialist to join our global team, owning the end-to-end implementation journey with large enterprise customers across our growth markets - from the moment a customer signs with Tandem to the point where they are fully up and running. You will work with large complex organisations across markets, each with its own health system, IT landscape, governance requirements and ways of working. One week you might be running a steering group with a hospital group’s executive team, the next working through integration details with a local IT provider in another country. You’ll need to read each context quickly and adapt your approach, while holding the line on scope, timeline and quality. What You Will Do Lead customer implementation projects end to end, keeping deliveries on track, on scope, and on time. Coordinate the technical setup - including EHR integrations - working closely with our engineering team. Work with customers and our Medical Operations team to ensure the right configurations are built for each clinical environment. Coordinate user training programmes together with Medical Operations, ensuring clinicians are confident and ready at go-live. Act as the customer's primary point of contact throughout the delivery phase, building trust and maintaining momentum. Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and blockers across workstreams. Continuously refine our delivery playbook, contributing to scalable processes as our customer base grows. What You Bring A strong track record in project management, ideally delivering technology solutions or complex multi-stakeholder projects within healthcare settings. Excellent stakeholder management — you're comfortable engaging with everyone from frontline clinicians to C-level decision-makers. Familiarity with healthcare IT environments — EHR integrations, clinical workflows, and change management in care organisations. Genuine curiosity about technology and AI — deep technical expertise is not required, but you understand how modern software products are delivered. An entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working in a fast-paced, scaling environment. Excellent communication skills in English. Bonus Experience in management consulting or a similar high-paced, client-facing environment, where you’ve had to get up to speed on a new organisation and deliver results under pressure. Additional languages relevant to our growth markets. Experience in a startup or scale-up, or in setting up delivery processes from scratch. Location We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture. How to Apply We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English. Our interview process consists of 4 stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition First interview with the Hiring Manager Follow-up interviews and tasks with members of the team and the Director of Global Expansion Working Day — Join us in the Stockholm office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action. Culture at Tandem At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started. Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together. Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection. We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

items.desc: At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars. Could you be the Requirements Management Engineer (RME) in Stockholm or Västerås we’re looking for? Your future role Take on a new challenge and apply your Requirement Management expertise in a new cutting-edge field. The Nordic Technology Center of Alstom is an internal development and supplier organization for train onboard signaling; train control and communication system. The organization is global with sites in Sweden, Germany, Switzerland, France, and India. The team in Stockholm and Västerås is responsible for computers legacy control and communication products as well as new, input and output products, and human machine interface products. We are now investing in new products with increased performance, cyber security protection and increased functionality. As Requirements Management Engineer (RME) you shall be a key user for requirement tools , manage requirement structure and support multiple programs by providing guidelines, coaching and training team members for the management and writing requirements. You will collaborate daily with the Program Development Managers, System Architects and engineering teams. We will look to you for: Implement Requirement Management processes for product development Administrate and be key user for Requirement Management tool Drive the engineers in their requirements development activities Verify the data quality & consistency in the Requirement Management database Manage the requirements changes & configuration Be the first line contact for Requirement Management queries All about you We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role: Master’s degree in engineering like System Engineering, Electronic Engineering or similar. Previous working experience (3-5 years) as requirement manager, requirement engineer (Doors and Doors NG). Previous working experience with DevOps (CI/CD) Previous working experience in international teams Previous working experience in configuration and change management. Experience in the development of embedded software and hardware. It would be highly appreciated if you have knowledge and or experience of industrial or railway safety standards (IEC61508/EN50128/EN60567/EN50129). Fluent in English. Swedish is an advantage. Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also: Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines. Work with newest train control systems Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues Contribute to innovative projects Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you! Important to note As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

items.desc: Vill du använda film, berättande och möten med människor för att göra kunskap användbar för svensk animalieproduktion? Trivs du lika bra ute på en gård som framför redigeringsdatorn? Då kan det här vara en tjänst för dig! Om Kunskapsnav Animalieproduktion Kunskapsnav Animalieproduktion arbetar för att stärka produktivitet, lönsamhet och konkurrenskraft inom svensk animalieproduktion. Inom enheten är vi 16 medarbetare med bred och kompletterande kompetens inom bland annat kommunikation, animalieproduktion, veterinärmedicin och företagsekonomi. Genom att sammanställa, tillgängliggöra och sprida relevant kunskap till lantbrukare och rådgivare bidrar vi till en robust och konkurrenskraftig svensk livsmedelsproduktion. Du blir en del av en innovativ miljö där vi ständigt utvecklar nya sätt att göra kunskap tillgänglig och användbar för Sveriges lantbrukare . Om rollen Vi söker en innehållsproducent som vill vara ute där det händer. En stor del av arbetet handlar om att besöka lantbruk, träffa djurägare och rådgivare, fånga erfarenheter från vardagen och omvandla dem till filmer och annat innehåll som inspirerar och skapar nytta för branschen. Hos oss får du kombinera kreativt innehållsskapande med ett genuint intresse för människor, praktiskt lantbruk och kunskapsutveckling. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Planera, filma och redigera kunskapsfilmer. Genomföra intervjuer och dokumentera praktiska exempel. Skapa innehåll för webb, sociala medier och digitala utbildningar. Producera fotografier, presentationer, infografik och kortare texter. Medverka vid mässor och andra branschevenemang. Bidra till utvecklingen av nya kunskapsprojekt och digitala format. Placering är Lund eller Uppsala. Vi utgår idag från ett hybridarbetssätt där det går att dela sin arbetstid mellan kontoret och hemarbetsplatsen. Resor är en naturlig del av rollen och förekommer regelbundet. Vem är du? För att lyckas i rollen är du nyfiken, kreativ och självgående. Du tycker om att möta människor och har lätt för att skapa förtroende. Du ser berättelser och kunskap i människors vardag och kan omsätta det till innehåll som engagerar och skapar nytta. Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar för hela produktionen och trivs med att växla mellan självständigt arbete och nära samarbete med andra. Krav för rollen: Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom film, journalistik, media, kommunikation eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av filmproduktion, från planering och intervju till redigering och publicering. Goda kunskaper i Adobe Premiere Pro eller motsvarande redigeringsverktyg. Erfarenhet av fotografering, ljudinspelning och produktion för digitala kanaler. Kunskap och erfarenhet inom lantbruk, animalieproduktion eller andra gröna näringar. God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift. B-körkort och möjlighet att resa regelbundet i tjänsten. Meriterande: Erfarenhet av journalistiskt arbete, intervjuteknik eller reportageproduktion. Erfarenhet av kunskapsförmedling, utbildningsproduktion eller forskningskommunikation. Erfarenhet av tillgänglighetsanpassning och textning av digitalt innehåll. Kunskaper i ytterligare verktyg inom Adobe Creative Cloud. Erfarenhet av webbpublicering, livesändningar, webbinarier eller AI-baserade produktionsverktyg. Är vi en bra match? Hos oss är du inte bara innehållsproducent. Du är också med och utvecklar framtidens kunskapsförmedling för svensk animalieproduktion. Du får stor frihet att testa nya idéer, utforska nya format och bidra till projekt som gör verklig skillnad för lantbrukare, rådgivare och andra aktörer i branschen. Arbetet är varierat, kreativt och utvecklande, med ena foten i den digitala världen och den andra ute på gårdar runt om i landet. Välkommen med din ansökan! Låter detta intressant och du vill du veta mer är du välkommen att kontakta Kristina Yngwe, Enhetschef Kunskapsnav animalieproduktion, kristina.yngwe@ri.se. Sista ansökningsdag är 12 november. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under och efter ansökningsperioden. Sök utan personligt brev. Våra fackliga representanter är Ingemar Petermann, Saco, 010 228 41 22 och Linda Ikatti, Unionen, 010-5165161.

items.desc: As a joint venture of the University of Basel and the University Hospitals Basel, the Department of Biomedicine (DBM) brings together basic and clinical scientists to advance the understanding of health and disease. We are home to more than 67 research groups and over 800 employees across six locations in the heart of Basel. Our collaborative and international environment fosters innovation, excellence, and impactful research. The Developmental Genetics led by Prof. Aimée Zuniga, is looking for a Research Assistant/Technician. Join our community and help shape the future of biomedicine. Your position The Research Assistant will join the Developmental Genetics Research Group, which investigates the signalling interactions and molecular mechanisms controlling embryonic development. Our research uses genetically engineered mouse models, mouse models of human diseases, and organoid systems to investigate the gene regulatory networks that control normal organ development and the alterations resulting in congenital disorders. We combine these experimental models with state-of-the-art genetic and molecular technologies, genome-wide approaches, and advanced 3D confocal imaging techniques. Your profile Applicants must have completed an apprenticeship as molecular biology research technician (Laborant:in) and/or hold a BSc/MSc in molecular biology and excellent skills in molecular biology. Prior expertise in using mouse models and/or transcriptome/analysis (immunofluorescence cells/frozen embryo sections, protein biochemistry etc) will be an asset for the position. Applicants with certification for animal experimentation (LTK1 or FELASA certification) and experience in using mouse models will be given preference. Good knowledge of (spoken) English is important as this is the working language. We offer you We offer a stimulating discovery research environment in an internationally renowned research team at the University of Basel. The group is located in one of the flagship Research Institutes at the Department of Biomedicine with state-of-the-art research facilities and excellent training and career development opportunities. For more information, please go to: https://www.devgenbasel.com/ The University of Basel is an equal opportunity employer that offers competitive salaries. Application Please submit a letter of motivation, CV, copies of the relevant diplomas, degrees and certifications, brief summary of research and technology expertise, and the names and email addresses of minimally two referees. items.desc: Description The Medical Science Liaison is responsible for supporting the safe and effective use of Company therapies focusing on communication complex medical and scientific information to healthcare professionals and communication field medical intelligence/insights to internal stakeholders. The MSL has internal and external training responsible for Company therapies. The MSL has an assigned territory autonomously managing, developing and growing medical activities/initiatives achieving key medical objectives. RESPONSIBILITIES As Oncology Field Medical Affairs, your day may include: Building and maintaining relationships with key therapeutic area experts and investigators to foster collaboration and insights. Responding to inquiries about study indications, disease states, and therapeutic areas by presenting scientific and clinical data in compliance with regulatory standards. Educating healthcare practitioners, payers, and researchers on disease management and therapeutic advancements. Attending medical conferences to gather and report scientific, clinical, and competitive intelligence insights. Supporting investigator-initiated studies by strengthening relationships with investigators and internal teams. Assisting in the development and dissemination of clinical data through abstracts, posters, presentations, and manuscripts. Strong collaboration with Clinical Development and Operations teams, as well as other relevant business functions REQUIREMENTS Hold a PhD, PharmD, or MD (a Master’s degree with Oncology experience may also be considered). Proven experience in the pharmaceutical industry or a clinical setting, ideally with expertise in immuno-oncology. Demonstrate experience working collaboratively within matrix environments as well as establishing meaningful relationships with KOLs. You excel in collaborative, matrixed environments and enjoy building relationships across teams. You are deeply passionate about Oncology You possess strong communication skills and are fluent in both the local language and English. You are comfortable with frequent travel, including overnight stays, to engage with stakeholders and attend conferences. You value integrity, professionalism, and strict adherence to compliance standards. At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities. Why Syneos Health? Each life we positively impact makes our work worthwhile. By joining one of our field medical teams, you will partner with some of the most talented clinicians in the industry and be reminded why you chose a career in healthcare. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world. Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives? items.desc: Are you looking for an exciting new challenge in a place to take your career to the next level? Would you like to join a friendly, progressive, innovative team and play a part in the transformation of pathology services across South Yorkshire and Bassetlaw? Do you want to work in a fully UKAS-accredited, modern laboratory environment where you can make a difference? We are looking for a passionate HCPC Registered Biomedical Scientist who either has or is part way through completing their specialist portfolio to join our small, busy, friendly team on a fixed term 12 month contract. You will help maintain and develop the work of the Rotherham Histopathology department of delivering a high quality, efficient service. This would be an excellent opportunity for somebody hoping to progress with their specialist portfolio or gain new skills and experiences in a new Histology department. The Rotherham Histology department receives 30000 Histology, 1000 non-gynae cytology and 600 andrology samples a year. We undertake all routine histological processes including BMS specimen dissection, microtomy, special stains, immunohistochemistry, molecular diagnostics and andrology. The successful candidate will rotate across all areas of the laboratory and support the monitoring of quality indicators, supervising and training other staff and other quality management duties such as audit and documentation review. As a Biomedical Scientist the post holder will be expected to work within the professional standards expected as a registrant of the Health Professions Council (HCPC) and maintain a portfolio of evidence supporting Continuing Professional Development (CPD). The post holder will be responsible for scientific and technical service delivery within the Histopathology services section of the laboratory. Duties as a Specialist Biomedical Scientist will include performing a range of scientific procedures involving the processing of biomedical specimens to contribute to the diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of diseases and investigation of pathological processes and will include undertaking of complex diagnostic tests and the interpretation of complex diagnostic tests to facilitate a diagnostic report to be produced. The post holder will be required to conform to agreed standard operational procedures, Health & Safety procedures, departmental and organisational policies and good laboratory practice. Within their work duties the post holder will be expected to comply with the standards as required of UKAS and other relevant professional and regulatory Bodies e.g. H.T.A. Please also note this vacancy is banded dependent upon applicants experience relevant to this post. The banding of the successful applicant/s will start at Band 5 unless applicants meet the necessary threshold of skills and experience required to start on Band 6. You will be working for an organisation which values and respects all its staff and the community it serves. The Trust is a leader in the NHS and research sectors and provides excellent benefits for its staff. This includes commitments to professional development but also many policies to support employees in balancing their personal and professional lives. STHFT operates with a budget of £1.2 bn, has a workforce of over 18,500 employees, covers five hospital sites, provides care from over forty community settings, and has an excellent reputation for research. As an organisation we value and respect our staff and the community we serve. We provide excellent staff benefits; this includes commitment to professional development but also many initiatives to support employees in balancing their personal and professional lives. The South Yorkshire and Bassetlaw Pathology Partnership are invested in training, developing, and supporting staff in all aspects including academic courses from certificates of achievement, registration, specialist and higher specialist IBMS portfolios, apprenticeships and leadership and management qualifications. We pride ourselves in enabling opportunity across all our sites to develop staff and provide a strong and sustained service for the future. This vacancy is advertised on a fixed term contract basis for the maximum period of twelve (12) months. Where there is potential, the secondment/fixed term contract may finish early, or in the first instance, the secondment/fixed term contract may be extended due to the internal/external secondment of the substantive post holder. The fixed term contract status of the post holder will be reviewed in accordance with the Trust's legal obligations regarding fixed term contracts and secondments in relation to the substantive post holder. Please note all existing NHS staff will only be considered on a secondment basis. This must first be agreed with your current line manager. items.desc: Job Introduction Position: Scientist/Associate Scientist, Analytical Sciences Location: Liverpool About Pharmaron Pharmaron is a global contract research and manufacturing organization (CRO/CDMO) helping pharma and biotech companies bring new therapies to life. With over 29,000 employees worldwide across 28 locations in the UK, US, China, and Singapore, we support drug discovery through to manufacturing with fully integrated high-quality services. We're proud of the impact we make and just last year, we supported 887 discovery projects, 1,100+ CMC programs, and 1,397 clinical trials across all phases. Our teams are involved in everything from small molecules, ADC's, biologics, and gene therapies and we work with more than 3,300 global customers. To learn more, visit www.pharmaron.com. The role We are looking for a practical and motivated Scientist or Associate Scientist to join our QC Microbiology team in Liverpool on a 12-month fixed-term contract, providing maternity cover. The final appointment level will depend on the successful candidate’s knowledge and experience. This is a hands-on laboratory role focused primarily on routine microbiological testing in support of our facility and the biological products manufactured at the site. Your work will include water system monitoring and product testing by membrane filtration, LAL testing, Environmental Monitoring and Identification ensuring that testing is completed accurately and in line with defined procedures, specifications and GMP requirements. This opportunity would be particularly well suited to a recent science graduate or someone at the beginning of their laboratory career who would like to gain practical experience within a regulated pharmaceutical environment. Previous industrial experience would be beneficial, but it is not essential, as training will be provided. You will join a small, friendly and hardworking team where colleagues support one another and are trained across a range of laboratory activities. Because of the size of the team, you will have the opportunity to learn different aspects of QC microbiology and build a strong foundation for your future scientific career. At Pharmaron we offer: Vibrant and dynamic employment: We are a highly specialised growth company operating in a critical sector of the economy, with a strong and exciting future. Opportunities to develop: Our continued growth provides opportunities for you to learn, build new skills and progress. A supportive team: You will work alongside colleagues who support one another and are committed to delivering high-quality work. Valuable industry experience: Gain practical exposure to GMP laboratory operations and pharmaceutical microbiology. Key roles and responsibilities Perform routine microbiological testing to support facility and product monitoring activities. Carry out water system testing and biological product testing using membrane filtration. Prepare, execute and accurately document laboratory testing activities in accordance with approved procedures. Complete laboratory records, test records and other supporting documentation accurately and within agreed timelines. Review testing data, identify potential issues and escalate them appropriately. Support environmental monitoring and other microbiology activities as required. Assist with equipment checks, qualification activities and the maintenance of laboratory equipment. Maintain laboratory reagents, consumables and stock levels. Ensure appropriate standards of laboratory housekeeping are maintained. Support day-to-day Quality Management System activities, where required. Work in accordance with applicable quality, regulatory, EHS and GMP requirements. Contribute to 5S, operational excellence and continuous-improvement initiatives. Work collaboratively with colleagues across the QC Microbiology team and the wider site. Provide occasional cover outside normal working hours for essential operations, where required by the business. Requirements: Essential BSc, MSc or equivalent qualification in microbiology, biology, biological sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, pharmaceutical sciences or another relevant scientific discipline. Some practical laboratory experience gained through university studies, a research project, industrial placement or employment. A careful and methodical approach to laboratory work. Good attention to detail and the ability to follow defined procedures accurately. Effective organisational and time-management skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. A willingness to learn new laboratory methods and develop within a regulated environment. The ability to work effectively as part of a small, collaborative team. items.desc: Synthomer is a leading supplier of high-performance, highly specialised polymers and ingredients that play vital roles in key sectors such as coatings, construction, adhesives, and health and protection – growing markets that serve billions of end users worldwide. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,500 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 28 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products. At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy. Are you ready to turn your scientific curiosity into a career that makes a real impact? Our Ignite Graduate Programme is a unique two-year development journey designed for ambitious graduates who want to accelerate their careers, build technical expertise, and develop the leadership capabilities needed to become the next generation of innovators at Synthomer. Working within our Research and Development function, you'll support real innovation projects that help solve customer challenges, develop new technologies, and create business value. Through a combination of hands-on project work, mentoring, training, and rotational placements, you'll gain the experience, confidence and commercial understanding needed to thrive in a technical or leadership career. What You'll Experience During the programme, you'll have the opportunity to: Complete four six-month rotations across key areas of our R&D organisation. Deliver experimental programmes and contribute to innovation projects that support business growth. Design, conduct and evaluate laboratory experiments. Analyse scientific and commercial data, draw conclusions and present recommendations to stakeholders. Contribute to the development of new products, technologies, capabilities and intellectual property. Gain experience across multiple technical disciplines including synthesis, applications and analytical science. Work closely with both technical and commercial teams to understand how innovation creates value for customers. Develop a broad internal network across research, manufacturing, commercial and support functions. Participate in structured leadership development and mentoring programmes. Build confidence presenting ideas, influencing stakeholders and managing projects. Play an active role in maintaining a strong Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) culture. You'll thrive in this programme if you : Have recently completed, or are on track to complete, a degree in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, or a related scientific discipline . Enjoy analysing data and turning insights into practical solutions. Are passionate about research, innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate strong communication and presentation skills. Enjoy working collaboratively with a wide range of people and functions. Can manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic environment. Are adaptable, resilient and open to new experiences. Have excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to safe working practices. Show leadership potential and the desire to make a positive impact. Have a good working knowledge of English. The Behaviours We Valu e We're looking for individuals who demonstrate: Curiosity - asking questions and challenging conventional thinking. Collaboration - building strong relationships and working effectively in teams. Adaptability - embracing change and learning from new experiences. Customer Focus - understanding how innovation creates value. Leadership Potential - taking ownership, showing initiative and driving improvement. Ready to Ignite Your Career? This is more than a graduate role. It's an opportunity to contribute to meaningful innovation, learn from experienced scientists and business leaders, and accelerate your development within a global organisation. If you're ready to challenge yourself, grow your expertise and make your mark from day one, we'd love to hear from you. items.desc: About us: Founded in 2015, B2C2 is a global leader for institutional liquidity within digital assets. We bring 24/7 365 days a year deep, reliable pricing for spot, futures, options, CFDs, and NDFs across all market conditions. Our growing team has deep expertise across pricing, structuring, risk, systems, and regulation. B2C2 bridges the gap between traditional financial and digital assets, and is relied upon by brokerages, exchanges, banks, fund managers, and other institutions to provide 24/7 liquidity. Headquartered in London, with global offices in Paris, Jersey City, Tokyo, Singapore, and Luxembourg, our fast-growing team has expertise in traditional financial and crypto markets. We pride ourselves on our company culture and ability to attract not only the top talent but the right people. If you are looking for a role in an exciting new industry, at a dynamic company please keep reading. About the role: We are seeking a highly specialised HFT System and Network Engineer to join our trading infrastructure team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our cutting-edge AWS environments and physical colocation facilities. You will be responsible for the end-to-end optimisation of our global trading stack: minimising tail latency, optimising cross-region connectivity, and automating the deployment of performance-tuned "bare metal" and cloud instances. This is a high-impact role where your optimisations directly translate to our competitive edge in execution speed across both CeFi and DeFi exchanges. Jobs to be Done: Low-latency Infrastructure Build: Architect and deploy HFT-grade stacks, focusing on low-latency connectivity to crypto exchanges and internal networking alike. Hybrid Cloud Optimisation: Manage the interplay between AWS servers and physical hardware in traditional colocation centers. System Performance Tuning: Implement deep-level Linux kernel optimisations to minimise jitter and improve performance Network Automation: Develop "Zero-Touch" deployment pipelines using Terraform and Ansible to ensure infrastructure is reproducible and error-free. Precision Monitoring: Instrument the network for microsecond-level visibility, tracking packet loss, jitter, and retransmissions. Connectivity Management: Coordinate with exchanges and providers to manage cross-connects, LOAs, and high-speed transit lines. Required Skills and experience: Low-Latency DNA: Proven experience in HFT or ultra-low latency environments where microseconds matter. Linux Mastery: Deep knowledge of system internals (CPU pinning, NUMA, kernel bypass) and performance profiling. Advanced Networking: Expert understanding of BGP, Multicast, and AWS networking. Automation-First Mindset: Proficiency in Python/Bash and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to manage complex global deployments. Hardware Savvy: Comfort working with high-performance NICs, low-latency switches (Arista/Cisco), and physical data centre requirements. Execution-Driven: A clear, concise communicator who thrives in high-pressure environments and takes ownership of the entire infra lifecycle. What we offer: An amazing global culture, who are ambitious, innovative and fun while working with the highest levels of honesty and integrity. Two discretionary bonus awards a year. A range of benefits in line with local market practice. Regular fun events and activities, as well as Social Impact volunteering days. A strong culture is a common denominator among the most successful companies and B2C2 is proud to be a values-based company. It is the policy of B2C2 to apply recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation and professional development practices without regard to actual or perceived race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), national origin, age, disability or certain classifications based on genetic information, or because someone is married or in a civil partnership or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances. As such, B2C2 will not tolerate discrimination against any of our employees on the basis of membership in a protected category. We are also committed to creating an inclusive environment to ensure we attract, engage, promote and retain the best talent. We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles.

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) at Equifax is a discipline that combines software and systems engineering for building and running large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that internal and external services meet or exceed reliability and performance expectations while adhering to Equifax engineering principles. SRE is also an engineering approach to building and running production systems – we engineer solutions to operational problems. Our SREs are responsible for overall system operation and we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad set of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems, proactive identification, and prevention of potential outages. Our SRE culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Equifax brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to build an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn, grow and take pride in our work. Build automated tooling to deploy service requests to push a change into production. Build runbooks that are comprehensive and detailed to manage detect, remediate and restore services. items.desc: As a Network & Connectivity Solution Architect reporting to the VP of Software Engineering, you'll play a critical role in designing and governing the end-to-end network and connectivity architectures that power the Calypso CapCloud platform — a cloud-native capital markets solution serving clients across global financial markets. You'll thrive in this position if you're technically deep, client-focused, and energized by solving complex connectivity challenges across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. You bring a global mindset, a passion for cloud networking and security, and the ability to translate complex architecture into clear, actionable outcomes. Key Responsibilities Lead the design of scalable, secure network and connectivity architectures for the CapCloud platform, spanning cloud-native, hybrid, and on-premises environments across AWS and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Serve as the primary technical advisor for customer connectivity and integration architecture, leading discovery workshops, design reviews, and onboarding engagements with clients and implementation partners. Define and maintain connectivity reference architectures, solution blueprints, and design standards — covering private connectivity, VPNs, APIs, load balancing, proxy architectures, and traffic management. Architect and govern enterprise PKI, TLS/mTLS, and Zero Trust networking solutions, ensuring compliance with X.509, RFC 5280, and PKIX standards. Lead adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using Terraform and cloud-native automation, standardizing connectivity deployment patterns and integrating networking into CI/CD pipelines. Required Qualifications Several years of experience in network architecture, cloud networking, or connectivity engineering, with hands-on expertise across AWS (preferred) and/or OCI environments. Proven ability to design end-to-end network solutions including VPC/VCN architectures, BGP/OSPF routing, VPN technologies (IPsec, FortiGate), and private connectivity services (AWS Direct Connect, OCI FastConnect, AWS PrivateLink). Strong experience with traffic management technologies including Layer 4/7 load balancers, HAProxy, Squid Proxy, SSL termination, and reverse proxy architectures. Demonstrated experience with Kubernetes networking, service mesh architectures (mTLS, East-West traffic), and API gateway standards (authentication, rate limiting, developer onboarding). Clear communicator with a track record of presenting architecture recommendations to both technical teams and senior stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Cloud networking certifications (e.g., AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, OCI Networking) or equivalent experience. Experience in capital markets, fintech, or regulated financial services environments. Familiarity with connectivity protocols used in financial markets, including FIX connectivity, IBM MQ, market data distribution, and third-party trading and clearing platforms. This position is based in London and offers a hybrid work environment with at least 3 days per week in-office, subject to change. items.desc: DESCRIPTION The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in leading large-scale portfolio assessment and application disposition for enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. The International Insights, Analytics and Commercial Operation (IIACO) team’s mission is to build best-in-class commercial capabilities to drive sustainable growth in the International region for Vertex. A successful candidate will likely work across more than one function to ensure a well-rounded and broad experience. Candidates will gain exposure to large-scale datasets, statistical analysis, and reporting automation, as well as emerging applications of AI and advanced analytics to drive efficiency and insight generation. This function suits candidates with strong quantitative skills and an interest in applying data-driven thinking to real commercial challenge. Projects with this team look at impact of customer facing activities so successful candidates will need to be comfortable analyzing data and reporting on the impact of activities. Candidates interested in this function should display an interest in digital marketing or innovation and/or some experience using digital channels (e.g. emails and websites) in a promotional setting. items.card: You will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better business decisions. This role combines business intelligence, advanced analytics and data storytelling. You will work closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges, use SQL and Python to explore and analyze data, and build scalable reporting and analytical solutions using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. Key Responsibilities
items.desc: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Analyst, Analytics & Metrics We are looking for a highly analytical and technically capable BI/Data Analyst to join our team. You will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better business decisions. This role combines business intelligence, advanced analytics and data storytelling. You will work closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges, use SQL and Python to explore and analyze data, and build scalable reporting and analytical solutions using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. Key Responsibilities Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, drivers, anomalies and opportunities. Use Python and SQL for data manipulation, advanced analysis, automation and analytical modelling. Design and develop intuitive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI. Work within Microsoft Fabric to access, transform, analyse and deliver data and insight. Partner with stakeholders to translate business challenges into meaningful analytical questions, metrics and KPIs. Conduct deep-dive and root-cause analysis to understand what is happening, why it is happening and where action should be taken. Develop repeatable and scalable analytical solutions rather than relying on manual analysis. Communicate complex findings through clear visualisations, data storytelling and recommendations. Support data quality, governance, documentation and consistent reporting standards. Requirements Proven experience in a BI, Data Analyst or similar analytical role. Strong Python skills for data analysis, automation and statistical modelling. Strong SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and its data and analytics capabilities. Strong experience developing dashboards and analytical solutions in Power BI. Experience applying advanced analytical techniques such as statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, cohort analysis, anomaly detection or driver analysis. Good understanding of data modelling, data warehousing and ETL processes. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured analysis. Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical audiences. Nice to Have Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure. Experience developing automated or scalable analytical solutions. Exposure to machine learning or predictive analytics. Degree or equivalent experience in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. All About You You are naturally curious and want to understand why something is happening, not simply report that it has happened. You enjoy working with complex data, testing hypotheses and finding patterns others might miss. You are comfortable moving between Python, SQL, Fabric and Power BI, but understand that technology is only part of the role. Most importantly, you can turn data into insight, understanding and action. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

items.desc: Job Description: Mars is delivering a global Product Lifecycle Management transformation program (cPLM) to replace our existing process and system used to capture and evolve knowledge about our products. This role serves as the critical functional bridge between global External Manufacturing team and the cPLM team, securing the foundational data integrity of external manufacturing recipes before and during all FN site deployments. By driving hands-on system validation, enforcing data compliance standards, and directly enabling EMs, this position ensures that our external manufacturing recipes are digitized accurately and compliantly. In this role, you will work closely with the Food Nutrition (FN) Scope Lead, the FN SMEs and FN cPLM leadership team. You will also occasionally need to collaborate with Enterprise POs, Corporate DT and other segment scope Leads. You will also need to engage with external partners including Co-Manufacturers, Co-Packers, and Supplier teams to ensure seamless deployment and capability building. This is a project-role for the Food cPLM program. The role is funded through June 2028. As we approach the funding end date, your manager will be in touch with additional information including funding for next phases, including pilot and deployment. Based country: UK or Netherlands External Manufacturing Discovery Support External Manufacturing Discovery Scoping: Participate in discovery workshops with External Manufacturing, Commercial, Product Development and other functions. Capture, consolidate and translate requirements from FN and share with the enterprise team. Provide Day-to-Day Functional Suppor: Act as the primary functional point of contact for External Manufacturing, Commercial leads, and external supplier technical contacts to troubleshoot process, system or data issues. Triage Issue Resolution: Rapidly diagnose and categorize user inquiries from external and internal co-manufacturing stakeholders, resolving functionalhow-to questions and partnering with technical teams for bug resolution. Coordinate External Deployment Readiness: Drive EM site specific deployment checklists, ensuring external partners and internal co-man data teams complete legacy data cleansing, access setup, and onboarding activities prior to go-live. .External Manufacturing Data Quality, Governance Compliance Audit External Manufacturing Legacy Data Readiness: Conduct rigorous audits on legacy external manufacturing specifications, recipe structures, and packaging records, identifying missing, obsolete, or non-compliant attributes prior to cPLM migration. Remediate Data Gaps Enrich External Specs: Directly assist internal external-manufacturing teams and external suppliers in gathering missing technical parameters, filling data gaps, and enriching specification records for seamless ingestion. Enforce Global Standardization Governance: Partner with global data stewards to enforce strict naming, classification, and taxonomy rules across all external supplier records, proactively identifying unauthorized workarounds or process deviations. Testing and Continuous Improvement Validate External Bill of Materials (BOM) Specifications: Build, configure, and validate raw material, recipe, packaging, and trade item specifications for external manufacturing streams in test environments to verify accurate data flows. Execute End-to-End Testing (UAT) for External Scenarios: Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by following test scripts, logging defects, and providing feedback on system KPIs. Support FN Pilot and Future Deployments: Support the initial pilot deployment and subsequent Food Nutrition site deployments by establishing reusable templates, checklists, and gathering learning for continuous improvement. Drive Process Interface Optimizations – long term: Analyze support ticket trends, supplier onboarding bottlenecks, and partner feedback to propose proactive improvements to external data exchange templates, workflows, and guidelines. External Partner Enablement, Support Community Engagement Design Deliver Targeted Partner Training: Partner with enterprise change and training leads to create and deliver role-based training, interactive demos, and step-by-step guides for external partners and internal co-man teams. Lead On-Site and/or Virtual Hypercare for External Go-Lives: Act as the dedicated hypercare lead during external manufacturing deployment waves, working shoulder-to-shoulder with our technical teams to resolve any issues. Prepare Stakeholder Communications: Translate deployment milestones, system release updates, and risk escalations into concise, impact-oriented summaries for External Manufacturing and RD leadership. . As the program evolves, your responsibilities may need to shift to support the team where needed most.

items.desc: Senior Statistical Programmer - Medical Devices At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise. As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide. As a Statistical Programmer at ICON, you will the development, validation, and execution of statistical programs to support clinical trial analysis and reporting. You will be working with as part of a team dedicated to a globally recognised client in the medical devices space. What You Will Do: You will contribute to statistical programming activities, taking responsibility for your deliverables and working collaboratively. Key responsibilities include: Developing, validating, and maintaining complex statistical programs (SAS) for data manipulation, analysis, and reporting in clinical trials. Collaborating with biostatisticians and cross-functional teams to interpret study requirements and ensure the accurate implementation of statistical analyses. Preparing and reviewing statistical analysis plans (SAPs), programming specifications, and derived datasets to meet regulatory standards. Ensuring data integrity and compliance with industry regulations, including ICH/GCP guidelines, throughout the programming process. Mentoring junior programmers and assisting in training team members on programming techniques and best practices. Your Profile: You will bring relevant statistical programming experience, along with the following qualifications and skills. Required qualifications and experience: Bachelor's degree in statistics, computer science, mathematics, or a related discipline Proven experience as a statistical programmer within the clinical research industry, with strong knowledge of statistical methodologies and programming. Proficiency in programming languages such as SAS, with experience in clinical data management systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail and the ability to work independently. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex statistical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively with team members. Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based. Rewards & Benefits ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development. Benefits may include: Competitive base salary and performance related incentives Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable Retirement and pension plans Life assurance and disability coverage Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways Benefits may vary depending on role and location. Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers. Inclusion and Accessibility ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a request . Are you a current ICON Employee?

No two weeks are the same. One day you could be analysing terrain models and producing GIS outputs. You'll contribute throughout the project lifecycle, providing technical insight that helps clients understand risk, improve resilience and make better decisions. Your work is likely to include: ️ Undertaking geomorphological surveys and site investigations ️ Mapping landforms, terrain features and geohazards ️ Supporting natural hazard and risk assessments ️ Interpreting topographic, LiDAR and remote sensing datasets ️ Producing GIS-based analysis and mapping outputs ️ Providing geomorphological input to engineering and environmental projects ️ Collaborating with geotechnical, environmental and water specialists across multidisciplinary teams ️ Supporting the development of innovative, sustainable solutions for clients This role includes regular fieldwork and travel to project locations, including remote and upland environments. items.card: You will: Build the business : turn the proposition and strategic ambition into a clear business plan, operating model and organisation. Lead the launch : bring together product, technology, commercial and operational capabilities to successfully take the business to market. Prove and scale the model : use customer and commercial insight to validate the proposition, make smart choices and determine where to invest.
items.desc: Liberty Global | Europe Build a business from the ground up. Liberty Global is looking for an exceptional Chief Executive Officer to lead a new business currently being incubated within Liberty Global. This is not an established business looking for its next leader. It is a start-up. The proposition is being developed, the foundations are being built and we’re now looking for the CEO who can take it through launch, prove the model and build it into a successful, scalable business. You’ll have the backing, expertise and reach of Liberty Global, but you’ll need the mindset of a founder: comfortable starting with a blank sheet of paper, making decisions with incomplete information, building a team and operating model from the ground up, and staying close enough to the detail to make things happen. It’s a rare opportunity to combine the pace, ownership and ambiguity of a start-up with the backing of an established international business. The opportunity As CEO, you’ll have end-to-end accountability for taking the business from incubation through launch and into its next stage of growth. You will: Build the business : turn the proposition and strategic ambition into a clear business plan, operating model and organisation. Lead the launch : bring together product, technology, commercial and operational capabilities to successfully take the business to market. Prove and scale the model : use customer and commercial insight to validate the proposition, make smart choices and determine where to invest. Own commercial performance : take accountability for growth, financial performance, investment decisions and resource allocation. Create the organisation : recruit and lead a high-performing leadership team and build the capabilities the business needs as it grows. Build for scale : establish the systems, governance, disciplines and operating rhythms needed to move from start-up to scaled business. Develop opportunities for growth : identify new partnerships, markets and commercial opportunities as the business develops. Lead with pace and discipline : balance entrepreneurial thinking and rapid execution with strong governance, risk management and operational resilience. Engage at the highest level : work closely with Liberty Global leadership, venture sponsors, shareholders and strategic partners. Who we’re looking for We’re looking for a builder, not simply a custodian . Someone who has experienced the reality of creating and scaling something new: the ambiguity, pace, trade-offs and hands-on leadership that come with building a start-up. You’ll bring: Significant leadership experience within a digital, technology-enabled, fintech, marketplace or subscription business A strong track record of building, launching and/or scaling a start-up, venture or high-growth business Commercial leadership experience with meaningful accountability for growth and business performance The ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution Experience leading across product, technology, commercial and operational disciplines Strong judgement and the ability to make decisions when there isn’t a perfect answer The credibility to operate with senior executives, Boards, investors and external partners A customer-led, commercially sharp and data-driven approach Experience of consumer digital businesses, fintech, marketplaces, regulated environments or scaling across multiple markets would be particularly valuable. The person This role will suit someone who gets energy from building . You’re entrepreneurial without being chaotic. You move quickly, but know when rigour matters. You can create a compelling vision and then roll up your sleeves to make it real. You build great teams, create clarity where there isn’t any and are comfortable being personally accountable for the outcome. Most importantly, you want to build the next business, not simply run the last one. Why Liberty Global? You’ll be joining at a point where you can have a fundamental impact on what this business becomes. The venture is currently being incubated within Liberty Global , giving it access to the capabilities and backing of an established international business while operating with the entrepreneurial mindset and pace of a start-up. The business itself remains confidential at this stage. More detail on the proposition, opportunity and ambition will be shared with candidates as they progress through the process.

items.desc: We are delighted to advertise for a Band 4 post within our team of therapists from the Camden Neurology and Stroke Service. This post is an exciting opportunity to work within a dynamic setting across the borough of Camden and join a highly supportive and cohesive therapy team. The Service provides client-centred assessment/rehabilitation/disability management at St Pancras Hospital and throughout Camden community, including in clients’ own homes, in therapy gym facilities or in wider community settings. You will work in the following pathways: Stroke Early Supported Discharge Long-term conditions NeuroActive: exercise-based therapy to prepare for transition to a local gym. The successful candidate will provide evidence-based, client goal focused rehabilitation appropriate to the various specialist areas. We are looking for a highly motivated team worker with excellent communication skills. This post will allow the successful applicant to continue to improve knowledge and clinical skills in a range of settings. The candidate will work alongside experienced multidisciplinary teams and be well supported by senior staff both informally and formally through supervision. There is a strong focus on personal and service development and you will take an active role in these. We reserve the right to close the advert early dependent on the number of applications received. We are recruiting for a generic therapy assistant within the Camden Neurological and Stroke Service, under the guidance and supervision of a qualified therapist. You may work with physiotherapists, occupational therapists and speech and language therapists. To be actively involved with carrying out multi- disciplinary rehabilitation, and enabling care programmes, as well as being assigned other duties such as clerical and administrative and implementing infection control tasks in the gym. To assist in the running and to support the provision of activity programmes at the Peckwater Centre and in a range of community exercise facilities. This may include facilitating group sessions, and supporting clients on a 1:1 basis in a range of settings under the guidance of a qualified therapist. The Camden Neurological and Stroke Service is currently based at St Pancras Hospital. The team is interdisciplinary and comprises of Clinical Psychologists, Occupational Therapists, Physiotherapists, Rehabilitation Assistants and Speech and Language Therapists. The remit of the team is to provide rehabilitation for adults with neurological impairment in the community. The team promotes independence and community integration. Work with clients can vary from short episodes of care to longer-term support or rehabilitation, but always follows a goal orientated approach. The team is committed to a clinical governance programme and team members are encouraged to use an evidence based practice model and to participate in research and audit programmes. To provide client-centred assessment/rehabilitation/disability management at St Pancras Hospital and throughout Camden community, including in clients’ own homes, in therapy gym facilities or in wider community settings.

items.desc: We are pleased to offer an opportunity to join our friendly and forward‑thinking radiotherapy physics team at North Middlesex Hospital in North London as a Band 7 Radiotherapy Physicist . This post is ideally suited to candidates who have recently completed the STP and achieved HCPC registration, or those nearing completion and looking to develop strong clinical and technical skills within a supportive team. Our radiotherapy service is equipped with Varian TrueBeam and Halcyon linacs, with Varian Eclipse used for all treatment planning. We have recently commissioned a TrueBeam equipped with HyperSight and AlignRT for SGRT. We also have an XStrahl treatment unit for superficial radiotherapy. The department provides a comprehensive physics service across treatment planning, machine QA, and molecular radiotherapy. You will be able to rotate through each section and contribute to service improvement and innovation alongside routine clinical work. Ongoing developments include knowledge-based planning, QA automation with RadMachine, planning with RapidArcDynamic, and lots more besides. The team includes 10 clinical scientists (including this post), 6 dosimetrists, and 6 engineering and technical staff, creating a collaborative and well-supported working environment. Flexible working is supported across the Trust, with a hybrid model combining on-site and remote working. The post holder will participate in the general Radiotherapy Physics service provision to the North Middlesex Hospital site . The post holder may be required to specialise in one or more sections within the Radiotherapy Physics service. The physicist’s role is to ensure the safe delivery of the Radiotherapy Physics service assisting the Head of the service as well as the designated Medical Physics Experts in their various areas of responsibility. The post holder will be responsible to the Deputy Head of Radiotherapy Physics and to the Principal Physicists when working in their specific areas. The post holder will also be expected to work closely with Radiotherapy Radiographers, Clinical Oncologists and Specialist Radiotherapy Registrars. North Mid is part of North Central London integrated care system – consisting of the NHS and Local authority organisations in Camden, Islington, Barnet, Enfield and Haringey. As with other ICS’s, we are working increasingly closely with partners and indeed many of our financial and performance objectives are measured at this system level. Whilst all organisations remain as standalone, statutory bodies we have an ICS infrastructure for making shared decisions and agreeing shared approaches. We are proud of our staff and want to ensure their training allows them to provide excellent clinical care. We are also a training unit for medical students from UCL and St George’s University Grenada, and for nursing and midwifery students from Middlesex and City Universities. Take a tour of our hospital here 1. 1. Clinical Scientific 1.1. Produce routine and complex treatment plans for external beam radiotherapy. Use computerised planning systems to design and customise treatment plans. Take responsibility for the accurate production of individualised treatment plans and associated dosimetry calculations. 1.2. Advise clinical staff on the effects of various treatment plan options on patient dose distributions. Discuss and agree approaches with clinical staff to create optimum treatment plans and advise on aspects of the treatment and patient set-up, as required. 1.3. Check and approve routine and complex treatment plans, dose calculations and templates produced by other members of staff. 2. 2. General 2.1. Provide support to Physics computing in Radiotherapy. Write software to the requirements of the department and adapt existing software packages as required. Monitor and resolve problems on computing systems in Radiotherapy and Radiotherapy Physics. 2.2. Participate in acceptance testing and commissioning of new equipment as appropriate. Please see the Job Description and the Persons Specification for further details about the job role.
