items.desc: About Kibble Kibble supports children and young people (aged 5-26) who have experienced trauma and adversity through residential care, education and mental health services. For more than 200 years, we’ve put young people first and have built a trusted charity with vital services that strive to transform lives, families and communities. When starting a new job at Kibble, you’ll become part of a dedicated staff team who make sure children are happy and safe 365 days a year, 24/7. Whether your role is in care, education, or the corporate side, you’ll help give young people a chance at life. Are you interested in making a real change with families with complex needs? The Systemic Family service is part of the Specialist Intervention Team who work with children 5-18 years old who are living away from home. We work across the range of facilities, including the safe centre, community services and early years provisions. You will become an integral part of the SIS team, which is responsible for the planning, implementation and evaluation of a range of specialist interventions for young people and their families. The service prides itself on working alongside families who have previously struggled to engage with services. We are looking to recruit a motivated and passionate family worker to work with families using therapeutic approaches. The post involves providing direct systemic interventions with all of the family, structured work with parents and carers, dyadic work with parents/children, family focused work with children and young people and family support. The role involves working closely with all the systems who work with the young person and their family such as education, the care team, health, support agencies and the local authority. The candidate is required to be flexible, creative, and be able to use playful approaches to engaging children in a therapeutic process. We also work with young people who have complex emotional and behavioural difficulties therefore having an understanding of mental health needs is essential. Main Duties: To implement a range of systemic interventions for individuals, carers, staff, professionals and families using systemic models. To work with young people, children, and their families both within a residential setting and where required within the family home. To work in collaboration with the therapeutic practitioners and psychology team. To provide consultation to professionals and those using the service regarding systemic formulation and care planning. To provide systemic advice, guidance and consultation to other professionals contributing directly to an intervention or care plan of those using the service. To communicate in a skilled and sensitive manner, information concerning the assessment, formulation and intervention plans of children and families. To write reports summarising systemic assessment, formulation or intervention outcomes. Person Specification Qualifications and Experience Essential Educated to degree level or above with experience providing intervention to families. Or A counsellor or psychotherapist registered with a regulatory body with a knowledge of systemic practice and experience of working with families. Desirable A Foundation and/or Intermediate Certificate in Systemic Practice. Understanding of the impact of trauma and child development approaches. DDP qualification. Experience of working with families with complex needs. Experience of delivering interventions with families and young people, monitoring individual/group interventions for challenged families. Job Related Skills and Achievements Essential Car driver with ability and readiness to travel to multiple sites Skills to undertake clinical roles and tasks within the multi-disciplinary and multi- agency contexts in which service users are cared for. A high-level ability to communicate effectively at both a written and oral level to colleagues, professionals and lay people, and a high level of skill and ability to foster effective partnership working. Desirable Skills in providing consultation to other professional and non-professional groups. Personal Attributes Enthusiasm for a broad range of systemic and family therapy approaches that promote family resilience. A capacity to establish priorities and organise workload effectively and efficiently. Ability to operate successfully within a team-based setting as well as being able to work autonomously. items.desc: We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Trust Resident Doctor ST3/4 (MN37) to join our friendly and supportive Diabetes and Endocrinology team at Watford General Hospital. This post is to start asap until 3rd August 2027 on a fixed term basis, with programmed activities to be agreed in line with service requirements. This post offers an excellent opportunity to develop specialist experience in the management of complex diabetes and endocrine disorders while contributing to the delivery of high-quality General Internal Medicine care. Working alongside a team of experienced consultants and a multidisciplinary workforce, you will gain valuable clinical experience, participate in teaching, audit and quality improvement activities, and play a key role in delivering safe, patient-centred care. We are looking for a doctor who is committed to clinical excellence, works well within a multidisciplinary team, demonstrates strong communication skills, and is keen to further develop their knowledge and skills within Diabetes and Endocrinology. Previous NHS experience at or above IMT2 level or equivalent is required. Core departmental hours are generally Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm. The post holder will also participate in the General Internal Medicine on-call rota, depending on experience. This includes evenings, nights, weekends and bank holidays on a rotational basis. Full details of the rota will be discussed at interview. The successful candidate will provide high-quality inpatient care for patients with Diabetes, Endocrinology and General Internal Medicine conditions, working as part of a consultant-led multidisciplinary team. Duties include patient assessment, diagnosis, investigation and treatment planning, daily ward reviews, monitoring progress, completing discharge summaries and maintaining accurate clinical records. The post holder will contribute specialist diabetes and endocrine advice across the Trust, participate in consultant-led ward rounds, and work closely with specialist nurses, dietitians, pharmacists, therapists and colleagues from other specialties to ensure high-quality, patient-centred care. The role also includes participation in teaching, clinical audit, quality improvement and governance activities. We are looking for a motivated doctor with excellent communication and organisational skills, strong clinical knowledge, the ability to prioritise workload effectively, work collaboratively within a team, and recognise when senior support is required. A commitment to safe, compassionate and patient-centred care is essential. With a new hospital planned for Watford, work underway to update theatres at St Albans City Hospital and plans for a neighbourhood healthcare centre in Hemel Hempstead, this is an exciting time to join us. We are building on the success of our award-winning virtual hospital and re-imagining models of care, working closely with partners and making the most of advances in digital healthcare. Staff wellbeing and development are a priority, as is the role of innovation in improving clinical care, outcomes and patient experience. Our vision is Excellent patient care, together and our values are to be empowered, compassionate, professional and inclusive. They capture an important balance across what we must all do as individuals and to support others. items.desc: We are seeking enthusiastic, motivated and adaptable clinicians to join us as CAMHS Community High Intensity CBT Practitioner Trainees. This is a unique opportunity to undertake a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Evidence Based Psychological Treatment for Children and Young People (CBT Route) while gaining valuable clinical experience within a progressive and forward-thinking mental health service. The role is designed to equip practitioners with the knowledge and skills required to deliver evidence-based Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) interventions to children, young people and their families. CYPMH Dorset: A Service in Transformation Children and Young People's Mental Health (CYPMH) Dorset is entering an exciting period of growth and transformation. Through significant new investment, we are developing and expanding our services in line with the i-THRIVE Framework, creating more responsive, accessible and needs-led support for children, young people and families across Dorset. As our transformation programme progresses, this role will evolve alongside the service. Successful candidates will initially support existing teams from a temporary base during the transition period, before becoming part of our future service model. All posts are pan-Dorset, and candidates should be prepared to work flexibly as services continue to expand, including the introduction of extended operational hours in the future. About the Training Programme Successful candidates will undertake a 12-month Postgraduate Diploma in Evidence-Based Psychological Treatment for Children and Young People (CBT Route) at the University of Exeter. The programme combines academic study with supervised clinical practice, preparing trainees to deliver High Intensity CBT for children and young people experiencing anxiety, depression and related mental health difficulties. [HI CBT trainee JD | PDF] Trainees will usually spend two days per week in university teaching and three days working within CYPMH services, developing a supervised clinical caseload and applying their learning in practice. Some teaching may be delivered online. Throughout the programme, trainees will provide evidence-based interventions within a stepped-care model and receive regular clinical supervision and support. [HI CBT trainee JD | PDF] The course is BABCP Level 2 accredited and, on successful completion, trainees will be eligible to apply for BABCP Provisional Accreditation. Following qualification, there may be opportunities to progress into a structured Preceptorship Programme, offering enhanced supervision, peer support, protected development opportunities and a managed caseload to support the transition into autonomous practice. Subject to successful completion and organisational requirements, this would typically lead to progression into a permanent Band 7 CBT Therapist role. At Dorset HealthCare we’re on a mission to empower people to make the most of their lives through our outstanding, joined-up healthcare services. We’re a dynamic, forward-looking Trust, running 12 community hospitals, specialist inpatient facilities and a wide range of integrated community and mental health services for a population of almost 800,000 people. And you’ll be working towards our vision to be better every day through excellence, compassion and expertise in all we do. items.title: Consultant Gastroenterologist with special interest in Hepatology
items.card: Job Description and Person Specification for further details for the post of Locum Consultant Gastroenterologist & Hepatologist at Blackpool Teaching Hospitals.
items.desc: An excellent opportunity has arisen to join our expanding patient centred and supportive Gastroenterology department at Blackpool Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. Our hard-working and forward-thinking team are keen to develop the Gastroenterology and Liver service and would welcome similar minded candidates to join our department. This is an exciting time to join us following investment of £4.0 million recurrent funding to support a blended workforce and £4.5 million capital investment to refurbish our Endoscopy unit. There will be opportunity to support outpatient transformation as part of a blended workforce as we develop our Luminal and Liver services and establish novel outpatient pathways. Our Gastroenterology and Liver service is one of the busiest in the UK – we offer a broad range of diagnostic and therapeutic services for all gastroenterological conditions. Our recently refurbished JAG accredited, performance driven and patient centred Endoscopy unit delivers approximately 15,000 procedures per annum and is a spoke centre for the North-West Endoscopy training academy and is the admin hub for Bowel cancer screening within the Lancashire region. The post holder is expected to have a broad experience of Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Endoscopy, contributing to the core Gastroenterology elective and emergency service but with special emphasis on delivering Hepatology services. There is shared care of inpatients under the Gastroenterology team on the Gastroenterology ward with a Consultant currently being ward based for 1 week out of every 6 weeks. The appointee will make an equal contribution to the care of Gastroenterology inpatients and the out-of-hours GI-Bleed endoscopy service which is 1:6 at present with plans to transition to a 1:8 model with further recruitment. All on-call weeks are followed by a post-on-call (POC) week where Gastroenterology triage, a post-on-call clinic and fast-track clinic are delivered. The POC week is followed by standard normal weeks until the next on-call cycle. Elective activity (outpatient clinics, endoscopy lists) is mainly concentrated in the 5-week period off the ward. The job plan comprises 10 Programmed activities including allocation for the current on call commitment. Job plans will be formally reviewed within the first 6 months after appointment and agreed according to evidence from actual activity. The job plan comprises 10 Programmed activities including allocation for the current on call commitment. Job plans will be formally reviewed within the first 6 months after appointment and agreed according to evidence from actual activity. Predictable emergency on call (Gastroenterology / GI Bleeding Service) is 1.5 DCC. Category A for unpredictable emergency work. This includes a daily ward round on the Gastroenterology ward at weekends when on-call. Blackpool Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is situated on the west coast of Lancashire, with services covering the local authority areas of Blackpool, Fylde and Wyre. The Trust is part of the Lancashire and South Cumbria Integrated Care System (ICS) supporting a population of around 1.6 million people. Blackpool Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust serves a resident population of approximately 330,000 and the 12 million holidaymakers who visit the area every year. The Trust comprises Blackpool Victoria Hospital which is a large busy acute hospital and a smaller community/ rehabilitation hospital - Clifton Hospital. Outpatient services are also provided in Blackpool, Fleetwood and Lytham Hospital. The Trust is also responsible for the provision of a wide range of community healthcare services, including District Nursing, Community Matrons and therapy services. The organisation provides specialist tertiary care for Cardiac and Haematology services, delivers community health services to over 445,000 residents including those in North Lancashire and hosts the National Artificial Eye Service across England. We also have specialised Cardio-thoracic Surgical and Sleep Medicine services (including polysomnography) and provide urgent and emergency care services to an estimated 18 million people who visit the seaside resort each year. items.desc: We are introducing a new, standardised Physical Health Monitoring Clinic model across all our Neighbourhood Teams to improve safety, quality and equity for people prescribed antipsychotic medication. The role of the Physical Healthcare Community Co-ordinator is a one year fixed term contract and will facilitate the launch of this new model. They will ensure each Neighbourhood Team will run a protected, regular physical health monitoring clinic for people prescribed antipsychotics. The clinics will be supported by dedicated Band 4 Health Care Assistant and will have administrative time, with clear clinical oversight from existing senior clinicians. The post holder will report directly to the Associate Director of Quality and Assurance and sit within the Physical health team and will hold managerial responsibility for the three Health Care Assistants, supporting and guiding them. They will establish effective working relationships within each of the thirteen Neighbourhood Teams and identify key staff to support the programme. They will develop key relationships with pharmacy, digital, medical devices and physical health team and will be working with key stakeholders in the project including the Chief Pharmacist and the QI Improvement Advisor. Act as a key member of the project board and project workstreams. Provide guidance on how the physical health clinics should be run, including identifying key responsibilities and roles, and designing the workflow processes including referral, interventions, escalation strategy and recall. Develop key guides for each of the Neighbourhood teams to ensure consistency in implementation and fidelity with the clinical model. Provide regular updates with regards to the project and attend key meetings as required. Identify what training is required and where appropriate, deliver this training to key staff within each of the Neighbourhood teams. This will include training on what physical health interventions need to be undertaken, why and how. As well as how to record this information on our electronic health record system. Work with the Lived experience lead, to help meet the needs of people who are hard to reach. Ensure that the culture you develop is not just based on completing checks but focuses on next steps to support people (don’t just screen, intervene’). Developing a culture and programme where abnormal results must be reviewed, acted on, and clearly documented, with risks explicitly considered where treatment continues. · Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS Foundation Trust is the leading provider of mental health, learning disability, neurodevelopmental and drug and alcohol services in Surrey and North East Hampshire. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further. About the Role Humanoid is looking for a hands-on Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the continued development, deployment and operation of the existing data platform within Humanoid. The role spans cloud infrastructure, full-stack development, platform engineering and data engineering, with responsibility for turning internal engineering requirements into reliable production systems. You will also lead delivery by external contractors and act as their sole point of contact with Humanoid. You will gather requirements from our internal engineering teams, translate them into technical briefs, oversee implementation and bring completed work back for validation. All contractor questions, feedback and delivery coordination will flow through you, without requiring direct communication between contractors and other Humanoid team members. This role combines substantial engineering work with technical leadership and delivery ownership. What You'll Do Own platform delivery: Understand the existing platform architecture, identify the changes needed for Humanoid’s environment and workflows, and take those changes through development, integration, testing and deployment. Lead external contractors: Define work packages, priorities, technical requirements and acceptance criteria. Review designs and code, resolve technical questions, track delivery and ensure completed work meets Humanoid’s standards. Connect internal needs to implementation: Work with Humanoid’s engineering teams to understand requirements and constraints. Maintain a clear backlog, communicate tradeoffs and progress, and raise risks or decisions early. Build and operate cloud infrastructure: Manage compute, storage, networking and environments through infrastructure as code, with attention to security, reliability, performance and cost. Develop across the stack: Implement and maintain backend services, APIs, integrations and frontend interfaces that support internal users and engineering workflows. Improve the engineering platform: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, deployment processes, environment configuration and developer tooling. Own data workflows: Develop and maintain data ingestion, processing, storage and access pipelines. Address data quality, schema changes, failed jobs and recovery. Maintain production reliability: Establish monitoring, logging and alerting; investigate incidents; and maintain practical rollback, backup and recovery procedures. Control access and preserve knowledge: Manage contractor permissions and secrets appropriately. Ensure source code, infrastructure definitions, documentation and operational knowledge remain accessible to Humanoid. Verify and hand over completed work. Validate contractor deliverables against agreed acceptance criteria and ensure releases include the documentation and support needed for ongoing operation. What We're Looking For Experience building, deploying and operating production software on a major cloud platform. Strong practical knowledge of infrastructure as code, containers, Linux, networking, identity and access management, and CI/CD. Solid software engineering skills, including backend services, APIs, databases and the ability to work across frontend and backend code. Experience with data pipelines, object storage, relational databases and reliable processing of large datasets. Evidence of taking ownership of an existing platform: understanding unfamiliar code, diagnosing problems and delivering improvements safely. Experience leading external developers or contractors, including scoping work, reviewing implementation and holding delivery to clear quality standards. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn incomplete requirements into actionable technical work. Sound judgment about what to build directly, what to delegate and when to involve internal engineering specialists. Experience with robotics, machine learning infrastructure, sensor data or internal data platforms would be valuable. We welcome engineers with particular depth in infrastructure or platform engineering who can demonstrate effective delivery across the wider software stack. What success looks like? The data platform is deployed reliably within Humanoid and develops in line with internal engineering needs. Contractor work arrives tested, documented and ready to integrate. Internal teams have clear visibility into progress and decisions, while you own the technical context, coordination and follow-through needed to deliver. items.desc: GRADUATE SCHEME 2027 We are looking for graduates to join our 2027 Data & Analytics Practice Graduate Scheme starting in January 2027 and build a career helping organisations turn data into meaningful insight. You will learn how to develop data solutions that support better decisions, improve services and address real business challenges. Our Graduate Consultant Scheme offers training, certifications and mentoring along with a variety of stimulating project work that will provide opportunities to learn, add new skills and work with our experienced team and high-profile clients on projects that make a difference. Working alongside experienced consultants, you will develop skills in data engineering, data analytics and business intelligence, with a focus on Azure, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric. We offer flexible home working for our team, with Graduates expected to work collaboratively and join their mentors and colleagues for team working sessions in our Shalford office near Guildford. Guildford is a vibrant university city with excellent shopping, close to the North Downs countryside and with fast transport links to London. You do not need previous professional experience with these platforms. We are looking for curiosity, analytical thinking and a willingness to learn. With guidance from your colleagues, you will progressively contribute to customer projects and deliver real-world solutions. This position provides a great opportunity for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit who wants to help shape the future direction of Ceox. NICE TO HAVE A university module in programming or similar personal experience, particularly Python or SQL Experience analysing data through coursework, research or personal projects. An interest in data engineering, analytics, AI or machine learning. LOCATION Remote Working combined with contact and training days at our Shalford office, GU4 8EP. DURATION Permanent - Our scheme is the start of a fulltime role at Ceox. BENEFITS Salary of £30,000 rising to £33,000 at the end of probation Profit Share Full training scheme REQUIREMENTS You will have or be expecting a 1st or 2i degree from a good university in one of the following subject areas: Science, Technology, Engineering, Maths, Business or Economics from a top university. We're looking for people who enjoy providing a service and can communicate clearly to customers and other team members.

Нашата цел е да бъдем банката за бъдещето на Европа и търсим хора, които имат желание да поемат с нас в тази посока. Ключово за отношенията и процесите, които градим, е те да са най-добър пример в прилагането на принципите за многообразие и равнопоставеност и в утвърждаването на приобщаваща среда за всички.
 Бизнесът ни създава инвестиции, ресурси и нови възможности, които стимулират развитието на нашите служители, като им предоставят уникално и динамично професионално преживяване. Ще се радваме да допълните екипа ни с вашите таланти и силни страни и да изградите кариера, в която ще бъдете възнаградени подобаващо за постиженията ви.
 Ние ще ти дадем възможност да
 ● Работиш с бизнес клиенти от собствен портфейл;
 ● Осъществяваш контакти с оглед тяхното задържане, консултиране и търсене на решения при казуси;
 ● Използваш пълната гама от банкови продукти за бизнес клиенти, предлагани от Банката, включително и в областта на кредитирането;
 ● Правиш предложения за повишаване на качеството на обслужване и ще съдействаш при възникнали запитвания, постъпващи от клиенти;
 ● Търсиш и привличаш нови клиенти в сегмента.
 В теб търсим
 ● Завършено висше икономическо или друго подходящо образование, магистърска степен или в ход на обучение;
 ● Познания по счетоводство и финанси, както и опит в сходна област ще се считат за предимство;
 ● Търговски умения, ориентираност към клиента;
 ● Предприемчивост, аналитичност, умения за работа в екип, инициативност.
 ● Компютърни умения - Microsoft Officе пакет;
 ● Ползване на английски език (счита се за предимство).
 При нас ще откриеш
 ● Коледен бонус;
 ● Стартово възнаграждение от минимум 1580 евро БРЗ;
 ● Бонуси за постигнати резултати;
 ● Ваучери за храна в размер на 102.26 евро;
 ● 25 дни отпуск;
 ● Платен почивен ден и подарък за рожден ден;
 ● Платен почивен ден за доброволчество;
 ● Програма „Препоръчай приятел“;
 ● Кредити при преференциални условия;
 ● Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
 ● MultiSport карти и обновени фитнес зали в централата ни;

 Да, точно това ще откриеш при нас!
 Нашият екип знае колко е ценно да получиш подкрепа при старта на кариерата, затова ние даваме възможност на младите хора да приложат на практика познанията си и да направят първите си професионални стъпки.
 Стажантската ни програма създава възможности пред студентите и наскоро завършилите специалисти, като ги запознава с основните дейности в банкирането и съчетава обучението с реални работни предизвикателства в екипа на водеща финансова институция.
 Ние ще ти дадем възможност да
 ● Участваш в подготовката и координацията на рекламни кампании, BTL активности, събития и промоционални инициативи на Банката; 
 ● Съдействаш при разработването и актуализацията на рекламни и информационни материали (брошури, плакати, флаери, дигитално съдържание и др.) в съответствие с корпоративните ни стандарти; 
 ● Оказваш административна и организационна подкрепа при комуникацията с вътрешни екипи, агенции и външни доставчици; 
 ● Участваш в процесите по брандиране на клоновата мрежа, поддръжка на рекламни елементи и проследяване на тяхното правилно позициониране; 
 ● Подпомагаш екипа при организацията на продуктови събития, изложения и маркетингови инициативи, както и при проследяване на изпълнението на текущи проекти. 
 В теб търсим
 ● Да си в процес на обучение на висше образование в сферата на Маркетинг, Реклама, Връзки с обществеността, Бизнес администрация или друга близка специалност; 
 ● Да проявяваш интерес към маркетинга, рекламата и брандинга; 
 ● Да умееш да работиш с MS Office и да се справяш добре с подготовката и обработката на информация; 
 ● Да демонстрираш инициативност, организираност и внимание към детайла; 
 ● Желание да съчетаваш теоретичното си обучение с реалните предизвикателства, които поднася работата; 
● Да притежаваш отлични комуникационни умения и желание да се развиваш в динамична корпоративна среда.
 При нас ще откриеш

 In Deinem 12-monatigen rotationsbasierten Traineeprogramm lernst Du das Unternehmen ganzheitlich kennen. Du arbeitest in einem zukunftsorientierten und internationalen Umfeld, in dem Du lernen, Dich entfalten und gleichzeitig mit Deinen Ideen etwas bewirken kannst - getreu unserem gemeinsamen Ziel "Empowering Communities to Progress".

 Du befindest Dich in den letzten Zügen Deines Bachelor- oder Masterstudiums in Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, bzw. hast Dein Studium innerhalb der letzten 2 Jahre absolviert

 If you really want to make a difference – make it with us 
 Siemens Mobility is a separately managed company of Siemens AG and has been a leading supplier in the field of mobility for over 160 years. Our core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems and related services. We have always been very innovative in making traveling faster, safer and more comfortable. Today, we need new solutions to new challenges such as climate change and rising populations worldwide. That's what drives us. That's why we shape mobility with passion, always being one step ahead. Through digitalization, we make infrastructures smart and create opportunities that get us from A to B sustainably and seamlessly. Our over 40,000 employees are pioneers in mobility who help to keep the world moving.
 What do you contribute? 
 You will be responsible for the setup, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of customized embedded Linux distributions for automated and driverless train operation (Automatic Train Operation), with a particular focus on kernel options, driver integration, and partitioning.
 Building on this, you optimize and manage modern build automation environments using BitBake, Buildroot, CMake, and Make, thereby facilitating efficient development workflows.
 Furthermore, you develop, adapt, and maintain drivers and interfaces for industrial bus systems such as TRDP, MVB, and ProfiNet to enable seamless hardware integration.
 Additionally, you configure network namespaces and services (including PAM, lighttpd, NginX) and ensure secure, encrypted communication via OpenSSL and certificate management.
 To round off your responsibilities, you support application teams with OS-level interfaces, maintain Git/GitLab repositories, oversee base applications and compilers, and validate your results through system testing and vulnerability management.
 What do you bring along? 
 You have a university degree with extensive relevant professional experience in the field or a completed vocational training with further qualification as a technician and extensive relevant professional experience.
 You have in-depth experience in the embedded Linux environment, including configuration, maintenance, partitioning of distributions, and integration of kernels and drivers.
 You are proficient in network programming, configuration of network services (PAM, lighttpd, NginX), and have a solid understanding of secure communication (OpenSSL, certificates).
 You possess practical knowledge in bus systems, driver adaptation, protocol integration (TRDP, MVB, ProfiNet), and are skilled in build tools such as BitBake, Buildroot, CMake, Make, and Debian package management.
 You demonstrate a structured, solution-oriented, and team-focused working style with a high willingness to learn.
 You have very good command of German, both written and spoken, and good English skills.

items.desc: Job Description The Enterprise Machine Learning team builds intelligent systems that help the business make better decisions at scale. We combine machine learning, data engineering, and modern AI techniques to transform complex customer and revenue data into products and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. As part of the Enterprise Data & Analytics organization, we work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to build production-ready ML solutions that continuously improve as new data becomes available. Role Overview As a Machine Learning Engineer , you'll build, deploy, and continuously improve machine learning systems that power this intelligence layer. You'll own the complete lifecycle—from understanding the business problem and developing models to deploying them into production, monitoring performance, and iterating based on real-world results. You'll work alongside AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Analytics professionals, building scalable ML solutions that become part of our core platform. What You'll Do Design, build, and deploy machine learning models that predict key business outcomes such as churn, expansion, conversion, and customer engagement. Develop and maintain scalable ML pipelines that continuously ingest data, retrain models, validate performance, and serve predictions in production. Work with large-scale structured and unstructured data, applying modern ML and LLM techniques where they deliver measurable business value. Monitor production models, improve performance over time, and ensure reliability through testing, validation, and continuous iteration. Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to deliver ML solutions that solve real customer and business problems. Own machine learning solutions end-to-end—from problem definition and experimentation to production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization. This Role Is For You If You enjoy building machine learning systems that solve real business problems—not just achieving better benchmark metrics. You've worked with imperfect, real-world datasets and understand challenges like noisy labels, feature leakage, class imbalance, and concept drift. You write clean, production-quality Python with testing, modular design, and maintainable code. You think beyond model performance and care about the impact your work has on users and business outcomes. You're comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial idea through production deployment and ongoing maintenance. You use data to guide decisions and proactively identify opportunities for new ML applications. What We're Looking For 3–5 years of professional experience in Machine Learning Engineering, Applied Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline. Master's or PhD is a plus, but not required. Technical Skills Strong understanding of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques, including regression, classification, survival analysis, causal inference, uplift modeling, or related methods. Experience developing models on large-scale, real-world datasets, including feature engineering, model validation, and handling imperfect data. Experience working with unstructured data using embeddings, fine-tuning, vector representations, or other modern NLP techniques. Strong Python programming skills with experience building production-ready software. Solid SQL skills and experience working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred). Experience deploying, serving, and monitoring machine learning models in production environments. Familiarity with experiment design, A/B testing, or causal inference is a plus. Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, or similar platforms is a plus. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar. The Poland annualized base salary range for this position is €98,000.00-€146,000.00. Please note that while the salary range represents the minimum and maximum base salary rate for this position, the actual compensation offered will be based on job related capabilities, applicable experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, or related incentives that will be communicated during the offer stage. items.desc: Join us on our mission to develop the world’s most sustainable battery chemistry . We’re a growing startup developing organic electrolytes for flow batteries, and we’re looking for a Flow Battery Expert to help us shape the future of our battery technology. This is a key role for someone who enjoys the intersection of chemistry, electrochemistry and engineering. We're seeking a experienced scientist with deep expertise in organic flow batteries . You’ll be joining a tight-knit team focused on progress and real-world deployment. About Rivus Rivus Batteries is a Swedish startup developing aqueous organic flow battery electrolytes to deliver stationary energy storage at lower cost and climate footprint than today’s battery systems. Our electrolytes are based on widely available elements – we believe this is crucial for sustainably covering the growing global demand for energy storage capacity. Following years of academic research, we’re now in our fourth year of commercialisation – with R&D and scaling up at the heart of everything we do. We are currently working on optimising our electrolyte formulation, installing customer pilot installations and moving towards commercialization. We are a mission-driven tech startup, committed to holistic care for the environment and corporate responsibility on all levels. About the job We are looking for a Flow Battery Expert to support us in the next phase as a Research Scientist: from lab and stack tests to commercial scale. As part of our R&D team, you will lead the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments aimed at advancing our aqueous organic flow battery technology. You will take ownership of electrolyte optimisation, using your deep know how to identify promising research directions, design rigorous experimental campaigns, analyse complex datasets, and translate findings into practical improvements in battery performance. Working closely with our CEO, Head of R&D, and the technical team, you will play a key role in shaping our R&D strategy. Your scientific insight will be instrumental during technical discussions and weekly results meetings, where you will help define priorities, challenge assumptions, and guide decision-making. We are looking for someone who thrives in an independent research environment, takes initiative, and can lead projects from concept to conclusion with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively across disciplines. About you We’re looking for someone with an extensive background in the field of flow batteries. Requirements: PhD in chemistry, electrochemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a closely related field. Strict requirement: Research and/or industrial experience in aqueous organic flow batteries. Candidates with substantial experience in other flow battery technologies (e.g. vanadium, iron, zinc-based, or hybrid systems) may also be considered. Strong background in electrochemistry, organic chemistry, and physical chemistry. Demonstrated experience designing, planning, and leading independent research projects. Experience developing and optimising flow battery electrolytes and/or flow battery systems. Experience with analytical and electrochemical techniques (e.g. UV-vis, LC-MS, NMR, EIS, CV). Strong skills in data analysis and using scientific programming tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, etc). Ability to present results clearly, challenge ideas, and lead technical decision-making. Ability to lead and deliver complex technical projects with partners and suppliers. Strong analytical skills and a collaborative, self-driven attitude. Your role will involve: Scientific leadership in the development of Rivus' aqueous organic flow battery technology. Leading projects focused on the optimisation of Rivus' organic flow battery electrolytes. Designing, leading, and analysing experimental campaigns to improve electrolyte lifetime, energy density, efficiency, and overall battery performance, and translating the findings into new development directions and practical improvements. Analysing, processing, and communicating experimental data, including automation through programming scripts and AI tools. Guiding the development of new laboratory methodologies and experimental infrastructure. Mentoring junior colleagues and providing guidance across multidisciplinary projects. Planning and coordination of external R&D collaborations, including interactions with academic partners, consultants, suppliers, and contract research organisations. Organisation and active engagement in the work of Rivus' lab. What we offer: Competitive salary with performance-based stock options with vesting 6 weeks paid vacation + 5 bridge days annually A high-impact role in a climate and energy resilience critical technology Daily collaboration with experienced chemists, engineers and entrepreneurs A warm and inclusive team culture grounded in purpose and pragmatism Hands-on experience in a fast-growing deep tech and chemistry startup Location: …

items.desc: Applied AI / ML Engineer – Warsaw Location: Warsaw, Poland Work model: Hybrid (3 days in the office) B2B Contract secured until 31 March 2027 , with an intention to extend for up to 4 years in total . Experience: 5+ years We are looking for an experienced Applied AI / ML Engineer to join a high-performing technology team building production-grade AI and machine learning solutions for complex business and quantitative workflows. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in machine learning, MLOps and quantitative applications. You will work closely with experienced engineers, researchers and business stakeholders to turn AI/ML concepts into scalable, reliable systems used in real-world production environments. What you will do Design, develop and deploy production-grade machine learning and AI solutions addressing complex business and quantitative problems. Collaborate with engineers, researchers and domain experts to advance production ML systems and applications . Research, prototype, experiment with and evaluate new AI/ML approaches and technologies . Build robust data and machine learning pipelines, from data preparation and feature engineering through to model deployment and monitoring. Develop, test and maintain high-quality, scalable and production-ready software . Apply MLOps practices including model versioning, monitoring, deployment and lifecycle management . Work extensively with AWS technologies , including services such as SageMaker, Lambda and S3. Contribute to and create reusable libraries, frameworks and engineering standards that enable reliable and testable ML systems. Take technical ownership of projects and demonstrate leadership across teams. Represent the organisation at technology and AI/ML conferences, industry events and open-source communities . What we are looking for 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning, AI, quantitative technology or a closely related field. Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related discipline — or equivalent industry experience. Strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production , preferably within AWS environments. Strong programming skills in Python and experience with another modern language such as C++ or Java . Solid understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation and ML lifecycle management . Practical experience with MLOps , including model monitoring, versioning, deployment and reproducibility. Hands-on experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, Lambda and S3 . Experience developing software for quantitative investment, trading, financial modelling or other data-intensive workflows is highly desirable. Experience working with equities, fixed income, multi-asset strategies or other quantitative investment domains is a strong advantage. Strong software engineering mindset, with an emphasis on code quality, testing, scalability and maintainability . Ability to take ownership of technically complex projects and work effectively across teams. Why this role? This is an opportunity to work on high-impact AI and machine learning problems where research meets production engineering. You will have the opportunity to influence how AI/ML systems are designed, developed and deployed, while working in an environment that values technical excellence, experimentation, collaboration and measurable business impact. If you are an experienced ML Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied Scientist, MLOps Engineer, Quantitative Developer or Software Engineer with strong ML experience, we would be interested in speaking with you.

items.desc: VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS Vous rêvez de transformer l'IA en avantage concurrentiel réel ? De concevoir des solutions GenAI qui impactent véritablement le business ? Rejoignez notre équipe d'experts en IA et devenez acteur de la transformation numérique d'AXA. Nous recherchons un AI Engineer Expert capable de designer, déployer et optimiser des solutions d'intelligence artificielle de pointe qui créent de la valeur mesurable pour l'ensemble du groupe. VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS En tant que AI Engineer Expert , votre objectif principal est de concevoir, construire, déployer et améliorer continuellement des solutions d'IA et GenAI prêtes pour la production, alignées avec les priorités stratégiques du Groupe AXA. À la pointe des technologies GenAI et d'IA agent, vous transformerez l'innovation en valeur métier concrète au sein des différentes entités d'AXA. Il s'agit d'une opportunité à forte visibilité pour contribuer à la transformation IA d'AXA via des initiatives stratégiques et critiques pour le business. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le Groupe AXA et ses entités métier, en apportant une expertise technique solide sur des sujets clés tels que l'évaluation de solutions GenAI, l'optimisation de la consommation d'IA et la gouvernance des coûts, tout en contribuant à des capacités d'IA scalables, fiables, sécurisées et mesurables. Vos responsabilités principales : Collaborer étroitement avec les entités AXA et les métiers pour comprendre leurs besoins, clarifier les exigences et co-concevoir des solutions IA adoptées et utiles dans des contextes opérationnels réels ; Concevoir, développer, déployer et opérer des solutions d'IA et GenAI générant une valeur mesurable pour les entités d'AXA ; Contribuer à l'évolution des pratiques d'ingénierie IA partagées, incluant l'évaluation, l'observabilité, la performance, l'efficacité des coûts, la sécurité et la gouvernance du cycle de vie ; Piloter des sujets stratégiques tels que l'évaluation d'applications GenAI et l'optimisation de la consommation d'IA, tout en restant flexible pour prendre en charge de nouvelles priorités d'ingénierie IA ; Collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (data scientists, data engineers, Product Owners, équipes plateforme, parties prenantes métier) pour identifier des opportunités et les transformer en solutions techniques robustes ; Appliquer et enrichir les patterns d'ingénierie réutilisables, standards et garde-fous garantissant des systèmes IA scalables, fiables, sécurisés et responsables à l'échelle de l'organisation ; Contribuer à la communauté d'ingénierie IA interne en partageant les pratiques, documentant les apprentissages et soutenant l'amélioration collective entre équipes. VOTRE PROFIL Expérience requise 3+ années de livraison de produits activés par l'IA/ML, d'applications GenAI ou de systèmes agent en environnement de production, couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de vie (conception, implémentation, monitoring, amélioration continue) ; Expérience avérée dans la contribution à des pratiques d'évaluation, d'observabilité, de fiabilité ou d'optimisation pour des applications GenAI (RAG, assistants conversationnels, automatisation de workflows, systèmes agent) ; Compréhension solide des drivers opérationnels de l'IA : qualité, latence, coûts, usage, sécurité, respect de la vie privée et valeur métier, avec capacité à les équilibrer de manière pragmatique ; Expérience de contribution à la livraison technique dans des équipes pluridisciplinaires, avec aptitude à prendre en charge des lots de travail et collaborer efficacement avec les pairs ; Expérience dans le secteur de l'assurance, des services financiers ou d'une autre industrie régulée (un plus). Compétences techniques Fondamentaux solides en ingénierie logicielle pour des systèmes IA prêts pour la production : Python ou langages similaires, APIs, patterns d'intégration, monitoring et automation ; Maîtrise des patterns d'applications GenAI : RAG, assistants conversationnels, automatisation de workflows, systèmes agent ou utilisant des outils ; Capacité à définir et opérer des approches d'évaluation pour systèmes GenAI, couvrant les critères de qualité, tests de régression, feedback humain, mesure de performance, fiabilité et contrôles de risque ; Compréhension des drivers de consommation et coûts IA : sélection de modèles, gestion du contexte, conception de prompts, caching, routage, orchestration, choix d'infrastructure et gouvernance d'usage ; Expérience en observabilité et monitoring opérationnel pour applications IA : tracing, latence, fiabilité, usage, efficacité des coûts et indicateurs d'amélioration continue ; Capacité à établir des garde-fous pragmatiques pour une ingénierie IA responsable, équilibrant performance, coûts, sécurité, sûreté, respect de la vie privée, durabilité et conformité réglementaire. Compétences comportementales et transversales Collaboration : aptitude à travailler efficacement avec des ingénieurs, data scientists, équipes …

items.desc: Drive the transformation of FAMAR’s business and industrial processes by combining Lean methodologies, data engineering, artificial intelligence and automation. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you will work directly with operational teams to identify inefficiencies, redesign workflows and develop practical AI-powered solutions through to production deployment. You’ll connect fragmented systems and build reliable, secure and reusable data integrations that make enterprise data accessible. Using generative AI, intelligent agents, document intelligence and workflow automation, you’ll simplify complex processes, eliminate repetitive tasks and help teams work more effectively. What you’ll do: Work alongside business and manufacturing teams to identify bottlenecks and simplify processes using Lean principles. Build and deploy AI applications, intelligent agents, RAG solutions and automated workflows that solve practical operational challenges. Connect enterprise systems through reliable data pipelines, APIs and reusable integrations, improving data quality and accessibility. Develop document automation solutions supporting activities such as customer quotations, quality reviews and reporting. Take solutions from prototype to production using Microsoft Azure and sound engineering practices, including testing, monitoring and appropriate human oversight. Partner with IT and Quality to ensure security, data integrity and regulatory compliance where applicable. Train users, drive adoption and work with IT to establish ongoing support and maintenance. Measure results through time saved, shorter lead times, improved quality and validated savings, scaling successful solutions across FAMAR. What makes you a great fit Min. 3 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI development or intelligent process automation. Proven ability to map, analyse, challenge and simplify end-to-end processes together with business teams. Strong collaboration skills, with a track record of delivering results jointly with operational, IT and Quality teams. Strong hands-on engineering capabilities, including application development, data pipelines, APIs, automated workflows and production deployment. Experience integrating diverse enterprise systems, data sources and AI solutions into business processes. Practical experience with LLM applications, intelligent agents, RAG architectures or workflow automation. Experience with cloud technologies and data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure. Ability to translate business requirements and operational challenges into practical technical solutions. Experience with ERP, QMS, CRM or other enterprise systems would be advantageous; MES or LIMS experience would be a plus for future initiatives. Knowledge of GxP, Computerized System Validation and data integrity principles would be an asset. Why join FAMAR? Bring your engineering skills to a European pharmaceutical manufacturing and development group with more than 75 years of expertise and products supplied to 80 international markets. See your work in action. Build solutions alongside the people who use them, with visible results in manufacturing, quality and everyday business operations. Make an impact across borders. Develop solutions that can be adopted across FAMAR’s European sites and corporate functions. Expand your expertise. Receive dedicated Lean training and deepen your experience at the intersection of AI, data engineering and pharmaceutical operations. Own the journey. Take projects from understanding the problem to deploying the solution and measuring the improvement. We’d love to hear your story - what you’ve built, what you’ve learned and what you’d like to do next. Apply and let’s connect!

items.desc: Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia ! Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail . Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès ! Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y ! Rigoureux(se) , vous ne laissez rien au hasard, Efficace , vous ne remettez pas à demain ce qui peut être fait dès aujourd’hui, Autonome , vous savez mener vos missions à bien sans aide. Dans le cadre de l'accompagnement de nos clients sur leurs enjeux Data & IA, vous serez amené(e) à être la personne clé faisant le lien entre la conception des modèles et leur intégration système. Vous interviendrez sur des projets ambitieux impliquant de : Industrialiser les modèles : Assurer la mise en production à grande échelle des modèles de Machine Learning développés par les équipes de Data Scientists. Automatiser les pipelines : Concevoir et maintenir des pipelines MLOps robustes (CI/CD) pour fluidifier et automatiser l'entraînement, la validation et le déploiement des modèles. Superviser et optimiser : Assurer le suivi des performances des modèles une fois en production, détecter les dérives (data drift) et optimiser la consommation des ressources. Prendre le lead technique : Accompagner les équipes en place et prendre progressivement le lead sur le périmètre MLOps pour transformer les idées en solutions concrètes et robustes. Collaborer en transverse : Travailler en étroite synergie avec les Data Scientists et Data Engineers pour garantir la "production-readiness" des modèles face aux besoins métiers. Profil recherché Une expérience significative (minimum 5 ans) en tant qu'Ingénieur MLOps, ou un profil Data Engineer / Data Scientist possédant une très forte appétence croisée pour ces deux domaines. Une maîtrise éprouvée des environnements Cloud (idéalement GCP) et d'une plateforme de traitement de données majeure, principalement Databricks et l'écosystème Spark. Un solide bagage en programmation (Python en priorité, SQL, Scala) associé à une très bonne connaissance des librairies de Machine Learning. Une expertise sur l'orchestration de workflows (Airflow), la gestion du cycle de vie des modèles (MLFlow), la conteneurisation (Docker) et les pratiques de delivery (Git, GitHub, Jinja). Processus de recrutement Échangez avec un ou une chargée de recrutement pour un premier contact téléphonique Rencontrez un ou une Ingénieure d’Affaires (Business Manager) sur vos souhaits d’évolution Approfondissez avec nos responsables et directeurs d’agence pour connaître la vision de l'agence Selon votre profil, des tests ou entretiens techniques pourront vous être demandés. Tout au long du processus, vous pourrez échanger avec nos consultants pour en savoir + sur leur quotidien chez nous ! 3 jours de présentiel minimum requis. Les petits plus 🏠 Télétravail possible (hybride) 👛 100% des frais de transports en communs pris en charge, des tickets restaurant et une mutuelle haut de gamme ❤️‍🩹Une politique inclusive et une référente handicap à disposition pour vous accompagner #greatplacetobe 🎁 Un CSE avantageux et des challenges tout au long de l'année ! #greatplacetolive 📈 Des primes à hauteur des performances de l'année et de l'implication 🎉 250 événements par an pour rencontrer tes collègues et des locaux feel good 📢 Des formations, conférences et une plateforme d'e-learning avec LinkedIn pour monter en compétences #greatplacetolearn 👩‍ Des Communautés Métiers et du Mentorat pour partager son expertise et en apprendre sur de nombreux sujets #greatplacetoshare 🕹️ Une communauté de e-sport : Extia Gaming ! #greatplacetoplay 🌏 Envie d’évoluer ? Grâce à notre politique de mobilité interne, explorez de nouvelles opportunités en France ou dans l’un de nos 7 autres pays !

items.desc: AI Engineer (Manager) Senior AI engineering leadership role at one of the UK’s leading AI and Data businesses Production ML and GenAI delivery for major healthcare and public sector clients UK wide, client site up to 3 days per week Salary £90,000 to £120,000 SC clearance required About the Company Our client is a leading digital technology consultancy recognised as one of the UK’s foremost AI and data businesses, with a decade-long track record of delivering production-grade AI solutions across government, healthcare, defence and commercial sectors. Their 150-strong AI and Data Practice is trusted by Microsoft, AWS and others to deliver advanced solutions at citizen scale, and they are pioneers in responsible AI, having authored the UK government’s AI Cyber Security Code of Practice implementation guide. The Role This is an engineering role, not a data science role. You will deploy and serve ML models in production at significant scale, act as the most senior technical person on complex client projects and lead multi-disciplinary engineering teams across the full solution. Alongside delivery, you will bring genuine consulting capability, managing senior client relationships, contributing to bids and tenders and spotting commercial opportunities. Healthcare is a major growth area and early work may involve pipeline building before moving into full delivery. This role suits a technically exceptional, client-facing AI engineer who is as comfortable leading a project as they are reviewing an architecture. Key Responsibilities Lead the deployment and serving of AI and ML models in production at significant scale Act as technical lead across the full solution, leading software and platform engineers as well as the AI component Drive adoption of modern AI engineering approaches including RAG, agentic AI, model evaluation and drift detection Engage with senior and C-level client stakeholders on architecture, delivery management and commercial opportunities Contribute to bids, tenders and pre-sales activity as a credible technical voice Ensure responsible AI principles and engineering best practices are embedded throughout delivery Manage, coach and develop a team of engineers, setting standards and fostering a culture of excellence What You’ll Need Essential: Proven track record deploying and serving AI and ML models in production at significant scale Traditional ML experience across classic ML, computer vision, reinforcement learning and MLOps, as well as GenAI including LLMs, RAG and agentic AI, with experience predating the GenAI era Technical leadership across a full solution, leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams Strong client-facing consulting ability including senior stakeholder management, delivery management and commercial awareness Strong Python and engineering practice including CI/CD, testing and code reviews Experience with Azure and/or AWS, Docker and Kubernetes Experience managing, coaching and developing engineers SC clearable: UK national with five years UK residency Desirable: Healthcare or public sector delivery background Consultancy experience Existing SC clearance Experience with LLM fine-tuning or distillation, vector databases and semantic search Familiarity with ISO 42001 or AI compliance frameworks Experience shaping AI offerings and supporting pre-sales Why Apply? Salary of £90,000 to £120,000 Work at the cutting edge of AI delivery on some of the UK’s most significant public sector programmes Join a 150-strong AI and Data Practice with a dedicated talent development lead and strong upskilling investment Healthcare is one of the biggest growth areas in the practice, with further roles across other sectors in the pipeline Two stage interview process with no technical test Client site travel expenses covered in full Interested? For a confidential conversation about this opportunity, connect with Justin Donaldson on LinkedIn or submit your CV via the link below.

items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🤖 Ops AI Platform team 🔀 We're building something that doesn't exist yet. Imagine a platform where AI agents autonomously handle operational work - connected to every internal and external tool, trained by operators themselves, running safely at scale. No engineers needed. No bottlenecks. Just agents that work. That's what we're building. The Ops AI Platform will let our Ops team create, evolve, and monitor their own AI agents to automate thousands of tedious tasks. We aim to crack problems no one has solved at this scale. The project just launched . You'd join at ground zero - shaping the architecture, the product, the entire foundation. If building the future of work from scratch excites you, this is it. ⭐ Our north star We’re building ops agents that work reliably and safely, without putting the engineering team on the critical path. Skills You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering and ML engineering. Our mission is to create the platform that enables building accurate and reliable AI agents, delivering an outstanding experience to our internal Ops team for the creation, iteration and monitoring of their agents, without requiring hard technical skills. Things we’re working on: 💬 Integrate agents at the heart of internal tools - UIs where Ops monitor and take action on concrete business situations. We want AI agents to become first-class citizens in this ecosystem, with context-aware chat modals, allowing users to review agents' reasoning, actions, and provide follow-up instructions - with instant impact on business data. 👥 Empower non-technical users to become autonomous in the creation and maintenance of agents to automate operational tasks at scale: prompting, tools configuration, testing, datasets, replayability, evaluations 🔧 Build a complete set of tools made available to AI agents , connecting to internal and external capabilities: internal business data, external servers, external web dashboards without API, etc. 💯 Safety and accuracy at the core: robust testing, stateful evaluation, progressive rollout, human-in-the-loop to validate sensitive actions, fine-grained permissions and limits In 6 to 12 months, we plan to increase our scope by owning the AI platform that will power all agentic use cases at Alan - creating economies of scale thanks to common infrastructure and tooling. If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of work, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. 🎯 Is it you we’re looking for? We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in operations. You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, tool calling, human-in-the-loop, internal tools UX, multi-agent architectures, and see your work deployed in production, used by our ops team You’ll implement new capabilities for AI agents, as well as tooling to make ops autonomous on the creation, evolution, monitoring and evaluation of their agents You’ll work on making our system scale, going from a few dozen to tens of thousands of tasks automated daily You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring). You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you: Strong background in full-stack software engineering, systems architecture, with a spike in back-end engineering. Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful Self-directed and pragmatic Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!) Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching Fluent in English (no need to speak French!) But …

items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🤖 Ops AI Platform team 🔀 We're building something that doesn't exist yet. Imagine a platform where AI agents autonomously handle operational work - connected to every internal and external tool, trained by operators themselves, running safely at scale. No engineers needed. No bottlenecks. Just agents that work. That's what we're building. The Ops AI Platform will let our Ops team create, evolve, and monitor their own AI agents to automate thousands of tedious tasks. We aim to crack problems no one has solved at this scale. The project just launched . You'd join at ground zero - shaping the architecture, the product, the entire foundation. If building the future of work from scratch excites you, this is it. ⭐ Our north star We’re building ops agents that work reliably and safely, without putting the engineering team on the critical path. Skills You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering and ML engineering. Our mission is to create the platform that enables building accurate and reliable AI agents, delivering an outstanding experience to our internal Ops team for the creation, iteration and monitoring of their agents, without requiring hard technical skills. Things we’re working on: 💬 Integrate agents at the heart of internal tools - UIs where Ops monitor and take action on concrete business situations. We want AI agents to become first-class citizens in this ecosystem, with context-aware chat modals, allowing users to review agents' reasoning, actions, and provide follow-up instructions - with instant impact on business data. 👥 Empower non-technical users to become autonomous in the creation and maintenance of agents to automate operational tasks at scale: prompting, tools configuration, testing, datasets, replayability, evaluations 🔧 Build a complete set of tools made available to AI agents , connecting to internal and external capabilities: internal business data, external servers, external web dashboards without API, etc. 💯 Safety and accuracy at the core: robust testing, stateful evaluation, progressive rollout, human-in-the-loop to validate sensitive actions, fine-grained permissions and limits In 6 to 12 months, we plan to increase our scope by owning the AI platform that will power all agentic use cases at Alan - creating economies of scale thanks to common infrastructure and tooling. If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of work, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. 🎯 Is it you we’re looking for? We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in operations. You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, tool calling, human-in-the-loop, internal tools UX, multi-agent architectures, and see your work deployed in production, used by our ops team You’ll implement new capabilities for AI agents, as well as tooling to make ops autonomous on the creation, evolution, monitoring and evaluation of their agents You’ll work on making our system scale, going from a few dozen to tens of thousands of tasks automated daily You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring). You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you: Strong background in full-stack software engineering, systems architecture, with a spike in back-end engineering. Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful Self-directed and pragmatic Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!) Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching Fluent in English (no need to speak French!) But …

items.desc: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An Overview Of This Role As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer. Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy. What You'll Do Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant. Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry. Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations. Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI. Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback. Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering. Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency. Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic. What You'll Bring Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models. Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses. Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility. Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus. Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications. Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team. Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields. About The Team The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability. Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features. How …
