 Territorio di riferimento: Piemonte, Liguria e Valle D'Aosta 
 Informazioni sulla posizione 
 Sanofi è un'azienda della salute, innovativa e globale, guidata da una ragion d'essere: sfidare i confini della scienza per migliorare la vita delle persone.
 La Franchise Rare Diseases rappresenta uno degli ambiti più strategici e distintivi di Sanofi, in cui l'impegno verso i pazienti con bisogni terapeutici non soddisfatti si traduce in ricerca scientifica avanzata, innovazione terapeutica e presenza capillare sul territorio. All'interno di questa realtà, l'area Rare Hematology è focalizzata sulla Mastocitosi, una patologia rara e complessa, caratterizzata da un'elevata eterogeneità clinica e da un percorso diagnostico e terapeutico ancora oggi sfidante per la comunità medica.
 In questo contesto, la linea Rare Hematology è alla ricerca di un/una Clinical Science Associate da inserire nel proprio organico, all'interno di un team ambizioso, agile e orientato all'impatto concreto per i pazienti. Un'opportunità unica per contribuire attivamente alla formazione scientifica, alla costruzione di relazioni scientifiche solide con i centri specialistici di riferimento e al miglioramento della gestione clinica di una patologia ancora poco conosciuta.
 Responsabilità principali 
 Garantire un'informazione e una comunicazione scientifica di alto livello sui prodotti e sulla patologia di competenza, rivolta agli specialisti di riferimento (ematologi, allergologi, immunologi, onco-ematologi e altri professionisti sanitari coinvolti nella gestione della Mastocitosi), nel pieno rispetto delle normative vigenti e del codice deontologico.
 Costruire e mantenere relazioni solide e durature con i principali esperti e centri specialistici del territorio, promuovendo una partnership scientifica autentica e orientata al miglioramento della gestione del paziente.
 Contribuire attivamente alla disease awareness, supportando la comunità medica nella conoscenza e nel riconoscimento della patologia, con l'obiettivo di ridurre i ritardi diagnostici e migliorare l'appropriatezza terapeutica.
 Monitorare le dinamiche del mercato locale, l'andamento della patologia nel territorio di competenza e la disponibilità dei farmaci, identificando opportunità e aree di intervento prioritarie.
 Proporre e contribuire allo sviluppo di iniziative e progetti scientifici locali, in collaborazione con i principali interlocutori clinici e con le funzioni aziendali di riferimento (Marketing, Medica, Market Access).
 Partecipare ai principali congressi, convegni e seminari dell'area terapeutica di riferimento, rappresentando Sanofi con competenza e professionalità.
 Lavorare in modo trasversale e collaborativo con i colleghi delle diverse funzioni aziendali, contribuendo a una visione integrata del territorio e affermandosi come punto di riferimento credibile per gli interlocutori interni ed esterni.
 Profilo del candidato/della candidata 
 Esperienza : Esperienza nella promozione scientifica di prodotti farmaceutici specialistici in ambiente ospedaliero; la conoscenza dell'area ematologica, onco-ematologica o delle malattie rare costituisce un requisito preferenziale.
 Competenze tecniche e “soft skill” : Spiccate capacità relazionali e comunicative, con attitudine a costruire relazioni di fiducia autentiche con gli interlocutori scientifici; orientamento al risultato, proattività e spirito imprenditoriale; agilità nell'apprendimento scientifico e capacità di aggiornarsi rapidamente in contesti terapeutici complessi e in continua evoluzione; forte attitudine alla collaborazione in team e al lavoro trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali; conoscenza delle dinamiche di mercato e dei meccanismi di accesso ospedaliero in ambito specialistico; familiarità con la lettura e l'interpretazione di dati clinici e con il contesto della ricerca clinica; approccio orientato ai dati per la pianificazione e la gestione del territorio; buona padronanza degli strumenti digitali e informatici 
 Istruzione : Richiesta la laurea in discipline scientifiche, quali Biologia, Farmacia, Chimica e Tecnologie Farmaceutiche (CTF) o Medicina e Chirurgia.
 Lingue : Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (parlata e scritta).
 Altro : e' richiesta la residenza nelle regioni di competenza
 Perche' scegliere noi? 
 Dai vita ai miracoli della scienza insieme a un team solidale e orientato al futuro.
 Scopri infinite …

items.desc:

 NXP Semiconductors enables secure connections and infrastructure for a smarter world, advancing solutions that make lives easier, better and safer. As the world leader in secure connectivity solutions for embedded applications, we are driving innovation in the secure connected vehicle, end-to-end security & privacy and smart connected solutions markets.  Your Team

 We are looking for a talented technical university student or graduate (Electrical Engineering, Informatics, Computer Science or similar) with experience or interest in embedded C/C++ software development.
 You will be participating on development of embedded drivers, complex solutions, and test applications for embedded operating systems like QNX and Green Hills Integrity. The knowledge of NXP i.MX architecture (ARM) and Linux is an advantage, and if you are proficient with distributed version control systems like Git – that´s what we need!

 Support the creation of complex software layers and demo/test applications

 For the Fleet Specialist position, you’ll have the opportunity to work across two main operational areas, with tasks allocated by the line manager based on business needs.
 In our mechanical team , you’ll focus on the maintenance and repair of our vehicles, keeping our scooters in excellent condition and providing crucial support to colleagues in the field.
 In our in‑field team , you’ll use our vans to carry out different tasks around the London area, ensuring our operations run safely, smoothly and reliably for our riders.
 Depending on daily priorities and workload, your line manager will assign you to one area or the other, giving you variety in your day‑to‑day while making sure we cover the most important operational needs.
 Here are some of the tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist: 
 Ensuring the logistics of collecting and deploying Voi scooters ⚙️
 Searching for and collecting damaged scooters 🛴
 Replacing batteries so vehicles are always ready to ride 🔋
 Performing quick on‑site repairs of scooters 🔧
 Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles 🔧
 Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired ♻️
 Assisting with the acceptance, packaging and preparation of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse 🔍
 Supporting our on‑site team as needed – for example, identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces or setting up fallen vehicles 🤝 You’ll work closely with a supportive team that shares knowledge and helps each other out.
 What you’ll need to embark 
 Mandatory requirement – You must hold a full UK driving licence for at least 12 months, with no more than 6 points and no major offences, to meet our e‑van insurance requirements. Licence checks will be conducted during the recruitment process. As part of the role, you will drive one of our company e‑vans. 
 Good knowledge of your city and feeling comfortable driving there.
 A responsible team player who can manage tasks independently and also enjoys working together with others.
 Willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues and contribute to a positive, respectful team culture.
 A practical, solution‑oriented mindset – you like getting things done and helping the team reach its goals.
 Comfortable navigating the city in a van in different weather and traffic conditions.
 Ability to stay calm and courteous in stressful situations (e.g. poor parking, traffic).
 A physical condition that allows you to safely handle and move scooters and batteries, using the equipment and support provided. 
 PLEASE NOTE: You may be required to go through a DBS Check for this role. 
 Job conditions 
 Working shifts : Sunday - Thursday 
 Working hours: 22:00 - 06:00
 Contract type: 6‑month fixed‑term contract
 Why Voi? 
 Working at Voi is more than just a job; it’s a personal Voiage where you can grow professionally and be part of a diverse team and culture committed to making a positive impact on society.
 At Voi, you’ll:
 Join Europe’s leading micromobility company and one of the fastest‑growing scale‑ups
 Make a direct impact on our success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in London
 Collaborate with inspiring, motivated and diverse colleagues who share a common goal
 Be part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are cleaner, quieter and less polluted.
 We’re committed to fair, transparent and ethical recruitment practices. All recruitment costs are covered by Voi – no recruitment fees or related costs are ever charged to workers at any stage of the hiring process. We work only with recruitment partners who share our commitment to ethical practices and regularly review our processes to protect workers’ rights and promote a safe and respectful experience for all candidates. We’re also committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We particularly welcome applications from women and other under‑represented groups in logistics, operations and technical roles.
 Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

items.desc:
Since our inception in 2015 in Denmark, Liva has been a pioneer in the field of digital behaviour change. Our ambition is to empower 1 million people by 2030 to improve their health and well-being by preventing and managing chronic conditions through digitally-powered, evidence-based lifestyle interventions.
 Headquartered in Copenhagen and London, our collaborations with healthcare systems - including the NHS, life science companies and health insurers - allow us to impact lives at scale. We recently acquired Momenta, a leading developer and provider of evidence-based, outcome driven, healthy lifestyle solutions that help people negotiate the many day-to-day challenges they face in living healthier lives, with a focus on weight management.
 About the role 
 Once people start a Liva programme, we want them to feel supported every step of the way. You'll be one of the people making that happen: answering their questions, solving their problems, and reaching out when someone has drifted away. You'll also help us work smarter, by improving our help centre and building the automations that get patients answers faster.
 What you'll be doing 
 Supporting patients, coaches and partners across phone, chat and email, so everyone gets a quick, helpful answer
 Helping patients use our app and programmes, and fixing problems when things go wrong
 Handling first-line concerns and complaints with care, and escalating when needed
 Writing and improving help centre articles, so patients can find answers themselves
 Building automations and workflows in our helpdesk to make support faster and simpler
 Spotting common issues and helping us fix them at the root
 What you'll have 
 Experience in customer or patient support across several channels
 Excellent written communication, and the ability to stay calm in difficult conversations
 Experience with a CRM or helpdesk, including building automations or workflows
 An interest in health, wellbeing or helping people change their habits
 Help centre or knowledge base writing
 Understanding of data protection and safeguarding
 What you'll get 
 Meaningful work helping people improve their health
 The chance to shape how our support service works, not just run it
 A collaborative, supportive team
 Exposure to digital health and behaviour change at scale
 At Liva, we are a purpose-driven company; we go to work every day to help people live better lives. Our purpose is in our DNA, and we are always on the lookout for talented people eager to evolve and build a life-changing career within global health tech. 
 We believe in doing business the right way. Liva is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our workforce. We're committed to developing a representative workforce at all levels, and maintaining a working environment that promotes the health and wellbeing of our employees. 
 As a signatory to the Armed Forces Covenant we welcome applications from veterans, service leavers, and military spouses. 
 Guaranteed Interview scheme - As part of our commitment to the Government Disability Confident Initiative, and the Armed Forces Covenant, we are offering a guaranteed interview scheme to anyone with as disability as defined by the Equality Act 2010, or military veterans, service leavers, and military spouses. 
 Liva will operate a fair, inclusive and transparent recruitment and selection process. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout our interview process please let us know and will be happy to accommodate.

items.desc:
Since 2018, Voi has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the #1 e-scooter service in Europe, operating in 100 cities and towns with over 250 MILLION rides to date. It has been an amazing journey and we have no intention of stopping now! We are now looking for a Shift Supervisor in Swansea!
 YOUR MISSION AT VOI 
 As Shift Supervisor, you’re the face of Voi on the warehouse floor in Swansea, working side by side with our 3PL partner’s team to keep the fleet moving. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on in the warehouse (70%), with the rest (30%) keeping the partnership running smoothly.
 Your responsibilities will be:
 Working alongside our 3PL : Be the go-to person for the partner’s team on shift, sharing the plan for the day, answering questions and keeping everyone on the same page.
 Getting vehicles out the door : Help receive, pack and deploy new vehicles, and pitch in wherever the shift needs you.
 Keeping quality high : Spot damaged or misplaced vehicles, get them fixed or moved, restore fallen vehicles and keep parking spots tidy, leading by example on how we like things done.
 Sharing know-how : Show the partner’s team Voi’s processes, tools and safety standards, and offer friendly tips and feedback along the way.
 Staying on top of the numbers : Keep an eye on how the shift is tracking against agreed targets, and check that hours and volumes match what’s reported.
 Raising your hand when something’s off : Flag issues early to Voi’s managers and the partner’s leads, and suggest ideas to make the way we work together better.
 Planning together : Work with Voi managers and the partner to make sure each shift is well staffed and ready to go.
 WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK 
 We are looking for a pragmatic and responsible team-player who can fulfill tasks, solve problems independently, and work as a part of a team to find new solutions and reach set goals. In addition to being fluent in English, the right person needs:
 2+ years of previous work experience
 Experience managing a team of people
 Mandatory requirement – Driving licence: You must hold a full UK driving licence for at least 12 months , with no more than 6 points and no major offences , to meet our e-van insurance requirements . Licence checks will be conducted during the recruitment process. As part of the role, you will be required to drive one of our company e-vans 
 General understanding of digital work tools (MS-office, G-Suite)
 JOB CONDITIONS 
 Working days: Monday-Friday
 Working hours: AM- Shift 0800 - 1600 
 Contract type: 6 months fixed-term contract 
 Work Area: Warehouse 
 WHY VOI? 
 Join Europes #1 micromobility company and one of the fastest growing scaleups
 Have a direct impact on our continued success and the development of the micromobility industry in the UK 
 Work with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal
 Join the micromobility-revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution
 At Voi, we are committed to responsible and ethical recruitment practices, ensuring that all recruitment processes are fair, transparent, and free from exploitation. We operate under the principle that we cover the associated recruitment costs, meaning that no recruitment fees or related costs are charged to workers at any stage of the hiring process. All such costs are borne by Voi, and we require the same standards to be upheld across the agencies we partner with. items.desc:
Sobre nosotros: 
 Today Mobility facilita la propiedad de vehículos proporcionando soluciones de movilidad para toda la industria automotriz. En esencia, transportamos los vehículos de nuestros clientes hacia y desde la inspección técnica, el cambio de neumáticos, el mantenimiento, la reparación, etc.
 Actualmente, Today Mobility ofrece servicios a través de algunos de los fabricantes de automóviles más grandes del mundo y a empresas con sus propias flotas de vehículos. Como resultado, los propietarios de automóviles disfrutan de una gran comodidad, las empresas mantienen su flota en excelente estado mientras ahorran tiempo y dinero, y los fabricantes de automóviles logran una distribución equilibrada en sus talleres, ofreciendo un servicio aún mejor a sus clientes.
 El ADN de Today Mobility: 
 Exigimos altos estándares de personalidad, espíritu de servicio y un fuerte sentido de responsabilidad en la gestión de proyectos.
 Today Mobility es una empresa amigable. Nos movemos con rapidez y hacemos lo necesario para ayudar a nuestros clientes, colegas y socios a tener un mejor día a día. Formamos equipos que actúan con un enfoque de "nosotros" en lugar de "yo", priorizando personas sin ego que valoran los resultados colectivos por encima de los individuales.
 Nuestro ADN impregna todo lo que hacemos, y nuestra identidad se demuestra con acciones más que con palabras. Por eso, nuestros socios nos eligen.
 ------------ 
 Conductor: 
 Como conductor, además de la conducción profesional y responsable exigida para el puesto, es importante que te sientas cómodo interactuando con clientes. En Today Mobility, nuestros clientes son grandes empresas y, en ocasiones, sus clientes finales, por lo que el trato con el cliente es necesario en el día a día.
 El rol de conductor es dinámico y cada jornada laboral es diferente, por lo que es fundamental que disfrutes estar en movimiento y viajar.
 Tipo de empleo: medio tiempo 
 Fecha de inicio: noviembre Todas las tareas de conducción y turnos de trabajo se presentan en nuestra aplicación propia. Es la herramienta de trabajo básica. Es fundamental sentirse cómodo y con soltura en el manejo de aplicaciones móviles.
 Criterios clave: 
 ✅Licencia de conducción categoría B (transmisión manual), al menos 12 puntos
 ✅Buen nivel de conducción.
 ✅Mayor de 25 años
 ✅Interés genuino por el servicio al cliente de primera calidad
 ✅Comprensión técnica de aplicaciones móviles
 ✅Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y actitud orientada a la solución
 ✅Fluidez total de español y valorable buen manejo de inglés
 ✅Buen conocimiento local
 Estás cordialmente invitado a ponerte en contacto para obtener más información sobre el puesto. La solicitud debe enviarse en forma de CV y carta de presentación en la aplicación a continuación.

items.desc: Amsterdam or Antwerp – As a Backend Engineer within the GenAI Platform team, you help build the foundation that enables AI products across DPG Media. You design and develop scalable backend solutions that support identity, access management and platform insights for a growing portfolio of AI services. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! What will you do? As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by: Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform. Building backend services that collect, combine and expose usage, cost and user data for the platform portal and reporting. Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows. Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development. Who are we? We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting. What makes you the ideal candidate? For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. In addition, you bring: Around 5 years of backend engineering experience, including designing systems yourself. Proficiency in at least one backend language. We work with Go, TypeScript and Python, and you are willing to work across these technologies. Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view. Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes. Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build. Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage. How do you work? You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. You think ahead when making design decisions and build with long-term scalability in mind. Our stack Languages: Go for the platform control plane, TypeScript and Python for services and APIs. Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD. Observability: Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. CI/CD: GitHub Actions. At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Votre rôle est de concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions concrètes pour automatiser les processus et améliorer le service rendu aux agents et aux citoyens. Prototypage rapide (PoC) : transformer les besoins en outils fonctionnels (ex : agents conversationnels dédiés, analyse automatisée de documents, aide à la décision). Industrialisation : assurer le déploiement (Docker), le monitoring et la maintenance évolutive des solutions créées. Ingénierie de la Donnée Préparation des données : identifier, extraire et nettoyer les jeux de données issus des logiciels métiers pour nourrir les modèles. Gouvernance, Transfert et Veille Suivi de la charte IA : participer activement à l'application et au suivi de la charte d'usage de l'IA de la collectivité, en veillant à la transparence et à l'éthique des algorithmes. items.desc: The Role This is a UK-based role that makes the AI systems which power our products measurably better. How well those systems perform is at the heart of what Aykua offers. You will design the evaluations that tell us how accurate they are, find out why they fail, and run the experiments that fix it. You will statistically assess prompt and model performance and maintain our internal evaluation frameworks. The role suits a scientist with rigorous experimental habits, from a PhD, postdoc or equivalent industry experience, who wants their work to ship in a product which real clinics are using today. What You’ll Do Improve how we measure AI quality: extend the evaluation frameworks for our existing products and stand up new ones as products are built, assessing prompt and model performance statistically and designing experiments that compare changes rigorously. Build and continuously improve our LLM-as-judge evaluations: calibrate judges against expert human review, find where they fail, and feed what you learn back into our prompts, models and products. Curate and maintain our internal evaluation datasets, working with expert reviewers to establish and keep ground truth. Work closely with our product and engineering teams to turn your findings into improvements that reach production. Mentor the team in evaluation and experimental practice, establish best practices, and raise the technical bar for how we measure AI quality across the company. What We’re Looking For A PhD and postdoctoral research experience, or equivalent industry experience (5+ years), in data science, machine learning or a related quantitative field. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python (with libraries like Pydantic, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn). A strong foundation in statistical analysis, experimental design and hypothesis testing, and experience applying it to large or messy datasets. Experience turning analysis into working tools: evaluation harnesses, data pipelines or reusable experiment code that others on the team can run. You will be a great fit if you... Enjoy working with frontier models. Would rather measure whether something works than assume it does. Automate away repetitive analysis and build tooling that makes evaluation faster and more reliable. It would be nice if you had... Hands-on experience with LLMs, such as prompting, LLM-as-judge or fine-tuning. Familiarity with evaluation metrics such as precision and recall, and with using them to check automated judgements against human review. Experience with healthcare or clinical data, or in another regulated industry, including de-identification, privacy-preserving data work or data governance for protected data (PII/PHI). Publications in peer-reviewed venues. Experience using coding agents in research work, with independent verification of the results. Please note: Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis, and we aim to respond to every applicant within one week. You must have the right to work in the UK, as this is an in-person role near Cambridge. Pay: £42,000.00-£60,000.00 per year Benefits: Employee stock ownership plan Education: Bachelor's (required) Work authorisation: United Kingdom (required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge CB4

items.desc: Vollzeit Ab wann kann es losgehen: Ab sofort Unternehmensbeschreibung Deloitte Österreich ist der führende Anbieter von Professional Services. Das gelingt uns mit unseren rund 1.900 engagierten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an 17 Standorten, die Unternehmen und Institutionen in verschiedenen Bereichen betreuen. Wir schätzen die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeitenden und sehen sie als essenziellen Schlüssel für Innovation und Erfolg. Deshalb setzen wir uns dafür ein, dass bei uns jede:r die gleichen Chancen erhält. Stellenbeschreibung Wir unterstützen Unternehmen in der Konzeption und Umsetzung wichtiger Vorhaben im IT-Umfeld. Du möchtest mit uns spannende IT-Projekte begleiten und deinen nächsten Karriereschritt setzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Was dich erwartet: Du begleitest und führst abwechslungsreiche (IT-)Projekte durch. Du analysierst, konzipierst und optimierst Geschäftsabläufe sowie Daten- und System-Architekturen mit Fokus auf digitale Prozesse. Du analysierst Kund:innenanforderungen und konzipierst darauf basierend kundenspezifische IT-Lösungen. Du berätst und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von IT-Prozessautomatisierungs-Lösungen mithilfe geeigneter Werkzeuge. Du planst, führst durch und bereitest Kund:innenworkshops vor und nach und dokumentierst und verwaltest Anforderungen. Du arbeitest mit einem interdisziplinären Team zusammen und arbeitest eigenständig in agilen und traditionellen Projekten. Qualifikationen Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt (Wirtschafts-)Informatik (HTL, Universität oder FH). Du begeisterst dich für ein breites Spektrum von IT-Technologien und Business Anwendungen (z.B. ERP, CRM, ECM, Datenbanken). Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Lastenheften, User Stories und Prozessmodellen sowie Erfahrung mit Tools/Methoden wie Scrum, JIRA, Confluence. Du hast idealerweise eine Zertifizierung im Requirements Engineering-Umfeld (z.B. IREB Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering – Foundation Level oder IREB Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering – Agile Primer). Du denkst lösungsorientiert, arbeitest eigenständig und hast eine Affinität zu agilen Methoden. Du bist eine teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit guten Kommunikations- und Präsentationsskills. Erfüllst du nicht alle genannten Kriterien? Kein Problem! Uns ist bewusst, dass nicht jede:r alle Anforderungen erfüllen kann, deshalb sind wir bereit, in deine Entwicklung zu investieren. Zusätzliche Informationen Jahresbruttogehalt ab € 53.200,- (All In). Deine Vergütung orientiert sich selbstverständlich an deiner individuellen Qualifikation und positionsrelevanten Berufserfahrung. Darüber hinaus erwarten dich attraktive Zusatzleistungen und Benefits. Make an impact that matters . Wir ermutigen dich, neue Verantwortungen zu übernehmen, dich aktiv in spannende Projekte einzubringen und wertvolle Erfahrungen zu sammeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir dir exzellente Trainingsprogramme (Deloitte Academy, Deloitte University), strukturierte Karrierepfade, fachspezifische Ausbildungen und Trainings sowie persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, damit du deine Karriereziele erreichst und dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst. Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von starkem Zusammenhalt und unseren gemeinsamen Werten . Dabei ist uns das Wellbeing unserer Mitarbeitenden besonders wichtig. Außerdem bieten wir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit im Home Office oder im Büro im Stadtzentrum zu arbeiten. Auf deine Bewerbung freut sich : Chiara Schittenhelm , Tel.: +43 1 537002561 Für Fragen oder konkrete Unterstützung zur Barrierefreiheit wende dich bitte an barrierefreiheit@deloitte.at. items.desc: Vil du være med til at uddanne fremtidens softwareingeniører? VIA Softwareingeniøruddannelse søger engagerede og fagligt stærke timelærere til undervisning på softwareingeniøruddannelsen for forårssemesteret 2027, hvor undervisningen starter i uge 6. Om stillingen Som timelærer bliver du en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor praksisnær undervisning, samarbejde og kontakt til studerende er i centrum. Du vil indgå i et team af undervisere, der brænder for at udvikle de studerendes tekniske forståelse, problemløsningsevner og professionelle identitet. Stillingen omfatter undervisning, vejledning og evaluering inden for ét eller flere af følgende områder: Machine Learning Lineær Algebra Java programmering DevOps & Cloud Omfanget af timer aftales individuelt og kan tilpasses både dig og uddannelsens behov. Er flydendei skriftlig og mundtlig kommunikation på både dansk og engelsk Har lyst til at formidle tekniske emner på en engagerende og praksisnær måde Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå i et samarbejdende underviserteam Har interesse for at arbejde med unge og voksne i et læringsmiljø præget af dialog og faglig nysgerrighed Undervisningserfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav – vi hjælper dig godt i gang. items.desc: Category: Digital & IT Location: Høje-Taastrup, Capital Region of Denmark, DK Your impact begins here As Product Owner, you will take full ownership of two global facility monitoring systems (FMS) that track environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, CO2, diff Pressure etc.) across Novo. The FMS supports product release and compliance, so they need clear direction and reliable delivery. You will bring that responsibility in-house, setting the strategy, priorities and budget that keep quality and supply moving. What you’ll bring You are preferably already working as a Product Owner and are ready to take clear ownership of a product’s strategy, priorities, backlog and finances. You will also bring: An academic degree preferably in IT or business. Relevant experience counts as much as the path you took to get here. Around 3+ years of Product Owner experience, combined with broader relevant experience. Strong IT strategic understanding and experience shaping and owning the longer-term direction of a product. An understanding of technical and solution architecture at design level. You don’t need to be a deep technical specialist. Experience with cost management and budgeting. Strong written and spoken English. The team and stakeholder environment is fully international and works in English. Useful, but not essential: Understanding of compliance in the pharmaceutical industry. Experience from production or manufacturing. Knowledge of facility monitoring systems, including the FMS solutions used at Novo. Experience with agile ways of working. On a personal level, you bring the maturity to take ownership, make decisions and prioritise competing demands while staying effective under pressure. You are also able to lead informally and build strong stakeholder relationships across functions and cultures. What you’ll do The two FMS solutions offer different functionality, so the right one can be chosen for each site and situation. Your job is to give both a clear direction and to make sure the product team delivers what matters most. Own the overall direction of both global FMS systems, setting the product strategy and longer-term roadmap. Own and prioritise the backlog, deciding what gets delivered and when, based on business needs and input from the product team. Lead the product team informally, aligning roles, responsibilities and deliverables so the team works effectively together. Manage costs, budgeting and the financial model, making sure costs are covered and following up on actual spend against budget. Manage stakeholders proactively. Spot potential issues early and bring the right people in before problems escalate. Act as the first escalation point when significant issues arise with the product or its implementations, and set a clear example on quality. Who you’ll work with You will join Monitoring and Control Solutions, the area that sets the strategic direction for global monitoring and control systems at Novo. The team is based at the Novo IT hub in Høje Taastrup, Denmark, and works closely online with stakeholders and the application vendor around the world. You can expect to spend much of your week in the office with your team. Your closest colleagues will be your product team: a Product Manager, Business Analysts, Implementation Leads, a Compliance Partner, a Solution Architect and System Managers. Beyond the team, you will coordinate with Line of Business, implementation teams, lifecycle management, architecture and the application vendors. The systems serve factories and laboratories globally, so your priorities will affect sites across many countries and cultures. Your role is to bring these perspectives together, create clarity when things stall and keep work moving at pace. What you can expect here This is a role with real ownership. You will be trusted to make decisions about two global systems, and your voice will shape where they go next. You will build broad experience across IT strategy, finance, architecture and manufacturing-related compliance, all in one product area. You will work in a team that values a quality mindset, honest dialogue and an informal working climate, where colleagues support each other and never compromise on quality. Clear priorities and ambitious goals mean your results will be visible and recognised. What we offer At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage. Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 DKK to 1,091,600 DKK corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience. Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, …

items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Laboratory Setting, Office Job Description How You Will Make an Impact At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As a Hardware & Automation Field Application Scientist (FAS) within BioProduction, you will be a trusted technical partner to biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers across the UK and Nordic region. You will work primarily with process development, MSAT, operations and manufacturing teams, helping them evaluate, implement and adopt technologies that improve bioprocess performance. You will support bioprocess workflows spanning upstream and downstream activities, with a focus on hardware, single-use technologies and automation. This includes single-use bioreactors and mixers, DynaSpin harvest systems, fluid-management solutions and related process-control technologies. You will connect process requirements with equipment capabilities, workflow integration and manufacturing needs, and help customers develop, scale, transfer, optimize and troubleshoot their processes. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding why a process or system behaves the way it does and turning that understanding into practical customer solutions. You do not need experience with every platform or at every scale; strong process understanding, technical problem-solving and the ability to transfer your knowledge to new systems are more important. What You Will Do Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor for BioProduction hardware, single-use systems and automation, serving as an application-focused contact for customer process development, MSAT, operations and manufacturing teams. Support workflow development and technology integration across upstream and downstream processing, with particular emphasis on upstream bioprocessing equipment and single-use systems. Support customers with process engineering, scale-up and scale-down, technology transfer, process optimization and troubleshooting from development through manufacturing. Lead or contribute to pre- and post-sales technical activities, including workflow assessments, hardware evaluations, proof-of-principle studies, demonstrations, pilot runs and technology qualification in regulated environments. Troubleshoot process, hardware, single-use flow-path and automation issues; coordinate with Field Service, Engineering, Quality, Technical Support and other teams to support timely, compliant resolution. Advise customers on effective use and integration of bioreactors, mixers, DynaSpin systems, single-use assemblies, fluid-management solutions and related technologies. Conduct workflow consulting and structured process walks at customer sites to understand operational needs, identify improvement opportunities and align technical recommendations with customer goals. Support Bioprocessing Development Center activities and other customer demonstrations, helping deliver clear, consistent technical messaging. Develop and follow hardware and automation adoption plans with customers; agree measurable milestones such as time to first run and, where applicable, time to first GMP lot, and review utilization after implementation. Deliver technical training and design or deployment workshops for scientists, engineers and operators, and support technology adoption from development through manufacturing. Document technical engagements in Salesforce CRM and contribute technical input to account plans and risk-mitigation plans. Work closely with commercial teams and cross-functional partners, including Field Service, Product Management, R&D, Quality/Regulatory and Technical Support, to understand customer needs and resolve technical challenges. Gather and communicate Voice of Customer feedback to inform product roadmaps and support technical content such as application notes, white papers and case studies. Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant conferences, workshops, seminars and webinars through workflow-based technical presentations and demonstrations. items.desc: Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome. As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce. This is where you make a difference You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation. One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business. From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership. You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg. Key responsibilities include: Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions What you bring You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills: Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains Experience with cloud data platforms and integration architecture SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly around Business Partner data Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences Professional proficiency in English It is an advantage if you also have experience with: Data engineering, integration or enterprise architecture Master data management, metadata, lineage and data quality disciplines Event-driven, API-based and batch integration patterns CargoWise, logistics or transport-related operations Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or similar technologies Advanced analytics, AI or relevant certifications such as TOGAF or DAMA Why Blue Water You will become part of a well-established Data Management team with strong professional capabilities across governance, master data, migration and quality. What characterises the team is not only its expertise, but also its willingness to help each other succeed. We work closely together, challenge each other’s thinking and believe that the best solutions are created through collaboration across business and IT. As part of the wider Operational Excellence organisation, you will work alongside colleagues specialising in process improvement, training and change management. Together, we are helping Blue Water build the capabilities needed for the future. Interested? This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data at Blue Water. items.desc: We are looking for a talented Mechanical Design Engineer to join us. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a highly specialized field, designing and developing products used by leading research organizations and technology companies around the world. We are looking for a curious and driven professional who enjoys technical problem-solving, collaborative teamwork, and continuous learning. Interested? Keep reading! Your tasks will include designing new customer-specific solutions and modifying existing product designs to meet project requirements. You will design components and sub-systems for our cryogen-free dilution refrigerators, ensuring that designs meet quality, functionality, and manufacturability requirements. In this role, you will participate in engineering change and continuous improvement projects, create detailed manufacturing drawings for production, and maintain accurate design data in our PDM and ERP systems. You will also contribute to team-specific initiatives related to CAD data management, documentation, and process development while working closely with colleagues across engineering, manufacturing, and product teams. We are looking for a mechanical engineering professional with a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering and relevant experience in mechanical design using 3D CAD software. You are capable of producing high-quality technical drawings with great attention to detail and have a solid understanding of production methods and manufacturing requirements. You are eager to learn, continuously develop your expertise, and take a systematic and careful approach to your work while maintaining a strong commitment to quality. In addition, you are a self-driven professional with a hands-on attitude who can work independently while also contributing positively to team success. Strong communication skills and good English language skills, both written and spoken, are essential for collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders in our international environment. To stand out in this role, you bring experience with Creo and are comfortable working with modern 3D CAD tools in a product development or engineering-to-order environment. Familiarity with PDM systems and engineering data management practices is also considered an advantage. Above all, we appreciate professionals who are motivated by solving technical challenges, enjoy working collaboratively across different teams, and are committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions. We offer you an interesting, challenging, and responsible position as well as the support of a highly skilled growth organization. This is an excellent opportunity for your own professional growth in a dynamic, enthusiastic, and professional team where we work together, and we support each other. We have a multicultural work environment with room to grow, where you can use your potential and develop your skills. items.desc: The Impact You'll Make Join us in accelerating the energy transition through advanced power conversion technologies. Based in Vaasa, Finland, with a hybrid work model, you will help develop electronic solutions that improve energy efficiency, grid stability, and electrification across a wide range of industries. As an Electronics Engineer, you will contribute to next-generation power conversion products used in energy storage, data centers, EV charging infrastructure, marine electrification, renewable energy, and microgrids. Your work will help transform innovative ideas into reliable products that support a more sustainable future. Working alongside experts in power electronics, software, controls, testing, and manufacturing, you will have the opportunity to grow your technical expertise while making a meaningful impact on global electrification solutions. What You’ll Be Doing Design and develop electronic hardware for power conversion products, helping bring innovative technologies from concept to market. Create schematics, perform circuit calculations, and maintain engineering documentation to support high-quality product development. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop integrated solutions that deliver strong performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Test and validate prototypes, analyze results, and solve technical challenges to improve product quality and robustness. Contribute to the development of future power conversion technologies, including new semiconductor solutions and converter topologies. What We're Looking For Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. Experience in electronic hardware development, power electronics, or industrial product development gained through work, internships, research projects, or academic studies. Understanding of power electronic circuits, including converters, inverters, power supplies, gate drives, and protection functions. Hands-on experience with circuit design, simulation, laboratory testing, and engineering verification activities. Experience with engineering tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence, OrCAD, LTspice, PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, PSPICE, Teamcenter, SAP, or equivalent solutions, combined with good analytical and problem-solving skills. What You'll Get from Us At Danfoss, you will work on technologies that are helping shape the future of electrification and sustainable energy systems. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and industry experts developing solutions for energy storage, renewable energy, data center infrastructure, and advanced power conversion applications. We offer a collaborative environment where learning, innovation, and continuous improvement are encouraged. You will have opportunities to expand your expertise across power electronics, electronics design, system architecture, controls, and emerging electrification technologies while contributing to meaningful projects with global impact. This position is based in Vaasa, Finland, and includes a hybrid work model that supports both flexibility and collaboration. Ready to Make a Difference? Avec ses 2000 collaborateur·rice·s, le Crédit Coopératif et ses filiales, BTP Banque et Ecofi, prônent depuis plus de 130 ans un modèle d’économie sociale et solidaire durable pour ses clients comme pour ses talents. Nous restons fidèles à nos convictions, à nos engagements et au bien-être de nos collaborateur·rice·s pour vous permettre de construire le parcours qui vous ressemble. Et vivre votre métier autrement ! #UnAutreJobEstPossible ; #AvecVousCestPossible Poste et missions Notre Direction des Risques et de la Conformité recrute un·e Délégué·e à la protection des données pour accompagner les équipes du Groupe Crédit Coopératif dans la maîtrise des enjeux liés aux données personnelles. En qualité de Délégué·e à la protection des données (DPO), vous informez et conseillez la Direction et les équipes sur leurs obligations au regard du RGPD et des réglementations applicables. Vous accompagnez les métiers dans leurs projets et veillez à la conformité des traitements mis en œuvre. Vos principales missions seront de : Conseiller les équipes sur la réglementation applicable et les accompagner dans les études d’impact sur la vie privée et la réduction des risques. Piloter le registre des traitements, en intégrant, le cas échéant, les applications privatives, et contribuer au reporting interne et externe. Mettre en œuvre les règles et les contrôles du Groupe en matière de protection des données, dans le cadre du contrôle permanent et d’une approche par les risques. Veiller au traitement des droits des personnes et à la mise en œuvre du plan de formation et de sensibilisation. Animer la communauté des référents et assurer les relations avec les interlocuteurs internes, notamment l’opérateur informatique, ainsi qu’avec les autorités de contrôle telles que la CNIL, l’ACPR et l’AMF. Profil et compétences requises ✨ Et vous ? Vous êtes diplômé·e de l’enseignement supérieur en droit, conformité, gestion des risques ou protection des données, et justifiez d’une expérience dans un domaine lié à la protection des données personnelles. Vous maîtrisez le RGPD et les règles applicables ; une connaissance de la réglementation bancaire et des métiers du secteur serait un plus. Une certification en protection des données personnelles serait particulièrement appréciée. Organisé·e, autonome et rigoureux·se, vous savez coordonner des interlocuteurs variés, analyser des situations complexes et en dégager les principaux enjeux. Votre aisance relationnelle, votre pédagogie et votre diplomatie vous permettent d’accompagner les équipes et de faire avancer les sujets avec ténacité. Vous maîtrisez l'IA, mais également la rédaction de documents structurés et savez prendre des décisions. Vous voulez en savoir plus sur le poste ? items.desc: À propos de nous La société Coutot-Roehrig fondée en 1894 est le leader européen sur le marché de la généalogie successorale, au service des études notariales et autres professions juridiques. Notre ambition : fournir aux généalogistes la meilleure plateforme de recherche mondiale du secteur. Mission Nous recherchons pour notre équipe data, un Chef de projet Data (H/F) Le poste, basé à Paris, est à pourvoir en CDI, pour une prise de fonction immédiate. Rattaché(e) au directeur de projets et en lien étroit avec l’équipe data, vous serez responsable de projets data de bout en bout, de la collecte à la mise en production. Vos responsabilités principales : Collecte des données Concevoir et développer des solutions techniques de collecte Mettre en place et maintenir des batchs de collecte automatisés Nettoyage et redressement des données Automatiser et suivre le contrôle qualité et pertinence des données Mettre en conformité les données avec les spécifications internes Valorisation les données Organiser le traitement manuel, algorithmique ou par IA des données (reconnaissance de texte, contextualisation, enrichissement) Mise en production et contrôle des données Documentation des processus pour assurer leur traçabilité et les mises à jour Suivant profil : Maintenir et développer les outils de recherche Votre rôle au quotidien: Travailler en autonomie et responsabilité, avec un support du reste de l’équipe. Avancer avec méthode et rigueur pour garantir la livraison d’une donnée de qualité. Identifier les tâches récurrentes et automatiser ce qui peut l’être. Méthodes et outils: Gestion de projets : Slack, Trello, Confluence, GitHub + outils internes. Traitement des données : Environnement Azure, Debian Bases de données : postgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Développement : en Python, bash Une approche inspirée des valeurs agiles : Priorité aux individus et aux interactions, Importance des résultats plutôt que de la documentation exhaustive, Collaboration plutôt que négociation contractuelle, Adaptation au changement plutôt qu’exécution stricte d’un plan Profil Formation supérieure Bac +4/5 en informatique. Première expérience réussie en en data engineering ou développement de solutions data. Excellente maîtrise de l’algorithmie et aisance dans l’analyse de bases de données Vous vous reconnaissez dans l’un des profils suivants : Profil Data Engineer : conception et maintenance de pipelines de données, automatisation des traitements, contrôle qualité et intégration. Profil Développement IA : expérience (ou forte appétence) pour le traitement d’images, l’apprentissage automatique ou les modèles d’IA appliqués à la donnée. Profil Développement applicatif : expérience en développement fullstack (idéalement PHP) ou expérience en développement d’agent de recherche IA Compétences clés : Rigueur et sens du travail bien fait, Autonomie et esprit d’initiative, Esprit d’équipe et volonté de partage.

items.desc: Entreprise Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein du secteur bancaire, nous recherchons un Business Analyst Banque / Finance , spécialisé dans les processus de paiement et de décaissement. Vous intégrerez l’une des deux équipes agiles du périmètre Crédit court terme , couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie du crédit, de la contractualisation à la gestion du contrat jusqu’à son terme. Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée d’un Product Owner, d’un Tech Lead, de développeurs et de Business Analysts. L’environnement technique s’appuie notamment sur Java, Angular et une architecture orientée événements reposant fortement sur Kafka. Poste En tant que Business Analyst, vous serez responsable de vos fonctionnalités de bout en bout, depuis le recueil du besoin métier jusqu’aux tests et à la recette fonctionnelle. À ce titre, vos principales responsabilités seront : Recueil et analyse des besoins : échanger avec les interlocuteurs métier, comprendre les processus existants et formaliser les besoins fonctionnels. Conception fonctionnelle : découper les fonctionnalités, analyser les impacts et définir les solutions fonctionnelles adaptées. Rédaction des spécifications : produire les spécifications fonctionnelles et rédiger les user stories avec des critères d’acceptation clairs. Tests et recette : préparer et réaliser les tests fonctionnels, vérifier la conformité des développements aux besoins exprimés et assurer la recette de vos fonctionnalités. Collaboration avec les équipes techniques : travailler quotidiennement avec le Product Owner, le Tech Lead et les développeurs afin de garantir la bonne compréhension des besoins et la qualité des livraisons. Analyse des flux : lire et analyser les topics et les messages Kafka pour faciliter la compréhension des échanges entre les composants applicatifs et contribuer à l’analyse des anomalies fonctionnelles. Profil Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que Business Analyst, idéalement acquise dans un environnement bancaire ou financier. Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge une fonctionnalité en toute autonomie, de la compréhension du besoin jusqu’à la validation fonctionnelle, tout en assurant une bonne coordination entre les équipes métier et techniques. Vous recherchez un rôle opérationnel de Business Analyst, centré sur l’analyse, la conception fonctionnelle et la recette, et non un rôle de Product Owner. Compétences indispensables Expérience significative en Business Analysis. Bonne connaissance fonctionnelle du secteur bancaire. Capacité à recueillir, analyser et formaliser des besoins métier. Maîtrise de la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles et de user stories. Expérience dans la préparation et l’exécution de tests fonctionnels et de recettes. Aisance dans un environnement technique impliquant Kafka : compréhension, lecture et analyse des topics et des messages. Capacité à dialoguer efficacement avec des équipes de développement Java, sans nécessité de développer. Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’analyse. Compétences appréciées Expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des décaissements ou des flux financiers. Connaissance des processus de crédit, idéalement du crédit court terme. Pratique des méthodes agiles et expérience du travail en équipe Scrum. Familiarité avec les environnements techniques Java, Angular et AWS. Pourquoi rejoindre cette mission ? Intervenir sur un périmètre bancaire fonctionnel couvrant le cycle de vie du crédit court terme. Prendre en charge des fonctionnalités de bout en bout avec un réel niveau d’autonomie. Elle accompagne près d’une vingtaine de clients, allant des grands comptes aux ETI et PME. Elle s’appuie sur un Centre de Services spécialisé dans le stockage et la sauvegarde ainsi que sur un Centre d'Expertise en sécurité. L'agence accorde une importance particulière à un recrutement fondé sur l'humain et la transparence. C’est votre mission Vous êtes passionné·e par l’architecture logicielle, l’industrialisation des outils internes et l’amélioration continue des pratiques de développement ? Ce poste est fait pour vous. En tant que Responsable Technique DevOps , vous contribuez à la structuration, à l’évolution et à la pérennité du portefeuille d’outils internes, en garantissant leur cohérence technique, leur qualité et leur exploitabilité. Côté build : Définir et faire évoluer l’architecture de référence des outils internes : intégration, APIs, authentification, gestion des données, journalisation et supervision. Analyser les redondances entre applications, scripts, automatisations et composants techniques, puis proposer des scénarios de consolidation ou de mutualisation. Définir les standards techniques, les règles de réutilisation et les composants communs afin d’améliorer la cohérence du portefeuille d’outils. Contribuer à la conception, au prototypage, au développement et à l’intégration des solutions en fonction des besoins identifiés. Réaliser ou préparer les revues d’architecture, de conception et de code des outils prioritaires. Mettre en place des standards et accélérateurs réutilisables : templates de projets, conventions de développement, composants communs et checklists de mise en production. Intégrer les pratiques d’intelligence artificielle dans le cycle de développement logiciel, notamment pour la conception, le développement, les tests, la documentation et l’analyse de code. Mettre en œuvre des démarches de développement guidé par les spécifications ( Specification Driven Development – SDD ), en structurant les spécifications et les critères d’acceptation. Contrôler, tester et valider les productions assistées par l’IA avant leur intégration, dans le respect des règles de sécurité applicables. Participer à la réduction de la dette technique et à l’amélioration de la maintenabilité des solutions pérennes. Côté run : Piloter les sujets techniques complexes et coordonner les échanges avec les équipes d’architecture, d’infrastructure, de sécurité, d’IAM, de réseau, d’hébergement et d’exploitation. Préparer les validations techniques et les mises en service en tenant compte des flux, des dépendances, des habilitations, des secrets, de l’exposition réseau et des exigences de supervision. Assurer le suivi des décisions, des actions, des dépendances et des échéances, en identifiant les blocages et en proposant des scénarios de résolution. Définir et faire évoluer les critères de maturité des outils internes : versionnement du code, documentation, tests, revue de code, chaîne de livraison et procédures de retrait. Garantir l’exploitabilité des solutions en structurant la journalisation, les métriques, les alertes, les tableaux de bord et les procédures de diagnostic. Adapter les exigences de qualité, de sécurité et de maintenance à la criticité des outils et à la sensibilité des données traitées. Formaliser les choix d’architecture, les dépendances, les limites connues, les risques et les modalités de reprise des solutions. Produire et maintenir la documentation technique et technico-fonctionnelle, les procédures de déploiement, de retour arrière et d’exploitation. Organiser le transfert de connaissances auprès des contributeurs internes afin de faciliter la maintenance, l’évolution et la continuité des activités. C’est votre parcours Vous disposez d’une expérience significative dans le développement logiciel, l’architecture technique ou l’industrialisation de solutions applicatives en environnement complexe. Vous savez prendre en charge des sujets techniques transverses, coordonner plusieurs équipes expertes et transformer des contraintes techniques en solutions concrètes. Vous aimez structurer, concevoir et améliorer les outils existants, tout en gardant une approche pragmatique orientée qualité, sécurité et pérennité. C’est votre expertise : Architecture logicielle, intégration applicative, APIs, authentification, gestion des données et composants partagés. items.desc: About Exotrail Space is becoming more strategic and competitive than ever. Tomorrow’s space leaders will not simply launch satellites into orbit, they will be able to move them, reposition them, extend their lifetime, and maximize their performance in space. Since 2017, Exotrail has been developing and operating cutting-edge in-space mobility solutions for commercial, institutional, and defense customers. From our high-performance propulsion system spaceware to our orbital transfer vehicle spacevan , we enable satellites to go farther, stay operational longer, and achieve more. Today, more than 200 Exotrailers across Massy and Toulouse are working together to make space operations more efficient and sustainable. Backed by over €75 million in funding , we are pursuing a clear mission: Making space a sustainable frontier for future generations. Job Description At Exotrail, we're building the technologies that make space mobility more flexible, efficient and sustainable. As part of our In-Orbit Services (IOS) division, you will contribute to the development of SpaceTower , our flight dynamics and mission operations software platform supporting spacecraft missions from mission design to in-orbit operations. As a Flight Dynamics Software Engineer , you will combine astrodynamics expertise and software engineering skills to design, develop and maintain the flight dynamics capabilities used by our teams and customers worldwide. If you enjoy solving complex orbital mechanics challenges, building reliable software products and seeing your work directly support operational space missions, we'd love to hear from you. Your Mission You will contribute to the design, development and validation of Exotrail's Flight Dynamics System (FDS), supporting mission analysis, orbit determination, maneuver planning, trajectory optimization and operational flight dynamics activities. Working closely with Flight Dynamics, Software, System and Operations teams, you will deliver high-performance software solutions that support spacecraft throughout their entire lifecycle, from mission preparation to routine operations in orbit. Your Responsibilities Mission Analysis & Astrodynamics Design and implement orbit propagation, orbit determination and maneuver planning algorithms. Develop trajectory optimization solutions for spacecraft missions. Contribute to mission analysis and operational flight dynamics capabilities. Validate algorithms through simulation, testing and operational data analysis. Translate mission requirements into robust software solutions in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams. Software Development Design, develop and maintain Flight Dynamics software products, including SpaceTower. Participate in software architecture decisions and technical roadmap definition. Improve software performance, scalability, robustness and maintainability. Develop automated testing frameworks and validation tools. Contribute to continuous integration and software quality processes. Participate in code reviews and software development best practices. Produce high-quality technical documentation. Mission & Operations Support Support System Engineering and Operations teams during CONOPS definition and mission preparation. Train and assist internal and external users of SpaceTower. Participate in software and operational validation campaigns. Support critical mission phases such as launch, commissioning and end-of-life operations. Investigate operational anomalies and contribute to continuous process improvements. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications Master's degree or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field. Strong foundation in applied mathematics and solid understanding of space mechanics Good understanding of spacecraft dynamics, orbit propagation and numerical methods. Proven experience in software development using Java (must have), Linux Git/GitLab, CI/CD/CT Fluency in English and French Preferred Qualifications Experience with flight dynamics libraries and tools (Orekit, GMAT, STK/ODTK, Tudat, Orecz). Python and Typescript Containerization and Orchestration (e.g.,Docker, Kbernetes) Knowledge of Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) systems. Knowledge of Agile development methodologies. Soft skills Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment, collaborating with engineers, scientists, and operations teams. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive attitude and ownership mindset, capable of driving topics from concept to completion. Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Ability to provide constructive feedback and contribute positively to team growth and continuous improvement. Capacity to work on on-call …

items.desc: Dans le cadre d'un projet international de transformation et de valorisation des données, nous recherchons un Business Data Analyst expérimenté (H/F) pour accompagner l'intégration, la structuration et l'exploitation des données issues de l'écosystème Amazon au sein d'une plateforme Data interne. L'objectif de cette mission est d'assurer le lien entre les données Amazon, les besoins des équipes métiers et les modèles de données existants. La priorité métier porte sur les données Sales Performance (performance commerciale), suivies des données Media Performance (performance marketing et publicitaire). Le consultant interviendra sur l'analyse des sources de données, leur mapping, la définition des indicateurs métiers et la fiabilisation des données dans un environnement international. Principales responsabilités : Réaliser l'inventaire des données et API Amazon disponibles. Analyser les sources de données Amazon liées aux performances commerciales et publicitaires. Effectuer le mapping entre les données Amazon et les modèles de données internes. Définir, formaliser et documenter les KPI métiers ainsi que leurs règles de calcul. Identifier les écarts, incohérences et données manquantes. Réconcilier et valider les données Amazon avec les sources existantes. Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité et de la cohérence des données. Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles et la documentation associée. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes métiers, Data et IT. Profil candidat: Nous recherchons un Business Data Analyst disposant d'une solide expérience dans l'analyse, la structuration et la modélisation des données, avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux métiers liés à la performance commerciale et marketing. Une expérience préalable dans l'écosystème Amazon, notamment sur les données Sales Performance et Media Performance, sera particulièrement appréciée. Compétences recherchées : Expérience confirmée en Business Analysis / Data Analysis. Bonne connaissance de l'écosystème Amazon et idéalement de ses API. Solide compréhension des données Sales Performance : ventes, chiffre d'affaires, volumes, KPI commerciaux. Connaissance des données Media Performance : campagnes publicitaires, indicateurs de performance marketing. Expérience en Data Mapping, Data Modeling et Data Reconciliation. Capacité à définir et documenter des KPI et des règles de gestion. Bonne maîtrise de SQL pour l'analyse et la validation des données. Expérience dans la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles et de documentation Data. Capacité à interagir avec des équipes métiers et techniques dans un contexte international. Excellent esprit d'analyse, rigueur et autonomie. Français et anglais courants indispensables.

items.desc: The European Organisation for Astronomical Research in the Southern Hemisphere (ESO) is the foremost intergovernmental astronomy organisation in Europe and the world's most productive ground-based astronomical observatory. ESO carries out an ambitious programme focused on the design, construction and operation of powerful ground-based observing facilities enabling astronomers to make important scientific discoveries. ESO operates three unique world-class observing sites in northern Chile: La Silla, Paranal and Chajnantor (home to ALMA), and the ESO Headquarters are located in Garching, near Munich, Germany. At Paranal, ESO operates the Very Large Telescope, the world's most advanced visible-light astronomical observatory, and will host and operate the southern array of the Cherenkov Telescope Array, the world's largest and most sensitive high energy gamma-ray observatory. ESO is a major partner in ALMA. On Cerro Armazones, ESO is building the 39-metre Extremely Large Telescope (ELT), which will become "the world's biggest eye on the sky" and whose operations will be fully integrated into the Paranal Observatory. Due to the need for additional resources within the Directorate of Programmes, ESO is advertising the position of Document Control Assistant Garching Deadline 21/11/2026 In your role as Document Control Assistant, you will be supporting the work of the Document Control team responsible for the management of a high number of business-critical documents for the Instrumentation Programme, Technology Development Programme and ELT Construction Programme. The Document Control Assistant ensures that the Programmes' documents are formatted, identified, signed, released and archived according to the relevant document lifecycle's rules. The Document Control Assistant ensures the distribution of documents to appropriate internal stakeholders and facilitates the sharing of documents with external parties. This is a crucial role as accurate, timely and efficient management of documents is vital for the success of the different Programmes. You will be expected to work effectively in a team but at the same time to work independently exercising problem-solving skills with responsibility for your own area of work. While playing a supporting role in the active management of documentation related to the Programmes, you will work under the guidance of the Programme Engineers and in close collaboration with the Document Control team in managing the document archive and the product configuration repositories. You will have to ensure that they are updated and accessible by the users whilst meeting required standards of accuracy, quality and integrity and enforce the documentation and configuration management processes as defined within the Programmes. Main Duties and Responsibilities: Support the administration of the archive of the different Programmes through the ESO Information Repository system (PDM) by generating and maintaining folder structures, updating metadata and populating the folders according to the Programmes' evolution. Perform quality control of documents, in particular checking the correctness of reference documents/versions, the proper use of standard templates and lifecycles, and that the configuration control rules relevant for documentation management are observed. Ensure that the documents go through a traceable and approved release process before being archived. Support tasks related to product configuration management, by keeping the repositories updated with the relevant information and allocated documentation. Work in strict co-operation with project managers, engineers, the Programme Engineers and the Document Control team to ensure that the ESO documentation for procurements as well as the documentation submitted by contractors and consortia complies with the relevant documentation management requirements and is correctly stored in the ESO PDM system. Provide support in the preparation, update and implementation of Contract Data Lists (CDL) for procurements. Provide user support to staff ensuring that the relevant document archive is effectively used and that document management procedures are duly followed. Provide support in delivering training to contractors and consortia to ensure accurate and efficient document delivery. Grant access to authorized users to the archived documents in accordance to established access permission policies. Coordinate with the ESO Information Repository Manager and System Administrator user licenses, access groups and access profiles. Participate to the PDM Programme Assistants monthly meeting chaired by the ESO Information Repository Manager. Key Competences and Experience: Essential Competences and Experience Excellent knowledge and experience of MS Office Suite, in particular Excel, of Adobe Acrobat pdf and of electronic signature requirements is essential. You should be able to demonstrate advanced proficiency in the applications leveraging advanced …
