items.desc: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Lead __ Your role and responsibilities We are looking for a Global Application Engineer with good know-how of controls for AC and DC microgrids, relevant experience in the key parts of a microgrid: solar PV, battery energy storage, AC/DC and DC/DC converters, electrical protection and grid connection, are considered valuable assets. The role combines hands-on technical work, from reference architectures to testing, validation and project execution, with close customer contact on real projects, including DC microgrid pilots. You’ll be the link between customers, R&D, product management and research centers, bringing market needs into new developments and helping turn technical solutions into business. Depending on your background, your focus will be either on grid-connected AC microgrids for industrial and commercial customers, or on DC microgrid installations and pilots. Work model: Hybrid (#LI hybrid) You will be mainly accountable for: Supporting customers and sales teams in industrial and commercial segments, from early technical discussions to solution proposals, for MG electrical & control systems serving solar PV, battery energy storage and variable loads. Developing and promoting reference architectures and application notes for AC and DC microgrids using ABB’s low voltage portfolio, converters and digital solutions. Planning and managing microgrid installations and pilot projects, from system design and panel solutions to commissioning support. Supporting development, testing and validation of applications, including supplier selection and purchasing. Working with R&D, product management, digital teams and research centers to bring market needs into new developments. Analyzing the competitive landscape and market trends and recommend adjustments to mid- and long-term strategy. Qualifications for the role Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, with 4+ years of experience in microgrids systems. Practical experience with microgrid components such as controllers, converters/PCS, battery energy storage and solar PV, including their protection. Ability to read and work with multiline diagrams and technical specifications in tools such as AutoCAD or EPLAN. Technical sales or application engineering towards industrial and commercial customers. Electrical system design, panel building or project management of microgrid or similar installations. Knowledge of DC applications and grid codes is a plus. Electrical simulations using MATLAB Simulink is a plus Comfortable working with customers, with good negotiation and communication skills in English. Agile mindset and willingness to keep learning. Willingness to travel for short periods. Driving’s license. More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive. The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

items.desc: Enabling smaller, more powerful and energy-efficient microchips – Working where tomorrow takes shape. Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are manufactured using ZEISS technologies. As the heart of every electronically controlled system, they have become an indispensable part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, more powerful and more energy-efficient microchips – and, through its innovations, plays a key role in shaping the age of micro- and nanoelectronics. Your Role Our team “Quality Assurance and Devops” within the department of Quality concerns itself with establishing quality assurance processes and DevOps standards for software applications and modules that are used in our production lines. The team develops and maintains platforms that support the implementation of core aspects of quality ranging from an effective software release and deployment platform to using data engineering approaches to build a reliability prediction platform for our production value streams. Your role: Reliability, Data Engineering and Full-Stack DevOps Engineer Develop a data-driven software reliability prediction platform for complex, production-relevant applications and machines Combine simulation, test, production, field issues, and DevOps data into scalable data pipelines and reliable analytical foundations. Apply statistical, data science, and machine learning methods to identify reliability risks, failure patterns and quality trends Design and implement full-stack web solutions, including user interfaces, backend services, APIs, dashboards, and integrations with enterprise systems that facilitate effective presentations of key learnings and trends towards stakeholders Integrate reliability models and algorithms into maintainable software components that support engineering and quality assurance decisions. Collaborate closely with operations and R&D to continue to build out and integrate effective Reliability prediction models that span across software and manufacturing machines Your Profile Degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, industrial engineering, or a comparable technical field Strong software engineering skills with practical experience in Python, C#, TypeScript/JavaScript or any high-level programming languages as well as clean code, modular design, and maintainable architectures Hands on experience and understanding of data science, statistics, machine learning, predictive analytics and reliability modeling Experience with data engineering concepts such as data pipelines, data quality, ETL/ELT, databases, APIs, and heterogeneous technical data sources Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, including modern frontend frameworks, backend services, REST APIs, authentication concepts, dashboards, and visualizations Good knowledge of DevOps and cloud native development and deployment approaches, GitOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and agile software development practices Analytical mindset, structured working style, and the ability to translate complex technical requirements into pragmatic software solutions Comfortable with English. items.desc: embecta is a global medical device company with a 100-year legacy in insulin delivery and diabetes care. Driven by innovation, purpose, and a commitment to improving lives, we are expanding our portfolio of solutions to serve even more patients, healthcare providers, and communities around the world. We are looking for a Master Data Specialist to own and optimize the data foundations that support reporting, analytics, and business decision-making across our international business. You will be responsible for integrating data from Salesforce, SAP, IQVIA, and other key systems into a centralized, trusted, and scalable data environment. This role will lead the management of customer master data, account hierarchies, territory mappings, and reporting structures across more than 100 countries. You will drive improvements in data quality, governance, and automation while enhancing Power BI and Excel reporting capabilities to deliver accurate, actionable business insights. Working closely with Commercial Excellence, IT, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional teams, you will help standardize data processes, support Salesforce data management, and identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot. This is an exciting opportunity for a data professional who enjoys turning complex data into meaningful business value. Key Responsibilities Data Integration & Extract, Transform & Load Pipelines Design, build, and maintain ETL processes connecting Salesforce, IQVIA, SAP, and additional data sources. Develop automated, schedule‑based data pipelines with robust error‑handling and alerting mechanisms. Centralize all locally purchased data assets (e.g., IQVIA) into a single environment Support the Monthly Business Review (MBR) data pipeline and reporting infrastructure. Data Cleaning & Quality Assurance Implement standardized data‑cleaning protocols and validation frameworks. Identify and resolve data‑quality issues at source or within transformation layers. Build and maintain data‑quality dashboards and metrics to monitor ongoing data health across all regions. Salesforce & Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Data Management Maintain accurate account hierarchies and customer master data in Salesforce. Troubleshoot issues related to Salesforce‑to‑analytics data synchronization. Ensure data consistency across all Salesforce environments and connected systems. Account Mapping & Customer Master Data Maintain and update global account hierarchies and territory mappings. Develop and enforce standardized account‑naming conventions across regions. Create and manage account‑to‑cluster mapping tables. Manage account mergers, divestitures, and organizational structure changes. Power BI Infrastructure & Optimization Set up and optimize Power BI data models, using both DirectQuery and Import modes. Create reusable templates and design standards to support scalable Power BI development. Monitor and improve query performance across Power BI datasets and semantic models. AI & Automation Opportunities Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual data‑processing workload. Evaluate AI‑enabled features (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) in collaboration with IT to enhance data workflows. Develop scripts or tools to automate repetitive validation and transformation tasks. Education and Experience Third-level qualification (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Analytics Tools & Platforms Proficiency in Power BI including advanced DAX measures, calculated tables, and complex data‑modelling formulas. Strong command of Microsoft Excel for data manipulation, analysis, and model building. Working knowledge of the Salesforce ecosystem, including custom fields, workflows, data models, and data‑quality structures. Familiarity with IQVIA, SAP, and other data systems commonly used in pharmaceutical and medical device environments. Strong problem‑solving mindset with a high level of attention to detail. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business‑friendly language. Collaborative approach to partnering with regional teams, business analysts, and cross‑functional stakeholders. Strong documentation discipline and a process‑oriented working style. Desirable Skills Experience with Python or R for data manipulation and automation. embecta is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. items.desc: iNFINITUM is a client-oriented organization that continuously evolves. Our team consistently extends its capabilities to meet exact needs based on specific business requirements, with customers coming from a wide range of industry sectors. At iNFINITUM , our success depends on our people, productivity, and procedures. We believe that the continuous success of our projects depends upon the outstanding performance of our highly skilled and trained staff. Providing access to modern professional training designed in line with real-world challenges is paramount to that success. We are looking for an experienced and passionate OpenShift & Ansible Automation Engineer to join our Infrastructure & Cloud Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for the architectural design, administration, scaling, and security of our Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) clusters, ensuring high availability and seamless application migration. Additionally, you will drive infrastructure automation across the organization using the Ansible Automation Platform , transforming repetitive manual operations into reusable, reliable playbooks while maintaining stability and security across our IT environment. Key Responsibilities OpenShift Engineering & Administration Cluster Design & Architecture: Analyze requirements to size nodes (worker & infra), evaluate storage options, define authentication methods, and integrate appropriate load balancers. Cluster Scaling & Capacity Management: Manage cluster capacity and scaling, optimize workload placement, and evaluate performance impact. Upgrades & Patching: Research and analyze new Red Hat OCP releases, conduct impact assessments, and execute seamless cluster upgrades and routine patching. Logging & Monitoring Solutions: Configure ClusterLogForwarder to securely forward audit, infrastructure, and application logs to external logging platforms (e.g., Splunk) as per Red Hat best practices. Registry & Namespace Administration: Manage container registries for cluster and application images. Maintain namespaces/projects, configure ResourceQuotas, LimitRanges, and project templates. Security & Governance: Define ACLs, Network Policies, and enforce least-privilege RBAC for users and Service Accounts. Harden clusters using the Compliance Operator and integrate image security scanning (e.g., Aqua, JFrog Xray). Developer Experience & Migration: Collaborate closely with development teams to migrate applications to OpenShift, provide Helm charts, and assist with Kubernetes resource definitions (Pods, Services, PVCs, Network Policies). Ansible Automation & Orchestration Automation Development: Design, build, and refine Ansible Playbooks, Roles, Templates, and Variables for software installation, configuration management, patching, and user provisioning. Platform & Inventory Management: Maintain Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) / AWX environments, managing job templates, workflows, credentials, execution environments, and dynamic/static inventories. Quality Assurance & Testing: Perform syntax checks, playbook linting, and utilize Ansible’s check mode to validate changes on non-production hosts prior to rollout. Version Control & Operational Improvement: Manage automation code via Git, lead code reviews, and partner with Systems, Network, Security, and Application teams to standardize processes and eliminate configuration drift. Requirements Must-Have Experience & Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 3+ years of hands-on experience in administering and designing Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) & Kubernetes environments. Strong experience with Ansible / Ansible Automation Platform (AWX) for configuration management and infrastructure automation (YAML, Playbooks, Roles). Deep understanding of Kubernetes/OpenShift networking concepts (Ingress, CNI, Services, Network Policies, Load Balancers). Experience integrating external logging platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK) and managing container registries. Proficiency with version control systems ( Git ) and CI/CD / GitOps tooling ( Helm , ArgoCD). Solid grasp of container security practices (RBAC, Image Scanning, Compliance Operators). Strong background in Linux/Unix administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python). Nice-to-Have / Certifications: Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration (EX280) or Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation (EX294) . Hands-on experience with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). Soft Skills & Working Style Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical conversations between Developers, SysAdmins, and Security teams. Proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement, standardization, and automating manual workloads. Benefits Friendly and Dynamic Working Environment. Interacting with product owners/clients, other business analysts, software developers and testers in the group. What you will bring Ideally you will have 1 -2 years experience in the banking and financial services industry, fund administration, accounting, tax or operations experience in financial services. Bachelor’s degree within Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Analytics and Information Technology (BAIT). Business, Accounting, Computer Science, Finance, Economics Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Strong project management, organization and communication skills. What will set you apart? Experience with SQL and related tools (e.g., Microsoft Query, Rapid SQL, DBeaver, etc.) preferred. Knowledge of the Software Development Life-Cycle preferred and Agile methodology a plus. Experience with Cognos or other reporting platforms is a plus. Experience with business analysis, requirements, software testing or proficiency tools (e.g., automated testing tools, compare tools, robotics, data visualization, Python) a plus PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. The role works closely with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure programmes align with business priorities and drive measurable performance outcomes. Develop and facilitate impactful learning solutions tailored to organisational needs, with a focus on employee development and leadership development. Deliver training using a range of methodologies, including classroom sessions, workshops, e-learning, and blended learning approaches. Provide coaching and mentoring to employees and managers to support development and improve performance. 2. Evaluate programme effectiveness using feedback, performance metrics, and business impact measures. Continuously refine and improve learning solutions based on evaluation outcomes. 5. T&D Team Contribution & Innovation Collaborate with the Talent & Development Manager to design and implement strategies aligned to business objectives. Work with T&D colleagues to promote learning offerings across the organisation. Stay up to date with emerging learning trends, technologies, and methodologies. Drive continuous improvement and innovation within the T&D function. Support and lead change initiatives, building engagement and adoption across the organisation. Skills & Experience 2 – 3 years’ experience in a learning and development capacity Strong facilitation, coaching, and programme design capabilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to use data to evaluate and improve learning impact. Strong business acumen and understanding of organisational priorities. Ability to travel within Europe Mercury is an equal opportunity employer

Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health. By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare. Business Information Systems (BIS) Placement January–June 2027 | Galway, Ireland Role: Technical Operations Intern Reporting to: Global Tech Operations and Ireland Site Lead Location: Hybrid - Bonham Quay, Galway city About Datavant Datavant is a data platform company and a leader in health data exchange. Clear written and verbal communication skills. An organised approach and attention to detail. A willingness to ask questions, solve problems, and learn new tools. The ability to take ownership of tasks and work collaboratively. Familiarity with Excel, Google Sheets, process-mapping tools, or basic query languages is helpful but not essential. We value potential over experience. You'll receive support and guidance as you learn. How You'll Apply Your BIS Learning This placement connects your coursework to practical experience in: Systems analysis and design: Gather requirements, map workflows, and document system interactions. Project management: Support planning, task tracking, and delivery. Business process modelling: Analyse workflows and recommend improvements. Data and information management: Contribute to reporting and learn about data governance. IT governance and compliance: See how teams manage risk, maintain standards, and document controls. Enterprise systems: Understand how tools, platforms, and teams support business operations. You'll build a foundation for a career in technology operations, systems analysis, IT management, or technology delivery. What We Offer Meaningful project work and real responsibility. items.desc: Cosa aspettarti Siamo uno dei principali gruppi tecnologici in Italia e operiamo come Business & Technology Accelerator di Aziende, Istituzioni Finanziarie e Servizi Pubblici, supportando l’evoluzione delle loro strategie IT e digitali. Con un ecosistema di imprese che condividono valori e visione, aiutiamo i clienti a cogliere i benefici della tecnologia, amplificandone l’impatto positivo su economia e società. Entrerai nella Direzione Sustainability, Risk & Compliance di Dedagroup e affiancherai le società del Gruppo nella gestione dei rischi e nell'evoluzione del sistema di compliance. Ti occuperai di normative in ambito privacy, intelligenza artificiale, resilienza operativa digitale, responsabilità amministrativa degli enti (D.Lgs. 231/2001) e anticorruzione. Collaborerai con le diverse funzioni aziendali per tradurre i requisiti normativi in processi e strumenti concreti stabiliti dalla Capogruppo. Cosa farai Supporterai le società del Gruppo negli adempimenti previsti dal GDPR e dalla normativa sulla protezione dei dati personali, inclusi i trattamenti effettuati con sistemi di intelligenza artificiale. Contribuirai all'adeguamento ai requisiti dell'AI Act e alla definizione di procedure per un utilizzo responsabile e conforme dell'intelligenza artificiale, valutando l'impatto delle tecnologie emergenti su processi, prodotti e servizi. Supporterai l'analisi dei requisiti DORA applicabili e l'adeguamento di processi e documentazione aziendale. Contribuirai all'implementazione, al mantenimento e all'aggiornamento dei Modelli 231, dei presidi anticorruzione e del sistema di whistleblowing. Parteciperai ad audit e assessment, monitorando i controlli interni e le azioni di miglioramento. Aggiornerai policy, procedure e linee guida aziendali in linea con l'evoluzione normativa. Supporterai le funzioni aziendali nella gestione dei requisiti di compliance previsti dai contratti con i clienti, contribuendo all'analisi delle clausole e alla predisposizione della documentazione e delle evidenze richieste. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te Laurea ed almeno 3 anni di esperienza in compliance o nei sistemi di controllo interno. Conoscenza dei principali requisiti di GDPR, AI Act, DORA, D.Lgs. 231/2001, whistleblowing e anticorruzione (es. ISO 37001). Esperienza in audit, assessment e nella redazione di policy e procedure. Buona conoscenza di Microsoft 365. Precisione, capacità di analisi, problem solving, autonomia e attitudine alla collaborazione. Nice to have: Esperienza in gruppi complessi o società di consulenza; Ottime capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale; Proattività e forte senso di responsabilità. Cosa ti offriamo Work life balance grazie a un modello di lavoro agile personalizzato e flessibile Coinvolgimento in progetti strategici e innovativi per la trasformazione digitale della sanità pubblica Valori da condividere; possibilità di crescita, formazione e certificazione supportati dall’azienda – scopri la vita in Deda Se ritieni di possedere le competenze richieste, anche con un livello di seniority non pienamente allineato a quello indicato, ti invitiamo comunque a candidarti: durante la selezione valuteremo attentamente il tuo grado di esperienza professionale. Il range retributivo indicato nell'annuncio si riferisce al livello di seniority esplicitato; un’eventuale diversa valutazione durante l'iter selettivo potrà determinare un adeguamento al range salariale corrispondente.

Entrerai a far parte del team Risk Models di Capogruppo , una
items.desc: Siamo uno dei più grandi gruppi bancari privati e indipendenti italiani che fonda le sue radici in una storia imprenditoriale lunga 450 anni e caratterizzata da innovazione e apertura. Stiamo lavorando per costruire l’ecosistema finanziario sostenibile del futuro con l’obiettivo di contribuire alle sfide personali e imprenditoriali dei nostri clienti. Entrerai a far parte del team Risk Models di Capogruppo , una squadra di professionisti che lavora allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione di modelli per il presidio e la gestione di rischi sempre più complessi, legati anche a business e contesti in continua trasformazione. Siamo innovativi per tradizione e anche nello sviluppo dei modelli sperimentiamo nuovi approcci, tecnologie e modalità di lavoro. In questo contesto, la qualità e l’affidabilità dei dati rappresentano un elemento fondamentale. Se ti interessa lavorare all’intersezione tra dati, rischio di credito, normativa e innovazione tecnologica , contribuendo in prima persona all’evoluzione dei nostri modelli e processi, potresti essere la persona che stiamo cercando. Nel ruolo ti occuperai di: coordinare ed eseguire le attività di raccolta, analisi e controllo della qualità dei dati utilizzati per lo sviluppo e la ricalibrazione dei modelli di rischio di credito; disegnare ed eseguire controlli di completezza, coerenza e correttezza delle informazioni presenti nelle basi dati utilizzate per la stima dei parametri PD, LGD ed EAD ; contribuire alla governance delle attività di Data Quality , assicurando il rispetto dei requisiti previsti dalla normativa CRR III ; definire e governare i processi di Data Management e Data Quality in ambito AIRB e nell’utilizzo di modelli basati sull’Intelligenza Artificiale; analizzare anomalie e criticità relative ai dati, individuarne le cause e contribuire alla definizione delle relative azioni correttive; predisporre report e documentazione a supporto delle verifiche svolte e delle evidenze emerse; collaborare con le diverse strutture aziendali coinvolte nella gestione dei dati e dei modelli, interfacciandoti anche con l’ IT per la definizione e l’evoluzione delle regole di Data Quality; contribuire al miglioramento e all’automazione dei controlli e dei processi di analisi , anche attraverso l’utilizzo di tecnologie di Intelligenza Artificiale. Chi cerchiamo Una persona con una solida capacità analitica, curiosità verso l’innovazione e interesse a lavorare in un contesto in cui Data Quality, Risk Management e tecnologia sono fortemente interconnessi. In particolare, ricerchiamo: laurea magistrale in discipline quantitative, economiche, informatiche o ingegneristiche ; almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ambito Data Quality, Data Management o Data Governance , maturata preferibilmente nel settore bancario, finanziario o nella consulenza; esperienza nella definizione, esecuzione e monitoraggio di controlli di qualità del dato e nella gestione delle relative anomalie; conoscenza di almeno uno tra SQL, SAS o Python ; buona conoscenza dei principali concetti e processi di Data Management e Data Governance ; esperienza nella collaborazione con funzioni IT per la definizione e l’evoluzione di regole e controlli di Data Quality; capacità di organizzare e pianificare le attività in autonomia, lavorando efficacemente in modo trasversale con interlocutori e funzioni differenti; interesse verso l’utilizzo dell’ Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa e dei Large Language Models (LLM) come strumenti per rendere più efficienti e automatizzare le attività di controllo, analisi e monitoraggio dei dati. Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio, capacità di problem solving e sintesi , proattività e orientamento al miglioramento continuo completano il profilo. Costituiranno un plus conoscenza della normativa prudenziale bancaria, con particolare riferimento a CRR III ed EBA Guidelines ; conoscenza del framework AIRB e dei principali parametri di rischio di credito PD, LGD ed EAD ; familiarità con le architetture dati tipiche del settore bancario; conoscenza di strumenti di reporting e data visualization ; esperienza nella predisposizione di documentazione metodologica e operativa. items.desc: Job Description Key Activities Progettare e sviluppare algoritmi di analisi dati e Intelligenza Artificiale applicati a misure provenienti da sensori avanzati (profilometri, sistemi di visione e fotocamere industriali), con l'obiettivo di identificare automaticamente le metriche/KPI di qualità per la caratterizzazione dei macchinari. E’ l’evoluzione delle soluzioni sviluppate durante il lavoro di tesi, estendendone l'applicazione ad altri processi. Analizzare la struttura e il contenuto dei file di log provenienti dai macchinari industriali e dai simulatori e sviluppare applicazioni software basate su tecniche di Intelligenza Artificiale e Machine Learning per l'estrazione automatica di informazioni significative a costruire feedback robusti al processo di progettazione. Realizzare algoritmi per il riconoscimento di anomalie, pattern ricorrenti e condizioni di guasto a partire dai dati raccolti durante i test prototipali. Inoltre si vuole ricercare la correlazione eventi per individuare relazioni causa-effetto tra parametri macchina, eventi log, allarmi e performance sui prodotti finali. Sviluppare sistemi di interrogazione in linguaggio naturale per consentire al personale tecnico Biesse di accedere rapidamente alle informazioni contenute nei database di tutti i report di validazione memorizzati in formati e in repository eterogenei. Collaborare con progettisti meccanici e software per identificare i parametri critici da monitorare durante le fasi di sviluppo prodotto. In particolare contribuire a creare modelli predittivi per anticipare comportamenti anomali e supportare le attività di miglioramento del progetto. Fornire supporto e formazione al personale tecnico nell'utilizzo degli strumenti di analisi sviluppati.

items.desc: Introduction Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. Overview In the role of an International Account Handler Junior, you'll manage insurance needs from first enquiry through to renewal, helping clients find practical solutions that fit their individual circumstances. You'll work closely with colleagues in Italy and the UK, combining client service, relationship building, and commercial awareness to support both new and existing business. How you'll make an impact Support international clients with their insurance needs from first contact through to renewal. Build trusted relationships with diplomats, expatriates, and internationally mobile professionals living in Italy. Manage enquiries across multiple insurance products and guide clients through available options. Help maintain high service standards by responding promptly to client requests and resolving queries efficiently. Contribute to new business growth by identifying opportunities to support prospective clients. Support renewal activity and maintain regular communication with existing clients throughout the policy lifecycle. Represent Gallagher at in-person meetings and events with key organisations, including United Nations-related contacts in Italy. Collaborate with colleagues in Italy and the UK to deliver a consistent and personal client experience. About you Here's what you'll bring to the role: Interest in developing a career within insurance, financial services, or client relationship management. Previous customer service, account support, administration, hospitality, or sales experience would be helpful, although transferable skills are equally valued. Fluency in both Italian and English, with the ability to communicate confidently with a diverse international client base. Qualification in business, economics, insurance, finance, or a related field would be beneficial, but we're equally interested in transferable skills and a willingness to learn. Organised and detail-focused approach when handling confidential information. Confidence to manage multiple client requests while maintaining a high level of accuracy. Customer-focused mindset and genuine interest in helping people find the right solutions. Ability to work independently while staying closely connected to a distributed team. Starting salary in accordance with the National Collective Barganing Agreement for personnel working in the Tertiary, Distribution and Services sector (the “CCNL”), 1° livello.

items.desc: We are a world leader in renewable energies utility looking for a highly skilled Civil Engineer with previous experience leading the civil engineering of wind farms or pv-plants in Italy. As member of an international team, you will perform a key function in the engineering of the onshore plants being developed in Italy and would be required to develop further projects in other countries, if needed. You’d play a role in the whole cycle of engineering. You will be the engineer manager responsible for leading from the technical, economic and planning point of view, the complete wind farms civil engineering and solar PV farms civil works in all phases of project development. Ensuring compliance of execution of projects targets in terms of Health, Safety and Environment, Quality, CAPEX and Schedule according with the Company Business Plan. You will work with different internal departments such as business development, offers, construction, networks, purchase, quality and environment, O&M, and also externally with developers, the Administration, certification companies, subcontractors, and others. The position will be in our offices located in Rome . MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES Responsible for specifying the scope and design criteria of the complete wind farm and solar PV civil engineering required in each phase of the project, from bidding, due diligence, greenfield, licensing, to detailed and constructive engineering, in coordination with the different internal teams. Responsible for specifying, supervising and validating technically the services that need to be outsourced in each case, as well as coordinating with the different internal areas involved in the design of wind projects, with direct responsibility. The activities would be: Developing and validation of the basic, tendering and detailed civil engineering for Wind Farm and PV Solar Projects. Validation of wind turbine lay-out supplied by the Wind Resource team taking into account the limitations of the project (environmental, land, affected authorities, etc.), from a civil point of view. Definition and validation of the internal and external roads lay-out, crane pads (3D model) and trenches. Definition and validation of the technical solutions to be adopted in the design of the low/medium voltage evacuation infrastructures with the technical supervision of the Networks engineering team. Definition and supervision of topography works. Geotechnical works definition and supervision. Pull Out Test for PV Plant´s structures (fixed and/or tracker) Foundations for wind turbines and for PV Plant structures (fixed and/or tracker) following internal Technical Specifications. Specification and technical validation of hydrological studies and hydraulic calculations. Definition of complete project: Design of the junction projects, as well as the definitions for technical solution for the rest of the utilities affected by the project’s infrastructures. Preparation of descriptive drawings and documentation of the project in collaboration with the internal areas involved: memory, specifications, Health and Safety study, etc. Visits to the sites to analyse the location and the aspects to be considered in the design. Managing the external engineering companies responsible for providing civil engineering services. Responsible for organizing and leading the project engineering follow up meetings.. Responsible for the civil technical supervision of offers and contracts with suppliers. Responsible for reporting to the Project Manager the status of the engineering project for all scopes, identifying potential problems and solutions, monitoring the planning and action plans for delays, economic control and others. Responsible for identifying, registering and spreading the lessons learned in each of the projects to the rest of the organization and countries. Responsible for identifying potential design improvements to be requested from wind turbine manufacturers and other equipment suppliers in order to achieve continuous technical and economic improvement in the projects. Responsible for ensuring compliance with the Quality, Environmental and Health and Safety standards required by Iberdrola. Represent the company with relevant stakeholders, such as agencies and institutions, both public and private, in relation to matters relating to its responsibilities INTERFACES: Internal: Development department, project department (solar engineering, offers, energy resource, networks, construction), global engineering department, operation and maintenance, investment office, main equipment and contracts department, procurement department, corporate areas of the group (corporate development, control, finance, etc.), as well as other corporate departments if any. External: engineering companies, renewable developers, suppliers, technical certification companies, as well as other external companies and stakeholders if it is necessary. items.desc: embecta is a global medical device company with a 100-year legacy in insulin delivery and diabetes care. Driven by innovation, purpose, and a commitment to improving lives, we are expanding our portfolio of solutions to serve even more patients, healthcare providers, and communities around the world. We are looking for a Master Data Specialist to own and optimize the data foundations that support reporting, analytics, and business decision-making across our international business. You will be responsible for integrating data from Salesforce, SAP, IQVIA, and other key systems into a centralized, trusted, and scalable data environment. This role will lead the management of customer master data, account hierarchies, territory mappings, and reporting structures across more than 100 countries. You will drive improvements in data quality, governance, and automation while enhancing Power BI and Excel reporting capabilities to deliver accurate, actionable business insights. Working closely with Commercial Excellence, IT, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional teams, you will help standardize data processes, support Salesforce data management, and identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot. This is an exciting opportunity for a data professional who enjoys turning complex data into meaningful business value. Key Responsibilities Data Integration & Extract, Transform & Load Pipelines Design, build, and maintain ETL processes connecting Salesforce, IQVIA, SAP, and additional data sources. Develop automated, schedule‑based data pipelines with robust error‑handling and alerting mechanisms. Centralize all locally purchased data assets (e.g., IQVIA) into a single environment Support the Monthly Business Review (MBR) data pipeline and reporting infrastructure. Data Cleaning & Quality Assurance Implement standardized data‑cleaning protocols and validation frameworks. Identify and resolve data‑quality issues at source or within transformation layers. Build and maintain data‑quality dashboards and metrics to monitor ongoing data health across all regions. Salesforce & Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Data Management Maintain accurate account hierarchies and customer master data in Salesforce. Troubleshoot issues related to Salesforce‑to‑analytics data synchronization. Ensure data consistency across all Salesforce environments and connected systems. Account Mapping & Customer Master Data Maintain and update global account hierarchies and territory mappings. Develop and enforce standardized account‑naming conventions across regions. Create and manage account‑to‑cluster mapping tables. Manage account mergers, divestitures, and organizational structure changes. Power BI Infrastructure & Optimization Set up and optimize Power BI data models, using both DirectQuery and Import modes. Create reusable templates and design standards to support scalable Power BI development. Monitor and improve query performance across Power BI datasets and semantic models. AI & Automation Opportunities Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual data‑processing workload. Evaluate AI‑enabled features (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) in collaboration with IT to enhance data workflows. Develop scripts or tools to automate repetitive validation and transformation tasks. Education and Experience Third-level qualification (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Analytics Tools & Platforms Proficiency in Power BI including advanced DAX measures, calculated tables, and complex data‑modelling formulas. Strong command of Microsoft Excel for data manipulation, analysis, and model building. Working knowledge of the Salesforce ecosystem, including custom fields, workflows, data models, and data‑quality structures. Familiarity with IQVIA, SAP, and other data systems commonly used in pharmaceutical and medical device environments. Strong problem‑solving mindset with a high level of attention to detail. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business‑friendly language. Collaborative approach to partnering with regional teams, business analysts, and cross‑functional stakeholders. Strong documentation discipline and a process‑oriented working style. Desirable Skills Experience with Python or R for data manipulation and automation. embecta is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. items.desc: Siamo alla ricerca di un/a Software Test Engineer motivato/a da inserire nel nostro team operante nel settore Automotive . In questo ruolo ti occuperai della definizione, dello sviluppo e dell'esecuzione di test case funzionali per software embedded e centraline elettroniche di bordo, con un focus verticale su sistemi HMI e Infotainment (IVI) . Lavorerai a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali, conducendo attività di validazione su banchi prova automatizzati ed estendendo progressivamente i collaudi alla validazione a bordo veicolo, per garantire elevati standard di qualità e affidabilità. Responsabilità principali Definire, redigere e manutenere le specifiche di test funzionali per HMI, Infotainment e sottosistemi elettronici correlati, includendo casi limite ( edge cases ) e scenari negativi. Eseguire test funzionali su banchi prova automatizzati, validando il comportamento del software, le logiche di interazione utente e le funzionalità di sistema. Utilizzare i tool dell'ecosistema Vector (es. CANoe, CANalyzer) per simulazione di rete, monitoraggio della comunicazione su bus e attività di troubleshooting. Analizzare i log e i report di test, identificare e tracciare le anomalie, supportando la root cause analysis in collaborazione con il team di sviluppo. Gestire la documentazione di collaudo, assicurando la tracciabilità bidirezionale tra requisiti e casi di test e gestendo il ciclo di vita dei difetti tramite piattaforme ALM. Requisiti richiesti Laurea (triennale o magistrale) in Ingegneria Elettronica, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Elettrica o discipline tecnico-scientifiche equivalenti. Esperienza pregressa nel testing e nella validazione di software embedded, con preferenza per contesti automotive HMI, Infotainment o Cockpit. Esperienza pratica e consolidata con la strumentazione Vector (in particolare CANoe e CANalyzer). Conoscenza dei principali protocolli di comunicazione su bus automotive (es. CAN, CAN FD, Automotive Ethernet). Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata), necessaria per l'interazione con team e stakeholder globali. Requisiti preferenziali (Nice to Have) Esperienza operativa su banchi di test HIL ( Hardware-in-the-Loop ) ed esecuzione di campagne di test automatizzate. Familiarità con strumenti ALM e di Requirements Management (es. Jira, Polarion, PTC Windchill o IBM DOORS). Esperienza pratica in attività di collaudo e validazione direttamente su veicolo ( in-vehicle testing ). Crescita Continua: Accesso a laboratori interni all'avanguardia e percorsi di carriera in un settore solido e in forte espansione. In Kineton troverai un ambiente inclusivo dove le tue idee saranno valorizzate e supportate. Offriamo percorsi di formazione continua, spazi di lavoro progettati per il benessere e la collaborazione. Il nostro approccio è basato sulla fiducia, sull'eccellenza e sulla crescita condivisa. Porta il tuo talento in un'azienda che non solo abbraccia l'innovazione, ma la guida. Do Work That Matters - Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? items.desc: Chi siamo Aira è un'azienda svedese fondata nel 2022 dal Gruppo Vargas ; ad oggi siamo più di 1000 dipendenti tra le varie sedi in Europa e stiamo continuando a crescere. La nostra sede centrale è a Stoccolma, in Svezia e operiamo in Italia , Germania e Regno Unito . La produzione interna dei nostri prodotti a marchio Aira avviene nello stabilimento produttivo in Polonia . Il nostro obiettivo è rendere accessibile la creazione di case intelligenti e sostenibili e contribuire a un mondo più ecologico. Le nostre pompe di calore aria-acqua sfruttano l'energia dell'aria esterna insieme a una piccola quantità di elettricità per mantenere un comfort termico ottimale in casa, combinate con la tecnologia del fotovoltaico . Scopri di più sul nostro sito su di noi e sui nostri prodotti . Il ruolo Per la sede centrale di Lainate (Milano nord-ovest) siamo alla ricerca di un Junior PV Design Engineer da inserire nel team di Design Engineer , con un orientamento tecnico e progettuale, che si occupi di supportare la progettazione di impianti fotovoltaici residenziali su scala nazionale. Principali responsabilità: Supportare lo sviluppo di progetti tecnici di impianti fotovoltaici residenzial i, comprensivi di schemi elettrici, layout, dimensionamenti e documentazione tecnica; Eseguire analisi di fattibilità tecnico-elettrica, valutando vincoli installativi, ombreggiamenti e capacità dell’impianto elettrico esistente; Utilizzare software di progettazione fotovoltaica (es. PVSyst, Autocad, Solar-Edge Designer o equivalenti) per la definizione delle soluzioni tecniche; Curare la predisposizione delle pratiche autorizzative (connessione, GSE, ENEA, ecc.) e interfacciarsi con gli enti preposti; Supportare il progetto gli impianti garantendo il pieno rispetto delle normative elettriche CEI, dei requisiti GSE e degli standard tecnici e qualitativi aziendali; Supportare la rete commerciale per lo sviluppo della soluzione tecnico economica Gestire attività di back office legate alla progettazione e documentazione. Il tuo profilo Conoscenza di base del settore fotovoltaico, nell'ambito progettazione o installazione; Diploma o laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Energetica o discipline tecniche affini; Conoscenza di base degli impianti elettrici in BT e delle normative di riferimento (CEI 0-21, CEI 64-8, ecc.); Conoscenza di base della materia normativa tecnico-fiscale; Buone capacità di problem-solving tecnico, orientamento al risultato, precisione e proattività. Cosa ti offriamo Assunzione diretta con contratto a tempo determinato/stage; Affiancamento e percorsi di sviluppo professionale; Ambiente giovane, stimolante e internazionale; Opportunità di crescita in un’azienda in forte espansione nel settore delle energie rinnovabili; Possibilità di contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di soluzioni sostenibili per migliaia di famiglie. La sede di lavoro sarà Lainate . È prevista la possibilità di lavorare in smartworking e garantiamo flessibilità ai nostri dipendenti. La ricerca è rivolta ad entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77). Si invitano gli interessati/e ad inviare un C.V. con aut. tratt. dati (D.Lgs. 196/2003) In Aira, promuoviamo l’energia di nuova generazione con un impegno verso diversità e inclusione. Crediamo che una forza lavoro eterogenea alimenti innovazione e ci permetta di servire meglio comunità e clienti. Accogliamo persone di ogni cultura e prospettiva, rifiutando ogni forma di discriminazione, per costruire insieme un futuro migliore per il pianeta. Sei pronto a trovare un reale significato nel tuo lavoro? Ci piacerebbe che tu ti unissi a noi. Candidati ora.

Fluency in both Italian and English, written and spoken. items.desc: Data Analyst - Transaction Banking At a glance Are you a Data Analyst, who is fascinated by the financial sector and eager to explore the world of banking products & transaction data? Do you want to be part of a team of young and highly motivated Data Professionals, who are entrusted and empowered to make use of data for strategic, regulatory, operational, and tactical decision making? Does the idea of an autonomous team with the freedom to learn, grow and make impact sound exciting? The BI & Analytics Center of Expertise is this and more! Your job In your role as a Data Analyst, you: Act as a data sparring partner with business stakeholders on smart KPIs & reports, with relevant insights for the right audience. Understand underlying processes for different products & services, and connect the dots. Work both in individual contributor roles (leading project) and in collaboration / co-creating with multiple analysts. Engage in complex long term projects, with focus on continuous delivery in small increments. Extract actionable insights from large data sources, perform recurring or ad hoc analyses / reports. Can conduct data research/analytics on different datasets (products, transactions, channels, customers, CRM/ sales). Have the opportunity to develop your data science skills by collaborating with the Advanced Analytics & AI CoE on experiments and proof-of-concepts, and translate business questions into valuable Advanced Analytics and AI use cases. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and manage different stakeholders. Practice the art of storytelling through numbers and effective visualization technique. Organize your work in a structured manner and effectively communicate to all parties involved. Focus on continuous improvement and automation of existing deliverables. Be curious, ask enough questions to deep dive and not hesitate to change/ challenge the status quo. Remain proactive in coming up with ideas to improve/ solve (technical/ business/ data) challenges. Working environment We are the Transaction Banking Data Domain, part of the Transaction Banking Value Stream. This value stream covers a vast portfolio of products: accounts, payment cards, packages, savings, insurances, open banking APIs, trade finance, digital products like Apple Pay/ Google Pay, and associated sales, business & risk management processes. We contribute significantly to the revenue of the bank, manage different regulatory and operational topics, and contribute to Objectives and Key Results set for the Personal & Business Banking Client Unit, serving about 6 million Personal & Business Banking customers. The Transaction Banking Data Domain is composed by three Centers of Expertise: 1) The BI & Analytics CoE (BI&A CoE), a team of data analysts responsible for the BI & Reporting and Data Analytics, 2) The Advanced Analytics & AI Center of Expertise (AA&AI CoE), a team of Data Scientists responsible for the portfolio of AA&AI use cases in line with the strategy of the Data Domain and the bank-wide AI Strategy, 3) The Data Products CoE (DP CoE), a team of Data Product Owners and Data Stewards responsible for the creation and bank-wide use of Data Products and the Data Management of the sources that are part of our Data Domain. In addition, the Data Domain is responsible for our cloud-based data and analytics platform with the Transaction Banking Domain Data Store (DDS). The team’s vision is to stimulate an environment where data is vital to everything we do. We apply analytics and emerging technologies (like GenAI) to explore, research and gather valuable insights; we define, report & monitor and improve performance for several product groups; advise them on new proposition designs and duty of care topics; predict and forecast trends of product’s usage; help decide the course of action and setting priorities to achieve great customer satisfaction and vendor relations. We also act as change agents to embed a data driven mindset at all levels of the organization enabling them to get the full potential of the data that we have, thereby strengthening data maturity and literacy in the bank. All our Data Analysts and Scientists have T-shaped profiles and next to data analytics and data science they can play different roles like:Subject Matter Experts, Business Liaisons etc. The Transaction Banking Data Domain consist of 40+ members and are based across the Netherlands and India. We value diversity and inclusion and the team atmosphere is dynamic, open and informal. We follow agile principles and work on cross departments and cross functional initiatives while collaborating with business experts, business developers, product owners, seniors and leaders – hence providing a golden opportunity for networking and serving as a knowledge haven. We have developed a culture where entrepreneurial spirit, empathy, element of fun and celebrating successes is truly appreciated. We do this by respecting and living bank’s values: Care, Courage and …

items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als Data Engineer Databricks Als Databricks Engineer voel jij je helemaal thuis in moderne data-omgevingen waarin technologie, structuur en samenwerking samenkomen. Je werkt met grote hoeveelheden data, zet complexe informatiestromen om in schaalbare en betrouwbare data-oplossingen en bouwt de fundamenten waarop organisaties kunnen vertrouwen. Jij zorgt dat data beschikbaar, veilig en bruikbaar is, in een vorm die direct waarde levert voor BI, analytics en AI. Je werkt binnen de Databricks stack en bouwt robuuste datapipelines, Lakehouse-architecturen en schaalbare datalagen. Met onder andere Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog en Databricks Workflows automatiseer en optimaliseer je dataverwerking, governance en beheer. Je begrijpt hoe data door een organisatie stroomt en weet deze processen continu te verbeteren, met aandacht voor prestaties, betrouwbaarheid en kosten. Bij klanten ben je een technische sparringpartner die complexe vraagstukken vertaalt naar praktische Databricks-oplossingen. Je communiceert helder, denkt mee over requirements en adviseert over de beste technische aanpak. Je werkt intensief samen met Data Scientists, Data Architects en businessteams. Vanuit jouw ervaring coach je ook junior en medior engineers. Binnen Sogeti krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien op jouw manier. Ook krijg je de kans om workshops te geven, collega’s te begeleiden en bij te dragen aan frameworks en initiatieven binnen onze data-community. items.desc: Your Mission, Should You Choose to Accept It Good data makes great things happen. And at The Social Hub, we're building the data foundations to make our next big moves in analytics, automation and AI possible. As our Data Engineer, you'll bring together data from across our hotels, guest experiences, memberships and business operations, turning scattered information into something reliable, useful and ready to make an impact. Working with Microsoft Fabric, PySpark and Azure, you'll build the pipelines and data models that power smarter decisions across the business. You'll join our Data Strategy & AI team, working closely with data analysts, data scientists and AI engineers to turn ambitious ideas into working solutions. There's plenty to build, improve and figure out along the way, so if you like solving tricky problems and making things work better, we'd love to meet you. In Case You Don't Know Who We Are Known for being the rule breakers in hospitality, TSH is a fun, creative and inspiring environment where everyone can work, stay, learn and play and most importantly – be themselves. As an employer we look, act and think like a hotel, but instead we offer a lot more. Think student accommodation, long and short stay options, gyms, talks, events, rooftop bar and eat & drink escapes as well as community and coworking spaces. Located in The Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Italy, France, Spain, Portugal, and the UK, with several new openings on the way, this hybrid hospitality concept may take root in the heart of Europe, but our plans are set for going global. What You'll Do Build and maintain data pipelines that bring information from our hotels, CRM, finance, feedback tools and other systems into Microsoft Fabric. Transform and clean large datasets using PySpark, Python and SQL, making data reliable and easy to work with. Create well-structured data models that power business reporting and analytics. Connect new data sources through APIs, cloud storage and Azure services. Manage development across Dev, Test and Production environments using Git and Azure DevOps. Set up monitoring and alerts to spot pipeline failures and data quality issues before they become bigger problems. Work with analysts and AI teams to make curated data available through Power BI and Fabric Apps. Troubleshoot production issues, document your work and keep improving how we build and manage data pipelines. What You'll Have You have at least 4 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a related data platform role. You bring strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python, plus experience with PySpark and Delta Lake or similar technologies. You have experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or another Spark-based cloud data platform. You understand lakehouse architecture, bronze/silver/gold data layers, data modelling and ETL/ELT pipelines. You have experience with APIs, Git-based workflows and CI/CD, ideally within Azure DevOps. You can work independently, solve technical problems and explain complex topics clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues. You bring an ownership mindset, an interest in AI and automation, and a good understanding of data privacy and GDPR. Experience with Power BI, customer data deduplication or hospitality is a plus. What We Offer The opportunity to work at a dynamic, multi-national company. Not just another hotel - we're a game changing innovator, challenging every convention and defining the future The opportunity to work for a Certified B Corp® company that balances profit with positive impact, collaborating with organizations like Movement on the Ground and the TSH Talent Foundation to create meaningful change The chance to learn and grow in your role with the potential for future growth Awesome discounts in all our properties in Europe and not just for you, but also for your friends and family! A wonderful workplace to call home, full of events, fun colleagues and all the other amazing salary/benefits stuff At The Social Hub, we believe pay should be fair and consistent. That's why we carefully determine your starting salary based on the role, your assessed proficiency, and our salary framework. We make our best and fairest offer upfront, so we don't negotiate salaries. Because fairness shouldn't depend on who negotiates best. Who you are, is how we want you to be. To us, hybrid hospitality goes across the board, from how we service our guests to how we represent ourselves. Here, everyone belongs, and we welcome people no matter their nationality, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion or culture. Your authenticity keeps our team diverse. Come as you are.

items.desc: Within Real Estate & Facility Contracting (RE&FC), KLM is undertaking one of the largest and most strategic real estate transitions in its history. This includes a number of interconnected projects, such as the construction of the new Cargo Terminal and catering facility, and the development of new offices—all driven by the relocation agreement with Schiphol. At the same time, RE&FC is increasingly moving from being a user of real estate to becoming an owner or tenant, with a significant impact on our balance sheet and cash flows. As Project Controller for RE&FC, you’ll be at the heart of this dynamic, helping steer the way forward. You’ll act as a strategic business partner, financial conscience and guardian of processes, with direct exposure to KLM’s senior management and external stakeholders, including investors, project developers and government authorities. Your decisions and advice can influence public opinion. RE&FC is part of Finance and has its own Controlling team, which is set to play an increasingly strategic role as the business grows its position as a real estate owner and increasingly as a tenant. The Project Controller role calls for an entrepreneurial mindset, strong planning and organisational skills, and the ability to focus on both short- and long-term goals. What will you do? As part of RE&FC’s multidisciplinary team, you’ll ensure strong programme governance, transparency and financial stability in a dynamic environment. items.desc: Tiered Approach In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby: Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026. Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply. Background UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP’s policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting-edge global perspectives and advocacy. In this context, UNDP invests in the Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan. Within the GPN, the Crisis Bureau, under the Governance, Rule of Law and Peacebuilding Hub, guides UNDP’s corporate strategies around the various aspects of peacebuilding, governance, justice, rule of law and human rights. Crisis Bureau staff provide global strategic advice to UNDP management and technical advice to regional hubs and Country Offices; advocate for UNDP corporate messages, represent UNDP at multi-stakeholder fora, and engage in UN inter-agency coordination in specific thematic areas. As part of the Global Policy Network (GPN, the Crisis Bureau works in an integrated manner with UNDP’s Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) ensuring that issues are fully integrated into UNDP’s development programmes. The Crisis Bureau (CB) is galvanizing UNDP’s efforts to support countries to build strong public institutions, promote governance and rule of law while working fully through the peacebuilding cycle from prevention to response. UNDP seeks to ensure that development perspectives are introduced as early as possible in response and recovery cycles, including approaching recovery as an opportunity to reset development practices onto more resilient, green, and equitable pathways. UNDP’s corporate Crisis Offer seeks to consolidate and upgrade UNDP’s crisis mechanisms to break the cycle of protracted crisis and fragility; to get ahead of the crisis curve through anticipating and preventing crises; and to sustain development throughout crisis by investing in hope – from jobs to justice. These efforts seek to mitigate potential shocks and disruptions, protect hard-won development gains, and to provide sustained accompaniment throughout crises, and to pursue pathways out of crisis and build longer-term resilience. The CB supports Regional Bureaux (RBx) and Country Offices (COs) to ensure risk-informed and preventive approaches are integrated into development plans, priorities, and programmes. Bureau guides UNDP’s corporate crisis-related strategies and vision for crisis prevention, response, and recovery. Part of the Crisis Bureau, the Operations Specialist, under the Global Programme for Strengthening the Rule of Law, Human Rights, Justice and Security for Sustainable Peace and Development, Phase V (2026-2029) within the Governance, Rule of Law and Peacebuilding Hub is responsible for the financial, administrative, and operational oversight of the Global Programme and will support UNDP Country Offices receiving and managing Global Programme resources at the regional and country level. The Global Programme is guided by and aligned to UNDP’s 2026-2029 Strategic Plan and its successor plan and is widely recognized for its ability to mobilize funds, provide technical and strategic expertise, and collaborate and coordinate across UN entities to enable more holistic, coherent, people centered, and comprehensive responses to rule of law, justice, and human rights challenges. The Operations Specialist will report to the Programme Manager, and work in close collaboration with the Crisis Bureau Operations Team as well as thew broader Global Programme Team and operations colleagues. Individuals from minority groups, indigenous groups and persons with disabilities are equally encouraged to apply. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Our analysts also work closely with the AI team, a group of about 15 specialists, so you are never the only one with the answer. Your mentor is an experienced analyst located in Oslo, Fornebu. You work closely together every day on method, data quality and the hard technical questions. This role offers substantial responsibility along with guidance from someone highly skilled in the work. Build, measure, learn We work in a build, measure, learn cycle. Your analysis is put to use quickly, evaluated and improved based on what happens. You see the effect of your work, not just the report, in real business life. Work with technical colleagues to understand the data, then explain results to sales and account managers in plain language. Use AI tools and automation to make analysis faster and more reliable. You can explain a technical finding simply to someone who is not technical, and you take initiative to pick up new things quickly. items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Laboratory Setting, Office Job Description How You Will Make an Impact At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As a Hardware & Automation Field Application Scientist (FAS) within BioProduction, you will be a trusted technical partner to biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers across the UK and Nordic region. You will work primarily with process development, MSAT, operations and manufacturing teams, helping them evaluate, implement and adopt technologies that improve bioprocess performance. You will support bioprocess workflows spanning upstream and downstream activities, with a focus on hardware, single-use technologies and automation. This includes single-use bioreactors and mixers, DynaSpin harvest systems, fluid-management solutions and related process-control technologies. You will connect process requirements with equipment capabilities, workflow integration and manufacturing needs, and help customers develop, scale, transfer, optimize and troubleshoot their processes. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding why a process or system behaves the way it does and turning that understanding into practical customer solutions. You do not need experience with every platform or at every scale; strong process understanding, technical problem-solving and the ability to transfer your knowledge to new systems are more important. What You Will Do Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor for BioProduction hardware, single-use systems and automation, serving as an application-focused contact for customer process development, MSAT, operations and manufacturing teams. Support workflow development and technology integration across upstream and downstream processing, with particular emphasis on upstream bioprocessing equipment and single-use systems. Support customers with process engineering, scale-up and scale-down, technology transfer, process optimization and troubleshooting from development through manufacturing. Lead or contribute to pre- and post-sales technical activities, including workflow assessments, hardware evaluations, proof-of-principle studies, demonstrations, pilot runs and technology qualification in regulated environments. Troubleshoot process, hardware, single-use flow-path and automation issues; coordinate with Field Service, Engineering, Quality, Technical Support and other teams to support timely, compliant resolution. Advise customers on effective use and integration of bioreactors, mixers, DynaSpin systems, single-use assemblies, fluid-management solutions and related technologies. Conduct workflow consulting and structured process walks at customer sites to understand operational needs, identify improvement opportunities and align technical recommendations with customer goals. Support Bioprocessing Development Center activities and other customer demonstrations, helping deliver clear, consistent technical messaging. Develop and follow hardware and automation adoption plans with customers; agree measurable milestones such as time to first run and, where applicable, time to first GMP lot, and review utilization after implementation. Deliver technical training and design or deployment workshops for scientists, engineers and operators, and support technology adoption from development through manufacturing. Document technical engagements in Salesforce CRM and contribute technical input to account plans and risk-mitigation plans. Work closely with commercial teams and cross-functional partners, including Field Service, Product Management, R&D, Quality/Regulatory and Technical Support, to understand customer needs and resolve technical challenges. Gather and communicate Voice of Customer feedback to inform product roadmaps and support technical content such as application notes, white papers and case studies. Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant conferences, workshops, seminars and webinars through workflow-based technical presentations and demonstrations. You can apply this foundation across integrated bioprocess workflows and learn new platforms as customer needs require. We are particularly interested in candidates with meaningful experience across several of the following areas: Process development • Process engineering • Process optimization • Scale-up / scale-down • Technology transfer • Process characterization • Troubleshooting / root-cause investigation You should also bring: Strong practical understanding of bioprocess equipment and process-engineering fundamentals, including the interaction between bioreactor design, agitation, gas transfer, sensors, pumps, process control and the …

items.desc: Szukamy osoby, która połączy świat logiki procesowej z realnym programowaniem. Dla jednego z największych banków w Polsce rozwijamy cyfrowe ścieżki wnioskowe, z których każdego dnia korzystają tysiące klientów indywidualnych i biznesowych. Wokół platform low-code narosło sporo mitów o „prostym wyklikaniu aplikacji”. U nas sprawa wygląda inaczej: Eximee to narzędzie, ale rdzeniem Twojej pracy będzie konkretny kod w Javie i JavaScripcie oraz reguły w XML/XSLT. Jeśli szukasz roli, w której łączysz wpływ na finalny interfejs z solidnym inżynierskim podejściem do backendu i testów – dobrze trafiłeś. Nie pracowałeś wcześniej w Eximee? To żaden problem. Jeśli masz doświadczenie z innymi platformami low-code lub BPMS (np. Ferryt, Camunda) i swobodnie kodujesz, wdrożymy Cię w specyfikę tego środowiska. 80 zł - 100 zł an hour Czym będziesz się zajmować? Budową i optymalizacją procesów wnioskowych: od prostych formularzy po wieloetapowe ścieżki dla kont bankowych i kredytów (dla klientów indywidualnych i firm). Pełnym zakresem prac wdrożeniowych: pisaniem logiki backendowej w Javie, tworzeniem interakcji frontendowych w JavaScripcie oraz konfiguracją widoków w edytorze graficznym. Pracą z danymi: przygotowywaniem i przetwarzaniem transformacji XML/XSLT oraz integracją z bazami danych przy użyciu SQL. Dbaniem o jakość kodu: pisaniem testów jednostkowych (jUnit) i wsparciem automatyzacji (Selenium) zgodnie ze standardami SDLC. Pracą w zespole Scrumowym: realnym wpływem na to, jak projektowane są poszczególne ekrany i jak działają pod spodem. Czego oczekujemy na start? Co najmniej 3 lat doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku (programistycznym lub wdrożeniowym w obszarze aplikacji webowych). Swobody w Javie i JavaScripcie – to Twoje codzienne narzędzia do pisania logiki i zachowań formularzy. Doświadczenia z platformami low-code lub silnikami procesów (BPMS) – np. Ferryt, Camunda, Eximee lub pokrewne. Praktycznej znajomości technologii webowych: HTML i CSS (rozumiesz, jak stylować i układać nowoczesny interfejs). Dobrej znajomości: XML, XSLT oraz SQL. Obycia z narzędziami deweloperskimi: jUnit, Maven, Jenkins, BitBucket oraz Selenium. Mile widziane: Doświadczenie zdobyte w bankowości lub fintechu (znajomość specyfiki procesów kredytowych i rachunków). Znajomość narzędzi Jira i Splunk. Praktyczne wyczucie zasad UI/UX i metodyki Design Thinking. Doświadczenie w pracy w zwinnych zespołach (Scrum). Dlaczego warto dołączyć? Prawdziwy development, nie tylko klikanie: projektujesz architekturę logiki biznesowej, integrujesz usługi i piszesz kod, który rozwiązuje nietrywialne problemy.
