items.desc: Je hebt ervaring met generatieve AI, volgt alle nieuwe modellen op de voet en hebt tientallen ideeën die je gewoon móet bouwen. Bij Zonneplan maak je hier je werk van. Als GenAI Engineer bouw je aan systemen zoals Kiki, onze AI-assistent die maandelijks 120.000 gesprekken voert. Je test de nieuwste modellen (LLM's, STT's, etc.) op echte klantgesprekken, bouwt je eigen agentprototypes en brengt geslaagde experimenten samen met het team naar productie. Ons Applied GenAI Team is een gedreven afdeling met een Silicon Valley-mentaliteit: als je een goed idee hebt, gaan we het gewoon doen. Van idee naar productie in dagen, niet maanden. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en werkt met de nieuwste generatieve AI-technologie. Jouw impact bij Zonneplan Technisch eigenaar van onze GenAI-oplossingen. Je neemt end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid voor agentic systemen. Dat betekent: uitwerken, bouwen, monitoren, optimaliseren én doorontwikkelen. Hierin word je ondersteund door een developmentafdeling van 45+ data scientists, ML-engineers en developers. Ontwerp en bouw nieuwe AI-agents. Van agentic flow tot prompt engineering: jij denkt het proces uit en bepaalt hoe onze agents met klanten, collega's en systemen communiceren. Je bouwt eigen MCP’s en koppelt die binnen ons eigen agentplatform: AgentOS. Je ontwerpt evals en verbetert op basis van echte cases en feedback, onder meer met LLM-as-judge-systemen. Bouw aan de kennis en context die onze agents nodig hebben. Je zorgt dat agents de juiste informatie kunnen vinden en gebruiken. Daarvoor werken we o.a. met knowledge graphs (Neo4j) en vector databases. Automatiseer taken en denk processen opnieuw uit. Met tools als n8n bouw je workflows die het werk van collega's makkelijker maken. Je analyseert processen, ziet kansen en vertaalt die naar werkende oplossingen. Je krijgt de ruimte om zaken uit te zoeken en een betere aanpak te bouwen. Dit krijg je van ons Een salaris tussen €3.250 en €5.000 per maand, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen, en reiskostenvergoeding. Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past. Een toegewijd team met veel ervaring in generatieve AI, dat elkaar elke dag uitdaagt om bestaande werkwijzen anders aan te pakken. Veel verantwoordelijkheid en vrijheid om met de nieuwste frontiermodellen te bouwen, inclusief een Codex- óf Claude Max-abonnement. Je kiest je eigen LLM-driven developmentstack, bijvoorbeeld OpenCode, T3 Code of Pi. Claude Code en Codex zijn de basis van hoe we dagelijks bouwen. We delen experimenten, zoeken samen uit waarom een agent iets verkeerd doet en bouwen ook agents en tools voor ons eigen werk. Dit neem jij mee Je hebt een 'getting things done'-mentaliteit en bent een echte GenAI-enthousiasteling. Je hebt minimaal 1 tot 2 jaar developmentervaring, bijvoorbeeld met Python of TypeScript. Ervaring met Claude Code is een pré. Je hebt affiniteit met prompt engineering en bent bekend met concepten zoals Chain of Thought prompting en Few Shot Examples. Je neemt graag technisch eigenaarschap over systemen, analyseert processen en vertaalt kansen naar werkende oplossingen. Je werkt comfortabel samen met verschillende stakeholders en weet techniek en business goed te verbinden. Zo ziet het proces eruit 1. Solliciteer via de button op deze pagina. 2. Telefonisch kennismakingsgesprek met Samer (recruiter). 3. Eerste gesprek met Glenn (Lead GenAI) en een recruiter. 4. Tweede gesprek met een praktijkcasus, en een persoonlijkheids- en capaciteitentest. 5. Is er een match? Dan doen we je snel een aanbod. Klaar om jouw GenAI-kennis in te zetten voor plan Zero? Bij Zonneplan werken we aan één duidelijk doel: een Nederland zonder fossiele energie. Wij noemen dat plan Zero. Geen uitstoot, geen verspilling, geen afhankelijkheid. Met jouw agents help je klanten en collega's bij de stappen die daarvoor nodig zijn: van een vraag over energie tot de voorbereiding van een installatie. Zo draag jij bij aan een van de grootste uitdagingen in Nederland: de energietransitie. Heb je vragen? Bel of mail met Samer: 088 020 3012, samer.elmokdad@zonneplan.nl Please note: Proficiency in the Dutch language is required

items.card: Responsibilities: Develop software in Python, C++ and Java. Work with Linux-based development environments and Git. Develop and integrate computer-vision solutions using cameras, image processing, object detection, person detection and depth sensing. Apply robotics fundamentals, including coordinate systems, kinematics, sensors, motion control and system integration. Develop and execute software and system tests.
items.desc: Scope: 100% Start : ASAP Duration: 1-year Location : Södertälje Assignment Overview: We are looking for an experienced professional to join our robotics project. The successful candidate will contribute to the development, integration and testing of advanced robotic systems, including embedded software, image processing, computer vision, autonomous functions and safety-critical applications. Responsibilities: Develop software in Python, C++ and Java. Work with Linux-based development environments and Git. Develop and integrate computer-vision solutions using cameras, image processing, object detection, person detection and depth sensing. Apply robotics fundamentals, including coordinate systems, kinematics, sensors, motion control and system integration. Develop and execute software and system tests. Troubleshoot complex software, hardware and communication problems. Coordinate development activities, manage technical priorities and deliver project milestones. Work with embedded systems and support integration between hardware and software. Contribute to safety engineering, risk assessment, verification and validation. Work independently while collaborating effectively with engineers and project stakeholders. Lead and coordinate a technical team when required. Education: Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field. Experience: At least 10 years of relevant professional experience. Strong programming skills in Python and C++; Java experience is also required. Professional experience with embedded systems. Previous experience with computer-vision and image processing projects, including cameras, image processing, object/person detection and depth sensing. items.desc: Le Groupe Revue Fiduciaire est un éditeur juridique de référence. Nous accompagnons au quotidien les professionnels des métiers du chiffre et du droit en leur proposant des solutions fiables, pratiques et innovantes pour s’informer, se former et anticiper les évolutions de leur métier. Rejoignez une structure à taille humaine, dynamique et en constante évolution où l’ esprit d’équipe, la qualité de service et l’innovation sont au cœur de nos valeurs. Le groupe Revue Fiduciaire recrute un(e) I ngénieur qualité & Évaluation IA (F/H) en CDI. Directement rattaché(e) à la Direction des Systèmes d’information (DSI) du Groupe Revue Fiduciaire, vous intégrerez l'équipe IA qui conçoit et opère les solutions d'Intelligence Artificielle du groupe : recherche documentaire augmentée et assistants conversationnels au service des professionnels du droit et du chiffre. Dans un domaine où l'exactitude des réponses est essentielle, vous serez le garant de la qualité mesurée de nos systèmes d'IA. Vos missions principales : Évaluation des systèmes d'IA : Construction et maintenance des jeux de tests de référence, en lien avec les experts métier (juristes, documentalistes) ; Développement de pipelines d'évaluation automatisée en Python (métriques RAG, LLM-as judge) ; Campagnes de non-régression avant chaque mise en production (changement de modèle, de prompt ou d'index) ; Enrichissement des jeux de tests à partir des cas problématiques remontés par la boucle de retour terrain, pilotée par l'Ingénieur IA. Qualité en production : Exploitation de l'observabilité (traces, scores d'évaluation) et construction des tableaux de bord qualité ; Recette fonctionnelle des livraisons IA et qualification des anomalies ; Tests de robustesse : injections de prompt, hallucinations, cas limites. Contribution à la chaîne de valeur IA : Collaboration étroite avec l'IA Engineer (qui porte la boucle de retour terrain) et les Développeurs Python pour améliorer en continu la fiabilité des solutions déployées ; Veille technologique sur les frameworks et pratiques d'évaluation des LLM Le profil recherché : Formation Bac+5 (informatique, data, NLP) ; débutant accepté, une première expérience en ML, data ou QA (stage, alternance) est un plus. Bonne pratique de Python : scripts, tests, manipulation de données. Compréhension des LLM et des architectures RAG ; curiosité forte pour l'IA générative. Rigueur, esprit critique et goût de la mesure : savoir douter d'une réponse plausible mais fausse. Capacité à communiquer avec des profils variés, techniques et métier. Avantages : Rémunération sur 13 mois, statut cadre Accord de participation PEE, PERCOL Tickets restaurant (Carte Swile) Compte épargne-temps (CET) 14,5 JRTT Comité Social et Economique Télétravail (possibilité de 2 jours/semaine) Forfait mobilités durables LOCALISATION : Nos locaux sont situés dans le 10e arrondissement de Paris, au pied du métro 7 (Poissonnière) et à proximité de la Gare du Nord et de la Gare de l’Est. Pourquoi rejoindre le Groupe Revue Fiduciaire ? Rejoindre notre DSI, c'est travailler sur des projets à fort impact, en interaction avec des experts métiers et techniques. Vous contribuerez activement à la transformation digitale du groupe, dans une ambiance collaborative et bienveillante.

items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Tooling Engineer based in United Kingdom. We are looking for an AI Tooling Engineer to develop and scale an internal agentic platform that brings together company knowledge, data, and tools in one secure, accessible environment. Working closely with a Principal Engineer, you will build production-ready AI agents and integrations that help employees and their AI assistants access the information they need. You will take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and designing solutions to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using technologies such as Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), you will transform prototypes into reliable tools used across the organization. You will also establish evaluation frameworks, optimize AI performance and costs, and ensure robust security and access controls. This remote opportunity offers the chance to shape company-wide AI capabilities within a globally distributed, technology-driven team. Accountabilities You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work. Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release. Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions. Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context. Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses. Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability. Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability. Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage. Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls. Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices. Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications. Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications. Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly. Requirements The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases. Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users. Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization. Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client. Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring. Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions. Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses. Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines. Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality. Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls. Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket. Excellent written …

Working closely with a Principal Engineer, you will build production-ready AI agents and integrations that help employees and their AI assistants access the information they need. You will take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and designing solutions to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using technologies such as Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), you will transform prototypes into reliable tools used across the organization. You will also establish evaluation frameworks, optimize AI performance and costs, and ensure robust security and access controls. This remote opportunity offers the chance to shape company-wide AI capabilities within a globally distributed, technology-driven team. Accountabilities You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work. Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release. Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions. Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context. Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses. Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability. Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability. Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage. Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls. Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices. Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications. Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications. Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly. Requirements The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases. Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users. Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization. Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client. Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring. Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions. Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses. Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines. Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality. Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls. Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket. Excellent written and …

Nous sommes présents à Paris, Montréal, Shanghai, New York et Genève, avec plus de 800 consultants. 🌍 Leader mondial de l'expérience client et corporate Nous collaborons avec les marques les plus emblématiques pour assurer leur succès : ✔️ De la stratégie et l'innovation ✔️ À l'exécution à grande échelle, grâce à notre expertise en business, tech, data et IA 🤖✨ 🏆 Reconnaissances & Leadership Leader en innovation et croissance 2025 (Les Echos Business Magazine) Acteur multi-tech et partenaire Premium Salesforce 🌿 Champion d'une "Tech Responsable et Durable" Créé avec la parité hommes-femmes, défendant l’égalité grâce à une équipe de direction engagée 🌟 45 % de femmes au sein de nos équipes Campagne primée TopCom en 2024 📜 Certifications et Prix Salesforce Impact Partner 2024 Cybervadis 2025 Entreprise à impact de l'année 2024 par Choose My Company 🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈 _________________________________________________________________ Pour l'un de nos clients majeurs dans le secteur du luxe, VO2 Group recherche un(e) Développeur(se) IA / AI Engineer pour rejoindre nos équipes à Paris en CDI. Vous interviendrez au cœur de projets d'intelligence artificielle générative, avec un objectif : concevoir, développer et intégrer des solutions IA performantes, sécurisées et industrialisables, en vous appuyant sur les technologies Google Cloud et les frameworks d'IA agentique. 🎯 Votre rôle Vous accompagnerez notre client dans la construction et le déploiement de solutions d'IA générative, notamment autour du développement d'agents intelligents et de leur intégration au système d'information. Au quotidien, vous serez notamment amené(e) à : Concevoir et développer des agents IA à l'aide de LangChain, LangGraph et Google ADK Développer et intégrer des APIs et connecteurs pour interagir avec les applications et systèmes existants Construire des solutions d'IA générative sur Google Cloud et Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (GEAP) Développer et maintenir des composants backend en Python Mettre en œuvre les mécanismes de sécurité, de gestion des identités et des accès Assurer le déploiement, l'industrialisation et l'observabilité des solutions IA Optimiser la fiabilité, les performances et la maintenabilité des agents développés Collaborer avec les équipes techniques, Cloud et métiers pour garantir la bonne intégration des solutions 🔎 Le profil que nous recherchons Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en développement logiciel, idéalement sur des projets d'IA générative ou d'IA agentique, et êtes capable d'intervenir de manière autonome sur des sujets techniques, de la conception jusqu'au déploiement. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : → Python : développement backend, APIs et intégrations → LangChain / LangGraph : orchestration de workflows et d'agents IA → Google Cloud Platform (GCP) : développement et déploiement de solutions Cloud → Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (GEAP) et Google ADK → APIs et connecteurs : intégration de services et de systèmes → Sécurité, IAM et observabilité : sécurisation, supervision et suivi des solutions en production Prérequis indispensables : Expérience pratique de Claude Code et/ou OpenAI Codex Certification Claude Certified Developer – Foundations obligatoire Formation ou certification Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (GEAP) réalisée avant le démarrage sur ce périmètre 🌍 Vous évoluerez dans un environnement international : un anglais professionnel courant est indispensable pour le poste. items.desc: Du willst KI nicht nur ausprobieren, sondern produktiv bauen? Bei uns entwickelst Du KI-Anwendungen, Agenten und Automatisierungen, die intern und bei unseren Kunden im Mittelstand wirklich im Einsatz sind. Vom ersten Prototyp bis zur stabilen Lösung im Betrieb. Was Dich erwartet: KI-Anwendungen mit echtem Einsatz: Du entwickelst KI-Lösungen für unsere internen Prozesse und für Kundenprojekte, von der Idee über den Proof of Concept bis zur produktiven Anwendung. RAG, Agenten und MCP-Server: Du baust Retrieval-Augmented-Generation-Systeme, die Unternehmenswissen nutzbar machen, entwickelst KI-Agenten für konkrete Geschäftsprozesse und stellst über eigene MCP-Server die sichere Anbindung von Datenbanken, APIs und Unternehmensanwendungen bereit. Plattformübergreifende Skills und Assistenten: Du setzt Agenten und Erweiterungen für Microsoft Copilot und Copilot Studio um, entwickelst Custom GPTs und Actions im OpenAI-Ökosystem und baust Skills und Tools mit Claude. KI im SAP-Umfeld: Du entwickelst SAP spezifische „Joule Skills“ und „Joule Agents“ und setzt KI-gestützte Lösungen auf der SAP Business Technology Platform um. Automatisierung von Prozessen: Du überführst manuelle Abläufe in KI-gestützte Workflows, vor allem mit n8n, inklusive Anbindung von LLMs, APIs und Unternehmenssystemen. Enablement und Beratung: Du unterstützt unsere Entwicklungsteams beim Einsatz von Claude Code, GitHub Copilot und weiteren KI-Werkzeugen und berätst Kunden und interne Fachbereiche zu sinnvollen KI-Anwendungsfällen. Das bringst Du mit: Verständnis für KI-Technologie: Du weißt, wie Large Language Models funktionieren und kannst einschätzen, welches Modell für welchen Anwendungsfall passt. Mit Blick auf Qualität, Geschwindigkeit, Kosten und Datenschutz. Entwicklungs-Know-how: Du programmierst sicher in Python, hast idealerweise auch schon mit TypeScript oder Node.js gearbeitet und kennst die Grundlagen der API- und Backend-Entwicklung. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung: Du arbeitest gerne mit Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder vergleichbaren Coding Agents und prüfst KI-generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm blind zu vertrauen. Erste Praxis mit KI-Anwendungen: Ob im Studium, der Ausbildung, in Projekten oder aus Eigeninitiative: Du hast schon eigene Anwendungen gebaut, zum Beispiel mit RAG, Agenten, Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n oder Cloud-Services auf SAP BTP, Azure, AWS oder Google Cloud. Neugier und Eigenantrieb: Das KI-Umfeld verändert sich schnell. Du hast Lust, Dich einzuarbeiten, Neues auszuprobieren und Dich in Themen reinzudenken, die es bis letzte Woche noch nicht gab. Sprachskills: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (Niveau B2) in Wort und Schrift. Warum wir die perfekte Wahl für Dich sind: Ein eingespieltes Team: flache Hierarchien mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe: Wir suchen gezielt ein Teammitglied mit Engagement, Leidenschaft für KI-Technologien und die Arbeit mit mittelständischen Kunden. Langfristige Perspektive: Wir fördern Deine Karriere ab dem ersten Tag. Flexibles und mobiles Arbeiten: flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit auf 2 Tage mobiles Arbeiten pro Woche. Location zwischen High Performance und Wohlfühlen: sehr modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Arbeitsequipment und höhenverstellbaren Tischen. Entspannen kannst Du mit Kaffee, fritz kola Drinks oder Obst in unserem Lounge-Bereich. Benefits: 30 Urlaubstage und noch mehr, denn der 24.12. und 31.12. sind zusätzlich frei. Ein faires Gehalt, bezahlte Überstunden, Gleitzeit und Gewinnbeteiligung gelten für uns als Selbstverständlichkeit. Umfangreiche Zusatzleistungen: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gewinnbeteiligung, iPhone zur privaten Nutzung, Jobrad, Kantine und Essenszuschuss in Stuttgart, attraktive Mitarbeiter-Events

items.desc: Responsable Transformation Industrielle & Intelligence Artificielle (H/F) 📍 Paris | CDI | Package attractif + intéressement au capital Votre futur environnement Nous accompagnons un acteur innovant de l'écosystème technologique, spécialisé dans le développement et le déploiement de solutions digitales et d'intelligence artificielle pour l'industrie. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement international, nous recherchons un(e) Responsable Transformation Industrielle & IA pour accompagner de grands groupes industriels dans l'amélioration de leur performance opérationnelle grâce aux nouvelles technologies. Vos missions: Au croisement de la stratégie, de l'industrie et de l'innovation technologique, vous piloterez des projets de transformation à fort impact. À ce titre, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes : Réaliser des diagnostics de maturité digitale et opérationnelle auprès de grands comptes industriels. Identifier les opportunités d'optimisation des processus de production grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et à la data. Définir les feuilles de route de transformation industrielle en collaboration avec les directions opérationnelles. Piloter le déploiement de solutions IA et digitales, depuis le cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en production. Coordonner les différentes parties prenantes : équipes industrielles, directions générales, équipes IT et partenaires technologiques. Accompagner la conduite du changement et l'adoption des solutions sur les sites de production. Mesurer les résultats des projets à travers des indicateurs de performance : productivité, qualité, coûts et efficacité opérationnelle. Contribuer à la structuration et au déploiement de solutions reproductibles à l'échelle internationale. Votre profil: Diplômé(e) d'une grande école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation équivalente. Vous justifiez idéalement de 4 à 7 ans d'expérience en conseil en stratégie ou transformation industrielle , notamment au sein d'un cabinet de conseil reconnu. Vous avez participé à plusieurs missions de transformation de sites industriels, avec une réelle exposition aux opérations terrain. Vous comprenez les enjeux de l'industrie 4.0, de la digitalisation des processus de production et des technologies IA/Data. Vous êtes à l'aise aussi bien avec les équipes opérationnelles qu'avec des interlocuteurs de direction générale. Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse, de communication et de pilotage de projets complexes. Vous appréciez les environnements entrepreneuriaux, exigeants et orientés résultats. Une expérience sur des projets d'IA industrielle, de maintenance prédictive, de vision artificielle ou d'optimisation de la performance constitue un véritable atout. Pourquoi rejoindre cette opportunité ? Participer à des projets d'innovation industrielle auprès de grands groupes internationaux. Piloter des transformations concrètes, de la stratégie jusqu'aux résultats opérationnels. Évoluer dans un environnement entrepreneurial dynamique. Bénéficier d'une forte autonomie et d'une exposition directe aux décideurs. Accéder à de réelles perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions de direction, de Partner ou d'entrepreneuriat. Vous souhaitez aller au-delà du conseil et participer directement à la transformation des industries de demain ? Échangeons sur cette opportunité !

items.desc: Descripción del puesto: En pocas palabras 📌 Posición: AI Engineer – Supply Chain Localización: Madrid / Híbrido Experiencia: 2-4 años ¿Quieres saber más? 👇 En Insud Pharma buscamos incorporar un/a AI Engineer – Supply Chain para diseñar e implementar soluciones de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a la cadena de suministro, integradas con datos, procesos y aplicaciones internas, con foco en la automatización, la creación de agentes y la mejora de la toma de decisiones. Buscamos un perfil muy aplicado, con una orientación clara a producto e ingeniería, más enfocado en llevar casos de uso desde la idea hasta producción que en la investigación pura. Si te motiva construir soluciones reales de alto impacto en negocio, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. ¿Qué buscamos? 🔎 Una persona que quiera asumir un rol clave en el diseño, desarrollo e integración de soluciones de IA aplicadas al negocio, especialmente en el ámbito de Supply Chain, colaborando con equipos técnicos y de negocio para identificar oportunidades de automatización y optimización. ¡El reto! 🚀 Diseñar agentes y asistentes internos sobre datos de negocio. Integrar LLMs con APIs, bases de datos y herramientas internas. Construir soluciones de RAG y búsqueda sobre documentación y datos. Automatizar análisis, reporting y procesos operativos. Trabajar con fuentes como SAP, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Excel y APIs internas. Diseñar sistemas de evaluación de calidad, precisión, coste y latencia. Implementar observabilidad y trazabilidad de prompts, respuestas y tool calls. Integrar capacidades de IA dentro de aplicaciones web existentes. Colaborar con los equipos de Data Analytics y Supply Chain para identificar casos de uso de alto impacto. Garantizar la seguridad, el control de acceso y el buen uso de los datos. ¿Qué necesitas? 🤓 Experiencia de 2 a 4 años en desarrollo de soluciones de IA, software engineering o automatización aplicada a negocio. Conocimientos sólidos de Python. Experiencia con FastAPI. Conocimientos en integración y consumo de APIs REST. Experiencia con LLMs y tool calling. Experiencia en desarrollo de soluciones RAG. Conocimientos de SQL. Experiencia con tecnologías como ClickHouse y Snowflake. Manejo de herramientas como Git y Docker. Experiencia en integración con aplicaciones web. Capacidad para llevar un caso de uso desde la idea hasta producción, con enfoque práctico y visión de producto. Muy valorable Experiencia con agentes empresariales. Conocimientos de embeddings y vector databases. Experiencia en evaluación automática de LLMs. Conocimientos de Machine Learning aplicado. Experiencia en entornos corporativos o trabajando con datos sensibles. Conocimiento de herramientas como LiteLLM y Langfuse. ¿Qué ofrecemos? 🌟 ⏰ Horario de entrada flexible de lunes a viernes (jornada completa). 📜 Contrato indefinido. 💸 Paquete salarial atractivo. 🥼 Seguro de vida y accidentes. 🍽️ Ticket restaurante. 🩺 Servicio médico en las instalaciones. 💸 Club de beneficios y ahorro. 💻 Plataforma de formación y aprendizaje de idiomas. 💆🏻‍♀️ Plataforma de bienestar con sesiones gratuitas e ilimitadas de psicología. 📈 Planes de desarrollo y política de movilidad interna. ⭐ ¡Y mucho más! 🔷¿Crees que esta oferta no es para ti? 🔷 Si esta oportunidad no encaja contigo, te invitamos a seguirnos para conocer futuras vacantes y novedades. Síguenos en LinkedIn e Instagram para más oportunidades laborales. #InsudPharma #Challenger #Insuder #InsudTalent Compromiso con la igualdad de oportunidades En Insud Pharma estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y con la creación de un entorno de trabajo diverso e inclusivo. Todas las candidaturas serán valoradas sin distinción de género, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, edad, origen étnico, nacionalidad, religión, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal o social protegida por la legislación vigente.

items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding CTO (AI/ML / Data Product) based in Romania. We are looking for an entrepreneurial technology leader ready to turn AI and data expertise into a business of their own. This founding opportunity is designed for experienced engineers who want to move beyond implementing someone else's vision and build an AI-powered B2B venture from the ground up. Over a focused 12-week, fully remote program, you will validate a real market problem, define a product-led minimum viable product (MVP), and develop a working solution with measurable business value. You will shape the technical architecture, data strategy, and deployment approach while establishing a compelling competitive advantage. Supported by experienced mentors, fellow founders, and a global startup network, you will refine your product and prepare an investor-ready technology vision. This is an opportunity to combine technical leadership, product thinking, and founder ambition to launch or join a founding team. Accountabilities As a founding technology leader, you will drive the technical and product development of an AI-powered B2B venture, balancing feasibility, customer needs, and commercial potential throughout the 12-week program. Identify and validate a B2B problem where AI can deliver measurable value through time savings, cost reduction, or risk mitigation. Define a product-focused MVP that addresses a clear customer need rather than prioritizing model complexity for its own sake. Design the data strategy, including data collection, labeling, evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Architect and deliver a reliable prototype or MVP, incorporating APIs, data pipelines, appropriate safeguards, and feedback loops. Establish foundational production practices for model deployment, monitoring, reliability, and ongoing performance evaluation. Iterate on the product based on validation results, user feedback, and evolving business requirements. Develop a compelling technical and product narrative for potential investors, explaining the venture's competitive advantage, data strategy, and product roadmap. Collaborate with co-founders, mentors, and other startup participants to refine the business concept and accelerate execution. Dedicate approximately 10–12 hours per week to building, validating, and improving the venture over the 12-week sprint. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong AI/ML or data product expertise, a product-oriented mindset, and the ambition to take ownership of a new business venture. At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, with substantial exposure to AI/ML or data-driven products. Demonstrated experience deploying software, machine learning models, or data products into production environments. Understanding of MLOps fundamentals, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and performance evaluation. Ability to design practical AI and data solutions that address real business problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Strong product judgment, with the ability to define MVP scope, prioritize essential functionality, and determine when a solution is ready for validation. Experience or familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and production-ready system design. An entrepreneurial mindset, with a genuine desire to build a company, take ownership of technical decisions, and participate in the potential upside of a venture. Ability to work independently, make decisions under uncertainty, and move quickly from problem discovery to product execution. Willingness to commit approximately 10–12 hours per week for 12 weeks. Interest in collaborating with co-founders, engaging with mentors, and developing an investor-ready vision for an AI-powered B2B business. Benefits A structured, 12-week startup sprint to progress from problem discovery to MVP development, validation, and iteration. Fully remote participation with an international community of founders and technology professionals. Weekly accountability sessions and a consistent execution cadence to maintain momentum and focus. Access to a network of more than 500 mentors specializing in B2B businesses, product development, go-to-market strategy, and fundraising. Connections to a global alumni network of more than 440 startups across over 40 countries, offering opportunities for learning, collaboration, and introductions. A practical CTO toolkit for AI ventures, covering product scoping, model evaluation, deployment, and the development of a defensible competitive advantage. The opportunity to become a co-founder or join a founding team and build an AI-powered business with long-term growth potential. items.desc: Er du i gang med din kandidat? Vil du gerne arbejde tæt på ledelsen, få ansvar fra dag ét, og bygge AI i produktionskvalitet til store virksomheder ved siden af studiet? 📍 København · ⏱️ Studiejob (15–20 timer/uge) · 🗓️ Start efter aftale (gerne hurtigst muligt) Vil du se din kode blive brugt af rigtige kunder, mens du stadig studerer? Er du nysgerrig på, hvordan AI-agenter bliver bygget og sat i drift i store virksomheder? Vil du lære mere ved siden af studiet, end du gør i forelæsningssalen? Vil du være med, hvor det sker, i stedet for at læse om det bagefter? Så læs videre. Om Kompose Vi bygger fokuserede AI-løsninger i produktionskvalitet til rådgivningsvirksomheder og større virksomheder. Vi løser de svære problemer, som virksomheder har brug for at få løst: Behandling af komplekse dokumenter Navigation i compliance-krav Løsninger, som organisationer bygger deres drift på Vi er et team med baggrund i tech og consulting og holder til på Christianshavn i København (lige ved kanalerne). Vi er i en tidlig fase, vokser organisk med stærk traction og bygger noget, der virker. Vi rykker hele tiden grænserne for, hvordan vi bruger AI, både internt og for vores kunder. Vi leverer ikke kun AI-løsninger. Vi udvikler også løbende vores egen AI-leverancemodel, så vi leverer hurtigere og bedre for hvert projekt. Rollen: AI Engineer (studiejob) Vi søger en teknisk stærk studerende, der er i gang med en kandidat inden for fx datalogi, software engineering, AI/machine learning, data science, matematik eller ingeniørvidenskab. Du kan kode, du kan lide at shippe, og du vil gerne tage ansvar. Du har allerede bygget ting selv, fx på studiet, i et sideprojekt eller i et tidligere studiejob. Du kommer med på rigtige kundeprojekter fra start: du er med til workshops, hjælper med leverancen og arbejder tæt sammen med resten af teamet og vores kunder, både på dansk og engelsk. Vi kalder det "deep tech, not deep basement". Du bygger, men du kan også forklare, hvad du bygger, og hvorfor det betyder noget. Det kommer du til at lave Bygge AI-systemer, der ræsonnerer over komplekse dokumenter, orkestrerer workflows i flere trin og gør virksomheders drift hurtigere og klogere, med frontier-LLM'er, agentiske frameworks, RAG-arkitekturer og vektordatabaser Deploye og vedligeholde systemer på kundens infrastruktur med fokus på sikkerhed, skalerbarhed, CI/CD i Azure DevOps og observability med LangFuse Arbejde med de nyeste agent-harnesses og reasoning-modeller samt Conductor til parallel agent-orkestrering Bidrage til vores interne AI-leverancemodel, dvs. de systemer og den praksis, der gør hvert projekt bedre end det forrige Bygge frontend i React og skrive produktionskode i Python og TypeScript Arbejde med infrastructure as code i Terraform på Azure Deltage i kundeworkshops, sprints og projektmøder. Du er en del af det team, kunden møder Det er ikke en forskerstilling. Det er applied engineering, der rent faktisk bliver brugt i den virkelige verden. Det forventer vi af dig Du er i gang med en relevant kandidatuddannelse Du kan arbejde 15–20 timer om ugen (fleksibelt i eksamensperioder) Solide Python-kompetencer Kendskab til eller interesse for prompt & context engineering, RAG og vektordatabaser Gerne erfaring med React (eller lignende) til frontend Lyst til at lære Azure, Azure DevOps og infrastructure as code (Terraform) Du behersker dansk og engelsk på et højt niveau, både skriftligt og mundtligt Klar kommunikation, både med tekniske og ikke-tekniske folk Det tilbyder vi Ansvar fra dag ét. Du er ikke bare et nummer. Du arbejder tæt på ledelsen, får rigtigt ansvar og ser direkte effekten af dit arbejde Erfaring, der rækker ud over studiet. Du designer, bygger og deployer AI-systemer i produktion til store virksomheder Læring fra et erfarent team. Du arbejder tæt sammen med stifterne, der har solid baggrund i tech og consulting Indflydelse på, hvordan AI-projekter leveres. Du er med til at udvikle vores interne leverancemodel De bedste værktøjer. Vi investerer i de bedste AI-værktøjer og engineering-praksisser Mulighed for speciale eller fuldtidsstilling. Gode studentermedhjælpere vil vi gerne beholde Fleksibilitet om studiet. Vi planlægger arbejdstiden efter dit skema og dine eksamener Godt sted at arbejde. Kontor midt på Christianshavn, tæt på metroen og kanalerne til en ugentlig svømmetur. Derudover tager vi på strategiture sammen Start: Efter aftale (gerne hurtigst muligt) Omfang: 15–20 timer om ugen, primært på kontoret Sådan søger du Søg direkte her på LinkedIn med "Easy Apply". For at gøre processen relevant (for dig og for os) vil vi helst se ansøgninger med rigtigt arbejde. Sørg derfor for, at din ansøgning indeholder: Dit CV og karakterudskrift (gerne samlet i én PDF) Link til din GitHub (eller lignende), gerne med noget, vi kan kigge på En kort tekst om, hvad du har bygget, hvad du havde ansvar for, og hvad du lærte Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt os på hi@kompose.dk eller på telefon +45 23 98 78 42.

items.desc: Au sein de votre équipe #OneTeam Vous évoluez au sein de l'équipe AI Ressources & Solutions qui a pour mission d'accompagner OVHcloud pour accélérer l'usage de l'IA par les équipes. Vous interviendrez sur du développement fullstack afin de produire des solutions IA internes permettant d’optimiser l’adoption de l’IA au sein de l’entreprise. Vos principales responsabilités Développer des applications d'agents ou agents autonomes prototypes ou fonctionnalités à l’aide de Python ou Typescript, en vous appuyant sur les framework Langchain, Langchain Deep Agent, LangGraph. Développer en frontend (React) et en backend à l'aide de coding assistants pour intégrer des fonctions IA. Développer des skills ou MCP de génération de document ou des plugins onlyOffice ou MsOffice afin d’intégrer l’IA d’OVH dans ces outils Rédiger des system prompts ou user prompts en anglais ou en français avec les IA d’OVHcloud répondants à des cas d’usages variés. Documenter vos travaux dans une documentation interne rédigée avec le framework mkdocs. Déployer les solutions développées à l’aide de docker, kubernetes et helm chart Votre futur impact Dans 4 à 6 mois Vous serez autonome sur les sujets qui vous sont confiés. items.desc: NAOKO to polska marka modowa, która rośnie szybko i świadomie. Budujemy wewnętrzny ekosystem technologiczny, który bezpośrednio napędza sprzedaż, logistykę, marketing i obsługę klienta. Nie outsourcujemy kluczowych systemów – budujemy je sami, blisko biznesu i produktu. Szukamy osoby, która będzie budować moduły naszego produktu AI (ManyMinds) od początku do końca: backend, API i interfejs. Bierzesz prototypy i pomysły od zespołu AI i zamieniasz je w działające, stabilne moduły – takie, które da się wdrożyć u klienta zewnętrznego, a nie tylko u nas. Technologie, których używamy: TypeScript Node.js Frontend (React, Vue albo Svelte) PostgreSQL API modeli językowych. Dodatkowo: Google Cloud Platform, Docker, React. Twój Zakres Obowiązków budowanie modułów naszego produktu AI (ManyMinds) od początku do końca: backend, API, interfejs praca z zespołem AI: bierzesz ich prototypy i pomysły i zamieniasz je w działające, stabilne moduły rozwój warstwy obsługi wielu dostawców modeli językowych: przełączanie, limity, kontrola kosztów, logowanie wywołań budowanie interfejsów na podstawie gotowych projektów i flow od naszego Product Designera – panele do przeglądania i akceptacji treści, widoki raportowe, ekrany dla klientów zewnętrznych dbanie o to, żeby to, co powstaje, dało się wdrożyć u klienta zewnętrznego, a nie tylko u nas udział w decyzjach o tym, jak moduł ma działać – nie dostajesz gotowej specyfikacji do przeklikania TypeScript / Node – backend, API, integracje frontend w dowolnym komponentowym frameworku (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular) plus dobre podstawy JS/TS – panele robi ta sama osoba, która pisze do nich backend. Nie wymagamy konkretnego frameworka: stos frontendowy produktu nie jest jeszcze zamknięty, liczy się umiejętność budowania interfejsu relacyjne bazy danych (Postgres) – projektowanie schematu na poziomie podstawowym doświadczenie z integracją API modeli językowych (OpenAI, Anthropic lub inne) – wystarczy z własnych projektów, nie musi być komercyjne umiejętność pracy na podstawie gotowego flow i makiety – nie oczekujemy projektowania, ale czytania projektu ze zrozumieniem codzienna praca z asystentami AI przy kodowaniu i umiejętność weryfikacji tego, co wygenerują Git, praca na branchach, podstawy CI gotowość wchodzenia w obszary poza własną specjalizacją angielski techniczny (dokumentacja, API) Mile Widziane React – dziś najbardziej prawdopodobny kierunek dla naszego produktu, ale nie warunek Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, konteneryzacja kolejki zadań, praca asynchroniczna, obsługa długo trwających operacji doświadczenie z agentami, RAG, ewaluacją outputu modeli testy automatyczne e-commerce jako domena Czego Nie Wymagamy samodzielnego projektowania architektury promptowania i doboru modeli AI znajomości Comarch Optima ani OMS W NAOKO piszesz kod, który ma bezpośredni wpływ na to, jak firma działa i sprzedaje – nie siedzisz w silosie i nie czekasz na tickety od product managera. Działasz blisko biznesu, rozumiesz kontekst i masz realny wpływ na to, co budujesz. Pracujesz w środowisku, które traktuje AI poważnie – mamy wdrożone procesy, narzędzia i ambicje, żeby być jedną z najbardziej AI-native firm w polskim e-commerce fashion. Oferujemy atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie (UoP lub B2B) oraz pakiet benefitów: karta Multisport, ubezpieczenie grupowe i zniżki na produkty marki NAOKO.

items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding CTO (AI/ML / Data Product) based in Switzerland. We are looking for an entrepreneurial technology leader ready to turn AI and data expertise into a business of their own. This founding opportunity is designed for experienced engineers who want to move beyond implementing someone else's vision and build an AI-powered B2B venture from the ground up. Over a focused 12-week, fully remote program, you will validate a real market problem, define a product-led minimum viable product (MVP), and develop a working solution with measurable business value. You will shape the technical architecture, data strategy, and deployment approach while establishing a compelling competitive advantage. Supported by experienced mentors, fellow founders, and a global startup network, you will refine your product and prepare an investor-ready technology vision. This is an opportunity to combine technical leadership, product thinking, and founder ambition to launch or join a founding team. Accountabilities As a founding technology leader, you will drive the technical and product development of an AI-powered B2B venture, balancing feasibility, customer needs, and commercial potential throughout the 12-week program. Identify and validate a B2B problem where AI can deliver measurable value through time savings, cost reduction, or risk mitigation. Define a product-focused MVP that addresses a clear customer need rather than prioritizing model complexity for its own sake. Design the data strategy, including data collection, labeling, evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Architect and deliver a reliable prototype or MVP, incorporating APIs, data pipelines, appropriate safeguards, and feedback loops. Establish foundational production practices for model deployment, monitoring, reliability, and ongoing performance evaluation. Iterate on the product based on validation results, user feedback, and evolving business requirements. Develop a compelling technical and product narrative for potential investors, explaining the venture's competitive advantage, data strategy, and product roadmap. Collaborate with co-founders, mentors, and other startup participants to refine the business concept and accelerate execution. Dedicate approximately 10–12 hours per week to building, validating, and improving the venture over the 12-week sprint. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong AI/ML or data product expertise, a product-oriented mindset, and the ambition to take ownership of a new business venture. At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, with substantial exposure to AI/ML or data-driven products. Demonstrated experience deploying software, machine learning models, or data products into production environments. Understanding of MLOps fundamentals, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and performance evaluation. Ability to design practical AI and data solutions that address real business problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Strong product judgment, with the ability to define MVP scope, prioritize essential functionality, and determine when a solution is ready for validation. Experience or familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and production-ready system design. An entrepreneurial mindset, with a genuine desire to build a company, take ownership of technical decisions, and participate in the potential upside of a venture. Ability to work independently, make decisions under uncertainty, and move quickly from problem discovery to product execution. Willingness to commit approximately 10–12 hours per week for 12 weeks. Interest in collaborating with co-founders, engaging with mentors, and developing an investor-ready vision for an AI-powered B2B business. Benefits A structured, 12-week startup sprint to progress from problem discovery to MVP development, validation, and iteration. Fully remote participation with an international community of founders and technology professionals. Weekly accountability sessions and a consistent execution cadence to maintain momentum and focus. Access to a network of more than 500 mentors specializing in B2B businesses, product development, go-to-market strategy, and fundraising. Connections to a global alumni network of more than 440 startups across over 40 countries, offering opportunities for learning, collaboration, and introductions. A practical CTO toolkit for AI ventures, covering product scoping, model evaluation, deployment, and the development of a defensible competitive advantage. The opportunity to become a co-founder or join a founding team and build an AI-powered business with long-term growth potential. items.desc: Manufacturing Vision Engineer ITM Power Location: Sheffield Direct Applications Only - No Agency Applicants at this time About ITM Power ITM is at the forefront of the green hydrogen industry, designing and manufacturing cutting-edge PEM electrolysers that are instrumental in global decarbonisation efforts. With over two decades of scientific expertise, we’ve established ourselves as industry leaders in clean energy technology. Our Journey and Growth As pioneers in green hydrogen technology, ITM is offering the most advanced PEM electrolyser technology in the world. Founded in 2000, ITM Power PLC was one of the first companies of its kind to be listed on the AIM market of the London Stock Exchange. Headquartered in the UK, our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility is the world’s first largest PEM Gigafactory in commercial operation, and home to our R&D and manufacturing. ITM Power Germany is our hub in the heart of the EU. This facility not only houses regional functions including business development and engineering, but also our Aftersales services with the ability to quickly deploy stacks. Innovation and Impact Our PEM electrolysers are deployed in some of the world's largest green hydrogen projects. We continue to push the boundaries of technology, enhancing cost-effectiveness and sustainability. Join Our Mission ITM is in the midst of a transformative phase, focusing on streamlined delivery and operational excellence. We're seeking talented individuals who share our passion for clean energy and our drive to make a tangible impact on the world's transition to net-zero. You will be working with an inspiring bunch of people, encouraging each other to be the best we can. We’ve come a long way, join us in the next step of our incredible journey! What are we looking for The Manufacturing Vision Engineer is a key member of the Manufacturing Automation team responsible for the design, integration, commissioning, and optimisation of machine vision and automated inspection systems across production equipment. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable vision-based inspection solutions, including Automated Optical Inspection (AOI), camera systems, and DMC-based identification, ensuring consistent quality control and traceability across manufacturing processes. Working closely with Automation Engineers, Process Engineers, Quality Engineering, and equipment suppliers, the role ensures that vision systems are correctly integrated into manufacturing equipment and production lines. This includes defining inspection requirements, supporting system integration, and ensuring stable operation during commissioning and ramp-up phases. A key aspect of the role is supporting the introduction of new manufacturing equipment and ensuring that all vision and inspection systems are fully integrated into production processes. The role also contributes to the standardisation of vision inspection approaches across multiple machines and production areas to ensure consistency, scalability, and reliability. The Manufacturing Vision Engineer plays an important role in ensuring that inspection systems are stable, correctly configured, and capable of supporting production quality and traceability requirements in a high-volume manufacturing environment. Responsibilities Lead the integration and commissioning of machine vision systems, including AOI cameras and DMC-based identification systems, into manufacturing equipment and production lines. Define and support implementation of vision inspection requirements in collaboration with Process Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Automation teams. Work closely with Automation Engineers to ensure correct integration of vision systems into PLC-controlled equipment and production machines. Support installation, configuration, and commissioning of vision systems during equipment introduction and ramp-up phases. Develop and optimise inspection parameters to ensure stable, reliable, and repeatable defect detection performance. Ensure consistent implementation of vision inspection and DMC standards across multiple machines and production areas. Support troubleshooting and resolution of vision system issues, including cameras, lighting, image processing, and system communication. Collaborate with equipment suppliers and machine builders to define, validate, and improve vision system performance. Support industrialisation activities by ensuring vision systems are correctly integrated into new manufacturing processes and equipment. Contribute to continuous improvement of inspection systems to improve quality detection capability, reliability, and production robustness. Ensure vision system data is correctly captured and available for downstream systems such as MES and traceability platforms. About You Knowledge and Experience Degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline …

This is a genuinely exciting opportunity for a technically talented individual to work at the intersection of AI, data and investment management . This is not your typical Data Analyst role. Working directly with the CIO, CFO and senior leadership, you will have the autonomy to build innovative solutions, introduce AI-driven tools and transform how investment data is managed and analysed. The opportunity: Develop and implement AI tools, LLMs and intelligent automation. Build data infrastructure and analytical solutions using Python and SQL. Create dashboards and portfolio analytics to support investment decisions. Take ownership of technology initiatives from concept through to delivery. Gain exposure to a sophisticated investment portfolio and senior decision-makers. What are we looking for? Ideally 3–5 years' experience in data analytics, engineering or software development. Strong Python and SQL skills. Hands-on experience with AI, LLMs and automation. An entrepreneurial mindset, intellectual curiosity and a passion for building solutions. Investment management experience is NOT essential. We are looking for technical ability, creativity and ambition. If you're working in a technology business, startup or data-focused role and want greater ownership, variety and exposure to the investment world, this could be an exceptional career move.

items.desc:
Salary Range: 
€69,000.00 - €128,100.00 
 Job Description Summary 
Dir. DDIT ISC Functional Security Architect role provides enterprise-level architectural leadership and specialist security expertise for Identity and Access Management (IAM). The role partners closely with Functional Security Architects, Enterprise Architects, Platform Architects, business stakeholders and IAM capability teams to ensure that solutions implement secure, scalable and reusable identity patterns aligned with enterprise security standards.
It also contributes to the strategic development and maturity of enterprise IAM capabilities, including Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), authentication, authorization, federation, Privileged Access Management (PAM), machine/workload identities and emerging identity requirements associated with AI and autonomous agents.
A key focus of the role is developing IAM architecture for AI-enabled applications and Agentic AI, including identities for AI agents, delegated authority, agent-to-agent and agent-to-application access, human-to-agent delegation, workload identities, least-privilege authorization, JIT access, credential and secret management, lifecycle governance, auditability and accountability. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Review, approve and govern IAM technology variants and architecture patterns against agreed enterprise security and architecture standards. 
 Drive IAM technology and architecture standards in close collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, Security Architecture, IAM capability teams and Architecture Governance. 
 Act as the IAM subject-matter expert for Functional Security Architects, providing IAM-specific architecture guidance, design reviews, reusable patterns and risk advice for projects and programmes. 
 Support development and evolution of enterprise IAM capabilities and their associated target architectures, roadmaps and reference architectures. 
 Advance the maturity of IAM architecture and governance processes, ensuring IAM architectural decisions and standards remain relevant as business, security and technology requirements evolve. 
 Drive relevant architecture KPIs and metrics to assess adoption, architectural compliance, exceptions and maturity of IAM capabilities. 
 Identify opportunities for consolidation, standardisation and retirement of overlapping IAM technologies and patterns. Proactively communicate IAM risks and architectural considerations to business, security and technology stakeholders. 
 Participate in evaluation of new IAM and security technologies, providing a holistic assessment of security, architecture, interoperability, lifecycle and operational considerations. 
 Engage early in solution and demand governance to ensure IAM requirements are identified before detailed solution design and implementation. 
 Promote reuse of approved enterprise IAM capabilities and patterns rather than creation of application-specific identity solutions. Build and maintain an IAM architecture Community of Practice, facilitating knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 Essential Requirement: 
 Strong experience in Identity and Access Management architecture, security architecture or enterprise security architecture. 
 Deep understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, federation, access governance and privileged access. 
 Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML 2.0, SCIM and modern identity-federation patterns. 
 Experience architecting enterprise SSO, MFA and passwordless authentication solutions. 
 Strong understanding of RBAC, ABAC, policy-based access control, least privilege and separation of duties. 
 Experience with identity governance and administration and privileged access management. Understanding of cloud-native identity, workload identity, APIs, service accounts and other non-human identities. 
 Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and identity-centric security.Ability to translate security requirements into practical, reusable architecture patterns. 
 Strong stakeholder-management skills and ability to provide specialist IAM guidance to Solution Security Architects, engineering teams and enterprise architects. 
 Desirable Requirement: 
 Understanding of security architecture for Generative AI and AI-enabled applications. 
 Knowledge of IAM challenges associated with autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents. Understanding of agent identity, workload identity, delegated authorisation and machine-to-machine trust.

items.desc: Σχετικά με εμάς Στη Heuristic Data βοηθάμε επιχειρήσεις και οργανισμούς στον ψηφιακό μετασχηματισμό και στην εξέλιξή τους, αξιοποιώντας βέλτιστα τα δεδομένα τους, την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη και τις σύγχρονες τεχνολογίες, ώστε να παίρνουν καλύτερες αποφάσεις και να αυτοματοποιούν διαδικασίες. Με μεγάλη εξειδίκευση σε data analytics, business intelligence, software και AI, υλοποιούμε έργα υψηλών απαιτήσεων και προδιαγραφών, σχεδιάζοντας και θέτοντας σε λειτουργία λύσεις που απαντούν στις σύγχρονες προκλήσεις των επιχειρήσεων και αξιοποιούνται στην καθημερινή τους λειτουργία. Η κουλτούρα μας στηρίζεται στη διαρκή εξέλιξη και στην παρακολούθηση των πλέον σύγχρονων τεχνολογιών. Πιστεύουμε στη συνεργασία, στην περιέργεια και στην ευθύνη για το τελικό προϊόν και για τον πελάτη, και θέλουμε συναδέλφους που θέλουν να αφήνουν το αποτύπωμά τους σε πραγματικά έργα, με ενθουσιασμό και φιλοδοξία. Ο ρόλος Αναζητούμε έναν/μία έμπειρο/η AI Engineer για να ενισχύσει την ομάδα AI της Heuristic Data. Θα συμμετέχει στον σχεδιασμό, την ανάπτυξη και τη λειτουργία λύσεων τεχνητής νοημοσύνης και ανάλυσης δεδομένων, από το πρώτο prototype μέχρι την παραγωγική ενσωμάτωση, σε έργα που έχουν πραγματικό αντίκτυπο στους πελάτες μας. Αντικείμενο εργασίας Σχεδιασμός, ανάπτυξη και παραγωγική λειτουργία συστημάτων τεχνητής νοημοσύνης (π.χ. Document Intelligence, Conversational Agents). Ανάπτυξη εφαρμογών με χρήση Large Language Models και Enterprise AI Platforms. Σχεδιασμός και υλοποίηση enterprise AI agents με Microsoft Copilot και Databricks AI/BI Genie. Συνεργασία με ομάδες Data & Software για ενσωμάτωση AI λύσεων σε έργα πελατών. Απαραίτητα Προσόντα: Πτυχίο πληροφορικής ή θετικών επιστημών Τουλάχιστον 2 έτη πρακτικής εμπειρίας στο αντικείμενο εργασίας. Πολύ καλή γνώση και εμπειρία σε ανάπτυξη εφαρμογών σε Python συμπεριλαμβανομένης της χρήσης βιβλιοθηκών για την ανάπτυξη συστημάτων Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης (π.χ. Cuda). Εμπειρία στην ανάπτυξη containerized εφαρμογών (Docker). Πολύ καλή γνώση SQL. Εμπειρία στο χειρισμό δομημένων και αδόμητων δεδομένων. Άριστη γνώση Ελληνικών και Αγγλικών. Επιθυμητά προσόντα Μεταπτυχιακό (MSc) σε Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Science ή συναφές πεδίο. Καταρτίσεις και πιστοποιήσεις σε σχετικά αντικείμενα (π.χ. Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, Fabric Data Engineer / Analytics Engineer Associate, ή Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate) Εμπειρία σε RAG pipelines, LLM serving και inference optimization, Text-to-SQL ή agentic/conversational BI συστήματα. Εμπειρία στην ανάπτυξη enterprise agents με Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Databricks AI/BI Genie ή συναφείς πλατφόρμες. Εξοικείωση με Cloud και MLOps εργαλεία. Δημοσιεύσεις ή συνεισφορές σε open-source projects. Χαρακτηριστικά που αναζητούμε Διάθεση για συνεχή μάθηση και εξέλιξη σε ένα ταχέως εξελισσόμενο πεδίο. Δομημένη σκέψη και ικανότητα επίλυσης σύνθετων προβλημάτων. Ικανότητα καλής επικοινωνίας και συνεργασίας με τεχνικούς και μη τεχνικούς συνομιλητές. Πρακτική και αποτελεσματική προσέγγιση, με έμφαση στην ανάπτυξη αξιόπιστων λύσεων. Παροχές: Αποδοχές ανάλογες των προσόντων και της εμπειρίας. Κάλυψη εξόδων για εκπαίδευση, πιστοποιήσεις και συνεχή επαγγελματική ανάπτυξη. Εργασία σε ένα ευχάριστο και υποστηρικτικό περιβάλλον, με ενασχόληση σε έργα στην αιχμή της τεχνολογίας τεχνητής νοημοσύνης. Δυνατότητα εξέλιξης του ρόλου και περαιτέρω ανάπτυξης της τεχνικής εξειδίκευσης. Δυνατότητα τηλεργασίας ή και υβριδικού μοντέλου Στη Heuristic Data πιστεύουμε ότι οι διαφορετικές εμπειρίες και οπτικές ενισχύουν τον τρόπο που συνεργαζόμαστε και εξελισσόμαστε. Αξιολογούμε κάθε υποψηφιότητα με βάση τις δεξιότητες, τα προσόντα και τη συνάφεια με τον ρόλο, με σεβασμό στις ίσες ευκαιρίες, τη διαφορετικότητα και τη συμπερίληψη. items.desc: About our client Our client is a London-headquartered company that designs, builds and operates infrastructure for an emerging area of transport. It has grown into an international business, with projects across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and North America, and it is now putting AI agents at the heart of how the business runs. About the role AIQoach is recruiting on behalf of our client for an Applied AI Engineer. This is a central role reporting directly to the CTO. You will build production-ready AI agents with LangGraph that support teams across the whole business. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building agents, not a data science or machine learning research role. It is hybrid from London, and fully remote working will be considered for exceptional candidates. What you will do Design, build and ship production-ready AI agents in Python with LangGraph Work with teams across the business to find where agents add the most value, and shape what each agent should do Connect agents to the data, systems and APIs they need through well-defined tools Build evaluations and tests so agent outputs can be trusted, with human review where it matters Deploy, monitor and improve agents in production, with attention to reliability, security and cost Work directly with the CTO to set the standards for how the company builds with AI Essential Three to six years of commercial Python engineering experience, including shipping and maintaining production software Hands-on experience building AI agents with LangGraph Hands-on experience building or integrating tools with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) A public GitHub portfolio of AI agents you have built, which we will review One of these certifications: Claude Certified Developer: Foundations (Anthropic) or AWS Certified Generative AI Developer, Professional Nice to have Experience deploying and running agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Experience building internal tools or automation for business teams How to apply Apply through Indeed with your CV and a link to your GitHub portfolio. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to walk us through one of their agents. There is no cost to apply. Pay: From £80,000.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

Our more than 2,000 IT experts and enthusiasts are the bank's Digital Muscle. Within our Daily Banking Experience department, you contribute to digital products that customers rely on for their everyday banking. Challenge requirements and solution approaches to find simple, sustainable and technically sound solutions . Build & Engineer Design and develop software hands-on across frontend, backend or full-stack, depending on your expertise and the needs of the product. Take responsibility for engineering quality through automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure coding. Contribute to architectural evolution, modernization and the reduction of technical debt. Leverage AI-assisted and agentic engineering across analysis, specification, development and testing. Connect & Coordinate Be a technical anchor for your product and connect Business, Product and Engineering. Coordinate technical dependencies and align with other products, teams and stakeholders. Drive technical topics, decisions and follow-ups instead of simply handing them over. Support product and delivery planning with technical expertise. Coordinate technical aspects of releases and product changes and maintain transparency around relevant product knowledge. Run & Improve Take ownership beyond go-live and contribute to the stable and reliable operation of your product. Support incident resolution and root-cause analysis and turn learnings into sustainable improvements. Continuously improve security, resilience, performance and maintainability. Identify opportunities to simplify the product, automate work and improve engineering efficiency. What makes this role different A Digital Product Engineer does not stop where another role traditionally starts. You can understand a requirement, analyze its technical implications, shape a solution, implement it and help run it in production. We do not expect everyone to be equally strong in every discipline from day one. You might come from Software Engineering or Technical Analysis and bring deep expertise in one area. What matters is the ambition to broaden your capabilities and develop into a T-shaped Digital Product Engineer with end-to-end product ownership. items.desc: Curious about how technology and AI can improve the way we work with data? Join Saxo and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets About the job At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets. We are a newly established team and still very much in the build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve. As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets. This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and have a real influence on how we work. What you will do Technology will be an important part of your role. Together with colleagues in the team, you will help strengthen our technical foundation. This could mean building AI supported workflows, contributing to Azure projects, automating manual processes or exploring new tools and platforms. As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work across our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled. Depending on the domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market and price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data. You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take ownership of your own areas and tasks. You will be part of one Markets Data Office, working with shared standards, tooling and governance practices. You will sit close to the business and help turn business needs into practical technical solutions. We want you to experiment, test ideas and find better ways of working. Your responsibilities will include Exploring and testing new technology, including AI, and helping the team choose and use the right tools Setting up reporting and dashboards for data owners and data stewards, for example in Power BI Automating manual parts of our governance work, including data quality checks, documentation and metadata Building and maintaining AI supported workflows and data workflows together with colleagues and technology teams, for example in Azure or Databricks Testing and validating automated workflows, including AI outputs, before they are used in day to day governance work Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved Working with data owners, stewards and stakeholders across business and technology, and helping translate between business needs and technical solutions Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office A key part of the role is making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation. Who you are You have recently completed a master’s degree or have around one to two years of professional experience. A relevant degree in areas such as information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a similar field An interest in data and how it supports business processes, combined with an interest in connecting business and technology Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or personal projects Hands on experience using AI or other technology to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is that you are curious, willing to learn and motivated to build your technical skills. An advantage if you have Familiarity with Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Great Expectations, data catalogue tools such as OpenMetadata or similar technologies Experience building with AI beyond everyday use, for example agents, LiteLLM based workflows, prompt engineering or automation using tools such as Power Automate Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services We are looking for someone who: Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative …
