items.card: About the Role You'll own the AI agents that run Gorgias's GTM workflows, taking them from manual process to reviewed agent. The goal is to optimize as much GTM work as possible without losing quality. A strong fit ships working agents quickly, debugs a broken workflow in Cargo, HubSpot, or another GTM tool without waiting for help, and cares whether the business actually uses what gets built. What You'll Do
items.desc: We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop. At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift. Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before. To win, we focus relentlessly on: Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand. Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout. Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing. The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood. Join us to make Conversational Commerce real. About the Team GTM Engineers builds the AI product layer for Gorgias's go-to-market teams: AI agents, internal cockpits, and the automations underneath them, all running on one shared context layer (Cortex). We work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships. We build and maintain the agents, the business teams own the outputs, and humans review exceptions. About the Role You'll own the AI agents that run Gorgias's GTM workflows, taking them from manual process to reviewed agent. The goal is to optimize as much GTM work as possible without losing quality. A strong fit ships working agents quickly, debugs a broken workflow in Cargo, HubSpot, or another GTM tool without waiting for help, and cares whether the business actually uses what gets built. What You'll Do Navigate between our context layer, our app and service repositories, MCPs, and our automation tools to build and improve end-to-end GTM workflows. Build custom agents and reusable agent skills on our agent stack (Cortex) , and on custom builds when the stack can't do the job. Build and maintain agents for lead and account work: outbound reply handling, audience and call-list building, enrichment, event follow-up, and referral routing. Map the Sales and Marketing workflow backlog, decide Agent vs. Automation vs. Manual for each workflow, and deliver the chosen option with a reviewable output for the business owner. Improve live agents: tune prompts and skills, read conversation and performance data, fix regressions, and document edge cases. Debug broken workflows fast across Cargo, HubSpot, Customer.io, and other GTM tools, and fix the root cause. Connect agents to our systems through APIs and workflows (n8n, Clay, custom code), with credentials managed centrally rather than on personal accounts. Help Sales (BDRs and AEs) and CS adopt agents: learn their daily work, design flows with them, and train them to supervise outputs. Work with the other GTM Engineers (cockpit, data, systems) so agents run on clean CRM data. Who You Are You need to be passionate about AI. Claude Code, Conductor, or another AI coding harness is where you spend most of your time building—not something you only experiment with occasionally. 3+ years in a technical GTM, RevOps, or growth engineering role, with production automations you can point to. Hands-on with LLM applications: prompt design, tool or function calling, and reviewing output quality. Experience building custom agents is a plus. Familiarity with a modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Segment, Airbyte, Hightouch) is a plus. Solid SQL and Python or JavaScript, and comfortable working with REST APIs. Working knowledge on outbound or engagement tool (Cargo, Dust, Apollo, Lemlist, Instantly, Customer.io, or similar). Experience with n8n, Clay, or a similar automation tool is a plus. Good business judgment: you know when an agent should draft and when it should act. Ownership: you take a workflow from idea to live agent and flag breakages early. Fluent English. French is a plus for the Paris team. Perks & Benefits 5-week vacation plus 2 weeks RTT (We follow each country's appropriate PTO Laws) Paid sick leave Paid parental leave (16 weeks) MacBook Pro Personal credit card to buy lunches (we use Swile) We provide private health insurance (we use GAN) Get up to €700 to set up your workstation at home (working from home should feel breezy) Get up to €2000 of learning material and wellness support per year! This includes €1500 for learning material (such as books, courses, and individual coaching sessions) directly linked to your job scope, as well as a €500 wellness budget. Take advantage of these resources to grow in your role and prioritize your personal development and wellness. Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats! AI at Gorgias At Gorgias, …

items.card: Your tasks Deliver measurable commercial and operational impact through operations intelligence, customer intelligence, and personalization. Contribute to the development of the Decision Science roadmap for operations intelligence and customer intelligence by applying scientifically sound statistical modeling, mathematical optimization, and machine learning. Translate business questions into well-defined
items.desc: Ready for a job where you look forward to Monday? Let's Go! Expert Data Scientist - Customer & Decision Intelligence (m/f/d) 1 For us „Let’s Go!“ is not just a slogan, it is an attitude. We love technology and we want to excite. We have fun and want to inspire. Our customers and our teams. That’s why we are looking for people who share this spirit. People who are passionate about creating the shopping experience of the future together with 50.000 colleagues across Europe. Your tasks Deliver measurable commercial and operational impact through operations intelligence, customer intelligence, and personalization. Contribute to the development of the Decision Science roadmap for operations intelligence and customer intelligence by applying scientifically sound statistical modeling, mathematical optimization, and machine learning. Translate business questions into well-defined mathematical and statistical problems, critically assess the available data, and select and justify the most appropriate modeling approach. Operations Intelligence: develop models for demand forecasting, inventory and replenishment optimization, assortment and allocation, supply chain and logistics optimization, workforce and store capacity planning, and pricing and markdown optimization. Customer Intelligence: develop recommendation systems and models for personalization, customer segmentation, customer lifetime value, churn, propensity, marketing effectiveness, and uplift. Choose methods based on assumptions, interpretability, robustness, computational efficiency, and empirical performance: use a simple linear model when sufficient, and advanced ML or AI only when it adds demonstrable value. Build predictive, prescriptive, and optimization models (e.g., linear/integer programming, simulation, causal inference, experimentation) to improve business performance and operational efficiency. Collaborate with Data Engineers and ML Engineers to build scalable data pipelines, feature stores, and production-ready ML solutions using Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Vertex AI). Evaluate, monitor, and continuously improve model performance through baseline comparisons and the validation of assumptions, uncertainty estimates, and generalization, while ensuring business value. Your profile Master’s degree (MSc) or PhD from an established, internationally recognized university in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Data Science, Operations Research, or a closely related quantitative field. Approximately 4–5 years of relevant professional experience after graduation in data science, statistical modeling, applied mathematics, or machine learning. A strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, linear algebra, numerical methods, and mathematical optimization, with the ability to explain the assumptions and limitations of different models. Proven ability to compare classical statistical models, optimization methods, and machine learning approaches and justify the choice using scientific reasoning and evidence. Practical experience in developing and validating predictive and optimization models; experience in operations intelligence (forecasting, inventory, supply chain, and pricing) or customer intelligence (recommendation systems, personalization, and CRM analytics) is an advantage. Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, digital products, media, retail technology, or customer-facing systems is an advantage. Excellent programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience processing large-scale structured and unstructured datasets. Experience with scientific Python libraries (e.g., NumPy, SciPy, statsmodels, and scikit-learn) and ML frameworks such as XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps practices, is an advantage. Understanding of modern AI methods, including deep learning and Generative AI / LLMs, and the judgment to identify when these approaches are—or are not—appropriate. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into sound mathematical and statistical solutions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and business audiences. A collaborative mindset, scientific curiosity, intellectual independence, and a pragmatic approach to delivering measurable business impact. What's in it for you? International teams & exciting tasks 30 days vacation & company pension plan Employees discount & Fitness Collaborations Training & Education Open corporate culture & Teamwork Mobile work (50/50) About us We are looking for a scientifically grounded Data Scientist to join our Decision Science team, which focuses on two pillars: Operations Intelligence and Customer Intelligence. You will develop robust statistical, mathematical, and machine learning solutions across one of Europe’s largest omnichannel retailers …

items.desc: Short Description SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes, Bosch, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia, and Salesforce. You'll own SPREAD's information security and compliance program, from ISO 27001, SOC 2, and TISAX audit cycles through to the risk register, policies, and vendor assessments that back them. You set the security requirements across the company and check that day-to-day operations meet them. You work closely with the GTM team on customer security questionnaires and with leadership on ISMS reporting each cycle, and you'll grow the scope of what you own as the program matures. Your Mission Own audit cycles end-to-end for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and TISAX, expanding scope as certifications mature. Answer security questionnaires for customers and OEMs alongside the GTM team, turning fast and accurate answers into a real edge in deals. Present ISMS status, risk posture, and audit results to leadership every cycle. Maintain and evolve risk registers, security policies, and vendor security assessments as the company grows. Run security awareness training and phishing simulations across the organization. Set the security requirements for identity, device, and endpoint management, and audit that IT operations meet them. Build and maintain the evidence base behind every control, closing gaps before an auditor finds them. Automate repetitive compliance and evidence-collection work with platforms like Vanta. Your Experience 3 to 5 years in information security, GRC, or compliance operations, with direct experience supporting a complete ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycle. items.desc: Product Engineer Neuron Innovations Location: UK, hybrid, with time in London Package: £90,000–£100,000 plus share options Why Neuron Neuron is building the machine internet. Sensors, drones, robots and software are becoming autonomous, but they can't yet find, trust or work with each other across organisations. Neuron is the coordination layer that changes that: the DNS and routing for agentic physical systems. Each organisation runs its own Neuron console and registers its systems as agents with a verifiable identity. Other organisations can then discover those agents, trust them and work with them through shared protocols, across organisational and national boundaries, without anyone giving up control of their systems or data. Everything on the network is ready to work with AI agents. It is already live and paid for. There are 470+ agents on our network, and we have won £4.3M in grants and sales since 2019, £1.7M of it since June 2026, from the UK CAA, Innovate UK and the European Space Agency. We are also part of NATO's multinational test and evaluation for counter-drone systems. We started in lower airspace, where we know the domain best: 4DSKY, our community sensor network for aircraft tracking, with hundreds of active receivers across the UK and Europe. Funded programmes with the CAA, Innovate UK and the European Space Agency: federated surveillance for airspace modernisation, ground-based detect-and-avoid for drones, counter-drone sensing at a regional airport, and distributed acoustic drone detection. Deployments of airspace surveillance networks for defence and UAS operators. Neuron is expanding rapidly. We are a team of 7 in London today, growing across product, engineering and delivery, and we are hiring exceptional people who want to build the infrastructure autonomous systems will run on. You would join early, with real ownership from your first week, share options in what you build, and work that goes straight into live operations at airports, along coastlines and in defence exercises. The role You make our products something customers love to use. You look after all of them: C2OS, our command-and-control platform; 4DSKY, our community sensor network; and the Neuron console, which each customer runs to connect their systems. The people using them run airspace, counter-drone and defence operations, working alongside the AI agents our network connects. You turn the product strategy into reality: you define how each feature should work, design and build the interface customers use every day, write the requirements our engineers build from, and make sure everything we ship is high quality. It's a hands-on role for an engineer who cares as much about the people using the product as about the code behind it. What you'll do Work with the Head of Engineering (our CEO until they join) to turn the product strategy into a roadmap of features, and define the detail of each: user journeys, workflows, edge cases and how it should behave. Design and build the user interface and experience yourself: the console's screens and onboarding, C2OS's operator displays and real-time maps, and the 4DSKY app. Write the requirements and acceptance criteria our engineers, including our outsourced development partner, build the back end from. Own product quality: test what's built against the requirements, run acceptance before each release, and decide with the Head of Engineering when it's ready for customers. Talk to customers and operators, watch how they use the product, and feed what you learn back into the design. Prototype new ideas quickly, including AI agents that work with the systems customers register, and line up programme needs with our Systems and Assurance Engineer. What you'll bring Front-end and full-stack engineering you have shipped, in TypeScript and a modern framework such as React, with real users relying on it. UX design: you design interfaces and workflows that customers love, not only implement someone else's designs. Product requirements and specifications that other engineers built from. Owning the quality of a shipped product: acceptance testing, release readiness and triaging what users hit. AI, IoT, robotics or connected-device products. UK-based and eligible for SC clearance. Nice to have Real-time maps and data visualisation; operator or mission-control interfaces; counter-UAS or defence systems; building with AI agents or large language models; drones, sensors or airspace; geospatial or aviation data such as ADSB; early-stage start-up experience. Der nächste Kurs startet bald – und es gibt noch freie Plätze! Diese Inhalte erwarten dich: Aufgaben Vom Entwickler zum Mitgestalter: Während AI repetitive Coding-Aufgaben übernimmt, wächst dein strategischer Einfluss in der Produktentwicklung. Dabei identifizierst du Risiken beim Einsatz von AI, überwachst deren Entscheidungen und behältst Kosten, API-Limits und System-Performance im Blick. Dabei behältst du die AI-Entscheidungen im Blick – von der Qualität und Einhaltung deiner Anforderungen bis hin zur Observability im Livebetrieb. Dabei automatisierst du Workflows und bindest Unternehmensdaten über etablierte Frameworks wie LangChain oder MCP ein – für echte AI-Features mit Mehrwert. items.desc: Role Overview So arbeiten wir – bitte aufmerksam lesen Diese Stelle passt nicht zu jedem, und das ist Absicht. Damit du einschätzen kannst, ob sie zu dir passt: Es gibt keine fertige Use-Case-Liste. Du baust dir deine Pipeline selbst auf – durch Gespräche, Beobachtung und Neugier auf die Arbeit anderer. Was du findest, bewertest und priorisierst du eigenverantwortlich. Du wirst öfter "nein" sagen als "ja". Viele Use-Case-Wünsche sind bei genauem Hinsehen zu teuer, zu riskant oder schlicht ein Prozessproblem, das keine KI braucht. Du musst das erkennen, begründen und freundlich vertreten können – ohne die Beziehung zur Abteilung zu beschädigen. Beratung ist die Hälfte des Jobs. Du führst Gespräche, moderierst Workshops, siehst Kollegen bei der Arbeit über die Schulter und dokumentierst Prozesse, die noch nie jemand aufgeschrieben hat. Erst danach wird gebaut. Wer diesen Teil als lästige Vorstufe zum Coden empfindet, wird hier nicht glücklich. Nicht alle freuen sich über dein Kommen. Manche Kollegen sehen in KI eine Bedrohung für ihre Arbeit, andere haben schlicht keine Zeit für dich, und in manchen Prozessen ist die Ineffizienz jemandes lieb gewordene Routine. Du nimmst diese Vorbehalte ernst statt sie wegzuargumentieren – und arbeitest bei sensiblen Themen früh und offen mit Datenschutz, IT-Security und Vorgesetzten zusammen, statt an ihnen vorbei. Jedes Teammitglied handelt sehr autonom. Du setzt dir deinen eigenen Maßstab und prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut. Austausch und Feedback gibt es selbstverständlich – aber die Qualitätssicherung deiner Arbeit beginnt bei dir. Du bist der Spezialist für dein Gebiet. Unser Innovationsteam ist bewusst interdisziplinär aufgestellt, mit kaum Überlappungen zwischen den Disziplinen. Du hast Spezialisten für Frontend, Backend und UX an deiner Seite, wenn aus einem Use-Case mehr wird – aber die KI-Transformation ist dein Feld, und du verantwortest es fachlich selbst. Wir arbeiten selbst AI-gestützt – konsequent. Tools wie Claude Code oder Cursor sind bei uns Alltag, nicht Experiment. Wer anderen Abteilungen KI-gestütztes Arbeiten näherbringt, sollte es selbst vorleben – und wissen, wo die Grenzen liegen. Das verschiebt den Schwerpunkt der Arbeit: weniger selbst tippen, mehr Probleme präzise formulieren und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen, bevor sie jemand anderes nutzt. Wöchentliche Freiräume sind fest eingeplant – rund 10 % deiner Arbeitszeit. Zeit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, eigene Ideen und kreativen Austausch ist bei uns Teil der Arbeitswoche – kein Nice-to-have, das im Tagesgeschäft verdampft. Ergebnisgetrieben und prozessual schlank. Wir brauchen schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren – keine über Monate ausgefeilten 100%-Systeme. Wächst ein Use-Case Richtung Produkt, übergibst du ihn an unser Innovationsteam oder R&D. Diese Rolle lebt von Präsenz. Use-Cases findet man häufig nicht per Videocall, sondern beim Zusehen, im Flurgespräch, am Schreibtisch der Kollegen. Plane regelmäßige Zeit in Landau ein (ca. 10–20 % der Arbeitszeit, gerade in der Anfangsphase eher mehr). Wenn du darauf wartest, dass dir jemand sagt, wo es klemmt, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Den Kolleginnen und Kollegen ist oft selbst nicht bewusst, dass ein Problem existiert oder sich eine Effizienzchance bietet – genau das zu erkennen, ist der Kern dieser Rolle. Wenn dich das reizt: lies weiter. Your Tasks Use-Cases für KI im Unternehmen aktiv identifizieren: Abteilungen und ihre Prozesse kennenlernen, Ineffizienzen und Potenziale aufdecken, Ideen gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen ausarbeiten Use-Cases ehrlich bewerten: Nutzen, Aufwand, Machbarkeit, Datenschutz- und Ethik-Risiken – und auf dieser Basis priorisieren, was umgesetzt wird und was nicht Lösungen pragmatisch umsetzen: Workflow-Automatisierungen, interne Tools, LLM-basierte Anwendungen, Integration von KI-APIs – mit dem Werkzeug, das zum Problem passt Lösungen in den Alltag bringen: Einführung begleiten, Kollegen befähigen, Feedback einsammeln und nachschärfen Gespräche und Workshops mit den Fachbereichen vorbereiten, moderieren und nachhalten – inklusive der Prozessaufnahme, die es vorher nicht gab (Shadowing, einfache Prozessdokumentation) Erwartungen managen: klären, was eine Lösung leisten wird und was nicht, bevor sie gebaut wird Kollegen befähigen: Schulungen und Hilfestellungen, Multiplikatoren in den Abteilungen gewinnen, internen Erfahrungsaustausch zu KI aufbauen Größere oder produktnahe Use-Cases strukturiert an Innovationsteam oder R&D übergeben Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fachbereichen und Geschäftsführung präsentieren – auf dem jeweiligen technischen Niveau deines Gegenübers Your Profile Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen – du bist und bleibst jemand, der selbst baut Praktische Erfahrung im Bau von GenAI-Anwendungen: LLM-APIs, Prompt Engineering, RAG – idealerweise in Lösungen, die echte Nutzer im Alltag verwenden …

items.desc: Stanowisko Obecnie dla naszego klienta z branży finansowej poszukujemy kandydata/kandydatki na stanowisko Programista Fullstack AI - K/M ze znajomością Python i React. Dodatkowe informacje Praca w modelu hybrydowym z Warszawy (8-10 dni w biurze miesięcznie), dostępna od 04.01.2027. Poszukujemy osoby na poziomie Senior do rozwoju aplikacji GenLite. Rola obejmuje pracę przy backendzie Python, rozwiązaniach AI/RAG/LLM, integracjach z usługami Microsoft i Azure oraz rozwoju warstwy frontendowej w React i Vue. Wymagane jest wyższe wykształcenie. Oferowane wynagrodzenie Wynagrodzenie: od 1100 do 1260 PLN netto/dzień, w zależności od posiadanego doświadczenia i kompetencji. Sprawdzisz się w tej roli, jeżeli: Posiadasz komercyjne doświadczenie w Python 3.12/3.13, FastAPI, async/await, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, pytest oraz pytest-asyncio. Znasz architekturę API REST, OpenAPI, walidację wejścia, obsługę błędów, autoryzację, wersjonowanie endpointów oraz zasady kompatybilności wstecznej. Pracujesz z PostgreSQL i Redis, w tym modelowaniem danych, migracjami, indeksami, transakcjami, Redis Stack, vector search oraz podstawami pgvector. Posiadasz doświadczenie w obszarze AI/RAG/LLM, w szczególności Azure OpenAI/OpenAI API, embeddings, chunking dokumentów, retrieval oraz prompt engineering. Znasz TypeScript oraz React/Vite, a także Vue 3/Vite. Posiadasz doświadczenie z MSAL, Entra ID, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, CORS, CSRF oraz modelami ról i uprawnień. Pracujesz z integracjami obejmującymi Azure Blob Storage, Microsoft Graph, Jira, Confluence oraz klientami HTTP (httpx, aiohttp). Dbasz o jakość kodu poprzez testy jednostkowe i integracyjne, wykorzystanie ruff, pyright oraz utrzymywanie kontraktów API. Rozumiesz podstawy DevOps, w tym Docker Compose, logi Kubernetes, pipeline’y CI/CD, zmienne środowiskowe oraz migracje baz danych. Znasz CI/CD w środowisku aplikacji utrzymywanych na Kubernetes. Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w pracy z rozwiązaniami wykorzystującymi vector search i pgvector. Doświadczenie w rozwijaniu aplikacji opartych o AI, RAG i modele językowe. Znajomość zagadnień związanych z niezawodnością integracji i odpornością na błędy systemów zewnętrznych. Zadania, które na Ciebie czekają: Rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji GenLite. Projektowanie, rozwijanie i utrzymywanie backendu opartego o Python i FastAPI. Rozwijanie oraz integracja rozwiązań AI/RAG/LLM z wykorzystaniem Azure OpenAI/OpenAI API. Tworzenie i rozwój komponentów frontendowych w React/Vite oraz Vue 3/Vite. Projektowanie i rozwój API oraz integracji z usługami Azure, Microsoft Graph, Jira i Confluence. Praca z PostgreSQL i Redis, w tym rozwój modeli danych oraz migracji. Zapewnianie jakości kodu poprzez testy, przeglądy oraz utrzymanie standardów programistycznych. Współpraca przy wdrożeniach i utrzymaniu aplikacji działających na Kubernetes z wykorzystaniem procesów CI/CD. items.desc: Position Purpose: We are seeking a passionate and motivated AI Data Engineer to join our international team as part of a strategic expansion of our AI and Data capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data foundations that power foundational applications, advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Model (LLM) applications across the organization. You will work at the intersection of data engineering, AI platform development, and data governance, ensuring that high-quality, trusted, and scalable data is available to support AI-driven innovation. Your work will play a critical role in enabling next-generation AI solutions by building robust data pipelines, optimizing large-scale data architectures, and creating AI-ready datasets that support model training, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and intelligent automation initiatives. As an AI Data Engineer, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Architects, Product teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that data assets are reliable, accessible, secure, and aligned with both business and technical requirements. What You Will Be Doing Design, develop, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines supporting AI and analytics initiatives. Assess, modernize, and migrate legacy data platforms, tools, and operational processes to scalable, governed, and AI-ready data infrastructures. Lead initiatives to replace manual, siloed, or obsolete data workflows with automated, cloud-enabled, and data-driven solutions. Design and execute migration strategies for data assets stored in legacy applications, databases, file systems, and on-premise environments while ensuring data quality and business continuity. Refactor and optimize existing ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, and integration processes to align with modern architectural standards and AI platform requirements. Develop data processing solutions using Python, Spark, SQL, and distributed computing frameworks. Design and implement data architectures supporting LLM-based applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and knowledge management platforms. Develop and manage metadata, lineage, and cataloging solutions to improve data discoverability and governance. Collaborate with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to provide high-quality feature stores, training datasets, and inference data pipelines. Support the creation and maintenance of Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) platforms and reusable data products. Implement automated data quality checks, validation frameworks, and monitoring solutions to ensure data integrity and reliability. Contribute to AI platform engineering initiatives, including model-serving infrastructure, feature management, and AI data lifecycle management. Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations, security standards, and organizational governance policies. Define and implement best practices to ensure migrated systems comply with enterprise standards for data governance, security, lineage, observability, and documentation. Participate in the design of AI governance processes related to data sourcing, quality management, access control, and responsible AI. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process automation, technical debt reduction, and platform modernization. Stay informed on emerging technologies in data engineering, Generative AI, knowledge graphs, vector search, and AI platform architectures. Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, solution design reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. What You Need For This Position Fluency in Czech/Slovak. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Proven at least 5 years of working experience as a Big Data Engineer or similar. Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Scala, Python, or Java. Familiarity with APIs, data integration frameworks, and event-driven architectures. At least 5 years of experience in migrating legacy data platforms, repositories, and operational workflows to modern data architectures while ensuring business continuity and data integrity. Building data solutions using Python, SQL, Spark, and distributed computing frameworks experience. Knowledge of data security, encryption, access controls, and compliance requirements. Understanding of modern data architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh concepts. Familiarity with AI and ML workflows, including training data preparation, feature engineering, and model-serving data pipelines Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to navigate complex and ambiguous challenges. Passion for AI, data …

Our products—such as toilet paper, paper towels, and napkins—are distributed in more than 50 countries. items.desc:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
 The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 
 Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
 The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 
 About Iso 
 Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
 Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
 We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
 Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.
 Your impact 
 As a Security Engineer (Corporate Security) you will play a pivotal role in creating and maintaining a resilient, user-friendly and scalable corporate security environment at Isomorphic Labs. Operating with a proactive, service-minded approach and a strong bias for AI and automation, you will safeguard our workforce, identity systems, and sensitive data.
 In this unique and polyvalent role, you will implement and maintain pragmatic corporate security controls across a wide range of domains such as IAM, DLP, corporate/external applications, and data governance. You will participate in detection and incident response and develop long-lasting measures to improve our corporate security posture. Beyond technical controls, you will also build scalable and secure operational processes across a wide range of domains such as data transfer or systems integration that will materially impact IsoLabs’ mission. You will directly support AI/medical researchers on security topics and will ensure our cross-functional teams can innovate rapidly, securely, and with total confidence.
 What you will do 
 Corporate Identity & Access Management (IAM): Design, optimize, and support corporate IAM structures, including group architectures, identity system integration, and streamlined employee onboarding/offboarding workflows.
 Corporate Security Controls: Audit corporate systems security and deploy/maintain a wide range of security tools (e.g., logging, monitoring & DLP, data labeling, AI agents).
 Data Governance: Collaborating with Corp Engineering, enhance data governance and security within corporate systems (Google Workspace, Confluence, Jira, Slack, etc.) by gathering user needs and co-developing scalable operating models, appropriate configurations, and SOPs.
 Incident Response & Alert Triage: Partner closely with Detection & Response security engineers to improve and triage corporate security alerts, support incident response efforts when issues arise and address Google’ vulnerabilities and bugs.
 Security Awareness: Promote corporate security rules, support security awareness training and run social engineering exercises.
 Workplace Security: Collaborate with Workplace and Tech teams to ensure the security of physical systems (badges, lab workstations) and offices.
 Security of Operations & Processes: Translate key user needs and security compliance requirements into clear operational processes—such as establishing workflows for onboarding new tools, setting up data transfers and external system integrations.
 Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Execute standardized vendor and software audits, improve SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) through tools, and address third-party integrations and supply-chain safety risks.
 Automation & AI Integration: Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows to automate routine security tasks, optimize triage, and streamline operations.
 User Enablement: Act as a positive, proactive point of contact for internal teams, delivering user-oriented security solutions that reduce friction while upholding …

items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 Version française 
 En tant que V.I.E. Ingénieur en déploiement de solutions GenAI, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Imaging SW et contribuerez à l’Imaging AI Core Team, une initiative transversale visant à accélérer l’adoption de l’intelligence artificielle dans l’ensemble des activités Imaging.
 Votre mission principale sera de concevoir, développer et déployer des projets pilotes de GenAI, définis collectivement comme des priorités stratégiques pour l’organisation.
 Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation d’idées à fort potentiel en prototypes d’IA fonctionnels, leur validation auprès des équipes d’ingénierie, leur préparation à une utilisation opérationnelle et le soutien à leur déploiement à grande échelle dans Imaging.
 Ce poste est concret, très visible et au cœur de la feuille de route IA d’Imaging.
 A propos de vos missions 
 1. Développer des projets pilotes de GenAI basés sur les LLM

If you want autonomy, ownership and impact in an international scale-up, this is the role for you! items.desc: Krijg jij energie van AI-oplossingen die niet in slides blijven hangen, maar echt werken bij klanten? Ben je zowel sterk in analyseren en adviseren als in bouwen en integreren? Wil je mee de kar trekken om AI concreet te laten landen, bij klanten en intern bij Flexso? Dan ben jij misschien de AI Agentic Engineer die we zoeken! Profiel Professional Brand Flexso Digital Locaties waar je kan werken Ontdek ons kantoor in Kontich, Gent, Lummen Wie is Flexso? Flexso, da’s één team met véél expertises. Als SAP Gold partner bouwen we mee aan de bedrijfsprocessen van morgen en willen we een pionier zijn in digitale innovatie ; dat is waar we elke ochtend met volle goesting voor opstaan. En dat doen we al sinds 2004. We zijn een enthousiaste en gepassioneerde bende, gedreven door ondernemingszin en teamspirit. De blik vooruit en de voeten op de grond. Onze waarden en mensen, dat is onze kracht! Hier is iedereen helemaal zichzelf en krijg je de kans om initiatief te nemen en het verschil te maken in je rol. Bij Flexso zit je goed én op de eerste rij. Zin om mee te schrijven aan ons groeiverhaal? SAP...say what? SAP is dé marktleider wereldwijd in bedrijfssoftware , a.k.a. ‘Enterprise Application Software’, en biedt een onovertroffen portfolio aan apps die bedrijven ondersteunen in alle aspecten en dimensies van hun processen: logistiek, finance, HR, e-commerce, analytics,… you name it! Daarnaast biedt SAP ook een uiterst krachtig technologie platform – SAP Business Technology Platform – volledig gebaseerd op open standaarden en het ‘Bring Your Own Language’ principe (BYOL), zowel in de cloud als on-premise. Als Agentic AI Engineer bij Flexso … Sta je op het kruispunt van analyseren en bouwen . Waar veel AI-verhalen blijven steken in een demo, ben jij net diegene die de brug slaat: je begrijpt de nood van de klant, weet die te vertalen naar een concrete oplossing, én bouwt die zelf mee uit tot iets dat écht werkt in productie, end-to-end geïntegreerd met SAP. Die combinatie van functioneel inzicht en technische diepgang is precies waar jouw meerwaarde zit. Het is wat het verschil maakt tussen een AI-idee en een AI-oplossing die klanten ook effectief gebruiken . Deze rol is een pioniersrol . Agentic AI bij Flexso staat nog volop in ontwikkeling, en jij gaat mee bepalen hoe we het aanpakken: welke tools we inzetten (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, N8N, Claude, Copilot Studio,…), hoe we oplossingen laten landen bij klanten, en hoe we onze eigen aanpak en interne tools zoals Flexso Cortex verder uitbouwen. Het draaiboek ligt zeker niet vast. Je krijgt de ruimte en vrijheid om zelf mee vorm te geven aan wat goed werkt. Daarmee speel je ook een sleutelrol in onze toekomst . Wat jij vandaag mee opbouwt, de aanpak, de keuzes, de kennis, legt de basis voor hoe AI en agentic development hier de komende jaren verder groeien . Je deelt actief wat je leert met collega's en klanten, en je ownership reikt verder dan je eigen project: je helpt mee de richting bepalen. Kortom, als analytische bouwer met een pioniersmindset krijg je hier niet zomaar een rol, maar de kans om mee te schrijven aan het AI-verhaal van Flexso. Wat verwachten we? Je hebt een sterke interesse in (generatieve) AI en agentic development , en durft daar zelf mee te experimenteren en in te investeren. Je hebt ervaring met agentic frameworks zoals LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, N8N, AgentForce, Zapier of gelijkaardige platformen. Kennis van en ervaring met SAP, BTP, ABAP, ... is een sterke plus , maar geen absolute vereiste: we leren je graag die kant van het verhaal, als jij de AI/Agentic-expertise meebrengt. Je geeft advies en neemt ownership : van idee tot werkende oplossing. Je hebt zin om mee te bouwen aan iets nieuws binnen Flexso , en schrikt niet terug van een rol die nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Wat bieden wij jou? Boeiende en gevarieerde projecten , waarbij AI niet blijft hangen bij een idee of een demo, maar je zelf mee bepaalt hoe het écht landt bij klanten — volgens jouw interesses en expertise. Je maakt deel uit van een team dat mee de agentic AI-koers van Flexso uittekent , in een professionele organisatie met SAP-diepgang. Een job met impact : je katapulteert klanten én Flexso zelf naar een AI-gedreven toekomst. Coaching , opleidingen via de Flexso Academy en massa’s ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, in een cultuur van kennisdeling waar iedereen elkaar uitdaagt en helpt groeien. Duidelijke focus op innovatie: we investeren graag in de nieuwste tools en volgen de evoluties in AI, agentic frameworks en de SAP-roadmap op de voet. De dynamiek van een klein bedrijf en de mogelijkheden van een groot bedrijf. Een open organisatie met toffe collega's en véél feestjes . Een barbecue, hackathon of een weekendje weg zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering. Voor zover we met regels werken, dan. items.desc: Kleinanzeigen reaches 36M+ monthly users and is Germany’s leading online classifieds market. We are looking for an AI engineer proficient in Python, AWS, and GenAI frameworks to bridge the gap between business needs and production-grade solutions, while upholding high standards of software quality and AI ethics. As an experienced AI Engineer, you will: Understand user needs and business opportunities and identify where Artificial Intelligence (including GenAI) can bring the greatest impact. Design, build and deploy AI systems and agentic workflows. Contribute to the implementation of the AI strategy and roadmap for the company. Share your knowledge with your colleagues to boost artificial intelligence in Adevinta and strengthen our AI community. Main responsibilities will be: Have experience applying machine learning methods (including deep learning) to: Develop solutions to address impactful business needs. Assure quality and robustness of AI system outputs. Work with other team members to help productionize end-to-end ML solutions. Experience in applying Generative AI technologies to solve business problems, while demonstrating a thorough understanding of its associated risks. Proficiency in Python with ability to translate ideas into prototypes. Experience working in cloud environment (e.g. AWS) Experience with Agile philosophies (e.g. Scrum) and project management tools (e.g.: JIRA). items.desc: Nordic Knots is looking for a mid-level to senior Member of Technical Staff with 5+ years of experience to join our team in Stockholm. This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing interior design company that strives for perfection and is willing to invest in developing great tools that deliver excellent customer experiences. We are looking for someone who has fully embraced agentic development. You don’t just use AI to write code faster – you design the harnesses, tools and flows that let agents do real work reliably, and you have the engineering judgment to know when the output is right. You thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and love solving problems and improving business operations with technical solutions. The Role AI has changed how software gets built, and we have changed with it. Our tech team works agentic-first: agents handle much of the implementation, and our engineers spend their time on architecture, context, review and making sure that what ships is fast, correct and maintainable. You will be an integral part of a team responsible for everything from development and testing to architecture, ensuring that we continue to scale up in the most technically efficient way possible. You will also help shape how the whole company works with AI – from our eCommerce platform to the internal tools and automations used across buying, logistics, finance and customer experience. You’re both encouraged and expected to take the initiative and solve problems, as you will have the opportunity to influence the way the tech team works. You need an explorative mindset and the ability to pick up new models, tools and techniques as fast as the landscape moves. What you’ll do Build and maintain our eCommerce frontend in Next.js and TypeScript, along with the integrations to Centra, our headless eCommerce platform, and Sanity, our CMS – working agentic-first with Claude Code as your daily driver. Design and own our agentic development setup: project context and CLAUDE.md files, custom commands and skills, hooks, subagents, MCP servers and the guardrails that keep agents on track. Build AI pipelines and internal agents that streamline processes throughout the organization, connecting models to our business systems through well-designed tools. Write the specs, tests and evals that make agent output verifiable, and review AI-generated code for correctness, security and performance before it ships. Set up agentic flows in our CI/CD, such as automated code review, test generation and background agents working on well-scoped tasks. Be part of optimizing the performance of the application to ensure an exceptional user experience. Raise the bar for how the rest of the tech team, and the wider company, works with AI. Be part of developing the roadmap to make sure that we stay ahead of technological developments in our market space, aligned with the company’s long-term strategy and vision. Who you are You are a mid-level to senior engineer with 5+ years of experience building production software, ideally high-performing eCommerce applications. You work agentic-first by default. Agents are part of how you plan, build, test and review – not an add-on. You’ve been working with Claude Code since its research preview in early 2025 and have evolved your workflow alongside it. You have hands-on experience setting up harnesses, tools and flows for agents: context engineering, tool and MCP server design, subagent and multi-agent orchestration, evals and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. You understand the underlying systems well enough to catch an agent that is confidently wrong, and you hold AI-generated code to the same standard as your own. You know how to break a problem down and describe it precisely enough for an agent to act on. You are well versed in TypeScript, React, Next.js, RESTful API and GraphQL integrations, and comfortable working directly with LLM APIs. You adjust easily and are able to change course as new requirements – and new models – arise. You’re curious and enjoy technical discussions, especially about what the latest models can and can’t do. You have excellent English communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with a team. We’re a Swedish company with multinational coworkers. (Plus) You’ve shipped AI features that run in production, not just AI-assisted workflows for yourself. (Plus) You have a good eye for UX and UI design. (Plus) You’re business oriented and understand true customer value. How to stand out In your application, tell us about a harness, agent workflow or AI pipeline you’ve built: the problem it solved, how you set it up and what you learned along the way. items.desc: Data Engineer Context & Impact As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, trusted data has become critical to how we make executive and board-level decisions. Two questions sit at the center: how is our revenue performing and how are customers using our products? We’re hiring two Data Engineers to bring structure, trust, and clarity to both. You’ll join the Data & Analytics team and work in one of two focus areas: Revenue Analytics : Build the foundation for how Lansweeper measures growth: ARR, retention, expansion, and forecasting. Your work will shape how C-level leaders, the board, sales, and finance understand performance and planning. Product Insights : Build the pipelines and models that show how customers adopt and use our products. Your work will help product teams decide what to build next and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early. Both roles share one goal: connecting commercial performance with product behavior, so the business can see not just what is happening, but why. In the near term, you’ll help establish a single source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, build reliable, board- and leadership-ready reporting, and enable the forecasting and insight models that drive go-to-market and product decisions. You don’t need to know our products or industry already. Curiosity, strong engineering fundamentals, and an interest in the business side of data matter more. 6-12 Month Goals Develop a strong understanding of the data platform, architecture, and key data flows supporting business reporting and analytics. Become a trusted partner for internal stakeholders by delivering reliable, well-structured, and scalable data solutions that support decision-making. Improve the quality, consistency, and availability of data by strengthening pipelines, models, and data management practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. Support the company’s data maturity by enabling better access to trusted data and contributing to a scalable analytics foundation. Challenges The main challenges you'll face are: Working within a growing organization where data sources, systems, and business processes have evolved over time and may have been customized to meet specific needs. Designing scalable and maintainable data solutions in an environment where requirements may change frequently as the business grows. Ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across multiple systems and pipelines, while managing dependencies and complexity. Translating business needs into technical implementations that are both practical and aligned with long-term platform standards. Key Responsibilities For both roles: Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines and models that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics in your focus area Establish a single, trusted source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, reconciling data across systems of record Build the curated data models and semantic layer that power dashboards and reporting, in partnership with analysts Partner with business stakeholders (sales operations, finance, product, customer success) to understand evolving processes and reflect them accurately in our data models Investigate data anomalies and trace them back to their source (pipeline issue, upstream system change, or genuine business shift), then work with stakeholders to resolve them Proactively improve data quality and integrity across your pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting Month-end close support: Reporting is time-critical at month-end. This is occasional and planned in advance, and the load is shared across the team. items.desc: Published : 2026-10-22 Department IT, Finance & Compliance Nils Foss Allé 1 3400 Hillerød Country Denmark At FOSS, we are driven by a strong sense of purpose—and we hope you are too. Global food production is expected to increase by 60% by 2050 to meet the needs of a growing population. Our mission is to help food and agricultural companies worldwide meet this demand without compromising sustainability. To support this exciting journey, we are looking for a Group Controller to join our Group Control team within the Finance function. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping financial strategy and ensuring robust control processes that enable FOSS to deliver on purpose. You will work onsite at our head office in Hillerød Denmark. It is part of our DNA to always strive to become even better at what we do. Being FIRST is one of our core values, because it is both rewarding and fun. What you will be doing As a Group Controller, you will be an integral part of our Group Control team, working alongside four dedicated colleagues. You will play a pivotal role in supporting the growth ambitions of the business by creating standardized financial processes in a global setting and a high level of financial insight by developing and aligning the transactional accounting, controlling, statutory and tax reporting processes. The team is responsible for consolidation of reporting entities, maintaining the control framework, regional control of sales entities, transfer pricing, and overall accounting policies. In this role, you will contribute to ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting and help drive continuous improvements in processes and controls. You will work closely with the Head of Group Control and collaborate with international teams to support FOSS’s global operations. Your main responsibilities will include: Owning parts of the control process across the group, working with local teams to ensure compliance with group accounting standards and policies Driving internal audits and country visits to ensure compliance with our internal processes Taking a key role in delivering monthly reporting within your area of responsibility Driving the further integration of OneStream as our core consolidation system Taking a central role in preparing the group annual report, including reconciliations and working with external auditors Working with colleagues and advisors on tax and transfer pricing documentation Ensuring compliance with Danish GAAP (ÅRL), local GAAP, and IFRS Developing and maintaining robust internal controls and driving process improvements What we hope to see you bring We are looking for a finance professional with international experience, ideally from group-level consolidation. Here is what we hope you bring: You have around 7 + years of experience from a corporate environment, working in finance or controlling Ideally, you also have audit experience, from a Big Four firm or elsewhere You have worked with internal controls and compliance You have good knowledge of international tax, transfer pricing, and Danish GAAP (ÅRL) You are strong in MS Office, and knowing SAP or OneStream is a plus You enjoy using AI tools in your daily work, for example for analysis, reporting, or automating processes You like improving processes and finding smarter ways of working You are happy to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details, while still keeping the bigger picture in mind You are curious and not afraid to challenge how things are done today You stay calm and keep an eye for detail, even when things get busy You have a degree in finance, such as a Bachelor's or HD You communicate well in English, and Danish is a plus Personal attributes You are a person with strong personal drive and a proactive mindset. You are thorough and possess excellent collaboration skills, enabling you to build strong professional relationships. You maintain a positive, can-do attitude and take pride in communicating your expertise clearly to stakeholders and colleagues. You thrive in an environment where we challenge the status quo while having a clear focus on our end goals. You have a natural curiosity and an interest in technical details, which is essential given the complexity of our products. Why choose FOSS? At FOSS, we are driven by a strong sense of purpose: supporting sustainable food production to meet the growing global demand. We live by our values of being FIRST in everything we do—striving for continuous improvement and innovation. items.desc: b> : Pratiquer l’innovation, choisir un tremplin professionnel, inventer des technologies qui ont du sens, contribuer à des projets de recherche qui n’existent nulle part ailleurs, travailler avec plus d’autonomie, plus de responsabilités, bénéficier d’une diversité sous toutes ses formes, intégrer une communauté de personnalités bienveillantes, curieuses, expertes et enthousiastes : b<>com est, selon les mots de ses collaborateurs, une entreprise où il fait bon innover. Alors n’attendez plus, soyez là où les autres ne sont pas encore ! Quel sera votre environnement ? Dans un contexte où les organisations sont confrontées à de nombreuses crises, la capacité à identifier rapidement des tendances émergentes ou des signaux faibles constitue un enjeu majeur pour l'aide à la décision. Une part importante de ces informations est aujourd'hui accessible en ligne, à travers des sources variées telles que les articles de presse, les publications scientifiques, les réseaux sociaux ou encore les documents institutionnels. Cependant, la dispersion et le volume de ces données rendent leur exploitation manuelle complexe, voire irréaliste. Les avancées récentes en traitement de langage naturel (NLP), portées notamment par les grands modèles de langage (LLM), ouvrent de nouvelles perspectives pour l'analyse automatisée de données textuelles massives. Ces modèles apparaissent comme des outils prometteurs pour les analyser à grande échelle et mettre en évidence des éléments d'intérêt. Ils ouvrent en outre la voie à une « prospective augmentée », dans laquelle ils assistent les experts sans s'y substituer, en challengeant des hypothèses ou en identifiant des scénarios de futur possibles, par exemple. Leur exploration constitue ainsi une opportunité de développer de nouvelles approches pour la détection précoce de tendances et de signaux pertinents au sein de flux massifs de données, ainsi que pour l’assistance à la prospective. Quelle sera votre mission ? Au sein d'un projet interdisciplinaire intégrant des recherches sur les liens entre numérique et vulnérabilités, ce stage vise à explorer et à développer des pipelines de traitement automatisé de données textuelles massives, dans le but de détecter des tendances ou des signaux faibles. Les objectifs seront notamment de : Réaliser une étude sur le traitement de grands corpus textuels pour la détection de tendances, de signaux faibles et pour la prospective augmentée ; Évaluer différentes approches sur des jeux de données de référence ; Implémenter l’approche la plus adaptée dans un pipeline complet ;19/10/2026 Diffusion : interne RH/M&C Documenter les études, évaluations et implémentations réalisées. Quel profil ? Étudiant•e en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou en master 2 informatique, avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, en traitement du langage naturel ou en traitement de données massives. > Les indispensables Développement en Python, gestion de versions via Git Connaissances en IA, en NLP et/ou en big data Aptitude à travailler en autonomie tout en sachant évoluer en équipe > Les plus Connaissance de modèles d’apprentissage machine (classification, prédiction, clustering) Connaissance des bibliothèques Python de traitement de données (pandas, matplotlib, spaCy, LangChain) Connaissance de technologies de traitement de données massives (Spark, data lakes) Connaissance de représentations formelles de données (p. ex. graphes de connaissances) Aisance dans la lecture d’articles de recherche récents Quelles modalités ? Build lasting relationships with partner engineering teams. Translate requirements and customer feedback into actionable plans, coordinate experts and influence product priorities. Track partner readiness, joint solution adoption and contributions to pipeline and customer wins. Use these results to improve enablement and scale successful partner activities. What you bring 5+ years in solutions architecture, technical presales or partner technical roles, with substantial experience supporting Channel and Technology partnerships. Demonstrated success enabling both VARs and technology partners, including examples of partners independently positioning solutions, pursuing opportunities or delivering joint offerings. Experience building joint value propositions and taking partner solutions to market, with evidence of customer wins, adoption growth or commercial impact. A track record of building partner enablement programs and adapting content for sales, presales and engineering audiences. Strong cloud architecture fundamentals across compute, storage, networking and security, with the ability to explain trade-offs and connect technical decisions to customer needs. Experience earning trust with partner engineering and product teams, working effectively with internal engineers and coordinating delivery across organizations without direct authority. Clear communication with engineers and business leaders, sound commercial judgment and an understanding of how resellers and technology partners make money. items.desc: About Serinyx Serinyx builds AI for high-stakes decisions on confidential data. On our decision-intelligence platform, AI agents break a hard question down, research it with checked citations and debate the findings under human review. The result is a verified, cited and signed report. Our second product gives universities and research institutes an always-current, AI-built view of their research. We were founded in Saarbrücken in 2026 and are now building our engineering team. The role You build what people use on our decision-intelligence platform, end to end. Users set up a research question, watch AI agents work on it live, review the findings and read the final report. You make each step clear, fast and accessible, from the component to the API behind it. Why this role You own the whole product surface, design system included, not one corner of it. Interesting interface problems: live AI runs, long-running jobs and human review in one flow. Your design system becomes the foundation every future screen is built on. What you will do in your first year Own the design system: a versioned design-token contract, several switchable visual themes and a library of atomic components that every screen uses. Ship the core flows end to end, screen and API: setting up a question, a live monitor for long-running AI research runs, the human review steps and the report view. Build the console where people approve which sources the platform may use, plus account, admin and sign-in flows. Keep every theme accessible, with colour contrast checked automatically in CI. Work with the engineer who builds our simulation and forecasting layer on how reports and forecasts are shown. What you bring Several years designing and owning production web products end to end. Show us one. React and TypeScript on the frontend; Python (FastAPI or similar) with Postgres on the backend. Design-system work: tokens, theming, and a component library others build on (Storybook or similar). Interfaces for complex workflows: forms, long-running jobs, review and approval steps. Tests across the stack (Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright, pytest). You turn a vague goal into a precise work order an AI coding agent can build from, and you can show us a time you caught an agent’s code or tests being wrong. Nice to have Temporal; single sign-on (OIDC, Keycloak or Entra ID); data visualisation (ECharts, D3); forms driven by JSON Schema; accessibility audits. How we work One team, one backlog. Everyone builds from day one and works directly with our CTO, Dr Raja Naeem Akram. Owners, not ticket-takers. Each engineer owns parts of the codebase and leads the AI coding agents working in them: writing their work orders, reviewing every pull request and deciding what merges. A typical week. Much of your time goes into specifying and reviewing work done by AI coding agents; the hardest parts you write yourself. AI agents take the routine platform work. Infrastructure, deployment and monitoring are done by AI agents under engineering review, so your time goes into design and the hard problems. You still own what you build once it is live. Quality is part of the job. You write the tests for your own work and keep CI green. Done means tests pass, security scans are clean, docs are updated and container images are signed. Two-week cycles. Planning on day one, a demo on day ten and a short written retro. English first. English is our working language; German is welcome but not required. What we offer Real ownership. An early role in a small team: you shape the product, the code and how we work, not a ticket queue. A modern stack. Python, FastAPI, Temporal, Kubernetes, React with TypeScript, and the best AI models for each task. Saarbrücken, hybrid. We are based in one of Europe’s leading centres for computer science, and we work hybrid. 30 days of holidays per year. International applicants welcome. If you come from outside the EU, we support you through the work-permit process, usually the EU Blue Card. How to apply Send your CV and one link that shows your work (code, a paper or a project you built) to contact@serinyx.com with the job title in the subject line. English or German is fine. The process has three steps: a call with our CTO, a technical interview on a problem typical of the role, with your usual AI tools, and a conversation with the founders. Equal opportunity We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity. You don’t need to include a photo or your date of birth. Job Type: Full-time Pay: 55.000,00€ - 65.000,00€ per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in 66111 Saarbrücken

items.desc: Kleinanzeigen reaches 36M+ monthly users and is Germany’s leading online classifieds market. We are a sustainability-focused platform where you won't just write code; you will power the services that bridge our high-traffic backend with seamless user experiences. As a Data Engineer (Analytics & Products) at Kleinanzeigen, you start where the data need begins — not where the code does. You will work directly with product managers, analysts, and domain stakeholders to understand what decisions the data needs to support, how it will be consumed, and what already exists in the platform before writing a single line. From there, you design and build data assets that are homogeneous with the existing stack, cost-effective at scale, maintainable by the next engineer, and self-discoverable, so consumers can find, understand, and trust what you built without asking you. You will own the full lifecycle: ingestion through Airflow DAGs, transformation across dbt stage, core, and report layers on Databricks, and the quality, documentation, and observability that make those assets production-grade. You stay current with Airflow and design DAG topology deliberately, knowing when to use dynamic task mapping, data-aware scheduling, the TaskFlow API, or a Cosmos dbt task group with Watcher mode for performance-critical pipelines. You understand Spark well enough to know why a dbt incremental model running in Databricks produces a full table scan instead of a partition filter push-down, how a poorly configured merge operation compounds into file fragmentation over time, and what to do about it, whether that means adjusting the incremental strategy, adding liquid clustering, running OPTIMIZE, or rethinking the model grain entirely. You write Python and shell scripts as naturally as SQL and follow engineering core principles: modularity, idempotency, testability, not because they are rules, but because they make your work last. You operate in an AI-First engineering model: AI handles execution; you own intent, precision, and correctness. You use it to automate, to accelerate best practices, and to raise the quality bar across the team, not to ship faster with less judgment. You will collaborate closely with analysts, product managers, data platform engineers, and stakeholders across the company to ensure that the datasets we create and maintain in our data platform are reliable, trustworthy, and built to serve the decisions that matter. items.desc: Data Engineer Context & Impact As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, trusted data has become critical to how we make executive and board-level decisions. Two questions sit at the center: how is our revenue performing and how are customers using our products? We’re hiring two Data Engineers to bring structure, trust, and clarity to both. You’ll join the Data & Analytics team and work in one of two focus areas: Revenue Analytics : Build the foundation for how Lansweeper measures growth: ARR, retention, expansion, and forecasting. Your work will shape how C-level leaders, the board, sales, and finance understand performance and planning. Product Insights : Build the pipelines and models that show how customers adopt and use our products. Your work will help product teams decide what to build next and help customer success spot risk and opportunity early. Both roles share one goal: connecting commercial performance with product behavior, so the business can see not just what is happening, but why. In the near term, you’ll help establish a single source of truth for your domain’s KPIs, build reliable, board- and leadership-ready reporting, and enable the forecasting and insight models that drive go-to-market and product decisions. You don’t need to know our products or industry already. Curiosity, strong engineering fundamentals, and an interest in the business side of data matter more. 6-12 Month Goals Develop a strong understanding of the data platform, architecture, and key data flows supporting business reporting and analytics. Become a trusted partner for internal stakeholders by delivering reliable, well-structured, and scalable data solutions that support decision-making. Improve the quality, consistency, and availability of data by strengthening pipelines, models, and data management practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. Support the company’s data maturity by enabling better access to trusted data and contributing to a scalable analytics foundation. Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity. Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you'll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. You take extreme technical complexity and turn it into a strategic solution, which positions Boomi as the leader in data activation. The ideal candidate knows the Boomi ecosystem cold and has a track record of clearing architectural hurdles to drive revenue attainment. You bridge field requirements and product innovation. items.card: Job Description Do you love film, tech and building innovative solutions? Are you driven by building stable, modern systems, and would you like to join a team where film quotes fly and the next big premiere is always up for discussion? This is your chance to combine your passion for tech with the magic of film! SF Studios is looking for a Software Engineer to help shape the future of streaming and film experiences.
items.desc: I'm interested Industry Entertainment Category Software Development Experience Experienced Location: Stockholm Workspace type: On-site Visit website Follow SF Studios Enable "functional cookies" to watch the video Job Description Do you love film, tech and building innovative solutions? Are you driven by building stable, modern systems, and would you like to join a team where film quotes fly and the next big premiere is always up for discussion? This is your chance to combine your passion for tech with the magic of film! SF Studios is looking for a Software Engineer to help shape the future of streaming and film experiences. Whether you prefer action, drama or sci-fi, this is a role where you can make a real difference. So, are you ready for the next chapter in your career? The role covers both SF Studios and SF Anytime. You’ll join a tight-knit, highly skilled team with many years of experience. What we all share is a strong interest in tech, film and series. The team has an open, non-hierarchical culture, which gives you plenty of room to influence where development goes next and to contribute to the company’s continued success. It’s a dynamic environment where you can help create magic, both at home and on the global stage. The role You’ll be part of a central development team that works across both SF Studios and SF Anytime and owns the full lifecycle of our services, from code to infrastructure and operations. You’ll work with a wide range of technologies, such as .NET, MongoDB, SQL Server, Docker, AWS, Terraform, GitHub and GitHub Actions, and Splunk. We also use AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code in our day-to-day work. Your responsibilities include: Designing and building robust, scalable and highly available APIs Building, maintaining and operating our cloud infrastructure on AWS using infrastructure as code Improving our CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and alerting to keep our services reliable in production Developing and maintaining internal and external-facing applications, including back-office systems for the business Building agentic workflows and integrations, such as MCP servers Working with other developers, product owners and stakeholders to deliver the best possible customer experience We have an office-first policy, which means the role is based at our office in Hagastaden five days a week. Requirements To be successful in this role, we believe you: Have at least a couple of years’ experience with .NET and feel at home in that environment Have solid experience with AWS (experience with Azure or GCP is also a plus) Have experience with both relational and document databases Speak Swedish – you don’t need to be fluent, but it’s a must – and have strong spoken and written English, as both languages are used every day It’s a plus if you have experience with streaming services experience building large-scale, distributed systems experience with data warehouse solutions and system integration knowledge of React As a person, you’re highly committed to your work and enjoy being part of a team. You are comfortable taking ownership and independently driving initiatives through to completion. At the same time, you actively engage with stakeholders across the business to gather input, discuss solutions and ensure that what we build meets real business needs. Furthermore, you work efficiently and have good business sense. You can argue the case for your own solution, while also being quick to acknowledge when someone else’s idea works better. You have a structured approach, take initiative and see problem-solving as something fun and challenging. Application Does this sound like a job for you? Apply today. We look forward to your application. For questions, please turn to SF Studios’ CTO Roger Levy, roger.levy@sfstudios.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications sent through email. About the company SF Studios, founded in 1919, is one of the world’s oldest film companies and the leading film studio in the Nordic region. Its business includes production and distribution of feature films and TV series and the streaming platform SF Anytime. SF Studios has its head office in Stockholm, Sweden and subsidiaries in Oslo, Copenhagen and Helsinki, and is part of the leading Nordic media company Bonnier AB.
