items.card: About the role Meridial is seeking an experienced experimental neuroscientist to join our team as Scientist – In Vivo Neurophysiology . This is a hands-on scientific role focused on developing and performing advanced in vivo experiments in mice that combine intracellular electrophysiology, two-photon imaging and optogenetic stimulation. You will develop new approaches as part of Meridial’s programme to create
items.desc: About Meridial Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system. Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA). About the role Meridial is seeking an experienced experimental neuroscientist to join our team as Scientist – In Vivo Neurophysiology . This is a hands-on scientific role focused on developing and performing advanced in vivo experiments in mice that combine intracellular electrophysiology, two-photon imaging and optogenetic stimulation. You will develop new approaches as part of Meridial’s programme to create advanced 3D imaging and photostimulation technologies for functional mapping of neural circuits. Your initial focus will be to establish electrophysiological ground-truth measurements for Meridial’s optical approaches to mapping functional neural connectivity. You will combine targeted intracellular recordings with optical imaging and stimulation to understand how synaptic activity and neuronal spiking are reflected in fluorescence signals. Your results will help guide experimental strategy and serve as a crucial foundation for interpreting our optical data. You will also contribute more broadly to Meridial’s experimental programme. That will include performing longitudinal two-photon imaging and optogenetic experiments and developing new approaches that extend the capabilities of our platform. We are looking for an exceptional experimentalist who combines strong electrophysiological and imaging expertise with scientific independence. You will join a growing Experimental Team and report to the Director of Experimental Research. You will work closely with engineers and computational researchers across Meridial and help train and mentor experimental team members. Key Responsibilities In vivo experimentation Develop and perform high-quality in vivo whole-cell patch-clamp recordings in current and voltage clamp, including two-photon-guided targeted patching combined with optical imaging and optogenetic stimulation. Contribute to analysis of electrophysiological and imaging data. Design and run in vivo experiments combining two-photon imaging and optogenetic stimulation, including longitudinal imaging of the same animals. Perform neurosurgical procedures required for in vivo electrophysiology and imaging experiments. Monitor recording and imaging quality, physiological stability and animal welfare throughout acute and longitudinal studies and identify and resolve sources of noise, artefacts and variability. Method and platform development Set up Meridial’s in vivo electrophysiology rig together with in-house experts, integrating acquisition with two-photon imaging and optogenetic stimulation. Lead the development, optimisation and validation of targeted patching methods. Optimise experimental configurations to improve recording stability, signal quality, reproducibility and throughput, and establish quantitative quality-control criteria and reproducible workflows for electrophysiological, imaging and multimodal experiments. Work with the Computational Team to develop analysis workflows, and to make sure data and metadata meet the standards needed for open sharing. Evaluate emerging technologies and experimental approaches relevant to Meridial's platform. Scientific contribution and team development Contribute to experimental design and interpretation across Meridial's research programmes, particularly the validation of optical measurements of neural activity and connectivity. Train and mentor other team members in electrophysiological, imaging, surgical and related experimental techniques. Maintain thorough experimental documentation and promote high standards of rigour, reproducibility and animal welfare. Communicate findings, technical challenges and recommendations clearly to colleagues across disciplines. Essential Qualifications and Experience PhD in neuroscience, neurophysiology, biophysics or a related discipline, or equivalent research experience. Substantial (3+ years’) hands-on experience with whole-cell patch-clamp electrophysiology, including high-quality current-clamp recordings. Strong practical expertise in electrophysiological troubleshooting, including obtaining and maintaining stable recordings, optimising recording quality and distinguishing physiological signals from technical artefacts. Experience with the surgical preparations required for in vivo electrophysiology, such as craniotomy and headplate implantation. Substantial hands-on experience with in vivo two-photon microscopy. Excellent understanding of neuronal physiology and biophysics, including synaptic …

The role offers broad exposure to property acquisitions, construction, development projects and commercial transactions, alongside a particular focus on using Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation and digital technology to improve how we work. We are looking for someone who is organised, curious and enthusiastic about technology, with the initiative to identify opportunities to make processes more efficient and develop practical digital solutions. Key Responsibilities Coordinate property administration, records, project documentation and reporting. Maintain property pipeline trackers, monitor deadlines and support acquisitions and transactions. Assist with construction and development projects, including budgets, programmes and milestones. Liaise with solicitors, property agents, developers, contractors and internal teams. Support legal due diligence, contractual documentation and transaction approvals. AI and Automation: Identify opportunities to use AI tools, develop AI agents and automated workflows, and explore simple applications that reduce manual work and improve efficiency. Use AI and digital tools to support research, document preparation, reporting, information analysis and project monitoring. Test and improve new processes, ensuring information is handled securely and responsibly. About You You will be proactive, analytical and detail-oriented, with strong organisational and communication skills and a genuine desire to learn. Essential requirements: Degree-level education or equivalent capability. Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. An interest in property, development, construction and commercial transactions. A genuine interest in AI, automation and emerging technologies, with the initiative to explore how they can improve business processes. Desirable experience: A degree in Property, Real Estate, Construction, Law, Business, Economics or a related discipline. Experience using AI tools, creating automated workflows, developing simple applications or improving digital processes. Previous experience in property, construction, project management or a commercial environment. Previous property experience is not essential. We welcome applications from graduates and candidates with strong potential, including those who have independently developed their AI and technology skills. Career Development This role offers the opportunity to develop technical and commercial property expertise while gaining practical experience in AI and business process automation. As your skills develop, you will take on increasing responsibility for property transactions, development projects and digital improvement initiatives. Why Join Liaise? Liaise provides specialist residential care for adults with learning disabilities, autism and complex needs. Our Property Team supports the organisation's growth by delivering safe, high-quality living environments. Join us to build a varied career combining property, commercial development and technology, while making a meaningful difference to people's lives.

items.desc: Quel sera votre rôle dans la #TeamDeloitte ? Description de l'emploi L'univers de la Data et de l'Intelligence Artificielle (IA) est à l'aube d'une révolution sans précédent, marquée par des avancées technologiques fulgurantes et une intégration toujours plus poussée dans tous les secteurs d'activité. L'ère de l'IA générative, avec son potentiel de transformer radicalement la stratégie de données des entreprises, s'annonce comme un tournant majeur pour les organisations. Rejoindre Deloitte France en tant qu' AI Engineer / Scientist confirmé vous offre une opportunité unique de jouer un rôle essentiel dans la conduite et la croissance de nos activités en Intelligence Artificielle au sein d'un cabinet de conseil de renommée mondiale. Vous travaillerez au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, en étroite collaboration avec des experts métiers et des cadres dirigeants, pour transformer les défis de nos clients dans divers secteurs tels que les services financiers, le secteur de l'énergie, la santé ou encore la technologie, les médias et les télécommunications. Vous contribuerez à établir les meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie IA (MLOps), de choix d'architecture technique et de delivery de produits IA en travaillant main dans la main, lorsque le contexte le permet, avec nos partenaires stratégiques (AWS, GCP, Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, Nvidia) . Vous aurez également l'opportunité de travailler et apprendre auprès d'une équipe d’experts de l'IA . Contribuer au delivery des projets et produits IA (Machine Learning, GenAI, NLP, Classification, Computer Vision, modélisation) pour des clients de divers secteurs Encadrer de jeunes Data Scientists et Ingénieurs ML en les coachant et assurant leur montée en compétences. Mettre en place et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques MLOps et LLMOps pour optimiser la livraison des modèles IA en production (scalabilité, fiabilité, coûts). Être un prescripteur sur les outils communs Data & IA et assurer l'identification et le déploiement d'assets techniques réutilisables (internes, groupe, marché). Contribuer activement à la veille technologique pour amplifier l'innovation et identifier les synergies entre technologies, méthodes et pratiques. Assurer la qualité des solutions, le respect des bonnes pratiques de développement et de sécurité, et intégrer les principes d'architecture de Deloitte. Capitaliser et diffuser auprès des équipes internes et externes sur les avancées et les résultats des projets IA. Participer à des initiatives d'innovation et effectuer une veille technologique sur les pratiques LLMOps. Et si c’était vous ? Au moins 3 années d'expérience significative dans le domaine du ML et de l’IA, et plus globalement de la data science, idéalement acquise dans un environnement de conseil ou en lien avec divers secteurs d'activité. Une formation scientifique et/ou informatique de niveau Bac+5 minimum, de préférence avec une spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées, machine learning ou domaines connexes. Une solide compréhension des technologies et outils d'IA, incluant notamment Python, PyTorch, ScikitLearn, services Clouds IA (Azure, GCP, AWS). La maîtrise de frameworks et outils liés aux LLM (ex?: LangChain, LangGraph, FAISS) est également un atout. Une maîtrise des concepts core du Machine Learning (Réseaux neuronaux, apprentissage non/semi/supervisé, Deep Learning, classification, modélisation). Une expérience significative dans les techniques de NLP/GenAI incluant LLM, RAG, VectorStores, Agents LLM. Une expertise avérée en gestion de projets techniques et une excellente capacité de collaboration interfonctionnelle. Une familiarité avec les processus et outils de développement modernes (DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes) et le déploiement de micro-services ou API (Flask, Django). Un esprit de synthèse et une capacité à travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires. D'excellentes capacités de communication et de présentation, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des profils techniques et non techniques. Une curiosité intellectuelle et d'excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes. La maîtrise des outils, méthodologies et concepts de suivi et gestion de projet est un plus.

items.desc: About At Uniplay, our vision is simple: Make Corporate Learning Fun. We're building something different — an AI-native company where games, data, and hyper-personalisation redefine how people learn and grow at work. Our product blends games, behavioral data, and AI agents into a living learning experience that adapts to employees and evolves with every organisation. We care less about titles and more about people who create, collaborate, and push limits. The role AI isn't a feature we bolted on — it's the product. Agent workflows, source grounding, RAG, structured generation, and learning science are how we turn real company material into adaptive, game-based learning. We're looking for an AI Engineer to join the team building that machinery: researching what's possible, building it, evaluating it honestly, and shipping it to customers. It's a hands-on role for someone who moves from paper to prototype to production without needing three planning meetings first. What you'll do Build AI learning pipelines end to end. From ingestion of source material to generated, adaptive learning content — research, build, ship, measure, improve, together with the rest of the engineering team. Work with messy, real knowledge sources. Documents, links, videos, internal company material. Turning that into something useful is the hard part, and it's what the team spends its days on. Build our evaluation infrastructure. Quality in generated learning content is not a vibe. Help us define how we measure it and make the numbers move. Improve the AI production system. Prompts, templates, orchestration, model selection, latency, cost, internal tooling. Find the bottlenecks and remove them. Add a strong voice to the roadmap. You'll have real influence over what we build next — and a direct line to the people making those calls. Work closely with the rest of the team. Engineers, product, design, and learning experts. You'll review each other's work, pair on hard problems, and share what you learn. What we're looking for Real experience shipping AI systems. You've built LLM-powered products that ran in production, with real users and real failure modes — not just notebooks and demos. Depth in the modern stack. RAG, agentic workflows, structured generation, evals, vector databases, knowledge graphs. You know where each one earns its keep and where it doesn't. Your own projects. You build things because you can't help it. Show us at least one — repo, demo, write-up, product. What you learned matters more than how polished it is. Extreme drive. You don't wait for permission. You make things happen and bring people along. Fast iteration. You prototype quickly, kill your own ideas when the data says so, and are comfortable with messy early-stage exploration. Strong engineering. TypeScript and/or Python. You write code others can build on. Curiosity about how people learn. The bottleneck to AI value isn't technology — it's human learning and behaviour change. If that thesis interests you, we'll get along. A team player. You share context, ask for help early, give useful feedback, and would rather the team ship something good than be right on your own. Clear communication in English. Swedish a plus. Why Uniplay Work on AI that turns company knowledge into learning experiences people voluntarily come back to. Global from day one — Sweden, Brazil, UK, DACH. A small team where your work reaches production in days, not quarters. Direct collaboration with engineers, AI specialists, HR experts, and product designers. Stockholm-base Goodbye boring. Hello fun. Apply https://careers.uniplay.io/jobs/8223234-ai-engineer

items.desc: Make a difference in the financial life of millions of people: At Erste Digital you are co-creating the digital future, in which better financial health is possible. #believeinyourself We are part of Erste Group – the largest banking group in Central and Eastern Europe with more than 2,500 branches and over 45,000 employees. Our more than 2,000 IT experts and enthusiasts are the bank's Digital Muscle. What to do: You deliver Data Science and Generative AI solutions that create measurable value for our internal business customers across Retail, Corporate, Operations, Data Quality and other areas. Typical use cases include customer experience, sales optimization, churn prevention, transaction classification, text and document processing, knowledge assistants and AI-powered automation. You design, develop and evaluate predictive models, machine learning solutions and GenAI applications, including solutions based on Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents and other emerging AI technologies. You work across the full Data Science and AI lifecycle – from understanding the business problem and exploring data to data preparation, feature engineering, model development, experimentation, evaluation, deployment and continuous improvement. You apply appropriate evaluation methods and guardrails to ensure that AI and GenAI solutions are accurate, reliable, explainable and suitable for use in a regulated banking environment. You collaborate closely with business experts, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, AI Platform teams and other partner departments to bring prototypes into robust, scalable and production-ready solutions. You work effectively both independently and as part of a team, proactively involving colleagues and subject-matter experts whenever needed to deliver high-quality results on time. You demonstrate genuine curiosity and continuously explore how developments in Machine Learning, Generative AI and emerging AI technologies can be translated into practical solutions for the banking industry. You are willing to continuously learn and develop your skills while working with business owners and multidisciplinary teams, including in international projects across Erste Group. You combine a strong interest in data, technology and business problems and are able to translate between technical possibilities and tangible business outcomes. You check these boxes: Bachelor’s or Masters degree with a focus on quantitative disciplines Minimum of 2 years practical experience as a Data Scientist Good understanding of statistical methods and common machine learning algorithms Hands-on experience in the design and development of applications utilizing the Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pattern, which includes steps such as chunking, embedding, and querying a Large Language Model (LLM) Good knowledge of Python, Spark and SQL (with practical experience). Hands-on experience with Databricks is a big plus. Basic understanding of the banking business Language skills: English full professional proficiency Why you will like us: Possibility to benefit and learn from our international, talented and passionate community at Erste Interest groups and clubs: Take part in discussions and get involved in projects. Employee benefits – Benefit from special conditions for financial services and insurances, supermarkets, clothing stores and many more. Employee Referral Program – Become a talent scout for career opportunities in IT. Act as a driver of continuous improvement for M&S capabilities within the function Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of learning, collaboration, and innovation Personal Skills And Professional Experience Modeling and Simulation Expertise: Strong background in statistics and mathematical modeling including Bayesian optimization (BoTorch, Optuna), uncertainty quantification, machine learning (scikit-learn, Pyro, Stan), and scientific computing Expert knowledge of Python and Git, with optional familiarity with R or Julia. Eingangsrechnungen landen automatisch im ERP, und fremdsprachige Mails lassen sich direkt im Postfach verstehen und beantworten. Unsere Kunden kommen aus allen Branchen und haben jede Größe, ein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Mittelstand. Du entwickelst KI-Lösungen, die in Produktion laufen, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment. Das kann ein neues System sein oder eine Erweiterung der bestehenden Software unserer Kunden. Du baust agentische Systeme: Bots mit klaren Aufgaben, automatisierte Workflows über mehrere Systeme und agentische Teams, in denen spezialisierte Agents und Menschen zusammenarbeiten, abgesichert mit Guardrails und Human-in-the-loop. Du entwickelst unsere Open-Source-basierte KI-Plattform orchideo | coreAI weiter: LLM-Gateway, MCP-Anbindung an Kundensysteme, Workflow-Engines, z.B. n8n und Temporal. Betrieben wird sie on-premise, in der Cloud oder hybrid. Du sorgst dafür, dass KI im Alltag zuverlässig funktioniert. Dazu gehören Evaluierung, Monitoring, Kostenkontrolle und Wartbarkeit, und du machst aus Prototypen belastbare, produktive Lösungen. Du machst die Daten und das Wissen unserer Kunden nutzbar, mit RAG und NLP oder, wo es passt, mit klassischem ML wie Prognosen, Computer Vision und Predictive Analytics. Du baust selbst und Beratung gehört ebenso dazu. In unseren AI-Shift-Workshops bringst du die technische Perspektive ein, findest mit Kunden Use Cases, prüfst die Machbarkeit und machst daraus Umsetzungspläne. Du teilst Wissen, intern in unserer KI-Gilde und extern, zum Beispiel in Fachbeiträgen oder auf Konferenzen. Warum jetzt zu uns? Unser AI-Team besteht aktuell aus 7 Kollegen und unserer Head of AI. Unterstützt wird es von der KI-Gilde mit neun Mitgliedern, die unser KI-Wissen bündelt und das ganze Unternehmen im Wandel mitnimmt. Gerade weil das Team noch wächst, hast du großen Einfluss darauf, welche Technologien wir einsetzen und wie wir Lösungen bauen. Du arbeitest nicht in einem Innovationslabor, sondern an Lösungen für echte Kunden. Profil Du kommst aus der professionellen Softwareentwicklung und bist nun tief in KI eingetaucht. Du weißt, was es heißt, Software zu bauen, die wartbar, sicher und im Betrieb stabil ist, und genau das willst du jetzt mit KI machen. B. APIs, Datenbanken, Cloud und CI/CD Praktische Erfahrung mit KI in echten Projekten, z. B. mit LLMs, RAG, NLP oder klassischem ML Erste Erfahrung mit Agentenarchitekturen, MCP oder Workflow-Engines wie n8n Kommunikationsstärke, ein sicheres Auftreten bei Kunden und Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) Du hast Software gebaut, die läuft und willst jetzt KI bauen, die läuft? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Wir bieten Marktgerechte Vergütung: Ein konkurrenzfähiges Gehaltspaket, das wir jährlich gemeinsam besprechen und anpassen. Die Gehaltsspanne zum Einstieg liegt je nach Erfahrung bei 65.000–85.000 € Jahresbrutto. Unternehmenskultur: Unsere Werte sind mehr als Worte. Dafür wurden wir mehrfach ausgezeichnet. way we work: Hybrid und flexibel. Du entscheidest mit deinem Team, wann und wo ihr arbeitet. Weil wir nah an unseren Kunden in der Region Ulm sind, arbeiten wir nicht zu 100 % remote. Familie & Leben: Teilzeit ist in allen Modellen möglich. Spontan mittags vom Office ins Homeoffice, weil zu Hause etwas ist? Kein Problem. …

items.desc: Love what you do – we make employment happen! Are you a passionate AI Engineer eager to build AI solutions that will reshape the European job market? We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our cross-functional AI Hub , working across teams and products to turn the latest advances in AI into solutions used by our customers and internal teams. In this high-impact role, you’ll design, build and deploy AI-powered applications and services , working with technologies such as LLMs, Generative AI, RAG and intelligent agents . You’ll experiment with new approaches, rapidly turn ideas into prototypes, and take the most promising solutions all the way into production. WHAT IS JOBCLOUD HR TECH? JobCloud HR Tech is the Porto, Portugal based company of JobCloud, Switzerland’s number 1 job ads brand and the company behind jobs.ch and jobup.ch. We build software that helps companies spend their hiring budget efficiently and get their job ads in front of the right candidates. Millions of job seekers and thousands of companies use our platform to find each other. WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK AT JOBCLOUD? We work as one team of experts in our field. Our culture is inclusive and respectful, and it is built on openness and collaboration. Your skills and motivation count. Your skin colour, gender and beliefs do not matter to us. Come as you are. Our purpose is “Love what you do.” WHAT WILL YOU DO IN THIS ROLE? Design, build, and operate production AI applications that connect language models with enterprise data, APIs, and business workflows. Develop conversational and AI-assisted experiences using tool calling, structured outputs, orchestration, state management, and appropriate combinations of deterministic workflows, RAG, and agentic behavior. Integrate and prepare data from APIs, databases, document repositories, and event-driven systems, ensuring it remains secure, current, and suitable for AI use. Establish automated evaluation, testing, monitoring, tracing, feedback, and safe fallback mechanisms covering quality, groundedness, reliability, latency, and cost. Collaborate with platform and security teams on deployment, CI/CD, observability, access control, privacy, auditing, and prompt-injection defenses. Own technical designs, communicate trade-offs, review code, mentor colleagues, and turn ambiguous business needs into maintainable solutions. WHAT SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? Strong Python and production software-engineering skills, including backend APIs, containers, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and observability. Experience delivering LLM-powered, machine-learning, or data-intensive applications beyond proof-of-concept work. Experience integrating heterogeneous enterprise data sources and building reliable data-preparation and synchronization workflows. Practical experience with grounded AI applications, tool or function calling, structured outputs, and evaluation of nondeterministic systems. Understanding of authentication, authorization, privacy, and secure data handling. Sound architectural judgment and the ability to lead technical discussions with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. WHAT DO WE OFFER? 1 day per month to tackle challenges inside the project, or test new ideas Tech training and human skills training and, budget for conferences Opportunity to travel and collaborate in our various office locations for workshops or team-building events (Zurich, Geneva, Belgrade or Vienna) A dynamic work environment that highly fosters a sense of fun while maintaining a productive atmosphere A competitive salary & career ladder Our Hiring Process Video call with People & Culture (30 mins) Technical conversation with the hiring manager (45 to 60 mins) Tech challenge (async) Challenge presentation (60 mins) Offer WHAT ARE OUR BENEFITS? 10 days fully paid sick leave per year 25 days of annual vacation leave Full private health coverage (employee + up to 2 children to age 20) Gym allowance Hybrid & flexible working (team-based arrangement) Learning & Development Workation

items.desc: Bygg verktygen som förändrar hur ett helt bolag jobbar AI förändrar inte bara produkter, den förändrar hur vi arbetar. På Thule byggs nu interna produkter som hjälper teamen att fatta bättre beslut, automatisera det repetitiva och jobba smartare. Tillsammans med Thule söker vi nu en AI Product Engineer som vill skapa nästa generation av interna verktyg, från grunden. Det här är ingen klassisk utvecklarroll. Du kommer inte att förvalta ett befintligt system, du kommer att bygga nytt. Vi letar efter dig som ser en manuell process och direkt tänker "det där kan vi lösa smartare", och som sedan gör det. Om teamet och rollen Du landar i ett mindre team där din personlighet märks direkt. Rollen sitter nära säljorganisationen och affären, du bygger alltså inte i ett vakuum utan för att pusha verksamheten framåt. Du jobbar både med den interna organisationen och tillsammans med vår befintliga AI-konsult, så du har en teknisk kollega att bolla med samtidigt som du äger och driver de interna produkterna framåt. Här finns frihet, ansvar och en rejäl möjlighet att sätta avtryck från dag ett. I rollen kommer du att Identifiera flaskhalsar och trögheter i organisationens arbetsflöden. Designa och bygga interna produkter, AI-verktyg och automationer. Utveckla lösningar med LLM:er, AI-agenter och moderna integrationer. Förvandla data till beslutsstöd och smartare processer. Äga dina initiativ hela vägen, från problemformulering till lanserad lösning. Jobba tätt med affären och driva förändring genom teknik. Experimentera snabbt, mäta resultat och iterera kontinuerligt. Vi tror att du Har ett starkt produkttänk och drivs av att lösa riktiga problem. Tar egna initiativ och trivs med stort eget ansvar. Är nyfiken på ny teknik och lär dig snabbt. Har ett systemtänk och förstår snabbt hur saker hänger ihop. Kommunicerar lika bra och gärna med utvecklare som med andra delar av verksamheten. Meriterande LLM, prompt engineering, context engineering och RAG. AI-agenter och agentiska arbetsflöden. Öga för UX/UI. Vana att tänka kring säkerhet och dataskydd. Varför den här rollen? Du kommer inte att ärva ett system. Du kommer att skapa produkter som förändrar hur hela organisationen arbetar. Vi söker dig som ser möjligheter där andra ser manuella processer, och som vill bygga AI-lösningar med verklig påverkan. Ansökan Den här rekryteringen sker i samarbete med A-hub. Sista ansökningsdag: 2026 - 10 - 30 Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join the Scalable Core team as an AI Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering the platform that supports Siemens Energy’s agentic software development lifecycle. You will engage in hands-on platform engineering while collaborating closely with development teams as a Forward Deployed Engineer, translating their needs into reusable services and automation. You will help implement the agentic way of working on real projects, gaining insights that will enhance the platform and its blueprint. With the support of experienced colleagues, you will grow towards owning capabilities and leading engagements independently, making a significant impact on our mission. How You’ll Make an Impact Help shape and deliver the platform that underpins Siemens Energy’s agentic software development lifecycle by translating delivery teams’ needs into reusable services, APIs, and self-service capabilities. Implement essential capabilities such as token budgets, consumption tracking, automated onboarding, LLM routing, and management of agent personas and skills. Support forward-deployed engagements by embedding with software engineering teams, configuring tooling, coding agents and guardrails, and building proofs of concept under the guidance of senior engineers. Advance harness engineering through context, tool integrations, execution environments, evaluations, and feedback loops that enable agents to operate reliably within defined boundaries. Write, review, test, and ship production code using AI coding tools like Cursor and Claude Code, ensuring the correct application of guardrails and supporting reliable platform operation. Capture lessons from real projects to enhance the platform, blueprint, and developer experience while developing your ability to scope and run engagements independently. What You Bring A master’s degree in computer science or a related field, with at least 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software engineering and a minimum of 2 years in AI-assisted/agentic software engineering. Strong programming fundamentals with flexibility across languages; experience with a statically typed language such as C#, Java, or TypeScript, as well as CI/CD and cloud-native development, is a plus. Practical integration experience connecting systems through APIs or data pipelines, with an understanding of challenges beyond your own code, including authentication, dependencies, and error handling. A systems understanding and curiosity about design trade-offs, such as message queues versus synchronous APIs or relational versus NoSQL databases, along with an interest in reusable platform capabilities and developer tooling. Curiosity about and hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot, and an interest in agent workflows, context, skills, and evaluations. A willingness to embed with teams, learn quickly, and deliver in short cycles, complemented by a collaborative, hands-on attitude, good communication skills, and growing ownership; fluent English is required, with Spanish being a plus. Must be based in Portugal or Spain (mandatory). About the Team The Scalable Core team is dedicated to driving foundational technologies and developer platforms that empower scalable and intelligent energy management solutions across Siemens Energy. We focus on building reusable backend services, AI/ML platforms, and lifecycle tools to support cloud, on-prem, and edge deployments. Our mission is to enable teams to deliver intelligent solutions faster and with higher quality through automation, enhanced developer experience, and scalable software foundations. Whether through a streamlined Software Factory Console, advanced model lifecycle capabilities, or self-service deployment engines, we ensure that engineering teams can concentrate on solving energy challenges rather than reinventing the wheel. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. items.desc: Present Connection is an international technology partner with offices in Lithuania, the Netherlands, and Spain. For more than 14 years, we have worked with companies across Europe, combining software engineering expertise with a strong understanding of business and technology. We bring together experienced technology specialists with a drive to experiment, explore new possibilities, and find better ways forward. We believe technology is more than something businesses use. It can change how they work, grow, and compete. That's why we work alongside our clients to challenge existing ways of working and build solutions that move their business forward. The Opportunity We are looking for a Python Developer to join an R&D team at the third-largest ERP provider for small and mid-sized manufacturing companies in the DACH region. The team is building an AI-based business intelligence and analytics platform, together with the data foundation underneath it. The data foundation brings business data from ERP systems into a modern cloud data platform – a data lake on AWS, a semantic layer that describes business objects, processes and a business glossary, and a fast analytical database. AI agents on top of it answer business questions in plain language: show me this customer's open orders becomes the right data, fields and filters. items.desc: Zimmer Biomet is one of the world’s leading Orthopaedics medical device companies. Our innovations help treat patients suffering from disorders of, or injuries to, bones, joints or supporting soft tissues. It is our mission to alleviate pain and improve the quality of life for people around the world: a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As part of that mission, we are committed to the highest standards in patient safety, quality and integrity. Within our Connected Health product group, we have set a new standard for digital health with our mymobility and ZBEdgeAnalytics platforms, which underpin a suite of digital healthcare products that transform Orthopaedic care for patients and clinicians alike. What You Can Expect We're looking for an AI Engineer to join our Connected Health team at Zimmer Biomet. This is a fully remote, UK-based job. You'll design, build, deploy and improve generative AI and data-driven products that raise the quality of care and quality of life for orthopaedic patients worldwide. You'll join our AI & Data Science team, which works across three areas: Product development: We develop prediction and decision-support algorithms, using classical ML and generative AI, for our patient- and clinician-facing applications. Product analysis: We help our product teams understand how people use our products, so they can make better decisions. Platform development: We build tooling and reusable infrastructure that supports AI and data-driven product development across Zimmer Biomet. We design it to follow best practice for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). We aim to keep improving, to communicate openly, and to enjoy ourselves along the way. How You'll Create Impact In this role you will work closely with machine learning scientists and application software engineers to bring advanced data insights to life. You'll build automation pipelines, deploy and serve both predictive models and generative AI systems, integrate third-party platforms and tooling, and design for observability and monitoring in production, whilst ensuring that we meet our regulatory commitments. Our work covers classical ML on structured, sensor and imaging data, and generative AI: retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems. Because we build medical devices in a regulated context, quality, traceability and responsible AI matter at every step. You'll help us productionise these systems against standards including the EU AI Act and FDA guidance on AI/ML-enabled medical devices. You'll help shape our technical roadmap and influence how the Connected Health team moves forward with AI products. Today, our tooling revolves around: Azure ML and Azure DevOps for model orchestration, CI/CD and development; Python for data pipelines, machine learning pipelines and model serving; MLflow (or similar) for experiment tracking and model registry, with monitoring for drift and performance in production; LLM/GenAI tooling including foundation-model APIs, vector stores/retrieval, orchestration frameworks and evaluation harnesses; Pulumi for infrastructure as code; Occasionally C# to support integration between our internal systems. We also use modern developer tooling. Responsible use of AI coding assistants like Claude Code is part of how we work day-to-day. What Makes You Stand Out A passion for building generative AI and data-driven products to improve healthcare; The idea of shaping AI products excites you, and you’re comfortable working where requirements are still evolving; Your background covers the majority of the end-to-end lifecycle of a AI/ML product, from containerisation, CI/CD, infrastructure deployment to debugging and monitoring models in production; Hands-on experience with either classical ML or generative AI in production, and have a genuine interest in the other; The ability to build cloud-native applications and are comfortable with infrastructure as code; You can communicate analyses and technical ideas, and their value, to a range of audiences; A drive to learn about new technologies and methodologies; If you don't meet every requirement but are excited by this role, we'd still like to hear from you! Your Background A demonstrable background within healthcare data and/or delivering AI/ML in regulated spaces (SaMD, EU AI Act, FDA); Prior knowledge of evaluating and guard-railing generative AI systems Experience with model monitoring, drift detection and responsible-AI practices (fairness, robustness, explainability). Industry experience as a Machine Learning, AI or Data Engineer; Comfortable programming with Python and packages associated with the AI/ML workflow; Travel & Logistic Expectations This is a fully remote, UK-based role, and we actively support flexible working. We actively encourage team members to meet up and collaborate in person. Some of our colleagues are based in the U.S., so there will occasionally be a need to be available for evening …

items.desc: Who we are We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we're here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe's safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, "roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen" kind of people. It's these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you're someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let's go! Your Mission: As an Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) Compliance Associate at Bitpanda, you will sit at the intersection of regulatory compliance, data engineering, and operational automation. Rather than handling operational onboarding, your focus will be on building intelligence into our AFC compliance architecture. You will design and maintain AFC compliance dashboards, test and validate the effectiveness of existing controls, and help construct scalable new risk controls. By combining strong data analytics capabilities with modern technology, you will drive process efficiency, automate routine compliance tasks, and strengthen our defense against financial crime across Europe. What you'll do: Design, build, and maintain interactive AFC compliance dashboards and monitoring tools (e.g., tracking risk metrics, alert volumes, SLA performance, and regulatory reporting indicators) for stakeholders across Compliance and Senior Leadership. Conduct regular quantitative testing and assessment of existing AFC controls (AML, CTF, sanctions, transaction monitoring) to identify coverage gaps, false-positive trends, and operational bottlenecks. Support the conceptualization and deployment of new, data-driven compliance controls. Identify manual workflows within the AFC team and engineer automated solutions. Drive projects to integrate AI agents, LLM workflows, and low-code automations to streamline compliance investigations, data extraction, and routine decisioning. Query complex financial datasets to extract actionable risk insights, uncover hidden transactional patterns, and conduct root-cause analyses on control failures or suspicious activity trends. Work closely with Product, Tech, Data, and Operations teams to translate regulatory requirements into functional technical specs, ensuring seamless deployment of automated control updates. Who you are: Educational Background: Degree (or currently enrolled in an advanced program) in Data Analytics, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field—combining analytical mindset with an interest in regulatory risk. Data Analytics & SQL Competence: Hands-on experience extracting, manipulating, and visualizing structured data. Strong command of SQL (e.g., Snowflake SQL) and experience with dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase, or similar) is essential. Process Automation & AI Agents (Great Advantage): Demonstrated experience or strong practical knowledge in process automation (Python scripts, APIs, workflow tools) and building or deploying AI agents / LLM workflows to enhance operational efficiency. Control & AFC Understanding: Familiarity with Anti-Financial Crime (AML, CTF, Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring) concepts, control testing frameworks, or risk-scoring mechanics, preferably within banking, fintech, crypto, or payment services under EU/Austrian regulations. Language Skills: Excellent written and spoken English. German proficiency is considered a strong plus. What's in it for you Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice. Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda's pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan. Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP. Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you've been with us for 6 months. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Limited contract until: 07/01/2030 Job ID: 6362 The working group of Marine Microbial Biogeochemistry at the Department of Functional and Evolutionary Ecology of the University of Vienna investigates how microorganisms shape carbon cycling and biogeochemical processes in the ocean, from coastal waters to the deep sea. We are looking for an enthusiastic, curious and communicative colleague who enjoys working in the laboratory, in the field and at sea as part of an international team. Does that sound like something for you? Apply to join our team! Your personal sphere of influence: As a scientific project assistant (predoctoral), you will join the research team around Dr. Thomas Reinthaler in the FWF-funded project “Variability of Ecologically Relevant Bacterioneuston (VERA)”. The project is carried out in collaboration with the University of Oldenburg and is embedded in a larger research group with prominent German universities and research institutes. You will investigate which bacteria are active in the sea-surface microlayer, the boundary layer between ocean and atmosphere, and how they vary over a seasonal cycle and along an Atlantic transect. By combining single-cell activity measurements with metagenomics and metatranscriptomics, you will identify the traits that allow key taxa such as SAR11 and Roseobacteraceae to thrive at the air-sea interface. The start of the contract is 1 February 2027. The employment period is 3.5 years from the beginning of the contract. As a team, an open, collaborative and respectful working environment is important to us. Your future tasks: You actively participate in research and teaching, which means: You sample the SML and the underlying water in northern Germany together with our project partners at GEOMAR in Kiel, during the first project year only (about 3 days per month, first sampling in February 2027) . You take part in the research cruise of RV METEOR across the tropical and subtropical Atlantic (February/March 2028), including sampling and shipboard experiments . You measure the activity of specific bacterial groups at the single-cell level using CARD-FISH, BONCAT and Redox Sensor Green (RSG), combined with flow cytometry and microscopy . You extract nucleic acids, prepare metagenomic and metatranscriptomic samples and analyse the data bioinformatically (about 85% laboratory and field work, 15% bioinformatics) . You co-supervise MSc students in the laboratory; teaching can be added at a later stage if you wish . You aim for a doctoral thesis comprising three papers within the Vienna Doctoral School of Ecology and Evolution (VDSEE) and present your results at international conferences and project meetings . You collaborate closely with the project partners at the University of Oldenburg and GEOMAR Kiel . Doctoral training and degree-related activities are additional to the contracted hours. Work-life balance: Our employees enjoy flexible working hours and can partially work remotely, apart from fieldwork and cruise periods. Inspiring working atmosphere: You are part of an international academic team in a healthy and fair working environment, with access to state-of-the-art facilities for microbial ecology and to the Life Science Compute Cluster of the University of Vienna. items.desc: About Board of Innovation We help companies grow in the autonomous age. Intelligent technologies are reshaping how businesses innovate, market and sell, creating entirely new ways to generate value. To capture this shift, organizations need to rethink how they work, make decisions and build for the future. At BOI, we partner with the world’s most ambitious companies to rewire their growth engines with AI. Our work ranges from building AI-native product and service models for Walmart to shaping the future of AI-powered marketing for The Coca-Cola Company. Each project is first-of-its-kind, pushing the boundaries of how AI can unlock new growth for the companies shaping their industries. About the Traineeship This traineeship is designed for early-career talent eager to step into the world of AI x Innovation. Over six months, you’ll work directly on client projects while developing the skills needed to move into a full-time Junior AI Strategist role. You’ll support and eventually take the lead on individual workstreams. Some days you’ll help shape an AI growth strategy for a global brand; other days you’ll design no-code prototypes, run AI-powered research, or support on client deliverables. You’ll be part of a small, fast-moving team where ownership comes early. You’ll report to Robin Vermeulen and you'll get a chance to work on live client engagements learning how AI strategy gets built from the inside: from first insights to final delivery. Hands-on and entrepreneurial: You like figuring things out, testing ideas and improving them. You feel comfortable in a dynamic environment and enjoy tackling new challenges. Tu gardes la responsabilité finale du code face à la machine, tu mènes des revues de code augmentées et tu insuffles les pratiques TDD (Red, Green, Refactor) et DDD (ateliers métiers, contextes bornés). ‍ Des projets qui parlent Plateforme de Maintenance Intelligente : Développement d’une application de remontée d'anomalies sur des équipements et d'analyse de données terrain pour optimiser la fiabilité opérationnelle, création d'agents IA aidant à la résolution de défauts sur des équipements. items.desc: TL;DR We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce) Founding deployment strategist : you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs) €45–60k + equity What this role is (and isn't) Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters. This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it. Why now Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients. What you'll do Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment. Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later. Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow. Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents. Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it. Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget. Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear. Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment. What you bring You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor. Must have Customer-facing project experience. Two years or more managing client projects in an industrial environment, typically in consulting (operations, supply chain, transformation). You've held deadlines, managed stakeholders, and delivered. AI-native, for real. You use LLMs every day, and you've built things with them: automations, agents, prompts that run in production (Claude, GPT, n8n, Make, scripts, whatever works). You know what an agent can do alone, where it breaks, and where a human must stay in the loop. Listening before configuring. You translate what people say into what the system and the agents must do, and you notice when the two don't match. At ease in front of clients: Plant directors, finance, shop-floor operators. You can hold a room, and say no in it. A full load, gladly. Around 150 project days a year, several deployments running at once. Fluent English and French, both required. Our first clients work in French, our team writes in English, and you may support our deployments in the United States. Nice to have You've automated a real operations process end to end, with measurable hours saved You've already taken a complex B2B software live Comfortable with AI You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns Seed / Series A experience, where nobody's job description holds for long Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway. How we'll measure success ERP go-lives on the date we …

items.desc: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it. We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production. At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success. What You'll do Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities. Scoping : Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both. Prototyping : Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits. Program Management : Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path. Prioritization : Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time. Customer Partnership : Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on. Onsite Embedding : Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome. Product Feedback Loop : Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve. Must Have Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting. Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast. Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows. Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on. Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between …

There are no long approval chains between a good idea and a production system, and no layers between you and the people who depend on the data you integrate. If you want to shape how global health data is built rather than inherit someone else’s architecture, this is the place to do it! Cheers!

items.card: The role At Upside, a modern software engineer brings three disciplines together: Engineer - owning the technical decisions that make a system hold up in production: architecture, data, security, performance and failure modes. items.desc: Upside is an applied AI engineering and consultancy firm. We build software for scaling companies, international brands and large institutions. Our team design, build and run systems, with particular depth in healthcare and life sciences. Alongside client delivery, we develop our own IP: frameworks and components distilled from systems we've taken to production. Clients come to us when the problem is unclear and the stakes are high. Our job is to work out what should actually be built, build it properly, and leave behind a system the client can own. The role At Upside, a modern software engineer brings three disciplines together: Engineer - owning the technical decisions that make a system hold up in production: architecture, data, security, performance and failure modes. Consultant - learning the client's domain in depth: their processes, data, and regulatory and operational constraints. Then turning that understanding into technical decisions. Product thinker - thinking about how a system behaves at scale, how it fails and how it's operated after launch, and you scope deliberately so that only what creates value gets built. Responsibilities: Work directly alongside client engineering and product teams on business requirements, architect solutions, and own delivery all the way through to production. Drive complex system development with coding agents as your core delivery engine, manage context, decompose architectural specs into agent-executable tasks, and run work in parallel under strict quality control. Review generated implementations critically, design the tests, evals, and runtime checks that catch edge cases and silent failures, and hold a high bar on security, performance, and maintainability. Make the foundational design calls on data models, integration boundaries, security parameters, and trade-offs, and document them for both human and synthetic contributors. Share proven workflows, evaluation methods, and agent orchestration patterns so the whole engineering team levels up, and contribute to Upside’s open-source frameworks Proven background as a Software Engineer - you’ve built, architected, and owned complex backend/cloud systems end-to-end. Production experience with LLM coding agents - you’ve applied them to production-grade software engineering, not only experiments. Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features - you’ve built, shipped, or integrated LLM-powered and agentic components into production software systems. Comfort with shifting ground and full ownership - you stay effective when requirements, tools, and domain contexts change, and you take responsibility for the technical outcome from initial problem discovery to post-launch stability. Strong client-facing communication - you work directly with client tech leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and explain complex architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong Python skills - or you bring deep experience in another major backend language like Ruby, Java, TypeScript, or Rust, and you’re ready to pivot to Python quickly. Fluent English (C1+) - you’ll collaborate directly with international clients. A university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field - highly valued. Nice to Have Fullstack Experience: Frontend experience with React or Vue; cloud and infrastructure work (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). Open Source: History of contributions to open-source tools or libraries. How we work Built for the Long Run: We hire for the company, not a temporary project. We look for engineers who want to grow with Upside over time. Small, Accountable Teams: 3-9 people per project. We're small by design, meaning your technical decisions carry weight and your impact is visible. Mission-Critical Work: We tackle complex technical challenges that move the needle for international brands, scaling companies, and large institutions under real load. Real Autonomy: Complete freedom to drive solutions, experiment with novel agentic workflows, and lead implementations without unnecessary oversight. Uncapped Tooling: Your stack is fully covered (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and any tool that increases your velocity or sharpness). Location Kraków first, hybrid or remote from anywhere in Poland. If you'd like to understand more about how we work or read about the recruitment process in detail, feel free to explore our handbook. If something important to you isn't mentioned, share your thoughts with us at careers@upsidelab.io.

items.desc: Are you an experienced data engineer or architect who knows a data foundation is more than a platform, and enjoys leading others to build one? At Curamando, you’ll design and deliver data foundations for AI-driven insights and activation. That means the platform, but also the data models, governance, ownership and teams around it. No two organisations need the same foundation, so you’ll fit each one to the client’s size, maturity and goals. We work across industries, with brands like McDonald’s and IKEA. Data foundations are changing. Clients now want custom reporting apps and AI agents that answer business questions on their own. That puts more weight on strong data models, a semantic layer that gives people and AI the same definitions, and clear rules for what AI can access. How we work is changing too. We’re quickly becoming AI-first, and you’ll help shape what that means for our team and our clients. As a Data Foundation Expert, you’ll own workstreams, lead data engineers and work as an equal with client leadership, often on site. What you’ll do Assess a client’s data foundation and set the roadmap with their leadership Design and build cost-efficient cloud data platforms, choosing the architecture and tools that fit each client Define data models and semantic layers that AI agents and downstream applications can rely on Shape governance, ownership, security and access for both people and AI Help clients build the data team they need and decide where AI fits in their work Lead and mentor data engineers, guide architectural choices and take on the hardest technical problems Set standards for orchestration, CI/CD, testing, monitoring and infrastructure as code Work AI-first with coding agents, and shape how our team and clients use them, holding AI output to the same standard as their own Contribute to proposals, scoping and pitches, and help grow our Data Foundation team and offering Who you are We believe you’re a good fit if you: Have many years’ experience building data platforms across different clouds and tools, including in a lead or architect role Have shaped governance, ownership and team setup in organisations of different sizes Have deep experience with data modelling and semantic layers Have led and coached data engineers, and enjoy helping people grow Still love to build and care about what you ship. Maybe coding agents got you hands-on again after years in engineering management Have strong Python and SQL skills Are a clear thinker who turns vague questions into a concrete plan and explains trade-offs to engineers and executives alike Have opinions on how AI is changing data foundations and engineering work, and the experience to back them up Communicate fluently in Swedish, both spoken and written Are based in Stockholm or open to relocating here Why Curamando? Curamando is part of Eidra, a group of 16 companies with more than 1,400 specialists across cities from Stockholm to New York. You’ll lead data foundation work for a range of clients and learn from experienced colleagues across Eidra. We value collaboration, curiosity and taking initiative, and believe in giving people responsibility and room to grow. We also believe in working together in person at our office in central Östermalm. The recruitment process We want the recruitment process to give both you and us a chance to get to know each other and see if we’re a good match. The process consists of: Introduction: A first conversation of around 45 minutes to discuss your experience, motivations and what you’re looking for. Technical interview and case: You’ll present a short take-home case on how you’d shape a client’s data foundation. We’ll focus on your technical depth, your judgement and how you communicate your approach. Team meet and greet: An optional opportunity to meet the team, ask questions and get a feel for everyday life at Curamando and Eidra. We review applications and invite candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

We build brands differently. We work with our clients to define and solve their business problems through the lens of brand. Landor companies also include amp (sonic branding), bdg (workplace & architectural experts), Deep Local (creative technologists) and ManvsMachine (3D motion design). We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. items.desc:
Description
 🚀 Le Bureau des Talents est spécialisé dans la chasse, l’accompagnement et le coaching des talents pour les startups, les scale-ups et les entreprises à impact.
 À propos de l'entreprise
 Notre client est une startup française à l'intersection de l'intelligence artificielle et de la cybersécurité.
 Elle vient de lever 4 millions d'euros en pré-seed pour accélérer le développement de sa technologie, qui s'appuie sur des agents IA autonomes pour automatiser des opérations de sécurité complexes.
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe technique à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs et d'experts en cybersécurité, à un moment clé de son développement.
 L'opportunité : participer à la construction d'un produit IA dès ses premières étapes, contribuer aux choix d'architecture et avoir un impact direct sur les orientations technologiques.
 Mission
 Le poste
 Dans le cadre de son développement, notre client recrute un AI Engineer pour concevoir et développer les systèmes d'intelligence artificielle au cœur de sa plateforme.
 Votre principal défi : construire des agents IA capables de prendre des décisions, d'utiliser des outils et d'exécuter des tâches complexes dans des environnements informatiques réels.
 Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement, de l'expérimentation à la mise en production, avec une forte implication dans les choix d'architecture.
 Un rôle mêlant engineering IA, systèmes agentiques et développement produit , avec une réelle autonomie technique.
 Vos missions
 Concevoir et développer des agents IA autonomes capables d'exécuter des tâches complexes de cybersécurité. 
 Construire des mécanismes de raisonnement et de planification permettant aux agents de prendre des décisions, d'utiliser des outils et d'enchaîner des actions. 
 Intégrer et optimiser des LLMs au sein de systèmes IA destinés à fonctionner en production. 
 Collaborer avec les experts en cybersécurité pour transformer des méthodes techniques en workflows automatisés. 
 Améliorer la fiabilité, les performances et la scalabilité des agents et des systèmes développés. 
 Expérimenter et évaluer différentes approches pour améliorer le comportement et l'efficacité des modèles. 
 Participer aux choix d'architecture et aux évolutions du produit , en tenant compte des retours terrain. 
 Profile
 👤 Profil recherché
 Les indispensables
 Vous disposez d'une solide maîtrise du développement logiciel , idéalement en Python. 
 Vous avez déjà développé des solutions reposant sur des LLMs, des agents IA ou des systèmes de machine learning appliqué . 
 Vous savez concevoir, développer et déployer des systèmes IA en production. 
 Vous comprenez les enjeux liés au prompting, à l'évaluation et au comportement des modèles . 
 Vous êtes capable de résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes et de faire avancer des sujets avec un niveau important d'autonomie. 
 Les plus
 Une expérience des architectures agentiques , notamment du tool calling et de l'orchestration d'agents. 
 Des connaissances en cybersécurité, pentesting ou sécurité offensive. 
 Une pratique des systèmes RAG, embeddings, bases vectorielles ou architectures de recherche. 
 Une expérience des environnements cloud (AWS, GCP…). 
 Une première expérience en startup early-stage ou dans un environnement de développement produit rapide. 
 Ce qui fera la différence : vous aimez construire des systèmes IA concrets, expérimenter, prendre des décisions techniques et travailler sur des problèmes qui ne disposent pas encore de solutions établies.
 💡 Pourquoi rejoindre ce projet ?
 Des défis IA concrets : travailler sur des agents autonomes, le raisonnement, la planification et l'intégration de LLMs dans des systèmes réels. 
 Un impact direct sur le produit : contribuer aux décisions techniques et à la construction des fondations technologiques. 
 Une forte autonomie : prendre des responsabilités sur des sujets structurants, au-delà de la simple implémentation. 
 Une équipe technique resserrée : collaborer directement avec des ingénieurs et des spécialistes en cybersécurité. 
 Une participation au capital : bénéficier d'un dispositif d'equity en complément de la rémunération. 
 📍 Informations pratiques
 Localisation : Paris 
 Contrat : CDI 
 Organisation : présentiel 
 💰 Rémunération & avantages
 Rémunération fixe et package à préciser. 
 Participation au capital (equity). 
 🤝 Process de recrutement
 Premier échange avec le CEO. 
 Entretien technique avec le CTO et le COO. 
 Exercice technique ou étude de cas. 
 Dernier échange avec l'équipe.

items.desc: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further. About The Role We are looking for a Senior or Staff Reinforcement Learning Engineer to develop learning-based control policies for humanoid robots. You will design and train reinforcement learning policies that enable dynamic locomotion and loco-manipulation behaviors on real robots. Your work will focus on building scalable training pipelines, designing reward functions and environments, and improving sim-to-real transfer for reliable deployment on hardware. You will work closely with controls and robotics engineers to integrate learned policies into the robot control stack, ensuring stable and robust behavior in real-world conditions. Development will involve continuous iteration between large-scale simulation and hardware experiments. The problems you will work on include dynamic locomotion, balance recovery, contact-rich manipulation, and multi-behavior policy learning. What You’ll Do Design and train reinforcement learning policies for humanoid robot control. Build scalable simulation and training pipelines (e.g., Isaac Lab, MuJoCo). Design reward functions, observation spaces, and curricula for complex behaviors. Improve robustness and sim-to-real transfer of learned policies. Deploy and evaluate policies on real robotic systems. Integrate policies into the control stack. What We're Looking For MS or PhD in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field. Strong experience with reinforcement learning (e.g., PPO, SAC, offline RL). Experience applying RL to robotics or physical systems. Experience deploying learned policies on real robotic systems. Experience with physics-based simulation environments (e.g., Isaac Lab, MuJoCo). Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++. Nice To Have Experience with RL for locomotion or legged robots. Experience with sim-to-real transfer. Familiarity with robot dynamics, control, or whole-body control. What We Offer Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale. 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown). Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care. Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings. Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office. Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics. Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.
