items.desc: Zimmer Biomet is one of the world’s leading Orthopaedics medical device companies. Our innovations help treat patients suffering from disorders of, or injuries to, bones, joints or supporting soft tissues. It is our mission to alleviate pain and improve the quality of life for people around the world: a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As part of that mission, we are committed to the highest standards in patient safety, quality and integrity. Within our Connected Health product group, we have set a new standard for digital health with our mymobility and ZBEdgeAnalytics platforms, which underpin a suite of digital healthcare products that transform Orthopaedic care for patients and clinicians alike. What You Can Expect We're looking for an AI Engineer to join our Connected Health team at Zimmer Biomet. This is a fully remote, UK-based job. You'll design, build, deploy and improve generative AI and data-driven products that raise the quality of care and quality of life for orthopaedic patients worldwide. You'll join our AI & Data Science team, which works across three areas: Product development: We develop prediction and decision-support algorithms, using classical ML and generative AI, for our patient- and clinician-facing applications. Product analysis: We help our product teams understand how people use our products, so they can make better decisions. Platform development: We build tooling and reusable infrastructure that supports AI and data-driven product development across Zimmer Biomet. We design it to follow best practice for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). We aim to keep improving, to communicate openly, and to enjoy ourselves along the way. How You'll Create Impact In this role you will work closely with machine learning scientists and application software engineers to bring advanced data insights to life. You'll build automation pipelines, deploy and serve both predictive models and generative AI systems, integrate third-party platforms and tooling, and design for observability and monitoring in production, whilst ensuring that we meet our regulatory commitments. Our work covers classical ML on structured, sensor and imaging data, and generative AI: retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems. Because we build medical devices in a regulated context, quality, traceability and responsible AI matter at every step. You'll help us productionise these systems against standards including the EU AI Act and FDA guidance on AI/ML-enabled medical devices. You'll help shape our technical roadmap and influence how the Connected Health team moves forward with AI products. Today, Our Tooling Revolves Around Azure ML and Azure DevOps for model orchestration, CI/CD and development; Python for data pipelines, machine learning pipelines and model serving; MLflow (or similar) for experiment tracking and model registry, with monitoring for drift and performance in production; LLM/GenAI tooling including foundation-model APIs, vector stores/retrieval, orchestration frameworks and evaluation harnesses; Pulumi for infrastructure as code; Occasionally C# to support integration between our internal systems. We also use modern developer tooling. Responsible use of AI coding assistants like Claude Code is part of how we work day-to-day. What Makes You Stand Out A passion for building generative AI and data-driven products to improve healthcare; The idea of shaping AI products excites you, and you’re comfortable working where requirements are still evolving; Your background covers the majority of the end-to-end lifecycle of a AI/ML product, from containerisation, CI/CD, infrastructure deployment to debugging and monitoring models in production; Hands-on experience with either classical ML or generative AI in production, and have a genuine interest in the other; The ability to build cloud-native applications and are comfortable with infrastructure as code; You can communicate analyses and technical ideas, and their value, to a range of audiences; A drive to learn about new technologies and methodologies; If you don't meet every requirement but are excited by this role, we'd still like to hear from you! Your Background A demonstrable background within healthcare data and/or delivering AI/ML in regulated spaces (SaMD, EU AI Act, FDA); Prior knowledge of evaluating and guard-railing generative AI systems Experience with model monitoring, drift detection and responsible-AI practices (fairness, robustness, explainability). Industry experience as a Machine Learning, AI or Data Engineer; Comfortable programming with Python and packages associated with the AI/ML workflow; Travel & Logistic Expectations This is a fully remote, UK-based role, and we actively support flexible working. items.desc: Ingénieur(e) Data & LLM (Python) – Trickstr Chez Trickstr , on construit des produits data & IA générative pour aider des décideurs (comex, directions data, communication, stratégie) à prendre de meilleures décisions en temps réel. On manipule de gros volumes de données, on joue avec les LLM, on teste des idées vite… et on ne se contente pas de faire des POC qui finissent dans un tiroir. Nous cherchons un(e) ingénieur(e) data/IA qui a envie : de coder tous les jours (Python), d' explorer les LLM au-delà des démos marketing, et de construire des vrais produits en équipe, utilisés par de vrais clients (très grandes organisations, CAC 40, etc.). Tes missions Au quotidien, tu vas : Concevoir et développer des briques techniques autour des LLM : pipelines d’ingestion et de préparation de données, systèmes de RAG (search + context), outils d’évaluation (hallucinations, biais, robustesse, qualité de réponse). Manipuler de la data (social media, presse, texte libre, métadonnées, etc.) : nettoyage, normalisation, enrichissement, feature engineering, scoring, agrégation. Prototyper puis industrialiser : passer d’un notebook à un service exploitable (APIs, scripts, jobs planifiés), documenter ton travail et le rendre utilisable par le reste de l’équipe. Travailler main dans la main avec : d’autres devs et data engineers, des deployment strategists des data analysts / consultants qui challengent les outputs, les fondateurs, directement, pour expérimenter de nouvelles idées produit. Veille & R&D appliquées : tester de nouveaux modèles, librairies, architectures, et mesurer ce qui marche vraiment pour nos cas d’usage. Ton profil On ne coche pas toutes les cases dans la vraie vie, mais si tu te reconnais dans une bonne partie de celles-ci, on veut te parler : Tu es jeune diplômé(e) d’école d’ingénieurs (ou 1–3 ans d’expérience) avec un vrai bagage en maths / computer science . Tu codes en Python tous les jours ou presque : tu maîtrises les bases (structures, fonctions, tests, environnement virtuel), tu es à l’aise avec des libs type pandas , numpy , éventuellement FastAPI , SQLAlchemy , etc. Tu as déjà joué sérieusement avec les LLM : appels d’API (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), prompt engineering, RAG, ou fine-tuning léger, tu comprends les enjeux de coût, latence, qualité, biais. Tu es rigoureux(se) sur la data : tu ne fais pas confiance aveuglément à un modèle, tu sais mesurer, comparer, remettre en question un résultat. Tu aimes travailler en équipe : code review, pair programming, expliquer ce que tu fais à des non-tech, recevoir et donner du feedback sans ego mal placé. Bonus (pas obligatoire mais très apprécié) : expérience avec Docker / déploiement, graphes de données, search, bases vectorielles, participation à un projet open-source, techno ou perso un peu ambitieux. Ce qu’on t’offre De vrais défis techniques : beaucoup d’itération produit et de problèmes pas déjà résolus sur StackOverflow. Un terrain de jeu LLM / data très concret : données réelles, enjeux business réels, interactions directes avec nos utilisateurs et clients. Une petite équipe solide , où tu as un impact visible sur : la roadmap produit, les choix techniques, les features livrées chaque mois. Des conditions de travail au top : magnifiques bureaux au cœur de Paris, matos adapté à ce que tu fais (machine costaude, environnement dev propre). coach de sport tous les lundis etc. Envoie-nous : ton CV , un projet dont tu es fier/fière (GitHub, repo privé, notebook, mémoire, etc.)

Being the daughter company of Swisscom - leading telecommunications company and one of the most sustainable and innovative companies in Switzerland - we share the same values, vision and goals. As a trustworthy and efficient Swisscom IT service partner, we create valuable customer experiences. We work in strong collaboration with our partners in Switzerland and attract and retain high performers. The team / project The Mobile Technology & Voice Value Stream is building an AI tooling suite that automates and supports the operation of Swisscom's mobile and voice network. We are a small, collaborative pod working closely with product owners and business stakeholders in Switzerland, network SMEs and external specialists, and together we're building an internal AI delivery capability for Swisscom Operations. As Agentic AI Engineer, you are a hands-on individual contributor who designs and builds agentic AI tools that automate operational processes. You help shape architecture decisions, engineering standards, code quality and technical delivery, and help embed AI engineering practices within Swisscom. What you'll do Build agentic workflows: Design and implement agent-based and multi-agent workflows that automate Mobile Technology & Voice operational processes. Orchestrate the agents: Develop and evolve orchestrator logic and tool-use patterns for operations automation. Make it trustworthy: Implement evaluation for quality, groundedness, latency, reliability and safety, plus guardrails against prompt injection, unsupported claims and unsafe tool usage. Keep humans in the loop: Design human-in-the-loop controls and evidence-based decision-support outputs. Shape the architecture: Contribute to the end-to-end architecture of the AI tooling suite, take part in design reviews, document decisions in Architecture Decision Records and make pragmatic build-versus-buy recommendations. Raise the bar: Uphold the pod's engineering, testing, documentation and code-review standards. Deliver as a pod: Plan and coordinate delivery with pod members, remove technical blockers, support onboarding, and pair with external specialists so knowledge stays within Swisscom. Turn operations into code: Work with Managers on Duty, network SMEs and operations engineers to convert workflows, SOPs and expert judgement into testable agent behaviour, and demo working software to non-technical stakeholders. Strong Python skills, with experience designing APIs and distributed services. Contribution to technical design, code reviews and engineering quality practices. Generative & Agentic AI Practical experience building production-grade generative AI or LLM applications. Experience with agentic workflows, tool calling, retrieval, grounding and evaluation. Cloud Practical AWS experience, ideally including Bedrock, IAM, networking, logging and serverless services. Soft Skills Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken). Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, cross-location product team. Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Strong ownership mindset combined with a collaborative, pod-first attitude. Willingness to share knowledge and support the growth of colleagues. items.desc: Eleva AI is the AI agent operating system for physical venues: shopping centers, outlets, retail parks, airports, stadiums and leisure destinations. 85% of consumer spending still happens offline, yet these places have no intelligent digital layer to talk to their visitors, sell to them and learn from them. We're building it. Our AI agents talk to visitors on web, QR, WhatsApp, apps and even phone calls, and our admin console turns every conversation into service, revenue and data for the operator. We're already live in some of Europe's leading shopping destinations and working with major retail real estate groups across Spain, Italy, Portugal and the Middle East. The category is brand new, and we intend to own it worldwide. 💼 THE ROLE We're hiring a Founding Full Stack AI Product Engineer: one of the first engineers of Eleva and part of the founding staff. This is not a job, it's a seat at the table. You'll build end-to-end: from the database and the agent orchestration to the APIs, integrations, admin console and deployment. What you build goes straight into production and is used every day by real visitors in live venues. AI is not only what we build, it's how we build. You'll work AI-native every single day: coding agents, LLMs and automation are part of your workflow, so one person ships what used to take a whole team. We don't care about the "Senior" title. We care about hunger, speed and ownership. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, become one of its most important people and, as we scale, lead the engineering team that takes Eleva global. That's why this role comes with a very significant phantom share package: a real stake in what we're building, not a token one. 🛠️ WHAT YOU'LL BUILD • The multi-agent platform: LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG over each venue's catalog, memory and guardrails. • Every channel: web widget, WhatsApp Business API, QR, apps and a voice agent that answers the venue's phone calls like a person. • The admin console: campaigns, segments, WhatsApp templates, and AI agents that take actions for the operator. • The Data Core: conversation analytics, intent, CSAT and the insights operators use to make decisions. • Integrations with the venue ecosystem: maps and wayfinding, loyalty and CRM, gift cards, parking, ticketing, bookings. • The next agents: asset management, review analysis, competitor analysis and operations. • The foundations: architecture, security, observability, CI/CD and reliability. 🧱 OUR STACK • Backend: Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, REST APIs, workers and webhooks • AI: LLM APIs, agents and tool calling, RAG, embeddings, Qdrant • Frontend: TypeScript and React • Cloud: Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage), CI/CD • Integrations: WhatsApp Business API, OAuth, third-party APIs 📚 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • Really strong backend: Python, SQL and APIs are your home. • You've shipped real products to production and you're probably already doing well in your current job. • You can move across the stack and are comfortable with TypeScript and React. • Hands-on with LLMs: you've built something with agents, tool calling, RAG or embeddings (side projects count). • AI-native in your day-to-day: you code with AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor or similar), automate everything you can and always test the latest models and tools. • You've owned something end-to-end and you're as much a product person as an engineer. • You take decisions, defend them and ship. Fast. 🔥 THIS IS FOR YOU IF… • You're very ambitious and want to build something that matters worldwide, not a feature in a big company. • You want real weight in a company: your decisions shape the product, the architecture and the culture. • You want to grow fast, from founding engineer to leading the engineering team. • You want to own the core of an AI company from day 0, and be rewarded like an owner. 🤝 WHAT WE OFFER • Competitive salary (40-65K€) + a VERY significant phantom share package • Founding impact: you'll design the backbone of the platform • A real career path to tech lead / head of engineering • Global from day one: Spain, Italy, Portugal and the Middle East • Young, fast team in central Barcelona, side by side with the founders • Barcelona office; flexible (ideally 2 days/week in office) for exceptional candidates based elsewhere in Spain If you've read this far, chances are you see the world a bit like we do. Let's talk.

items.card: What you will do Build gold sets with SMEs: annotate regulatory and clinical documents with the expected outputs (for example, extracted risks, relevant guidance and precedent, and whether the data supports each key message). Write the annotation guidelines, run adjudication, and measure inter-rater agreement. Evaluate extraction: score risk extraction for precision, recall, and completeness, and compare successive
items.desc: The project: We are building a GenAI regulatory science co-pilot for regulatory submission teams. It works like a virtual Health Authority reviewer. It extracts and assesses regulatory risks, maps submission content to relevant regulatory guidance and precedent, checks that key messages are supported by the underlying clinical data, and anticipates likely Health Authority questions. This system directly informs regulatory submission strategy, so its outputs must be accurate, grounded in cited sources, and traceable. We are hiring an experienced contractor to build and run the evaluations for the system’s core reasoning engines, working with regulatory affairs subject-matter experts (SMEs) and the product engineering team. What you will do Build gold sets with SMEs: annotate regulatory and clinical documents with the expected outputs (for example, extracted risks, relevant guidance and precedent, and whether the data supports each key message). Write the annotation guidelines, run adjudication, and measure inter-rater agreement. Evaluate extraction: score risk extraction for precision, recall, and completeness, and compare successive engine versions against a baseline. Evaluate retrieval and ranking: measure retrieval recall (Recall@K), ranking quality (MRR, nDCG), and question coverage when the engine retrieves regulatory guidance, precedent, and prior Health Authority interactions. Evaluate grounding and traceability: build code-based checks that every finding traces through evidence and document back to a valid source and citation. Detect fabricated guidance, fabricated precedent, and unsupported regulatory claims. Evaluate reasoning with LLM judges: design and validate LLM-as-judge rubrics for regulatory relevance, evidence sufficiency, risk assessment, and explanation quality, calibrated against SME judgment. Evaluate each pipeline stage: create evaluation datasets and baselines for each stage of a multi-stage engine (evidence structuring, question coverage, retrieval, ranking, mapping, grounding), plus an end-to-end review with SMEs. Report and harden: turn failure analysis into clear readouts for the product team, and package the evaluations as regression suites that run in CI/CD. Required experience 5+ years of hands-on work in AI/ML evaluation, NLP, or applied data science, including recent delivery on LLM, RAG, or agent systems. Has built evaluation frameworks and gold datasets for information extraction and retrieval/ranking systems. Please share examples. Strong grounding in evaluation metrics and statistics: precision/recall/F1, Recall@K, MRR, nDCG, inter-rater reliability (e.g., Cohen’s kappa or Krippendorff’s alpha), and confidence intervals for small evaluation sets. Experience designing and validating LLM-as-judge systems against human expert ratings. Experience running annotation projects with domain experts: guidelines, adjudication, and quality control. Strong Python; experience with evaluation harnesses (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, Inspect, or in-house equivalents), LLM APIs, and Git/CI/CD. Can deliver against fixed milestones with little onboarding and work independently. Fluent professional English, written and spoken. Nice to have Experience with regulatory affairs, regulatory intelligence, or submissions: FDA/EMA guidance, CTD structure (e.g., Modules 2.5 and 2.7), Health Authority questions, and labeling. Experience evaluating AI in regulated (GxP) environments. Familiarity with clinical trial outputs (CSRs, TLFs, statistical outputs) and drug development. Experience evaluating document-comparison, claim-verification, or fact-checking systems. Publications or open-source work in AI evaluation, information retrieval, or biomedical NLP.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an AI, Data & Digital Transformation Expert (f/m) to join our Corporate Audit department based in Toulouse, France . 
 You will be part of a functional, multicultural, and transnational team driving the digital evolution of our audit operations. 
 As part of the Corporate Audit function, you will be involved in developing AI agents and advanced data analytics solutions aiming at accelerating digital transformation and supporting the integrity of our global activities. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10,000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

items.desc:
Wir entwickeln moderne, cloud-basierte Softwarelösungen für die Mobilitäts- und Logistikbranche – von internationalen Automobilherstellern über Speditionen bis hin zum Vor-Ort-Dienstleister. Unsere Plattformen digitalisieren und automatisieren komplexe Transport- und Einsatzprozesse. In einem Arbeitsumfeld, das zunehmend durch generative Software-Werkzeuge unterstützt wird, gewinnen Konzeption, Schnittstellenkompetenz und architektonische Weitsicht rasant an Bedeutung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort Gießen (Hybrid) suchen wir dich als gestaltende Kraft, die diese technologische Entwicklung aktiv nutzt und die Schnittstelle von Technologie und Fachlichkeit besetzt.
 End-to-End Feature Ownership : Du begleitest Features von der ersten Kundenidee über die fachliche und technische Konzeption bis zum produktiven Release.
 Kunden- & Schnittstellendialog : Du sprichst direkt mit Anwendern, Partnern und Auftraggebern aus der Mobilitätsbranche, verstehst deren Workflows und übersetzt Business-Anforderungen in pragmatische, skalierbare Produkt-Features.
 Architektur & KI-gestützte Entwicklung : Du nutzt moderne KI-Generatoren und Agentic-Tools, um effizient Lösungen zu realisieren. Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Design robuster Datenmodelle, der Validierung generierten Codes und der Sicherung hoher Qualitätsstandards.
 Code-Review & Qualitätssicherung : Du agierst als Mentor und QA-Instanz für automatisiert erstellte Softwarekomponenten, um Wartbarkeit und Performance zu garantieren.
 Themen- & Schnittstellen-Management : Du behältst bei mehreren parallelen Entwicklungssträngen den Überblick, stimmst technische Machbarkeiten mit Kunden und Partnern ab und triffst fundierte Architektur-Entscheidungen.
 Technologie-Radar : Du evaluierst proaktiv neue Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Tools, um unsere Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit und Produktqualität kontinuierlich zu steigern.
Ausbildung: erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Medieninformatik oder eine vergleichbare Berufs- und Fachausbildung.
 AI-First-Mindset : Du begreifst KI-Coding-Assistenten und autonome Agenten nicht nur als Hilfsmittel, sondern als festen Bestandteil deines Workflows. Du verstehst es, Anforderungen so präzise zu formulieren, dass generative Systeme optimale Ergebnisse liefern.
 Tech-Stack & Erfahrung : Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Software Engineering. Unser Stack basiert auf PHP/Laravel sowie MySQL im Backend und historisch gewachsenem JavaScript im Frontend. Du hast Freude daran, dich in bestehende Legacy-Architekturen einzuarbeiten, diese pragmatisch weiterzuentwickeln und sukzessive auf moderne Standards (wie z. B. Vue.js) zu heben. Wichtiger als ein einzelnes Framework ist dein tiefes Verständnis für saubere Software-Architektur, API-Design und Refactoring.
 Methoden- & Qualitätskompetenz : Erfahrung im Umgang mit automatisierten Tests, CI/CD und modernen Entwickler-Tools (inkl. KI-Coding-Assistenten/Copilots).
 Kommunikation & Organisation : Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, parallele Themen strukturiert zu steuern, komplexe Sachverhalte für Kunden verständlich zu machen und Entscheidungen transparent zu begründen.
 Sprachen : Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
 Arbeitsort: Hybrid (vor Ort / Homeoffice), nicht Remote

At GCTIO, we lead network technology strategy across the Telefónica group. Our mission is to ensure that the right technologies are identified, selected, and deployed in the most efficient and effective way to support Telefónica’s strategic vision and business objectives. 
 In this role based in Madrid (Spain), you will be part of Mobile Packet Core Technology and Planning team as an expert across the Telefónica Group within the GCTIO organization. Your primary focus will be to provide deep technical expertise and contribute to the definition, selection, implementation, and evolution of mobile packet core technologies in close coordination with Telefónica’s operating businesses and key stakeholders. 
 The role requires deep technical expertise and the ability to influence and support the evolution of the mobile core towards 6G. 
 You will contribute your expertise to maximizing the value of core network capabilities in support of Telefónica’s automation and monetization objectives, leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), intent-based operations, and advanced network programmability. 
 You will provide expert input into the future network architecture and help promote a consistent technology strategy across the Group, fostering innovation, operational efficiency, and new business opportunities. 
 How will you contribute to this role? 🎯 
 Define the Packet Core strategic vision to support current and future product requirements, deliver operational efficiencies and automation objectives 
 Drive the evolution towards 6G architectures and standards. 
 Provide expert guidance on technology selection and packet core implementation across the Group, in line with our multi-vendor strategy. To support this objective, you will collaborate closely with our operating businesses and with Finance, Procurement, Access, IT, Security, and other relevant teams. 
 Provide technical input to vendor roadmaps and capability development 
 Introduce AI in packet core architecture to enhance automation and open new monetization opportunities 
 Collaborate with cloud and automation team to ensure life cycle management based on intents 
 Collaborate with product teams to ensure that packet core can deliver service and monetization roadmap 
 Contribute to industry forums and standards bodies to promote Telefónica’s technical vision in line with the defined strategy 
 Build efficiencies projects to meet budget targets and telefonica staretgic plan 
 What skills and key capabilities we are looking for ? 🔎 
 2 years + of experience in a similar role 
 Strong experience and knowledge in mobile packet core technology and architecture 
 Ability to provide technical guidance, influence decisions, and collaborate effectively with project teams 
 Team work in multi cultural environment 
 Experience in AI and Agentic AI in order to build and execute projects to meet AI for network and network for AI capabilities within packet core domain 
 Experience in participating and contributing in the telco standards and industry ecosystem 
 Knowledge and experience in cloud native infrastructures 
 Fluent in Spanish and English 
 Which other aspect will be considered ? 📚 
 Master in computer science or telecom engineering. 
 Experience working in cross-functional technical teams 
 Automation driven in improving day to day way of working 
 Experience in multi cultural environment 
 Whats advantage would you get working for us? 💙 
 Tansformational Projects. At Telefónica, you will be part of high-impact initiatives that shape industry trends and address the connectivity and digital transformation challenges of our society. 
 Professional Development. You will enjoy a long-term career path and continuous learning opportunities on a global scale, supported by our presence across multiple geographies. We will provide development opportunities, training programs, and international mobility options. We want to grow and build the future together with you. 
 Flexibility. We are committed to maintaining a healthy work-life balance. At Telefónica, we promote flexible working arrangements and position ourselves as a benchmark for new ways of working and work-life integration initiatives. 
 27 working days of annual leave to enjoy and recharge.

 Flexible compensation plan with a wide range of options to choose from

At NVIDIA, we invite hard-working new college graduates and early-career engineers to apply for our System Software Engineer, Automotive Cybersecurity role and join the HPSE Interface team in the United Kingdom. This is a remarkable opportunity to aid the creation and upkeep of software that delivers security services for NVIDIA's automotive platforms. You will examine sophisticated, low-level software and gain hands-on knowledge of how PKCS#11 functions within the DRIVE OS security architecture alongside hardware and software components. As you expand your system-level expertise, you will collaborate with global engineering teams to translate requirements into durable solutions for our customers. Engage throughout the software lifecycle, from development and deployment to validation, integration, release support, and issue resolution.
 What you'll be doing 
 Build your expertise in our HPSE security architecture and its interactions with hardware security, operating-system components, and other security services.
 Build, implement, test, debug, and maintain C-based software and interfaces for PKCS#11 and related security services within DRIVE OS and other deployments of the Tegra chipsets.
 Collaborate with software, hardware, system architecture, safety, security, quality, and customer-facing teams to clarify requirements and refine specifications.
 Contribute to investigating and resolving complex system, integration, and customer-reported issues; communicate technical findings clearly and help drive issues to closure, taking on greater ownership as your experience grows.
 Build and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; improve test automation and software quality.
 Participate in code reviews, design and build discussions, and documentation to ensure maintainable, secure, and reliable software.
 Contribute to development and release activities that follow applicable product lifecycle, safety, security, and quality processes.
 What we need to see 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical area. The role welcomes new college graduates and early-career candidates with up to 4 years of experience following a Bachelor's degree or up to 2 years following a Master's degree. Responsibilities and ownership will reflect your experience, with opportunities to grow toward greater independence.
 Sound C programming and debugging skills; ability to write clear, reliable, and maintainable code, demonstrated through coursework, projects, research, internships, or professional experience.
 Solid foundations in data structures, operating systems, computer architecture, and software engineering practices.
 A methodical and analytical approach, a willingness to learn complex systems, and the ability to work effectively with distributed cross-functional teams.
 Clear written and verbal communication skills, to communicate technical trade-offs clearly and collaborate on customer requirements.
 A proactive, quality-focused approach and a desire to learn and deliver in a safety- and security-conscious engineering environment, while exploring and adopting Agentic AI in disciplined and creative ways.
 Curiosity about the broader effects of our work. A desire to develop technical expertise alongside commercial awareness and learn to make sound technical and practical decisions.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd 
 These are opportunities to showcase your interests and experience, not prerequisites; examples from coursework, personal projects, research, or internships are welcome alongside professional experience.
 Coursework, personal projects, internships, research or professional experience in Linux/QNX embedded systems, SoCs based on ARM technology, platform security, or device and driver connectivity.
 Python experience, particularly for test automation, tooling, analysis, or developer efficiency; interest in or experience with Rust for systems programming, secure software, or tooling.
 Knowledge of applied cryptography, PKCS#11, key management, hardware security modules, secure boot, roots of trust, trusted execution environments, or hardware/software security boundaries.

items.desc: Are you looking for a new opportunity in hydrometallurgy in an organisation that strongly supports professional growth? Would you like to use your expertise to develop sustainable metals and materials recovery solutions while working in an inspiring community at the cutting edge of science and technology? Do you enjoy turning research ideas into practical solutions together with customers and multidisciplinary teams? VTT might be just the place for you. VTT is one of the leading applied research organisations in Europe. What unites us are curiosity, a passion for learning, and a purpose: to solve the biggest challenges of our time and turn them into sustainable growth and well-being. Our cross-disciplinary community of over 2000 brilliant minds from 55+ different nationalities focuses on creating impact through science-based innovation. Get to know us further by exploring VTT's tech & infra . We are now looking for a Research Scientist or Senior Scientist to join our Metals and Materials Recovery team. As a Research Scientist or Senior Scientist, you will plan and conduct hydrometallurgical research and help turn promising ideas into practical, industry-relevant solutions. Your work will combine experimental research, project preparation and customer collaboration with opportunities to contribute from early desktop studies to pilot-scale validation. Our Metals and Materials Recovery team develops hydrometallurgical and mechanical separation processes for low-grade and complex ores, concentrates, wastes and secondary raw materials, including spent batteries. Based at the Circular Raw Materials Hub laboratory and Hydrometallurgy pilot hall in Bioruukki, Espoo, the team works closely with industry to create applicable solutions that minimise waste and environmental impact while improving resource and energy efficiency. As a Senior Scientist, you will: Contribute to publicly funded research project proposal preparation and direct sales efforts. Develop process concepts from desktop studies towards laboratory testing and pilot-scale validation. Plan, conduct and interpret hydrometallurgical experiments. Apply techno-economic assessments into the research and publication workflow, supporting concept development and decision-making. Work closely with customers to understand their needs and translate them into relevant research questions and practical solutions. Coordinate multidisciplinary collaboration and communicate research ideas and results clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Contribute to safe, high-quality and forward-looking research practices in the team. Who we are looking for: A relevant master's or PhD degree and research or industry experience in hydrometallurgy. Strong knowledge of hydrometallurgical unit processes, from leaching to recovery, in particular solvent extraction and/or ion-exchange. Experience in planning and conducting experimental research and interpreting results. Ambition in combining scientific research and techno-economic assessments. Experience in preparing research projects or proposals for publicly funded or customer-funded work. Ability to understand customer needs, build networks and present complex ideas convincingly. Professional English skills, both written and spoken. Prior programming knowhow and familiarity with Python is considered an advantage. Industrial background in TEA is considered a strong advantage. Practical background in electrochemistry is considered a strong advantage. As a person, we hope that you are: Proactive, collaborative and able to see the bigger picture. You are socially perceptive, confident in networking and negotiation, and comfortable presenting ideas to different audiences. You combine scientific curiosity with an innovative and practical mindset, bringing people together and advancing relevant ideas towards real-world application. With VTT, you’ll enjoy: Work with a strong purpose. At VTT, you’ll get to use your professional expertise to help solve the greatest challenges of our time through science and innovation. Our research agenda is dedicated to creating solutions for systemic and technological challenges, such as reaching carbon neutrality and creating superior digital systems. At VTT, you’ll get to do your part in driving this meaningful change through your professional skills. Read more about our strategy, Chain reaction for growth, and our organisational culture as the builder of the world's most meaningful place to work. An inspiring community. VTT houses all the cutting-edge fields of innovation, from quantum technology to synthetic biology, under one roof. As a professional at VTT, you’ll witness and influence the future of science and technology as it happens. Career and learning opportunities. items.desc: We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to build trusted knowledge platforms. Solita is helping to build knowledge platforms, sometimes called company brains, for our customers. These platforms connect company information to its business context, enabling employees and AI agents to find reliable answers, understand where they come from, and rely on having permission to see the information. The information usually already exists, spread across SharePoint sites, ticketing systems, ERP data, and the expertise of people who have spent years building the business. While building digital solutions is becoming easier and faster with AI-assisted development, creating trusted knowledge platforms still requires a deep understanding of business concepts, data, and how people make decisions. In this role, you’ll work closely with our customers’ domain experts to understand their business, which are the most valuable questions the platform should solve, and which sources and definitions those answers need. You then take each use case into production, where employees and agents rely on it in their daily work. AI coding agents are naturally used in your daily work. You’ll give them clear specifications, provide the right context, and ensure the quality and reliability of what is produced. While AI helps accelerate development, you remain responsible for delivering solutions that work in production and create real business value. Responsibilities Collaborate with customer domain experts to identify use cases and define success metrics, such as time to answer or answer accuracy. Translate the customer business concepts into maintainable conceptual models and ontologies, ensuring that both people and agents use the same definitions: what counts as an active customer, or which price list applies when. Integrate documents and enterprise systems such as SharePoint, Confluence, CRM and ERP platforms, and while modeling structured data from databases and data platforms to fit the ontology. Design and implement retrieval and agent workflows that respect source system permissions and stay up to date when the sources change. Set up the development workflows with automated testing, evaluations, and code review. Deploy and operate the platform and continuously track answer quality and operational performance after go-live. Investigate answers users don’t trust and fix the underlying cause. What helps you succeed in this role Experience delivering software to production and maintaining it afterwards. Conceptual modelling: turning how domain experts talk about their business into a model and judging where it needs precision and where it can stay loose. Good SQL and experience with relational data models. Ability to model business knowledge using ontologies or similar semantic modelling approaches and keep those models maintainable as the domain evolves. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Github Copilot, and the ability to review, debug and improve generated code. Experience building LLM applications or retrieval systems, including measuring whether they give good answers. Proficiency in Python or TypeScript Experience on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP). Comfort with incomplete requirements and clarify them directly with customers. Modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks Fluent communication skills in English. Finnish language is considered an advantage. Additionally, we appreciate: Experience with semantic technologies such as RDF, OWL or SPARQL, graph databases. What do we offer? The opportunity to build AI-powered knowledge platforms that solve real business problems, helping organizations turn fragmented information into trusted answers that employees and AI agents can rely on every day. A role at the intersection of AI, software engineering, and business understanding, where you'll shape both what gets built and how it's built together with customers and domain experts. The chance to work on some of the most challenging AI adoption problems, designing retrieval systems, knowledge models, ontologies, and agent workflows that deliver measurable business impact in production. A high level of autonomy and influence, from selecting the most valuable use cases to defining solution approaches and driving them all the way to deployment and continuous improvement. The freedom to grow in the direction that interests you most, whether that's knowledge engineering, AI and agent systems, software architecture, customer advisory work, or building reusable capabilities that become part of Solita's broader offering. A multidisciplinary community of experts, collaborating with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Architects, Designers, and Software Developers who actively share knowledge and support one another. A culture built on trust, autonomy, and low hierarchy, where you're trusted to make decisions, take ownership, and shape your own way of …

Pour y parvenir, tu toucheras à de nombreux domaines : Imaginer et lancer des campagnes d'acquisition : identifier les bons chercheurs, trouver les messages qui font mouche et choisir les canaux les plus pertinents pour engager la discussion. Booster nos campagnes de mailing : affiner le ciblage, personnaliser les messages, tester de nouvelles approches et analyser les résultats pour progresser à chaque campagne. Faire évoluer notre site web : utiliser les outils d'IA pour améliorer nos pages, optimiser les parcours utilisateurs, explorer le front-end comme le back-end et renforcer notre visibilité sur les moteurs de recherche et les IA génératives ( SEO & GEO ). Construire les outils IA de demain : concevoir des prompts efficaces, développer des assistants intelligents et automatiser les tâches qui méritent de l'être. Oser les idées « out of the box » : imaginer un outil utile aux chercheurs, créer un contenu inattendu ou inventer une nouvelle manière d'identifier leurs besoins. On partage les idées, on expérimente et on garde ce qui fonctionne ! Bien plus que du marketing : comprendre et influencer l'innovation ! Ton travail ne servira pas uniquement à générer des prospects. En analysant les besoins et les réactions des chercheurs, tu nous aideras aussi à mieux comprendre notre marché et à orienter les futurs développements de notre équipe R&D. L'IA au cœur de ton quotidien ! Ici, l'intelligence artificielle n'est pas juste un sujet à la mode : c'est un outil que nous exploitons pleinement. Notre ambition ? Te permettre de développer de véritables compétences de prompt engineer, en pratiquant chaque jour, avec nous. Ta formation Tu as une formation Bac +5 en sciences ou en ingénierie ? Parfait ! Tu as moins d'années d'études, mais tu t'es formé(e) par toi-même, tu as développé de solides compétences et tu as des réalisations concrètes à nous montrer ? Ta candidature nous intéresse tout autant ! Ce qu'on recherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un qui aime transformer ses idées en actions. Un esprit vif et inventif : tu réfléchis vite, tu es curieux(se) et tu trouves des solutions là où d'autres voient des obstacles. Le goût de l'action : quand tu identifies une opportunité, tu ne te contentes pas d'en parler. Tu imagines un premier test et tu passes à l'action ! Une approche expérimentale : tu testes, tu mesures, tu analyses et tu ajustes. Tu développes ce qui fonctionne et tu sais abandonner une mauvaise idée, même quand c'était la tienne ! Une vraie autonomie : tu prends des initiatives, tu anticipes et tu fais avancer tes projets sans attendre qu'on te relance. Une curiosité pour les nouvelles technologies : tu as envie d'explorer les possibilités de l'IA, d'expérimenter de nouveaux outils et de développer tes compétences. Chez nous, on aime : Les gens d'action, les inventifs, les autonomes, les curieux et ceux qui sont exigeants avec eux-mêmes tout en prenant soin des autres. Ceux qui osent essayer, qui apprennent de leurs erreurs et qui préfèrent faire plutôt que parler. Et ceux qui ramènent des chouquettes ont déjà compris une partie de notre culture ! Tu as lancé un projet, développé un outil, automatisé une tâche, testé une idée originale ou créé quelque chose de tes propres mains ? Un projet personnel, associatif ou autodidacte compte tout autant qu'une expérience professionnelle ! You pick up unfamiliar platforms quickly and reason about how they fit together. You are comfortable reading API documentation, handling authentication, respecting rate limits, and parsing JSON when a native connector does not exist. Fluency with AI as a build material. Hands-on experience using LLMs, agentic workflows, prompt design and evals to build systems you can trust in production, not just as an end user. Comfort across low-code and code. You build with whatever fits the problem, from orchestration tools and Salesforce Flows through to scripting in Python, JavaScript, SOQL or SQL where it earns its place. Cross-functional range. You can interview a top rep to find the manual work that should not exist, translate a business problem into a technical build, and explain the result in plain language. Experience with RAG is useful, but this isn't a role for someone whose experience is primarily connecting APIs together with LangChain or similar frameworks. I am particularly interested in people who understand what is happening underneath the RAG stack, how embeddings are trained and evaluated, how retrieval works, how re-rankers work, how training data is created and how models can be improved through experimentation. The role is 4 days a week hybrid in London and is paying up to the £110k + bonus mark on the top of the band. If interested, please apply or email me directly at tomasz@virtuetech.io

Someone who parallelizes hypotheses using coding agents, moves fast, and stays relentlessly focused on building AI solutions that scale and solve real customer pains. Someone who measures before optimizing, but never lets analysis slow down shipping. ➡️ What You’ll Do 👉 Architect and ship AI solutions for restaurateurs, balancing latency, cost, and accuracy 👉 Obsess over efficiency: a single line of code has saved us thousands of dollars, minutes of latency, or unlocked a step-change in accuracy. items.desc: Software engineering has moved up the stack. AI now writes a growing share of the code; the harder, more valuable work is specifying what to build, judging whether it's right, and getting it trusted into production. This programme is built for that shift. You will join our Agentic Engineering and Build Capability CoE as part of a client squad, working alongside senior engineers and Forward Deployed Consultants on real problems: agentic systems, AI-enabled products, and the evaluation and governance that make them safe to ship. We are not training you to write code AI can already write; we are training you to do what AI cannot: understand the problem, specify it precisely, evaluate the output, and defend your reasoning to engineers and the business alike. We are looking for graduates who can already show us this in practice. If you have built something with AI (a side project, a hackathon entry, an automation that actually runs), bring it: we will spend more time on what you built and why than on your degree. Key Responsibilities Work inside a client squad, contributing to agentic and software engineering builds under the direction of a Forward Deployed Consultant or senior engineer. Translate business problems into clear, testable specifications: the discipline that increasingly separates good engineers from AI that writes syntactically correct but wrong code. Build and integrate AI-powered features using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic workflows. Evaluate AI-generated and AI-assisted output against defined success criteria, using evaluation harnesses and golden datasets rather than judgement alone. Apply security, governance and cost-awareness principles, including AI FinOps thinking, so what you build is reliable, scalable and safe to run. Work directly with product owners and business stakeholders to understand what "done" actually means, not just what was asked for. About You Skills & Knowledge A demonstrable AI engineering portfolio: personal projects, hackathons, open-source contributions or coursework where you have actually built something with AI, not just studied it. Confidence to make and defend a technical judgement call, curiosity to keep exploring how the tools are changing, and enough security in your own reasoning to say when you think an AI-generated answer is wrong. Understanding of programming fundamentals and object-oriented concepts, strong enough to read and critique AI-generated code, not just write your own. An informed view on how the software engineer's role is shifting: less time producing code, more time specifying, evaluating and taking accountability for it. Strong communication skills: able to explain a technical decision to an engineer and a business outcome to a product owner, in the same week. Comfortable working in a squad, taking direction from a Forward Deployed Consultant or technical lead, and contributing across build, evaluation and delivery. Desirable Experience with Python or another modern language, including using AI coding assistants (such as Copilot, Claude Code or Cursor) as part of your workflow. Exposure to agentic frameworks, specification-driven development, or evaluation and testing tooling. Understanding of software development lifecycles and Agile delivery. Familiarity with version control (Git), cloud platforms or APIs. Awareness of AI governance, safety or risk concepts. Experience gained from academic projects, internships, bootcamps or personal builds, particularly anything you can show us running. What Success Looks Like We grade AI fluency separately from technical seniority, using FDM's AI fluency framework: AI Aware, AI Productive, AI Operational, AI Orchestrating. Within your first year, successful graduates will: Progress from AI Aware to AI Productive, and be working towards AI Operational. Deliver clean, tested, production-ready code as part of a live client squad. Specify, build and evaluate agentic and RAG-based solutions that others can trust without re-checking your work. Apply governed, auditable engineering practice by default, not as an afterthought. Present technical decisions clearly and confidently to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including product owners. Build the track record that opens the door to specialist tracks such as Agentic AI Engineer (AI Orchestration), FDM's most senior technical capability. You are: Confident enough to make a technical call and stand behind it, without needing to be told you're right. Curious about how AI is changing the craft of engineering, and genuinely interested in finding out rather than assuming you already know. Secure enough to say "I don't know" or "I think this AI output is wrong", and explain why. Collaborative, and comfortable taking direction inside a squad while still bringing your own point of view. items.desc: Buscamos incorporar un/a AI Skills Developer que diseñe, construya y mantenga una librería de skills complejas para agentes de IA que asisten y ejecutan tareas a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del ensayo clínico para una importante industria farmacéutica: desde feasibility y startup, pasando por monitorización, data management, bioestadística, medical writing y regulatory, hasta TMF y calidad. Qué harás: - Mapear y descomponer procesos de operaciones clínicas junto a los SMEs de cada área, convirtiéndolos en skills accionables por un agente. - Escribir y mantener archivos SKILL.md complejos: instrucciones claras, lógica de decisión, ejemplos y contraejemplos, manejo de casos límite, criterios de calidad y plantillas de referencia. - Construir los activos de soporte que cada skill necesita: prompts y plantillas, documentos de referencia, checklists, scripts auxiliares y esquemas de datos (p. ej. CDISC/CDASH, estructuras de CRF/SoA). - Probar, evaluar e iterar el comportamiento de los agentes: definir criterios de evaluación, medir precisión y calidad de salida, y refinar las skills hasta que sean fiables en producción. - Garantizar el cumplimiento: que las salidas se alineen con ICH-GCP, requisitos regulatorios, SOPs internas y privacidad de datos (anonimización). - Versionar y gobernar la librería de skills (control de versiones, documentación, trazabilidad, governance). - Formar a usuarios finales (CRAs, CTMs, DM, etc.) en el uso de los agentes y recoger feedback para mejora continua. Las skills abarcarán dominios como: - Monitorización y CRA: seguimiento de monitorización diaria, RBQM, preparación y reporte de visitas (SQV, SIV, IMV), monitoring report review, follow-up letters, PD classification e identificación de desviaciones. - Medical writing : protocolo, CSR, IB (creación, revisión v0 y actualización), ICF, briefing book. - Data management y bioestadística: CRF design y SoA programming, edit checks, data management/validation plans, SAP, programación de análisis estadístico, CDISC standardization, anonimización. - Regulatory y submissions: documentación esencial, respuestas y predicción de RFIs, EC programming, consulta de centros y países participantes. - Calidad y TMF: crosscheck eTMF vs CTMS, inspection readiness, quality check, QC de documentos, PD plan/review. - Feasibility y startup: feasibility questionnaires, site selection review, site activation, planificación del ensayo, performance review. - Vendors y gestión económica : alta y cualificación de proveedores, investigator grant plan, site payments, validación de facturas y seguimiento de presupuesto, study budgeting. - Formación: generación de materiales de CRA training, SIV e IM. Imprescindible: - Conocimiento sólido de operaciones de ensayos clínicos y del panorama documental y de procesos descrito arriba (no necesariamente experto en todas las áreas, pero capaz de entenderlas y entrevistar a quien sí lo es). - Experiencia escribiendo instrucciones estructuradas / prompts para agentes LLM: familiaridad con el formato de Agent Skills (SKILL.md) y con prompt engineering. - Fluidez técnica: Markdown, Git, scripting básico (Python preferente), trabajo con datos estructurados (JSON/YAML) y con formatos de documento (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx). - Capacidad analítica y de descomposición de proceso : convertir un proceso ambiguo y lleno de excepciones en pasos explícitos y verificables. - Mentalidad de calidad y cumplimiento:, con atención al detalle y conciencia de las implicaciones regulatorias de una salida incorrecta. - Español e inglés: (entorno de trabajo bilingüe; gran parte de la documentación clínica está en inglés). Valoraremos: - Certificación ICH-GCP y/o experiencia previa como CRA, CTA/CTM, data manager, medical writer o en regulatory/QA. - Conocimiento de CDISC (SDTM/ADaM/CDASH), sistemas EDC, CTMS/eTMF y herramientas de RBQM. - Experiencia con frameworks de evaluación de LLMs , RAG, integración vía API y construcción de agentes. - Experiencia documentando y versionando librerías de contenido o de código. Qué ofrecemos Salario competitivo Contrato indefinido Seguro de salud y de vida Entorno internacional y diverso con oportunidades a nivel mundial Plan de carrera a medida, orientado a crecimiento y aprendizaje continuo Formación tanto técnica como competencial cursos de Skills interpersonales...) Bonus por objetivos 31 días de vacaciones Un rol de alto impacto en el centro de una transformación real de las operaciones clínicas con IA. Trabajo transversal con todas las áreas de Clinical Operations de un grupo farmacéutico internacional.

Success is not measured by years of experience or by knowledge of a particular AI framework. It is measured by strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, quality of thinking, and the ability to contribute working code to AI-enabled solutions. L’AI Engineer inoltre contribuirà alla Bip xTech Data Community con attività di ricerca, scouting tecnologico, concept di nuove soluzioni e sviluppo del business sui clienti di BIP. Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti fondamentali Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo; Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica o discipline affini (STEM). Esperienza nello sviluppo di software in almeno un linguaggio, come per esempio: Python, Scala, Java, e/o simili; Esperienza nel disegno di soluzioni software e nell’implementazione di strutture dati, algoritmi; Esperienza nell’utilizzo degli strumenti di Code Repository, come per esempio: GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps e/o simili. Conoscenza dei concetti, algoritmi e metodologie di Machine Learning. Esperienza con linguaggi SQL per il design, query e gestione dei database; esperienza nell’utilizzo di linguaggi SQL per le attività di ETL. Indispensabile la conoscenza fluente di Italiano e Inglese professionali. Plus Esperienza nell’utilizzo delle principali piattaforme cloud (Google, AWS, Azure); Conoscenza dei concetti e tecnologie di Big Data e Data Warehousing (esempio: Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Kafka); Esperienza con framework e metodologie di Deep Learning (esempio: Tensorflow, PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, LangChain). Conoscenza di framework di versionamento di dati e/o modelli (esempio: MLFlow, DVC, WanDB…). Esperienza con framework di lavoro AGILE (esempio: Scrum, Kanban). Perché Bip? Crescita e Formazione Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale. items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



Safety System Engineer



🛠️ About our Engineering Teams



At Wayve, we are developing AV2.0: an end-to-end AI driving system designed to learn and adapt across a wide range of driving environments, with the ambition to scale autonomy globally. Our Safety team tackles one of the most important and complex challenges in that mission - assuring the safety of our Automated Driving System (ADS) as it evolves across vehicle platforms, applications and operating environments. You will help design and orchestrate the safety assurance framework that makes this possible.



🧠 Your day-to-day



You will lead functional safety activities for Wayve's ADS and its integration into current and future vehicle platforms, as well as third-party safety-critical systems. Working closely with internal engineering teams, external partners and other safety experts, you will build a deep understanding of the system, assess risk, shape the safety concept and architecture, define verification and validation, and develop the evidence needed to support a robust safety case.



🧩 What you’ll be working on:



• Build and maintain Item Definition work products for each vehicle platform and safety-critical integration.

• Conduct HARAs, FMEAs and FTAs to identify risk and define safety concepts that reduce risk to an acceptable level.

• Work with design teams on system architectures that satisfy the safety concept, including decomposition decisions and derived software and external requirements.

• Support software teams in implementing safety requirements on target hardware.

• Define test specifications across integration levels, including vehicle-level verification and validation of the safety concept.

• Build structured safety cases using clear claims, arguments and evidence.

• Contribute to production safety work products and evolve safety processes with process and compliance teams for certification activities.



🙌 You should apply if:



• You have at least 5 years of hands-on automotive functional safety experience applying ISO 26262 across different systems, with strong working knowledge of Parts 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 9.

• You have conducted vehicle-level testing at proving grounds to verify and validate safety concepts.

• You are experienced in risk analysis and safety engineering techniques such as HARA, FMEA and FTA, and can translate findings into practical safety concepts, architectures and requirements.

• You can work effectively across software, hardware, systems and external partners, and are comfortable debating safety-related trade-offs at different levels of the organisation.

• You are pragmatic in balancing risk and benefit, especially in a fast-moving development environment, while maintaining high safety standards.

• You are a self-starter who can move between long-term, high-level safety thinking and detailed subsystem or application-level problem solving, and you are confident challenging ideas while remaining open to constructive feedback.



✨ Nice to have

• Practical experience with ISO 26262 Part 6, including production software development and software-tool qualification.

• Experience managing suppliers of safety-related hardware or software, including DIA definition, supplier audits and assessments.

• Experience developing safety cases for automated driving systems, including computer-vision-based systems, and enough knowledge of neural networks to discuss safety assurance approaches with scientists and engineers.

• Experience with SOTIF, including identifying triggering conditions and defining testing and validation strategies.

• Operational safety experience, including identifying operational risks and defining training or procedures for safe public-road testing.



🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven …

 Work mode: On-site, 8-hour shift rotation covering 24/7 operations
 Level: Mid/Senior level
 Employment type: Full time and permanent
 About the role
 Our site runs high-density GPU infrastructure around the clock, and we are hiring at both Data Center Technician and Senior Data Center Technician levels. Your level will be determined by your experience, technical capability and the complexity of work you can handle independently.
 This is a hands-on, all-rounder role covering server installation, hardware break/fix, rack builds, copper and fibre cabling, link-level troubleshooting and general site operations. You will work independently within your level of responsibility while collaborating closely with other technicians, network engineers, system administrators and wider infrastructure teams.
 At the senior level, you will take on more complex technical work, lead the technical execution of deployments and build-outs, mentor junior technicians and help improve operating procedures and technical standards.
 Your responsibilities 
 Install, configure, and maintain servers, storage systems, networking equipment, and other data center hardware.
 Monitor data center environmental conditions — temperature, humidity, power — and respond to alerts.
 Ensure uptime and availability of data center infrastructure in a 24/7 environment, including participation in on-call.
 Lead or contribute to data center build-outs, migrations, and refresh projects — including opening new data halls and extensions.
 Plan and schedule machine installations independently, and plan future site upgrades as power capacity grows.
 Collaborate closely with remote hands teams, network engineers, system administrators, the Site Manager, and Head of DC Operations.
 Mentor junior technicians and, as the site grows, take part in hiring and building the on-site team.
 Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, with professional fluency in English — our internal working language and the language of daily contact with colleagues globally.
 Your key competencies 
 We're looking for someone who works independently on routine hardware and cabling tasks and knows when to escalate.
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
 3–5+ years of progressive data center or IT infrastructure experience.
 Direct hands-on experience with enterprise GPU servers (NVIDIA Ampere, Hopper, or Blackwell generations).
 Ability to operate independently and improvise — you don't need check-ins or supervision to know what matters.
 Ability to work on-site full-time in shift rotation.
 Comfortable with ambiguity and a broad scope of work
 Nice to have
 Experience with liquid cooling — DLC loops, and maintenance of liquid cooling solutions.
 Experience leading site build-outs, data hall openings, or large cluster deployments.
 Experience mentoring or leading junior technicians.
 What's next
 We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.
 If you have a CV in English, you are welcome to submit it. Applications in Spanish are equally accepted. Please apply through our careers page, as we do not accept applications by email.

items.desc: Lieu : Toulouse, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien Votre destination pour une maîtrise totale du ciel ! De la conception à l'installation, nous créons des systèmes de contrôle aérien de pointe ! Nous rendons l'accès à l'espace aérien fluide, équitable et durable. La cybersécurité est en constante évolution et c’est encore plus vrai avec l’intelligence artificielle : comment se protéger vis-à-vis de l’IA et comment utiliser l’AI pour renforcer les mesures de protection cyber ? Le Group Product Security Office est mobilisé, joue un rôle fondamental pour protéger les actifs numériques de THALES afin de garantir la confiance de nos clients. Le GPSO renforce son équipe sur ce domaine d’expertise. L'ingénieur cybersécurité logiciels et produits digitaux est chargé de garantir la sécurité des solutions logicielles et des produits numériques développés par THALES . Il agit en tant qu'expert technique en cybersécurité logicielle : il conçoit, expérimente, outille et met en œuvre lui-même les solutions, au contact direct des équipes pluridisciplinaires de développement, d'ingénierie, de gestion des risques, de R&D/R&T, etc. Ce poste requiert avant tout une expertise technique approfondie, à la croisée de la cybersécurité et du développement logiciel, complétée par des capacités analytiques et communicationnelles. Dans ce cadre vos principales missions seront : Le poste s'articule autour de plusieurs axes stratégiques de transformation : Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) : industrialiser et élever la maturité des pratiques de développement sécurisé sur l'ensemble des lignes de produits. Structurer et animer une communauté de parties prenantes (CPSO, PSO, CSA, COL, PDA, etc.) autour des thématiques SSDLC et IA-in-engineering : événements, groupes de travail, ressources partagées, base de connaissances. IA dans l'ingénierie logicielle : accélérer l'adoption sûre de l'IA dans nos pratiques de développement, et garantir un déploiement sécurisé de l'IA embarquée dans nos produits. Assurer une veille technologique active et identifier de nouvelles opportunités ; concevoir et réaliser les Proof-of-Concept (PoC) et MVP afin d'évaluer les solutions candidates (SAST/DAST/SCA, outils SBOM, assistants de codage IA, plateformes de test de sécurité IA, fournisseurs émergents). Il s'agit d'un rôle d'expertise de bout en bout : de la contribution aux référentiels et instructions jusqu'à l'implémentation technique, en interaction directe avec les équipes d'ingénierie. Votre profil : Justifier une expérience en tant que Cyber Risk Manager et/ou PSIRT manager. Sécurité des logiciels, des applications et des services cloud. Maîtrise approfondie et pratique des outils et techniques SSDLC : codage sécurisé, tests de sécurité (SAST, DAST, SCA, coordination de pentests). Connaissance des standards et référentiels reconnus tels que OWASP (SAMM, ASVS), NIST SSDF, IEC 62443, ISO 27034. Compréhension pratique des technologies IA/ML. Gestion des incidents : concevoir et outiller des processus pour détecter, signaler et traiter les incidents de sécurité. Cryptographie. Capacité démontrée à concevoir et réaliser des évaluations, PoC et bancs d'essai d'outils, puis à industrialiser le résultat. De formation supérieure : diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent en informatique, sécurité des systèmes d'information ou domaine connexe. Certifications : [exemples : CSSLP, OSCP, GIAC, CISSP, etc.] sont un plus. Expérience : Expert en développement logiciels sécurisés avec un minimum de 10 ans d'expérience, de préférence dans l'industrie - vous avez développé du logiciel, et vous l'avez sécurisé. Par ailleurs : Vous pouvez témoigner de capacités de rigueur avec un esprit d'analyse poussé et un pragmatisme reconnu.  En tant qu’Architecte Solution Infrastructure, vous serez le/la chef(fe) d’orchestre technique des projets d’automatisation et d’industrialisation des infrastructures, avec une approche DevOps. Vos responsabilités : Analyser les besoins techniques et métiers pour concevoir des architectures d’infrastructure agiles, scalables et sécurisées. Définir et mettre en œuvre des chaînes CI/CD robustes et automatisées. Industrialiser les déploiements d’infrastructure (Infrastructure as Code) via des outils comme Terraform, Ansible, Puppet ou Chef. Maîtrise de la conteneurisation et de l’orchestration : Docker, Kubernetes. Compétences en scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell). Bonne culture des environnements systèmes (Linux/Windows), réseaux, sécurité. Certification DevOps ou Cloud (Azure DevOps, CKA, etc.) appréciée. Au-delà de la technicité, votre capacité à vulgariser, convaincre, structurer une vision technique et à travailler en transverse avec des équipes projet variées vous permettront de vous sentir pleinement à votre place dans cette fonction. Communauté d’architectes : intégrez un réseau mondial d’architectes, favorisant le partage d’expertise, le mentorat et les échanges entre pairs, notamment lors du Architect Summit. Projets à fort impact : diversité de missions dans des environnements innovants, interactions avec des dirigeants (CTO, CXO…) et opportunités concrètes de progression. Apprentissage en continu : accédez à des certifications techniques (AWS, Azure, Programme Architecte) et à des plateformes de formation pour rester à la pointe des évolutions technologiques.

items.desc: Date: Oct 23, 2026 Location: Berlin, DE, 10117 Company: Corning Requisition Number: 78725 The company built on breakthroughs. Join us. Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible. How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more. Come break through with us. Corning’s businesses are ever-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with: Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low-cost solar energy solutions Overview Corning is seeking a Systems Engineer to partner closely with customers and ecosystem collaborators to understand product challenges, develop system-level solutions, translate those solutions into product requirements, and support the design-in of Corning’s Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) portfolio. This role combines strong technical expertise in mechanical engineering of optical management systems and photonic connectivity with a customer-focused mindset. As a key technical interface across technology, manufacturing and business teams, the Systems Engineer will help shape the future of AI infrastructure in hyperscale data centers. This is a highly visible role that requires systems-level thinking, technical credibility, and strong communication skills. The individual will guide customers from early architecture discussions through design-in, qualification, and serial production, while helping bridge internal engineering teams and external stakeholders to solve deployment challenges and inform Corning’s CPO roadmap. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical point of contact for strategic customers and ecosystem partners throughout the CPO product lifecycle, from early architecture discussions through design-in, qualification, and deployment. Lead product and system ideation with customers and partners to address identified needs through differentiated product offerings.
