items.desc: Great AI doesn’t start with a great model. It starts with a great platform. The success of an AI initiative is rarely determined by the model alone. More often, it depends on the quality of the platform underneath it. As a Platform Engineer in our central Data & AI team, you’ll build the foundations that let engineers develop, deploy and operate AI workloads safely and efficiently. You’ll work on the infrastructure, automation and platform capabilities that allow teams to innovate without compromising reliability, and you’ll bridge the gap between promising technology and production reality. Think Kubernetes platforms, deployment automation, observability, security and developer experience. Think AI workloads built around Large Language Models, retrieval systems, graph technologies and modern data platforms. Think creating an environment where engineers focus on solving problems rather than fighting infrastructure. What you will work on Designing self-service platform capabilities using Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps principles Operationalizing graph and vector databases, and enabling model serving workloads Improving the observability of AI systems running in production Integrating OpenAI or Anthropic-based services into our platform Operationalizing LangGraph workloads on Kubernetes Enabling GraphRAG architectures powered by Neo4j Designing deployment patterns so AI services meet the same standards as any other production workload You’ll spend less time tuning models and more time making sure AI capabilities can be trusted, operated and continuously improved. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, software engineering and AI. At Schuberg Philis we don’t believe in throwing solutions over the fence. The engineers building systems are responsible for running them too, and that ownership extends to AI just as much as every other technology we work with. Your impact won’t be measured by the number of clusters you manage, but by how much autonomy and confidence other engineers gain from the platform you’ve built. We’d love to meet you if You care deeply about building platforms that other engineers love to use, and you’re happiest when automation replaces repetitive work You have a strong background in Platform Engineering, SRE, infrastructure or distributed systems You have extensive experience building and operating Kubernetes-based and cloud-native environments, with infrastructure automation at scale You’ve built and operated production environments using tools such as Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions or similar You understand what it takes to operationalize AI workloads in production, and technologies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Neo4j, GraphRAG, vector databases or LangGraph are familiar territory You believe observability, reliability and security belong in every design conversation You enjoy improving developer experience through automation and self-service You see the gap between a successful proof of concept and a production-ready system and immediately start figuring out how to close it You take ownership of the result You get satisfaction from enabling other engineers to move faster and safer You are currently based in the Netherlands. Questions? Please do not hesitate to contact Maggie: 0623757086 Only applications submitted through the website will be considered. Please note that we do not work with external recruitment agencies and we will not pay any fees for unrequested CV introductions. Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

You analyse system developments, identify future bottlenecks, and develop solutions that support a reliable, affordable, and future-proof energy system. Working within the Grid Solutions team in the Design division, you translate complex system analyses into clear recommendations for future grid development. Together with stakeholders, you assess grid and non-grid solutions across short-, medium-, and long-term planning horizons (0-5, 5-15, and 15-25 years), ensuring alignment with investment plans, grid visions, and policies. With your expertise in power system analysis, high-voltage networks, and problem-solving, you contribute directly to TenneT's strategic goals, including security of supply, sustainability, and a resilient electricity infrastructure. Jouw rol As a Grid Planning & Analysing Specialist, you play a key role in shaping the future electricity grid. By combining grid analyses, congestion assessments, scenarios, asset strategies, and energy developments, you translate complex insights into clear grid visions and investment recommendations. Working closely with colleagues and external stakeholders, you identify future capacity needs, assess system constraints, and support strategic decision-making. With your analytical expertise, you help ensure a reliable, robust, and future-proof grid while contributing directly to TenneT's goals of security of supply, the energy transition, and efficient infrastructure investments. Your responsibilities include: Ensuring future-proof grid development by assessing grid strategy alternatives, system development scenarios and network expansion options within your assigned region. Developing and maintaining regional grid visions (together with DSO’s) and planning perspectives by translating the outcomes of Investment Plan (IP) analyses, congestion studies, scenario assessments and stakeholder insights into coherent system development strategies. Developing and maintaining national grid vision (with developments of offshore wind, nuclear, industry and interconnections) and planning perspectives by translating the outcomes of Investment Plan (IP) analyses, strategic studies, scenario assessments, and stakeholder insights into coherent network development strategies. Providing the analytical foundation for network investment decisions (TollGate 1) by identifying system constraints, assessing alternative solutions and supporting prioritization of network reinforcement and expansion projects. Performing grid calculations for investment decisions (TollGate 1) and assessing the future behavior of the grid and the total system, particularly in relation to power flows, short circuit levels, reactive power, contingency analyses and system stability. Contributing to harmonized grid development methodologies, planning standards, and analytical frameworks across TenneT, ensuring consistency in network development strategies and planning processes in all project phases. You will be part of the Grid Solutions team within Design, work on the HV-grid (150kV specific) and report to the Manager of Grid Solutions. In this role, you work closely with colleagues from Design, Operate, Onshore, Offshore and other disciplines across TenneT, as well as with external stakeholders such as DSOs, government authorities, regulators, and regional energy partners. In this role, you will also participate in multidisciplinary teams within Design and on call, with Onshore and/or Offshore. In this way, you will contribute to the preparation of investment projects that are aligned with management and maintenance projects, customer projects and support their implementation with clear design documents and expertise. items.desc: Your Mission The Field Engineer owns the technical planning, deployment, execution, and support of assigned pre-clinical and clinical studies involving INBRAIN's neural-interface systems. The role ensures reliable device performance, high-quality data collection, and study readiness across research and clinical environments. Working closely with Clinical, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and external study-site teams, the Field Engineer II serves as the primary technical lead for assigned studies and translates field experience into continuous product and process improvements. What You'll Do Study Planning & Execution Own the technical execution of assigned pre-clinical and clinical studies from preparation through close-out. Develop study-specific deployment plans, equipment strategies, and technical readiness activities. Identify and mitigate technical risks affecting study execution, data quality, or system performance. Ensure all study equipment, software, and supporting systems are available, calibrated, and compliant with applicable requirements. System Deployment & Technical Support Deploy, configure, and validate implantable-device systems and associated telemetry, stimulation, recording, and data-acquisition platforms. Perform system verification and functional testing prior to study activities. Monitor system performance during study execution and troubleshoot technical issues affecting device operation, connectivity, or data integrity. Coordinate escalation of complex technical issues to appropriate internal or external stakeholders. Stakeholder & User Support Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned study sites and external partners. Deliver training and technical guidance to clinicians, researchers, technicians, and study personnel. Support users throughout study execution and promote adherence to approved procedures and technical standards. Documentation & Continuous Improvement Maintain accurate records of system configuration, technical activities, deviations, and equipment status. Prepare study reports and communicate technical findings to Clinical, R&D, Quality, and Regulatory teams. Provide field feedback to support product improvements, risk management activities, and usability enhancements. Contribute to the development and refinement of field-engineering procedures, tools, and best practices. Equipment Management Maintain operational readiness of field equipment through appropriate calibration, maintenance, and inventory control. Coordinate equipment repair, replacement, and supplier support activities as needed. Support continuous improvement of study setup, deployment, and technical support processes. What You'll Bring Education Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Neuroscience, Biomedical Sciences, or a related technical discipline. Experience 3–5+ years of experience supporting medical devices, clinical research, biomedical systems, or related technical environments. Experience troubleshooting complex hardware-software systems in laboratory, hospital, or field settings. Experience working within regulated environments such as medical devices, clinical research, or life sciences. Technical Skills Medical device hardware and software troubleshooting. Data acquisition, telemetry, electrophysiology, or neural-interface systems. Technical documentation and root-cause investigation. Familiarity with quality systems, study documentation, and regulated processes. Demonstrated ability to configure, integrate, test and troubleshoot multidisciplinary hardware and software systems used in in vivo studies. Ability to analyse technical problems systematically, distinguish hardware, software and workflow-related causes, and drive issues through resolution. Ability to manage multiple technical workstreams independently in dynamic and time-sensitive study environments. Behavioral Competencies Confidence working as a technical counterpart to colleagues in software, electronics, mechanical engineering, clinical and research disciplines. Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to train users and present technical findings to diverse audiences. Self-motivated, proactive and results-oriented approach, combined with flexibility, reliability and a strong service mindset. Professional fluency in English. Willingness and ability to travel regularly to pre-clinical and clinical study sites. Preferred Experience with active implantable medical devices or brain-computer interface technologies. items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Role Description NestAI builds the software and intelligence layer for autonomous defense systems, deployed in live operational environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have — it's the whole point. As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll own the technical delivery and integration of that platform for our most critical partners. This is not a traditional implementation or support role. It's a high-stakes, high-ownership full-stack engineering position: you'll build, adapt, and scale modern web applications, decision-support interfaces, and backend integration layers directly against complex customer environments — with the freedom to choose the right tool for the problem rather than inherit a decade of someone else's legacy decisions. We need a versatile engineer who can jump into unfamiliar codebases, connect disparate software ecosystems, and deliver intuitive, high-performance user experiences where software meets the mission. Most of what you encounter here won't have a known answer yet; you'll work it out alongside a small, senior team that has full ownership of the problems in front of it, and a product organization that takes field feedback seriously enough to ship it back into the platform in days, not quarters. Day-to-Day Responsibilities: Mission-specific full stack engineering: Take technical ownership of building, customizing, and deploying client-facing web applications, operational dashboards, and backend services. API & system integration: Design, develop, and deploy robust APIs and backend services that connect NestOS cloud and edge modules with external situational awareness and command systems. Frontend execution: Build responsive, high-performance decision-support UI designed for low-latency, mission-critical operational environments. Engineering craft under pressure: Hold a high bar for code quality, testing, and observability even while moving fast on-site. AI-driven workflows: Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate velocity and rapidly prototype client-requested features without sacrificing platform security or reliability. Collaborative problem solving: Work directly with customer technical teams and internal product R&D to translate operational user needs into scalable full-stack features, feeding field feedback back into our core product roadmap. Qualifications: Solid experience (equivalent to 5+ years) as a Full Stack Software Engineer, with a proven track record of shipping complex web applications and backend systems. Strong proficiency across the full web stack, including modern frontend frameworks (React, TypeScript) and server-side ecosystems (Node.js, Python, or Go). Practical experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and WebSockets, database management (SQL/NoSQL), and hands-on familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and deployment pipelines across cloud or on-prem environments. A quick study who adapts rapidly to new technical environments, diverse codebases, and shifting customer priorities — you thrive on changing scenery rather than needing a settled, well-trodden stack. Strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence to interface directly with external partners, understand user workflows, and translate complex operational needs into software realities. Willingness to travel to and work in customer environments as needed. Preferred, not required: Experience in client-facing technical delivery or technical consulting. Prior exposure to mapping/GIS libraries (e.g., Mapbox, Cesium) or data visualization. Experience in defence or aerospace environments. If your background doesn't match every requirement but the work resonates with you, we'd encourage you to apply. How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box. Why join NestAI At NestAI, you’ll build meaningful, real-world …

Leverage threat intelligence and emerging attacker techniques to develop realistic testing scenarios and attack campaigns. Validate prevention, detection and response capabilities and work with the SOC and detection engineering teams to improve defensive effectiveness. Drive innovation in Offensive Security by identifying, testing and operationalizing AI capabilities that improve the scale, speed and effectiveness of Red Team activities. Define and maintain operational standards, rules of engagement and safety mechanisms for offensive security activities. Provide technical mentoring, knowledge sharing and guidance to Offensive Security colleagues and stakeholders. Here is what you will need to bring with you: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field; Master’s degree is a plus. 5+ years of hands-on offensive security experience, including at least 2 years focused primarily on Red Team operations. Hands-on experience designing, deploying, securing and/or operating Red Team infrastructure, for example in cloud or hybrid environments. Experience conducting attacks against Entra ID, Active Directory, and/or hybrid identity environments. Strong understanding of operational security principles, authorization boundaries, risk management, cleanup procedures, and/or emergency stop mechanisms. Practical understanding of how AI may augment offensive security activities or workflows. Strong communication skills in English. items.desc: About the job you're considering Role Purpose As an Observability Engineer, you’ll design, build and evolve enterprise observability capabilities across cloud and hybrid environments, with Dynatrace as our platform of choice. You’ll be equal parts engineer and consultant. You’ll implement end-to-end observability and also evangelise its value, influencing engineering, platform, operations and business teams to adopt it. You’ll help organisations move beyond traditional monitoring. You’ll do this by grounding observability in SRE principles and by turning telemetry into insight the business can act on. You’ll be recognised as a source of thought leadership in observability and reliability practice, both within our clients and across the wider profession. Your role Key Responsibilities Observability strategy and thought leadership Act as a trusted adviser, consulting with clients and teams on observability strategy, maturity and roadmaps. Define and drive observability standards, frameworks and best practices, and evangelise their adoption across multiple teams. Provide thought leadership on modern observability, OpenTelemetry and SRE practice, internally and externally. Use influence rather than authority to shift teams from reactive monitoring to proactive, data-driven operations. SRE principles in practice Establish Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budget frameworks, and help teams use them to balance reliability against delivery pace. Champion SRE ways of working, including reducing toil, defining error budget policies and running blameless post-incident reviews. Support incident management, root cause analysis and problem management, and feed the lessons back into engineering practice. Partner with development and platform teams to improve reliability, resilience and operational maturity. Getting the most from Dynatrace Maximise the full capability of Dynatrace across applications, infrastructure and cloud services, going well beyond out-of-the-box configuration. Use Dynatrace’s AI-driven analysis, service mapping and SLO capabilities to cut noise and shorten time to resolution. Integrate Dynatrace with OpenTelemetry instrumentation and wider telemetry pipelines to give a single, consistent view of service health. Translating business insight into meaningful dashboards Work with business and product stakeholders to understand what matters to them, and translate it into dashboards, service maps and alerts that tell a clear story. Connect technical signals to customer experience and business outcomes, so that decisions are driven by data rather than instinct. Make observability data accessible and meaningful to audiences from engineers to senior leadership. Engineering and automation Develop and maintain metrics, logs, traces and events strategies. Drive automation of monitoring, alerting and remediation. Governance and adoption Support governance, onboarding and adoption of observability platforms across multiple teams, building communities of practice that last beyond the engagement. items.desc: Unikie is seeking a Geospatial Data Science Engineer to pioneer the data layer powering our next-generation software-defined electric vehicles. In this senior role, you will be responsible for transforming massive, high-frequency streams of vehicle sensor observations into highly accurate, dynamic map features that the vehicle can use for localization, routing, and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). You will apply advanced computational statistics, machine learning, and spatial analysis to process and model large datasets, drawing actionable insights that translate raw fleet telemetry into live, high-definition maps. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in autonomous roles and are passionate about building performant, scalable systems at the intersection of data science and robotics. Responsibilities Geospatial Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, clean, and segment billions of daily vehicle sensor observations into consumable map features and geometries. Statistical Modeling & Insights: Apply advanced data mining and analytic methods to detect real-world changes (e.g., road closures, new lanes, construction) and design rigorous statistical tests to validate map accuracy. Map Generation & Map Matching: Develop robust algorithms for map matching, trajectory smoothing, and sensor fusion to convert noisy probe data into high-fidelity road geometry and attributes. System Design & Architecture: Lead the technical design of spatial data systems, ensuring low-latency query performance, efficient spatial indexing (e.g., H3, S2), and scalable storage of vector/raster map data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with embedded software engineers, perception teams, and cloud architects to align onboard vehicle capabilities with cloud-based mapping platforms. Staying Ahead of the Curve: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in big data technologies, computational statistics, machine learning, and automated mapping practices. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with an emphasis or thesis work on computational statistics, data mining, machine learning, or spatial optimization. Experience: 8+ years of related professional experience building and maintaining large-scale data processing and predictive systems. Advanced Analytics & Data Mining: Expert-level knowledge in data mining and analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, and Bayesian network analysis. Geospatial Expertise: Proven experience working with geospatial data, handling noisy time-series datasets, writing advanced spatial queries in PostGIS, and utilizing spatial libraries/indexing systems (e.g., H3, S2, GeoPandas). Programming & Scripting: Proficiency with statistical analysis packages and programming languages, including Python, SQL, and shell scripting (or familiarity with R/MATLAB). Statistical Testing: Strong statistical foundation with proven expertise in designing, executing, and analyzing complex data tests and validation methodologies. Preferred Qualifications Crowdsourced Mapping: Experience with fleet-based, crowdsourced map generation methodologies, including probe-data aggregation, change detection, and incremental map updates. Cloud Ecosystems: Experience deploying large-scale geospatial pipelines and machine learning workloads within cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Databricks). Open-Source Infrastructure: Experience with standard open-source vector tile formats, tools like Martin, QGIS, and geospatial processing engines (GDAL/OGR, GEOS). Automotive Map Formats: Familiarity with automotive map standards, routing schemas, and data structures such as NDS (Navigation Data Standard), OpenStreetMap (OSM), and Lanelet2/HD Maps. Robotics Algorithms: Familiarity with core robotics concepts, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization & Mapping), Sensor Fusion, and Point Cloud / Sensor Processing (LiDAR, radar, vision).

items.desc: AI Engineer Consultant Bouw AI. Adviseer klanten. Breng het naar productie. Een goede AI-oplossing bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat die oplossing aansluit bij wat een organisatie nodig heeft en daadwerkelijk wordt gebruikt, is iets anders. Bij Orange Business combineer je die twee. Als AI Engineer binnen ons Data & AI-team werk je samen met klanten aan AI-vraagstukken van idee tot implementatie. Je onderzoekt wat er werkelijk nodig is, maakt technische keuzes begrijpelijk en bouwt zelf mee aan de oplossing. De ene dag ontwerp je een RAG- of agentic AI-architectuur, de andere dag programmeer je in Python, experimenteer je met modellen of de evaluatie hiervan. Je bent engineer én consultant: hands-on met technologie en een Trusted Advisor voor onze klanten. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van het Data & AI-team van Orange Business Nederland: een hechte groep consultants met een gedeelde passie voor technologie. We praten graag over de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in GenAI, maar willen ze vooral begrijpen door ze zelf te gebruiken en te bouwen. We delen code en kennis, dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit en helpen elkaar om betere engineers én consultants te worden. Tegelijkertijd kijken we verder dan technologie. Onze klanten hebben niet alleen iemand nodig die een model of agent kan bouwen. Ze zoeken een partner die begrijpt wat ze willen bereiken, kan adviseren over de juiste aanpak en hen helpt om AI daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van hun organisatie. Daar ligt onze kracht: we combineren technische kennis met consultancy. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Engineer Consultant werk je end-to-end aan Data & AI-vraagstukken bij onze klanten. Je helpt bepalen wat er gebouwd moet worden en bent vervolgens zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Je gaat onder andere: samen met klanten bedrijfsproblemen vertalen naar AI use-cases en bepalen wanneer AI wel, en niet, de juiste oplossing is; prototypes ontwerpen en deze doorontwikkelen tot betrouwbare toepassingen die in de prakrijk gebruikt kunnen worden; genAI-applicaties bouwen met onder andere LLMs, RAG, agents, tool calling en moderne AI-workflows; AI-oplossingen integreren met bestaande data, API's, applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen; schaalbare architecturen ontwerpen voor AI-applicaties in de cloud; kennis delen binnen Orange Business en bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Data & AI-propositie. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken geen kandidaat die ieder framework op een lijst kan afvinken. We zoeken iemand met een goede technische basis die graag bouwt, samenwerkt en zich verder wil ontwikkelen als engineer en consultant. We vinden het belangrijk dat je: ervaring hebt met het ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen, bijvoorbeeld als AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist of een vergelijkbare rol; comfortabel bent met Python en begrijpt wat er nodig is om code betrouwbaar en onderhoudbaar te maken; begrijpt wat er nodig is om AI-oplossingen verder te brengen dan een experiment of notebook richting een productieomgeving; graag samenwerkt met klanten en collega’s waarbij je technische keuzes duidelijk kunt maken aan mensen met verschillende achtergronden en kritische vragen kan stellen; nieuwsgierig bent, graag nieuwe technologie uitprobeert en je kennis deelt met andere; Een bachelor- of masteropleiding in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Wiskunde, Econometrie of een vergelijkbare richting is mooi meegenomen, maar relevante praktijkervaring vinden we minstens zo belangrijk. Technologie waarmee je kunt werken Onze stack verschilt per klant en use case. Je hoeft dus zeker niet alles al te kennen. Belangrijker Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: AI & GenAI OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Hugging Face, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, Semantic Kernel en vergelijkbare frameworks. Modern AI Engineering RAG, embeddings, vector search, agents, MCP, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt & context engineering en LLM evaluation. Engineering & Cloud Python, REST APIs, Git, CI/CD, Docker, Azure DevOps, Azure ML, MLflow en cloud-native deployment. Belangrijker dan ervaring met één specifieke tool is dat je begrijpt hoe je een betrouwbaar AI-systeem ontwerpt, bouwt en naar productie brengt. Waarom Orange Business? Omdat je bij ons niet hoeft te kiezen tussen technologie en consultancy. Je krijgt de ruimte om diep de techniek in te gaan én jezelf te ontwikkelen als adviseur. Je werkt aan verschillende klantomgevingen en vraagstukken en ziet daardoor veel meer dan wanneer je jarenlang aan één product of platform werkt. Tegelijkertijd sta je er niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met een hecht Data & AI-team waarin kennisdeling, nieuwsgierigheid en elkaar beter maken belangrijk zijn. Daarnaast biedt Orange Business je de combinatie van een lokaal consultancyteam en de kennis, klanten en mogelijkheden van een internationale technologieorganisatie. items.desc: 💻 Job Title: Software Engineer (Agentic AI) 💰 Salary: up to ~€100k (flex for strong candidates) + up to 35% bonus (~20% standard, rest based on performance) 📈 Equity: very generous, early stage equity 📍 Location: Madrid (preferred) or Barcelona (1-2 office days) 🚀 Company : autonomous AI agents for enterprise clients 👥 Team : ~35 💸 Funding : ~$25m (Series A) About the company This rapidly scaling start-up is building an AI-native platform that lets enterprise clients run high-volume operations through autonomous, conversational agents — voice, chat and messaging, deployed across dozens of countries in over 60 languages, for some of the largest employers in the world. The company's core technical challenge is multi-agent orchestration that stays rock-solid at scale — reliable, secure and observable whether it's deployed for a healthcare provider in the US or a retailer in Latin America. Founded by an experienced team with two prior successful exits, backed by a top-tier European VC, and already trusted by household-name enterprise customers. About the role You'll build, operate and continuously improve the reliability of the agentic AI systems running in production for enterprise clients — focused on how agents behave, decide, fail, recover and scale under real operational load, not just on shipping new features. You'll own the observability and evaluation layer that keeps autonomous agents trustworthy at scale — tracing, logging, cost tracking across model calls, regression testing through prompt and model changes, and alerting on failures, hallucinations and degraded performance before customers ever see them. You'll also work end-to-end across the stack: production-grade async Python services, LLM/RAG pipelines, and the conversational voice layer where relevant — STT/TTS, telephony, real-time latency. ✅ Must have requirements (most of the below): Professional fluency in English (and ideally Spanish) Strong Python backend engineering — async programming, high-throughput/message-queue systems (Celery + Redis or equivalent), production-grade service design Solid LLM/RAG fundamentals — prompt engineering, chaining, caching strategies, vector databases, model selection trade-offs Experience building evaluation pipelines for non-deterministic systems — accuracy/consistency testing, regression testing across prompt and model changes, synthetic test data generation Production observability instincts — tracing, logging, metrics, alerting on failures and degraded performance, cost tracking and optimisation across model calls Comfortable debugging complex, multi-step, non-deterministic agent behaviour in live production systems Cloud deployment and containerisation experience (AWS/GCP, Docker) Git, testing, CI/CD, code review — clean, testable, well-documented code as standard practice Startup pace and mentality - high energy, ownership, proactiveness, hunger to innovate and succeed, comfortable operating with ambiguity 👍 Bonus points for: Conversational/voice AI experience — STT/TTS pipelines, turn-taking, telephony integration (e.g. Twilio), latency-sensitive real-time systems Frontend experience (ideally React) Experience building enterprise or B2B products Model fine-tuning or model-selection/cost-optimisation experience

items.desc: HFM is an internationally acclaimed multi-asset broker, delivering cutting-edge trading tools, platforms, and conditions to traders worldwide. We are committed to innovation, transparency, and excellence in the financial markets. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a driven and strategic Mid AI Engineer to join our team. Responsibilities: Build and ship internal AI services end to end — from the data pipeline through the model to the API other teams call — working within the team's established architecture. Develop asynchronous REST APIs and microservices in FastAPI, deployed on Kubernetes, to serve models and orchestrate agent tool calls. Implement retrieval pipelines over PostgreSQL and pgvector — chunking, embedding, indexing and retrieval tuning — and measure them against a held-out evaluation set. Build and maintain training pipelines covering data preparation, fine-tuning, evaluation and model registration, promoting a new model only when it measurably beats the one in production. Integrate agent tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoints, ensuring each tool enforces its own access controls rather than relying on the model to do so. Write the evaluation sets, structural output checks and drift monitoring that prove a model works before release and keep proving it afterwards. Instrument services with structured logging, Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing, so that failures can be diagnosed rather than guessed at. Review the work of junior engineers and trainees, pair with them on delivery, and contribute to the team's engineering and documentation standards. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of backend software development experience, including hands-on delivery of at least one machine learning or LLM application into production. Strong proficiency in Python and FastAPI, with solid working knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL. Practical experience with LLM application patterns — retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation of model quality. Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines, and comfort working in a containerised environment such as Kubernetes. Working knowledge of a major cloud platform, ideally AWS. A methodical approach to correctness: you write tests, you measure before and after, and you can explain how you know a change is an improvement. Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in English. A collaborative approach — comfortable learning from senior colleagues and supporting those with less experience. Nice to have: Experience running vector search in production (pgvector, OpenSearch, Qdrant or similar). Exposure to multi-agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex) or to the Model Context Protocol. Experience with model registries and deployment workflows (MLflow or equivalent), or with serving open-weight models (e.g., vLLM). Familiarity with analytical data stores such as ClickHouse, and with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Langfuse). Familiarity with FinTech platforms, FX trading, or financial services operations. Resumes must be submitted in English. Applicants must be eligible or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based. Benefits Hybrid Work Model (2 days working from home) Monthly Food Vouchers Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Summer Short Fridays (August) Additional Paid Annual Leave Birthday Leave Udemy Business access Referral Bonus Program Additional Support Visa Sponsorship and Relocation Assistance Sounds like you? Let’s write the next chapter together! All applications will be handled with the strictest confidentiality.

items.desc: Pourquoi rejoindre Keyrus aujourd'hui ? Keyrus est un groupe international de 2 800 consultants et experts présents dans 28 pays , porté par une conviction forte : ce n'est pas l'intelligence artificielle qui transforme les entreprises, mais l'intelligence conçue, structurée et intégrée à leur fonctionnement. Depuis plus de 30 ans, nous construisons les fondations data qui permettent aux systèmes intelligents de créer de la valeur. Nous concevons le système d'exploitation de l'entreprise intelligente, où la donnée, l'IA et l'expertise humaine s'intègrent au cœur des processus métiers pour générer une performance durable. Chez Keyrus, nous donnons vie à l'intelligence opérationnelle. L'intelligence artificielle ne remplace pas l'humain. Elle lui permet de se concentrer sur ce qu'aucun système ne peut reproduire : comprendre, décider, concevoir et innover. Rejoindre Keyrus, c'est construire son jugement, son expertise et sa capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes. La technologie est un accélérateur. La culture Keyrus fait la différence. L'excellence opérationnelle permet de relier les deux. AI Engineer L'AI Engineer construit, orchestre et déploie l'intelligence artificielle en production : briques d'IA générative (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.), modèles de machine learning, agents multi-étapes intégrés aux systèmes du client. C'est la colonne technique du dispositif Keyrus AI, garant que ce qui est déployé fonctionne, tient à l'échelle et reste maîtrisé en coût : chaque brique construite porte sa propre responsabilité FinOps, du prototype à la production. Il construit avec le Foundations Architect qui en définit l'architecture et le Data Engineer qui prépare la donnée, confie l'intégration applicative au Software Engineer, et travaille main dans la main avec le Forward Deployed Engineer au contact du client et le Business Value Advisor sur la valeur visée ; le Data Trust & AI Governance Manager encadre la gouvernance de ce qu'il déploie et le Service Delivery Manager en assure l'exploitation dans la durée. Ce qui vous attend Vous concevez et déployez des systèmes d'IA agentique de bout en bout : du modèle de langage (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.) capable de raisonner à l'agent autonome capable d'agir, en environnement de production réel, pas en prototype isolé. Vous architecturez des agents multi-étapes qui orchestrent outils, mémoire et prise de décision : vous ne branchez pas un modèle sur une API, vous structurez la manière dont l'IA agit dans le système d'information du client. Vous intégrez ce que vous construisez au sein des architectures du système client, en vous appuyant sur les connecteurs, API et protocoles disponibles (CRM, ERP, MCP, webhooks). Vous maîtrisez le coût des modèles (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.), des tokens et de l'inférence (FinOps IA), pour que la valeur créée tienne à l'échelle, pas seulement en démonstration. Vous documentez chaque agent que vous construisez (périmètre, capacités, limites, KPIs), pour qu'il reste exploitable au-delà de votre présence sur la mission. Vous itérez à partir des retours d'usage réels (pilotes, métriques), plutôt que de considérer un agent comme terminé dès son premier déploiement. Vous accompagnez la montée en compétences des équipes internes sur ces sujets, en posture de champion du changement. Ce que vous apportez Le socle Architect of Intelligence : des qualités indispensables, présentes dans les critères ci-dessous : curiosité, créativité, communication, conscience professionnelle, culture, capacité à faire. Expérience et parcours Une expérience de construction de briques d'IA générative (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.) ou agentique en production, pas seulement en prototype ou en atelier, quel que soit votre point de départ : ESN, éditeur, startup, ou client final. Une pratique de l'intégration système (API, CRM, ERP, webhooks, connecteurs) dans des environnements de production réels. Une trajectoire technique orientée vers l'autonomie croissante sur le déploiement de solutions IA, avec l'ambition d'évoluer aux côtés du Forward Deployed Engineer et du Foundations Architect. Posture et savoir-être Une rigueur d'ingénierie qui dépasse la validation en démonstration : vous pensez production, coût et maintenabilité dès la conception. Une curiosité pour le résultat métier produit par ce que vous construisez, pas seulement pour la technique elle-même. Une capacité à produire, documenter et transmettre ce que vous construisez, pour qu'un agent survive à votre départ de la mission. Une posture d'enablement : vous aimez faire monter les autres en compétence, pas seulement livrer seul. Compétences techniques indispensables Maîtrise d'un langage de prédilection pour l'IA : Python en priorité, Java ou Node.js/TypeScript en alternative selon l'écosystème du client. items.desc:
As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building some of the world's most extensive data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.
In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.
You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.
Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.
Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.
Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
Conceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost-benefit tradeoffs within systems Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights visually in a meaningful way Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts Influence product and cross-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedback
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent 7+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions 7+ years of experience with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala or others.) Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Master's or Ph.D degree in a STEM field Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 As the Global Expert Interior Design,you will play a key role in driving quality and consistency in the design of our global facilities. 
 Your key responsibilities include :
 Corporate Identity Stewardship: Ensuring all projects align with the "Our Spaces" guidelines and Roche Corporate Identity by liaising with local architects and acting as a global brand ambassador.
 Design Management: Overseeing the interior design scope for global interior workplace fit-outs (office and labs) from design phase through to realization.
 Consultant Selection: Assessing the capabilities of potential architectural and design consultants or contractors and seeking endorsement from the Head of Corporate Architecture.
 Project Collaboration: Supporting project managers regarding design timelines and resources, and reviewing phase deliverables for quality control and guideline alignment.
 Technical Advisory: Providing direction on global signage, corporate identity adherence, and local guidance according to global guidance and site Master Plans.
 Sustainability Leadership: Partnering with GCI scope areas and engineering organizations to drive the adoption of sustainable construction, decarbonization, and circularity.
 Strategic Alignment: Translating business needs into tangible project scopes while challenging user requirements to align with global workplace and laboratory strategy governance.
 Stakeholder Management: be able to clearly communicate across organizations and cultures about the value of corporate architecture and our approach.
 Who You Are
 We are looking for a passionate and courageous architect or interior designer, a leader who simplifies complex challenges to create inspiring environments. The ideal candidate meets the following criteria:
 Educational Background: A University-level Master’s Degree in Architecture or Interior Design with a deep understanding of design theory, history (from Bauhaus to contemporary), and aesthetics with a strength in conceptual design.
 Professional Experience: At least 10 years of international experience leading complex architectural projects, specifically within the life sciences sector (including research and laboratory design).
 Technical Proficiency: Strong computer skills, including a working knowledge of BIM, CAD, and project software, alongside experience with sustainable construction strategies.
 Leadership & Communication: A trusted team player with the ability to influence in a matrix organization, communicate across all levels and cultural backgrounds, to build lasting international relationships.
 Mindset & Versatility: A systematic thinker who is open to change, possesses a high sense of continuous improvement, and is willing to travel internationally up to 10%.
 Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!
 THERE IS A PREFERRED CANDIDATE
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 We are looking for a key player to transform our technological roadmaps into reality by identifying strategic public funding opportunities, building collaborative consortia, and securing public financing for our R&T projects in Spain.

 Funding Intelligence & Strategy: Actively monitor, analyze, and map European (e.g., Clean Aviation, Horizon Europe, EDF), National (e.g., CDTI, MINTUR, SEPIDES, Ministry of Defence/DGAM/PLATIN), and Regional funding landscapes to identify strategic financing opportunities for Airbus Helicopters España. 
 Capture & Bidding Management: Lead and drive the capture strategy and preparation of high-quality proposals for public funding, industrial investment, and procurement calls (including R&D grants, CAPEX/industrialization funds, and PPI), ensuring full alignment with our technology roadmaps.  Technology Alignment: Coordinate globally with AH R&T teams and the Engineering Centres of Competence (CoCs) to map their technological roadmaps and capabilities against available funding mechanisms. Communicate in an appropriate way to various internal stakeholders. 
 IP Protection: Under the guidance of the Head of IP, ensure that early-stage consortium agreements and proposal structures safeguard Airbus Helicopters' Intellectual Property rights.

 Experience: More than 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years directly dedicated to R&D public funding capture in high-tech, defense, or aerospace sectors.

 Network & Relationships: Extensive and pre-existing network within national and European funding bodies (specifically requiring established contacts within the Spanish Ministry of Defence, DGAM, and DIGEID/PLATIN, alongside other relevant entities like CDTI or MINTUR), as well as with key aerospace and defense sector companies in Spain and Europe.

Experience in collaborative R&D grants is essential. Knowledge of Public Procurement of Innovation processes (PPI) is a plus. 
 Mindset & Teamwork: Innovative mindset with a strong "team player" attitude, demonstrated capacity to work in cross-organizational contexts and influence heterogeneous teams. 
 Autonomy: Ability to drive complex capture campaigns and orchestrate multi-partner consortia autonomously .

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The role / impact
As an Internal AI Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be embedded at the frontier of how we scale - acting as a forward-deployed engineer across our GTM, Operations, and Finance teams. You won't just build tools; you'll co-design and ship agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people operate.

Your impact goes beyond the code. You'll own high-stakes automations from discovery to production, acting as a technical partner to internal teams. The patterns, guardrails, and tooling you define will become the blueprint other teams reach for - the standard for how ElevenLabs harnesses AI safely and at speed.

The team / how we work
You'll join a lean, high-velocity team with a shared obsession: turning broken, manual processes into elegant automated systems. We move fast through rapid experimentation, work closely with operators and business owners to uncover the real problem, and ship pragmatic solutions without waiting for perfect specs.

What you'll actually be working on

 - Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like ElevenAgents, Claude, and n8n.

 - Integrating AI systems with our core business stack - Salesforce, Slack, Ashby, and more

 - Building reusable automation services, patterns and shared templates that multiply the output of every team you touch

 - Owning experiments end-to-end: spotting the opportunity, building the solution, and measuring the impact

 - Developing evaluation and monitoring frameworks so our AI-native workflows are reliable, auditable, and safe
   
   
   What we're looking for

 - Proven experience building and shipping automations or applications in production - you know what it takes to go from fuzzy business pain to something real teams depend on

 - AI-First Instincts: Strong familiarity with LLM capabilities, prompting strategies, RAG patterns, and a genuine passion for building agentic workflows.

 - Deep Backend Expertise : Strong Python and SQL and system design patterns (APIs, webhooks, orchestration layers)

 - A systems-thinking mindset : you design with security, auditability, and blast radius in mind from the start

 - Builder and AI-First instincts: you don't wait to be told what to build - you spot the pattern, propose the fix, and ship it.

items.desc: Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family. We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people. To support our customer, we are looking for a: UX/UI Designer TASKS: Translate business and user requirements into intuitive, user-friendly UI solutions aligned with business goals. Analyze user journeys and user behavior using UX research methods and analytics to improve the overall experience. Design responsive interfaces for web, mobile, and tablet applications, defining information architecture, navigation, interactions, and visual design. Create wireframes, mock-ups, prototypes, and graphical assets to validate concepts and support product development. Maintain and evolve design systems, ensuring consistency, scalability, and alignment across digital products. Plan and conduct usability testing, heuristic reviews, and user evaluations, providing actionable recommendations for improvement. Collaborate with UX Analysts, Accessibility Experts, developers, and cross-functional teams throughout the design lifecycle, from discovery to implementation. Prepare developer handoff documentation and support testing activities to ensure accurate and compliant implementation. Promote and apply design system standards, UI patterns, and best practices to deliver a cohesive user experience across all platforms. REQUIREMENTS: 3+ years of experience in UX/UI design , applying user-centered design principles, methodologies, and UX best practices across digital products and services. Proven experience with wireframing, interactive prototyping, and design tools such as Figma, Balsamiq, InVision, UxPin, Framer.js, or similar. Experience in defining target audiences, personas, user journeys, and user stories , and in developing usability testing plans to support user-centered design activities. Hands-on experience conducting and analyzing user testing throughout the entire digital solution lifecycle , using a variety of testing techniques and validation methods. Strong knowledge of usability, accessibility, responsive design, web ergonomics, and WCAG standards , ensuring intuitive and inclusive user experiences. Good understanding of core web technologies (HTML5, CSS3), cross-browser compatibility, SEO principles, data protection, and security requirements. Experience working in Agile development environments , collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams. Knowledge of visual and interaction design principles , including typography, graphical design, design systems, component libraries, and tools such as Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. Experience with collaborative platforms such as Atlassian Confluence, including configuration, customization, and knowledge management practices. Experience with Case and Document Management solutions , including workflow design, process optimization, document handling, and case lifecycle management, as well as exposure to Competition-related environments. CERTIFICATES: (Optional) A certification such as UXQB Certified Professional for Usability and User Experience - Foundation (CPUX-F), Nielsen Norman Group (NN/g) UX Certification, or Google UX Design Certificate. SKILLS: Capability to work in an international/multicultural environment, including participation in multi-lingual meetings. Talent for generating bold, user-centered concepts and capacity to articulate and defend design decisions with evidence (research insights, usability findings, analytics). Proficiency in adapting to and mastering fast-evolving design and prototyping tools and industry trends. Strong interpersonal communication skills in English and/or French. Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously. Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering. Language knowledge: English B2+, French B2+. Office: Bruxelles, Belgium. Near-site service provision with regular on-site presence of 2 day per week unless agreed …

Acting as both a trusted advisor and problem solver, you will ensure customers achieve compliance, speed, and performance using Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions while helping shape our future innovations through Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback. Experience with common chromatography skids at lab, pilot and manufacturing scale and the ability to operate and interpret data from commonly used chromatography software programmes Hands-on experience of small, pilot and manufacturing scale column packing Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Deep understanding of bioprocessing workflows. Skilled in process design, optimization, and workflow consulting, using data-driven analysis to identify improvements. Familiarity with PAT tools , DoE, and QbD principles (ICH Q8/9/10). Knowledge of analytics used to support purifications processes, including HPLC, ELISA, SDS-PAGE and Spectroscopy and ability to interpret such data sets Proficient in data analysis tools (Excel, JMP; scripting a plus) and technical writing. Strong communication, problem-solving, and influencing skills; effective in multi-functional collaboration. Experience using Salesforce.com (SFDC CRM) for opportunity and activity tracking. items.desc: The role Aniah develops OneCheck , a transistor-level electrical rule checker for analog, mixed-signal and digital designs. OneCheck analyzes the full-chip netlist without stimuli or simulation and detects ESD, power-domain, floating-node, level-shifting, leakage and reliability errors. It is deployed at most Tier-1 semiconductor companies. As an Application Engineer, you drive OneCheck adoption at customers and you develop the checks that extend its coverage. Part of the AE team, you work day to day with customers and R&D: the role requires both technical depth and effective communication skills. Responsibilities Check development: code electrical rules from customers or the literature as checks on OneCheck’s analysis engine — specification, implementation, validation on test circuits, integration. You write the code and owns the quality, with AI as part of the workflow. Quality of results: ensure every real error is reported with minimal noise, and that setup and results are natural to a designer. Pre- and post-sales support: lead demonstrations, benchmarks and evaluations on customer designs; drive deployment into production; resolve technical issues, onsite when required. Product feedback: deliver structured feedback from the field to R&D and influence the roadmap. AI workflows: author agent workflows on OneCheck’s MCP interface, starting with automated review of ERC results, and define what the engine exposes next. Foster AI usage in analog design with our customers. Requirements MSc in Electrical Engineering or equivalent. Typically 3–5 years of analog or mixed-signal IC design on production circuits; ability outweighs seniority. Solid command of ESD, power domains, level shifters, interfaces and reliability . Hands-on Virtuoso-type flow and SPICE simulation experience. Strong appetite for code , in both algorithmic understanding and execution (Python, SKILL, JavaScript or equivalent). Checks are written in JavaScript, which can be learned on the job. Linux/Unix proficiency. Fluent English, working French; able to engage senior designers, CAD teams and R&D. Preferred Experience with Calibre PERC, DRC/LVS or parasitic extraction. Exposure to customer support or EDA environments. About Aniah Fifteen people in Grenoble and Taiwan, across algorithm research, analog design and EDA. Founded in 2019; new funding round in 2026 to expand internationally and extend OneCheck from ERC to combined electrical and physical verification. Acsiel Startup of the Year 2023, i-Venture Tech&Fest 2025, IC Taiwan Grand Challenge 2026, AI Best Award Taiwan 2026. Practical Grenoble, next to the train station Up to 2 days/week remote International travel for customer engagements (France, US, Taiwan) Salary based on experience Job Type: Full-time Pay: 45,000.00€ - 60,000.00€ per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Grenoble (38)

Mango 3D édite les logiciels de référence de l'impression 3D résine, utilisés par une large communauté internationale. Lychee Slicer - le slicer résine (application desktop), notre socle. Objectif : le meilleur slicer résine du monde. Lychee Library - la plateforme web de modèles 3D et de créateurs, notre prochain moteur de croissance. Lychee Studio - l'IA générative 3D pour que nos clients produisent les modèles de leurs cas d'usage, un chantier à construire. 4 M€ de chiffre d'affaires aujourd'hui, 40 M€ visés d'ici 5 ans maximum. La satisfaction de nos clients est au coeur de tout ce que nous faisons, et nous devenons une entreprise AI native. Pourquoi maintenant ? Le fondateur porte aujourd'hui la direction produit et la direction technique. Nous cherchons la personne qui prendra la tech en main, composera l'équipe qui fera le x10 et installera une façon de produire nativement pilotée par l'IA. Votre mission : Vous dirigez la tech de Mango 3D et la transformez en machine à vélocité. Vous ne codez plus : vous faites produire le code par des agents multiples et par une équipe d'opérationnels de haut niveau que vous savez repérer, valoriser et outiller; vous gardez la maîtrise de ce qui part en production. Périmètre : toute la tech - Slicer (desktop), Library (web), Studio (IA), infrastructure. Pouvoir : vous composez l'équipe, choisissez les outils et l'organisation, arbitrez la dette technique. Rattachement : le Président, fondateur et CPO. Membres du Codir. Vos 12 premiers mois À 3 mois : vous avez posé un diagnostic de l’équipe et évalué l’appétence de chacun pour l’IA. Un tableau de bord de vélocité est en place, ainsi qu’un plan d’action sur les 3 sujets qui fonctionnent le moins bien. À 6 mois : toute l’équipe produit avec des agents, et le délai entre un ticket et sa mise en production a été divisé par 2. À 12 mois : l’équipe cible est en place et la satisfaction client sur Lychee Slicer se maintient à 4/5 ou plus. La feuille de route technique de l’IA générative 3D est validée, et ses premiers résultats sont en production. Indicateurs suivis : délai entre ticket et production, fréquence de livraison, part du code produite par des agents, taux d’échec et de crash, satisfaction client. Vous êtes : Un leader tech confirmé (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering) qui sait repérer les meilleurs opérationnels, s'appuyer massivement sur eux et choisir son équipe selon son appétence pour l'IA. Un praticien de l'IA qui produit déjà avec des agents multiples, au quotidien, et sait le prouver en direct. Un obsédé de la vélocité , pragmatique : vous partez de ce qui marche, réparez ce qui ne marche pas et ne réinventez pas la roue. Anglais courant indispensable : notre communauté est internationale. Ce qui fera la différence : Une expérience en 3D : jeu vidéo, modélisation, CAO, géométrie, impression 3D. Une compréhension concrète de l'entraînement de modèles : vous avez déjà fine-tuné un modèle open source sur une tâche précise, ou piloté une équipe qui l'a fait. Une expérience de scale-up en forte croissance. Ce poste n'est pas pour vous si : Vous voulez rester le meilleur codeur de l'équipe. Vous voulez tout réécrire avant de livrer. Vous pilotez au ressenti, sans métriques. Vous utilisez l'IA comme une autocomplétion. Ce que nous offrons : Intéressement au capital en fonction de la performance : vous participez directement au x10. Rémunération selon profil à partir 120k brut annuel Lieu : bureaux à Bordeaux centre, sur place au moins 3 jours par semaine (télétravail 2 jours maximum). Impact : une entreprise de taille humaine, un poste au Codir, une équipe à construire. Processus : Échange avec le fondateur. Cas pratique : diagnostic d'un chantier tech réel et démonstration en direct de votre façon de produire avec des agents. Rencontre avec l'équipe tech et le Codir. Échange en anglais. Références. Rémunération : à partir de 120 000,00€ par an Avantages : Travail à domicile occasionnel Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (33000 Bordeaux)

items.desc: #StormYourCareer ? Rejoins STORM GROUP et construis ta carrière avec nous ! Fortifie les architectures génératives et sécurise les systèmes agentiquesDans le cadre du déploiement à grande échelle de ses solutions d?IA générative, l?un de nos partenaires stratégiques recherche un(e) AI Security Engineer / Architecte Sécurité IA. Ton rôle sera hautement critique et novateur : tu concevras et déploieras l?ensemble des dispositifs de sécurité visant à prémunir les applications basées sur les LLMs et les systèmes agentiques contre les nouvelles cybermenaces, tout en diffusant une culture Security by Design auprès des équipes de delivery. Ton futur environnementTu évolueras au sein d?un pôle technologique d?excellence, au carrefour de l?ingénierie en cybersécurité et de l?intelligence artificielle de pointe. En prise directe avec les architectes cloud, les équipes DevSecOps et les data scientists, tu interviendras sur des cas d?usage novateurs exploitant des modèles de fondation et des architectures complexes de type RAG. C?est le cadre de travail idéal pour valoriser ton expertise sur les nouveaux référentiels de sécurité IA, manipuler des frameworks de guardrails émergents et faire de la sécurité un accélérateur d?innovation pour le groupe. Tes missions clésArchitecture de Sécurité & Protection des Systèmes IA (Mode BUILD) : Définir l?architecture de sécurité globale des solutions IA : segmentation des réseaux, contrôle et chiffrement des flux, isolation stricte des environnements d?inférence. Concevoir et implémenter des garde-fous robustes (guardrails) pour assurer le filtrage des entrées/sorties, la détection des prompts malveillants (prompt injection, jailbreak) et le contrôle de conformité des contenus générés. Sécuriser les architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) en garantissant le cloisonnement des données par profil d?utilisateur et la gestion des contrôles d?accès aux bases documentaires vectorielles. Sécuriser les systèmes agentiques : encadrement strict du périmètre d?action des agents, contrôle des appels d?outils (function calling) et implémentation de boucles de validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) pour les actions sensibles. Structurer la gestion des identités, des accès (IAM), des secrets et des habilitations au sein de l?ensemble de la chaîne de traitement IA. Gouvernance, DevSecOps & Security by Design (Mode RUN & Conseil) : Définir et maintenir le référentiel des exigences de sécurité applicables à l?ensemble des projets IA du groupe. Accompagner les équipes de développement dans une démarche proactive de Security by Design et intégrer les contrôles de sécurité IA dans les pipelines CI/CD. Piloter et réaliser les revues de sécurité ainsi que les analyses de risques sur les nouveaux cas d?usage avant leur mise en production. Assurer une veille prospective permanente sur les nouvelles vulnérabilités et techniques d?attaque ciblant les LLMs. Ton profilFormation : Diplôme d?Ingénieur ou Bac+5 spécialisé en cybersécurité, informatique ou systèmes d?information. Expérience : Tu justifies d?une expérience confirmée en sécurité applicative ou en architecture de sécurité, avec une pratique concrète et démontrable de la sécurisation des systèmes à base de LLM. Expertise Cybersécurité & IA Impérative : Parfaite maîtrise des référentiels de sécurité dédiés à l?IA : OWASP Top 10 for LLM, NIST AI RMF. Compréhension approfondie des architectures GenAI (RAG, agents autonomes, function calling) et de leurs surfaces d?attaque spécifiques. Connaissance pratique des frameworks de modération et de guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard ou gateways LLM). Expérience solide de la gestion des identités et des secrets (Vault, IAM). Compétences Cloud & DevSecOps : Maîtrise de la sécurisation des environnements Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Notions solides en intégration DevSecOps et maîtrise du langage Python. Langues : Anglais professionnel opérationnel. Tes atoutsPosture de Facilitateur : Capacité à dialoguer avec les développeurs et data scientists pour positionner la sécurité comme un levier d?accélération plutôt que comme un point de blocage. Rigueur et Esprit d?Analyse : Grande précision méthodologique pour cartographier les risques émergents sur des technologies en constante évolution. Pédagogie et Communication : Aisance relationnelle pour vulgariser les risques cyber liés à l?IA auprès de décideurs techniques et métiers. Nos avantagesRemboursement des titres de transport à hauteur de 75%. Tickets restaurant pris en charge par STORM GROUP à hauteur de 50% (10,5? / jour). Accès Gymlib / Wellpass (sport et bien-être). Contrat Santé / Prévoyance mis en place auprès de la compagnie Alan. Formation continue : Accès à Udemy Business. Prime de cooptation, prime d?intéressement et de participation. Deux à trois jours de télétravail par semaine. 5 raisons de nous rejoindreParcours sur mesure : Co-construis une trajectoire professionnelle unique, adaptée à tes ambitions. Missions Stratégiques : Interviens …

 Afin de renforcer notre équipe Data, nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Data Snowflake passionné(e) et expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe de professionnels dévoués à l'architecture et à l'optimisation des données. Vos missions Vous rejoindrez une équipe jeune et dynamique, curieuse et toujours à l'affût d'occasions pour acquérir ou partager de nouvelles connaissances autour de la Data. Vous participerez à un nombre varié d'activités, allant du conseil en architecture et gouvernance de la donnée, aux aspects Data Analytique et Data Science, en passant par la mise en place, l’intégration, le développement et l’optimisation de solutions souples et évolutives pour les projets stratégiques de nos clients. Dans le cadre du poste proposé, vous intégrerez notre communauté d’architectes et vous aurez pour principales missions : Concevoir des architectures de données sur Snowflake, adaptées aux besoins stratégiques des clients et optimisées pour les performances, la scalabilité et la sécurité. Prendre en charge l’encadrement technique des projets dans la mise en œuvre de solutions BI et Data Analytics sur Snowflake, en intégrant les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance des données. Encadrer et mener des ateliers avec l’ensemble des intervenants et construire la solution la plus adaptée, Encadrer une équipe et la faire monter en compétences, Être le/la référent(e) technique en support de l'équipe et l'interlocuteur privilégié de toutes les parties prenantes Contribuer au développement de notre offre Data, en réponse aux enjeux de nos clients Participer activement aux phases de pré-vente, en apportant votre expertise pour des propositions techniques et commerciales convaincantes. Participer à la veille technologique sur la Data, partager et transmettre ses connaissances plus largement au sein de notre communauté Data Expérimenter et développer des solutions et approches innovantes dans le cadre de notre DataLab, laboratoire d’innovation local. Effectuer une veille technologique, en restant à l'affût des nouvelles fonctionnalités et tendances liées à Snowflake et à l'architecture des données en général. 

 Qui êtes-vous ? Vous disposez d'un Bac+5 en informatique (ou équivalent) et avez une expérience de plus de 5 ans dans l’architecture de données, avec une spécialisation en Snowflake. Vous avez une expertise approfondie dans la conception et l'optimisation de solutions sur Snowflake, ainsi que dans l'intégration de données provenant de sources multiples. Vous maîtrisez les environnements Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) et possédez une solide expérience avec les technologies de Data Engineering et de Data Warehouse. Vous avez une forte capacité à résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes et à fournir des solutions innovantes. Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux(se), avec un excellent esprit d’équipe et une aptitude à interagir avec divers interlocuteurs (internes et clients). Vous avez un bon niveau d'anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, pour évoluer dans un environnement international. La maîtrise de l’anglais vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets dans un contexte international. Si la technique est au cœur de vos préoccupations et que vous êtes passionné(e) par la gestion des données métiers, leur transformation et leur mise en valeur, n’hésitez plus !
