People who want to take their careers to the next level of success. You will be part of a global and diverse team, contribute to all stages of software development lifecycle and lead the implementation, deployment and test of multi-agent systems. Also, This Role Will Give You The Chance To Use frameworks like Google Agent Development Kit (Google ADK) and LangGraph to build robust, controllable, and observable agentic architectures Assist in the design of LLM-powered agents and multi-agent workflows (planning, tool use, orchestration, memory, and human-in-the-loop) So if you are an experienced AI Engineer please join our team to create the next big thing in digital banking. What You’ll Be Doing Design and build complex agentic systems with multiple interacting agents Implement robust orchestration logic (state machines / graphs, retries, fallbacks, escalation to humans) Implement RAG pipelines, tool calling, and sophisticated system prompts for optimal reliability, latency, and cost control Apply core ML concepts to evaluate and improve agent performance, including dataset curation and bias/safety checks Lead the development of agents using Google ADK and/or LangGraph, leveraging advanced features for orchestration, memory, evaluation, and observability Integrate with supporting libraries and infrastructure (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector databases, message queues, monitoring tools) with minimal supervision Define success metrics, build evaluation suites for agents (automatic + human evaluation), and drive continuous improvement Curate and maintain comprehensive prompt/test datasets; run regression tests for new model versions and prompt changes Deploy and operate AI services in production, establishing CI/CD pipelines, observability, logging, and tracing Debug complex failures end-to-end, identifying and document root causes across models, prompts, APIs, tools, and data Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to shape requirements, translate them into agent capabilities, and manage expectations Document comprehensive designs, decisions, and runbooks for complex systems What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field At least 3 years of experience as Software Engineer / ML Engineer / AI Engineer, with at least 1-2 years working directly with LLMs in real applications Strong proficiency in Python (core language features, packaging, testing, async, type hints) Very strong software engineering practices: version control (Git), unit/integration testing, code reviews, CI/CD Experience building and consuming REST/gRPC APIs and integrating external tools/services Understanding of core ML concepts: supervised/unsupervised learning, train/validation/test splits, overfitting, regularization, and common metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, etc.) models Tokenization, context windows, temperature, top-p, system vs user prompts Prompt engineering patterns (ReAct, chain-of-thought, tool-calling/tool-use) Fine-tuning / adapters / instruction-tuning, or experience with RAG as an alternative Experience building LLM-powered applications end-to-end: from idea → prototype → production Familiarity with safety and reliability considerations: hallucinations, guardrails, content filtering, privacy Conceptual understanding of modern agentic frameworks and patterns (stateful graphs, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop, memory, and evaluation). Collaborate on architecture and technical design: You will work closely with architects and technical stakeholders to shape application architecture, evaluate technologies and define secure, scalable and maintainable solutions aligned with business and technical requirements. Build and integrate backend services: You will develop and integrate REST APIs, asynchronous workflows, event-driven services, databases and cloud storage, ensuring reliable connectivity between AI solutions and enterprise systems. Deliver and operate cloud-native solutions: You will deploy and maintain applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure AI services and cloud-native capabilities while ensuring performance, scalability and operational reliability. Drive engineering quality and secure development: You will apply software engineering best practices, support automated testing, code reviews and secure coding principles, while implementing appropriate identity and access management, secrets handling and monitoring. Automate software delivery through DevOps: You will contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployments, and infrastructure automation. You will also create, refine and manage user stories, tasks and bugs in Azure DevOps, ensuring clear requirements, acceptance criteria and delivery traceability. Evaluate and continuously improve AI solutions: You will assess AI application quality, retrieval relevance, response accuracy, performance and cost, while contributing to prompt and model versioning, AI observability, security safeguards and responsible AI practices. Collaborate in an Agile, cross-functional environment: You will work with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users using Kanban and continuous feedback to prioritize work, manage workflow, clarify requirements, challenge assumptions constructively and deliver measurable business value. Essential Requirements For The Position Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Strong professional experience developing production software with Python, including API development, asynchronous processing, testing and dependency management. Good knowledge of software engineering principles, object-oriented and modular design, clean code, design patterns, DevOps and Git workflows, automated testing and code review. Hands-on experience with cloud application development and deployment on Microsoft Azure. Hands-on experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD, containers and automated deployment. Experience integrating REST APIs, event-driven services, relational or NoSQL databases and cloud storage. Understanding of application security, identity and access management, secrets handling, secure coding, monitoring and operational support. Practical experience building solutions that use LLM APIs, RAG, vector search or AI agents is mandatory. Experience with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Semantic Kernel, LangChain or comparable platforms and frameworks is a strong advantage. Experience with frontend development using React is an advantage, but the role is primarily focused on Python and backend engineering. Experience with MLOps, model evaluation, prompt/version management, AI observability or responsible AI controls is an advantage. Ability to understand business processes, challenge assumptions constructively and translate ambiguous needs into practical technical solutions. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across technical and non-technical teams. Professional proficiency in English. items.desc: Chi siamo E se il tuo prossimo progetto iniziasse proprio qui? ACENSI, gruppo europeo di consulenza nella trasformazione digitale, accompagna aziende di primo piano in diversi settori come banca, assicurazioni, energia e telecomunicazioni. Con oltre 2.200 talenti in Francia e a livello internazionale (Canada, Belgio,Portogallo, Romania, Mauritius, Singapore), ACENSI progetta e realizza soluzioni digitali che trasformano in modo duraturo le organizzazioni dal 2003. Guidata dall’innovazione e dall’expertise, ACENSI pone l’intelligenza artificiale al centro della propria visione. Oggi, compiamo un nuovo passo nella nostra crescita entrando nel mercato italiano. Siamo alla ricerca di un/una AI Software Engineer da inserire nel nostro team di Milano , con un forte orientamento al cliente e alla realizzazione di soluzioni innovative basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa e Agentica. La persona ideale ha esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni AI in ambiente di produzione e una solida conoscenza delle architetture agentiche, dei Large Language Models e delle tecnologie di orchestrazione. Responsabilità principali Progettare e sviluppare architetture e applicazioni basate su AI Generativa e Agentica in ambiente di produzione. Sviluppare applicazioni full-stack e realizzare integrazioni tramite API. Progettare e implementare soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM) e architetture multi-agent . Sviluppare e integrare pipeline RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) . Progettare e gestire l’orchestrazione di agenti e workflow utilizzando LangChain e LangGraph . Sviluppare e configurare MCP driver utilizzando il Model Context Protocol (MCP) . Integrare soluzioni AI con infrastrutture e tecnologie cloud, container e sistemi distribuiti. Collaborare con i clienti e con i team tecnici per comprendere le esigenze e trasformarle in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete. Contribuire alla definizione delle migliori pratiche di sviluppo, deployment e gestione delle applicazioni AI. Requisiti Almeno 2 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni basate su AI Generativa e Agentica in ambiente di produzione. Esperienza full-stack e nell’integrazione tramite API . Solida conoscenza di Agentic AI, LLM, architetture multi-agent e RAG . Esperienza con LangChain, LangGraph e MCP (Model Context Protocol) . Buona conoscenza di Python o C#/.NET Core . Conoscenza di Vertex AI, Google ADK e KAgent . Familiarità con SQL/NoSQL e tecnologie cloud/infrastrutturali come Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, Kafka, Elasticsearch e Git . Ottime capacità di problem solving , lavoro in team e orientamento al cliente. Inglese professionale . Dove 📍 Milano, Italia RAL indicativa : €35.000 – €45.000 Pronto/a a guidare l’innovazione Data & IA presso ACENSI Italia? Unisciti a noi e lascia il tuo segno!

items.desc: Who We Are Based in The Romania Excellence Centre, Bucharest - our client is seeking for experienced professionals who value teamwork, pioneering technology, and innovation. People who want to take their careers to the next level of success. You will be part of a global and diverse team, contribute to all stages of software development lifecycle and lead the implementation, deployment and test of multi-agent systems. Also, This Role Will Give You The Chance To Use frameworks like Google Agent Development Kit (Google ADK) and LangGraph to build robust, controllable, and observable agentic architectures Assist in the design of LLM-powered agents and multi-agent workflows (planning, tool use, orchestration, memory, and human-in-the-loop) So if you are an experienced AI Engineer please join our team to create the next big thing in digital banking. What You’ll Be Doing Design and build complex agentic systems with multiple interacting agents Implement robust orchestration logic (state machines / graphs, retries, fallbacks, escalation to humans) Implement RAG pipelines, tool calling, and sophisticated system prompts for optimal reliability, latency, and cost control Apply core ML concepts to evaluate and improve agent performance, including dataset curation and bias/safety checks Lead the development of agents using Google ADK and/or LangGraph, leveraging advanced features for orchestration, memory, evaluation, and observability Integrate with supporting libraries and infrastructure (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector databases, message queues, monitoring tools) with minimal supervision Define success metrics, build evaluation suites for agents (automatic + human evaluation), and drive continuous improvement Curate and maintain comprehensive prompt/test datasets; run regression tests for new model versions and prompt changes Deploy and operate AI services in production, establishing CI/CD pipelines, observability, logging, and tracing Debug complex failures end-to-end, identifying and document root causes across models, prompts, APIs, tools, and data Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to shape requirements, translate them into agent capabilities, and manage expectations Document comprehensive designs, decisions, and runbooks for complex systems What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field At least 3 years of experience as Software Engineer / ML Engineer / AI Engineer, with at least 1-2 years working directly with LLMs in real applications Strong proficiency in Python (core language features, packaging, testing, async, type hints) Very strong software engineering practices: version control (Git), unit/integration testing, code reviews, CI/CD Experience building and consuming REST/gRPC APIs and integrating external tools/services Understanding of core ML concepts: supervised/unsupervised learning, train/validation/test splits, overfitting, regularization, and common metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, etc.) Good understanding of deep learning basics (neural networks, embeddings) and at least one ML/DL framework (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit-learn) Deep practical knowledge of large language models Tokenization, context windows, temperature, top-p, system vs user prompts Prompt engineering patterns (ReAct, chain-of-thought, tool-calling/tool-use) Fine-tuning / adapters / instruction-tuning, or experience with RAG as an alternative Experience building LLM-powered applications end-to-end: from idea → prototype → production Familiarity with safety and reliability considerations: hallucinations, guardrails, content filtering, privacy Conceptual understanding of modern agentic frameworks and patterns (stateful graphs, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop, memory, and evaluation). Hands-on experience with at least one of: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) – building multi-agent workflows, using its orchestration, tools, and evaluation features or LangGraph – designing graph-based, stateful agent workflows with cycles, branches, and durable execution Candidates must be able to read, reason about, and extend ADK/LangGraph-based codebases Direct production experience with both ADK and LangGraph is a strong plus Experience working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Chroma) for retrieval-augmented generation Comfortable with SQL and basic data modeling Experience deploying on at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, Azure) and using managed services (e.g., serverless runtimes, container orchestration, secrets management) Nice-to-Have Experience With Vertex AI / Gemini or other hosted LLM ecosystems Related frameworks and tools: LangChain, LlamaIndex, semantic search, evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, custom eval harnesses) Monitoring and observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana/NewRelic, Datadog, etc.)

items.desc: Who We Are Based in The Romania Excellence Centre, Bucharest - our client is seeking for experienced professionals who value teamwork, pioneering technology, and innovation. People who want to take their careers to the next level of success. You will be part of a global and diverse team, contribute to all stages of software development lifecycle and lead the implementation, deployment and test of multi-agent systems. Also, This Role Will Give You The Chance To Use frameworks like Google Agent Development Kit (Google ADK) and LangGraph to build robust, controllable, and observable agentic architectures Assist in the design of LLM-powered agents and multi-agent workflows (planning, tool use, orchestration, memory, and human-in-the-loop) So if you are an experienced AI Engineer please join our team to create the next big thing in digital banking. What You’ll Be Doing Design and build complex agentic systems with multiple interacting agents Implement robust orchestration logic (state machines / graphs, retries, fallbacks, escalation to humans) Implement RAG pipelines, tool calling, and sophisticated system prompts for optimal reliability, latency, and cost control Apply core ML concepts to evaluate and improve agent performance, including dataset curation and bias/safety checks Lead the development of agents using Google ADK and/or LangGraph, leveraging advanced features for orchestration, memory, evaluation, and observability Integrate with supporting libraries and infrastructure (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector databases, message queues, monitoring tools) with minimal supervision Define success metrics, build evaluation suites for agents (automatic + human evaluation), and drive continuous improvement Curate and maintain comprehensive prompt/test datasets; run regression tests for new model versions and prompt changes Deploy and operate AI services in production, establishing CI/CD pipelines, observability, logging, and tracing Debug complex failures end-to-end, identifying and document root causes across models, prompts, APIs, tools, and data Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to shape requirements, translate them into agent capabilities, and manage expectations Document comprehensive designs, decisions, and runbooks for complex systems What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field At least 3 years of experience as Software Engineer / ML Engineer / AI Engineer, with at least 1-2 years working directly with LLMs in real applications Strong proficiency in Python (core language features, packaging, testing, async, type hints) Very strong software engineering practices: version control (Git), unit/integration testing, code reviews, CI/CD Experience building and consuming REST/gRPC APIs and integrating external tools/services Understanding of core ML concepts: supervised/unsupervised learning, train/validation/test splits, overfitting, regularization, and common metrics (precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, etc.) Good understanding of deep learning basics (neural networks, embeddings) and at least one ML/DL framework (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit-learn) Deep practical knowledge of large language models Tokenization, context windows, temperature, top-p, system vs user prompts Prompt engineering patterns (ReAct, chain-of-thought, tool-calling/tool-use) Fine-tuning / adapters / instruction-tuning, or experience with RAG as an alternative Experience building LLM-powered applications end-to-end: from idea → prototype → production Familiarity with safety and reliability considerations: hallucinations, guardrails, content filtering, privacy Conceptual understanding of modern agentic frameworks and patterns (stateful graphs, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop, memory, and evaluation). Hands-on experience with at least one of: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) – building multi-agent workflows, using its orchestration, tools, and evaluation features or LangGraph – designing graph-based, stateful agent workflows with cycles, branches, and durable execution Candidates must be able to read, reason about, and extend ADK/LangGraph-based codebases Direct production experience with both ADK and LangGraph is a strong plus Experience working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Chroma) for retrieval-augmented generation Comfortable with SQL and basic data modeling Experience deploying on at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, Azure) and using managed services (e.g., serverless runtimes, container orchestration, secrets management) Nice-to-Have Experience With Vertex AI / Gemini or other hosted LLM ecosystems Related frameworks and tools: LangChain, LlamaIndex, semantic search, evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, custom eval harnesses) Monitoring and observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana/NewRelic, Datadog, etc.)

items.desc: AI & Tech Breadcrumb Home > Applied AI Engineer Applied AI Engineer 38 Rue du Sentier, 75002 Paris, France I'm interested Share this job Company Description Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes. Sia’s AI & Data Business Unit is the powerhouse of our firm’s innovation—merging cutting-edge Data Science, Generative AI, and advanced digital solutions to transform industries. With over 350 experts worldwide, we tackle projects from proof-of-concept to large-scale deployment, always pushing the boundaries of AI capabilities. Our 12 R&D labs in Europe and North America drive continuous research in areas like computer vision, MLOps, and deep learning, partnering closely with our business consultants for real-world impact. By joining Sia’s AI & Data team, you’ll step into a vibrant, collaborative environment that nurtures professional growth and empowers you to shape the future of AI-driven consulting. Job Description We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to join our team where you will harness model capabilities to implement cutting-edge algorithms and solutions across myriad industries. You will serve as a pivotal link between Data Scientists, ML and Platform Engineers to unleash the potential of Generative AI technology by implementing business-centric solutions. You will help customers find the appropriate level of refinement among semantic search, RAG, agents, and ultimately fine-tuning to reach their value delivery threshold in the most cost-effective way. Beyond crafting prompts, you will be responsible for designing and building robust and scalable products starting with benchmarks of candidate FMs through targeted requests, rapidly iterating prototypes, and validating product ideas. Your expertise in orchestrating the entire AI workflow will ensure the seamless integration of advanced models' capabilities into applications, optimizing performance, security, compliance, scalability, and efficiency. You will competently navigate between prompts, chains, and agents while mastering the underlying infrastructure challenges. Your role will involve research, design, implementation and optimization of AI systems. You will need to master both: the model stack (FM, VLM, SLM) from both private and open foundational models like GPT-x, Claude, Gemini to smaller edge models like Ministral or Arcee AI to deliver cost-effective solutions to business users. the landscape of AI application frameworks using chaining, retrieval, autonomous agents, and vector search tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, pgvector). We invest in your success through comprehensive training, combining internal programs with resources from our technology partners. Join us if you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI technology and making a significant impact in enabling our customers to create GenAI-powered applications with confidence and a fast time to market. Responsibilities You are part of a cross-functional consulting team that drives the adoption of Generative AI in every imaginable sector, working step-by-step with customers to understand business requirements to design then build bespoke GenAI solutions. Assist the GenAI Solution Architect in application design. Develop applications powered by GenAI models, both self-managed and API-accessible that meet business needs and comply with applicable regulations (GDPR, EU AI Act, Model licenses, etc.) Design effective prompts, continuously balancing simplicity and complexity, to enhance models’. analytical capabilities, refine outputs, improve user experience, and increase control over business users' interactions with the models. Optimize model output accuracy with RAG techniques to retrieve relevant information from pre-determined knowledge sources and gain insights into how the model generates the response (including source attribution). Select and fine-tune the right models to create higher-quality multimodal content (images, text, audio, video, etc.) and raise the value creation opportunity for businesses. Conduct research on latest advances in generative AI techniques, technologies, and frameworks. Stay abreast of ethical considerations and ensure responsible AI development and deployment practices to help internal teams and customers navigate the end-to-end security and compliance process. Monitor model performance in production and resolve issues related to application …

items.desc: Akkodis è un leader globale nel mercato dell'ingegneria e della ricerca e sviluppo, che mira ad accelerare l'innovazione e la trasformazione digitale utilizzando la forza dei connected data. Con la passione per la tecnologia e il talento, il gruppo, composto da più di 40.000 ingegneri ed esperti digitali e con un fatturato di €4bn, offre una profonda esperienza intersettoriale in 28 paesi tra Nord America, EMEA e APAC. Akkodis vanta un’esperienza quarantennale e un forte know-how in settori tecnologici chiave come la mobilità, i servizi software e tecnologici, la robotica, i test, le simulazioni, la sicurezza dei dati, l'intelligenza artificiale e l'analisi dei dati. La combinazione di competenze informatiche e ingegneristiche porta a un'offerta unica di soluzioni end-to-end, con quattro linee di servizio - Consulting, Solutions, Talents e Academy - per supportare i clienti nel ripensare ai loro processi di sviluppo prodotto e di business, migliorare la produttività, ridurre al minimo il time-to-market e dare forma a un domani più smart e sostenibile. La divisione IT di Akkodis è dedicata all' ICT e alla Digital Transformation , composta da oltre 200 consulenti altamente specializzati presenti su scala nazionale. Offriamo una vasta gamma di servizi, unendo talento e tecnologia per ottimizzare i processi IT e promuovere l'innovazione. Tra i nostri servizi principali troviamo Digital Transformation, Cloud Technologies e Data Strategy, che comprendono attività come ad esempio Software Engineering, Migrazione al Cloud, Data Governance, Artificial Intelligence, etc. Nell’ottica di un potenziamento della divisione, ricerchiamo una figura di: Generative AI Engineer Entra a far parte della nostra divisione Digital , un gruppo di 200 consulenti che operano in Italia, specializzati nel settore ICT e nella Digital Transformation. La nostra forza risiede nell'integrazione delle nostre competenze, che ci consente di avere una visione a 360° delle esigenze tecnologiche e innovative delle aziende. Quale sarà il tuo contributo in Akkodis? Siamo alla ricerca di un Generative AI Engineer con esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni avanzate basate su LLM, agentic workflows e architetture RAG , da inserire in un contesto innovativo e ad alta complessità tecnologica. Attività principali: Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni di Generative AI per supportare processi di analisi documentale avanzata. Realizzare workflow agentici multi-step con gestione dello stato e della memoria utilizzando framework quali LangChain e LangGraph . Implementare pipeline RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) per l'analisi e l'estrazione di informazioni da documentazione complessa e non strutturata. Sviluppare sistemi per l'elaborazione automatica di contratti, tender, capitolati tecnici e documentazione di gara. Integrare e orchestrare modelli LLM on-premise/locali , garantendo la protezione di dati sensibili e riservati. Sviluppare pipeline ETL e componenti di data processing per la preparazione e la valorizzazione dei dati. Collaborare con stakeholder tecnici e di business per identificare e implementare nuovi use case basati su AI generativa. Hai una formazione in ambito Informatico o discipline affini e almeno 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo similare? About you Requisiti per iniziare il tuo percorso di crescita: Esperienza consolidata nello sviluppo di soluzioni Generative AI . Ottima conoscenza di LangChain , LangGraph e delle architetture agentiche. Esperienza nella progettazione e implementazione di pipeline RAG avanzate e sistemi di retrieval su basi documentali complesse. Competenze di Document Intelligence e Information Extraction da PDF, contratti, report tecnici e documentazione non strutturata. Esperienza nell'integrazione di LLM locali/on-premise e nella gestione di infrastrutture orientate alla tutela del dato. Ottima conoscenza di Python . Esperienza con librerie quali Pandas , NumPy e Scikit-Learn . Competenze nello sviluppo di pipeline ETL e nella manipolazione di dati eterogenei. Capacità di sviluppare modelli predittivi e componenti di machine learning applicati a contesti enterprise. Offerta Tempo Indeterminato, CCNL Commercio 36.000€ - 48.000€ RAL. 💼 Cosa troverai in Akkodis? Un percorso di carriera strutturato e personalizzato, con possibilità di crescita verticale e trasversale Ti supporteremo grazie ai nostri piani di formazione , ad una performance review annuale , ad un affiancamento nelle fasi iniziali di ingresso, unitamente a follow-up con figure Manageriali e HR Business Partner Avrai a disposizione una Piattaforma di Corporate Benefits Location Provincia di Milano - ibrido 2gg/sett In Akkodis crediamo nel valore della diversità, dell’equità e dell’inclusione. Ci impegniamo ogni giorno a costruire un ambiente di lavoro in cui ogni persona possa sentirsi accolta, rispettata e valorizzata, indipendentemente da età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità o background …

items.desc: Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP. As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence. By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco. About the Job: Zone & Co is seeking a skilled AI Software Engineer to join our fast-paced, innovation-driven development team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions that power and enhance our business products and operations. You’ll collaborate closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to build scalable, production-ready AI systems that deliver real business value. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically curious and creative problem-solver who is passionate about artificial intelligence, continuous learning, and delivering high-impact outcomes. What You'll Do: Design, prototype, and implement AI systems for real-world business applications. Build and deploy end-to-end AI/ML pipelines for key product features. Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to deliver integrated AI solutions. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code using Python, JavaScript, or statically typed languages. Integrate AI/ML models into backend and frontend applications. Analyze large datasets to extract insights and support data-driven decisions. Evaluate and select AI frameworks, tools, and technologies based on project needs. Monitor and optimize deployed models for performance, scalability, and reliability. Lead experimentation and prototyping efforts to test new ideas and algorithms. Participate in code reviews and mentor junior engineers. Communicate technical details and outcomes to both technical and non-technical audiences. Maintain a strong commitment to data quality, privacy, and ethical AI practices. Stay current with emerging AI research, frameworks, and methodologies. Contribute to infrastructure and cloud service decisions for AI workflows. What You'll Bring: 2+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on AI/ML applications. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field (Master’s preferred). Hands-on experience with LLMs, agents, and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or DSPy. Proficient in Python with familiarity in JavaScript or similar languages; knowledge of statically typed languages is a plus. Strong understanding of both relational (SQL) and non-relational databases. Experience deploying AI systems in production environments. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure); containerization experience is a bonus. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities. Strong communication skills in English—both written and verbal. Passion for innovation and using technology to create business value. Commitment to ethical AI development and continuous professional growth. Benefits At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution. We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers Join Our Global Mission Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor. Employment Terms United States Employment with Zone is “At-Will” , meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or …

items.desc: Experis è la società IT & Technology del Gruppo Manpower. Le persone e le loro competenze sono il nostro successo e insieme ci poniamo come partner tecnologici dei nostri clienti attraverso servizi e soluzioni. Vogliamo essere artefici, proprio insieme a te, di un ambiente di lavoro innovativo, stimolante e flessibile, attraverso i nostri Valori: People, Knowledge e Innovation. Experis è alla ricerca di un/una Java AI Developer Competenze richieste: Esperienza di 3-5 anni nella progettazione e nel mantenimento di API RESTful e servizi distribuiti in produzione, con responsabilità su affidabilità e performance Esperienza concreta nella costruzione di applicazioni basate su LLM in produzione: RAG, tool calling via MCP, sistemi agentici, gestione del contesto, streaming Comprovata conoscenza del linguaggio Java e dei relativi framework, con particolare riferimento a Java > 11, Spring Framework e Spring Boot Costituirà titolo preferenziale la conoscenza del linguaggio Python, con particolare riferimento a Python 3 e FastAPI Familiarità con almeno un framework di orchestrazione (Langflow, LangGraph o equivalenti) Conoscenza degli AI Gateway, dei pattern di routing/fallback multi-provider (LiteLLM, OpenRouter o soluzioni proprietarie) e delle API dei principali provider Conoscenza dei database relazionali e non relazionali (PostgreSQL/MySQL, MongoDB) e di almeno un motore di ricerca vettoriale o ibrida (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Qdrant, pgvector) Conoscenza dei protocolli di streaming e real-time: SSE, WebSocket, backpressure, gestione delle connessioni long-lived Conoscenza di strumenti DevOps quali Git, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes Esperienza su osservabilità: logging strutturato, tracing distribuito (OpenTelemetry), definizione di metriche e alert Capacità di scrivere e documentare codice di qualità, di prendere in autonomia decisioni tecniche motivate e di spiegarle a interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici. items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: The demo is the easy part. We build the AI that’s still running, and still useful, long after it. At Schuberg Philis, we see AI as an exciting and fast-evolving technology, but its real power lies in solving meaningful problems and creating lasting value. As an AI Python Engineer in our central team, you’ll turn that potential into dependable products and services. Working alongside talented engineers, you’ll build the software capabilities behind retrieval systems, agentic workflows, knowledge platforms and AI-powered applications designed to thrive long after the demo is over. You’ll also help identify where AI can create real value, and understand the problem deeply enough to build the right solution. Your work will be varied and impactful. One week, you might improve the quality of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform using technologies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, LangGraph and vector search. The next, you could design Python services, build APIs, develop a knowledge assistant combining LLMs with Neo4j and GraphRAG, automate operational processes with agentic workflows, or shape the architecture of a new AI capability used across multiple teams. What you will work on Improving the quality of RAG platforms using OpenAI, Anthropic, LangGraph and vector search Designing Python services and building APIs Developing knowledge assistants with Neo4j and GraphRAG techniques Automating operational processes using agentic workflows Building intelligent search that helps engineers find answers across thousands of documents and systems Shaping the architecture of new AI capabilities used across multiple teams Here, building and running go hand in hand. The engineers making the decisions are also the engineers carrying the pager. That shared ownership makes operational excellence, observability and reliability every bit as important as elegant code, and you’ll own your solutions from design to production, learning from real-world feedback and continuously improving what you’ve built. You’ll join a team that celebrates engineering craftsmanship, autonomy and curiosity. We want you to challenge ideas, make bold but thoughtful decisions, and continuously improve both our technology and the way we work. We’d love to meet you if You’re first and foremost a software engineer who happens to be interested in AI. You enjoy understanding the problem before jumping to the solution, and you take pride in seeing your systems perform reliably in production. You have several years of solid experience building production-grade software with Python You’ve worked with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, LangGraph, LangChain, Neo4j, GraphRAG or semantic search, beyond side projects and demos You enjoy designing systems and taking responsibility for how they behave in production You naturally switch between architecture discussions and hands-on implementation You can turn ambiguity into a practical engineering approach You have strong opinions about software quality, testing and maintainability You’re interested in both technology and the business context it serves You like owning outcomes, not tickets, from idea to production and beyond You are currently based in the Netherlands. Questions? Please do not hesitate to contact Maggie: 0623757086 Only applications submitted through the website will be considered. Please note that we do not work with external recruitment agencies and we will not pay any fees for unrequested CV introductions.

items.desc: AU QUOTIDIEN ÇA DONNE QUOI ? Au cœur de la stratégie Data & AI du pôle Investment & Protection Services (IPS), le Head Office IPS accélère la transformation de ses métiers par l’intelligence artificielle. Il accompagne les entités Cardif, Wealth Management, Asset Management et Real Estate dans l’adoption de solutions IA à fort impact, tout en développant des actifs réutilisables à l’échelle du pôle et du Groupe. Rattaché hiérarchiquement au Head Office IPS et positionné au plus près des métiers, vous suivrez un parcours composé de rotations de 18 à 24 mois au sein des différentes entités du pôle. Vous contribuerez ainsi à transformer des opportunités IA en solutions concrètes, robustes et industrialisées. Votre première rotation se déroulera au sein de BNP Paribas Cardif, la branche assurance du Groupe, présente dans 30 pays et reconnue mondialement en assurance des emprunteurs, en épargne et en protection. Vous rejoindrez le Global AI Office, centre d’expertise rattaché au Secrétariat Général de Cardif. Basé en France, il conçoit et déploie des solutions en Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision et Predictive Analytics pour transformer les parcours clients, partenaires et collaborateurs. Concrètement, vous : Identifierez les processus à fort potentiel d’automatisation et concevrez les solutions IA adaptées aux enjeux métiers. Explorerez l’état de l’art en IA générative et agentique, testerez de nouveaux modèles, frameworks et méthodologies, puis transformerez les résultats en choix technologiques concrets. Contribuerez à la feuille de route des chatbots et agents IA en développant de nouvelles fonctionnalités et un code robuste, maintenable et conforme aux standards de qualité. Déploierez, industrialiserez et superviserez des pipelines RAG en production. Accompagnerez les utilisateurs de la plateforme agentique, structurés en cohortes, et diffuserez les bonnes pratiques grâce à une documentation claire et opérationnelle. Vous évoluerez au sein de l’équipe NLP, composée d’Applied AI Engineers, de Data Scientists, de stagiaires et d’un manager. Cette équipe développe des produits d’IA générative autour du texte et de la voix, notamment des solutions RAG, des chatbots et des agents IA, intégrés aux processus IT de plusieurs business lines à l’international. Vous travaillerez en proximité avec le Data Office, l’IT, les métiers, les fonctions et les AI Transformation Leads. Vous bénéficierez d’un environnement stimulant, d’une expertise technique reconnue et de temps de partage réguliers pour accélérer votre montée en compétences. Vous évoluerez à Nanterre, au sein des locaux de l’Odyssée, récemment rénovés, en flex office. ET APRÈS ? Ce poste vous ouvrira un parcours transverse au sein du pôle IPS. Après cette première rotation chez Cardif, vous pourrez découvrir d’autres environnements selon les opportunités, les besoins du pôle et votre projet professionnel. Ce parcours vous permettra d’élargir votre compréhension des métiers, de renforcer votre expertise en IA appliquée et de multiplier les cas d’usage à fort impact au sein du Groupe. Vous développerez ainsi un profil rare : une expertise technique solide, associée à une vision transverse des enjeux business et à une réelle capacité à faire passer l’IA à l’échelle. LES AVANTAGES À NOUS REJOINDRE : Travailler chez BNP Paribas, c’est : Un package rémunération et des avantages : Une rémunération annuelle fixe, versée sur 12 mois, ajustée selon votre profil et votre expérience. S’ajouterait à ce montant une rémunération annuelle variable individuelle, liée à l’atteinte d’objectifs individuels et collectifs, et fonction des résultats et de la rentabilité de l’entreprise ; elle sera versée annuellement et au prorata du temps de travail et de présence. Accords d’entreprise et de groupe, plan épargne entreprise/retraite, intéressement et participation, accès au restaurant d’entreprise et/ou tickets restaurant, couverture santé et prévoyance, activités sociales et culturelles via le comité social et économique… De la flexibilité avec un rythme de travail hybride : jusqu’à 2,5 jours de télétravail à définir avec votre manager. Rejoignez un Groupe engagé auprès de ses clients et de la société, et contribuez activement à notre transformation en faveur d’un monde plus durable. Impliquez-vous à nos côtés, sur votre temps professionnel, grâce à notre programme One Million Hours To Help. ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE PROCHAIN APPLIED AI ENGINEER RAG & AGENTIC AI H/F ? Vous êtes diplômé d’un Bac+5 en école d’ingénieurs ou à l’université, avec une spécialisation en Data Science et/ou Software Engineering, et justifiez d’une première expérience professionnelle significative sur des sujets IA. Vous maîtrisez la Data Science et disposez d’une compréhension approfondie des architectures RAG, des LLM et des agents IA. Vous êtes à l’aise en Python, avec les frameworks RAG et agentiques tels que LangGraph ou Docling, ainsi qu’avec Git, Pytest et la programmation orientée objet. Vous …

Ob du
items.desc: Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du. Deine Aufgaben Als AI Berater (w/m/d) in unserer SAP Platforms gestaltest du an unseren Standorten in Deutschland mit, wie Künstliche Intelligenz im Zusammenspiel mit SAP-Ökosystem echten Mehrwert schafft. Gemeinsam mit unseren Mandant:innen entwickeln wir aus Ideen produktive KI-Lösungen – von SAP Business AI und Joule bis hin zu modernen KI-Plattformen, Agentenlösungen und intelligenten Automatisierungen. Ob du gerade einsteigst oder bereits Projekterfahrung mitbringst- bei uns findest du den Rahmen, um zu wachsen und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung zu übernehmen: Du wirkst an der Entwicklung von KI-Agenten und Assistenzlösungen mit, die reale Geschäftsprozesse unterstützen. Dabei arbeitest du mit SAP-Technologien wie Joule Studio und AI Foundation sowie gängigen LLMs und Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangChain oder Semantic Kernel). Du übersetzt unstrukturierte Ideen unserer Mandant:innen in messbare Anwendungsfälle und begleitest diese vom ersten Workshop über Prototypen bis zur produktiven Nutzung. Du behältst Compliance, Governance und Skalierbarkeit im Blick und berücksichtigst Responsible-AI-Prinzipien sowie interne Freigabeprozesse von Beginn an. Du verstehst Datenqualität und Data Governance als Grundlage erfolgreicher KI-Anwendungen und sorgst für ein belastbares Datenfundament als Basis produktiver Use Cases. Du arbeitest KI-gestützt mit modernen Werkzeugen wie Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude oder GitHub Copilot und bringst deine Erfahrungen aktiv in unsere AI Communities, Best Practices, Accelerators und KI-gestützten Delivery-Ansätze ein. Dein Skillset Du hast ein überdurchschnittliches Studium abgeschlossen und bringst bereits Kenntnisse in KI- und SAP-Technologien mit, gepaart mit einem technischen Interesse an der SAP Business AI Platform sowie einem Verständnis von S/4HANA, Clean Core und Erweiterbarkeit. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Werkzeuge einzusetzen – etwa Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude oder GitHub Copilot. Wichtiger als ein bestimmtes Tool ist uns, dass du Konzepte wie generative KI, RAG oder Agentic Workflows verstehst, solche Werkzeuge sicher anwendest und Lust hast, dich in neue Lösungen einzuarbeiten. Du verfügst über sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1) und kannst zwischen Technik und Business „übersetzen“. Zudem bringst du eine hohe Reisebereitschaft für Projekteinsätze bei unseren Mandant:innen mit. Dein Mindset Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten. Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden. Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen. Deine Benefits Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits. Bewirb dich noch heute! Mehr Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess bei EY findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor. Bei EY leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können. Du hast noch Fragen? Unser Recruitment Center beantwortet diese gerne unter +49 6196 996 10005.

items.desc: Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia ! Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail . Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès ! Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y ! Curiosité et autonomie : Capacité à apprendre et s'adapter très rapidement dans un domaine qui évolue chaque semaine. Sens du produit et pragmatisme : Capacité à transformer une avancée technologique en valeur métier concrète. Communication : Capacité à vulgariser des sujets complexes pour des profils non-techniques. Vous concevez, développez et déployez des solutions avancées basées sur les derniers modèles d'IA générative (LLM, modèles multimodaux, etc.). Conception & Développement : Créer et optimiser des architectures applicatives tirant parti des LLM (architecture RAG, agents autonomes, fine-tuning). Intégration & MLOps/LLMOps : Déployer, surveiller et maintenir les modèles en production avec des contraintes de latence, de coût et de scalabilité. Prompt Engineering & Évaluation : Concevoir des stratégies d’évaluation rigoureuses pour mesurer la qualité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des réponses générées (anti-hallucination, garde-fous/guardrails). Industrialisation : Mettre en place les pipelines de données et sécuriser la confidentialité des données traitées. Veille & Innovation : Suivre les évolutions rapides de l'écosystème GenAI (open source, frameworks, API) et proposer des PoC pertinents pour le produit. Le profil recherché Compétences techniques clés : Maîtrise du développement Python et de son écosystème Data/AI (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Pandas, etc.). Expérience avérée avec les LLM (OpenAI API, Anthropic, Mistral, Hugging Face, Llama). Maîtrise des architectures RAG et des bases de données vectorielles (Pinecone, ChromaDB, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector). Frameworks GenAI : Utilisation de LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack ou DSPy. Méthodes : Fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), Quantization, Prompt Engineering avancé. Pratiques MLOps / DevOps : Docker, CI/CD, cloud provider (AWS, GCP ou Azure). Les petits plus 🏠 Télétravail possible (hybride) 👛 100% des frais de transports en communs pris en charge, des tickets restaurant et une mutuelle haut de gamme ❤️‍🩹Une politique inclusive et une référente handicap à disposition pour vous accompagner #greatplacetobe 🎁 Un CSE avantageux et des challenges tout au long de l'année ! #greatplacetolive 📈 Des primes à hauteur des performances de l'année et de l'implication 🎉 250 événements par an pour rencontrer tes collègues et des locaux feel good 📢 Des formations, conférences et une plateforme d'e-learning avec LinkedIn pour monter en compétences #greatplacetolearn 👩‍ Des Communautés Métiers et du Mentorat pour partager son expertise et en apprendre sur de nombreux sujets #greatplacetoshare 🕹️ Une communauté de e-sport : Extia Gaming ! #greatplacetoplay 🌏 Envie d’évoluer ? Grâce à notre politique de mobilité interne, explorez de nouvelles opportunités en France ou dans l’un de nos 7 autres pays !

items.title: Data Scientist (AI) | National Security - eSC/eDV Required
items.card: Your Role And Responsibilities At IBM Consulting FutureNow, our Artificial Intelligence practice helps clients solve complex business and mission challenges using Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI and Large Language Models. We're looking for experienced Data Scientists (AI) to join our growing Hybrid Cloud & Data service line, working alongside engineers, architects, data specialists and client
items.desc: Introduction At IBM Consulting UK FutureNow, you’ll build a career at the forefront of hybrid cloud and AI, working with leading clients across the public and private sectors. You’ll collaborate with top industry professionals, gain hands on experience with cutting edge technologies, and deliver solutions that create real business impact. From day one, you’ll work on meaningful, high profile programmes that stretch your skills and accelerate your growth. We invest heavily in you—supporting continuous learning, in demand skills development, and long term career progression. You’ll thrive in a flexible, inclusive environment that values curiosity, encourages reinvention, and recognises what makes you unique. We Offer Tools and policies to support your work-life balance from flexible working approaches, sabbatical programs, paid paternity leave, maternity leave and an innovative maternity returners scheme More traditional benefits, such as 25 days holiday (in addition to public holidays), private medical, dental & optical cover, online shopping discounts, an Employee Assistance Program, life assurance and a group pension plan through salary sacrifice. Your Role And Responsibilities At IBM Consulting FutureNow, our Artificial Intelligence practice helps clients solve complex business and mission challenges using Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI and Large Language Models. We're looking for experienced Data Scientists (AI) to join our growing Hybrid Cloud & Data service line, working alongside engineers, architects, data specialists and client stakeholders to design, develop and operationalise AI-driven solutions within highly regulated and security-conscious environments. This is a hands-on consulting role requiring practitioners who can translate business challenges into practical AI solutions whilst balancing innovation, governance, security and measurable outcomes. Successful candidates will combine strong analytical capability with modern AI engineering practices, helping clients unlock value from traditional Machine Learning, Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, agentic workflows and advanced analytics. Key Responsibilities As a Consulting Data Scientist, you will: Design, develop and deploy AI and Data Science solutions across multiple client engagements. Translate complex and often ambiguous business problems into practical analytical and AI-driven solutions. Deliver Generative AI use cases including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, knowledge retrieval, intelligent assistants and agentic workflows. Apply machine learning, statistical analysis and predictive modelling techniques to structured and unstructured datasets. Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, evaluation and validation activities. Evaluate, fine-tune and optimise AI models to improve performance, reliability, explainability and business value. Work closely with Data Engineers, Architects, Product Owners and client stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle. Support the deployment and operationalisation of AI solutions through cloud platforms, APIs, MLOps practices and modern integration approaches. Communicate technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences. Contribute to best practices across AI engineering, governance, responsible AI and secure-by-design delivery. Support and mentor junior practitioners where appropriate. Preferred Education Bachelor's Degree Required Technical And Professional Expertise We're looking for experience across several of the following areas: Strong proficiency in Python and modern Data Science tooling including Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar libraries. Commercial experience designing, building and deploying Data Science, Machine Learning or AI solutions. Practical experience working with Generative AI technologies including one or more of: Large Language Models (LLMs) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Agentic AI workflows Prompt Engineering Embeddings and Semantic Search AI Evaluation Frameworks Experience using AI ecosystems and frameworks such as: OpenAI Azure OpenAI Anthropic LangChain LangGraph DSPy Similar technologies Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP. Strong understanding of model evaluation, experimentation, data quality and AI governance considerations. Experience collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements and shape analytical approaches. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience delivering solutions from discovery through to deployment and adoption. Experience working within Agile delivery teams. This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personal Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NVS) …

items.desc: Du verantwortest AI-Systeme für den Mittelstand, vom ersten Termin bei Kund:innen bis zum laufenden Betrieb. WE BUILD AI gibt es seit Februar 2025. Wir sind rund zehn Leute in einem Loftbüro in Köln-Ehrenfeld und bauen AI-Lösungen für den gehobenen Mittelstand. Level: Regular oder Senior Ort: Köln-Ehrenfeld und Homeoffice Start: ab sofort Bei uns gehört dir ein Projekt Du arbeitest immer in einem Projektteam mit anderen Engineers und Consultants. Gemeinsam klärt ihr mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung unserer Kund:innen, was sie brauchen. Die Architektur verantwortest du, und das System bauen und betreiben wir zusammen. So läuft ein Projekt bei uns Ein typisches Projekt hat drei Phasen, und du begleitest alle als technisch verantwortliche Person im Projektteam. Discovery Sprint mit dem Fachbereich: Wir legen fest, welches Problem wir lösen und woran wir den Erfolg messen. Pilotphase mit klaren Go/No-Go-Kriterien: Ihr baut eine erste Version, die Nutzer:innen im Fachbereich testen. Ausbau und Betrieb: Trägt der Pilot, bringt ihr das System in den Alltag und haltet es mit Monitoring stabil. Deine Aufgaben Bei aktuellen Projekten dreht es sich viel um das Training von eigenen VLMs und um das, was jedes Unternehmen umtreibt: den Einsatz von Agentic AI im gesamten Unternehmenskosmos. Du konzipierst LLM-Anwendungen mit RAG, strukturierter Extraktion und Agentic Workflows und entscheidest die Architektur. Backend-Services und APIs entwickelst du in Python, meist mit FastAPI. Auf Azure, meist mit Azure OpenAI und AI Foundry, bringst du die Systeme in Betrieb und betreust sie dort. Mit Tests, Evaluation und Monitoring sicherst du die Qualität von Anfang an. Gemeinsam mit unseren Consultants klärst du Anforderungen mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung der Kund:innen. Dein Profil Du hast mindestens eine LLM-Anwendung oder ein ML-Modell selbst in Betrieb gebracht, die Menschen im Arbeitsalltag nutzen. Python beherrschst du sicher, inklusive Tests und Deployment. Erfahrung mit einer Cloud-Plattform bringst du mit, am liebsten Azure, alternativ AWS oder GCP. Deine technischen Entscheidungen kannst du begründen, auch gegenüber Kund:innen. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Feld, alternativ vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil der Kundenkontakt auf Deutsch läuft. Klassisches Machine Learning ist ein Plus. Was wir dir bieten Den Aufbau eines Unternehmens begleiten und eine neue Generation von Beratung und Engineering prägen Benefit-Budget von 30 Euro im Monat für Gutscheine bei über 100 Anbietern, Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket Dienstrad-Leasing per Gehaltsumwandlung mit bis zu 40 Prozent Ersparnis, Vollkasko und Wartung inklusive Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice nach eigener Verantwortung Mentoring, Peer Reviews und regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche mit ehrlichem Feedback Gemeinsame Workations und regelmäßige Teamevents Loftbüro in Köln-Ehrenfeld mit Bürohunden, Getränken, Snacks und Mario Kart Ehrlich vorab Wir sind ein kleines Team ohne eigenes Plattform-Team, und viele technische Entscheidungen triffst du selbst. Wer lieber in einem großen Team an einem eigenen Produkt arbeitet, ist woanders vermutlich glücklicher. Bewirb dich bei uns Das ist der Ablauf unseres Bewerbungsverfahrens: Gemeinsamer Call, etwa 30 Minuten. Wir sprechen über dich und über uns. Probeaufgabe mit etwa 2 Stunden Aufwand. Danach stellst du deine Lösung in 45 bis 60 Minuten vor. Treffen in Köln mit gemeinsamem Essen, Einblick in laufende Projekte und fachlichem Sparring im Team. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du innerhalb von einem Werktag von uns. Von der Bewerbung bis zum Angebot planen wir drei Wochen.

items.desc:
Meta's Privacy Engineering team is seeking a Security Engineer with experience in applying an adversarial mindset to identify, scope, contain, and eradicate real-world privacy threats to products and infrastructure. Your primary responsibilities will be to deal with privacy vulnerabilities by designing or guiding Software Engineers through remediations, learning from security/privacy incidents, identifying vulnerabilities in our codebase, and building agentic systems at scale to assist and perform these operations. Your skills will be the foundation of security initiatives that protect the security and privacy of billions of people. You will advance Meta’s mission of making the world more open and connected by identifying and neutralizing threats that aim to collect sensitive information or disrupt our systems.
Lead technical triage and investigation of complex privacy incidents - reviewing code, system architecture, logs, and other evidence to guide engineers through mitigation and remediation Design and build scalable agentic AI systems that can autonomously handle all aspects of incident response, discover and verify security/privacy vulnerabilities in product and infrastructure, and guide coding agents to write secure-by-default code Partner with engineering and product teams to improve designs, prioritize durable remediation, and shift privacy protections earlier in the development lifecycle Lead medium-to-large technical projects from ambiguous problem definition through implementation, adoption, measurement, and long-term ownership
5+ years of work experience in technical privacy, security, or security software engineering domains, including incident response, application privacy/security, and/or offensive security Experience identifying, analyzing, and remediating real-world privacy/security threats Software engineering proficiency equivalent to 1+ years of work experience in coding in Python, PHP, Java, C/C++, (or an equivalent language), including code maintenance and review Experience with using AI coding tools and agents in helping to investigate or discover security/privacy issues Experience mentoring engineers and creating documentation, training, tools, or processes that scale the people around you Experience improving the precision, coverage, reliability, or operational health of security or privacy systems Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies Experience designing safeguards or frameworks that eliminate recurring classes of privacy or security issues Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Experience participating in or leading an incident-management oncall rotation Experience building AI agents or agent pipelines for code analysis, investigation, detection, verification, or remediation Experience with static or dynamic analysis, large-scale code search, data pipelines, or automated detection systems

Overview 
 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you’ll play an instrumental role in helping customers migrate, modernize and transform their architecture and applications, laying the groundwork for world-class, scalable, production-ready AI solutions.

From designing roadmaps to leading Proof of Concepts and MVPs, you’ll help customers build and run intelligent applications and AI agents at scale. Your expertise will guide customers through critical milestones, leveraging proven IP and delivery engines to accelerate adoption and unlock value. 
 This is an opportunity to deepen your knowledge across Azure AI, AI agents, applications, serverless, microservices, GitHub, databases, and hybrid environments. You’ll be part of a multinational team that values precision, creativity and impact - where your decisions influence outcomes and your growth is continuous. 
 Find out more about our culture and values , and the environment you will be working in.

 Build trusted relationships with key customer IT and business decision makers to drive long-term cloud adoption, understand their business objectives, priorities and success measures, and design secure, scalable, AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value.

 Drive migration and modernization initiatives, including committed proof of concept and production milestones, across application and AI workloads.
 Deliver repeatable intellectual property (IP) to achieve targeted outcomes, accelerate Azure adoption and consumption, and contribute to centralized IP development initiatives.
 Provide delivery oversight and escalation support for key strategic engagements across application and AI workloads.
 Identify and resolve technical blockers to accelerate go-live, and serve as the Voice of the Customer, sharing feedback and insights with Microsoft engineering teams to influence product improvements.
 Drive technical excellence by leading the health, resiliency, security, and optimization of mission-critical application and AI workloads, ensuring readiness for production-scale AI use cases.
 Achieve and maintain certifications in priority Cloud & AI Apps workloads.
 Maintain deep technical expertise and stay current with market trends, competitive insights, and Microsoft’s evolving application and AI capabilities.
 Demonstrate a growth mindset by continuously learning, contributing to technical communities, sharing best practices and mentoring others to accelerate customer outcomes.
 Qualifications

items.desc: Position Overview We are looking for a Configurable Materials Master Data Domain Lead whose core craft is Variant Configuration. SAP VC, including characteristics, classes, configuration profiles, dependencies, constraints, and super-BoMs, is the structural spine of how we define, price, manufacture, and service our products worldwide. You will own the strategic data roadmap for this domain, serve as Business Owner for SAP MDG-M and the SAP Variant Configuration landscape (LO-VC / AVC) , and orchestrate cross-functional initiatives that enable product innovation, operational excellence, analytics, and intelligent automation. This is a global role, reporting directly to the Global Head of Data Governance & MDM, with end-to-end accountability across R&D, Commercial, Procurement & Operations, and Finance, spanning Idea-to-Market (I2M), Market-to-Cash (M2C), Plan-to-Deliver (P2D), and Record-to-Report (R2R). If you have deep VC-modeling expertise and want to shape how a world-class industrial company builds its digital product thread, we want to hear from you. items.desc: We're looking for a Product Engineer to join one of our clients, a UK-based proptech company building an AI-powered platform to transform residential property management. Its product brings together property operations, resident communication, and building management into a more connected, intelligent system. This is a highly hands-on, product-focused engineering role for someone who enjoys building from the ground up, taking ownership of features end to end, and turning ideas into products that solve real-world problems. You'll work closely with the team to shape product decisions, move quickly from concept to implementation, and use modern development tools, including AI, to build, ship, and iterate. The focus is on engineers who combine strong technical skills with product thinking, initiative, and a desire to make a tangible impact on the product's direction and growth. What you'll do Take problems from unclear to shipped. Discover, architect, build, test and deliver new features across the entire stack. Build with users, not just for them. Property managers and residents give us direct, sometimes blunt feedback. You will be close enough to hear it first-hand and turn it into product the same week. Use AI to do the previously impossible. Turning messy inspection reports into clear action plans, making sense of resident messages, drafting replies a manager can actually trust. The kind of thing that was not buildable a couple of years ago. Have a real say in what gets built. Your product instincts matter as much as your code. If you think we are building the wrong thing, we want to hear it. Share your expertise. Be on hand to help other team members, technical or otherwise, and help mentor other engineers. Help us operate more efficiently by building and maintaining our developer tooling and CI/CD pipelines, and staying at the forefront of the latest AI tools. Who does well hereWe care less about your exact CV than about how you work The people who thrive here tend to: Have a strong bias to action. You spot what is missing and go and do something about it, rather than waiting to be asked. Have good product instincts. You have taste for what to build and the discipline to leave the rest out. Be comfortable with ambiguity. You can make real progress without a clear spec, and you are happy changing course when the problem turns out to be different than you thought. Be kind and low-ego. You are collaborative and pragmatic, you would rather get it right than be right, and you are easy to build alongside. On the engineering side, you will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You have owned and shipped real features across frontend and backend, and you enjoy the whole stack rather than a slice of it. You are strong with TypeScript and React, and/or with Python and a modern web framework, and happy to become strong in the other. You can make the bigger architectural calls and have them still look right in six months. You already build with AI tools and have a genuine view on where they help and where they get in the way. Bonus, not essential: React Native, AWS, GraphQL, CI/CD, or having shipped LLM features to production. None of this is a checklist. If it sounds like you, even without every box ticked, get in touch. What We Offer Real product ownership - take features from idea to production and see the direct impact of your work. A meaningful technical challenge - help build an AI-powered product that is transforming residential property management. Influence over product decisions - contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and help shape both the product and its technical direction. A high level of autonomy - work in a fast-moving environment where initiative and practical problem-solving are valued. Modern development practices - use AI-powered coding tools and modern technologies to build, ship, and iterate quickly. Competitive compensation and equity A collaborative team environment - work closely with the team from the London office, 4–5 days per week. Pay: £55,000.00-£90,000.00 per year Work Location: In person
