items.desc: Bei Exxeta treibst du an vorderster Front Innovationen voran, denkst AI-Lösungen nicht nur, sondern baust sie direkt beim Kunden. In dieser Rolle bist du end-to-end unterwegs, vom Prototyp bis zum Produktivsystem und verstehst die Domäne des Kunden. Du realisierst AI-Systeme und -Agenten auf Basis von LLMs, integrierst sie in bestehende Systemlandschaften und stellst die fortlaufende Evaluierung (EvalOps) sicher. Exxeta arbeitet als Partner mit Frontier Labs wie OpenAI und Anthropic zusammen und bringt deren Technologien bei unseren Kunden in Produktion. Was erwartet dich Du begleitest Projekte von der Idee bis zum Live-Betrieb. Dabei gehst du tief sowohl in den Tech-Stack als auch in die Domäne des Kunden und leitest wiederverwendbare Komponenten, Strategien und Muster ab. Arbeite hands-on mit LLM- und Agent-Frameworks wie LangChain, Codex SDK, Claude Agent SDK. Du evaluierst AI-Systeme und Agenten (EvalOps), wendest Agentic Engineering nativ an, entdeckst und entwickelst neue Herangehensweisen. Außerdem enablest du die Fachexpert:innen bei unseren Kunden. Verantworte die Architektur und Implementierung von AI-Agenten und -Systemen und verbinde diese mit Bestandssystemen. Du stellst sicher, dass AI-Lösungen unter Produktionsbedingungen entwickelt werden und kennst die Proof-of-Concept-Wüste nur zu gut. Rapid Prototyping und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Nutzer:innen sind Teil deines Alltags. Du bist Teil eines agilen, innovationsgetriebenen Teams innerhalb der Exxeta und stehst in engem Austausch mit unseren Kunden. Gestalte die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Frontier Labs Partnern mit und bringe deine Erfahrungen aus Kundenprojekten in den fachlichen Austausch mit den Labs ein. Was erwarten wir von dir Persönlicher Background: Du bringst Expertise und Erfahrung in Software-Architektur, Software Engineering und Agentic Engineering mit und fokussierst dich auf alles rund um AI und/oder Machine Learning. Du weißt, wie man die gesamte Lösung verantwortet, nicht nur den Code. Tech Skills: Von Backend bis Frontend, Infrastruktur bis AI - du hast Spaß daran, überall dort anzupacken, wo Impact gebraucht wird. Dir ist Outcome wichtiger als Output. Techniken wie Agentic RAG und klassisches RAG beherrscht du, außerdem sind dir LLM-/Agent-Frameworks, Infrastruktur-Themen (wie Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform) und Vektor-Datenbanken (wie Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector) bestens bekannt. Kunden-Fokus: Du überzeugst durch deine Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt und in agilen Delivery-Settings. Mit Ambiguitäten und Unsicherheit im Projektalltag gehst du souverän um. Mindset: Prototypen, MVPs und Produktion sind für dich kein Widerspruch, sondern der Spaß an deinem Job. Du bist kreativ und lösungsorientiert, kannst dich in Fachbereiche eindenken und hast dabei stets unsere Kunden im Fokus. On the road: Du bist reisebereit und flexibel, unsere Kunden bundesweit vor Ort zu beraten. Let's talk: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch - super, dann findest du dich bei Exxeta bestens zurecht. Warum Exxeta Echte Challenges für dein Wachstum – Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive Für deinen perfekten Start setzen wir auf unser Mentor:innenprogramm Mobiles Arbeiten? Nachteule oder früher Vogel? Für deine optimale Work-Life-Balance gibt es genug Gestaltungsraum. Bleib gesund - neben betrieblicher Krankenversicherung gibt es ein Gesundheitsbudget für individuelle Leistungen Mit dem XX-Bike ins Büro: Wir bezuschussen Fahrrad- und E-Bike-Leasing. Wer legt die meisten Kilometer zurück? Warum Exxeta Bei Exxeta entwickeln wir digitale Lösungen, die wirklich etwas verändern – in Unternehmen, Märkten und Köpfen. Über 1200 Kolleg:innen bringen dafür Technologie, Ideen und unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammen. Was uns antreibt: Neugier, Teamspirit und der Anspruch, echten Impact zu schaffen. Hightech with a heartbeat eben. Wir sind ein Zuhause für Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen. Diversität und unterschiedliche Perspektiven bereichern unser Team. Haltung, Ideen und Lust aufs Machen - das zählt bei uns! Bewirb dich jetzt!

items.desc: Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer bij PwC werk je dicht bij de klant en de mensen die de oplossing gebruiken. Je onderzoekt hoe hun processen werkelijk werken, brengt een nog onduidelijk probleem terug tot iets dat je kunt bouwen en vertaalt feedback uit de praktijk direct naar werkende software. Je schrijft productiecode, bouwt integraties en brengt oplossingen naar productie. Je wacht niet tot alle requirements zijn uitgewerkt, maar stelt vragen, maakt aannames expliciet en bouwt snel een eerste versie om met gebruikers te toetsen wat daadwerkelijk werkt. Waar je terechtkomt Binnen het Data & AI Consulting-team van PwC Nederland werk je aan complexe vraagstukken bij ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, financiële instellingen en grote commerciële opdrachtgevers. Je helpt klanten om generatieve AI niet alleen te verkennen, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van hun processen, applicaties en dagelijkse werk. Forward deployed betekent bij ons dat je regelmatig dicht op de praktijk van de klant werkt. Je spreekt met gebruikers en domeinexperts, werkt met echte data en bestaande systemen en ontwikkelt de oplossing samen met het klantteam. Maar, je begint niet vanaf nul: we nemen onze AI-versnellers en frameworks mee naar de klant en versterken daarmee onze eigen producten. Afhankelijk van de fase van het traject werk je bij de klant, op ons kantoor in Amsterdam of vanuit huis. Belangrijk om te weten wat deze rol níet is. Je bent geen consultant die alleen analyseert en adviseert, geen sales engineer die vooral demo’s bouwt en geen software engineer die uitsluitend vanuit een uitgewerkt backlog werkt. Je bent en blijft een engineer. Je schrijft productiecode en bent aanspreekbaar op wat je bouwt, dus we meten je niet af op je PowerPoint slides en beschermen je focustijd. Tegelijk ga je zelf naar de bron. Samen met onze consultants spreek je met gebruikers, onderzoek je data en processen en stel je aannames ter discussie. Ons werk is pas geslaagd als de oplossing technisch werkt én in de dagelijkse praktijk waarde oplevert. Dit ga je doen Je werkt van een nog niet volledig uitgewerkt klantvraagstuk naar een AI-oplossing die in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt gebruikt. Je combineert discovery, software-engineering en klantgerichte delivery. Concreet: Je onderzoekt samen met gebruikers het echte probleem. Je brengt processen, knelpunten, data en bestaande systemen in kaart en vertaalt een nog onduidelijke klantvraag naar heldere requirements, succescriteria en een eerste leverbare stap. Je bouwt en toetst snel een eerste werkende oplossing. Met echte gebruikers en realistische data test je aannames en ontwikkel je GenAI-oplossingen met bijvoorbeeld LLM’s, RAG, agents en reguliere softwarecomponenten. Je integreert de oplossing in de klantomgeving. Je bouwt API’s, datastromen, authenticatie en koppelingen met bestaande applicaties en systemen. Daarbij maak je bewust de afweging wanneer AI waarde toevoegt en wanneer reguliere softwarelogica beter past. We werken voor klanten waar security, privacy en compliancy van levensbelang zijn (zoals banken en ministeries). Snel naar productie gaan is daar een uitdaging. Jouw rol is om met onze teamleden de discussie aan te gaan met security-officers en architecten. Je helpt hen in te zien hoe we op een veilige en verantwoorde manier die eerste versies live kunnen krijgen. Je brengt de oplossing betrouwbaar naar productie. Je zorgt voor geautomatiseerde tests, evaluaties, security, CI/CD, monitoring en logging. Je blijft betrokken bij livegang en stabilisatie en draagt bij aan het oplossen van technische blokkades in de klantomgeving. Je verbetert op basis van gebruik en maakt lessen herbruikbaar. Je verzamelt feedback, meet kwaliteit en gebruik, begeleidt de technische ingebruikname en vertaalt terugkerende patronen naar herbruikbare componenten, evaluatieframeworks en implementatieaanpakken. Je staat er niet alleen voor. Hoewel je als FDE de technische leiding neemt over de AI-oplossing, werk je nauw samen met onze gespecialiseerde data-engineers, architecten en consultants. Jij focust op de AI-logica, integratie en de developer experience van de oplossing, terwijl je collega’s zich op de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur en de organisatorische adoptie richten. Je maakt daarbij steeds een bewuste afweging tussen AI en reguliere softwarelogica. Niet ieder probleem heeft een LLM of agent nodig. Waar je mee werkt Onze stack varieert per klant en per vraagstuk. Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer werk je regelmatig in een technische omgeving die je niet zelf hebt gekozen. We zoeken daarom een sterke technische basis, brede nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om nieuwe tools snel eigen te maken. AI-applicaties bouwen: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic en SQL. Voor RAG en agentic AI gebruiken we bijvoorbeeld LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Microsoft Agent Framework, MCP, embeddings en vector stores zoals Azure AI Search of pgvector. Integreren en naar productie brengen: Microsoft Azure is ons meest …

items.card: you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so.
items.desc: Role Description You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. As an AI Engineer (Agentic/Applied), you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams and a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer programme. Key Responsibilities Design and build production-grade agentic systems end-to-end: multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, tool invocation, memory management, and lifecycle observability Build and own RAG pipelines: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector search, context window engineering and tuning against real quality targets Integrate and abstract across multiple LLM providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, and open-source models — with fallback routing, token, cost, and latency management Implement LLMOps in production: eval harnesses with real quality metrics, prompt versioning, observability tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent), cost and safety monitoring Embed directly with client engineering teams to design, prototype, and deploy agentic solutions — workshops, proofs of concept, code-with sessions, and architecture walkthroughs Build reusable patterns, accelerators, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual client engagement and enable the next one to start faster Define and use metrics to measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost-effectiveness; present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders in business terms Basic Qualifications Strong software engineering experience in production environments Hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment — non-negotiable Demonstrated experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent — at production depth, not tutorial level Direct experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI) in production code: provider abstraction, token management, latency and cost tradeoffs RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering LLMOps fundamentals: eval harness design, prompt versioning, and production observability Cloud-native engineering maturity: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless, CI/CD, and IaC (Terraform or Helm) Strong Python; Java or equivalent backend language acceptable; production debugging and observability experience Quality of experience is weighted over years, a candidate who has shipped three production agentic systems in four years is preferred over a generalist with passive AI exposure

items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.



THE TEAM

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on.

THE ROLE

AI agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will build ours.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build the isolation layer: microVMs or containers, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, snapshot and restore.

- Own the security boundary. Customers run code they didn't write and can't fully trust — your systems make that safe.

- Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

- Write Go and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

- Partner with Product Managers to turn frontier research needs into shippable primitives.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

- You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

- You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

- Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

- 5+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

- You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

- A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join our dynamic team at Siemens Energy as a Senior Control Engineer, where your expertise will play a crucial role in shaping the future of wind power technology! Imagine tuning, optimizing, and validating control systems for cutting-edge wind turbines, ensuring they operate at peak performance throughout their lifecycle. You will collaborate closely with a talented international team of engineers, gaining insights from various disciplines such as loads and aerodynamics. Your contributions will directly enhance the competitiveness of our products, making a significant impact on the wind energy sector. How You’ll Make an Impact You will take technical responsibility for tuning, optimizing, and validating wind turbine control systems, balancing energy production, mechanical loads, and operational availability Collaborate with functionality development teams to identify and evaluate improvements to control strategies, enhancing turbine performance and reliability. Tune and optimize control parameters for various turbine types and operating conditions, ensuring stability and robustness across the defined operating envelope. Plan and execute software-in-the-loop simulations to validate control functionalities and parameter settings against performance and safety requirements. Support the commissioning and field validation of prototypes and fleet turbines, analyzing operational data to verify compliance with design specifications. What You Bring You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Control and Automation, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering, or possess equivalent relevant experience. You have proven experience in control system tuning, optimization, and validation, ideally within the wind turbine sector or similar dynamic systems. Your strong understanding of control theory and system dynamics allows you to assess trade-offs between energy production and mechanical loads effectively. Proficiency in MATLAB and Simulink is essential, along with hands-on experience in simulation-based verification and diagnosing control-related issues. You are a self-starter with excellent communication skills, capable of thriving in a global team environment and articulating technical findings clearly. Who is Siemens Energy? Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. items.desc: The briefing Every good service has an origin story. Ours starts with a broken promise. The story of Fairlo began when our founders, Jimmy and Shamon, saw first-hand how unfair and predatory lending practices can trap people in cycles of debt. Their mother had been misled by a large bank, and instead of being offered a lifeline, she was pushed further into financial difficulties. That injustice sparked something: to build a company that reimagines credit, rooted in transparency, flexibility and respect. That company became Fairlo. Current operations Since launching in 2018, Fairlo has grown to around 50,000 active customers, with a 4.7 Trustpilot rating from over 4,700 reviews. Proof that putting transparency, flexibility and people first isn't just the right thing to do. It's a winning model. We’re a tight team of 45 people based in Stockholm, Crete and the UK. Backed by some of Sweden’s most experienced investors and driven by a culture that prizes kindness, courage, collaboration and common sense, we’re very proud of what we’ve built so far. The mission Every operation needs a quartermaster. Fairlo is becoming a bank, and we’re building it to be AI-driven from the ground up. We’re bringing AI into everything we do, not just engineering: how we assess credit, how we run finance, how we serve customers, and how we work day to day. With today’s AI tools, the distance between an idea and a working solution is shrinking fast, and the people closest to our customers and our business can increasingly shape and build solutions themselves. We want to be early, not catch up later. That’s why we’re hiring AI Engineer #1. This is a new role, so there’s no roadmap to inherit. You’ll help write it. Based in our Stockholm office, you’ll report directly to our CTO and work with every part of the company: finding where AI can make the biggest difference, building the tools that make it real, and creating the platform and guardrails that keep it safe in a regulated bank. Your assignments You’ll build things people use every day, and you’ll see the impact across the whole company. As our first AI engineer, you’ll also shape how we work: how fast we try new things, and how we make sure they hold up. Others will follow your lead, so how you work matters as much as what you build. Your work will involve: Build the gadgets. Design and ship AI-powered tools and agents that change how colleagues work, from automating manual processes in operations to giving credit and finance teams answers in seconds instead of days. You’ll own them from the first conversation with users through backend, integrations, deployment and iteration. Find the next mission. Sit down with teams across Fairlo, understand their work, and spot where AI can remove friction or open up something new. Then prototype fast, test with real users, and turn what works into something reliable. Keep the lab ahead. Try new models, tools and ways of working as they appear, decide quickly what’s worth adopting, and bring what works into Fairlo safely. Run the lab on AWS. Own the foundation for how Fairlo uses AI, including Amazon Bedrock, approved AI tools, model access, logging, cost control and monitoring, so every new tool builds on solid ground. Wire the gadgets into headquarters, safely. Build integrations that give AI tools controlled, least-privilege access to our codebase, analytics and data, including MCP servers and internal APIs. Write the instruction manual. Create templates, self-serve environments and clear documentation so colleagues outside engineering can build and experiment on their own. The goal is a paved road where the safe path is also the easy one. Unlike certain famous agents, ours will actually read it. Build in the safety catch. Turn security, compliance and data-protection rules into automated checks in our CI/CD pipelines, so speed and safety go together. Train the field agents. Run workshops, coach colleagues, and share what works, so the whole company gets better at using AI. Field requirements We’re looking for someone who is hungry, fast and knows what they’re doing. You ship quickly, and what you ship is secure and built to last. We believe you: Have several years of backend engineering experience and love building complete products yourself, ideally in TypeScript / Node.js. items.desc: Goldfern is recruiting 3 x Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE III) for a UK Government AI unit. It's a small, fast-moving team that sees itself as a disruptor inside government, building AI products used directly by frontline operational teams who handle highly sensitive data. This is the unit's senior hands-on engineering role and its top priority. You'll work directly with frontline teams, find the real problems and build AI products that make a measurable difference to them. The key word is ownership. You build the whole thing yourself: front end, backend, database, AI, monitoring and deployment. Architecting it, or directing others who built it, doesn't count. You'll usually run several projects at once and work alongside more junior engineers, so explaining technical decisions clearly and supporting others carries real weight. What you'll be building • LLM and agent workflows, retrieval (RAG), speech-to-text, translation and document intelligence • Data pipelines and production AI services, built with the people who use them and improved from their feedback • Products handling sensitive data, with access control, human review and audit trails built in from the start What we're looking for • You have personally shipped an AI product end to end into live use, with a clear before and after: users, time saved, cost reduced. A list of technologies isn't evidence • Equal strength across front end and backend. Strong backend and AI work where someone else built the UI is read as a gap, and the same applies the other way round. You can talk in depth about component structure, state management, data fetching and performance, and you've built more than one basic screen: separate views for different users, admin or operations tooling, or several workflows in one product • Production Python APIs, ideally FastAPI: routers, dependency injection, Pydantic models, async and background tasks, database access and migrations, and serving AI features such as streamed model responses • Authentication and security done properly: identity provider integration (ideally Microsoft Entra ID, covering app registrations, token validation, roles and scopes), least-privilege access, secrets management, service isolation, logging and monitoring • A solid understanding of how AI systems behave and fail: context engineering, retrieval, tool-using agents, unpredictable model output, prompt injection and over-privileged tools • Working directly with users where there's no fixed spec, and a methodical approach to debugging that owns problems through to a real fix The stack (or demonstrably similar) • Next.js and React, Python and FastAPI, Postgres • Microsoft Azure (App Service, Blob Storage, Postgres, Terraform-managed containers) and Microsoft Entra ID If you've built on a different stack, you'll need to show how you'd build the same thing on this one. Desirable • Designing AI safeguards: prompt injection defences, least-privilege tools, human approval points and audit trails • Delivery in a regulated, safety-critical or high-consequence setting • Taking a product from prototype to adoption at scale • Sensible build-versus-buy decisions and integrating third-party models and data services • A start-up background, and mentoring other engineers • Current SC clearance The practicalities • 12-month contract, day rate, inside IR35 via an umbrella company • Hybrid, with regular time on site in London, Manchester, Glasgow or Cardiff • BPSS required before starting. SC isn't needed to start and will be progressed alongside; it normally requires around five years' UK residence • Start: as soon as clearance allows • You must be based in the UK with the existing right to work here. Applications from candidates based overseas will not be considered The process is quick: a single informal, conversational interview with the hiring team. Expect to talk through real examples of what you've built, including what went wrong and to that end, please ensure that your CV and supporting information covers all of the above. You must be UK based and eligible for security clearance. lester@goldfern.co.uk

items.desc: TL;DR → You design and build production-grade RAG and agentic AI systems end-to-end. From use-case definition through to a working interface in users' hands. → Consulting across the Nordics, with clients spanning industries from financial services to manufacturing. → You work in cross-functional delivery teams alongside Data Engineers and Platform Engineers, each owning a distinct layer of the stack. → Certifications without a debate. Colleagues who are obsessed with the craft. Freedom to grow your way. What you'll do As a GenAI Developer, you own the AI application layer end-to-end: the systems that ingest, retrieve, reason, and respond, plus the lightweight interfaces that put them in front of users. You're the person closest to the end customer. You turn a business problem into a working use-case, from gathering requirements and aligning stakeholders to shipping a production system people actually use. You come in before the solution is defined. Together with the client, you shape what gets built, then you build it. You work alongside Data Engineers and Platform Engineers, each owning a distinct layer of the stack. Your layer is where the model meets the business problem, and where the user meets the product. A few examples of what this looks like in practice: A production RAG system for a financial services client, letting internal teams navigate regulatory documentation using generative AI. From ingestion through to answer generation, quality evaluation, and a lightweight front-end for day-to-day use. An agentic AI solution in the FinOps space, applying LLM reasoning over infrastructure data to drive cloud cost optimization beyond what rule-based tooling can handle. AI capability building at enterprise clients: use-case workshops, requirements definition, and architecture advisory on agents and coding tools for senior technical audiences. The bar for what "done" means here is high: production-grade, observable, secure and used. What you get Assignments that accelerate you. Every 6–18 months you're in a new engagement. New industry, new architecture decisions, new stakeholders to earn trust from. You'll face more distinct technical challenges in two years here than most engineers see in five. Work that's hard to come by elsewhere. Agentic AI in enterprise environments is one of the most technically demanding spaces in the industry right now. The problems here aren't solved yet, and you'll be among the people solving them. Your direction, your call. Want to go deep technically and become the go-to person for enterprise AI architecture? Go for it. Want to lead client engagements, own stakeholder relationships and drive use-cases from discovery to production? Also go for it. Both paths are real and equally valued. People who make you better. The people here are genuinely passionate about technology, not as a job, but as something they care about. Engineers who go deep because they want to, follow the space obsessively, and get restless when things stop moving. That's what keeps Redeploy consistently ahead, and it's what you'll feel from day one. The perks. 30 days vacation · hybrid work and flexible hours · private medical insurance · pension (ITP1) · wellness allowance 5,000 SEK · free choice of tools and tech · free breakfast, soda and snacks · yearly gatherings and AW's · a team with genuine interests outside work — gaming, food, running, padel, golf, football, cycling. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! items.desc: Role title: AI Engineer Location: UK Nationwide (2x a month in the Cheltenham office- hybrid working) Salary: Competitive salary and package (Depending on level of experience) Please Note: Any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory BPSS and SC security clearance which requires 5 years continuous UK address history (typically including no periods of 30 consecutive days or more spent outside of the UK) at the point of application. The above information relates to a specific client requirement' We are looking for an AI Engineer to develop and optimise AI agents and LLM-powered applications that will help advance Accenture’s Security Operations Centre (SOC) capabilities. Working closely with security engineers and SOC analysts, you will design, build and operationalise AI-powered workflows that integrate with security tooling and help accelerate threat detection and response. You’ll bring strong AI engineering expertise, with hands-on experience building production-ready LLM applications, agentic workflows and RAG solutions. Previous Cyber Security Experience Is Advantageous But Not Essential. We are at an exciting point in the evolution of defensive cyber operations, with AI playing an increasingly important role in responding to a rapidly evolving threat landscape. We’re looking for innovative, practical engineers who want to apply their AI expertise to this challenge. Responsibilities LLM Configuration: Configure, evaluate and tune large language models for security use cases, including prompt engineering, system prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool/function calling. Agent Development: Design, build and maintain AI agents and agentic workflows using platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, integrating with security toolsets such as SOAR, SIEM and EDR. Secure Configuration: Implement safeguards to protect against adversarial inputs, including prompt injection and jailbreaks, ensuring AI systems meet robust security standards. System Architecture: Architect AI solutions that are modular, maintainable and built to scale, following secure development principles. Governance: Implement solutions in line with our AI governance framework, covering areas such as data handling, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls and regulatory compliance. Cost Management: Monitor and optimise LLM API usage and infrastructure costs, implementing strategies such as caching, model tiering and guardrails to ensure solutions are economically viable. Collaboration: Work closely with key stakeholders, security engineers and SOC analysts to understand operational challenges, prototype solutions and iterate based on feedback. Documentation: Produce clear technical documentation to support the effective ongoing management of developed capabilities. Essential: We are looking for: 2+ years of experience within AI/ML engineering. Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-powered applications in production environments, including appropriate observability and evaluation mechanisms. Practical experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or similar. Strong understanding of LLM concepts and vector databases, including context windows, temperature and sampling parameters, system prompts and tool/function calling. Experience implementing RAG pipelines end-to-end, including data ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding model selection and retrieval tuning. Experience implementing parsing pipelines for tasks such as document processing and ingestion, including handling unstructured data. Knowledge of AI security risks, including familiarity with the OWASP LLM Top 10, and an understanding of how these risks can be mitigated. Experience working within enterprise governance frameworks. Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, and familiarity with common AI/ML libraries. Ability to build custom tools that can interact with, or be exposed to, LLMs. Strong understanding of REST APIs, with the ability to integrate AI solutions with third-party platforms and internal tooling. Desirable: The following would be beneficial but are not essential: Previous experience within cyber security or security operations. Knowledge of enterprise security tooling such as SOAR, SIEM and EDR. Experience applying AI to security operations, threat detection or incident response. Experience deploying infrastructure-as-code. What We're Looking For A collaborative and engaging approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to work as part of a wider team. Self-motivated, results-focused and pragmatic, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines. Someone who values diversity and recognises the innovation and competitive advantage that comes from diverse, highly skilled teams where equal opportunities are genuinely valued.

items.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Germany
items.card: In this role, you'll be the hands-on AI builder defense and intelligence customers rely on. You’ll deploy ICEYE’s intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and rapidly ship AI-powered workflows on top of it—everything from Docker-based deployments to RAG systems fusing SAR imagery with intelligence reports. This is a ship-code-daily role: turning raw satellite data into mission-critical tools
items.desc: Role Highlights Role: Forward Deployed AI Engineer Department: Forward Deployed Engineering Location: Germany Reports to: VP, Forward Deployed Engineering Working type: Hybrid (On-site at customer locations approx. 50% of time) German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung Ü1/Ü2/Ü3) Must be eligible and able to attain relevant national and NATO security clearances Must be based in-country and native level speaker of the country you're deploying to. The Mission of the Forward Deployed AI Engineer In this role, you'll be the hands-on AI builder defense and intelligence customers rely on. You’ll deploy ICEYE’s intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and rapidly ship AI-powered workflows on top of it—everything from Docker-based deployments to RAG systems fusing SAR imagery with intelligence reports. This is a ship-code-daily role: turning raw satellite data into mission-critical tools analysts use to protect nations. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Day To Day Responsibilities Platform Deployment & Integration Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on-premise, air-gapped networks, classified data centers). Build and maintain containerized applications (Docker) and manage deployments in customer Kubernetes clusters. Develop APIs and data pipelines connecting ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools. Troubleshoot deployment issues in disconnected environments without external internet access. AI Solution Development & Customization Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that combine ICEYE SAR data with customer intelligence documents for context-aware analysis. Develop AI agents and workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar tools to automate analytical tasks. Implement prompt engineering strategies and conversational AI interfaces that enable analysts to query satellite data using natural language. Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI systems with customer data sources. Data Fusion & Intelligence Workflows Build data fusion pipelines combining SAR imagery with additional intelligence sources (AIS, RF signals, optical imagery, SIGINT). Develop automated workflows that correlate and cross-reference information across different data modalities. Create lightweight tools, dashboards, and alerting systems tailored to customer operational needs. Customer Engagement & Rapid Prototyping Work embedded with intelligence analysts, data scientists, and military operators to understand mission-critical problems. Rapidly prototype AI-powered solutions (code first, polish later) that address immediate operational requirements. Conduct hands-on training sessions on platform capabilities and AI workflow usage. Gather customer feedback and translate it into technical requirements for ICEYE's product and engineering teams. What we are looking for Must Have Skills 3+ years hands-on software engineering building and deploying production systems. Strong Python programming skills (required) plus one of: Go, TypeScript, or Rust. Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG systems. Working knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, pydantic-ai) and vector databases. Experience with Docker and deploying in secure / isolated / air-gapped environments. Practical experience with APIs, data pipelines, and integrating systems in production, Familiarity with Linux and basic Kubernetes operations. Builder mindset: ship fast, iterate with feedback, and prioritize working solutions over perfect architecture. Strong communication + customer engagement, able to work embedded with intelligence analysts / military operators. Strong spoken and written English, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Willingness to travel 40–60% to customer sites within the region. Nice To Have Skills Experience in defense, intelligence, or government operational environments. Deploying to on-prem data centers and/or air-gapped networks. Familiarity with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote sensing. Experience with MCP integrations, …

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture About This Role We are seeking an experienced Python and Django Software Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team in Romania. Working closely with security engineers and SOC analysts, you will design, build and operationalise AI-powered workflows that integrate with security tooling and help accelerate threat detection and response. You’ll bring strong AI engineering expertise, with hands-on experience building production-ready LLM applications, agentic workflows and RAG solutions. Previous Cyber Security Experience Is Advantageous But Not Essential. We are at an exciting point in the evolution of defensive cyber operations, with AI playing an increasingly important role in responding to a rapidly evolving threat landscape. We’re looking for innovative, practical engineers who want to apply their AI expertise to this challenge. Responsibilities LLM Configuration: Configure, evaluate and tune large language models for security use cases, including prompt engineering, system prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool/function calling. Agent Development: Design, build and maintain AI agents and agentic workflows using platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, integrating with security toolsets such as SOAR, SIEM and EDR. Secure Configuration: Implement safeguards to protect against adversarial inputs, including prompt injection and jailbreaks, ensuring AI systems meet robust security standards. System Architecture: Architect AI solutions that are modular, maintainable and built to scale, following secure development principles. Governance: Implement solutions in line with our AI governance framework, covering areas such as data handling, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls and regulatory compliance. Cost Management: Monitor and optimise LLM API usage and infrastructure costs, implementing strategies such as caching, model tiering and guardrails to ensure solutions are economically viable. Collaboration: Work closely with key stakeholders, security engineers and SOC analysts to understand operational challenges, prototype solutions and iterate based on feedback. Documentation: Produce clear technical documentation to support the effective ongoing management of developed capabilities. Essential: We are looking for: 2+ years of experience within AI/ML engineering. Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-powered applications in production environments, including appropriate observability and evaluation mechanisms. Practical experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or similar. Strong understanding of LLM concepts and vector databases, including context windows, temperature and sampling parameters, system prompts and tool/function calling. Experience implementing RAG pipelines end-to-end, including data ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding model selection and retrieval tuning. Experience implementing parsing pipelines for tasks such as document processing and ingestion, including handling unstructured data. Knowledge of AI security risks, including familiarity with the OWASP LLM Top 10, and an understanding of how these risks can be mitigated. Experience working within enterprise governance frameworks. Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, and familiarity with common AI/ML libraries. Ability to build custom tools that can interact with, or be exposed to, LLMs. Strong understanding of REST APIs, with the ability to integrate AI solutions with third-party platforms and internal tooling. Desirable: The following would be beneficial but are not essential: Previous experience within cyber security or security operations. Knowledge of enterprise security tooling such as SOAR, SIEM and EDR. Experience applying AI to security operations, threat detection or incident response. Experience deploying infrastructure-as-code. What We're Looking For A collaborative and engaging approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to work as part of a wider team. Self-motivated, results-focused and pragmatic, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines. Someone who values diversity and recognises the innovation and competitive advantage that comes from diverse, highly skilled teams where equal opportunities are genuinely valued.

items.desc: Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. Role description: The AI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting AI-powered solutions that improve business processes, employee experiences, and operational efficiency across Arcadis. The AI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting AI-powered solutions that improve business processes, employee experiences, and operational efficiency across Arcadis. Working as part of a global technology team, this role will help build and enhance AI agents, copilots, automations, and integrations using technologies such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Model Context Protocol (MCP), custom connectors, Power Platform, and Azure cloud services . This position is ideal for a developer who is passionate about emerging AI technologies and enjoys combining software development, automation, integration, and problem-solving to deliver practical business solutions. Role accountabilities: Develop, test, and deploy AI-powered applications, copilots, agents, and automation solutions. Build solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Power Platform technologies. Develop integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems through APIs, MCP tools, custom connectors, and other integration technologies. Assist in creating reusable components, templates, and development patterns that support scalable solution delivery. Support the implementation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, document ingestion, and knowledge search capabilities. Support proof-of-concept and pilot initiatives to evaluate emerging AI technologies and capabilities. Participate in Agile delivery processes, including sprint planning, development, testing, and deployment activities. Document solutions, integrations, and technical processes to support ongoing operations and future development. Follow established security, privacy, and compliance standards in the design and delivery of AI solutions. Support implementation of Responsible AI practices, including content safety, transparency, and governance requirements. Work with cybersecurity and platform teams to ensure secure access to enterprise data and services. Qualifications & Experience: 2–5 years of experience in software development, automation, application development, or related technical roles. Experience developing solutions using at least one modern programming language such as Python, C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Experience building integrations using APIs, web services, or cloud platforms. Familiarity with Azure cloud services and modern development practices. Understanding of AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation concepts. Experience working within Agile development teams. Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar AI platforms - nice to have Experience developing MCP tools, custom connectors, plugins, or API-based integrations - nice to have Why Arcadis? We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people.

items.desc: About Waystone Waystone is a leading asset-servicing solutions provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to financial institutions. With over 25 years’ experience and a comprehensive range of specialist services to its name, Waystone helps our clients structure, operate and grow through our expertise, innovation and digitisation, backed by the operational scale to support global expansion Summary: Reporting to the AI & Automation Manager, the AI Engineer is responsible for embedding artificial intelligence capabilities into Waystone’s engineering, automation, and assurance ecosystems. Acting as a bridge between cutting‑edge AI technologies and existing high‑code and low‑code platforms, the role focuses on AI enablement rather than foundational model building, ensuring intelligence is thoughtfully integrated into systems and workflows. The AI Engineer designs, develops, and assures AI-enabled solutions, improves automation efficiency, elevates engineering quality, and mentors teams on responsible and effective AI adoption. The mission is to drive innovation, productivity, and intelligent automation across Waystone while upholding compliance, security, and architectural integrity. The role requires strong hands‑on engineering skills, practical understanding of agentic AI patterns, and the ability to guide teams on effective and responsible AI usage. Essential Duties And Responsibilities AI Enablement and Integration: Hands-on contributor to the design and development of AI-enabled solutions, capable of writing both production-quality code and rapid experimental prototypes. Develop and implement AI‑enabled microservices, APIs, applications, and internal tools. Integrate AI capabilities following secure, scalable engineering best practices. Design, build and validate AI‑driven solutions leveraging providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic. Enhance low‑code/no‑code automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate, n8n, Workato) by embedding intelligent processing and applying agentic patterns where relevant. Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for secure AI‑to‑system connectivity. Lead AI‑based document parsing and intelligent data extraction initiatives. Contribute to educating and enabling Enterprise Capabilities areas, including Integration and Automation, by providing guidance, training, and best practices, e.g., on effective use of n8n agents. Engage with business stakeholders to understand requirements, constraints, and key drivers, identifying and implementing high‑value AI opportunities across Waystone. AI Engineering Prototype AI features and iterate towards production‑ready capabilities. Build agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework, with a solid understanding of agent fundamentals (tools, memory, orchestration, context control). Implement AI agents with tool integration, memory, context control, and guardrails. Develop retrieval‑augmented workflows to enhance context, reliability, and performance. Perform quality assurance on AI outputs by implementing robust AI observability practices, including monitoring model behaviour, detecting anomalies, and ensuring visibility into AI performance and reliability. Contribute to ongoing research and development, staying current with emerging AI tools, frameworks, and techniques to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement. Apply sound judgment to determine when not to use AI, ensuring traditional deterministic solutions are chosen when they are safer, simpler, or more cost effective. Ensure AI-enabled solutions consider full total cost of ownership, including token consumption, performance, observability, and ongoing maintenance, with awareness of cost‑efficiency and model‑selection trade‑ Knowledge Sharing, Mentoring And Governance Mentor and support both technical and non‑technical staff (e.g. citizen developers), fostering knowledge sharing and strengthening AI fluency across Waystone. Act as AI subject matter expert for engineering, testing, architecture teams, as well as business functions across the wider organisation. Deliver demos, internal evangelism, and produce reference documentation. Nurture the wider internal community, helping uplift AI adoption and responsible, high‑value usage across the business. Lead the design and documentation of AI-enabled solutions, contributing to Solution In Principle (SIP) or Solution Architecture Design (SAD) documents as needed. Collaborate with delivery teams throughout the project lifecycles, offering guidance on AI-enabled solutions and addressing technical challenges as they arise. items.desc: Senior AI Engineer | LegalTech | Remote (UK) – Salary DoE + Equity How do you get an LLM to reliably work across 10,000 pages of medical and legal documents? How do you evaluate its output, reduce hallucinations and build AI systems people can actually rely on? These are some of the problems you’ll be solving. I’m working with a LegalTech business that has raised £7.4m and is building AI deeply into its claims management platform. Their AI products are already being used across areas such as medical document summarisation, document extraction and querying, with a broader roadmap around AI-assisted case handling and intelligent workflows. They’re now looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the team and help build the next generation of these systems. This isn’t a role where you’ll be wrapping an API around ChatGPT. The team has built its own agent architecture and is working with AWS Bedrock, Anthropic models, RAG and large-scale document processing , with a major focus on evaluation, reliability and quality. You’ll be hands-on across the AI stack, working on problems such as: Building and improving production RAG systems Developing agentic AI workflows Working with large, complex document sets Evaluating new models and approaches Building automated evaluation and quality frameworks Reducing hallucinations and improving groundedness Productionising new AI capabilities Improving reliability, performance and cost What are we looking for? Strong hands-on AI Engineering experience Experience building and shipping AI systems into production Strong knowledge of RAG and agentic architectures Experience with LLM evaluation, benchmarking and AI quality AWS experience, ideally including Bedrock Strong Python engineering experience Comfortable owning technical problems from experimentation through to production Nice to have Experience working with regulated or sensitive data LegalTech, HealthTech, FinTech or InsurTech experience Claude / Anthropic experience Voice or conversational AI experience .NET / C# exposure The package Generous base salary, dependent on experience EMI equity Remote-first across the UK Roughly monthly travel to Yorkshire 25 days holiday + bank holidays AXA healthcare Opportunity to work on genuinely complex production AI problems as the platform scales The interview process is straightforward. An initial conversation with the team, followed by a technical deep dive into what you’ve actually built, the decisions you made and how you approach production AI systems, then a final conversation with the wider team. Interested? Reach out to me directly or click the apply button and let’s get talking. Call: 020 3769 9017 Email: mo@kairostalent.ai Please note: you must be eligible to work in the UK to be considered for this role. Interested in other opportunities? items.desc: About the Role Are you passionate about building state-of-the-art agentic systems, context architectures, and scalable AI infrastructure? We are seeking a Senior AI Systems Engineer & Architect to serve as a technical authority across our AI engineering initiatives. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level architectural vision and hands-on engineering execution. You’ll lead the design and implementation of production-grade multi-agent frameworks, advanced context and memory systems, and enterprise LLMOps pipelines—setting the technical standards that empower engineering teams to build reliable, high-performance AI solutions at scale. What You’ll Do Design Next-Gen Agentic Architectures: Architect and deploy production-ready multi-agent workflows, establishing robust patterns for agent loops, tool execution, state management, retry strategies, and fail-safe recovery. Advance Context & Knowledge Systems: Build scalable retrieval, memory, and knowledge graph architectures (including GraphRAG, LPG, and RDF) to optimize LLM reasoning and contextual awareness. Drive Interoperability & Integration: Establish standardized, reusable AI capabilities, skills, and plugins utilizing cutting-edge protocols such as MCP, A2A, and custom tool-calling frameworks. Elevate AI Reliability & LLMOps: Set up comprehensive evaluation frameworks, test harnesses, observability platforms, and production debugging standards across the entire AI lifecycle. Optimize System Performance: Lead strategies around token economics, inference efficiency, dynamic model routing, latency reduction, and cost optimization. Shape AI Engineering Standards: Partner cross-functionally with Product, Architecture, and Domain Experts to define technology roadmaps and drive best practices across AI-assisted SDLC and modern AI UX patterns (such as AG-UI and human-in-the-loop workflows). What We’re Looking For Deep AI Engineering Expertise: Proven track record of architecting and deploying agentic systems, multi-agent orchestrations, and advanced RAG/retrieval frameworks in production. Core Software Engineering Rigor: Strong foundation in distributed systems, spec-driven development, Test-Driven Development (TDD), Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and modern API design. Ecosystem Mastery: Deep familiarity with modern AI protocols and tools (e.g., Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A), agentic coding tools, and evaluation frameworks). Multimodal Capabilities: Experience or strong interest in multimodal AI execution spanning text, voice, and vision systems. Technical Leadership: Natural ability to mentor engineering teams, influence technical direction, and establish reusable architectural patterns across complex environments. Why Join Us? Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Work directly on leading-edge agentic AI, context engineering, and multimodal systems at the forefront of the industry. High-Impact Leadership: Own key technical decisions and set the benchmark for enterprise AI engineering standard methodologies. Collaborative Environment: Join a forward-thinking culture that values software engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

items.desc: Job Description At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people. Building a Finance Data & AI Analytics capability in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We are seeking a Generative AI Engineer to design, build, test, and operate AI-powered applications that automate the generation and consumption of financial statistics sourced from multiple world regions. The role combines hands-on GenAI engineering with financial data, web application, and analytics capabilities, supporting global and regional Finance stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Design and develop GenAI applications that retrieve, transform, interpret, and present financial statistics from governed internal data sources and data pages. Build AI agents for repetitive, rules-based tasks and agentic applications for complex, open-ended Finance use cases. Integrate in-house LLMs with applications, data pages, structured datasets, and supporting services. Develop modular AI architectures with independently testable components, clear interfaces, reusable services, and maintainable code. Implement AI orchestration workflows, tool use, retrieval, prompt patterns, and state management using the LangChain family of tools or equivalent frameworks. Design and enforce guardrails for accuracy, safety, access control, data confidentiality, and predictable agent behavior. Build evaluation and A/B testing approaches for prompts, agents, workflows, and user-facing outputs; monitor quality and improve iteratively. Develop lightweight web interfaces and services using HTML and modern web frameworks; support on-premise and cloud deployment patterns. Partner with Finance and Data/BI stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions and data products. Document technical designs, data flows, test cases, operating procedures, and model/agent behavior. Contribute to the broader analytics capability, including forecasting, anomaly detection, intelligent automation, and decision-support use cases. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field. 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, data analytics engineering, or a closely related discipline. Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or agentic workflows. Practical experience with AI orchestration frameworks and the LangChain family of tools or equivalent technologies. Experience integrating LLMs with applications, APIs, databases, or structured/unstructured data sources. Ability to design modular, testable software components and establish automated evaluation/testing for AI behavior. Experience implementing guardrails, validation, monitoring, and quality controls for AI-enabled applications. Working knowledge of Python and web technologies, including HTML; experience deploying applications on-premise or in cloud environments. Strong communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to data quality and reliable outputs. Preferred Finance or data analytics domain knowledge, especially financial statistics, FP&A, reporting, forecasting, or business performance analysis. Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases; familiarity with Snowflake or similar data platforms. Experience with Django, Gradio, FastAPI, or similar frameworks for AI-enabled web applications. Experience with prompt engineering, RAG, structured outputs/function calling, model evaluation, or LLM observability. Experience with BI/reporting ecosystems and governed enterprise data products. If YOU are the person we are looking for, feel free to apply and let's start drafting your future career in a healthy and growing environment! The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities. OUR CORE PRINCIPALS : Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Diversity & Inclusion. OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES Customer Focus Operational Excellence High-Performance Culture Innovation Financial Strength OUR BEHAVIORS Own It Act With Urgency Foster a Customer-First Mindset Think Big and Execute Lead by Example Drive Continuous Improvement Learn and Seek Out Development

items.desc: Job ID REF64764E Date posted 21/10/2026 Localisation Milan, Italy Job IT Design & Development Contract type Standard Descrizione dell'azienda Veolia è leader mondiale nei servizi ambientali e si impegna ogni giorno a rafforzare la sicurezza ecologica, a tutela della salute pubblica e della competitività delle imprese e dei territori. Presente in cinque continenti, il Gruppo contrasta l’inquinamento, riduce le emissioni di carbonio e rigenera le risorse con soluzioni concrete nei settori dell’acqua e delle tecnologie idriche, della gestione dei rifiuti — anche pericolosi — e dell’energia locale. In Italia da oltre 100 anni, Veolia affianca clienti pubblici e privati nel percorso di decarbonizzazione, attraverso interventi integrati di efficientamento energetico e produzione locale di energie rinnovabili. Gestiamo 14.500 edifici, tra scuole, ospedali e immobili pubblici e privati, e 180 siti industriali, contribuendo a rendere più sicuri, efficienti e sostenibili i luoghi in cui le persone vivono, studiano e si curano. Guidati dalla sostenibilità e dall'innovazione, contiamo su un team di oltre 3.200 persone che uniscono uno storico know-how alle potenzialità dei nuovi strumenti digitali e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale e gestiamo oltre 3.000 strutture sanitarie, coprendo circa il 25% dei posti letto del Paese, e finanziamo opere pubbliche attraverso iniziative di Partenariato Pubblico Privato. Siamo tra le prime aziende in Italia certificate UNI ISO 56001 per la gestione dell'innovazione. Il digitale è il cuore della nostra offerta: sviluppiamo partnership di eccellenza e utilizziamo soluzioni avanzate - come la suite Hubgrade, Green Path, Flexcity e algoritmi di AI per il building energy optimizer - per ottimizzare i consumi e guidare i nostri partner nella transizione ecologica. Nell’ultimo anno sono oltre 132.000 le tonnellate di CO2 risparmiate e 200 gli impianti di depurazione acque gestiti e 33.000 le tonnellate di rifiuti liquidi e solidi speciali intermediati. Cosa troverai in Veolia Italia? In Veolia crediamo che le persone siano il motore del cambiamento: valorizziamo il talento coniugando il radicamento territoriale e la solidità della tradizione con l'innovazione e la trasformazione digitale. Entrerai a far parte di un team dinamico e inclusivo dove potrai mettere a frutto le tue competenze per costruire concretamente un futuro più sostenibile. Inoltre diverse sono le opportunità volte a favorire il benessere della persona con un'attenzione particolare ad un sano equilibrio tra vita privata e lavorativa: Salute e benessere: offriamo un ampio pacchetto di benefit, tra cui assicurazione sanitaria Metasalute, piano welfare, ticket restaurant e servizio di supporto psicologico gratuito; Formazione e sviluppo: investiamo nella crescita professionale offrendo corsi e percorsi di formazione tecnica e sulle soft skills, per favorire lo sviluppo continuo delle competenze e accompagnarti nella gestione del tuo talento; Famiglia e Genitorialità: Offriamo flessibilità e agevolazioni concrete per madri e padri. Vogliamo che tu possa conciliare serenamente la vita professionale con quella familiare; Sostegno alle cure e Caregiving: promuoviamo il benessere e l'autonomia con webinar psico-educativi dedicati al caregiving e garantiamo pieno supporto, permessi retribuiti e congedi per i lavoratori con disabilità; Smart Working: favoriamo un ambiente di lavoro flessibile, offrendo opzioni di Smart working e orari flessibili per migliorare il tuo equilibrio tra vita professionale e personale; Impegno sociale: incoraggiamo la partecipazione attiva nella comunità offrendo a tutti i dipendenti 1 giornata retribuita all’anno da dedicare ad attività di volontariato presso enti o associazioni no profit; Mobilità internazionale : promuoviamo lo sviluppo professionale e personale grazie alle tante opportunità derivanti dalle dimensioni globali e dalla diversità delle competenze presenti nell'organizzazione. Descrizione del lavoro La risorsa sarà inserita all'interno del Team Data Science nella direzione Digital Business & Technology (DB&T) di Milano. Il ruolo rappresenta un'opportunità concreta di contribuire attivamente a progetti di Digital & Data Transformation con un focus specifico sulle tecnologie di Generative AI, partecipando allo sviluppo e alla configurazione di soluzioni AI innovative su dati reali provenienti da impianti energetici, edifici gestiti e processi operativi aziendali. In particolare, la risorsa si occuperà delle seguenti attività: Configurazione e sviluppo di AI Agent su piattaforma aziendale VeoliaSecureGPT e su altre piattaforme GenAI, per l'automazione di processi e il supporto decisionale alle diverse funzioni aziendali; Supporto alla progettazione e implementazione di soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM), con particolare attenzione a tecniche di prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e fine-tuning; Mappa e documenta i processi delle aree di business. items.desc: Software Engineer - Energy | Job details Software Engineer - Energy We are looking for a Software Engineer - Energy to join our Energy department based in Louvain-la-Neuve . Who we are N-SIDE is a world leader in increasing the efficiency of life sciences and energy industries by providing software and services that optimize the use of natural resources, facilitating the transition to a more sustainable world. To achieve this, N-SIDE leverages its deep industry knowledge, technical expertise, and understanding of applied mathematics to help global pharmaceutical and energy companies anticipate, adapt, and optimize their decisions. N-SIDE is driven by a diverse team of over 200 passionate engineers, computer scientists, and business experts from 30+ different nationalities, with 25% holding PhDs. Together, they are committed to making a meaningful impact toward a more sustainable future. We are continuously looking at how we can support system operators (TSOs, DSOs, Transcos, and Integrated Utilities) with advanced grid optimization tools. System operators face a tremendous challenge. They are under heavy pressure to upgrade and expand their networks fast - but face shrinking time windows available to execute this work. Our standardized solutions enable operators to maximize work throughput while maintaining uncompromised grid safety, efficiency, and reliability. As a Software Engineer - Energy , you will help the company be the top reference in Advanced Analytics Solutions for energy power systems. You will contribute in particular to the inception, development, and validation of a new optimization platform, aimed to help system operators better execute expanding CAPEX and maintenance programs within tighter, less predictable execution windows. What you’ll do Together with the N-SIDE team, and more particularly the GEO task force, you will help incept, develop and deliver a new grid execution optimization platform: Collaborate with the product owners, analysts and tech lead to gather and analyze requirements, and design software solutions that meet business needs. Lead backend developments & rapid prototyping. Implement new features and do the maintenance of a Spring Boot backend codebase (Web MVC, JPA, Security, ,...), including, among others algorithm, servers, APIs (Rest API, …) and databases. Contribute to the integration of some of our existing solutions at customers to get acquainted with the tech stack. Participate in containerization (Docker), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm charts, Argo, …), continuous integration & continuous deployment aspects. As a Software Engineer, you will also participate in the technical growth of the product and team. You will therefore: Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in software development. Depending on your seniority level, you may also mentor junior developers, providing technical guidance and fostering their growth within the team. Contribute to a positive and inclusive work environment, promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing. By providing qualitative code reviews and participating in technical choices around our product, you will ensure that the team develops an efficient, reusable, and reliable code, and that they adhere to coding standards, best practices, and company guidelines. About you You have a master in Computer Science or Software Development; or a bachelor with minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience. You have solid programming skills. Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot is a must. You demonstrate extensive knowledge of Spring Web MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security. You are interested in software design and wish to contribute and evolve in that career path. You demonstrate excellent problem-solving abilities. You are able to break down complex problems into manageable components and devise efficient solutions. You have a continuous learning mindset. The tech stack is constantly evolving, so a willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and best practices is essential for long-term success. You have a great team spirit, creativity, sense of initiative and responsibility. You are willing to share your knowledge and, depending on your seniority level, to mentor junior profiles. Leveraging agentic coding for rapid prototyping and proof-of-concepts has no secret for you. You are also able to take AI integration to a higher level: everything we build will leverage AI directly or be architected as AI-native (e.g., agent or LLM-powered apps, scalable model interfaces, etc…) You are fluent in English. Nice to have: Mathematical optimization Other Spring tools Build tools (Gradle/Maven) Database management (SQL / NoSQL) Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, …) Experience in or interest for building user interfaces Python Knowledge in the Energy sector Travel: 5% Start date: ASAP Our offer What’s important for us is that you grow and …
